Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section SEQUENCES.

Variable A: Type.

Variable R: A -> A -> Prop.

Inductive star: A -> A -> Prop :=
  | star_refl: forall a,
      star a a
  | star_step: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> star a c.

Inductive plus: A -> A -> Prop :=
  | plus_left: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> plus a c.

Definition all_seq_inf (a: A) : Prop :=
  forall b, star a b -> exists c, R b c.

Definition infseq_with_function (a: A) : Prop :=
  exists f: nat -> A, f 0 = a /\ forall i, R (f i) (f (1 + i)).

CoInductive infseq: A -> Prop :=
  | infseq_step: forall a b,
      R a b -> infseq b -> infseq a.

Definition irred (a: A) : Prop := forall b, ~(R a b).

End SEQUENCES.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions.

Close Scope string_scope.

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y
  end.

Definition subst_path (z: var) (q: path) (p: path) : path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => sel_fields (subst_avar z q x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (p: path) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z p D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => subst_typ z p T1 ∧ subst_typ z p T2
  | q ↓ L          => subst_path z p q ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (subst_typ z p T)
  | ∀(T) U         => ∀ (subst_typ z p T) subst_typ z p U
  | {{ q }}        => {{ subst_path z p q }}
  end
with subst_dec (z: var) (p: path) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | {A >: T <: U} => {A >: subst_typ z p T <: subst_typ z p U}
  | {a ⦂ U}        => {a ⦂ subst_typ z p U }
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: path) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => trm_val (subst_val z u v)
  | trm_path p       => trm_path (subst_path z u p)
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_path z u x1) (subst_path z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  end
with subst_val (z: var) (u: path) (v: val) : val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds  => ν(subst_typ z u T) subst_defs z u ds
  | λ(T) t   => λ(subst_typ z u T) subst_trm z u t
  end
with subst_def (z: var) (u: path) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (subst_typ z u T)
  | { a := t }  => { a := subst_defrhs z u t }
  end
with subst_defs (z: var) (u: path) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end
with subst_defrhs (z: var) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (subst_path z u p)
  | defv v => defv (subst_val z u v)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx (z: var) (p: path) (G: ctx) : ctx :=
  map (subst_typ z p) G.

Definition named_path p := exists x bs, p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Definitions Binding.

Reserved Notation "γ '⟦' t '⤳' u '⟧'" (at level 40).

Inductive lookup_step : sta -> def_rhs -> def_rhs -> Prop :=




| lookup_var : forall γ x v,
    binds x v γ ->
    γ ⟦ pvar x ⤳ defv v ⟧




| lookup_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    γ ⟦ p•a ⤳ defp (q•a) ⟧




| lookup_sel_v : forall γ p a t T ds,
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (val_new T ds) ⟧ ->
    defs_has ds { a := t } ->
    γ ⟦ p•a ⤳ open_defrhs_p p t ⟧

where "γ '⟦' p '⤳' t '⟧'" := (lookup_step γ (defp p) t).

Notation "γ '⟦' t '⤳*' u '⟧'" := (star (lookup_step γ) t u) (at level 40).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

Notation "p '••' bs" := (sel_fields p bs) (at level 5).

Definition label_of_def(d: def): label := match d with
| def_typ A _ => label_typ A
| { a := t }  => label_trm a
end.

Definition label_of_dec(D: dec): label := match D with
| { A >: _ <: _ } => label_typ A
| { a ⦂ _ }  => label_trm a
end.

Fixpoint get_def(l: label)(ds: defs): option def :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of_def d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of_def d) ds = Some d.

Definition defs_hasnt(ds: defs)(l: label) := get_def l ds = None.

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path k u p ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2      => ∀(open_rec_typ k u T1) open_rec_typ (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ k u T <: open_rec_typ k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path k u p) (open_rec_path k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val (k: nat) (u: var) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T)ds   => ν (open_rec_typ (S k) u T) open_rec_defs (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ k u T) open_rec_trm (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => def_typ A (open_rec_typ k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs (k: nat) (u: var) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar u a := open_rec_avar  0 u a.

Definition open_typ  u t := open_rec_typ   0 u t.

Definition open_dec  u D := open_rec_dec   0 u D.

Definition open_trm  u e := open_rec_trm   0 u e.

Definition open_val  u v := open_rec_val   0 u v.

Definition open_def  u d := open_rec_def   0 u d.

Definition open_defs u l := open_rec_defs  0 u l.

Definition open_defrhsdd u t := open_rec_defrhs 0 u t.

Definition open_path u p := open_rec_path  0 u p.

Definition open_paths u ps := map (open_path u) ps.

Definition open_rec_avar_p (k: nat) (u: path) (a: avar) : path :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then u else p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f x => pvar x
  end.

Definition open_rec_path_p (k: nat) (u: path) (p: path): path :=
  match p, u with
  | p_sel x bs, p_sel y cs=>
    match x with
    | avar_b i => If k = i then p_sel y (bs ++ cs) else p
    | avar_f x => p
    end
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L
  | μ       T      => μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2       => ∀(open_rec_typ_p k u T1) open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path_p k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec_p (k: nat) (u: path) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ_p k u T <: open_rec_typ_p k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_dec_p  u D := open_rec_dec_p   0 u D.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Definition open_trm_p  u t := open_rec_trm_p   0 u t.

Definition open_val_p  u v := open_rec_val_p   0 u v.

Definition open_def_p  u d := open_rec_def_p   0 u d.

Definition open_defs_p u l := open_rec_defs_p 0 u l.

Definition open_defrhs_p u t := open_rec_defrhs_p 0 u t.

Inductive repl_typ : path -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| rrcd: forall p q D1 D2,
    repl_dec p q D1 D2 ->
    repl_typ p q (typ_rcd D1) (typ_rcd D2)
| rand1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (T1 ∧ U) (T2 ∧ U)
| rand2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (U ∧ T1) (U ∧ T2)
| rpath: forall p q bs A,
    repl_typ p q (p••bs ↓ A) (q••bs ↓ A)
| rbnd: forall p q T1 T2,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (μ T1) (μ T2)
| rall1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(T1) U) (∀(T2) U)
| rall2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(U) T1) (∀(U) T2)
| rsngl: forall p q bs,
    repl_typ p q {{ p••bs }} {{ q••bs }}
with repl_dec : path -> path -> dec -> dec -> Prop :=
| rdtyp1: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: T1 <: U} {A >: T2 <: U}
| rdtyp2: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: U <: T1} {A >: U <: T2}
| rdtrm: forall p q T1 T2 a,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {a ⦂ T1} {a ⦂ T2}.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Definition ctx := env typ.

Definition sta := env val.

Definition fv_ctx_types(G: ctx): vars :=
  (fv_in_values (fun T => fv_typ T) G).

Definition fv_sta_vals(s: sta): vars := (fv_in_values (fun v => fv_val v) s).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec { A >: T <: T }
| rd_trm : forall a T, inert_typ T -> record_dec { a ⦂ T }
| rd_trm_sngl : forall a p, record_dec { a ⦂ {{ p }} }





with record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (T ∧ typ_rcd D) (union ls \{l})















with inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (∀(S) T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T ls,
      record_typ T ls ->
      inert_typ (μ T).

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D.

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_push : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).

Fixpoint tight_bounds T :=
  match T with
  | typ_rcd D => tight_bounds_dec D
  | U ∧ V     => tight_bounds U /\ tight_bounds V
  | typ_bnd U => tight_bounds U
  | _         => True
  end
with tight_bounds_dec D :=
  match D with
  | { a ⦂ T }       => tight_bounds T
  | { A >: T <: U } => T = U
  end.

Inductive ty_trm : ctx -> trm -> typ -> Prop :=







| ty_var : forall x T G,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ tvar x : T








| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
      G & z ~ T ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(T) U








| ty_all_elim : forall G p q S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app p q : open_typ_p q T








| ty_new_intro : forall L G T ds,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
      z; nil; G & (z ~ open_typ z T) ⊢ open_defs z ds :: open_typ z T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_val (ν(T) ds) : μ T







| ty_new_elim : forall G p a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : T







| ty_rcd_intro : forall G p a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T }









| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t : T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x u : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let t u : U








| ty_sngl : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T








| ty_path_elim : forall G p q a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : {{ q•a }}







| ty_rec_intro : forall G p T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : open_typ_p p T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : μ T







| ty_rec_elim : forall G p T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : μ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : open_typ_p p T








| ty_and_intro : forall G p T U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T ∧ U








| ty_sub : forall G t T U,
    G ⊢ t : T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t : U
where "G '⊢' t ':' T" := (ty_trm G t T)





with ty_def : var -> fields -> ctx -> def -> dec -> Prop :=

| ty_def_typ : forall x bs G A T,
    x; bs; G ⊢ def_typ A T : { A >: T <: T }







 | ty_def_all : forall x bs G T t b U V,
    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(U) V ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=v λ(T) t } : { b ⦂ ∀(U) V }







 | ty_def_new : forall x bs b G ds T p,
     p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
     tight_bounds (μ T) ->
     x; (b :: bs); G ⊢ open_defs_p p•b ds :: open_typ_p p•b T ->
     x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=v ν(T) ds } : { b ⦂ μ T }







 | ty_def_path : forall x bs G q b T,
    G ⊢ trm_path q: T ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=p q } : { b ⦂ {{ q }} }

where "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' d ':' D" := (ty_def x bs G d D)





with ty_defs : var -> fields -> ctx -> defs -> typ -> Prop :=






| ty_defs_one : forall x bs G d D,
    x; bs; G ⊢ d : D ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil d :: typ_rcd D









| ty_defs_cons : forall x bs G d ds D T,
    x; bs; G ⊢ ds :: T ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ d : D ->
    defs_hasnt ds (label_of_def d) ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ defs_cons ds d :: T ∧ typ_rcd D
where "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' ds '::' T" := (ty_defs x bs G ds T)


with subtyp : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=





| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top





| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T





| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T








| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U





| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ T ∧ U <: T


| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ T ∧ U <: U








| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: T ∧ U







| subtyp_fld: forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } <: typ_rcd { a ⦂ U }








| subtyp_typ: forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 } <: typ_rcd { A >: S2 <: T2 }








| subtyp_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->

    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    G ⊢ T <: T'








| subtyp_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->

| subtyp_sel2: forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->

| subtyp_sel1: forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd  { A >: S <: T } ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: T









| subtyp_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->

where "G '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyp G T U).

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

Notation "p '••' bs" := (sel_fields p bs) (at level 5).

Definition label_of_def(d: def): label := match d with
| def_typ A _ => label_typ A
| { a := t }  => label_trm a
end.

Definition label_of_dec(D: dec): label := match D with
| { A >: _ <: _ } => label_typ A
| { a ⦂ _ }  => label_trm a
end.

Fixpoint get_def(l: label)(ds: defs): option def :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of_def d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of_def d) ds = Some d.

Definition defs_hasnt(ds: defs)(l: label) := get_def l ds = None.

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path k u p ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2      => ∀(open_rec_typ k u T1) open_rec_typ (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ k u T <: open_rec_typ k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path k u p) (open_rec_path k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val (k: nat) (u: var) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T)ds   => ν (open_rec_typ (S k) u T) open_rec_defs (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ k u T) open_rec_trm (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => def_typ A (open_rec_typ k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs (k: nat) (u: var) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar u a := open_rec_avar  0 u a.

Definition open_typ  u t := open_rec_typ   0 u t.

Definition open_dec  u D := open_rec_dec   0 u D.

Definition open_trm  u e := open_rec_trm   0 u e.

Definition open_val  u v := open_rec_val   0 u v.

Definition open_def  u d := open_rec_def   0 u d.

Definition open_defs u l := open_rec_defs  0 u l.

Definition open_defrhsdd u t := open_rec_defrhs 0 u t.

Definition open_path u p := open_rec_path  0 u p.

Definition open_paths u ps := map (open_path u) ps.

Definition open_rec_avar_p (k: nat) (u: path) (a: avar) : path :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then u else p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f x => pvar x
  end.

Definition open_rec_path_p (k: nat) (u: path) (p: path): path :=
  match p, u with
  | p_sel x bs, p_sel y cs=>
    match x with
    | avar_b i => If k = i then p_sel y (bs ++ cs) else p
    | avar_f x => p
    end
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L
  | μ       T      => μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2       => ∀(open_rec_typ_p k u T1) open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path_p k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec_p (k: nat) (u: path) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ_p k u T <: open_rec_typ_p k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_dec_p  u D := open_rec_dec_p   0 u D.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Definition open_trm_p  u t := open_rec_trm_p   0 u t.

Definition open_val_p  u v := open_rec_val_p   0 u v.

Definition open_def_p  u d := open_rec_def_p   0 u d.

Definition open_defs_p u l := open_rec_defs_p 0 u l.

Definition open_defrhs_p u t := open_rec_defrhs_p 0 u t.

Inductive repl_typ : path -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| rrcd: forall p q D1 D2,
    repl_dec p q D1 D2 ->
    repl_typ p q (typ_rcd D1) (typ_rcd D2)
| rand1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (T1 ∧ U) (T2 ∧ U)
| rand2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (U ∧ T1) (U ∧ T2)
| rpath: forall p q bs A,
    repl_typ p q (p••bs ↓ A) (q••bs ↓ A)
| rbnd: forall p q T1 T2,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (μ T1) (μ T2)
| rall1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(T1) U) (∀(T2) U)
| rall2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(U) T1) (∀(U) T2)
| rsngl: forall p q bs,
    repl_typ p q {{ p••bs }} {{ q••bs }}
with repl_dec : path -> path -> dec -> dec -> Prop :=
| rdtyp1: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: T1 <: U} {A >: T2 <: U}
| rdtyp2: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: U <: T1} {A >: U <: T2}
| rdtrm: forall p q T1 T2 a,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {a ⦂ T1} {a ⦂ T2}.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Definition ctx := env typ.

Definition sta := env val.

Definition fv_ctx_types(G: ctx): vars :=
  (fv_in_values (fun T => fv_typ T) G).

Definition fv_sta_vals(s: sta): vars := (fv_in_values (fun v => fv_val v) s).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec { A >: T <: T }
| rd_trm : forall a T, inert_typ T -> record_dec { a ⦂ T }
| rd_trm_sngl : forall a p, record_dec { a ⦂ {{ p }} }





with record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (T ∧ typ_rcd D) (union ls \{l})















with inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (∀(S) T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T ls,
      record_typ T ls ->
      inert_typ (μ T).

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D.

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_push : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).

Fixpoint tight_bounds T :=
  match T with
  | typ_rcd D => tight_bounds_dec D
  | U ∧ V     => tight_bounds U /\ tight_bounds V
  | typ_bnd U => tight_bounds U
  | _         => True
  end
with tight_bounds_dec D :=
  match D with
  | { a ⦂ T }       => tight_bounds T
  | { A >: T <: U } => T = U
  end.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢' t ':' T" (at level 40, t at level 59).

Reserved Notation "G '⊢' T '<:' U" (at level 40, T at level 59).

Reserved Notation "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' d ':' D"
         (at level 40, bs at level 39, G at level 39, d at level 59).

Reserved Notation "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' ds '::' D"
         (at level 40, bs at level 39, G at level 39, ds at level 59).

Inductive ty_trm : ctx -> trm -> typ -> Prop :=







| ty_var : forall x T G,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ tvar x : T








| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
      G & z ~ T ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(T) U








| ty_all_elim : forall G p q S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    G ⊢ trm_app p q : open_typ_p q T








| ty_new_intro : forall L G T ds,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
      z; nil; G & (z ~ open_typ z T) ⊢ open_defs z ds :: open_typ z T) ->
    G ⊢ trm_val (ν(T) ds) : μ T







| ty_new_elim : forall G p a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : T







| ty_rcd_intro : forall G p a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T }









| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t : T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x u : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let t u : U








| ty_sngl : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T








| ty_path_elim : forall G p q a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : {{ q•a }}







| ty_rec_intro : forall G p T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : open_typ_p p T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : μ T







| ty_rec_elim : forall G p T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : μ T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : open_typ_p p T








| ty_and_intro : forall G p T U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : T ∧ U








| ty_sub : forall G t T U,
    G ⊢ t : T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ t : U
where "G '⊢' t ':' T" := (ty_trm G t T)





with ty_def : var -> fields -> ctx -> def -> dec -> Prop :=

| ty_def_typ : forall x bs G A T,
    x; bs; G ⊢ def_typ A T : { A >: T <: T }







 | ty_def_all : forall x bs G T t b U V,
    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(U) V ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=v λ(T) t } : { b ⦂ ∀(U) V }







 | ty_def_new : forall x bs b G ds T p,
     p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
     tight_bounds (μ T) ->
     x; (b :: bs); G ⊢ open_defs_p p•b ds :: open_typ_p p•b T ->
     x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=v ν(T) ds } : { b ⦂ μ T }







 | ty_def_path : forall x bs G q b T,
    G ⊢ trm_path q: T ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ { b :=p q } : { b ⦂ {{ q }} }

where "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' d ':' D" := (ty_def x bs G d D)





with ty_defs : var -> fields -> ctx -> defs -> typ -> Prop :=






| ty_defs_one : forall x bs G d D,
    x; bs; G ⊢ d : D ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil d :: typ_rcd D









| ty_defs_cons : forall x bs G d ds D T,
    x; bs; G ⊢ ds :: T ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ d : D ->
    defs_hasnt ds (label_of_def d) ->
    x; bs; G ⊢ defs_cons ds d :: T ∧ typ_rcd D
where "x ';' bs ';' G '⊢' ds '::' T" := (ty_defs x bs G ds T)


with subtyp : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=





| subtyp_top: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: typ_top





| subtyp_bot: forall G T,
    G ⊢ typ_bot <: T





| subtyp_refl: forall G T,
    G ⊢ T <: T








| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: U





| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ T ∧ U <: T


| subtyp_and12: forall G T U,
    G ⊢ T ∧ U <: U








| subtyp_and2: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T ->
    G ⊢ S <: U ->
    G ⊢ S <: T ∧ U







| subtyp_fld: forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } <: typ_rcd { a ⦂ U }








| subtyp_typ: forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢ typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 } <: typ_rcd { A >: S2 <: T2 }








| subtyp_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    G ⊢ T <: T'








| subtyp_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    G ⊢ T <: T'







| subtyp_sel2: forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    G ⊢ S <: (p ↓ A)







| subtyp_sel1: forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd  { A >: S <: T } ->

    G ⊢# trm_path p : {{ q }} ->

    G ⊢# trm_path p : open_typ_p p T ->

    G ⊢# trm_path p : μ T ->

    G ⊢# trm_path p : T ->
    G ⊢# trm_path p : U ->
    G ⊢# trm_path p : T ∧ U





| ty_sub_t : forall G t T U,
    G ⊢# t : T ->
    G ⊢# T <: U ->
    G ⊢# t : U

    G ⊢# T <: ⊤


| subtyp_bot_t: forall G T,
    G ⊢# ⊥ <: T


| subtyp_refl_t: forall G T,
    G ⊢# T <: T





| subtyp_trans_t: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢# S <: T ->

    G ⊢# T ∧ U <: U





| subtyp_and2_t: forall G S T U,
    G ⊢# S <: T ->
    G ⊢# S <: U ->
    G ⊢# S <: T ∧ U




| subtyp_fld_t: forall G T U a,
    G ⊢# T <: U ->
    G ⊢# typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}





| subtyp_typ_t: forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢# S2 <: S1 ->
    G ⊢# T1 <: T2 ->
    G ⊢# typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 } <: typ_rcd { A >: S2 <: T2 }





| subtyp_sngl_pq_t : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    G ⊢# T <: T'





| subtyp_sngl_qp_t : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    G ⊢# T <: T'




| subtyp_sel2_t: forall G p A T ,
    G ⊢!!! p : typ_rcd { A >: T <: T } ->
    G ⊢# T <: p ↓ A




| subtyp_sel1_t: forall G p A T,
    G ⊢!!! p : typ_rcd { A >: T <: T } ->
    G ⊢# p↓A <: T






| subtyp_all_t: forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 L,
    G ⊢# S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
    G ⊢# ∀(S1) T1 <: ∀(S2) T2
where "G '⊢#' T '<:' U" := (subtyp_t G T U).

Scheme ts_ty_trm_mut_ts  := Induction for ty_trm_t    Sort Prop
with   ts_subtyp_ts      := Induction for subtyp_t    Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ts_mutind_ts from ts_ty_trm_mut_ts, ts_subtyp_ts.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.
TLC

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma binds_neq_fresh : forall A (x:var) (v:A) E (w:var),
  binds x v E -> w # E -> x <> w.
Proof. intros. intro. subst w. exact (binds_fresh_inv H H0). Qed.

Lemma notin_union_single : forall (z w:var) L,
  z \notin L \u \{w} -> z \notin L /\ z <> w.
Proof.
  intros. apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  split; auto. apply notin_singleton_r in H2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_push_middle2 : forall A (G1 G2:env A) z (T:A) (w:var),
  w # (G1 & G2) -> w <> z -> w # (G1 & (G2 & z ~ T)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite dom_concat in *. apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
  - apply notin_union_l; auto. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
  - apply notin_union_l; auto. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->

  (forall (x:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x;bs;G ⊢ d : D),

       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       x; bs; (G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->

  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S0:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).

  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G T ds t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.

  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply IH; auto.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rcd_intro. apply IH; auto.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U d1 IH1 t1 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (L := L \u \{w}).

    + intros z Hz. destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzw].

    apply ty_sngl.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) intros G p q a T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_path_elim.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G p T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_intro. apply IH; auto.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros G p T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_elim. apply IH; auto.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros G p T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_and_intro.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros G t T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_sub with (T := T).
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  all: admit.
Admitted.

Lemma tight_bounds_subst :
  (forall (T:typ), tight_bounds T -> forall z p, tight_bounds (subst_typ z p T)) /\
  (forall (D:dec), tight_bounds_dec D -> forall z p, tight_bounds_dec (subst_dec z p D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros z p H. simpl. exact I.
  - intros z p H. simpl. exact I.
  - intros d IH z p H. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 z p H. simpl in *. destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl.
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q A z p H. simpl. exact I.
  - intros t IH z p H. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 z p H. simpl. exact I.
  - intros q z p H. simpl. exact I.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 z p H. simpl in *. subst t1. reflexivity.
  - intros a t IH z p H. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma label_of_def_subst : forall d z p,
  label_of_def (subst_def z p d) = label_of_def d.
Proof. intros d z p. destruct d; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma get_def_subst : forall l ds z p,
  get_def l (subst_defs z p ds) = option_map (subst_def z p) (get_def l ds).
Proof.
  intros l ds. induction ds as [|[d' ds'] IH]; intros z p.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite label_of_def_subst. destruct (classic (label_of_def d' = l)) as [H|H].
    + repeat rewrite If_l by auto. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_subst : forall ds l, defs_hasnt ds l -> forall z p,
  defs_hasnt (subst_defs z p ds) l.
Proof.
  intros ds l H z p. unfold defs_hasnt in *. rewrite get_def_subst.
  rewrite H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_subst : forall ds d, defs_has ds d -> forall z p,
  defs_has (subst_defs z p ds) (subst_def z p d).
Proof.
  intros ds d [l Hl] z p. unfold defs_has in *. subst l.
  unfold defs_has. rewrite get_def_subst. rewrite Hl. simpl. rewrite label_of_def_subst.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_decomp : forall G1 z Tz G2 p,
  z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
  subst_ctx z p (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) = G1 & z ~ Tz & subst_ctx z p G2.
Proof.
  intros. unfold subst_ctx.
  rewrite map_concat. rewrite map_push.
  rewrite subst_ctx_fresh by auto.
  rewrite subst_typ_fresh by auto.
  reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

cd /tmp && cat >> op.v <<'EOF'

Lemma open_rec_typ_inj :
  (forall (T1 T2:typ) k x, x \notin fv_typ T1 -> x \notin fv_typ T2 ->
     open_rec_typ k x T1 = open_rec_typ k x T2 -> T1 = T2) /\
  (forall (D1 D2:dec) k x, x \notin fv_dec D1 -> x \notin fv_dec D2 ->
     open_rec_dec k x D1 = open_rec_dec k x D2 -> D1 = D2).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq; reflexivity.
  - intros T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq; reflexivity.
  - intros d IH T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as Ed. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. simpl in H1. apply notin_union_r in H1. destruct H1 as [H1a H1b].
    destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as E1 E2. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q L T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as Eqq EL. subst. f_equal. apply open_rec_path_inj; auto.
  - intros t IH T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as E. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. simpl in H1. apply notin_union_r in H1. destruct H1 as [H1a H1b].
    destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as E1 E2. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q T2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct T2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as Eqq. subst. f_equal. apply open_rec_path_inj; auto.
  - (* dec_typ *) intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 D2 k x H1 H2 Eq. simpl in H1. apply notin_union_r in H1. destruct H1 as [H1a H1b].
    destruct D2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as E1 E2. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - (* dec_trm *) intros a t IH D2 k x H1 H2 Eq. destruct D2; simpl in *; try discriminate Eq.
    injection Eq as E. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma open_typ_inj : forall (T1 T2:typ) x,
  x \notin fv_typ T1 -> x \notin fv_typ T2 ->
  open_typ x T1 = open_typ x T2 -> T1 = T2.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 open_rec_typ_inj); auto. Qed.

Lemma open_dec_inj : forall (D1 D2:dec) x,
  x \notin fv_dec D1 -> x \notin fv_dec D2 ->
  open_dec x D1 = open_dec x D2 -> D1 = D2.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 open_rec_typ_inj); auto. Qed.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List.

Require Import Definitions Binding RecordAndInertTypes Replacement.

Require Export PreciseFlow.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!!' p ':' T" (at level 40, p at level 59).

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" (at level 40, p at level 59).

Inductive precise_typing2: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt2: forall G p T U,
    G ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
    G ⊢!! p: U
| pt2_sngl_trans : forall G p q a U,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! q•a : U ->
    G ⊢!! p•a : {{ q•a }}
where "G '⊢!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing2 G p T).

Inductive precise_typing3: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt3: forall G p T,
    G ⊢!! p : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p: T
| pt3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p : T
where "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing3 G p T).

Inductive wf : ctx -> Prop :=
| wfe_empty :
    wf empty
| wfe_push G x T :
    wf G ->
    x # G ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ T ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }}->
             exists U, G & x ~ T ⊢!! q : U) ->
    wf (G & x ~ T).

Definition typed_repl_comp_qp G T1 T2 :=
  exists p q U,
    G ⊢! p: {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} /\
    G ⊢!! q : U /\
    repl_typ q p T1 T2.

Definition repl_composition_qp G := star (typed_repl_comp_qp G).

Notation "G '⊢' T '⟿' U" := (repl_composition_qp G U T) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Notation "G '⊢' p '⟿'' q" := (G ⊢ {{ p }}⟿ {{ q }}) (at level 40, p at level 59).

Notation "G '⊩' T '⟿' U '⬳' V" := (G ⊢ T ⟿ U /\ G ⊢ V ⟿ U) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Notation "G '⊩' p '⟿'' q '⬳' r" := (G ⊢ p ⟿' q /\ G ⊢ r ⟿' q) (at level 40, p at level 59).
=====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions Binding RecordAndInertTypes.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!v' v ':' T" (at level 40, v at level 59).

Inductive ty_val_p : ctx -> val -> typ -> Prop :=





| ty_all_intro_p : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x t : open_typ x U) ->
    G ⊢!v λ(T) t : ∀(T) U





| ty_new_intro_p
     : forall (L : fset var) (G : env typ) (T : typ) (ds : defs),
       (forall x : var, x \notin L -> x; nil; G & x ~ open_typ x T ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T) ->
       G ⊢!v ν(T)ds : μ T

where "G '⊢!v' v ':' T" := (ty_val_p G v T).

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!' p ':' T '⪼' U" (at level 40, p at level 59).

Inductive precise_flow : ctx -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=





| pf_bind : forall x G T,
      ok G ->
      binds x T G ->
      G ⊢! pvar x: T ⪼ T




  | pf_fld : forall G p a T U,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ U} ->
      G ⊢! p•a : U ⪼ U




  | pf_open : forall p G T U,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ μ U ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ open_typ_p p U




  | pf_and1 : forall p G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1 ∧ U2 ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1




  | pf_and2 : forall p G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1 ∧ U2 ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U2

where "G '⊢!' p ':' T '⪼' U" := (precise_flow G p T U).
=====

with inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (∀(S) T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T ls,
      record_typ T ls ->
      inert_typ (μ T).

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D.

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_push : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).

Fixpoint tight_bounds T :=
  match T with
  | typ_rcd D => tight_bounds_dec D
  | U ∧ V     => tight_bounds U /\ tight_bounds V
  | typ_bnd U => tight_bounds U
  | _         => True
  end
with tight_bounds_dec D :=
  match D with
  | { a ⦂ T }       => tight_bounds T
  | { A >: T <: U } => T = U
  end.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros a t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_trm :
  (forall (t:trm) k x, open_rec_trm_p k (pvar x) t = open_rec_trm k x t) /\
  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T 0 x). Qed.

Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 open_pvar_trm)))). Qed.

Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
  γ ⫶ G /\
  inert G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,
  G ⊢!v v : T -> x # G -> G & x ~ T ⊢!v v : T.
Proof. intros G v T x H Hx. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v T H x T Hx). Qed.

Lemma HInv_empty : HInv empty empty.
Proof.
  unfold HInv. split; [apply well_typed_empty|]. split; [apply inert_empty|]. split.
  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros x T0 ds Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
  G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v [Hwt [Hinert [Hentries Hdefs]]] HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs.
  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split]].
  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
    + exact HxG.
  - intros y T' v' HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * subst. exact (ty_val_p_weaken_single Hval HxG).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).
  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * rewrite Eyx. exact (proj2 (Hnewdefs T0 ds (eq_sym Ev))).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * unfold defs_at in *.
        eapply weaken_defs with (G1:=G) (G2:= y ~ open_typ_p (pvar y) T0) (w:=x) (S:=S).
        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
           ++ exact HxG.
           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.
Qed.

Lemma star_trans : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) a b c,
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. induction H1; intros H2.
  - exact H2.
  - apply star_step with (b:=b); auto.
Qed.

Lemma infseq_from_function : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) (f:nat->A),
  (forall n, R (f n) (f (S n))) -> infseq R (f 0).
Proof.
  intros A R f H. generalize 0 as n. cofix IH. intro n.
  apply infseq_step with (f (S n)); auto.
Qed.

Definition TypedState (T:typ) :=
  sig (fun s : sta * trm => exists G, G ⊢ (snd s) : T /\ HInv (fst s) G).

Definition ts_state T (a:TypedState T) : sta * trm := proj1_sig a.

Definition mkTS : forall (T:typ) (γ:sta) (t:trm) (G:ctx),
  G ⊢ t : T -> HInv γ G -> TypedState T.
Proof.
  intros T γ t G Ht Hi.
  exists (γ,t). exists G. simpl. auto.
Defined.

Lemma ts_typed : forall T (a:TypedState T),
  exists G, G ⊢ (snd (ts_state a)) : T /\ HInv (fst (ts_state a)) G.
Proof. intros T [s Hs]. exact Hs. Qed.

Definition next_rel T (a b:TypedState T) : Prop :=
  red (ts_state a) (ts_state b) \/
  (norm_form (snd (ts_state a)) /\ b = a).

Lemma next_exists : forall T,
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall a : TypedState T, exists b, next_rel a b.
Proof.
  intros T Hstep [[γ t] [G [Ht Hi]]].
  destruct (Hstep γ G t Hi Ht) as [Hnf | [γ' [G' [t' [Hred [Hi' Ht']]]]]].
  - exists (@mkTS T γ t G Ht Hi). right. split; auto.
  - exists (@mkTS T γ' t' G' Ht' Hi'). left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma terminate_or_diverge :
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
    infseq red (γ,t) \/
    exists γ' (u:trm) G', star red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ norm_form u /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ HInv γ' G'.
Proof.
  intros Hstep γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Ht0.
  destruct (classic (infseq red (γ0,t0))) as [Hinf|Hnin].
  - left; auto.
  - destruct (classic (exists a : TypedState T0,
        star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state a) /\ norm_form (snd (ts_state a)))) as [Hterm|Hnoterm].
    + right. destruct Hterm as [a [Hstar Hnf]].
      destruct (ts_state a) as [γs us] eqn:E. simpl in Hstar, Hnf.
      destruct (ts_typed a) as [G' [Hty Hi]].
      rewrite E in Hty, Hi. simpl in Hty, Hi.
      exists γs, us, G'. auto.
    + exfalso. apply Hnin.
      set (a0 := @mkTS T0 γ0 t0 G0 Ht0 Hi0 : TypedState T0).
      destruct (@functional_choice (TypedState T0) (TypedState T0) (@next_rel T0) (@next_exists T0 (fun γ G t Hi Ht => @Hstep γ G t T0 Hi Ht))) as [f Hf].
      assert (Hstar : forall n, star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      { intro n. induction n as [|n IH].
        - simpl. apply star_refl.
        - simpl. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hred | [Hnf _]].
          + apply star_trans with (b := ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)).
            * exact IH.
            * apply star_step with (b := ts_state (f (Nat.iter n f a0))).
              -- exact Hred.
              -- apply star_refl.
          + exfalso. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; auto. }
      assert (Hnon : forall n, ~ norm_form (snd (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)))).
      { intros n Hnf. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; [apply Hstar|auto]. }
      assert (Hred : forall n, red (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)) (ts_state (Nat.iter (S n) f a0))).
      { intro n. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hr | [Hnf _]].
        - exact Hr.
        - exfalso. exact (Hnon n Hnf). }
      apply (@infseq_from_function (sta*trm) red (fun n => ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      intro n. exact (Hred n).
Qed.

     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall a : TypedState T, exists b, next_rel a b.
Proof.
  intros T Hstep [[γ t] [G [Ht Hi]]].
  destruct (Hstep γ G t Hi Ht) as [Hnf | [γ' [G' [t' [Hred [Hi' Ht']]]]]].
  - exists (@mkTS T γ t G Ht Hi). right. split; auto.
  - exists (@mkTS T γ' t' G' Ht' Hi'). left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma terminate_or_diverge :
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
    infseq red (γ,t) \/
    exists γ' (u:trm) G', star red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ norm_form u /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ HInv γ' G'.
Proof.
  intros Hstep γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Ht0.
  destruct (classic (infseq red (γ0,t0))) as [Hinf|Hnin].
  - left; auto.
  - destruct (classic (exists a : TypedState T0,
        star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state a) /\ norm_form (snd (ts_state a)))) as [Hterm|Hnoterm].
    + right. destruct Hterm as [a [Hstar Hnf]].
      destruct (ts_state a) as [γs us] eqn:E. simpl in Hstar, Hnf.
      destruct (ts_typed a) as [G' [Hty Hi]].
      rewrite E in Hty, Hi. simpl in Hty, Hi.
      exists γs, us, G'. auto.
    + exfalso. apply Hnin.
      set (a0 := @mkTS T0 γ0 t0 G0 Ht0 Hi0 : TypedState T0).
      destruct (@functional_choice (TypedState T0) (TypedState T0) (@next_rel T0) (@next_exists T0 (fun γ G t Hi Ht => @Hstep γ G t T0 Hi Ht))) as [f Hf].
      assert (Hstar : forall n, star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      { intro n. induction n as [|n IH].
        - simpl. apply star_refl.
        - simpl. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hred | [Hnf _]].
          + apply star_trans with (b := ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)).
            * exact IH.
            * apply star_step with (b := ts_state (f (Nat.iter n f a0))).
              -- exact Hred.
              -- apply star_refl.
          + exfalso. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; auto. }
      assert (Hnon : forall n, ~ norm_form (snd (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)))).
      { intros n Hnf. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; [apply Hstar|auto]. }
      assert (Hred : forall n, red (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)) (ts_state (Nat.iter (S n) f a0))).
      { intro n. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hr | [Hnf _]].
        - exact Hr.
        - exfalso. exact (Hnon n Hnf). }
      apply (@infseq_from_function (sta*trm) red (fun n => ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      intro n. exact (Hred n).
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma subst_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       subst_ctx z p G ⊢ subst_trm z p t : subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (subst_ctx z p G) ⊢ subst_def z p d : subst_dec z p D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (subst_ctx z p G) ⊢ subst_defs z p ds :: subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       subst_ctx z p G ⊢ subst_typ z p S <: subst_typ z p U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y T G b G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [-> | Hyz].
    + assert (T = Tz) as ->.
      { destruct (ok_middle_inv Hok) as [HzG1 HzG2].
        exact (binds_middle_self HzG1 HzG2 b). }
      simpl. rewrite svp_same. rewrite sel_fields_nil. rewrite subst_typ_fresh by auto.
      rewrite (@subst_ctx_decomp G1 z Tz G2 p HfG HfT).
      rewrite <- concat_assoc.
      apply weaken_ctx_trm with (H := z ~ Tz & subst_ctx z p G2).
      * exact Hp.
      * rewrite concat_assoc. rewrite <- (@subst_ctx_decomp G1 z Tz G2 p HfG HfT).
        apply ok_subst_ctx; auto.
    + simpl. rewrite svp_diff by auto. rewrite sel_fields_nil.
      apply ty_var. unfold subst_ctx. apply binds_map. exact b.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G T t U t0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2)). intros w Hw.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
    assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
    specialize (IH w HwL).
    assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ T))).
    { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
    change (subst_ctx z p (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) & w ~ subst_typ z p T
            ⊢ open_trm w (subst_trm z p t) : open_typ w (subst_typ z p U)).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_trm_comm t z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_comm U z w p Hwz Hn).
    unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
    apply (IH G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ T) p Hok').
    apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    auto. auto. auto. auto.

    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.

    destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
    assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
    specialize (IH w HwL).
    assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ open_typ w T))).
    { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
    change (w; nil; (subst_ctx z p (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) & w ~ open_typ w (subst_typ z p T))
            ⊢ open_defs w (subst_defs z p ds) :: open_typ w (subst_typ z p T)).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_defs_comm ds z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_comm T z w p Hwz Hn).
    unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
    apply (IH G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ open_typ w T) p).
    + exact Hok'.
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + exact Hn.
    + exact Hwz.
    + exact HfG.
    + exact HfT.
    + exact Hp.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G pm a T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    cbn [subst_trm]. rewrite subst_path_sel_field.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G pm a T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    cbn [subst_trm]. apply ty_rcd_intro.
    rewrite <- subst_trm_path_sel. apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U d1 IH1 t1 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (T := subst_typ z p T) (L := L \u dom (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2)).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + intros w Hw. destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
      assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
      specialize (IH2 w HwL).
      assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ T))).
      { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
      change (subst_ctx z p (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) & w ~ subst_typ z p T
              ⊢ open_trm w (subst_trm z p u) : subst_typ z p U).
      rewrite <- (@subst_open_trm_comm u z w p Hwz Hn).
      unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
      apply (IH2 G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ T) p).
      * exact Hok'.
      * apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
      * exact Hn.
      * exact HfG.
      * exact HfT.
      * exact Hp.
  - (* ty_sngl *) intros G pm q T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_sngl with (q := subst_path z p q).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) intros G pm q a T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    rewrite subst_trm_path_sel. rewrite subst_typ_sngl_sel.
    apply ty_path_elim with (q := subst_path z p q) (a := a) (T := subst_typ z p T).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + rewrite <- subst_trm_path_sel. apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G pm T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_intro with (T := subst_typ z p T).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p pm Hn (ty_path_named d)).
    apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros G pm T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p pm Hn (ty_path_named d)).
    apply ty_rec_elim with (T := subst_typ z p T). apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros G pm T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_and_intro.
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros G t T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_sub with (T := subst_typ z p T).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_def_typ *) intros x0 bs G A T G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_def_typ.
  - (* ty_def_all *) intros x0 bs G T t b U V d0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_def_all with (T := subst_typ z p T) (U := subst_typ z p U) (V := subst_typ z p V).

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions.

Close Scope string_scope.

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma subst_var_p_same : forall z (p:path), subst_var_p z p z = p.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_var_p. rewrite If_l; auto. Qed.

Lemma subst_path_named : forall z (p q:path) x bs,
  named_path p -> q = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
  subst_path z p q = If x = z then sel_fields p bs else q.
Proof.
  intros z p q x bs Hn ->. destruct Hn as [y [cs ->]]. simpl.
  unfold subst_path, subst_avar, subst_var_p. simpl.
  destruct (classic (x = z)) as [H|H].
  - repeat rewrite If_l by auto. reflexivity.
  - repeat rewrite If_r by auto. unfold sel_fields. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_path_z : forall k z p q,
  named_path p -> z \notin fv_path q ->
  subst_path z p (open_rec_path k z q) = open_rec_path_p k p q.
Proof.
  intros k z p q Hn Hf. destruct Hn as [y [cs Hp]]. subst p.
  destruct q as [a bs]. destruct a as [i|x].
  - simpl. unfold subst_path, subst_avar, open_rec_path, open_rec_avar, open_rec_path_p. simpl.
    destruct (classic (k = i)) as [Hk|Hk].
    + repeat rewrite If_l by auto. simpl.
      rewrite subst_var_p_same. unfold sel_fields. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. simpl.
      unfold sel_fields. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
  - simpl in Hf. simpl.
    unfold subst_path, subst_avar, open_rec_path, open_rec_avar, open_rec_path_p. simpl.
    destruct (classic (x = z)) as [Hxz|Hxz].
    + subst x. exfalso. exact (notin_singleton_r Hf eq_refl).
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. simpl.
      unfold subst_var_p. rewrite If_r by auto.
      unfold sel_fields. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_typ_dec_z :
  (forall (T:typ) k z,
     z \notin fv_typ T -> forall p, named_path p ->
     subst_typ z p (open_rec_typ k z T) = open_rec_typ_p k p T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k z,
     z \notin fv_dec D -> forall p, named_path p ->
     subst_dec z p (open_rec_dec k z D) = open_rec_dec_p k p D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k z Hf p Hn. reflexivity.
  - intros k z Hf p Hn. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k z Hf p Hn. simpl in *. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k z Hf p Hn. simpl in *. apply notin_union_r in Hf. destruct Hf as [H1 H2].
    simpl. f_equal; [apply IH1 | apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q A k z Hf p Hn. simpl. f_equal. apply subst_open_path_z; auto.

  intros G t T H. induction H using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Eq.
  - (* ty_var *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. exists x, (@nil trm_label). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply named_path_sel. apply IHty_trm. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply (named_path_sel_inv p a). apply IHty_trm. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_sngl *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply IHty_trm1. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply named_path_sel. apply IHty_trm1. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply IHty_trm. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply IHty_trm. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) injection Eq as Hp. subst p0. apply IHty_trm1. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) exact (IHty_trm p0 Eq).
Qed.

Lemma ty_path_named : forall G (p:path) T, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> named_path p.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_path_named_gen; [exact H | reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma subst_trm_path_sel : forall z p (q:path) a,
  subst_trm z p (trm_path (q • a)) = trm_path ((subst_path z p q) • a).
Proof.
  intros. change (trm_path (subst_path z p (q • a)) = trm_path ((subst_path z p q) • a)).
  f_equal. apply subst_path_sel_field.
Qed.

Lemma subst_typ_sngl_sel : forall z p (q:path) a,
  subst_typ z p {{ q • a }} = {{ (subst_path z p q) • a }}.
Proof.
  intros. change (typ_sngl (subst_path z p (q • a)) = typ_sngl ((subst_path z p q) • a)).
  f_equal. apply subst_path_sel_field.
Qed.

Lemma named_path_fvar : forall x bs, named_path (p_sel (avar_f x) bs).
Proof. intros. exists x, bs. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma named_path_sel_field : forall (q:path) a, named_path q -> named_path (q • a).
Proof. intros. apply named_path_sel. auto. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma binds_insert : forall (A:Type) (y:var) (T:A) G1 G2 (w:var) (S:A),
  binds y T (G1 & G2) -> y <> w -> binds y T (G1 & w ~ S & G2).
Proof.
  intros A y T G1 G2 w S Hb Hy.
  apply binds_concat_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [HyG2 H1]].
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    exact (binds_concat_right (G1 & w ~ S) Hb).
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H1.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
    + exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma binds_neq_fresh : forall A (x:var) (v:A) E (w:var),
  binds x v E -> w # E -> x <> w.
Proof. intros. intro. subst w. exact (binds_fresh_inv H H0). Qed.

Lemma notin_union_single : forall (z w:var) L,
  z \notin L \u \{w} -> z \notin L /\ z <> w.
Proof.
  intros. apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  split.
  - auto.
  - exact (notin_singleton_r H2).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_push_middle2 : forall A (G1 G2:env A) z (T:A) (w:var),
  w # (G1 & G2) -> w <> z -> w # (G1 & (G2 & z ~ T)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite dom_concat in H. apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
  rewrite dom_concat, dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
  - auto.
  - apply notin_union_l.
    + auto.
    + apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x;bs;G ⊢ d : D),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       x; bs; (G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       x; bs; (G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S0:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) ->
       G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros x T G b G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_var. apply binds_insert; auto.
    eapply binds_neq_fresh; eauto.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G T t U t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u \{w}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzw].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (IH G1 (G2 & z ~ T) w S0).
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + eapply fresh_push_middle2; eauto.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S).
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G T ds t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u \{w}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzw].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (IH G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z T) w S0).
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + eapply fresh_push_middle2; eauto.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply IH; auto.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
