Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma weaken_trm : forall G t T, G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 weaken_ty); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_def : forall x bs G d D, x;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> x;bs;(G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ d : D.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 (proj2 weaken_ty)); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_defs : forall x bs G ds T, x;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> x;bs;(G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ ds :: T.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_ty))); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub : forall G S U, G ⊢ S <: U ->
  forall G1 G2 w S0, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_ty))); eauto. Qed.

Lemma binds_rebind_neq : forall A (G1 G2:env A) (x:var) (T1 T2:A) y (T:A),
  binds y T (G1 & x ~ T1 & G2) -> y <> x -> binds y T (G1 & x ~ T2 & G2).
Proof.
  intros A G1 G2 x T1 T2 y T Hb Hy.
  apply binds_concat_inv' in Hb. destruct Hb as [[HyG2 Hb] | Hb].
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & x ~ T2) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_inv' in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Hyx H1] | Hb1].
      * apply binds_concat_left.
        -- exact H1.
        -- rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
      * exfalso. apply Hy. apply binds_single_inv in Hb1. tauto.
    + exact HyG2.
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & x ~ T2) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_right. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_middle_self : forall A (G1 G2:env A) x (T T':A),
  x # G1 -> x # G2 -> binds x T (G1 & x ~ T' & G2) -> T = T'.
Proof.

## Task

Show that a closed well-typed pDOT term either diverges or reaches a normal form with the stated typing and heap invariants.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `safety`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

===TASK
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

Lemma binds_shadow : forall A (y:var) (T:A) G1 G2 (w:var) (S:A),
  binds y T (G1 & G2) -> w \in dom G2 -> binds y T (G1 & w ~ S & G2).
Proof.
  intros A y T G1 G2 w S Hb Hw.
  apply binds_concat_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [HyG2 H1]].
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_right. exact Hb.
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H1.
      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hyw. rewrite in_singleton in Hyw.
        apply HyG2. rewrite Hyw. exact Hw.
    + exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_shadow_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\

cd /tmp && cat > step.v <<'EOF'
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hwt _]. apply well_typed_ok; auto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat in Hx. rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_r in Hx.
      destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. apply notin_union_l; auto.
      rewrite dom_single in Hx2. intro Hxw. apply Hx2. rewrite in_singleton. auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w).
    { rewrite dom_concat in Hx. apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [_ Hx2].
      rewrite dom_single in Hx2. intro E. apply Hx2. rewrite in_singleton. auto. }
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    eapply weaken_trm with (G1 := G & H') (G2 := x ~ T) (w := w) (S := S0).
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto.
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto.
    + exact Hty'.
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHty_trm γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & H & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        subst t. right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L) by (intro E; apply Hx; unfold Lx; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; auto).
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l. apply in_union_l. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (t0 x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (@subst_ty (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p) as Hs.
        (* Hs needs arguments; instantiate explicitly below instead *)
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (proj1 (@subst_ty (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody) G x T empty p Hok eq_refl Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        rewrite concat_empty_r in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        change (subst_trm x p (open_rec_trm 0 x u) = open_trm_p p u) in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, empty, (open_trm_p p u). split.
        -- apply red_let_path.
        -- split; [exact Hi|]. split; [exact Hsub|reflexivity].
      * (* let-val *)
        subst t. right.
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u dom γ).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L) by (intro E; apply Hx; unfold Lx; apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; auto).
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_r. exact E. }
        pose proof (t0 x HxL) as Hbody.
        destruct (ty_val_inv Hty0) as
          [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]].
        -- (* lambda *)
           subst v. right.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0 ds, (λ(T1) t') = ν(T0) ds -> ∀(T1) T2 = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2) x T0 ds).
           { intros. discriminate H. }
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t') (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (∀(T1)T2) (λ(T1)t') Hi HxG Hxγ Hval Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t'), (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** (* result typing *)
                 assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)).
                 { rewrite dom_concat_empty. exact HxG. }
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2 & empty ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (proj1 (@bind_sub_ty (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody) G x T empty (∀(T1)T2) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
        -- (* new *)
           subst v. right.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0' ds', (ν(T0) ds) = ν(T0') ds' -> μ T0 = μ T0' /\ defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0' ds').
           { intros T0' ds' E. injection E as ET Eds. subst T0' ds'. split; [reflexivity|].
             (* build defs_at *)
             dependent destruction Hval.
             assert (HxL0 : x \notin L0).
             { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. apply in_union_l; auto. }
             pose proof (H0 x HxL0) as Hdx.
             unfold defs_at.
             rewrite open_defs_pvar, open_typ_pvar.
             assert (Hsh : x; nil; ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ x T0) ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T0).
             { eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_shadow_ty))); [exact Hdx | reflexivity |].
               rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'. }
             exact Hsh. }
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (μ T0) (ν(T0)ds) Hi HxG Hxγ Hval Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds), (G & x ~ μ T0), (x ~ μ T0), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)) by (rewrite dom_concat_empty; exact HxG).
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ μ T0 & empty ⊢ μ T0 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (proj1 (@bind_sub_ty (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody) G x T empty (μ T0) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
    + (* let step in scrutinee *)
      right. exists γ', G', H, (trm_let u' u). split.
      * apply red_let_tgt; auto.
      * split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
        -- (* re-type the let in extended context *)
           set (L2 := L \u fv_ctx_types H \u dom G').
           apply ty_let with (T := T) (L := L2).
           ++ exact Hty'.
           ++ intros x Hx2.
              assert (HxL : x \notin L).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. apply in_union_l; apply in_union_l; auto. }
              assert (HxH : x \notin fv_ctx_types H).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. apply in_union_l; apply in_union_r; auto. }
              assert (HxG' : x \notin dom G').
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. apply in_union_r; auto. }
              assert (HxGH : x # (G & H)).

              rewrite <- Heq.
              eapply weaken_insert_ctx.
              ** rewrite <- Heq. apply HInv_ok in Hi'; exact Hi'.
              ** rewrite <- Heq. exact HxGH.
              ** exact Hbody.
        -- exact Heq.
  - (* ty_sngl *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros. destruct (IHty_trm γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & H & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].

    + right. exists γ', G', H, u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
      * apply ty_sub with (T := T).

Lemma well_typed_binds : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G ->
  forall x T, binds x T G -> exists v, binds x v γ.

Lemma HInv_entries : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G ->
  exists v, binds x v γ /\ G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] Hb.
  destruct (well_typed_binds Hwt Hb) as [v Hv].
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact (Hentries x T v Hb Hv)].

cd /tmp && cat > precise.v <<'EOF'
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma wf_ok : forall G, wf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_weaken : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢! p : R ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pf_bind.
    + apply ok_push; [exact H|exact Hx].
    + apply binds_concat_left; auto.
      apply binds_neq_fresh with (v:=T) (E:=G); auto.
  - eapply pf_fld. apply IHHf; auto.
  - eapply pf_open. apply IHHf; auto.
  - eapply pf_and1. apply IHHf; auto.
  - eapply pf_and2. apply IHHf; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pt2. apply flow_weaken; auto.
  - eapply pt2_sngl_trans.
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pt3. apply precise2_weaken; auto.
  - eapply pt3_sngl_trans.
    + apply precise2_weaken; auto.
    + apply IHHp; auto.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma record_type_mu_absurd : forall U, record_type (μ U) -> False.
Proof.

Lemma record_type_and_l : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U1.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_r : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U2.
Proof.

Proof. intros T p [ls H]. exists ls. apply record_typ_open_p; auto. Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_shape : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> U = μ T0 \/ record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf. remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER.
  revert T0 Hrt ER. induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt ER.
  - (* bind *) inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - (* fld *) inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - (* open *) inversion ER; subst.

    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd _ Hrec).
  - (* and1 *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. apply record_type_and_l. exact Hrec.
  - (* and2 *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. apply record_type_and_r. exact Hrec.
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_same : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ μ U -> U = T0.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf.
  destruct (flow_mu_shape Hrt Hf) as [E | Hrec].
  - inversion E; subst. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd _ Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_record_has : forall G p T0 U D,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> record_has U D ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) D.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U D Hrt Hf Hhas.
  remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER. revert T0 Hrt Hhas ER.

  - (* fld *) inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.

    apply rh_andl. exact Hhas.
  - (* and2 *) inversion ER; subst.
    apply IHHf with (T1:=T1); auto.
    apply rh_andr. exact Hhas.
Admitted.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma flow_all_shape : forall G p S T U,
  G ⊢! p : ∀(S) T ⪼ U -> U = ∀(S) T.
Proof.
  intros G p S T U Hf. remember (∀(S) T) as R eqn:ER.
  revert S T ER. induction Hf; intros S1 T1 ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma flow_prefix_snoc : forall G p a T U,
  G ⊢! (p • a) : T ⪼ U -> exists R V, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ V.
Proof.
  intros G p a T U Hf. remember (p • a) as q eqn:Eq.
  revert p a Eq. induction Hf; intros p0 a0 Eq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Eq; subst. eexists; eexists; eassumption.
  - (* open *) inversion Eq; subst.
    apply IHHf; reflexivity.
  - (* and1 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    apply IHHf; reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    apply IHHf; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_prefix_snoc : forall G p a U,
  G ⊢!! (p • a) : U -> exists V, G ⊢!! p : V.
Proof.
  intros G p a U Hp. remember (p • a) as q eqn:Eq.
  revert p a Eq. induction Hp; intros p0 a0 Eq.
  - (* pt2 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    destruct (flow_prefix_snoc H) as [R [V Hf]].
    exists V. apply pt2. exact Hf.
  - (* sngl trans *) inversion Eq; subst.
    exists {{q}}. exact Hp1.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma binds_insert_open : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  y <> x -> binds y Ty (G1 & G2) ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hyx H.
  apply binds_concat_inv in H. destruct H as [HG2 | [HyG2 H1]].
  - apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H1.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
    + exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma self_insert_open :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    destruct (classic (y = x)) as [-> | Hyx].
    + assert (Ty = μ T0) as ET.
      { apply (binds_functional b). apply binds_concat_left; auto. }
      subst Ty.
      apply ty_rec_intro with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; [|exact Hx].
      apply binds_concat_right. apply binds_tail.
    + apply ty_var. apply binds_insert_open; auto.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (@IH G1 (G2 & z ~ Tb) x T0 Hb Hx'
      (eq_sym (@concat_assoc typ G1 G2 (z ~ Tb)))).
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G Tb ds t0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (@IH G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb) x T0 Hb Hx'
      (eq_sym (@concat_assoc typ G1 G2 (z ~ open_typ z Tb)))).
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_rcd_intro. apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u Tb U d1 IH1 u1 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (T := Tb) (L := L \u \{x}).
    + apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
    + intros z Hz. destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
      specialize (IH2 z HzL).
      assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
      { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].

      rewrite <- concat_assoc.

  - (* ty_sngl *) intros G p q T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.

  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G p T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.

  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros G p T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T). apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros G p T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_and_intro; [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* ty_sub *) intros G t T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_sub with (T := T); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* ty_def_typ *) intros x0 bs G A T G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_def_typ.
  - (* ty_def_all *) intros x0 bs G Tb t b U V d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_def_all with (T := Tb) (U := U) (V := V). apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_def_new *) intros x0 bs b G ds Tb p e tb d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.

  - (* ty_def_path *) intros x0 bs G q b T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_def_path with (T := T). apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_defs_one *) intros x0 bs G d D d0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_defs_one. apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_defs_cons *) intros x0 bs G d ds D T d0 IH1 d1 IH2 hh G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_defs_cons with (T := T) (D := D); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|exact hh].
  - (* subtyp_top *) intros G T G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G. apply subtyp_top.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) intros G T G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G. apply subtyp_bot.
  - (* subtyp_refl *) intros G T G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp_trans *) intros G S T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply subtyp_trans with (T := T); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* and11 *) intros G T U G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G. apply subtyp_and11.
  - (* and12 *) intros G T U G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G. apply subtyp_and12.
  - (* and2 *) intros G S T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply subtyp_and2; [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* fld *) intros G T U a d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply subtyp_fld with (a := a). apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* typ *) intros G Sa Sb Ta Tb A d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply subtyp_typ with (A := A); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* sngl_pq *) intros G pm q T T' U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 r G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.

Lemma ty_val_p_ty : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> G ⊢ trm_val v : T.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply ty_all_intro with (L := L); auto.
  - apply ty_new_intro with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_val_p_inert : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply inert_typ_all.
  - destruct (var_fresh (L \u fv_typ T)) as [x Hx].
    apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxT].
    destruct (ty_defs_record_typ (H x HxL)) as [ls Hrt].
    apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls).
    eapply record_typ_open_var; eauto.

Lemma ty_val_inv_inert : forall G (v:val) T,
  G ⊢ trm_val v : T -> exists S, G ⊢!v v : S /\ inert_typ S.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. destruct (ty_val_inv H) as [[T1 [T2 [t [Ev [Hp _]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hp _]]]]].

  - (* all *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.

    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l.

  - (* new *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition is_arrow T := exists S U, T = ∀(S) U.

Inductive ResCore (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rc_lam p v S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv v ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v v : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCore γ G p A
| rc_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCore γ G p U
| rc_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCore γ G p {{ q }}.

Parameter res_field : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.

Lemma flow_res : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCore γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi. destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]].
  intros p S U Hf. revert p S U Hf.
  induction Hf; intros p0 S0 U0 Hf0.
  - (* bind *) subst p0 S0 U0.
    destruct (HInv_entries (conj Hwt (conj HinertG (conj Hwf (conj Hentries Hdefs)))) H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].

      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.

    + (* alias *) subst V. discriminate.
  - (* and1 *) remember (U1) as V eqn:EV.

input.command:
cd /tmp && cat > shape.v <<'EOF'
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive sub_rel : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| srel_refl T : sub_rel T T
| srel_bot T : sub_rel typ_bot T
| srel_top T : sub_rel T typ_top
| srel_and_l T U V : sub_rel T V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and_r T U V : sub_rel U V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and2 T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel T V -> sub_rel T (U ∧ V)
| srel_fld T U a : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| srel_typ S1 S2 T1 T2 A :
    sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel T1 T2 ->
    sub_rel (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| srel_sngl_pq p q T T' : repl_typ p q T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sngl_qp p q T T' : repl_typ q p T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sel2 p A T : sub_rel T (p ↓ A)
| srel_sel1 p A T : sub_rel (p ↓ A) T
| srel_all S1 S2 T1 T2 : sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2)
| srel_trans T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel U V -> sub_rel T V.

Lemma subtyp_to_rel : forall G T U, G ⊢ T <: U -> sub_rel T U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply srel_top.
  - apply srel_bot.
  - apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_trans; eauto.
  - apply srel_and_l. apply srel_refl.
  - apply srel_and_r. apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_and2; eauto.
  - apply srel_fld. assumption.
  - eapply srel_typ; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply srel_sel2.
  - apply srel_sel1.
  - eapply srel_all; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres.

Lemma self_remove_flow : forall G x Vc p S U,
  binds x (μ Vc) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) ⊢! p : S ⪼ U ->
  exists S', G ⊢! p : S' ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros G x Vc p S U Hb Hf. remember (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as C eqn:EC.
  revert G x Vc Hb EC. induction Hf; intros G x Vc Hb EC.
  - (* bind *) subst C.
    destruct (classic (x0 = x)) as [-> | Hx].
    + (* self open -> self mu + open *) 
      assert (T = open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as ET.
      { assert (HbC : binds x T (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)).
        { exact H0. }
        apply binds_concat_inv in HbC. destruct HbC as [Hs | [Hfrh Hm]].
        - destruct (binds_single_inv Hs) as [E1 E2]. inversion E1. exact E2.
        - exfalso. apply Hfrh. apply binds_single_inv in Hm. destruct Hm as [E1 E2]. subst x0. auto. }
      subst T. exists (μ Vc).
      apply (@pf_open (pvar x) G (μ Vc) Vc).
      apply pf_bind.
      * destruct (ok_concat_inv_l H) as Hok. exact Hok.
      * exact Hb.
    + (* other variable *) exists T.
      apply pf_bind.
      * destruct (ok_concat_inv_l H) as Hok. exact Hok.
      * eapply binds_concat_left_inv. exact H0. exact Hx.
  - (* fld *) destruct (IHHf G x Vc Hb EC) as [S' Hf'].
    exists U. eapply pf_fld. exact Hf'.
  - (* open *) destruct (IHHf G x Vc Hb EC) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_open. exact Hf'.
  - (* and1 *) destruct (IHHf G x Vc Hb EC) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_and1. exact Hf'.
  - (* and2 *) destruct (IHHf G x Vc Hb EC) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_and2. exact Hf'.
Qed.

Lemma self_remove_precise2 : forall G x Vc p U,
  binds x (μ Vc) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) ⊢!! p : U ->
  G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros G x Vc p U Hb Hp. remember (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as C eqn:EC.
  revert G x Vc Hb EC. induction Hp; intros G x Vc Hb EC.
  - (* pt2 *) subst C.
    destruct (self_remove_flow Hb H) as [S' Hf'].
    apply (@pt2 G p S' U). exact Hf'.
  - (* sngl trans *) subst C.
    apply (@pt2_sngl_trans G p q a U).
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

  binds x (μ Vc) G ->

  - (* pt3 *) subst C.

  - (* sngl trans *) subst C.

Lemma flow_record_shape : forall G p R U,
  record_type R -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> U = R \/ record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G p R U Hrt Hf. remember R as R0 eqn:ER.
  revert R Hrt ER. induction Hf; intros R0 Hrt ER.
  - (* bind *) inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - (* fld *) inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - (* open *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf R0 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + rewrite <- E in Hrt. exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd _ Hrt).
    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd _ Hrec).
  - (* and1 *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf R0 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + right. apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2). rewrite <- E. exact Hrt.
    + right. apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2). exact Hrec.
  - (* and2 *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf R0 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + right. apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1). rewrite <- E. exact Hrt.
    + right. apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1). exact Hrec.
Qed.

Lemma flow_open_record_has : forall G p T0 U D,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : open_typ_p p T0 ⪼ U ->
  record_has U D -> record_has (open_typ_p p T0) D.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U D Hrt Hf Hhas.
  remember (open_typ_p p T0) as R eqn:ER. revert T0 Hrt ER.
  induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt ER.
  - (* bind *) inversion ER; subst. exact Hhas.
  - (* fld *) inversion ER; subst. exact Hhas.
  - (* open *) inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (flow_record_shape Hrt H) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec]; exfalso.
    + rewrite <- E in Hrt. exact (record_type_mu_absurd _ Hrt).

  - (* and2 *) inversion ER; subst.
    apply (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl). apply rh_andr. exact Hhas.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions.

Close Scope string_scope.

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y
  end.

Definition subst_path (z: var) (q: path) (p: path) : path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => sel_fields (subst_avar z q x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (p: path) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z p D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => subst_typ z p T1 ∧ subst_typ z p T2
  | q ↓ L          => subst_path z p q ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (subst_typ z p T)
  | ∀(T) U         => ∀ (subst_typ z p T) subst_typ z p U
  | {{ q }}        => {{ subst_path z p q }}
  end
with subst_dec (z: var) (p: path) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | {A >: T <: U} => {A >: subst_typ z p T <: subst_typ z p U}
  | {a ⦂ U}        => {a ⦂ subst_typ z p U }
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: path) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => trm_val (subst_val z u v)
  | trm_path p       => trm_path (subst_path z u p)
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_path z u x1) (subst_path z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  end
with subst_val (z: var) (u: path) (v: val) : val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds  => ν(subst_typ z u T) subst_defs z u ds
  | λ(T) t   => λ(subst_typ z u T) subst_trm z u t
  end
with subst_def (z: var) (u: path) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (subst_typ z u T)
  | { a := t }  => { a := subst_defrhs z u t }
  end
with subst_defs (z: var) (u: path) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end
with subst_defrhs (z: var) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (subst_path z u p)
  | defv v => defv (subst_val z u v)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx (z: var) (p: path) (G: ctx) : ctx :=
  map (subst_typ z p) G.

Definition named_path p := exists x bs, p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs.
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Definitions Binding.

Reserved Notation "γ '⟦' t '⤳' u '⟧'" (at level 40).

Inductive lookup_step : sta -> def_rhs -> def_rhs -> Prop :=




| lookup_var : forall γ x v,
    binds x v γ ->
    γ ⟦ pvar x ⤳ defv v ⟧




| lookup_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    γ ⟦ p•a ⤳ defp (q•a) ⟧




| lookup_sel_v : forall γ p a t T ds,
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (val_new T ds) ⟧ ->
    defs_has ds { a := t } ->
    γ ⟦ p•a ⤳ open_defrhs_p p t ⟧

where "γ '⟦' p '⤳' t '⟧'" := (lookup_step γ (defp p) t).

Notation "γ '⟦' t '⤳*' u '⟧'" := (star (lookup_step γ) t u) (at level 40).
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Definitions Lookup Sequences.

Reserved Notation "t1 '⟼' t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : sta * trm -> sta * trm -> Prop :=




| red_app: forall γ p q T t,
    γ ⟦ defp q ⤳* defv (λ(T) t) ⟧ ->
    (γ, trm_app q p) ⟼ (γ, open_trm_p p t)


| red_let_val : forall v t γ x,
    x # γ ->
    (γ, trm_let (trm_val v) t) ⟼ (γ & x ~ v, open_trm x t)


| red_let_path : forall t γ p,
    (γ, trm_let (trm_path p) t) ⟼ (γ, open_trm_p p t)




| red_let_tgt : forall t0 t γ t0' γ',
    (γ, t0) ⟼ (γ', t0') ->
    (γ, trm_let t0 t) ⟼ (γ', trm_let t0' t)

where "t1 '⟼' t2" := (red t1 t2).

Notation "t1 '⟼*' t2" := (star red t1 t2) (at level 40).

Inductive norm_form: trm -> Prop :=
| nf_path: forall p, norm_form (trm_path p)
| nf_val: forall v, norm_form (trm_val v).

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_dec_p  u D := open_rec_dec_p   0 u D.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Definition open_trm_p  u t := open_rec_trm_p   0 u t.

Definition open_val_p  u v := open_rec_val_p   0 u v.

Definition open_def_p  u d := open_rec_def_p   0 u d.

Definition open_defs_p u l := open_rec_defs_p 0 u l.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.

  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.

      * (* let-path *)
        right.

        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).

        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).

        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (Hsubst_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p Hok (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ T))) Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        unfold open_trm in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (@subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p p u). split.
        -- apply red_let_path.
        -- split; [exact Hi|]. split; [exact Hsub|].
           exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
      * (* let-val *)
        right.
        destruct (ty_val_inv Hty0) as
          [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]].
        -- (* lambda *)
           subst v.
           set (Lx := L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (λ(T1) t') = ν(T0x) dsx -> ∀(T1) T2 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx Eqx. discriminate Eqx. }
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t') (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (∀(T1)T2) (λ(T1)t') Hi HxG Hxγ Hval Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t'), (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)).
                 { rewrite dom_concat_empty. exact HxG. }
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ (∀(T1) T2) & empty ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (@bind_sub_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty (∀(T1)T2) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
        -- (* new *)
           subst v.
           dependent destruction Hval.
           set (Lx := L0 \u L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxL0 : x \notin L0).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H1 x HxL0) as Hdx.
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (ν(T0) ds) = ν(T0x) dsx -> μ T0 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx E. injection E as ET Eds. subst T0x dsx. split; [reflexivity|].
             unfold defs_at.
             rewrite open_defs_pvar, open_typ_pvar.
             assert (Hsh : x; nil; ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ x T0) ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T0).
             { eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_shadow_ty))); [exact Hdx | reflexivity |].
               rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'. }
             exact Hsh. }
           assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v ν(T0) ds : μ T0) by (apply ty_new_intro_p with (L:=L0); exact H1).
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (μ T0) (ν(T0)ds) Hi HxG Hxγ Hval' Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds), (G & x ~ μ T0), (x ~ μ T0), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)) by (rewrite dom_concat_empty; exact HxG).
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ (μ T0) & empty ⊢ μ T0 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (@bind_sub_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty (μ T0) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
    + (* let step in scrutinee *)
      subst G'. right. exists γ', (G & Hext), Hext, (trm_let u' u). split.
      * apply red_let_tgt; auto.
      * split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
        -- (* re-type the let in extended context *)
           set (L2 := L \u fv_ctx_types Hext \u dom (G & Hext)).
           apply ty_let with (T := T) (L := L2).
           ++ exact Hty'.
           ++ intros x Hx2.
              assert (HxL : x \notin L).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              assert (HxH : x \notin fv_ctx_types Hext).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              assert (HxGH : x # (G & Hext)).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
              exact (@weaken_insert_ctx G Hext x T (open_trm x u) U (HInv_ok Hi') HxGH Hbody).
        -- reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sngl *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + left. exact Hnf.
    + right. exists γ', G', Hext, u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
      * apply ty_sub with (T := T).
        -- exact Hty'.
        -- rewrite Heq. apply weaken_sub_ctx; [rewrite <- Heq; apply HInv_ok in Hi'; exact Hi'|exact H].
      * exact Heq.
Qed.
===ENDSTEP

Theorem safety_test : forall t T,
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  infseq red (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, star red (empty, t) (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).
Proof.
  intros t T Ht.
  destruct (@terminate_or_diverge (fun γ G t0 T0 Hi Hty => step_plain Hi Hty) (empty:sta) (empty:ctx) t T HInv_empty Ht) as [Hinf | Hterm].
  - left; exact Hinf.
  - right. destruct Hterm as [γ [u [G [Hstar [Hnf [Hty Hi]]]]]].
    exists γ, u, G. split; [exact Hstar|]. split; [exact Hnf|]. split; [exact Hty|].
    destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf _]]]. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hwf|exact Hinert].
Qed.

Lemma step_plain : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (t':trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Ht. destruct (@step γ G t T Hi Ht) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
  - left; exact Hnf.
  - right. exists γ', G', u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|exact Hty'].
Qed.

Theorem safety_test : forall t T,
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  infseq red (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, star red (empty, t) (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).
Proof.
  intros t T Ht.
  destruct (@terminate_or_diverge (fun γ G t0 T0 Hi Hty => step_plain Hi Hty) (empty:sta) (empty:ctx) t T HInv_empty Ht) as [Hinf | Hterm].

  - right. destruct Hterm as [γ [u [G [Hstar [Hnf [Hty Hi]]]]]].
    exists γ, u, G. split; [exact Hstar|]. split; [exact Hnf|]. split; [exact Hty|].
    destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf _]]]. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hwf|exact Hinert].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Lemma app_var_step : forall γ G x q Sarg Tres,
  HInv γ G ->
  binds x (∀(Sarg) Tres) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : Sarg ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (Hext:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app (pvar x) q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q Tres /\ G' = G & Hext.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Sarg Tres Hi Hb Hq.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [Hvγ Hval]].
  dependent destruction Hval.
  (* now v = lambda, Sarg/Tres fixed; premise typing of body named H0? *)
  assert (Hbody : forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ Sarg ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z Tres).
  { intros z Hz. exact (H z Hz). }
  assert (Hlook : γ ⟦ defp (pvar x) ⤳* defv (λ(Sarg) t) ⟧).
  { apply star_step with (b := defv (λ(Sarg) t)).
    - apply lookup_var. exact Hvγ.
    - apply star_refl. }
  exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := Sarg) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - split; [exact Hi|]. split.
    + (* preservation by substitution *)
      set (Lz := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ Sarg \u fv_typ Tres \u fv_trm t).
      destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
      assert (HzL : z \notin L).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ Sarg).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ Tres).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q Sarg Hq)).
      assert (Hok : ok (G & z ~ Sarg & empty)).
      { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
        intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      pose proof (Hbody z HzL) as Hbz.
      pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ Sarg) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z Tres) Hbz
                    G z Sarg empty q Hok
                    (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ Sarg)))
                    Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub.
      unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
      rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub.
      rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
      unfold open_trm in Hsub.
      rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub.
      unfold open_typ in Hsub.
      rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z Tres 0 z HzT q Hnp) in Hsub.
      exact Hsub.
    + exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma binds_subst_drop : forall G1 z Tz G2 p y T,
  z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 ->
  binds y T (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> y <> z ->
  binds y (subst_typ z p T) (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 z Tz G2 p y T Hfz Hb Hyz.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HbG2 | [HyG2 HbG1z]].
  - apply binds_concat_right. apply binds_map. exact HbG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv HbG1z) as [HbTz | [HyTz HbG1]].
    + destruct (binds_single_inv HbTz) as [E1 E2]. subst y T. exfalso; auto.
    + assert (HT : subst_typ z p T = T).
      { apply subst_typ_fresh. exact (@fv_ctx_binds G1 z Hfz y T HbG1). }
      rewrite HT. apply binds_concat_left; auto. unfold subst_ctx. rewrite dom_map. exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       G1 & subst_ctx z p G2 ⊢ subst_trm z p t : subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) ⊢ subst_def z p d : subst_dec z p D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) ⊢ subst_defs z p ds :: subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       G1 & subst_ctx z p G2 ⊢ subst_typ z p S <: subst_typ z p U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y T G b G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [-> | Hyz].
    + assert (T = Tz) as ->.
      { destruct (ok_middle_inv Hok) as [HzG1 HzG2].
        exact (binds_middle_self HzG1 HzG2 b). }
      simpl. rewrite svp_same. rewrite sel_fields_nil. rewrite subst_typ_fresh by auto.
      apply weaken_ctx_trm with (H := subst_ctx z p G2).
      * exact Hp.
      * unfold subst_ctx. apply ok_concat_map.
        apply ok_remove with (F := z ~ Tz). exact Hok.
    + simpl. rewrite svp_diff by auto. rewrite sel_fields_nil.
      apply ty_var. exact (@binds_subst_drop G1 z Tz G2 p y T HfG b Hyz).
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G T t U t0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2)). intros w Hw.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
    assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
    specialize (IH w HwL).
    assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ T))).
    { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
    change ((G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) & w ~ subst_typ z p T
            ⊢ open_trm w (subst_trm z p t) : open_typ w (subst_typ z p U)).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_trm_comm t z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_comm U z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc. unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
    apply (IH G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ T) p Hok').
    apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    auto. auto. auto. auto.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G pm q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p q Hn (ty_path_named d2)).
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := subst_typ z p S).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G T ds t0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2)). intros w Hw.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
    assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
    specialize (IH w HwL).
    assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ open_typ w T))).
    { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
    change (w; nil; ((G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) & w ~ open_typ w (subst_typ z p T))
            ⊢ open_defs w (subst_defs z p ds) :: open_typ w (subst_typ z p T)).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_defs_comm ds z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_comm T z w p Hwz Hn).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc. unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
    apply (IH G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ open_typ w T) p).
    + exact Hok'.
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + exact Hn.
    + exact Hwz.
    + exact HfG.
    + exact HfT.
    + exact Hp.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G pm a T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    cbn [subst_trm]. rewrite subst_path_sel_field.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G pm a T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    cbn [subst_trm]. apply ty_rcd_intro.
    rewrite <- subst_trm_path_sel. apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u T U d1 IH1 t1 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (T := subst_typ z p T) (L := L \u dom (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2)).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + intros w Hw. destruct (notin_union_dom Hw) as [HwL HwG].
      assert (Hwz : w <> z) by (eapply fresh_middle_neq; eauto).
      specialize (IH2 w HwL).
      assert (Hok' : ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & (G2 & w ~ T))).
      { rewrite concat_assoc. apply ok_push; auto. }
      change ((G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) & w ~ subst_typ z p T
              ⊢ open_trm w (subst_trm z p u) : subst_typ z p U).
      rewrite <- (@subst_open_trm_comm u z w p Hwz Hn).
      rewrite <- concat_assoc. unfold subst_ctx. rewrite <- map_push.
      apply (IH2 G1 z Tz (G2 & w ~ T) p).
      * exact Hok'.
      * apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
      * exact Hn.
      * exact HfG.
      * exact HfT.
      * exact Hp.
  - (* ty_sngl *) intros G pm q T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_sngl with (q := subst_path z p q).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) intros G pm q a T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    rewrite subst_trm_path_sel. rewrite subst_typ_sngl_sel.
    apply ty_path_elim with (q := subst_path z p q) (a := a) (T := subst_typ z p T).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + rewrite <- subst_trm_path_sel. apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G pm T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_intro with (T := subst_typ z p T).
    rewrite <- (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p pm Hn (ty_path_named d)).
    apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros G pm T d IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p pm Hn (ty_path_named d)).
    apply ty_rec_elim with (T := subst_typ z p T). apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros G pm T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_and_intro.
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros G t T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_sub with (T := subst_typ z p T).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_def_typ *) intros x0 bs G A T G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_def_typ.
  - (* ty_def_all *) intros x0 bs G T t b U V d0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_def_all with (T := subst_typ z p T) (U := subst_typ z p U) (V := subst_typ z p V).
    apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_def_new *) intros x0 bs b G ds T pm e tb d0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    subst pm.
    apply ty_def_new with (T := subst_typ z p T) (p := p_sel (avar_f x0) bs).
    + reflexivity.
    + apply tight_bounds_subst; auto.
    + assert (Hq0 : named_path (p_sel (avar_f x0) bs)) by (apply named_path_fvar).
      assert (Hq : named_path ((p_sel (avar_f x0) bs) • b)) by (apply named_path_sel_field; auto).
      pose proof (IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok eq_refl Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp) as HIH.
      rewrite (@subst_open_defs_p_comm ds z p ((p_sel (avar_f x0) bs) • b) Hn Hq) in HIH.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_p_comm T z p ((p_sel (avar_f x0) bs) • b) Hn Hq) in HIH.
      rewrite (@subst_path_sel_field z p (p_sel (avar_f x0) bs) b) in HIH.
      rewrite (@subst_path_fvar_neq z p x0 bs Hzx) in HIH.
      exact HIH.
  - (* ty_def_path *) intros x0 bs G q b T d0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_def_path with (T := subst_typ z p T).
    apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_defs_one *) intros x0 bs G d D d0 IH G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_defs_one. apply (IH G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
  - (* ty_defs_cons *) intros x0 bs G d ds D T d0 IH1 d1 IH2 hh G1 z Tz G2 p Hok Heq Hn Hzx HfG HfT Hp. subst G.
    apply ty_defs_cons with (T := subst_typ z p T) (D := subst_dec z p D).
    + apply (IH1 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + apply (IH2 G1 z Tz G2 p); auto.
    + change (defs_hasnt (subst_defs z p ds) (label_of_def (subst_def z p d))).
      rewrite (@label_of_def_subst d z p). apply defs_hasnt_subst; auto.

Lemma lookup_star_from_defv : forall γ v t,
  γ ⟦ defv v ⤳* t ⟧ -> t = defv v.
Proof.
  intros γ v t H. remember (defv v) as r eqn:E. revert v E.
  induction H; intros v0 E.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - subst. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p_gen : forall γ r t,
  γ ⟦ r ⤳* t ⟧ ->
  forall p q a, r = defp p -> t = defp q ->
  γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros γ r t H. induction H; intros p0 q0 aa Er Et.
  - rewrite Er in Et. injection Et as Eq. subst q0. apply star_refl.
  - rewrite Er in H. destruct b as [b0 | bv].
    + apply star_step with (b := defp (b0 • aa)).
      * apply lookup_sel_p with (a := aa). exact H.
      * apply IHstar with (p := b0) (q := q0) (a := aa); [reflexivity|exact Et].
    + exfalso. pose proof (lookup_star_from_defv H0) as E. rewrite Et in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros. eapply lookup_star_sel_p_gen with (p := p) (q := q) (a := a); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_record_shape : forall G p R U,
  record_type R -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> U = R \/ record_type U.

  intros G p R U Hrt Hf. remember R as R0 eqn:ER.

    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).

    pose proof (IHHf R0 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.

  G ⊢!! p : U.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma wf_ok : forall G, wf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_weaken : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢! p : R ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pf_bind.
    + apply ok_push; [exact H|exact Hx].
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H0.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
        apply binds_neq_fresh with (v:=T) (E:=G); auto.
  - apply (@pf_fld (G & x0 ~ S0) p a T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_open p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and1 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and2 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt2 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T U). exact (@flow_weaken G p T U H x0 S0 Hx).
  - apply (@pt2_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q a U).
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt3 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T). eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
  - apply (@pt3_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q T).
    + eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
    + apply IHHp; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_mu_absurd : forall U, record_type (μ U) -> False.
Proof. intros U [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_l : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U1.
Proof. intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst. exists ls0. assumption. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_r : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst.
  exists (\{label_of_dec D}). apply rt_one; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_open_p :
  (forall D, record_dec D -> forall p k, record_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)) /\
  (forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> forall p k, record_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T) ls) /\
  (forall T, inert_typ T -> forall p k, inert_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)).
Proof.
  apply rcd_mutind.
  - (* rd_typ *) intros A T p k. simpl. apply rd_typ.
  - (* rd_trm *) intros a T Hin IH p k. simpl. apply rd_trm. apply (IH p k).
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) intros a q0 p k. simpl. apply rd_trm_sngl.
  - (* rt_one *) intros D l Hdec IH Heq p k. simpl. apply rt_one.
    + apply (IH p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
  - (* rt_cons *) intros T ls D l Hrt IHt Hdec IHd Heq Hnin p k. simpl.
    apply rt_cons with (T := open_rec_typ_p k p T) (D := open_rec_dec_p k p D) (l := l).
    + apply (IHt p k).
    + apply (IHd p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
    + exact Hnin.
  - (* inert_all *) intros S T p k. simpl. apply inert_typ_all.
  - (* inert_bnd *) intros T ls Hrt IH p k. simpl.
    apply (@inert_typ_bnd (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T) ls).
    exact (IH p (S k)).
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_p : forall T p, record_type T -> record_type (open_typ_p p T).
Proof.
  intros T p [ls H]. exists ls.
  destruct record_inert_open_p as [_ [Htyp _]].
  exact (Htyp T ls H p 0).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_shape : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> U = μ T0 \/ record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf. remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER.
  revert T0 Hrt ER. induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + inversion E; subst. right. apply record_type_open_p; auto.
    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_l U1 U2 Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_r U1 U2 Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_same : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ μ U -> U = T0.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf.
  destruct (flow_mu_shape Hrt Hf) as [E | Hrec].
  - inversion E; subst. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_record_has : forall G p T0 U D,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> record_has U D ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) D.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U D Hrt Hf Hhas.
  remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER. revert T0 Hrt Hhas ER.
  induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt Hhas ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (flow_mu_same Hrt Hf) as E. subst U.
    exact Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andl U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andr U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
Qed.

  exists d, defs_has ds d /\ x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d : {a ⦂ S}.

  intros C x bs T0 ds a S Hds Hhas.
  destruct (DefsTyped_field Hds Hhas) as [d [Hd Hty]].
  destruct (@defs_has_open_p_inv 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds d Hd) as [d0 [Hd0 E]].
  exists d0. split; [exact Hd0|]. rewrite E. exact Hty.

Lemma defs_field_lookup : forall γ p x bs T0 ds C a S,
  γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
  p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
  exists rhs,
    defs_has ds {a := rhs} /\
    γ ⟦ p • a ⤳ open_defrhs_p p rhs ⟧ /\
    x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 p {a := rhs} : {a ⦂ S}.
Proof.
  intros γ p x bs T0 ds C a S Hlook Ep Hds Hhas.
  subst p.
  destruct (DefsTyped_field_stored Hds Hhas) as [d0 [Hd0 Hty]].
  destruct (proj1 ty_def_record x bs C (open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d0) {a ⦂ S} Hty) as [_ Hlab].
  rewrite label_of_def_open_p in Hlab.
  simpl in Hlab.
  destruct d0 as [A Td | b rhs]; simpl in Hlab.
  - discriminate Hlab.
  - injection Hlab as Eba. subst b.
    exists rhs. split; [exact Hd0|]. split.
    + apply lookup_sel_v with (T := T0) (ds := ds); auto.
    + exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma flow_prefix_snoc : forall G p a T U,
  G ⊢! (p • a) : T ⪼ U -> exists R V, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ V.
Proof.
  intros G p a T U Hf. remember (p • a) as q eqn:Eq.

  - (* and1 *) subst p. apply (IHHf p0 a0 eq_refl).
  - (* and2 *) subst p. apply (IHHf p0 a0 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma precise2_prefix_snoc : forall G p a U,
  G ⊢!! (p • a) : U -> exists V, G ⊢!! p : V.

    exists {{q}}. exact Hp1.
Qed.
