Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma well_typed_binds : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G ->
  forall x T, binds x T G -> exists v, binds x v γ.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hwt. induction Hwt.
  - intros x T Hb. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros y T' Hb. apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Ey ET] | [Hy Hb0]].
    + subst y T'. exists v. apply binds_push_eq.
    + destruct (IHHwt y T' Hb0) as [v0 Hv0].
      exists v0. apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_entries : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G ->
  exists v, binds x v γ /\ G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] Hb.
  destruct (well_typed_binds Hwt Hb) as [v Hv].
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact (Hentries x T v Hb Hv)].
Qed.

Lemma HInv_bind_inert : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (HInv_entries H H0) as [v [_ Hv]]. exact (ty_val_p_inert Hv).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_no_sngl_bind : forall γ G x q, HInv γ G -> binds x {{q}} G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma flow_record_has : forall C p R U D,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> record_has U D -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros C p R U D Hf Hhas. revert C p R Hf.
  induction Hhas; intros C p0 R0 Hf.
  - exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and1 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and2 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma flow_ty_path : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> C ⊢ trm_path p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var; auto.
  - apply ty_new_elim. eapply ty_sub.
    + apply IHHf.
    + apply record_has_sub. apply rh_one.
  - apply ty_rec_elim. apply IHHf.
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and11].
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

Inductive good_typ : typ -> Prop :=
| gt_all : forall S T, good_typ (∀(S) T)
| gt_bnd : forall T, good_typ T -> good_typ (μ T)
| gt_rcd : forall D, good_dec D -> good_typ (typ_rcd D)
| gt_and : forall T U, good_typ T -> good_typ U -> good_typ (T ∧ U)
| gt_sngl : forall p, good_typ ({{ p }})
with good_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| gd_typ : forall A T U, good_dec { A >: T <: U }
| gd_trm : forall a T, good_typ T -> good_dec { a ⦂ T }.

Scheme good_mut := Induction for good_typ Sort Prop
with   good_dec_mut := Induction for good_dec Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme good_mutind from good_mut, good_dec_mut.

Lemma good_open_p :
  (forall T, good_typ T -> forall p k, good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)) /\
  (forall D, good_dec D -> forall p k, good_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)).
Proof.
  apply good_mutind.
  - intros S T p k. apply gt_all.
  - intros T H IH p k. change (good_typ (μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T))). apply gt_bnd. apply IH.
  - intros D H IH p k. change (good_typ (typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k p D))). apply gt_rcd. apply IH.
  - intros T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 p k. change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k p T2)). apply gt_and; auto.
  - intros q p k. change (good_typ ({{ open_rec_path_p k p q }})). apply gt_sngl.
  - intros A T U p k. change (good_dec ({ A >: open_rec_typ_p k p T <: open_rec_typ_p k p U })). apply gd_typ.
  - intros a T H IH p k. change (good_dec ({ a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k p T })). apply gd_trm. apply IH.
Qed.

Definition ctx_good (C:ctx) := forall y U, binds y U C -> good_typ U.

Lemma good_flow : forall C p R U,
  ctx_good C -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> good_typ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hg Hf. induction Hf.
  - exact (Hg x T H0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    match goal with H : good_dec _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; assumption end.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p 0 p U)).
    exact (proj1 good_open_p U H0 p 0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_good :
  (forall T, (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T) /\
             (inert_typ T -> good_typ T)) /\
  (forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* bot *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* rcd *) intros D IH. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 IH1 ls0 H2) as Hg1.
      assert (Hg2 : good_typ (typ_rcd D)).
      { apply (proj1 IH2 (\{label_of_dec D})). apply rt_one; auto. }
      apply gt_and; assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* sel *) intros p l. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* mu *) intros T IH. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_bnd.
      match goal with Hr : record_typ T _ |- _ => exact (proj1 IH _ Hr) end.
  - (* all *) intros S T IH1 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H; inversion H. apply gt_all.
  - (* sngl *) intros p. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* dec typ *) intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 Hdec. apply gd_typ.
  - (* dec trm *) intros a T IH Hdec. inversion Hdec; subst.
    + apply gd_trm. apply (proj2 IH). assumption.
    + apply gd_trm. apply gt_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_good : forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj1 record_inert_good T) ls H). Qed.

Lemma record_dec_good : forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 record_inert_good D H). Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_good : forall T, inert_typ T -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj1 record_inert_good T) H). Qed.

Lemma repl_good :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> good_typ T -> good_typ T') /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> good_dec D -> good_dec D').
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - (* rrcd *) intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
  - (* rand1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [apply IH; assumption|assumption].
  - (* rand2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [assumption|apply IH; assumption].
  - (* rpath *) intros p q bs A Hg. inversion Hg.
  - (* rbnd *) intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_bnd. apply IH; assumption.
  - (* rall1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rall2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rsngl *) intros p q bs Hg. apply gt_sngl.
  - (* rdtyp1 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtyp2 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtrm *) intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gd_trm. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Inductive sub_rel : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| srel_refl T : sub_rel T T
| srel_bot T : sub_rel typ_bot T
| srel_top T : sub_rel T typ_top
| srel_and_l T U V : sub_rel T V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and_r T U V : sub_rel U V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and2 T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel T V -> sub_rel T (U ∧ V)

| srel_sngl_qp p q T T' : repl_typ q p T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sel2 p A T : sub_rel T (p ↓ A)
| srel_sel1 p A T : sub_rel (p ↓ A) T
| srel_all S1 S2 T1 T2 : sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2)
| srel_trans T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel U V -> sub_rel T V.

Lemma subtyp_to_rel : forall G T U, G ⊢ T <: U -> sub_rel T U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply srel_top.
  - apply srel_bot.

  - eapply srel_trans; eauto.
  - apply srel_and_l. apply srel_refl.
  - apply srel_and_r. apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_and2; eauto.
  - apply srel_fld. assumption.
  - eapply srel_typ; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply srel_sel2.
  - apply srel_sel1.
  - eapply srel_all; eauto.
Qed.

    match goal with H : good_dec _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; assumption end.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p 0 p U)).
    exact (proj1 good_open_p U H0 p 0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_good :
  (forall T, (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T) /\
             (inert_typ T -> good_typ T)) /\
  (forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* bot *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* rcd *) intros D IH. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 IH1 ls0 H2) as Hg1.
      assert (Hg2 : good_typ (typ_rcd D)).
      { apply (proj1 IH2 (\{label_of_dec D})). apply rt_one; auto. }
      apply gt_and; assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* sel *) intros p l. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* mu *) intros T IH. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_bnd.
      match goal with Hr : record_typ T _ |- _ => exact (proj1 IH _ Hr) end.
  - (* all *) intros S T IH1 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H; inversion H. apply gt_all.
  - (* sngl *) intros p. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* dec typ *) intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 Hdec. apply gd_typ.
  - (* dec trm *) intros a T IH Hdec. inversion Hdec; subst.
    + apply gd_trm. apply (proj2 IH). assumption.
    + apply gd_trm. apply gt_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_good : forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj1 record_inert_good T) ls H). Qed.

Lemma record_dec_good : forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 record_inert_good D H). Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_good : forall T, inert_typ T -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj1 record_inert_good T) H). Qed.

Lemma repl_good :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> good_typ T -> good_typ T') /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> good_dec D -> good_dec D').
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - (* rrcd *) intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
  - (* rand1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [apply IH; assumption|assumption].
  - (* rand2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [assumption|apply IH; assumption].
  - (* rpath *) intros p q bs A Hg. inversion Hg.
  - (* rbnd *) intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_bnd. apply IH; assumption.
  - (* rall1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rall2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rsngl *) intros p q bs Hg. apply gt_sngl.
  - (* rdtyp1 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtyp2 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtrm *) intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gd_trm. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive sub_rel : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| srel_refl T : sub_rel T T
| srel_bot T : sub_rel typ_bot T
| srel_top T : sub_rel T typ_top
| srel_and_l T U V : sub_rel T V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and_r T U V : sub_rel U V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and2 T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel T V -> sub_rel T (U ∧ V)
| srel_fld T U a : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| srel_typ S1 S2 T1 T2 A :
    sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel T1 T2 ->
    sub_rel (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| srel_sngl_pq p q T T' : repl_typ p q T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sngl_qp p q T T' : repl_typ q p T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sel2 p A T : sub_rel T (p ↓ A)
| srel_sel1 p A T : sub_rel (p ↓ A) T
| srel_all S1 S2 T1 T2 : sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2)
| srel_trans T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel U V -> sub_rel T V.

Lemma subtyp_to_rel : forall G T U, G ⊢ T <: U -> sub_rel T U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply srel_top.
  - apply srel_bot.
  - apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_trans; eauto.
  - apply srel_and_l. apply srel_refl.
  - apply srel_and_r. apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_and2; eauto.
  - apply srel_fld. assumption.
  - eapply srel_typ; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply srel_sel2.
  - apply srel_sel1.
  - eapply srel_all; eauto.
Qed.

# 133 — pDOT type safety

## Task

Show that a closed well-typed pDOT term either diverges or reaches a normal form with the stated typing and heap invariants.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `safety`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: TLC.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

Notation "p '••' bs" := (sel_fields p bs) (at level 5).

Definition label_of_def(d: def): label := match d with
| def_typ A _ => label_typ A
| { a := t }  => label_trm a
end.

Definition label_of_dec(D: dec): label := match D with
| { A >: _ <: _ } => label_typ A
| { a ⦂ _ }  => label_trm a
end.

Fixpoint get_def(l: label)(ds: defs): option def :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of_def d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of_def d) ds = Some d.

Definition defs_hasnt(ds: defs)(l: label) := get_def l ds = None.

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma star_trans : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) a b c,
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. induction H1; intros H2.
  - exact H2.
  - apply star_step with (b:=b); auto.
Qed.

Lemma infseq_from_function : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) (f:nat->A),
  (forall n, R (f n) (f (S n))) -> infseq R (f 0).
Proof.
  intros A R f H. generalize 0 as n. cofix IH. intro n.
  apply infseq_step with (f (S n)); auto.
Qed.

Definition TypedState (T:typ) :=
  sig (fun s : sta * trm => exists G, G ⊢ (snd s) : T /\ HInv (fst s) G).

Definition ts_state T (a:TypedState T) : sta * trm := proj1_sig a.

Definition mkTS : forall (T:typ) (γ:sta) (t:trm) (G:ctx),
  G ⊢ t : T -> HInv γ G -> TypedState T.
Proof.
  intros T γ t G Ht Hi.
  exists (γ,t). exists G. simpl. auto.
Defined.

Lemma ts_typed : forall T (a:TypedState T),
  exists G, G ⊢ (snd (ts_state a)) : T /\ HInv (fst (ts_state a)) G.
Proof. intros T [s Hs]. exact Hs. Qed.

Definition next_rel T (a b:TypedState T) : Prop :=
  red (ts_state a) (ts_state b) \/
  (norm_form (snd (ts_state a)) /\ b = a).

Lemma next_exists : forall T,
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall a : TypedState T, exists b, next_rel a b.
Proof.
  intros T Hstep [[γ t] [G [Ht Hi]]].
  destruct (Hstep γ G t Hi Ht) as [Hnf | [γ' [G' [t' [Hred [Hi' Ht']]]]]].
  - exists (@mkTS T γ t G Ht Hi). right. split; auto.
  - exists (@mkTS T γ' t' G' Ht' Hi'). left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma terminate_or_diverge :
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
    infseq red (γ,t) \/
    exists γ' (u:trm) G', star red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ norm_form u /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ HInv γ' G'.
Proof.
  intros Hstep γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Ht0.
  destruct (classic (infseq red (γ0,t0))) as [Hinf|Hnin].
  - left; auto.
  - destruct (classic (exists a : TypedState T0,
        star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state a) /\ norm_form (snd (ts_state a)))) as [Hterm|Hnoterm].
    + right. destruct Hterm as [a [Hstar Hnf]].
      destruct (ts_state a) as [γs us] eqn:E. simpl in Hstar, Hnf.
      destruct (ts_typed a) as [G' [Hty Hi]].
      rewrite E in Hty, Hi. simpl in Hty, Hi.
      exists γs, us, G'. auto.
    + exfalso. apply Hnin.
      set (a0 := @mkTS T0 γ0 t0 G0 Ht0 Hi0 : TypedState T0).
      destruct (@functional_choice (TypedState T0) (TypedState T0) (@next_rel T0) (@next_exists T0 (fun γ G t Hi Ht => @Hstep γ G t T0 Hi Ht))) as [f Hf].
      assert (Hstar : forall n, star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      { intro n. induction n as [|n IH].
        - simpl. apply star_refl.
        - simpl. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hred | [Hnf _]].
          + apply star_trans with (b := ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)).
            * exact IH.
            * apply star_step with (b := ts_state (f (Nat.iter n f a0))).
              -- exact Hred.
              -- apply star_refl.
          + exfalso. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; auto. }
      assert (Hnon : forall n, ~ norm_form (snd (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)))).
      { intros n Hnf. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; [apply Hstar|auto]. }
      assert (Hred : forall n, red (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)) (ts_state (Nat.iter (S n) f a0))).
      { intro n. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hr | [Hnf _]].
        - exact Hr.
        - exfalso. exact (Hnon n Hnf). }
      apply (@infseq_from_function (sta*trm) red (fun n => ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      intro n. exact (Hred n).
Qed.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.

Lemma open_pvar_trm :

  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.

Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.

Lemma open_defs_pvar : forall (ds:defs) x, open_defs_p (pvar x) ds = open_defs x ds.

Lemma open_path_pvar : forall (q:path) x, open_path_p (pvar x) q = open_path x q.
Proof. intros. apply open_pvar_path. Qed.

Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
  γ ⫶ G /\
  inert G /\
  wf G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Parameter wf_push_cond : forall γ G x S v,

Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,

  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).

Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,

  G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

  intros γ G x S v [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs.
  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].

  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).

    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
    + exact HxG.
  - apply wfe_push.

    + exact HxG.

      exact (@wf_push_cond γ G x S v Hi HxG Hval Hnewdefs).

    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].

  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.

    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].

        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
        -- reflexivity.

           ++ exact HxG.
           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.

Lemma label_of_def_open_p : forall k p (d:def),
  label_of_def (open_rec_def_p k p d) = label_of_def d.
Proof. intros. destruct d; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_open_p_inv : forall k p (ds:defs) d,
  defs_has (open_rec_defs_p k p ds) d ->
  exists d0, defs_has ds d0 /\ open_rec_def_p k p d0 = d.
Proof.
  intros k p ds d. revert k p d.
  induction ds as [|rest IH d0]; intros k p d H.
  - unfold defs_has in H. simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - unfold defs_has in H. cbn in H.
    destruct (classic (label_of_def (open_rec_def_p k p d0) = label_of_def d)) as [Heq|Hne].
    + rewrite If_l in H by auto. injection H as E. subst d.
      exists d0. split; [apply defs_has_cons_same|reflexivity].
    + rewrite If_r in H by auto.
      assert (Hlab : label_of_def d0 <> label_of_def d).
      { intro E. apply Hne. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. exact E. }
      destruct (IH k p d H) as [ds0 [Hds E]].
      exists ds0. split.
      * unfold defs_has. rewrite get_def_cons_neq.
        -- unfold defs_has in Hds. exact Hds.
        -- assert (Elab : label_of_def ds0 = label_of_def d).
           { rewrite <- E. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. reflexivity. }
           intro E2. apply Hlab. rewrite E2. exact Elab.
      * exact E.
Qed.

Definition DefsTyped (C:ctx) (x:var) (bs:fields) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; bs; C ⊢ open_defs_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds ::
               open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0.

Lemma defs_at_DefsTyped : forall G x T0 ds,
  defs_at G x T0 ds -> DefsTyped (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) x nil T0 ds.
Proof.
  intros. unfold defs_at, DefsTyped in *. simpl. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma DefsTyped_field : forall C x bs T0 ds a S,
  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
  record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
  exists d, defs_has (open_defs_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds) d /\
            x; bs; C ⊢ d : {a ⦂ S}.
Proof.
  intros. unfold DefsTyped in H.
  exact (ty_defs_record_has_inv H H0).
Qed.

Lemma DefsTyped_field_stored : forall C x bs T0 ds a S,
  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
  record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
  exists d, defs_has ds d /\ x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d : {a ⦂ S}.
Proof.
  intros C x bs T0 ds a S Hds Hhas.
  destruct (DefsTyped_field Hds Hhas) as [d [Hd Hty]].
  destruct (@defs_has_open_p_inv 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds d Hd) as [d0 [Hd0 E]].
  exists d0. split; [exact Hd0|]. rewrite E. exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma defs_field_lookup : forall γ p x bs T0 ds C a S,
  γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
  p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
  exists rhs,
    defs_has ds {a := rhs} /\
    γ ⟦ p • a ⤳ open_defrhs_p p rhs ⟧ /\
    x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 p {a := rhs} : {a ⦂ S}.
Proof.
  intros γ p x bs T0 ds C a S Hlook Ep Hds Hhas.
  subst p.
  destruct (DefsTyped_field_stored Hds Hhas) as [d0 [Hd0 Hty]].
  destruct (proj1 ty_def_record x bs C (open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d0) {a ⦂ S} Hty) as [_ Hlab].
  rewrite label_of_def_open_p in Hlab.
  simpl in Hlab.
  destruct d0 as [A Td | b rhs]; simpl in Hlab.
  - discriminate Hlab.
  - injection Hlab as Eba. subst b.
    exists rhs. split; [exact Hd0|]. split.
    + apply lookup_sel_v with (T := T0) (ds := ds); auto.
    + exact Hty.
Qed.

Definition is_arrow T := exists S U, T = ∀(S) U.

Inductive ResCore (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rc_lam p v S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv v ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v v : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCore γ G p A
| rc_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCore γ G p U
| rc_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCore γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma res_field : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U Hi R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + (* stored path *) dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rc_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * (* stored lambda *) dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.

                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)

              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).

              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.
              rewrite concat_empty_r in HsubG. exact HsubG.
           ++ exists U0, V; reflexivity.
        -- exfalso. discriminate Ev.
Qed.

Lemma flow_res : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCore γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi p S U Hf.
  induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    dependent destruction Hval.
    + (* lambda *) apply rc_lam with (v := λ(T) t) (S0 := ∀(T) U).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L); exact H1.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * exists T, U; reflexivity.
    + (* object *) apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := T) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T)
                               (bs := nil) (T0 := T) (ds := ds).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H0.
      * reflexivity.
      * apply defs_at_DefsTyped. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hi))) x T ds H0 Hv).
      * inversion Hiner; subst. exists ls. assumption.
      * apply pf_bind; auto.
  - (* fld *) apply res_field with (a := a) (U := U).
    + exact Hi.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma well_typed_binds : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G ->
  forall x T, binds x T G -> exists v, binds x v γ.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hwt. induction Hwt.
  - intros x T Hb. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros y T' Hb. apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Ey ET] | [Hy Hb0]].
    + subst y T'. exists v. apply binds_push_eq.
    + destruct (IHHwt y T' Hb0) as [v0 Hv0].
      exists v0. apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_entries : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G ->
  exists v, binds x v γ /\ G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] Hb.
  destruct (well_typed_binds Hwt Hb) as [v Hv].
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact (Hentries x T v Hb Hv)].
Qed.

Lemma HInv_bind_inert : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (HInv_entries H H0) as [v [_ Hv]]. exact (ty_val_p_inert Hv).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_no_sngl_bind : forall γ G x q, HInv γ G -> binds x {{q}} G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma flow_record_has : forall C p R U D,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> record_has U D -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros C p R U D Hf Hhas. revert C p R Hf.
  induction Hhas; intros C p0 R0 Hf.
  - exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and1 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and2 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma flow_ty_path : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> C ⊢ trm_path p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var; auto.
  - apply ty_new_elim. eapply ty_sub.
    + apply IHHf.
    + apply record_has_sub. apply rh_one.
  - apply ty_rec_elim. apply IHHf.
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and11].
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

Inductive good_typ : typ -> Prop :=
| gt_all : forall S T, good_typ (∀(S) T)
| gt_bnd : forall T, good_typ T -> good_typ (μ T)
| gt_rcd : forall D, good_dec D -> good_typ (typ_rcd D)
| gt_and : forall T U, good_typ T -> good_typ U -> good_typ (T ∧ U)
| gt_sngl : forall p, good_typ ({{ p }})
with good_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| gd_typ : forall A T U, good_dec { A >: T <: U }
| gd_trm : forall a T, good_typ T -> good_dec { a ⦂ T }.

Scheme good_mut := Induction for good_typ Sort Prop
with   good_dec_mut := Induction for good_dec Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme good_mutind from good_mut, good_dec_mut.

Lemma good_open_p :
  (forall T, good_typ T -> forall p k, good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)) /\
  (forall D, good_dec D -> forall p k, good_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)).
Proof.
  apply good_mutind.
  - intros S T p k. apply gt_all.
  - intros T H IH p k. change (good_typ (μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T))). apply gt_bnd. apply IH.
  - intros D H IH p k. change (good_typ (typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k p D))). apply gt_rcd. apply IH.
  - intros T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 p k. change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k p T2)). apply gt_and; auto.
  - intros q p k. change (good_typ ({{ open_rec_path_p k p q }})). apply gt_sngl.
  - intros A T U p k. change (good_dec ({ A >: open_rec_typ_p k p T <: open_rec_typ_p k p U })). apply gd_typ.
  - intros a T H IH p k. change (good_dec ({ a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k p T })). apply gd_trm. apply IH.
Qed.

Definition ctx_good (C:ctx) := forall y U, binds y U C -> good_typ U.

Lemma good_flow : forall C p R U,
  ctx_good C -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> good_typ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hg Hf. induction Hf.
  - exact (Hg x T H0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    match goal with H : good_dec _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; assumption end.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p 0 p U)).
    exact (proj1 good_open_p U H0 p 0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_good :
  (forall T, (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T) /\
             (inert_typ T -> good_typ T)) /\
  (forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* bot *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* rcd *) intros D IH. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 IH1 ls0 H2) as Hg1.
      assert (Hg2 : good_typ (typ_rcd D)).
      { apply (proj1 IH2 (\{label_of_dec D})). apply rt_one; auto. }
      apply gt_and; assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* sel *) intros p l. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* mu *) intros T IH. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_bnd.
      match goal with Hr : record_typ T _ |- _ => exact (proj1 IH _ Hr) end.
  - (* all *) intros S T IH1 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H; inversion H. apply gt_all.
  - (* sngl *) intros p. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* dec typ *) intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 Hdec. apply gd_typ.
  - (* dec trm *) intros a T IH Hdec. inversion Hdec; subst.
    + apply gd_trm. apply (proj2 IH). assumption.
    + apply gd_trm. apply gt_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_good : forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj1 record_inert_good T) ls H). Qed.

Lemma record_dec_good : forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 record_inert_good D H). Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_good : forall T, inert_typ T -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj1 record_inert_good T) H). Qed.

Lemma repl_good :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> good_typ T -> good_typ T') /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> good_dec D -> good_dec D').
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - (* rrcd *) intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
  - (* rand1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [apply IH; assumption|assumption].
  - (* rand2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [assumption|apply IH; assumption].
  - (* rpath *) intros p q bs A Hg. inversion Hg.
  - (* rbnd *) intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_bnd. apply IH; assumption.
  - (* rall1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rall2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rsngl *) intros p q bs Hg. apply gt_sngl.
  - (* rdtyp1 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtyp2 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtrm *) intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gd_trm. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ok : forall G, wf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_weaken : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢! p : R ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pf_bind.
    + apply ok_push; [exact H|exact Hx].
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H0.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
        apply binds_neq_fresh with (v:=T) (E:=G); auto.
  - apply (@pf_fld (G & x0 ~ S0) p a T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_open p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and1 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and2 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt2 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T U). exact (@flow_weaken G p T U H x0 S0 Hx).
  - apply (@pt2_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q a U).
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt3 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T). eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
  - apply (@pt3_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q T).
    + eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
    + apply IHHp; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_mu_absurd : forall U, record_type (μ U) -> False.
Proof. intros U [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_l : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U1.
Proof. intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst. exists ls0. assumption. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_r : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst.
  exists (\{label_of_dec D}). apply rt_one; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_open_p :
  (forall D, record_dec D -> forall p k, record_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)) /\
  (forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> forall p k, record_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T) ls) /\
  (forall T, inert_typ T -> forall p k, inert_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)).
Proof.
  apply rcd_mutind.
  - (* rd_typ *) intros A T p k. simpl. apply rd_typ.
  - (* rd_trm *) intros a T Hin IH p k. simpl. apply rd_trm. apply (IH p k).
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) intros a q0 p k. simpl. apply rd_trm_sngl.
  - (* rt_one *) intros D l Hdec IH Heq p k. simpl. apply rt_one.
    + apply (IH p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
  - (* rt_cons *) intros T ls D l Hrt IHt Hdec IHd Heq Hnin p k. simpl.
    apply rt_cons with (T := open_rec_typ_p k p T) (D := open_rec_dec_p k p D) (l := l).
    + apply (IHt p k).
    + apply (IHd p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
    + exact Hnin.
  - (* inert_all *) intros S T p k. simpl. apply inert_typ_all.
  - (* inert_bnd *) intros T ls Hrt IH p k. simpl.
    apply (@inert_typ_bnd (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T) ls).
    exact (IH p (S k)).
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_p : forall T p, record_type T -> record_type (open_typ_p p T).
Proof.
  intros T p [ls H]. exists ls.
  destruct record_inert_open_p as [_ [Htyp _]].
  exact (Htyp T ls H p 0).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_shape : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> U = μ T0 \/ record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf. remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER.
  revert T0 Hrt ER. induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + inversion E; subst. right. apply record_type_open_p; auto.
    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_l U1 U2 Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_r U1 U2 Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_same : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ μ U -> U = T0.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf.
  destruct (flow_mu_shape Hrt Hf) as [E | Hrec].
  - inversion E; subst. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_record_has : forall G p T0 U D,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> record_has U D ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) D.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U D Hrt Hf Hhas.
  remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER. revert T0 Hrt Hhas ER.
  induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt Hhas ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (flow_mu_same Hrt Hf) as E. subst U.
    exact Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andl U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andr U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma lookup_star_from_defv : forall γ v t,
  γ ⟦ defv v ⤳* t ⟧ -> t = defv v.
Proof.
  intros γ v t H. remember (defv v) as r eqn:E. revert v E.
  induction H; intros v0 E.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - subst. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p_gen : forall γ r t,
  γ ⟦ r ⤳* t ⟧ ->
  forall p q a, r = defp p -> t = defp q ->
  γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros γ r t H. induction H; intros p0 q0 aa Er Et.
  - rewrite Er in Et. injection Et as Eq. subst q0. apply star_refl.
  - rewrite Er in H. destruct b as [b0 | bv].
    + apply star_step with (b := defp (b0 • aa)).
      * apply lookup_sel_p with (a := aa). exact H.
      * apply IHstar with (p := b0) (q := q0) (a := aa); [reflexivity|exact Et].
    + exfalso. pose proof (lookup_star_from_defv H0) as E. rewrite Et in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros. eapply lookup_star_sel_p_gen with (p := p) (q := q) (a := a); eauto.
Qed.

Inductive RHolds (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rh_lam v S0 A :
    G ⊢!v v : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) A
| rh_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) U
| rh_path q :
    RHolds γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holds : forall γ G p U,
  ResCore γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv v). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv v); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_lam with (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_sngl_absurd : forall q, record_type {{ q }} -> False.
Proof. intros q [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_path : forall γ G r q,
  RHolds γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_res Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holds; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookup Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookup Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

Notation "p '••' bs" := (sel_fields p bs) (at level 5).

Definition label_of_def(d: def): label := match d with
| def_typ A _ => label_typ A
| { a := t }  => label_trm a
end.

Definition label_of_dec(D: dec): label := match D with
| { A >: _ <: _ } => label_typ A
| { a ⦂ _ }  => label_trm a
end.

Fixpoint get_def(l: label)(ds: defs): option def :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of_def d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of_def d) ds = Some d.

Definition defs_hasnt(ds: defs)(l: label) := get_def l ds = None.

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path k u p ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2      => ∀(open_rec_typ k u T1) open_rec_typ (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ k u T <: open_rec_typ k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path k u p) (open_rec_path k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val (k: nat) (u: var) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T)ds   => ν (open_rec_typ (S k) u T) open_rec_defs (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ k u T) open_rec_trm (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => def_typ A (open_rec_typ k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs (k: nat) (u: var) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar u a := open_rec_avar  0 u a.

Definition open_typ  u t := open_rec_typ   0 u t.

Definition open_dec  u D := open_rec_dec   0 u D.

Definition open_trm  u e := open_rec_trm   0 u e.

Definition open_val  u v := open_rec_val   0 u v.

Definition open_def  u d := open_rec_def   0 u d.

Definition open_defs u l := open_rec_defs  0 u l.

Definition open_defrhsdd u t := open_rec_defrhs 0 u t.

Definition open_path u p := open_rec_path  0 u p.

Definition open_paths u ps := map (open_path u) ps.

Definition open_rec_avar_p (k: nat) (u: path) (a: avar) : path :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then u else p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f x => pvar x
  end.

Definition open_rec_path_p (k: nat) (u: path) (p: path): path :=
  match p, u with
  | p_sel x bs, p_sel y cs=>
    match x with
    | avar_b i => If k = i then p_sel y (bs ++ cs) else p
    | avar_f x => p
    end
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L
  | μ       T      => μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2       => ∀(open_rec_typ_p k u T1) open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path_p k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec_p (k: nat) (u: path) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ_p k u T <: open_rec_typ_p k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_dec_p  u D := open_rec_dec_p   0 u D.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Definition open_trm_p  u t := open_rec_trm_p   0 u t.

Definition open_val_p  u v := open_rec_val_p   0 u v.

Definition open_def_p  u d := open_rec_def_p   0 u d.

Definition open_defs_p u l := open_rec_defs_p 0 u l.

Definition open_defrhs_p u t := open_rec_defrhs_p 0 u t.

Inductive repl_typ : path -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| rrcd: forall p q D1 D2,
    repl_dec p q D1 D2 ->
    repl_typ p q (typ_rcd D1) (typ_rcd D2)
| rand1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (T1 ∧ U) (T2 ∧ U)
| rand2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (U ∧ T1) (U ∧ T2)
| rpath: forall p q bs A,
    repl_typ p q (p••bs ↓ A) (q••bs ↓ A)
| rbnd: forall p q T1 T2,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (μ T1) (μ T2)
| rall1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(T1) U) (∀(T2) U)
| rall2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(U) T1) (∀(U) T2)
| rsngl: forall p q bs,
    repl_typ p q {{ p••bs }} {{ q••bs }}
with repl_dec : path -> path -> dec -> dec -> Prop :=
| rdtyp1: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: T1 <: U} {A >: T2 <: U}
| rdtyp2: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: U <: T1} {A >: U <: T2}
| rdtrm: forall p q T1 T2 a,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {a ⦂ T1} {a ⦂ T2}.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Definition ctx := env typ.

Definition sta := env val.

Definition fv_ctx_types(G: ctx): vars :=
  (fv_in_values (fun T => fv_typ T) G).

Definition fv_sta_vals(s: sta): vars := (fv_in_values (fun v => fv_val v) s).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec { A >: T <: T }
| rd_trm : forall a T, inert_typ T -> record_dec { a ⦂ T }
| rd_trm_sngl : forall a p, record_dec { a ⦂ {{ p }} }





with record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of_dec D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (T ∧ typ_rcd D) (union ls \{l})















with inert_typ : typ -> Prop :=
  | inert_typ_all : forall S T, inert_typ (∀(S) T)
  | inert_typ_bnd : forall T ls,
      record_typ T ls ->
      inert_typ (μ T).

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (T ∧ U) D.

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive inert : ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty : inert empty
  | inert_push : forall G x T,
      inert G ->
      inert_typ T ->
      x # G ->
      inert (G & x ~ T).

Fixpoint tight_bounds T :=
  match T with
  | typ_rcd D => tight_bounds_dec D
  | U ∧ V     => tight_bounds U /\ tight_bounds V
  | typ_bnd U => tight_bounds U
  | _         => True
  end
with tight_bounds_dec D :=
  match D with
  | { a ⦂ T }       => tight_bounds T
  | { A >: T <: U } => T = U
  end.

| ty_var : forall x T G,
    binds x T G ->
    G ⊢ tvar x : T








| ty_all_intro : forall L G T t U,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
      G & z ~ T ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(T) U








| ty_all_elim : forall G p q S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->

    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->

| ty_rcd_intro : forall G p a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T }









| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,
    G ⊢ t : T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x u : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_let t u : U








| ty_sngl : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->

| ty_path_elim : forall G p q a T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q•a : T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p•a : {{ q•a }}







| ty_rec_intro : forall G p T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : open_typ_p p T ->

    G ⊢ trm_path p : μ T ->

| ty_and_intro : forall G p T U,

with ty_def : var -> fields -> ctx -> def -> dec -> Prop :=

| ty_def_typ : forall x bs G A T,

    G ⊢ trm_val (λ(T) t) : ∀(U) V ->

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions.

Close Scope string_scope.

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y
  end.

Definition subst_path (z: var) (q: path) (p: path) : path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => sel_fields (subst_avar z q x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (p: path) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z p D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => subst_typ z p T1 ∧ subst_typ z p T2
  | q ↓ L          => subst_path z p q ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (subst_typ z p T)
  | ∀(T) U         => ∀ (subst_typ z p T) subst_typ z p U
  | {{ q }}        => {{ subst_path z p q }}
  end
with subst_dec (z: var) (p: path) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | {A >: T <: U} => {A >: subst_typ z p T <: subst_typ z p U}
  | {a ⦂ U}        => {a ⦂ subst_typ z p U }
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: path) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => trm_val (subst_val z u v)
  | trm_path p       => trm_path (subst_path z u p)
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_path z u x1) (subst_path z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  end
with subst_val (z: var) (u: path) (v: val) : val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds  => ν(subst_typ z u T) subst_defs z u ds
  | λ(T) t   => λ(subst_typ z u T) subst_trm z u t
  end
with subst_def (z: var) (u: path) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (subst_typ z u T)
  | { a := t }  => { a := subst_defrhs z u t }
  end
with subst_defs (z: var) (u: path) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end
with subst_defrhs (z: var) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (subst_path z u p)
  | defv v => defv (subst_val z u v)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx (z: var) (p: path) (G: ctx) : ctx :=
  map (subst_typ z p) G.

Definition named_path p := exists x bs, p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (Hsubst_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p Hok (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ T))) Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        unfold open_trm in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (@subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p p u). split.
        -- apply red_let_path.
        -- split; [exact Hi|]. split; [exact Hsub|].
           exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
      * (* let-val *)
        right.
        destruct (ty_val_inv Hty0) as
          [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]].
        -- (* lambda *)
           subst v.
           set (Lx := L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (λ(T1) t') = ν(T0x) dsx -> ∀(T1) T2 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx Eqx. discriminate Eqx. }
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t') (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (∀(T1)T2) (λ(T1)t') Hi HxG Hxγ Hval Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t'), (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)).

                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ (∀(T1) T2) & empty ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (@bind_sub_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty (∀(T1)T2) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
        -- (* new *)
           subst v.
           dependent destruction Hval.
           set (Lx := L0 \u L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxL0 : x \notin L0).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H1 x HxL0) as Hdx.
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (ν(T0) ds) = ν(T0x) dsx -> μ T0 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx E. injection E as ET Eds. subst T0x dsx. split; [reflexivity|].
             unfold defs_at.
             rewrite open_defs_pvar, open_typ_pvar.
             assert (Hsh : x; nil; ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ x T0) ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T0).
             { eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_shadow_ty))); [exact Hdx | reflexivity |].
               rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'. }
             exact Hsh. }
           assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v ν(T0) ds : μ T0) by (apply ty_new_intro_p with (L:=L0); exact H1).
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (μ T0) (ν(T0)ds) Hi HxG Hxγ Hval' Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds), (G & x ~ μ T0), (x ~ μ T0), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)) by (rewrite dom_concat_empty; exact HxG).
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ (μ T0) & empty ⊢ μ T0 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (@bind_sub_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty (μ T0) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.

    + (* let step in scrutinee *)
      subst G'. right. exists γ', (G & Hext), Hext, (trm_let u' u). split.
      * apply red_let_tgt; auto.
      * split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
        -- (* re-type the let in extended context *)
           set (L2 := L \u fv_ctx_types Hext \u dom (G & Hext)).
           apply ty_let with (T := T) (L := L2).
           ++ exact Hty'.
           ++ intros x Hx2.
              assert (HxL : x \notin L).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              assert (HxH : x \notin fv_ctx_types Hext).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              assert (HxGH : x # (G & Hext)).
              { intro E. apply Hx2. unfold L2. solve_union. }
              pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
              exact (@weaken_insert_ctx G Hext x T (open_trm x u) U (HInv_ok Hi') HxGH Hbody).
        -- reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sngl *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + left. exact Hnf.
    + right. exists γ', G', Hext, u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|]. split.
      * apply ty_sub with (T := T).
        -- exact Hty'.
        -- rewrite Heq. apply weaken_sub_ctx; [rewrite <- Heq; apply HInv_ok in Hi'; exact Hi'|exact H].
      * exact Heq.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Lemma app_var_step : forall γ G x q Sarg Tres,
  HInv γ G ->
  binds x (∀(Sarg) Tres) G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : Sarg ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (Hext:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app (pvar x) q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q Tres /\ G' = G & Hext.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Sarg Tres Hi Hb Hq.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [Hvγ Hval]].
  dependent destruction Hval.
  (* now v = lambda, Sarg/Tres fixed; premise typing of body named H0? *)
  assert (Hbody : forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ Sarg ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z Tres).
  { intros z Hz. exact (H z Hz). }
  assert (Hlook : γ ⟦ defp (pvar x) ⤳* defv (λ(Sarg) t) ⟧).
  { apply star_step with (b := defv (λ(Sarg) t)).
    - apply lookup_var. exact Hvγ.
    - apply star_refl. }
  exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := Sarg) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - split; [exact Hi|]. split.
    + (* preservation by substitution *)
      set (Lz := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ Sarg \u fv_typ Tres \u fv_trm t).
      destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
      assert (HzL : z \notin L).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ Sarg).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ Tres).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
      { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q Sarg Hq)).
      assert (Hok : ok (G & z ~ Sarg & empty)).
      { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
        intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
      pose proof (Hbody z HzL) as Hbz.
      pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ Sarg) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z Tres) Hbz
                    G z Sarg empty q Hok
                    (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ Sarg)))
                    Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub.
      unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
      rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub.
      rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
      unfold open_trm in Hsub.
      rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub.
      unfold open_typ in Hsub.
      rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z Tres 0 z HzT q Hnp) in Hsub.
      exact Hsub.
    + exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
Qed.
