=====HP.V=====
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros a t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_trm :
  (forall (t:trm) k x, open_rec_trm_p k (pvar x) t = open_rec_trm k x t) /\
  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T 0 x). Qed.
Lemma open_defs_pvar : forall (ds:defs) x, open_defs_p (pvar x) ds = open_defs x ds.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 open_pvar_trm)))). Qed.
Lemma open_path_pvar : forall (q:path) x, open_path_p (pvar x) q = open_path x q.
Proof. intros. apply open_pvar_path. Qed.

Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
  γ ⫶ G /\
  inert G /\
  wf G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Parameter wf_push_cond : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
            exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,
  G ⊢!v v : T -> x # G -> G & x ~ T ⊢!v v : T.
Proof. intros G v T x H Hx. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v T H x T Hx). Qed.

Lemma HInv_empty : HInv empty empty.
Proof.
  unfold HInv. split; [apply well_typed_empty|]. split; [apply inert_empty|]. split; [apply wfe_empty|]. split.
  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros x T0 ds Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
  G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs.
  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
    + exact HxG.
  - apply wfe_push.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact HxG.
    + assert (Hi : HInv γ G) by (unfold HInv; split; [exact Hwt|]; split; [exact Hinert|]; split; [exact Hwf|]; split; [exact Hentries|exact Hdefs]).
      exact (@wf_push_cond γ G x S v Hi HxG Hval Hnewdefs).
  - intros y T' v' HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * subst. exact (ty_val_p_weaken_single Hval HxG).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).
  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * rewrite Eyx. exact (proj2 (Hnewdefs T0 ds (eq_sym Ev))).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * unfold defs_at in *.
        eapply weaken_defs with (G1:=G) (G2:= y ~ open_typ_p (pvar y) T0) (w:=x) (S:=S).
        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
           ++ exact HxG.
           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma ty_val_inv_gen : forall G (t:trm) T, G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall (v:val), t = trm_val v ->
  (exists T1 T2 t', v = λ(T1) t' /\ G ⊢!v v : ∀(T1) T2 /\ G ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T) \/
  (exists T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds /\ G ⊢!v v : μ T0 /\ G ⊢ μ T0 <: T).
Proof.
  intros G t T H.
  induction H using ty_trm_ind; intros v0 Eq.
  - (* ty_var *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
    left. exists T, U, t. split; [reflexivity|]. split.
    + apply ty_all_intro_p with (L:=L); auto.
    + apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
    right. exists T, ds. split; [reflexivity|]. split.
    + apply ty_new_intro_p with (L:=L); auto.
    + apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_sngl *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) discriminate Eq.
  - (* ty_sub *)
    destruct (IHty_trm v0 Eq) as [[T1 [T2 [t1 [Ev [Hp Hs]]]]] | [T1 [ds [Ev [Hp Hs]]]]].
    + left. exists T1, T2, t1. split; auto. split; auto.
      eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
    + right. exists T1, ds. split; auto. split; auto.
      eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_val_inv : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢ trm_val v : T ->
  (exists T1 T2 t', v = λ(T1) t' /\ G ⊢!v v : ∀(T1) T2 /\ G ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T) \/
  (exists T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds /\ G ⊢!v v : μ T0 /\ G ⊢ μ T0 <: T).
Proof. intros. eapply ty_val_inv_gen; eauto. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition is_arrow T := exists S U, T = ∀(S) U.

Inductive ResCore (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rc_lam p v S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv v ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v v : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCore γ G p A
| rc_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCore γ G p U
| rc_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCore γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma res_field : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U Hi R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + (* stored path *) dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rc_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * (* stored lambda *) dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rc_lam with (v := λ(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                                    (open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv))
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
              destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).
              ** exact H1.
              ** rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto.
              ** reflexivity.
           ++ assert (Hxempty : x # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.
              rewrite concat_empty_r in HsubG. exact HsubG.
           ++ exists U0, V; reflexivity.
        -- exfalso. discriminate Ev.
Qed.

Lemma flow_res : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCore γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi p S U Hf.
  induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    dependent destruction Hval.
    + (* lambda *) apply rc_lam with (v := λ(T) t) (S0 := ∀(T) U).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L); exact H1.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * exists T, U; reflexivity.
    + (* object *) apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := T) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T)
                               (bs := nil) (T0 := T) (ds := ds).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H0.
      * reflexivity.
      * apply defs_at_DefsTyped. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hi))) x T ds H0 Hv).
      * inversion Hiner; subst. exists ls. assumption.
      * apply pf_bind; auto.
  - (* fld *) apply res_field with (a := a) (U := U).
    + exact Hi.
    + apply (IHHf Hi).
  - (* open *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + pose proof (flow_mu_same H4 H5) as E. subst U.
      apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_open (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) T0 H5).
  - (* and1 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_and1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) U1 U2 H5).
  - (* and2 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_and2 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) U1 U2 H5).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Lemma lookup_star_from_defv : forall γ v t,
  γ ⟦ defv v ⤳* t ⟧ -> t = defv v.
Proof.
  intros γ v t H. remember (defv v) as r eqn:E. revert v E.
  induction H; intros v0 E.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - subst. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p_gen : forall γ r t,
  γ ⟦ r ⤳* t ⟧ ->
  forall p q a, r = defp p -> t = defp q ->
  γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros γ r t H. induction H; intros p0 q0 aa Er Et.
  - rewrite Er in Et. injection Et as Eq. subst q0. apply star_refl.
  - rewrite Er in H. destruct b as [b0 | bv].
    + apply star_step with (b := defp (b0 • aa)).
      * apply lookup_sel_p with (a := aa). exact H.
      * apply IHstar with (p := b0) (q := q0) (a := aa); [reflexivity|exact Et].
    + exfalso. pose proof (lookup_star_from_defv H0) as E. rewrite Et in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros. eapply lookup_star_sel_p_gen with (p := p) (q := q) (a := a); eauto.
Qed.

Inductive RHolds (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rh_lam v S0 A :
    G ⊢!v v : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) A
| rh_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) U
| rh_path q :
    RHolds γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holds : forall γ G p U,
  ResCore γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv v). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv v); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_lam with (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_sngl_absurd : forall q, record_type {{ q }} -> False.
Proof. intros q [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_path : forall γ G r q,
  RHolds γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_res Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holds; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookup Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookup Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Lemma wf_ok : forall G, wf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_weaken : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢! p : R ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pf_bind.
    + apply ok_push; [exact H|exact Hx].
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H0.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
        apply binds_neq_fresh with (v:=T) (E:=G); auto.
  - apply (@pf_fld (G & x0 ~ S0) p a T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_open p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and1 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and2 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt2 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T U). exact (@flow_weaken G p T U H x0 S0 Hx).
  - apply (@pt2_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q a U).
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt3 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T). eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
  - apply (@pt3_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q T).
    + eapply precise2_weaken; eauto.
    + apply IHHp; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_mu_absurd : forall U, record_type (μ U) -> False.
Proof. intros U [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_l : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U1.
Proof. intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst. exists ls0. assumption. Qed.

Lemma record_type_and_r : forall U1 U2, record_type (U1 ∧ U2) -> record_type U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 [ls H]. inversion H; subst.
  exists (\{label_of_dec D}). apply rt_one; auto.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_open_p :
  (forall D, record_dec D -> forall p k, record_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)) /\
  (forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> forall p k, record_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T) ls) /\
  (forall T, inert_typ T -> forall p k, inert_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)).
Proof.
  apply rcd_mutind.
  - (* rd_typ *) intros A T p k. simpl. apply rd_typ.
  - (* rd_trm *) intros a T Hin IH p k. simpl. apply rd_trm. apply (IH p k).
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) intros a q0 p k. simpl. apply rd_trm_sngl.
  - (* rt_one *) intros D l Hdec IH Heq p k. simpl. apply rt_one.
    + apply (IH p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
  - (* rt_cons *) intros T ls D l Hrt IHt Hdec IHd Heq Hnin p k. simpl.
    apply rt_cons with (T := open_rec_typ_p k p T) (D := open_rec_dec_p k p D) (l := l).
    + apply (IHt p k).
    + apply (IHd p k).
    + rewrite label_of_dec_open_p. exact Heq.
    + exact Hnin.
  - (* inert_all *) intros S T p k. simpl. apply inert_typ_all.
  - (* inert_bnd *) intros T ls Hrt IH p k. simpl.
    apply (@inert_typ_bnd (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T) ls).
    exact (IH p (S k)).
Qed.

Lemma record_type_open_p : forall T p, record_type T -> record_type (open_typ_p p T).
Proof.
  intros T p [ls H]. exists ls.
  destruct record_inert_open_p as [_ [Htyp _]].
  exact (Htyp T ls H p 0).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_shape : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> U = μ T0 \/ record_type U.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf. remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER.
  revert T0 Hrt ER. induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst. left; reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + inversion E; subst. right. apply record_type_open_p; auto.
    + exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_l U1 U2 Hrec).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf T1 Hrt eq_refl) as HS.
    destruct HS as [E | Hrec].
    + discriminate E.
    + right. exact (@record_type_and_r U1 U2 Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_same : forall G p T0 U,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ μ U -> U = T0.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U Hrt Hf.
  destruct (flow_mu_shape Hrt Hf) as [E | Hrec].
  - inversion E; subst. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. exact (record_type_mu_absurd Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma flow_mu_record_has : forall G p T0 U D,
  record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U -> record_has U D ->
  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) D.
Proof.
  intros G p T0 U D Hrt Hf Hhas.
  remember (μ T0) as R eqn:ER. revert T0 Hrt Hhas ER.
  induction Hf; intros T1 Hrt Hhas ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst. inversion Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (flow_mu_same Hrt Hf) as E. subst U.
    exact Hhas.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andl U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
  - inversion ER; subst.
    exact (IHHf T1 Hrt (@rh_andr U1 U2 D Hhas) eq_refl).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma well_typed_binds : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G ->
  forall x T, binds x T G -> exists v, binds x v γ.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hwt. induction Hwt.
  - intros x T Hb. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros y T' Hb. apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Ey ET] | [Hy Hb0]].
    + subst y T'. exists v. apply binds_push_eq.
    + destruct (IHHwt y T' Hb0) as [v0 Hv0].
      exists v0. apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_entries : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G ->
  exists v, binds x v γ /\ G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] Hb.
  destruct (well_typed_binds Hwt Hb) as [v Hv].
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact (Hentries x T v Hb Hv)].
Qed.

Lemma HInv_bind_inert : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (HInv_entries H H0) as [v [_ Hv]]. exact (ty_val_p_inert Hv).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_no_sngl_bind : forall γ G x q, HInv γ G -> binds x {{q}} G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma flow_record_has : forall C p R U D,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> record_has U D -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros C p R U D Hf Hhas. revert C p R Hf.
  induction Hhas; intros C p0 R0 Hf.
  - exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and1 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and2 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma flow_ty_path : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> C ⊢ trm_path p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var; auto.
  - apply ty_new_elim. eapply ty_sub.
    + apply IHHf.
    + apply record_has_sub. apply rh_one.
  - apply ty_rec_elim. apply IHHf.
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and11].
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

Inductive good_typ : typ -> Prop :=
| gt_all : forall S T, good_typ (∀(S) T)
| gt_bnd : forall T, good_typ T -> good_typ (μ T)
| gt_rcd : forall D, good_dec D -> good_typ (typ_rcd D)
| gt_and : forall T U, good_typ T -> good_typ U -> good_typ (T ∧ U)
| gt_sngl : forall p, good_typ ({{ p }})
with good_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| gd_typ : forall A T U, good_dec { A >: T <: U }
| gd_trm : forall a T, good_typ T -> good_dec { a ⦂ T }.

Scheme good_mut := Induction for good_typ Sort Prop
with   good_dec_mut := Induction for good_dec Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme good_mutind from good_mut, good_dec_mut.

Lemma good_open_p :
  (forall T, good_typ T -> forall p k, good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)) /\
  (forall D, good_dec D -> forall p k, good_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)).
Proof.
  apply good_mutind.
  - intros S T p k. apply gt_all.
  - intros T H IH p k. change (good_typ (μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) p T))). apply gt_bnd. apply IH.
  - intros D H IH p k. change (good_typ (typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k p D))). apply gt_rcd. apply IH.
  - intros T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 p k. change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k p T2)). apply gt_and; auto.
  - intros q p k. change (good_typ ({{ open_rec_path_p k p q }})). apply gt_sngl.
  - intros A T U p k. change (good_dec ({ A >: open_rec_typ_p k p T <: open_rec_typ_p k p U })). apply gd_typ.
  - intros a T H IH p k. change (good_dec ({ a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k p T })). apply gd_trm. apply IH.
Qed.

Definition ctx_good (C:ctx) := forall y U, binds y U C -> good_typ U.

Lemma good_flow : forall C p R U,
  ctx_good C -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> good_typ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hg Hf. induction Hf.
  - exact (Hg x T H0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    match goal with H : good_dec _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; assumption end.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst.
    change (good_typ (open_rec_typ_p 0 p U)).
    exact (proj1 good_open_p U H0 p 0).
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
  - pose proof (IHHf Hg) as Hgood. inversion Hgood; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_inert_good :
  (forall T, (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T) /\
             (inert_typ T -> good_typ T)) /\
  (forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* bot *) split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* rcd *) intros D IH. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H. inversion H; subst.
      pose proof (proj1 IH1 ls0 H2) as Hg1.
      assert (Hg2 : good_typ (typ_rcd D)).
      { apply (proj1 IH2 (\{label_of_dec D})). apply rt_one; auto. }
      apply gt_and; assumption.
    + intros H; inversion H.
  - (* sel *) intros p l. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* mu *) intros T IH. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H. inversion H; subst. apply gt_bnd.
      match goal with Hr : record_typ T _ |- _ => exact (proj1 IH _ Hr) end.
  - (* all *) intros S T IH1 IH2. split.
    + intros ls H; inversion H.
    + intros H; inversion H. apply gt_all.
  - (* sngl *) intros p. split; [intros ls H; inversion H | intros H; inversion H].
  - (* dec typ *) intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 Hdec. apply gd_typ.
  - (* dec trm *) intros a T IH Hdec. inversion Hdec; subst.
    + apply gd_trm. apply (proj2 IH). assumption.
    + apply gd_trm. apply gt_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_good : forall T ls, record_typ T ls -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj1 record_inert_good T) ls H). Qed.

Lemma record_dec_good : forall D, record_dec D -> good_dec D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 record_inert_good D H). Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_good : forall T, inert_typ T -> good_typ T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj1 record_inert_good T) H). Qed.

Lemma repl_good :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> good_typ T -> good_typ T') /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> good_dec D -> good_dec D').
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - (* rrcd *) intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_rcd. apply IH. assumption.
  - (* rand1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [apply IH; assumption|assumption].
  - (* rand2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst.
    apply gt_and; [assumption|apply IH; assumption].
  - (* rpath *) intros p q bs A Hg. inversion Hg.
  - (* rbnd *) intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gt_bnd. apply IH; assumption.
  - (* rall1 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rall2 *) intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hg. apply gt_all.
  - (* rsngl *) intros p q bs Hg. apply gt_sngl.
  - (* rdtyp1 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtyp2 *) intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hg. apply gd_typ.
  - (* rdtrm *) intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hg. inversion Hg; subst. apply gd_trm. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path k u p ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2      => ∀(open_rec_typ k u T1) open_rec_typ (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ k u T <: open_rec_typ k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path k u p) (open_rec_path k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val (k: nat) (u: var) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T)ds   => ν (open_rec_typ (S k) u T) open_rec_defs (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ k u T) open_rec_trm (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => def_typ A (open_rec_typ k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs (k: nat) (u: var) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar u a := open_rec_avar  0 u a.

Definition open_typ  u t := open_rec_typ   0 u t.

Definition open_dec  u D := open_rec_dec   0 u D.

Definition open_rec_avar_p (k: nat) (u: path) (a: avar) : path :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then u else p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f x => pvar x
  end.

Definition open_rec_path_p (k: nat) (u: path) (p: path): path :=
  match p, u with
  | p_sel x bs, p_sel y cs=>
    match x with
    | avar_b i => If k = i then p_sel y (bs ++ cs) else p
    | avar_f x => p
    end
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L
  | μ       T      => μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2       => ∀(open_rec_typ_p k u T1) open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path_p k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec_p (k: nat) (u: path) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ_p k u T <: open_rec_typ_p k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Inductive repl_typ : path -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| rrcd: forall p q D1 D2,
    repl_dec p q D1 D2 ->
    repl_typ p q (typ_rcd D1) (typ_rcd D2)
| rand1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (T1 ∧ U) (T2 ∧ U)
| rand2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (U ∧ T1) (U ∧ T2)
| rpath: forall p q bs A,
    repl_typ p q (p••bs ↓ A) (q••bs ↓ A)
| rbnd: forall p q T1 T2,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (μ T1) (μ T2)
| rall1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(T1) U) (∀(T2) U)
| rall2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(U) T1) (∀(U) T2)
| rsngl: forall p q bs,
    repl_typ p q {{ p••bs }} {{ q••bs }}
with repl_dec : path -> path -> dec -> dec -> Prop :=
| rdtyp1: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: T1 <: U} {A >: T2 <: U}
| rdtyp2: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: U <: T1} {A >: U <: T2}
| rdtrm: forall p q T1 T2 a,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {a ⦂ T1} {a ⦂ T2}.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y
  end.

Definition subst_path (z: var) (q: path) (p: path) : path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => sel_fields (subst_avar z q x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (p: path) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z p D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => subst_typ z p T1 ∧ subst_typ z p T2
  | q ↓ L          => subst_path z p q ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (subst_typ z p T)
  | ∀(T) U         => ∀ (subst_typ z p T) subst_typ z p U
  | {{ q }}        => {{ subst_path z p q }}
  end
with subst_dec (z: var) (p: path) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | {A >: T <: U} => {A >: subst_typ z p T <: subst_typ z p U}
  | {a ⦂ U}        => {a ⦂ subst_typ z p U }
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: path) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => trm_val (subst_val z u v)
  | trm_path p       => trm_path (subst_path z u p)
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_path z u x1) (subst_path z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  end
with subst_val (z: var) (u: path) (v: val) : val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds  => ν(subst_typ z u T) subst_defs z u ds
  | λ(T) t   => λ(subst_typ z u T) subst_trm z u t
  end
with subst_def (z: var) (u: path) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (subst_typ z u T)
  | { a := t }  => { a := subst_defrhs z u t }
  end
with subst_defs (z: var) (u: path) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end
with subst_defrhs (z: var) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (subst_path z u p)
  | defv v => defv (subst_val z u v)
  end.

Definition subst_ctx (z: var) (p: path) (G: ctx) : ctx :=
  map (subst_typ z p) G.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a monolithic Task.v from the verified scratch chain.
Usage: python3 merge.py OUT.v [--check]
It preserves the supplied header of /workspace/Task.v through the diverges
definition, appends helper files in dependency order, strips only imports /
scope commands / duplicate Ltac / scratch Parameter declarations, and appends
the target theorem with the proof from safety.v.
"""
import re, sys, os
WORK = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
TASK = '/workspace/Task.v'
CHAIN = ['dev9','w3','b','b2','v3','s','sp','sub','rec','op','dr','val2','look',
         'hp','sh','term','step','wfpush','precise','appvar','resnav','selfswap',
         'defsn','res','lookupres','selfflow','viewflow']
# wfpush imports step but does not depend on StepOK; step before wfpush is fine.

def strip_scratch(txt):
    out=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('Require Import') or s.startswith('Require Export'):
            continue
        if s in ('Set Implicit Arguments.','Close Scope string_scope.','Close Scope string_scope.'):
            continue
        # keep everything else, including comments and ltac; duplicate Ltac handled later
        out.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(out)

def main():
    out_path=sys.argv[1]
    task=open(TASK).read()
    marker='Definition diverges := infseq red.'
    i=task.index(marker)+len(marker)
    header=task[:i]
    # verify supplied target statement is still present exactly
    assert 'Theorem safety t T :' in task
    chunks=[]
    seen_ltac=False
    for f in CHAIN:
        p=os.path.join(WORK,f+'.v')
        txt=open(p).read()
        txt=strip_scratch(txt)
        # remove duplicate Ltac solve_union block (all files define same tactic).
        if 'Ltac solve_union :=' in txt:
            if seen_ltac:
                # remove just the Ltac command (one line in this dev)
                txt=re.sub(r'^\s*Ltac solve_union :=.*?\.\s*$','',txt,flags=re.M|re.S)
            else:
                seen_ltac=True
        if re.search(r'^\s*(Parameter|Axiom|Conjecture)\b',txt,re.M):
            sys.stderr.write('ERROR: %s.v still contains a Parameter/Axiom/Conjecture\n'%f)
            sys.exit(2)
        chunks.append('\n(* ===== %s.v ===== *)\n'%f + txt)
    # safety proof: reuse safety_test statement proof from safety.v, but target
    # theorem must be exactly `safety` and use the supplied statement.
    saf=strip_scratch(open(os.path.join(WORK,'safety.v')).read())
    # Pull out the safety_test theorem body.
    m=re.search(r'Theorem safety_test\s*:.*?Qed\.',saf,re.S)
    if not m:
        sys.stderr.write('ERROR: safety_test theorem not found\n'); sys.exit(2)
    body=m.group(0)
    body=body.replace('Theorem safety_test','Theorem safety',1)
    merged=header+'\n\n(* ===== helper development ===== *)\n'+''.join(chunks)+'\n\n(* ===== target theorem ===== *)\n'+body+'\n\nEnd Safety.\n'
    open(out_path,'w').write(merged)
    print('wrote',out_path,len(merged),'bytes')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

  - (* all *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    apply notin_union_r in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzx].
    apply notin_singleton_r in Hzx.
    eapply weaken_trm with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ T) (w := x) (S := S).

  - (* new *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    apply notin_union_r in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzx].

Lemma flow_prefix_snoc : forall G p a T U,

Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Lemma binds_remove_self : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/ binds y Ty (G1 & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hb Hx H.
  apply binds_concat_inv in H. destruct H as [HG2 | [HyG2 H1]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - apply binds_concat_inv in H1. destruct H1 as [Hxopen | [Hyopen H1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hxopen. exact Hxopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma self_remove_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    destruct (binds_remove_self Hb Hx b) as [[Eyx ETy] | Hb'].
    + subst y Ty. apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; auto.
    + apply ty_var. exact Hb'.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (@IH G1 (G2 & z ~ Tb) x T0 Hb Hx'
      (eq_sym (@concat_assoc typ (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) G2 (z ~ Tb)))).
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S); [apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)|apply (@IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl)].
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G Tb ds t0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
    specialize (IH z HzL).
    assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (@IH G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb) x T0 Hb Hx'
      (eq_sym (@concat_assoc typ (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) G2 (z ~ open_typ z Tb)))).
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_rcd_intro. apply (@IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u Tb U d1 IH1 u1 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (T := Tb) (L := L \u \{x}).
    + apply (@IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx eq_refl).
    + intros z Hz. destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
      specialize (IH2 z HzL).
      assert (Hx' : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
      { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx|].
        rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
      rewrite <- concat_assoc.

Lemma self_remove_flow : forall G x Vc p S U,
  binds x (μ Vc) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) ⊢! p : S ⪼ U ->
  exists S', G ⊢! p : S' ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros G x Vc p S U Hb Hf.
  remember (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as C eqn:EC.
  revert G x Vc Hb EC.
  induction Hf; intros GG xx VV Hbb ECC.
  - (* bind *) subst G.
    destruct (classic (x = xx)) as [-> | Hx].
    + assert (T = open_typ_p (pvar xx) VV) as ET.
      { apply binds_concat_inv in H0. destruct H0 as [Hs | [Hfr Hm]].
        - destruct (binds_single_inv Hs) as [E1 E2]. inversion E1. exact E2.
        - exfalso. apply Hfr. rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'. }
      subst T. exists (μ VV).
      apply (@pf_open (pvar xx) GG (μ VV) VV).
      apply pf_bind; [exact (ok_concat_inv_l H)|exact Hbb].
    + exists T.
      apply pf_bind; [exact (ok_concat_inv_l H)|].
      eapply binds_concat_left_inv; eauto.
  - (* fld *) subst G.
    destruct (IHHf GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl) as [S' Hf'].
    exists U. eapply pf_fld; eauto.
  - (* open *) subst G.
    destruct (IHHf GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_open; eauto.
  - (* and1 *) subst G.
    destruct (IHHf GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_and1; eauto.
  - (* and2 *) subst G.
    destruct (IHHf GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl) as [S' Hf'].
    exists S'. eapply pf_and2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma self_remove_precise2 : forall G x Vc p U,
  binds x (μ Vc) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) ⊢!! p : U ->
  G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros G x Vc p U Hb Hp.
  remember (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as C eqn:EC.
  revert G x Vc Hb EC.
  induction Hp; intros GG xx VV Hbb ECC.
  - (* pt2 *) subst G.
    destruct (self_remove_flow Hbb H) as [S' Hf'].
    apply (@pt2 GG p S' U). exact Hf'.
  - (* sngl trans *) subst G.
    apply (@pt2_sngl_trans GG p q a U).
    + apply (IHHp1 GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl).
    + apply (IHHp2 GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma self_remove_precise3 : forall G x Vc p U,
  binds x (μ Vc) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) ⊢!!! p : U ->
  G ⊢!!! p : U.
Proof.

  remember (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) as C eqn:EC.
  revert G x Vc Hb EC.
  induction Hp; intros GG xx VV Hbb ECC.
  - (* pt3 *) subst G.
    apply pt3. apply (self_remove_precise2 Hbb H).
  - (* sngl trans *) subst G.
    apply (@pt3_sngl_trans GG p q T).
    + apply (self_remove_precise2 Hbb H).
    + apply (IHHp GG xx VV Hbb eq_refl).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (Hsubst_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p Hok (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ T))) Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        unfold open_trm in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (@subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p p u). split.
        -- apply red_let_path.
        -- split; [exact Hi|]. split; [exact Hsub|].
           exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
      * (* let-val *)
        right.
        destruct (ty_val_inv Hty0) as
          [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]].
        -- (* lambda *)
           subst v.
           set (Lx := L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (λ(T1) t') = ν(T0x) dsx -> ∀(T1) T2 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx Eqx. discriminate Eqx. }
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t') (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (∀(T1)T2) (λ(T1)t') Hi HxG Hxγ Hval Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ λ(T1) t'), (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (x ~ ∀(T1) T2), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.
              ** assert (HxGe : x # (G & empty)).
                 { rewrite dom_concat_empty. exact HxG. }
                 assert (HeqG : G & x ~ T = G & x ~ T & empty) by (rewrite concat_empty_r; reflexivity).
                 assert (Hsub' : G & x ~ (∀(T1) T2) & empty ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T).
                 { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply weaken_sub_last; auto. }
                 pose proof (@bind_sub_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty (∀(T1)T2) HxGe HeqG Hsub') as Hres.
                 rewrite concat_empty_r in Hres. exact Hres.
              ** reflexivity.
        -- (* new *)
           subst v.
           dependent destruction Hval.
           set (Lx := L0 \u L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxL0 : x \notin L0).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H1 x HxL0) as Hdx.
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (ν(T0) ds) = ν(T0x) dsx -> μ T0 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0x dsx).
           { intros T0x dsx E. injection E as ET Eds. subst T0x dsx. split; [reflexivity|].
             unfold defs_at.
             rewrite open_defs_pvar, open_typ_pvar.
             assert (Hsh : x; nil; ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ x T0) ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T0).
             { eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_shadow_ty))); [exact Hdx | reflexivity |].
               rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'. }
             exact Hsh. }
           assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v ν(T0) ds : μ T0) by (apply ty_new_intro_p with (L:=L0); exact H1).
           assert (Hir : HInv (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by (apply (@HInv_push γ G x (μ T0) (ν(T0)ds) Hi HxG Hxγ Hval' Hnewdefs)).
           exists (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds), (G & x ~ μ T0), (x ~ μ T0), (open_trm x u). split.
           ++ apply red_let_val; auto.
           ++ split; [exact Hir|]. split.

Lemma binds_shadow : forall A (y:var) (T:A) G1 G2 (w:var) (S:A),
  binds y T (G1 & G2) -> w \in dom G2 -> binds y T (G1 & w ~ S & G2).
Proof.
  intros A y T G1 G2 w S Hb Hw.
  apply binds_concat_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [HyG2 H1]].
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_right. exact Hb.
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H1.
      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hyw. rewrite in_singleton in Hyw.
        apply HyG2. rewrite Hyw. exact Hw.
    + exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_shadow_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> x0; bs; (G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> x0; bs; (G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S0:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - intros y T G b G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_var. apply binds_shadow; auto.
  - intros L G T t U t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L). intros z Hz.
    specialize (IH z Hz).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (IH G1 (G2 & z ~ T) w S0).
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + rewrite dom_concat. apply in_union_l. auto.
  - intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S).
    + apply IH1; auto. + apply IH2; auto.
  - intros L G T ds t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L). intros z Hz.
    specialize (IH z Hz).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply (IH G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z T) w S0).
    + apply eq_sym, concat_assoc.
    + rewrite dom_concat. apply in_union_l. auto.
  - intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply IH; auto.
  - intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rcd_intro. apply IH; auto.
  - intros L G t u T U d1 IH1 t1 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_let with (T := T) (L := L).
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + intros z Hz. specialize (IH2 z Hz).
      rewrite <- concat_assoc.
      apply (IH2 G1 (G2 & z ~ T) w S0).

  - intros G p q T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.

  - intros G p q a T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_path_elim with (q := q) (a := a) (T := T).
    + apply IH1; auto. + apply IH2; auto.
  - intros G p T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_intro with (T := T). apply IH; auto.
  - intros G p T d IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T). apply IH; auto.
  - intros G p T U d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.
    apply ty_and_intro.

Lemma res_field_proof : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U Hi R. dependent destruction R.

Lemma lookup_star_from_defv : forall γ v t,
  γ ⟦ defv v ⤳* t ⟧ -> t = defv v.
Proof.
  intros γ v t H. induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - inversion H. Show.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros γ p q a H. induction H.
  - apply star_refl.
  - destruct r as [r0 | v].
    + apply star_step with (b := defp (r0 • a)).
      * inversion H; subst.
        -- discriminate.
        -- apply lookup_sel_p. assumption.
        -- discriminate.
      * apply IH.
    + exfalso. pose proof (lookup_star_from_defv H0) as E. discriminate E.
Qed.

We need: for any flow from p_sel x bs to {{q}} in G&x~S (where S inert, and in μ case it's the type of v and the object's defs are typed in the view), q is precise2 in G&x~S.

But wait — is this actually true? Let's sanity check a possible counterexample: Suppose x's type S = μ T0, and x's value v = ν(T0) ds. Suppose ds contains a path definition `{a :=p y}` where y is some variable in G whose type is a singleton {{q0}}. Then flow from p_sel x [a] to output? The flow: x : μT0. pf_bind gives μT0. Then pf_open gives open_typ_p (pvar x) T0. If record has {a ⦂ {{q0}}} maybe, then pf_fld yields {{q0}} output. q = q0 (or open of q0). Need q precise2 in G&x~μT0. q0 is in G, and HInv γ G gives... We need precise2 q0 in G&x~μT0. Is that guaranteed? Not obviously from HInv alone: HInv's wf component (wf G) gives the *same* wf_push_cond for G! I.e. wf G includes the property that for each y~T in G, flows from pvar y to singleton yield precise2. But q0 is a *path* q0, not necessarily a variable pvar y. But the stored def typing gives G_view ⊢ trm_path q0 : T. Precise typing of an arbitrary path in old context isn't directly given.

However, perhaps we can obtain precise2 q from the flow itself using a different argument: The flow from p_sel x bs to singleton {{q}} gives a precise flow; combined with ResCore we know lookup yields defp q, and `q` is also typed by flow_ty_path? Actually `flow_ty_path` gives G&x~S ⊢ trm_path (p_sel x bs) : {{q}}. That means the *path* p_sel x bs has type {{q}}, i.e., ordinary typing, not precise2 q.

Precise2 q says q itself has a "precise" type (flow with matching source/output). Is that derivable from ordinary path typing G ⊢ q : U? No, precise typing is stronger (it's a self-referential "exact" type).

Lemma step_plain : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (t':trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Ht. destruct (@step γ G t T Hi Ht) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
  - left; exact Hnf.
  - right. exists γ', G', u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|exact Hty'].

Theorem safety_test : forall t T,
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  infseq red (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, star red (empty, t) (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).
Proof.
  intros t T Ht.
  destruct (@terminate_or_diverge (fun γ G t0 T0 Hi Hty => step_plain Hi Hty) (empty:sta) (empty:ctx) t T HInv_empty Ht) as [Hinf | Hterm].

  - right. destruct Hterm as [γ [u [G [Hstar [Hnf [Hty Hi]]]]]].
    exists γ, u, G. split; [exact Hstar|]. split; [exact Hnf|]. split; [exact Hty|].
    destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf _]]]. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hwf|exact Hinert].
Qed.

Lemma binds_open_to_mu : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ μ T0 & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 Hb.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HG2 | [HyG2 Hbpre]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv Hbpre) as [Hopen | [Hyopen HG1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hopen. exact Hopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; [|exact HyG2].
      apply binds_concat_left; [exact HG1|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
      intro E. apply Hyopen. rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma swap_view_mu_trm : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) T,
  G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall G1 G2 x T0,
    x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
    G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
    G1 & x ~ μ T0 & G2 ⊢ t : T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj1 (proj1 swap_view_mu_ty)) G t T H G1 G2 x T0 H0 H1 H2). Qed.

Lemma swap_view_mu_defs : forall x0 bs (G:ctx) (ds:defs) T,
  x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
  forall G1 G2 x T0,
    x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
    G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
    x0;bs; (G1 & x ~ μ T0 & G2) ⊢ ds :: T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 swap_view_mu_ty)) x0 bs G ds T H G1 G2 x T0 H0 H1 H2). Qed.

We don't have that; we might have flow p R U with U=μ or and etc. But from the ordinary typing p:record{a⦂S}, we can perhaps derive that *some* flow p R' record{a⦂S}? That's exactly the closure needed.

Maybe define the theorem with an additional clause: 
`forall a S, C ⊢ p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> exists R U, C ⊢! p•a : R ⪼ U` (selection closure).
And perhaps recursively for deeper selections, but flow for p•a with its source is enough; then for p•a•b we'd invoke the clause on typing of p•a:record?, which is an instance of the main theorem with p:=p•a. Hmm, the typing of p•a:record would be a premise in the derivation? Not necessarily, but we can prove general theorem by induction with simultaneous statement:

P(p): forall T, C⊢p:T -> exists R U, flow p R U.
Q(p): forall a S, C⊢p:typ_rcd{a⦂S} -> exists R U, flow p•a R U.

Prove P and Q by induction on the typing derivation of p? But Q(p) uses a typing derivation that might be larger than the one for P(p); not immediate. Alternatively prove by induction on the *path structure*? Paths are p_sel x bs, so induction on bs (list length). Let p0 = pvar x, p_{i+1}=p_i•a_i. For a path p = pvar x followed by fields. We need: if C⊢p:T then exists flow p. We can try induction on the length of bs (prefix). If C⊢ pvar x • (a::bs) : T, can we relate to a typing of pvar x • bs? Use binding/flow reasoning, plus inversion of the typing derivation of the longer path. Ordinary typing of a selection p•a must be derived from rules whose conclusion is trm_path (p•a). Which rules can produce a selection path?
- ty_var: only pvar, not selection (p_sel x nil; syntactically p•a has nonempty bs, can't equal pvar).
- ty_new_elim: conclusion p•a, premise p:record{a⦂T}. This matches.
- ty_rcd_intro: conclusion trm_path p (generic), could p itself be p0•a? ty_rcd_intro conclusion is p:record{b⦂T} and premise p•b:T. Hmm, conclusion path p; if p=p0•a then premise p0•a•b. So typing of a selection may come from rcd_intro premise with an *even longer* path — not structurally smaller! That's a problem: ty_rcd_intro/ty_new_elim are inverses and can be applied alternately. But rcd_intro's conclusion is a record type; if we're proving existence of a flow (any output), maybe rcd_intro can be ignored/handled by looking at its premise? Wait conclusion p:record{b⦂T}, premise p•b:T. For existence of flow p, if we only know typing of p via rcd_intro, we could use IH on premise p•b:T (longer path), leading to potential nontermination. But maybe flow p can be derived from flow p•b? There's flow_prefix_snoc (resnav.v): flow (p•a):T⪼U implies exists R V, flow p:R⪼V. So from a flow of p•b we get a flow of p. That's exactly what rcd_intro needs. But still the induction would be on... We can define a well-founded measure: maybe the typing derivation is finite, and we can do induction on the derivation with a more careful analysis because rcd_intro premise has *more fields* but the derivation tree is smaller. Structural induction on the typing derivation tree works: IH applies to premise subderivation, regardless of path length. For ty_rcd_intro: premise `C ⊢ p•b : T` is a subderivation; IH (which is P for path p•b) gives flow of p•b, then flow_prefix_snoc gives flow of p. Good. For ty_new_elim: premise `C ⊢ p : record{a⦂T}` is a subderivation; IH gives flow p:R⪼U for some U. But we need flow p•a, requiring field a. Hmm. Here the premise is p (shorter). We have from IH only some flow p:R⦼U. We need to know we can select a. But we also have the fact that p's ordinary type is record{a⦂T}. Maybe we should strengthen IH to preserve the ordinary type: prove a statement like "for any path typing C⊢p:T, there exists flow p:R⪼U such that U is 'compatible' with T". If compatible means U = T or U is μ with open U having T as subtype... Let's think about what's true.

Hmm, z:μT1; ordinary type record from rec_elim open T1 <: record. Then U=μT1; open U = open T1, which is <: record (the subtyping that was used). So compatibility: exists U, flow p R U and (U = T or (U = μ T0 and open_typ_p p T0? ...)). Not clean.

Let's instead strengthen to: if C⊢p:T then there exists *some* selection-by-fields extension of p to a flow whose output is a record from which T can be recovered? Hmm.

S(p): C⊢p:T -> exists R U, flow p R U, AND for every a S with T = record{a⦂S} OR ...?

(A) C⊢p:T -> exists R U, flow p R U.
(B) C⊢p:typ_rcd{a⦂S} -> exists R U, flow p•a R U.

Combined(H): forall a S, T = typ_rcd {a⦂S} -> exists R U, flow (p•a) R U; AND exists R U, flow p R U.

Actually A is implied by B? No, if T not a record we can't select. But A likely follows by same induction.

Let's check rule by rule for A and B:

1. ty_var: p=pvar x, T=binding. A: flow pvar x : T ⪼ T (pf_bind, needs ok C). B: if T=record{a⦂S}, flow pvar x • a : T ⪼ S (pf_fld after pf_bind). Works.

2. ty_new_elim: conclusion p•a : T, premises H1: C⊢p : record{a⦂T}. A(conclusion): need flow p•a. Use B(H1): since H1's type is record{a⦂T}, get flow p•a directly. B(conclusion): conclusion type T; need flow (p•a)•b if T=record{b⦂S}. From B? We have flow p•a R⪼U' where U'=?? B(H1) gives flow p•a : R ⪼ S' where the source R and output = S? Wait B(H1) as stated yields exists R U, flow (p•a) R U, but we actually need the output to equal T to then select b. Hmm, B as "exists some flow" is too weak to iterate.

So strengthen: B(H) should give a flow p•a : R ⪼ S exactly the record field S, i.e., output = S. Similarly A(H) perhaps output related. Let's define:

For H : C ⊢ p : T:
A(H): exists R, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ T  (flow with output exactly T!)
B(H): forall a S, T = record{a⦂S} -> exists R, C ⊢! p•a : R ⪼ S.

Is A true? Counterexample z:record{a⦂T}: no flow z:?⪼record; flow z:μT1⪼μT1. So A false. Need A to output not T. But B can still hold: flow z•a: R⪼T. How to get B for z:record from the derivation z:record which came from rec_elim + sub? We need flow z•a. The rec_elim gives z:open T1, then subtyping to record{a⦂T}. We can derive flow z:μT1⪼open T1 (pf_open), then need field a from open T1 — record_has open T1 {a⦂?}. Subtyping open T1 <: record{a⦂T} should imply record_has open T1 {a⦂S'} with S' <: T. Then pf_fld gives flow z•a : μT1 ⪼ S'. Output S', not T. So B output = T fails unless S'=T. But for our purposes (precise2 existence) output exact doesn't matter. However to iterate selections, we need to continue from output S'. For the next selection b, we'd use ordinary typing of p•a:record{b⦂...} and derive from output S'? We need record_has S' {b⦂...}. But subtyping gave S' <: T and T=record{b⦂...}; S' might be μ or and; record_has may still hold? If S' <: record{b⦂U} then S' must structurally have field b? Subtyping rules that produce a record on right: refl, trans, fld, typ. Source could be an and or record or path? subtyp could have source μ? rec_elim? Subtyping never unfolds μ. So S' <: record implies S' is a record-ish type with the field (via ands). Then record_has S' {b⦂U'} for some U' <: U maybe. So we can continue. This suggests a more semantic approach: define a relation "C ⊢ p : T" but recast via flows and subtyping: precise flow output U with U <: T? Let's test z:record{a⦂T}: flow z:μT1⪼μT1; μT1 <: record? No. So not subtyping.

But after selection, flow z•a : μT1 ⪼ S' where S' <: T. So maybe statement: for any path p and type T, if C⊢p:T then either exists R, flow p R⪼U with U <: T? fails at p=z. But for p with at least one selection? z:record via rec_elim gives flow z:μT1⪼μT1 not <: record. So no.

Maybe the right statement is about "flow after unfolding" — some paths require pf_open first. Define flow with source μ and output open. The ordinary typing relation essentially follows the "unfolded" structure. For arbitrary path p, there might be multiple flows. Let's think of the computational content: precise_flow p R U is derivable in a deterministic-ish way once the heap/environment and path are fixed: starting from binding of root x, you process each field label; at each step you may unfold μ (pf_open) and split ∧ (pf_and1/2) to find a record containing the field. So a flow exists iff the path is "resolvable" in the environment's record structure. Ordinary typing of a path essentially requires the same resolvability, because typing rules for paths follow the same structure. So the theorem should be true. Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

Lemma binds_open_to_mu : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 Hb.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HG2 | [HyG2 Hbpre]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv Hbpre) as [Hopen | [Hyopen HG1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hopen. exact Hopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; [|exact HyG2].
      apply binds_concat_left; [exact HG1|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
      intro E. subst y. apply Hyopen. rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma swap_view_mu_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    destruct (@binds_open_to_mu G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 b) as [[Eyx ETy] | Hb].
    + subst y Ty. apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; [apply binds_tail|exact Hx2].
    + apply ty_var. exact Hb.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).
    intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hz) as [HzL HzC].
    assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. repeat rewrite dom_single. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG1 : z # G1).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG2 : z # G2).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HxG2z : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx2|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    specialize (IH z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ Tb) x T0 Hx1 HxG2z).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply IH.
    rewrite concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S).
    + apply (IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G Tb ds t0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).
    intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hz) as [HzL HzC].
    assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. repeat rewrite dom_single. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG1 : z # G1).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG2 : z # G2).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HxG2z : x # (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx2|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    specialize (IH z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb) x T0 Hx1 HxG2z).

Lemma swap_view_mu_defs : forall x0 bs (G:ctx) (ds:defs) T,
