Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive ResCoreL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rcL_lam p (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCoreL γ G p A
| rcL_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCoreL γ G p U
| rcL_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCoreL γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma res_fieldL : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCoreL γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCoreL γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U Hi R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + (* stored path *) dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rcL_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * (* stored lambda *) dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rcL_lam with (T0 := open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                             (t := open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv)
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
              destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).
              ** exact H1.
              ** rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto.
              ** reflexivity.
           ++ assert (Hxempty : x # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.
              rewrite concat_empty_r in HsubG. exact HsubG.
           ++ exists U0, V; reflexivity.
        -- exfalso. discriminate Ev.
Qed.

Lemma flow_resL : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCoreL γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi p S U Hf.
  induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    dependent destruction Hval.
    + (* lambda *) apply rcL_lam with (T0 := T) (t := t) (S0 := ∀(T) U).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L); exact H1.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * exists T, U; reflexivity.
    + (* object *) apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := T) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T)
                               (bs := nil) (T0 := T) (ds := ds).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H0.
      * reflexivity.
      * apply defs_at_DefsTyped. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hi))) x T ds H0 Hv).
      * inversion Hiner; subst. exists ls. assumption.
      * apply pf_bind; auto.
  - (* fld *) apply res_fieldL with (a := a) (U := U).
    + exact Hi.
    + apply (IHHf Hi).
  - (* open *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + pose proof (flow_mu_same H4 H5) as E. subst U.
      apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_open (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) T0 H5).
  - (* and1 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_and1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) U1 U2 H5).
  - (* and2 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                        (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact H.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * apply (@pf_and2 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) G (μ T0) U1 U2 H5).
Qed.
=====AUX_SWAP=====
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

Lemma binds_open_to_mu : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 Hb.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HG2 | [HyG2 Hbpre]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv Hbpre) as [Hopen | [Hyopen HG1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hopen. exact Hopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; [|exact HyG2].
      apply binds_concat_left; [exact HG1|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
      intro E. subst y. apply Hyopen. rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma swap_view_mu_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    destruct (@binds_open_to_mu G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 b) as [[Eyx ETy] | Hb].
    + subst y Ty. apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; [apply binds_tail|exact Hx2].
    + apply ty_var. exact Hb.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).
    intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hz) as [HzL HzC].
    assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. repeat rewrite dom_single. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG1 : z # G1).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HzG2 : z # G2).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union. }
    assert (HxG2z : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx2|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    specialize (IH z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ Tb) x T0 Hx1 HxG2z).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply IH.
    rewrite concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S).
    + apply (IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G Tb ds t0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).

No existing path-to-precise lemma. Let's think whether our specific q can be handled without the general theorem.

Recall the final q is the path from flow output. The flow output singleton arrives at the end. Let's think about the lookup chain we can obtain from ResCore. We can build ResCore for the self flow using a variant of flow_res where the base case for x uses v and DefsTyped (after self_remove/swap). Then rescore_holds yields a lookup star `γ&x~v ⟦ p_sel x bs ⤳* r ⟧` and RHolds r {{q}}; holds_sngl_path => r=defp q. So the lookup star ends at defp q. From this star we may derive q's precise2 by induction on the star, using the defs typing.

But note: for the target precise2 q in C0 = G&x~μT0, we have q possibly involving x. The lookup star's last steps produce q from a stored path defp q0 in ds, plus selections. Specifically:

Start: defp (p_sel x bs) (with bs possibly nonempty) — wait lookup star starts from defp p_sel x bs, but that's not how lookup works: γ ⟦ defp p_sel x bs ⤳* r ⟧ means the source def_rhs is defp (p_sel x bs). The first step must be lookup_sel_p if bs nonempty? lookup_step's rules: lookup_var for pvar x; lookup_sel_p for p•a when current is defp q; lookup_sel_v for p•a when current is defv val. The star starts with defp (p_sel x bs) as a *def_rhs*, so we can't "go backwards"; the star relates def_rhs to def_rhs. Starting from defp (p_sel x bs) with bs nonempty, the only possible step in the general relation? lookup_step γ t u with t=defp q: rules produce u from a *path* p, and t is defp p for lookup_var/lookup_sel_p, or defv val for lookup_sel_v. Specifically lookup_sel_p: premise γ⟦p⤳defp q⟧, conclusion γ⟦p•a⤳defp(q•a)⟧. Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.
===
# 133 — pDOT type safety

## Task

Show that a closed well-typed pDOT term either diverges or reaches a normal form with the stated typing and heap invariants.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

18	  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
19	  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
20	Proof.

36	  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma subst_path_fvar_neq : forall z p x bs, x <> z ->
  subst_path z p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) = p_sel (avar_f x) bs.
Proof.
  intros. destruct p as [a cs]. unfold subst_path, subst_avar, subst_var_p. simpl.
  rewrite (If_r (P:=x=z)); auto. unfold sel_fields. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_path_sel_field : forall z p q a,
  subst_path z p (q • a) = (subst_path z p q) • a.
Proof.
  intros. destruct q as [x bs]. destruct x as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct p as [a' cs]. unfold subst_path, subst_avar, sel_fields. simpl. rewrite !app_nil_r. reflexivity.
  - unfold subst_path, subst_avar, subst_var_p, sel_field, sel_fields. simpl.
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [H|H].
    + subst y. repeat rewrite If_l by auto. destruct p as [a' cs]. simpl. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. rewrite !app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_path_sel_fields : forall z p q bs,
  subst_path z p (q •• bs) = (subst_path z p q) •• bs.
Proof.
  intros. destruct q as [x fs]. destruct x as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct p as [a' cs]. unfold subst_path, subst_avar, sel_fields. simpl. rewrite !app_nil_r. repeat rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
  - unfold subst_path, subst_avar, subst_var_p, sel_fields. simpl.
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [H|H].
    + subst y. repeat rewrite If_l by auto. destruct p as [a' cs]. simpl. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. rewrite !app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_subst :
  (forall p q T T', repl_typ p q T T' ->
     forall z r, repl_typ (subst_path z r p) (subst_path z r q) (subst_typ z r T) (subst_typ z r T')) /\
  (forall p q D D', repl_dec p q D D' ->
     forall z r, repl_dec (subst_path z r p) (subst_path z r q) (subst_dec z r D) (subst_dec z r D')).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 H IH z r. simpl. apply rrcd. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rand1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rand2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q bs A z r. simpl. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields, subst_path_sel_fields. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 H IH z r. simpl. apply rbnd. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rall1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rall2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q bs z r. simpl. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtyp1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtyp2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtrm. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tight_bounds_subst :
  (forall (T:typ), tight_bounds T -> forall z p, tight_bounds (subst_typ z p T)) /\
  (forall (D:dec), tight_bounds_dec D -> forall z p, tight_bounds_dec (subst_dec z p D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros H z p. simpl. exact I.
  - intros H z p. simpl. exact I.
  - intros d IH H z p. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 H z p. cbn in H. destruct H as [H1 H2]. cbn.
    split; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros q A H z p. simpl. exact I.
  - intros t IH H z p. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 H z p. simpl. exact I.
  - intros q H z p. simpl. exact I.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 H z p. simpl in *. subst t1. reflexivity.
  - intros a t IH H z p. simpl in *. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma label_of_def_subst : forall d z p,
  label_of_def (subst_def z p d) = label_of_def d.
Proof. intros d z p. destruct d; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma get_def_subst : forall l ds z p,
  get_def l (subst_defs z p ds) = option_map (subst_def z p) (get_def l ds).
Proof.

  binds y T (G1 & G2) -> w \in dom G2 -> binds y T (G1 & w ~ S & G2).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive ResCoreL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rcL_lam p (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCoreL γ G p A
| rcL_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCoreL γ G p U
| rcL_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCoreL γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma res_fieldL : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCoreL γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCoreL γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U Hi R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + (* stored path *) dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rcL_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * (* stored lambda *) dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rcL_lam with (T0 := open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                             (t := open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv)
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
              destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).
              ** exact H1.
              ** rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto.
              ** reflexivity.
           ++ assert (Hxempty : x # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.
              rewrite concat_empty_r in HsubG. exact HsubG.
           ++ exists U0, V; reflexivity.
        -- exfalso. discriminate Ev.
Qed.

Lemma flow_resL : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCoreL γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi p S U Hf.
  induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.

    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.

    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + pose proof (flow_mu_same H4 H5) as E. subst U.

      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.

  - (* and1 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)

      * exact H1.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.

  - (* and2 *) simpl in IHHf.
    pose proof (IHHf Hi) as IHres. dependent destruction IHres.
    + exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta EA]]. discriminate EA.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres resL.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive RHoldsL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rh_lam (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv (λ(T0) t)) A
| rh_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv v) U
| rh_path q :
    RHoldsL γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holdsL : forall γ G p U,
  ResCoreL γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv (λ(T0) t)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (λ(T0) t)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_lam with (T0 := T0) (t := t) (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_pathL : forall γ G r q,
  RHoldsL γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_resL Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holdsL; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookupL Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookupL Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive sub_rel : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| srel_refl T : sub_rel T T
| srel_bot T : sub_rel typ_bot T
| srel_top T : sub_rel T typ_top
| srel_and_l T U V : sub_rel T V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and_r T U V : sub_rel U V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and2 T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel T V -> sub_rel T (U ∧ V)
| srel_fld T U a : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| srel_typ S1 S2 T1 T2 A :
    sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel T1 T2 ->
    sub_rel (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| srel_sngl_pq p q T T' : repl_typ p q T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sngl_qp p q T T' : repl_typ q p T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sel2 p A T : sub_rel T (p ↓ A)
| srel_sel1 p A T : sub_rel (p ↓ A) T
| srel_all S1 S2 T1 T2 : sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2)
| srel_trans T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel U V -> sub_rel T V.

Lemma subtyp_to_rel : forall G T U, G ⊢ T <: U -> sub_rel T U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply srel_top.
  - apply srel_bot.
  - apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_trans; eauto.
  - apply srel_and_l. apply srel_refl.
  - apply srel_and_r. apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_and2; eauto.
  - apply srel_fld. assumption.
  - eapply srel_typ; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply srel_sel2.
  - apply srel_sel1.
  - eapply srel_all; eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (Hsubst_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p Hok (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ T))) Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        unfold open_trm in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (@subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p p u). split.

23	    - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G0 T t U t0 IH v0 Eq. injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
24	      left. exists T, U, t. split; [reflexivity|]. split.
25	      + apply ty_all_intro_p with (L:=L); auto.
26	      + apply subtyp_refl.
27	    - (* ty_all_elim *) intros v0 Eq; discriminate Eq.
28	    - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G0 T ds t0 IH v0 Eq. injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
29	      right. exists T, ds. split; [reflexivity|]. split.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
4	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr.
5	Close Scope string_scope.

7	Lemma ty_val_p_ty : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> G ⊢ trm_val v : T.
8	Proof.
9	  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
10	  - apply ty_all_intro with (L := L); auto.
11	  - apply ty_new_intro with (L := L); auto.
12	Qed.
13	
14	Lemma ty_val_p_inert : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> inert_typ T.
15	Proof.
16	  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
17	  - apply inert_typ_all.
18	  - destruct (var_fresh (L \u fv_typ T)) as [x Hx].
19	    apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxT].
20	    destruct (ty_defs_record_typ (H x HxL)) as [ls Hrt].
21	    apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls).
22	    eapply record_typ_open_var; eauto.
23	Qed.
24	
25	Lemma ty_val_inv_inert : forall G (v:val) T,
26	  G ⊢ trm_val v : T -> exists S, G ⊢!v v : S /\ inert_typ S.
27	Proof.
28	  intros G v T H. destruct (ty_val_inv H) as [[T1 [T2 [t [Ev [Hp _]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hp _]]]]].
29	  - subst. exists (∀(T1) T2). split; auto. apply ty_val_p_inert in Hp; auto.
30	  - subst. exists (μ T0). split; auto. apply ty_val_p_inert in Hp; auto.
31	Qed.
32	
33	Lemma ty_val_p_weaken : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T ->
34	  forall x S, x # G -> G & x ~ S ⊢!v v : T.
35	Proof.
36	  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
37	  - (* all *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
38	    apply notin_union_r in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzx].
39	    apply notin_singleton_r in Hzx.
40	    eapply weaken_trm with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ T) (w := x) (S := S).
41	    + apply H. auto.
42	    + reflexivity.
43	    + rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l.
44	      * auto.
45	      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hxz. rewrite in_singleton in Hxz. apply Hzx. symmetry. exact Hxz.
46	  - (* new *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
47	    apply notin_union_r in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzx].
48	    apply notin_singleton_r in Hzx.
49	    eapply weaken_defs with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_typ z T) (w := x) (S := S).
50	    + apply H. auto.
51	    + reflexivity.
52	    + rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l.
53	      * auto.
54	      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hxz. rewrite in_singleton in Hxz. apply Hzx. symmetry. exact Hxz.
55	Qed.

8	  forall (v:val), t = trm_val v ->
9	  (exists T1 T2 t', v = λ(T1) t' /\ G ⊢!v v : ∀(T1) T2 /\ G ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T) \/
10	  (exists T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds /\ G ⊢!v v : μ T0 /\ G ⊢ μ T0 <: T).

12	  intros G t T H.
13	  induction H using ty_trm_ind; intros v0 Eq.
14	  - (* ty_var *) discriminate Eq.
15	  - (* ty_all_intro *) injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
16	    left. exists T, U, t. split; [reflexivity|]. split.
17	    + apply ty_all_intro_p with (L:=L); auto.
18	    + apply subtyp_refl.
19	  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Eq.
20	  - (* ty_new_intro *) injection Eq as Hv. subst v0.
21	    right. exists T, ds. split; [reflexivity|]. split.
22	    + apply ty_new_intro_p with (L:=L); auto.
23	    + apply subtyp_refl.
24	  - (* ty_new_elim *) discriminate Eq.
25	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) discriminate Eq.
26	  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Eq.
27	  - (* ty_sngl *) discriminate Eq.
28	  - (* ty_path_elim *) discriminate Eq.
29	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) discriminate Eq.
30	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) discriminate Eq.
31	  - (* ty_and_intro *) discriminate Eq.
32	  - (* ty_sub *)
33	    destruct (IHty_trm v0 Eq) as [[T1 [T2 [t1 [Ev [Hp Hs]]]]] | [T1 [ds [Ev [Hp Hs]]]]].
34	    + left. exists T1, T2, t1. split; auto. split; auto.
35	      eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
36	    + right. exists T1, ds. split; auto. split; auto.
37	      eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
38	Qed.

40	Lemma ty_val_inv : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢ trm_val v : T ->
41	  (exists T1 T2 t', v = λ(T1) t' /\ G ⊢!v v : ∀(T1) T2 /\ G ⊢ ∀(T1) T2 <: T) \/
42	  (exists T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds /\ G ⊢!v v : μ T0 /\ G ⊢ μ T0 <: T).

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma weaken_trm : forall G t T, G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 weaken_ty); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_def : forall x bs G d D, x;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> x;bs;(G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ d : D.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 (proj2 weaken_ty)); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_defs : forall x bs G ds T, x;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
  forall G1 G2 w S, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> x;bs;(G1 & w ~ S & G2) ⊢ ds :: T.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_ty))); eauto. Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub : forall G S U, G ⊢ S <: U ->
  forall G1 G2 w S0, G = G1 & G2 -> w # (G1 & G2) -> G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U.
Proof. intros. eapply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 weaken_ty))); eauto. Qed.

Lemma binds_rebind_neq : forall A (G1 G2:env A) (x:var) (T1 T2:A) y (T:A),
  binds y T (G1 & x ~ T1 & G2) -> y <> x -> binds y T (G1 & x ~ T2 & G2).
Proof.
  intros A G1 G2 x T1 T2 y T Hb Hy.
  apply binds_concat_inv' in Hb. destruct Hb as [[HyG2 Hb] | Hb].
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & x ~ T2) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_inv' in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Hyx H1] | Hb1].
      * apply binds_concat_left.
        -- exact H1.
        -- rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto.
      * exfalso. apply Hy. apply binds_single_inv in Hb1. tauto.
    + exact HyG2.
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & x ~ T2) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_right. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_middle_self : forall A (G1 G2:env A) x (T T':A),
  x # G1 -> x # G2 -> binds x T (G1 & x ~ T' & G2) -> T = T'.
Proof.
  intros A G1 G2 x T T' H1 H2 Hb.
  change (binds x T ((G1 & x ~ T') & G2)) in Hb.
  apply binds_concat_left_inv in Hb; auto.
  apply binds_concat_inv' in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Hx H3] | Hb].
  - exfalso. rewrite dom_single in Hx. apply Hx. apply in_singleton_self.
  - apply binds_single_inv in Hb. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_target_self : forall A (G1 G2:env A) x (T2:A),
  x # G1 -> x # G2 -> binds x T2 (G1 & x ~ T2 & G2).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds x T2 ((G1 & x ~ T2) & G2)).
  apply binds_concat_left.
  - exact (binds_tail x T2 G1).
  - exact H0.
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix.

        | apply in_union_r; solve_union

(* The arrow-subtyping opening relation.  If [G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T], then
   [ArrowOpen G S T A B] records the two pieces of information supplied by
   arrow subtyping inversion: the parameter is contravariant and the bodies
   are related under the *target* parameter. *)
Definition ArrowOpen (G:ctx) (S T A B:typ) : Prop :=
  G ⊢ S <: A /\
  exists L, forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ S ⊢ open_typ z B <: open_typ z T.

(* Main reduction/preservation step for an application, given a store lookup
   of the function path to a literal lambda together with the tight type of
   that lambda and its subtyping to the arrow target.  [ArrowOpen] is the
   only remaining subtyping fact; it is hypothesis-free here. *)
Lemma app_red_pres : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ) (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  (* invert the tight typing of the lambda to obtain its body *)
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.

  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ T \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ T).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  (* typing of the substituted body *)
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].

  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_trm.

    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }

                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z T) Hsubz
                G z S empty q Hok1
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))

  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.

(* Conditional form: if the precise3 typing of the function path is available
   (the ordinary-path-to-precise3 bridge) and incoming arrow subtyping can be
   opened (ArrowOpen), then the full app_step statement holds. *)
Lemma app_step_of_precise3_open : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢!!! p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  (forall (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
      γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq Hbridge.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now S0 = ∀(T0) U0 and Hsub : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* Also expose the reduction-plus-typing core with the raw RHoldsL facts,
   for callers that obtain the lambda by another route. *)
Lemma app_step_of_RHoldsL_lam : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T0 ->
  ArrowOpen G S T0 T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T0 /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_red_pres; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_from_defv : forall γ v t,
  γ ⟦ defv v ⤳* t ⟧ -> t = defv v.
Proof.
  intros γ v t H. remember (defv v) as r eqn:E. revert v E.
  induction H; intros v0 E.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - subst. inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p_gen : forall γ r t,
  γ ⟦ r ⤳* t ⟧ ->
  forall p q a, r = defp p -> t = defp q ->
  γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros γ r t H. induction H; intros p0 q0 aa Er Et.
  - rewrite Er in Et. injection Et as Eq. subst q0. apply star_refl.
  - subst a. destruct b as [b0 | bv].
    + apply star_step with (b := defp (b0 • aa)).
      * inversion H; subst. Show.
      * apply IHstar with (p := b0) (q := q0) (a := aa); [reflexivity|exact Et].
    + exfalso. pose proof (lookup_star_from_defv H0) as E. rewrite Et in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_star_sel_p : forall γ p q a,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defp (q • a) ⟧.
Proof.
  intros. eapply lookup_star_sel_p_gen with (p := p) (q := q) (a := a); eauto.
Qed.

Inductive RHolds (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rh_lam v S0 A :
    G ⊢!v v : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) A
| rh_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) U
| rh_path q :
    RHolds γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holds : forall γ G p U,
  ResCore γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv v). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv v); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_lam with (S0 := S0); auto.
  - exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds); auto.
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_sngl_absurd : forall q, record_type {{ q }} -> False.
Proof. intros q [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_path : forall γ G r q,
  RHolds γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. destruct HR.
  - destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. apply (record_type_sngl_absurd _ H1).
  - injection e as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - destruct (flow_res Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holds; auto.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (apply holds_sngl_path; auto).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookup Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookup Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (apply holds_sngl_path; auto).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar.

Lemma flow_all_shape : forall G p S T U,
  G ⊢! p : ∀(S) T ⪼ U -> U = ∀(S) T.
Proof.
  intros G p S T U Hf. remember (∀(S) T) as R eqn:ER.
  revert S T ER. induction Hf; intros S1 T1 ER.
  - inversion ER; subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
  - inversion ER; subst.
    pose proof (IHHf S1 T1 eq_refl) as E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma flow_prefix_snoc : forall G p a T U,
  G ⊢! (p • a) : T ⪼ U -> exists R V, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ V.
Proof.
  intros G p a T U Hf. remember (p • a) as q eqn:Eq.
  revert p a Eq. induction Hf; intros p0 a0 Eq.
  - (* fld *) inversion Eq; subst. eexists; eexists; eassumption.
  - (* open *) inversion Eq; subst. Show.
  - (* and1 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    apply IHHf; reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    apply IHHf; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_prefix_snoc : forall G p a U,
  G ⊢!! (p • a) : U -> exists V, G ⊢!! p : V.
Proof.
  intros G p a U Hp. remember (p • a) as q eqn:Eq.
  revert p a Eq. induction Hp; intros p0 a0 Eq.
  - (* pt2 *) inversion Eq; subst.
    destruct (flow_prefix_snoc H) as [R [V Hf]].
    exists V. apply pt2. exact Hf.
  - (* sngl trans *) inversion Eq; subst.
    exists {{q}}. exact Hp1.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) rename H into Hpre. pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + (* fs_all impossible *)
      discriminate H1.
    + (* fs_bnd impossible *) discriminate H1.
    + (* fs_rec : record_type (typ_rcd {a⦂U}) *)
      destruct H1 as [ls Hrt].
      inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
      inversion H3; subst.
      * (* rd_typ *) discriminate H4.
      * (* rd_trm *) rename H5 into Hiner.
        destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
        -- apply fs_all.
        -- apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
      * (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
    + (* fs_sngl impossible *) discriminate H1.
  - (* open *) rename H into Hpre. pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + (* fs_bnd *) apply fs_rec. apply record_type_open_p with (p:=p). exact H1.
    + (* fs_rec with record_type (μ U) *)
      exfalso. exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U0 H1).
    + discriminate H1.
  - (* and1 *) rename H into Hpre. pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply fs_rec. apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2). exact H1.
    + discriminate H1.
  - (* and2 *) rename H into Hpre. pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply fs_rec. apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1). exact H1.
    + discriminate H1.
Qed.

(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)
Definition ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A.

(* Residual bridge 2: no non-arrow flow-shaped type is a subtype of an
   arrow. *)
Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G U A,
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

(* Residual bridge 3: opening/inversion of arrow subtyping. *)
Definition arrow_open_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G A B S T,
    G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T -> ArrowOpen G S T A B.

(* Assembly: the three bridges imply the full app_step statement. *)
Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge ->
  arrow_open_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (exact (HNS G U (∀(S)T) Hfs Hsub Har)).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* Hval-type : G ⊢!v λ(T0)t : ∀(T0) U0, and
     Hsub0 : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S') T'. *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  (* compose the two arrow subtypings: ∀(T0)U0 <: ∀(S')T' <: ∀(S)T *)
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen G T0 U0 S T Hcomp) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
Qed.
EOF

# 133 — pDOT type safety

## Task

Show that a closed well-typed pDOT term either diverges or reaches a normal form with the stated typing and heap invariants.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `safety`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: TLC.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
=== Task.v.orig ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply rcd_record_type_shape. exact H1.
    + discriminate H1.
  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply fs_rec. apply record_type_open_p with (p:=p). exact H1.
    + exfalso. exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H1).
    + discriminate H1.
  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply flow_shape_and_l with (U2:=U2). apply fs_rec. exact H1.
    + discriminate H1.
  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + discriminate H1.
    + discriminate H1.
    + apply flow_shape_and_r with (U1:=U1). apply fs_rec. exact H1.
    + discriminate H1.
Qed.

(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)
Definition ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A.

(* Residual bridge 2: no non-arrow flow-shaped type is a subtype of an
   arrow. *)
Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G U A,
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

(* Residual bridge 3: opening/inversion of arrow subtyping. *)
Definition arrow_open_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G A B S T,
    G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T -> ArrowOpen G S T A B.

(* Assembly: the three bridges imply the full app_step statement. *)
Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge ->
  arrow_open_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (exact (HNS G U (∀(S)T) Hfs Hsub Har)).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* Hval-type : G ⊢!v λ(T0)t : ∀(T0) U0, and
     Hsub0 : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S') T'. *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  (* compose the two arrow subtypings: ∀(T0)U0 <: ∀(S')T' <: ∀(S)T *)
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen G T0 U0 S T Hcomp) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* The arrow-subtyping opening relation.  If [G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T], then
   [ArrowOpen G S T A B] records the two pieces of information supplied by
   arrow subtyping inversion: the parameter is contravariant and the bodies
   are related under the *target* parameter. *)
Definition ArrowOpen (G:ctx) (S T A B:typ) : Prop :=
  G ⊢ S <: A /\
  exists L, forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ S ⊢ open_typ z B <: open_typ z T.

(* Main reduction/preservation step for an application, given a store lookup
   of the function path to a literal lambda together with the tight type of
   that lambda and its subtyping to the arrow target.  [ArrowOpen] is the
   only remaining subtyping fact; it is hypothesis-free here. *)
Lemma app_red_pres : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ) (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  (* invert the tight typing of the lambda to obtain its body *)
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now the typing is [G ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z V0] for z ∉ L0 *)
  destruct Hop as [Hparam [L1 Hbody_sub]].
  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ T \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ T).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  (* typing of the substituted body *)
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ T0) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z V0) Hbz
                G z T0 empty q Hok0
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ T0)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzT0 Hq0) as Hsub_trm.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  (* subtyping of the opened result types *)
  assert (Hok1 : ok (G & z ~ S & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 subst_ty))
                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z T) Hsubz
                G z S empty q Hok1
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub_out.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z T 0 z HzT q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := T0) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - split; [exact Hi|]. split.
    + apply ty_sub with (T := open_typ_p q V0); auto.
    + exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
Qed.

(* Conditional form: if the precise3 typing of the function path is available
   (the ordinary-path-to-precise3 bridge) and incoming arrow subtyping can be
   opened (ArrowOpen), then the full app_step statement holds. *)
Lemma app_step_of_precise3_open : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢!!! p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  (forall (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
      γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq Hbridge.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now S0 = ∀(T0) U0 and Hsub : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* Also expose the reduction-plus-typing core with the raw RHoldsL facts,
   for callers that obtain the lambda by another route. *)
Lemma app_step_of_RHoldsL_lam : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T0 ->
  ArrowOpen G S T0 T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T0 /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_red_pres; eauto.
Qed.

```coq
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
```

```coq

  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge -> flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge -> arrow_open_bridge ->
```

```coq
  forall γ G p A, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
```

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@rcd_record_type_shape a U). exact H.
  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + apply fs_rec. apply (@record_type_open_p U p).
      match goal with Hr : record_type U |- _ => exact Hr end.
    + exfalso.
      match goal with Hr : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
        exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U Hr) end.
  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_l U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_r U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
Qed.

(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)
Definition ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A.

(* Residual bridge 2: no non-arrow flow-shaped type is a subtype of an
   arrow. *)
Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G U A,
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

(* Residual bridge 3: opening/inversion of arrow subtyping. *)
Definition arrow_open_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G A B S T,
    G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T -> ArrowOpen G S T A B.

(* Assembly: the three bridges imply the full app_step statement. *)
Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge ->
  arrow_open_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (exact (HNS G U (∀(S)T) Hfs Hsub Har)).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* Hval-type : G ⊢!v λ(T0)t : ∀(T0) U0, and
     Hsub0 : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S') T'. *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  (* compose the two arrow subtypings: ∀(T0)U0 <: ∀(S')T' <: ∀(S)T *)
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen G T0 U0 S T Hcomp) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'

(* The arrow-subtyping opening relation.  If [G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T], then
   [ArrowOpen G S T A B] records the two pieces of information supplied by
   arrow subtyping inversion: the parameter is contravariant and the bodies
   are related under the *target* parameter. *)
Definition ArrowOpen (G:ctx) (S T A B:typ) : Prop :=
  G ⊢ S <: A /\
  exists L, forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ S ⊢ open_typ z B <: open_typ z T.

(* Main reduction/preservation step for an application, given a store lookup
   of the function path to a literal lambda together with the tight type of
   that lambda and its subtyping to the arrow target.  [ArrowOpen] is the
   only remaining subtyping fact; it is hypothesis-free here. *)
Lemma app_red_pres : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ) (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  (* invert the tight typing of the lambda to obtain its body *)
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now the typing is [G ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z V0] for z ∉ L0 *)
  destruct Hop as [Hparam [L1 Hbody_sub]].
  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ T \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ T).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  (* typing of the substituted body *)
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ T0) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z V0) Hbz
                G z T0 empty q Hok0
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ T0)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzT0 Hq0) as Hsub_trm.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  (* subtyping of the opened result types *)
  assert (Hok1 : ok (G & z ~ S & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 subst_ty))
                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z T) Hsubz
                G z S empty q Hok1
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub_out.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z T 0 z HzT q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := T0) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - split; [exact Hi|]. split.
    + apply ty_sub with (T := open_typ_p q V0); auto.
    + exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).

      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\

  (* now S0 = ∀(T0) U0 and Hsub : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)

  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* Also expose the reduction-plus-typing core with the raw RHoldsL facts,
   for callers that obtain the lambda by another route. *)
Lemma app_step_of_RHoldsL_lam : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T0 ->
  ArrowOpen G S T0 T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T0 /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_red_pres; eauto.
