Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
    + subst. exact H.
    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.
  intros C H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin. induction 1; intros q0 ET.
  - (* pf_bind *)
    exfalso.
    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst U.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. exact H.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IHprecise_flow q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IHprecise_flow q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IHprecise_flow q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
Proof.
  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all : forall C x A B bs T U,
  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros C x A B bs T U Hb. remember (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) as p eqn:Ep.
  intros Hf. revert x A B bs T U Hb Ep.
  induction Hf; intros x A B bs T U Hb Ep.
  - (* pf_bind: p = pvar x0, T = binding, U = T *)
    subst p.
    destruct bs as [|a bs].
    + simpl in Ep. injection Ep as Ex. subst x.
      assert (T = ∀(A) B) by (eapply binds_functional; eauto).
      subst T. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (path_pvar_eq_cons x x bs a Ep).
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst p.
    destruct (path_sel_cons_inv p y a0 bs (eq_sym Ep)) as [bs0 [Ebs Ep0]].
    subst bs.
    pose proof (IHHf x A B bs0 T Hb eq_refl) as [_ Hout].
    rewrite Hout in H. discriminate H.
  - (* pf_open *)
    subst p.
    pose proof (IHHf x A B bs T Hb eq_refl) as [_ Hout].
    rewrite Hout in H. discriminate H.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    subst p.
    pose proof (IHHf x A B bs T Hb eq_refl) as [_ Hout].
    rewrite Hout in H. discriminate H.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    subst p.
    pose proof (IHHf x A B bs T Hb eq_refl) as [_ Hout].
    rewrite Hout in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual bridges.                                                   *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same "ordinary path    *)
(* precision" residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  destruct Hval as [L T U Hbody | L T0 ds Hbody].

(* The bridge predicate, at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: any precise flow already gives a bridge witness (its own
   output type, which is flow-shaped by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply pt3. apply pt2. exact Hf.
  - exact (flow_shape_of_flow Hi Hf).
  - apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure of the bridge predicate is immediate: keep the same
   witness and compose the subtyping. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union_sub :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Replacement is symmetric.  This is needed for the singleton      *)
(*    (type-replacement) subtyping rules: the domain of an arrow is    *)
(*    contravariant, so if a source arrow is obtained by replacing p    *)
(*    with q we must be able to replace back.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma repl_typ_sym :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Trans-free subtyping.                                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is `subtyp` without the primitive transitivity rule.  It  *)
(* is *not* closed under transitivity (that is precisely the residual  *)
(* difficulty), but arrow inversion on it is a pure case analysis.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply subtyp_sel2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_sel1; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Main trans-free arrow inversion.  This is the genuinely provable core
   of the arrow-subtyping inversion: every non-transitive derivation of
   [∀(S1)T1 <: ∀(S2)T2] yields contravariance of the parameter and the
   body relation under the *target* parameter. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_inv : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (G ⊢ S2 <: S1) /\
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
    G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) injection e as E1 E2. subst.
    split; [apply subtyp_refl|]. exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) split.
    + apply subtyp1_subtyp. exact H.
    + exists L. intros x Hx. apply subtyp1_subtyp. apply H0. exact Hx.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1: domains replaced, bodies equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_qp with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := T2) (T' := S1); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2: bodies replaced, domains equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * (* the body replacement is a subtyping, stable under the binder *)
        assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        apply notin_singleton_r in Hx. 2: exact I.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T1 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T2 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        (* the goal already has the opened types; use freshness *)
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'.
        apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_pq with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := S1) (T' := S2); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'. apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* all other constructors have non-arrow conclusions *)
    all: try (exfalso; match goal with
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bot |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_rcd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = _ ∧ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_path _ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bnd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_sngl _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              end).
Qed.

Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified pieces toward bridge 1
   (ordinary arrow path typing -> precise3 at a flow-shaped subtype).
   The raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] in agent_bridge.v is refuted by
   counter_bridge2.v; the HInv-aware assembly is in aux_bridge_fixed.v. *)

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->

| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,

import re, sys, os
WORK=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); TASK='/workspace/Task.v'

def rd(name): return open(os.path.join(WORK,name)).read()

def strip_scratch(txt):
    out=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('Require Import') or s.startswith('Require Export'): continue
        if s in ('Set Implicit Arguments.','Close Scope string_scope.'): continue
        out.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(out)

def strip_ltac(txt, seen):
    if 'Ltac solve_union :=' in txt:
        if seen[0]:
            txt=re.sub(r'^\s*Ltac solve_union :=.*?\.\s*$','',txt,flags=re.M|re.S)
        else: seen[0]=True
    return txt

    out=sys.argv[1]
    for f in ['agent_wf.v','agent_bridge1.v','agent_suball.v']:
        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(WORK,f)):
            sys.exit('missing required final file '+f)
    hp=rd('hp.v')
    # hp prefix without Parameter, before HInv_push
    hp=re.sub(r'Parameter wf_push_cond\s*:.*?\.\n\n','',hp,count=1,flags=re.S)

    after_step=['wfpush','precise','appvar','resnav','selfswap','defsn','res',

                'aux_arrow','aux_prefix','agent_app','agent_bridge','aux_bridge_fixed']
    chunks=[]; seen=[False]

        chunks.append('\n(* ===== %s ===== *)\n'%label+t)
    for f in core: add(f+'.v',rd(f+'.v'))

    for f in after_hp: add(f+'.v',rd(f+'.v'))

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union_sub :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Replacement is symmetric.  This is needed for the singleton      *)
(*    (type-replacement) subtyping rules: the domain of an arrow is    *)
(*    contravariant, so if a source arrow is obtained by replacing p    *)
(*    with q we must be able to replace back.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma repl_typ_sym :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Trans-free subtyping.                                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is `subtyp` without the primitive transitivity rule.  It  *)
(* is *not* closed under transitivity (that is precisely the residual  *)
(* difficulty), but arrow inversion on it is a pure case analysis.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Main trans-free arrow inversion.  This is the genuinely provable core
   of the arrow-subtyping inversion: every non-transitive derivation of
   [∀(S1)T1 <: ∀(S2)T2] yields contravariance of the parameter and the
   body relation under the *target* parameter. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_inv : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (G ⊢ S2 <: S1) /\
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
    G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) injection e as E1 E2. subst.
    split; [apply subtyp_refl|]. exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) split.
    + apply subtyp1_subtyp. exact H.
    + exists L. intros x Hx. apply subtyp1_subtyp. apply H0. exact Hx.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1: domains replaced, bodies equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_qp with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := T2) (T' := S1); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2: bodies replaced, domains equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * (* the body replacement is a subtyping, stable under the binder *)
        assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        apply notin_singleton_r in Hx. 2: exact I.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T1 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T2 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        (* the goal already has the opened types; use freshness *)
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'.
        apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_pq with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := S1) (T' := S2); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'. apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* all other constructors have non-arrow conclusions *)
    all: try (exfalso; match goal with
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bot |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_rcd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = _ ∧ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_path _ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bnd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_sngl _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              end).
Qed.

Ltac solve_union_sub :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Replacement is symmetric.  This is needed for the singleton      *)
(*    (type-replacement) subtyping rules: the domain of an arrow is    *)
(*    contravariant, so if a source arrow is obtained by replacing p    *)
(*    with q we must be able to replace back.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma repl_typ_sym :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Trans-free subtyping.                                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is `subtyp` without the primitive transitivity rule.  It  *)
(* is *not* closed under transitivity (that is precisely the residual  *)
(* difficulty), but arrow inversion on it is a pure case analysis.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Main trans-free arrow inversion.  This is the genuinely provable core
   of the arrow-subtyping inversion: every non-transitive derivation of
   [∀(S1)T1 <: ∀(S2)T2] yields contravariance of the parameter and the
   body relation under the *target* parameter. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_inv : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (G ⊢ S2 <: S1) /\
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
    G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) injection e as E1 E2. subst.
    split; [apply subtyp_refl|]. exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) split.
    + apply subtyp1_subtyp. exact H.
    + exists L. intros x Hx. apply subtyp1_subtyp. apply H0. exact Hx.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1: domains replaced, bodies equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_qp with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := T2) (T' := S1); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2: bodies replaced, domains equal *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * (* the body replacement is a subtyping, stable under the binder *)
        assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        apply notin_singleton_r in Hx. 2: exact I.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T1 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        rewrite (subst_typ_fresh T2 x (pvar x)) by auto.
        (* the goal already has the opened types; use freshness *)
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'.
        apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    inversion H as [p0 q0 bs A0 E1 E2|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr|p0 q0 T1' T2' U0 Hr];
      subst; clear H.
    + (* rall1 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * eapply subtyp_sngl_pq with (p := p) (q := q) (U := U)
          (T := S1) (T' := S2); [exact H0|exact H1|].
        apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hr.
      * exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.
    + (* rall2 *)
      injection E1 as ES1. injection E2 as ET1. subst.
      split.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * assert (Hsub : G ⊢ T1 <: T2).
        { eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact H0|exact H1|exact Hr]. }
        exists (dom G \u fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2). intros x Hx.
        apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxG HxT].
        apply notin_union_r in HxT. destruct HxT as [HxT1 HxT2].
        assert (E1' : open_typ x T1 = T1).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT1. }
        assert (E2' : open_typ x T2 = T2).
        { unfold open_typ. apply subst_typ_fresh. exact HxT2. }
        rewrite E1', E2'. apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
  - (* all other constructors have non-arrow conclusions *)
    all: try (exfalso; match goal with
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bot |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_rcd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = _ ∧ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_path _ _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_bnd _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              | Hbad : ∀(_) _ = typ_sngl _ |- _ => discriminate Hbad
              end).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
    + subst. exact H.
    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
Qed.

Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
  induction H; intros T0 ET.
  - discriminate ET.
  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.
  intros C H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
  induction Hflow as
    [ x G T Hok Hb
    | G p a T U Hprem
    | p G T U Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
    intros Hin q0 ET.
  - (* pf_bind *)
    exfalso.
    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst U.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. assumption.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
Proof.
  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all_aux : forall C (p:path) T U,
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall x A B bs,
    binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hf.
  induction Hf; intros xx AA BB bs Hb Ep.
  - (* pf_bind: p = pvar x0, T = binding, U = T *)
    destruct bs as [|a bs].
    + simpl in Ep. injection Ep as Ex. subst xx.
      assert (HTeq : T = ∀(AA) BB) by (eapply binds_functional; eauto).
      subst T. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (@path_pvar_eq_cons x xx bs a Ep).
  - (* pf_fld *)
    destruct (@path_sel_cons_inv p xx a bs Ep) as [bs0 [Ebs Ep0]].
    subst bs.
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs0 Hb Ep0) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all : forall C x A B bs T U,
  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply flow_from_all_aux; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual bridges.                                                   *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros G x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G1 := G) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  Show.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    (G & x ~ μ T0 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by apply binds_push_eq.
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.
  exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T0) p T Hin Hty').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  dependent destruction Hval.
  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].

(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.

    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.

Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
  induction H; intros T0 ET.
  - discriminate ET.
  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.

(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)

(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
  induction Hflow as
    [ x G T Hok Hb
    | G p a T U Hprem
    | p G T U Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
    intros Hin q0 ET.

    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.

  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union_sub :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A. Replacement is symmetric.                                        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The domain position of an arrow is contravariant.  When an arrow is *)
(* moved across a singleton/replacement rule we therefore have to      *)
(* replace in the *opposite* direction.  The replacement relation is   *)
(* structurally symmetric.                                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_sym :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* B. Replacement commutes with opening of a bound type variable.      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the analogue of [repl_typ_subst] for de Bruijn opening.    *)
(* Needed when the body of an arrow is moved under a fresh binder.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_open :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' ->
     forall k x, repl_typ (open_rec_path k x p) (open_rec_path k x q)
                          (open_rec_typ k x T) (open_rec_typ k x T')) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' ->
     forall k x, repl_dec (open_rec_path k x p) (open_rec_path k x q)
                          (open_rec_dec k x D) (open_rec_dec k x D')).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH k x. simpl. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH k x. simpl. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH k x. simpl. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A k x. simpl. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH k x. simpl. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH k x. simpl. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH k x. simpl. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs k x. simpl. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH k x. simpl. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH k x. simpl. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH k x. simpl. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
Proof.
  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. split; auto.
  - right. split; auto.
Qed.

(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* D. Conditional application-preservation step.                       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The unrestricted bridge statements in agent_bridge.v are refutable  *)
(* in non-HInv contexts (counter_bridge2.v, and the same loose-record  *)
(* / type-member selection pattern refutes the unrestricted           *)
(* arrow_open_bridge).  The corrected HInv-aware interface lives in    *)
(* aux_bridge_fixed.v.  We expose the exact residual and the assembly. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Exact residual: the only missing semantic ingredient for app is     *)
(* contravariant arrow opening in an HInv context.                     *)
Definition arrow_open_HInv_residual : Prop := arrow_open_HInv_bridge.

(* The assembly, restated with the exact residual name. *)
Lemma app_step_from_precise3_residual :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_residual ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv; eauto.
Qed.

### New verified lemmas (agent_bridge1.v)

```coq
Lemma bridge_of_flow   : HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.

Lemma precise2_flow_shape : HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> flow_shape U.

Lemma precise3_sngl_trans_gen :
  G ⊢!!! p : S -> S = {{q}} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.
Lemma precise3_sngl_trans :
  G ⊢!!! p : {{q}} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.

Lemma inert_ok : inert C -> ok C.
```

(* Resolving flows in the pushed context [G & x ~ μ T0].               *)
(* We build a [ResCore] for the heap [γ & x ~ ν(T0)ds] using only the   *)
(* entries/definitions components of [HInv], not its [wf] component.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma defs_at_weaken : forall (G:ctx) (x0:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) x S,
  x # G -> x <> x0 ->
  defs_at G x0 T0 ds ->
  defs_at (G & x ~ S) x0 T0 ds.
Proof.
  intros G x0 T0 ds x S Hx Hne Hd. unfold defs_at in *.
  eapply weaken_defs
    with (G1 := G) (G2 := x0 ~ open_typ_p (pvar x0) T0) (w := x) (S := S).
  - exact Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
    + exact Hx.
    + apply notin_singleton_l. intro E. apply Hne. auto.
Qed.

(* The [res_field] step does not actually use the [HInv] argument. *)
Lemma res_field_noinv : forall γ G p a U,
  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rc_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].

          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rc_lam with (v := λ(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                                    (open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv))
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
              destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).
              ** exact H1.
              ** rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto.
              ** reflexivity.
           ++ assert (Hxempty : x # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.

=== agent_bridge1.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified pieces toward bridge 1
   (ordinary arrow path typing -> precise3 at a flow-shaped subtype).
   The raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] in agent_bridge.v is refuted by
   counter_bridge2.v; the HInv-aware assembly is in aux_bridge_fixed.v. *)

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.

(* Two facts isolated as the remaining obstructions for bridge 1. *)

(* (O1) Record-field extraction from a flow-shaped subtype of a record.
   Needed by [ty_new_elim]: from a flow output U with U <: {a : T}, recover
   a field declaration V of U (so that pf_fld applies) with V <: T.  Under
   HInv this must use provenance of U (the raw version is false). *)
Definition flow_shape_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G U a T,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, flow_shape V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* (O2) Reverse-field (record introduction) for the bridge witness.
   Needed by [ty_rcd_intro]: from a bridge witness V <: T for p•a, produce a
   flow-shaped witness W <: {a : T} for p (or a precise3 of p at such W). *)
Definition bridge_rcd_intro : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G (p•a) T ->
    exists W, G ⊢!!! p : W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}.

(* (O3) The singleton/alias refinement needed by [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]:
   a bridge witness below a singleton can be turned into a precise2 typing at
   the singleton itself. *)
Definition bridge_sngl_refine : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

(* (Reduced goal suggested by the coordinator.) *)
Definition precise_exists_of_path_typing : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p T U Hi H).

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros GG x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) GG).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G := GG & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & (empty:ctx))
         (G1 := GG) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow.
  assert (HinC : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  destruct (@flow_sngl_source (G & x ~ μ T0) (p_sel (avar_f x) bs)
              {{ q }} {{ q }} HinC Hflow q eq_refl)
    as [_ [p0 [a [R [Ep Hf0]]]]].
  pose proof (@flow_res_push γ G x T0 ds (G & x ~ μ T0) Hi Hx Hrt
                eq_refl Hdefs p0 R (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) Hf0) as Rc.
  destruct (@rescore_sngl_field_path_typed (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds)
              (G & x ~ μ T0) p0 a q Rc)
    as [x0 [Vc [C [bs0 [T0' [ds' [Tq [EC [Hb Hty]]]]]]]]].
  exists Tq.
  eapply (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x0 Vc q Tq Hb).
  rewrite <- EC. exact Hty.
Qed.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)


Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0))
    by (exact (@binds_push_eq typ x (μ T0) G)).
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.
  exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T0) p T Hin Hty').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  dependent destruction Hval.
  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
Qed.

(* The same statement, specialised to the exact hypothesis layout that the
   scratch [hp.v] parameter uses, for easy integration. *)
Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

(* Final assembly: only the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge remains. *)
Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof.
  intro Hpath.
  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
Qed.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->

  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->

  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.

  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].

    intros bs q Hflow.

    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).

Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->

    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof.
  intro Hpath.
  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Natural (tight field) targets.

   Term-field declarations in a record are either [inert_typ] or a
   singleton (record_dec = rd_trm / rd_trm_sngl), and these are exactly the
   field types that application/bridge1 can ever require.  Restricting O1 to
   such targets avoids arbitrary record/and field types. *)

Definition nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop := inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).

Lemma nat_flow_shape : forall T, nat_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T [H | [q E]].
  - apply inert_flow_shape. exact H.
  - subst. apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

(* Natural-target field extraction (the reduced O1). *)
Definition nat_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* What app/bridge1 consumes: a natural-target witness gives a flow for the
   field path and the bridge witness. *)
Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
  nat_field_of_sub ->
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T V0,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    (exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T) ->
    exists W, G ⊢! (p • a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros _. intros γ G p R U a T V0 Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hnat [V [HnV [Hhas HVsub]]].
  exists V. split; [|split].
  - apply pf_fld with (T := R) (U := V).
    apply (@flow_record_has G p R U (typ_rcd {a ⦂ V}) Hf). exact Hhas.
  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
  - exact HVsub.
Qed.
EOF

Promising induction formulation for the combined-measure issue you identified: use `tds_mutind` with a mutual property over typing and subtyping, where the subtyping property takes the source typing and its Good witness as *explicit hypotheses*:
`Psub(Hsub : T<:U) := forall C p (Hty : C⊢trm_path p : T), Good C p T -> Good C p U`
and `P0(Hty : C⊢trm_path p:T) := Good C p T`.

## Final status report

I attempted the `ts_mutind`/`tds_mutind` “Good” invariant plan and the natural-target/head-compatibility simplification. I did **not** complete bridge 1; I localised the remaining obstruction to two concrete rules and recorded the analysis in the file.
