### New verified material (`agent_bridge1.v`)

Natural-target reduction (as requested):

```coq
Definition nat_typ T := inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{q}}).
Lemma nat_flow_shape : nat_typ T -> flow_shape T.

Definition nat_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U a T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a⦂T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a⦂V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
  nat_field_of_sub -> … -> exists W, G ⊢! (p•a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
```
The consumer side is fully proved: `flow_record_has` + `pf_fld` turn any `nat_field_of_sub` witness into a precise flow for the field path at a natural subtype. Head-exclusivity facts `arrow_not_bnd`, `arrow_not_sngl`, `bnd_not_sngl` are proved; `nat_head_compat`, `nat_sub_head_compat`, `path_field_coherence` are stated as the residual head-compatibility/coherence obligations. Earlier verified glue remains: `precise3_sngl_trans`/`_gen`, `precise2_flow_shape`, `precise3_flow_shape`, `bridge_of_flow`, `bridge_sub`, `bridge_of_precise2`, `Rsing3`/`sngl_sub_precise3`/`Rsing3_sub_closure`/`field_sub_closure3`, and the inert-context base lemmas.

### Why the `ts_mutind` instantiation does not close with a shallow `Good`

The proposed plumbing
```
P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U
```
does make `ty_sub`/`subtyp_trans` work exactly as the coordinator described (transport with the source witness; trans composes `P0` using the constructed typing `ty_sub Hty Hsub1`, which is legal because `P0` quantifies over typing proofs). The two blockers are elsewhere and are intrinsic:

1. **`subtyp_sel2`** (`S <: p↓A`): `P0` must produce `Good q (p↓A)` for an **arbitrary** path `q` from `Good q S`. To make that possible, `Good` has to be upward-closed under the subtyping relation being defined (or carry the selection’s record-typing provenance). Making it upward-closed (`Good p T := forall B, T <: B -> Bridge p B`) shifts the burden onto every typing rule for all supertypes.
2. **`ty_and_intro`**: under upward-closed `Good`, one would need `Bridge p (T∧U)` from `Bridge p T` and `Bridge p U`; two distinct precise-flow witnesses below `T` and below `U` need not combine into one below `T∧U`. In pDOT the intersection itself is never the needed target (only and11/and12 towards an arrow are used), so the correct invariant must be target-restricted, not uniformly upward-closed — which is exactly the subtyping inversion (and11/12, fld, sel, repl) that the O1/O3 analyses kept hitting.

These two points are the same barrier as before: the real invariant is the paper’s precise/tight semantic relation, where the selection case carries a lower-bound witness together with record-typing provenance, and `wf` supplies precise2 for singleton alias targets. The exact residual statements to attack next are:

```coq
nat_field_of_sub      (* flow_shape U, U <: rcd{a⦂T}, nat_typ T -> field V with nat_typ V, V<:T *)
nat_sub_head_compat   (* inert G -> nat_typ V -> nat_typ T -> V<:T -> head compatibility *)
sngl_sub_precise3     (* inert C -> C⊢p:T -> T<:{{q}} -> C⊢!!! p:{{q}} *)
Rsing3_sub_closure    (* transport Rsing3 along T<:B, typing at T fixed *)
bridge_rcd_intro      (* reverse field for Bridge *)
ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge  (* the full bridge 1 *)
```
`nat_field_of_sub`/`nat_sub_head_compat` are true under HInv (finiteness forbids a head-incompatible seed without a real field) but their proof needs a measure over the combined typing+subtyping derivation bundle or a store-semantic model; a subtyping-only induction and `ts_mutind`’s `P0` branches cannot reach the `sel2 → subtyp_typ` subtyping obligation embedded in a typing premise.

### Deliverables

- `/mnt/claude-home/projects/-workspace/work/agent_app.v` — fully proved `app_red_pres` (λ lookup + `ArrowOpen` ⇒ reduction + typing preservation + HInv) and `app_step_of_precise3_open`.
- `/mnt/claude-home/projects/-workspace/work/agent_bridge.v` — `flow_shape` taxonomy, `flow_shape_of_flow`, original conditional assembly (caveated; raw bridge2 refuted).
- `/mnt/claude-home/projects/-workspace/work/agent_bridge1.v` — verified precision/flow-shape glue, natural-target packaging, residual definitions/notes.
- Integration with the coordinator’s `aux_bridge_fixed.v` (`app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv`) is ready once `ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge`, `rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge`, `arrow_open_HInv_bridge` are available.

  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->

  C ⊢!! p : U ->
  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.

  `Snd C p T := exists U, C⊢!! p:U /\ C⊢U<:T` (with `U` flow-shaped), together with the companion `Rsing`.

Actually you can: recursion over a proof of an inductive Prop returning a Prop (a proof) is allowed (elimination of Prop into Prop is unrestricted). E.g., `Fixpoint f (H : P) : Q := match H with ... end` where P,Q : Prop is fine as long as Q doesn't depend on H in a way requiring large elimination? (* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Precise3-based singleton invariant (coordinator refinement).

   precise2 is not closed under singleton transitivity, but precise3 is
   (precise3_sngl_trans, proved above), so Rsing uses precise3. *)

Definition Rsing3 (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.

(* Minimal singleton-target subtyping inversion under inert typing. *)
Definition sngl_sub_precise3 : Prop :=
  forall C p T q,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> C ⊢ T <: {{ q }} ->
    C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.

(* Two-sided form used inside the typing induction at [ty_sub]: the [Rsing3]
   invariant is available for the source type T, and must be transported to
   the target B along T <: B. *)
Definition Rsing3_sub_closure : Prop :=
  forall C p T B,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Rsing3 C p T -> C ⊢ T <: B ->
    Rsing3 C p B.

(* Same for the field/record invariant. *)
Definition field_sub_closure3 : Prop :=
  forall C p T a S,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
    exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Natural (tight field) targets.

   Term-field declarations in a record are either [inert_typ] or a
   singleton (record_dec = rd_trm / rd_trm_sngl), and these are exactly the
   field types that application/bridge1 can ever require.  Restricting O1 to
   such targets avoids arbitrary record/and field types. *)

Definition nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop := inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).

Lemma nat_flow_shape : forall T, nat_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T [H | [q E]].
  - apply inert_flow_shape. exact H.
  - subst. apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

(* Natural-target field extraction (the reduced O1). *)
Definition nat_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* What app/bridge1 consumes: a natural-target witness gives a flow for the
   field path and the bridge witness. *)
Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
  nat_field_of_sub ->
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists W, G ⊢! (p • a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn.
  destruct (Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn) as [V [HnV [Hhas HVsub]]].
  exists V. split; [|split].
  - apply pf_fld with (T := R) (U := V).
    apply (@flow_record_has G p R U {a ⦂ V} Hf). exact Hhas.
  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
  - exact HVsub.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Head compatibility for natural types.

   [ty_def_path] types path fields at a singleton, [ty_def_all]/[ty_def_new]
   type value fields at an arrow/μ; hence actual record field types are
   exactly arrow, μ (record), or singleton, i.e. [nat_typ].  The residual
   below asks that subtyping between natural types preserves the head
   constructor; it is what remains of the O1 impasse after restricting to
   natural targets. *)

Lemma arrow_not_bnd : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma arrow_not_sngl : forall (q:path), ~ is_arrow {{ q }}.
Proof. intros q [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), μ T <> {{ q }}.
Proof. intros T q E. discriminate E. Qed.

(* The three heads of a natural type are mutually exclusive. *)
Definition nat_head_compat (G:ctx) (V T:typ) : Prop :=
  (is_arrow V /\ is_arrow T) \/
  ((exists U0, V = μ U0 /\ record_type U0) /\
   (exists T0, T = μ T0 /\ record_type T0)) \/
  ((exists q, V = {{ q }}) /\ (exists q', T = {{ q' }})).

(* Residual: natural-source / natural-target subtyping preserves the head.
   This is the "good/natural V <: natural T head-compatibility" fact. *)
Definition nat_sub_head_compat : Prop :=
  forall G V T,
    inert G -> nat_typ V -> nat_typ T -> G ⊢ V <: T ->
    nat_head_compat G V T.

(* Residual: path-typing coherence for actual record fields.  Combining the
   head-compatibility fact with the def-typing structure
   (ty_def_path vs ty_def_all/ty_def_new) is intended to prove
   [nat_field_of_sub]. *)
Definition path_field_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Notes on the tds/ts_mutind instantiation (not proved).

   The proposed plumbing

     P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
     P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U

   transport along one subtyping derivation uses the good witness at the
   source, and trans composes P0 with the typing [ty_sub Hty Hsub1] (P0 is
   universally quantified over typing proofs).

      *arbitrary* path q from [Good q S].  Hence [Good] must be closed
      upward under the very subtyping relation being defined (or carry the
      selection's record-typing provenance).  Making it upward closed
      (e.g. Good p T := forall B, T<:B -> Bridge p B) pushes the burden
      into every typing rule for all supertypes.

      from [Bridge p T] and [Bridge p U]; but two precise/flow witnesses
      below T and below U need not combine to one below T∧U.  In pDOT the

   full solution is the paper's precise/tight semantic invariant, with the
   selection case carrying a lower-bound witness plus record-typing
   provenance (and [wf] supplying precise2 for singleton alias targets). *)

  match fuel with
  | O => True
```coq
  | S f =>
    match T with
    | typ_top => True
    | typ_bot => False                                   (* no path typed at ⊥ *)
    | typ_all S0 U0 => Bridge γ C p (∀(S0)U0) /\ (exists U, C⊢!!p:U)   (* Bridge = bridge1 conclusion *)

    | typ_and T1 T2 => GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
    | typ_rcd (dec_typ A L U) => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)   (* transport function, allowed here *)
    | typ_rcd (dec_trm a S0) => GoodF f γ C (p•a) S0
    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{q}}                     (* exact singleton precision *)
    | typ_path p0 A =>
        (forall S0 T0, C⊢trm_path p0 : typ_rcd{A>:S0<:T0} ->
                       GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)  (* selection transport *)
    end
  end.
```

This is exactly the coordinator’s invariant design, realised as a `Definition`: arrow stores `Bridge` (so bridge1 is a projection), singleton stores `precise3`, records store the field `Good`, intersections store both components, `μ` stores the opened type with `fuel-1`, and type-member/selection decomposition is a stored transport function (negative occurrence, legal in a `Fixpoint`). Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Mutual structural recursion over the proof trees of [ty_trm] and
   [subtyp], returning Prop.  This validates the combined
   typing+subtyping well-foundedness: subtyping rules that store a typing
   premise (sel1/sel2/sngl_pq/sngl_qp) recursively enter that typing proof,
   and the typing rule [ty_sub] recursively enters its subtyping proof.
   Recursion is purely structural on the proof arguments (the guard checker
   accepts both directions).  The body here is [True]; it is the skeleton
   into which the [Good] invariant is to be plugged. *)

Fixpoint prove_ty_true (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H : G ⊢ t : T) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | ty_var b => I
  | ty_all_intro t U body => I
  | ty_all_elim d1 d2 =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_new_intro T ds body => I
  | ty_new_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rcd_intro p a d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_let u d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in I
  | ty_sngl d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_path_elim a d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_rec_intro T d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rec_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_and_intro d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_sub d s => let _ := prove_ty_true d in let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  end
with prove_sub_true (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H : G ⊢ S <: U) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_top G0 T => I
  | subtyp_bot G0 T => I
  | subtyp_refl G0 T => I
  | subtyp_trans s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_and11 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and12 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and2 s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_fld a s => let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  | subtyp_typ A s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_pq t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_qp t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sel2 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_sel1 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_all T1 T2 s1 body => let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in I
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel-indexed structural invariant skeleton.

   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field
   [forall q, Good q L -> Good q U] is rejected by Coq: the occurrence of
   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant
   design is expressible.  This is the implementable shape. *)

Require Import agent_bridge1.

Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | O => True
  | Datatypes.S f =>
    match T with
    | typ_top => True
    | typ_bot => False
    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
    | typ_bnd T0 =>
        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
    | typ_rcd D =>
        match D with
        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
        end
    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}
    | typ_path p0 A =>
        (forall (S0 T0:typ),
            C ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} ->
            GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)
    end
  end.
===

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Structural Good invariant for actual record / recursive types.      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* A [Good G p T] certificate records that the precise flow at [p]     *)
(* ending in [T] is structurally well behaved:                         *)
(*   - records expose their term fields recursively (at [p • a]);      *)
(*   - type members carry their transport along the bound;             *)
(*   - intersections expose both components;                          *)
(*   - [μ T0] exposes its unfolding [open_typ_p p T0].                 *)
(* Every constructor also stores the precise flow it was built from.   *)
(* This is the structural piece needed to avoid residual O1.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint typ_size (T:typ) {struct T} : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bot => 1
  | typ_rcd D => S (dec_size D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_path _ _ => 1
  | typ_bnd T0 => S (typ_size T0)
  | typ_all S T0 => S (typ_size S + typ_size T0)
  | typ_sngl _ => 1
  end
with dec_size (D:dec) {struct D} : nat :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ _ L U => S (typ_size L + typ_size U)
  | dec_trm _ T => S (typ_size T)

  (forall (T:typ) k (p:path), typ_size (open_rec_typ_p k p T) = typ_size T) /\\

Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q l k p. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros S IH1 T IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q k p. reflexivity.
  - intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.

Lemma typ_size_open_eq : forall T p, typ_size (open_typ_p p T) = typ_size T.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Mutual structural recursion over the proof trees of [ty_trm] and
   [subtyp], returning Prop.  This validates the combined
   typing+subtyping well-foundedness: subtyping rules that store a typing
   premise (sel1/sel2/sngl_pq/sngl_qp) recursively enter that typing proof,
   and the typing rule [ty_sub] recursively enters its subtyping proof.
   Recursion is purely structural on the proof arguments (the guard checker
   accepts both directions).  The body here is [True]; it is the skeleton
   into which the [Good] invariant is to be plugged. *)

Fixpoint prove_ty_true (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H : G ⊢ t : T) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | ty_var b => I
  | ty_all_intro t U body => I
  | ty_all_elim d1 d2 =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_new_intro T ds body => I
  | ty_new_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rcd_intro p a d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_let u d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in I
  | ty_sngl d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_path_elim a d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_rec_intro T d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rec_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_and_intro d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_sub d s => let _ := prove_ty_true d in let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  end
with prove_sub_true (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H : G ⊢ S <: U) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_top G0 T => I
  | subtyp_bot G0 T => I
  | subtyp_refl G0 T => I
  | subtyp_trans s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_and11 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and12 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and2 s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_fld a s => let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  | subtyp_typ A s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_pq t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_qp t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sel2 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_sel1 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_all T1 T2 s1 body => let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in I
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel-indexed structural invariant skeleton.

   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field
   [forall q, Good q L -> Good q U] is rejected by Coq: the occurrence of
   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant
   design is expressible.  This is the implementable shape. *)

Require Import agent_bridge1.

Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | O => True
  | Datatypes.S f =>
    match T with
    | typ_top => True
    | typ_bot => False
    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
    | typ_bnd T0 =>
        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
    | typ_rcd D =>
        match D with
        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
        end
    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}
    | typ_path p0 A =>
        (forall (S0 T0:typ),
            C ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} ->
            GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)
    end
  end.

(*                                                                     *)
(* A [Good G p T] certificate records that the precise flow at [p]     *)
(* ending in [T] is structurally well behaved:                         *)
(*   - records expose their term fields recursively (at [p • a]);      *)
(*   - type members carry their transport along the bound;             *)
(*   - intersections expose both components;                          *)
(*   - [μ T0] exposes its unfolding [open_typ_p p T0].                 *)
(* Every constructor also stores the precise flow it was built from.   *)
(* This is the structural piece needed to avoid residual O1.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint typ_size (T:typ) {struct T} : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bot => 1
  | typ_rcd D => S (dec_size D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_path _ _ => 1
  | typ_bnd T0 => S (typ_size T0)
  | typ_all Sx T0 => S (typ_size Sx + typ_size T0)
  | typ_sngl _ => 1
  end
with dec_size (D:dec) {struct D} : nat :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ _ L U => S (typ_size L + typ_size U)
  | dec_trm _ T => S (typ_size T)
  end.

Lemma typ_size_open_p :
  (forall (T:typ) k (p:path), typ_size (open_rec_typ_p k p T) = typ_size T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k (p:path), dec_size (open_rec_dec_p k p D) = dec_size D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q l k p. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros S IH1 T IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q k p. reflexivity.
  - intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_size_open_eq : forall T p, typ_size (open_typ_p p T) = typ_size T.
Proof. intros T p. unfold open_typ_p. apply (proj1 typ_size_open_p T 0 p). Qed.

Lemma typ_size_pos : forall T, 0 < typ_size T.
Proof. intros T. destruct T; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma typ_size_lt_bnd : forall T0, typ_size T0 < typ_size (μ T0).
Proof. intros. simpl. lia. Qed.
Lemma typ_size_lt_and1 : forall T1 T2, typ_size T1 < typ_size (T1 ∧ T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. lia. Qed.
Lemma typ_size_lt_and2 : forall T1 T2, typ_size T2 < typ_size (T1 ∧ T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. lia. Qed.
Lemma typ_size_lt_rcd : forall a S, typ_size S < typ_size (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}).
Proof. intros. simpl. lia. Qed.

(* Natural targets: inert types and singleton aliases.  (Named [wf_nat_typ]
   to avoid clashing with the app worker's [nat_typ].) *)
Definition wf_nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop :=
  inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel-existential Good for actual record / recursive / arrow /
   singleton types.  This is the construction side of the invariant
   defined in agent_mutual.v (GoodF).                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint g_typ_size (T:typ) {struct T} : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bot => 1
  | typ_rcd D => S (g_dec_size D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => S (g_typ_size T1 + g_typ_size T2)
  | typ_path _ _ => 1
  | typ_bnd T0 => S (g_typ_size T0)
  | typ_all Sx T0 => S (g_typ_size Sx + g_typ_size T0)
  | typ_sngl _ => 1
  end
with g_dec_size (D:dec) {struct D} : nat :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ _ L U => S (g_typ_size L + g_typ_size U)
  | dec_trm _ T => S (g_typ_size T)
  end.

Lemma g_typ_size_open_p :
  (forall (T:typ) k (p:path), g_typ_size (open_rec_typ_p k p T) = g_typ_size T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k (p:path), g_dec_size (open_rec_dec_p k p D) = g_dec_size D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q l k p. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros S IH1 T IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros q k p. reflexivity.
  - intros A T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k p. simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a T IH k p. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma g_typ_size_open_eq : forall T p, g_typ_size (open_typ_p p T) = g_typ_size T.
Proof. intros T p. unfold open_typ_p. apply (proj1 g_typ_size_open_p T 0 p). Qed.

Lemma g_typ_size_pos : forall T, 0 < g_typ_size T.
Proof. intros T. destruct T; simpl; lia. Qed.

(* Natural targets: inert types and singleton aliases. *)
Definition wf_nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop :=
  inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).

Definition GoodEventually (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists n, forall m, n <= m -> GoodF m γ C p T.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
    + subst. exact H.
    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
Qed.

Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
  induction H; intros T0 ET.
  - discriminate ET.
  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.
  intros C H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
  induction Hflow as
    [ x G T Hok Hb
    | G p a T U Hprem
    | p G T U Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
    intros Hin q0 ET.
  - (* pf_bind *)
    exfalso.
    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst U.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. assumption.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
Proof.
  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all_aux : forall C (p:path) T U,
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall x A B bs,
    binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hf.
  induction Hf; intros xx AA BB bs Hb Ep.
  - (* pf_bind: p = pvar x0, T = binding, U = T *)
    destruct bs as [|a bs].
    + simpl in Ep. injection Ep as Ex. subst xx.
      assert (HTeq : T = ∀(AA) BB) by (eapply binds_functional; eauto).
      subst T. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (@path_pvar_eq_cons x xx bs a Ep).
  - (* pf_fld *)
    destruct (@path_sel_cons_inv p xx a bs Ep) as [bs0 [Ebs Ep0]].
    subst bs.
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs0 Hb Ep0) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all : forall C x A B bs T U,
  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply flow_from_all_aux; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

  - exact Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
    + exact Hx.
    + apply notin_singleton_l. intro E. apply Hne. auto.
Qed.

Lemma res_field_noinv : forall γ G p a U,

(* Extract the concrete stored-path typing from a [ResCore] whose output is
   a record with a singleton field.  The stored definition must be a path
   (a [defv] cannot be typed at a singleton field type), and its typing
   premise in the DefsTyped view context is returned. *)
Lemma rescore_sngl_field_path_typed : forall γ G p a q,
  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) ->
  exists (x:var) (Vc:typ) (C:ctx) (bs:fields) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (Tq:typ),
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc /\
    binds x (μ Vc) G /\
    C ⊢ trm_path q : Tq.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a q R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0
                  (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) {a ⦂ {{ q }}} H4 H5
                  (@rh_one {a ⦂ {{ q }}})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a {{ q }} H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q0|val].
    + dependent destruction Hty.
      exists x. exists Vc. exists (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc).
      exists bs. exists T0. exists ds. exists T.
      split; [reflexivity|split; [exact H1|exact H0]].
    + exfalso. dependent destruction Hty.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual bridges.                                                   *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros GG x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) GG).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G := GG & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & (empty:ctx))
         (G1 := GG) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow.
  assert (HinC : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  destruct (@flow_sngl_source (G & x ~ μ T0) (p_sel (avar_f x) bs)
              {{ q }} {{ q }} HinC Hflow q eq_refl)
    as [_ [p0 [a [R [Ep Hf0]]]]].
  pose proof (@flow_res_push γ G x T0 ds (G & x ~ μ T0) Hi Hx Hrt
                eq_refl Hdefs p0 R (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) Hf0) as Rc.
  destruct (@rescore_sngl_field_path_typed (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds)
              (G & x ~ μ T0) p0 a q Rc)
    as [x0 [Vc [C [bs0 [T0' [ds' [Tq [EC [Hb Hty]]]]]]]]].
  exists Tq.
  eapply (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x0 Vc q Tq Hb).
  rewrite <- EC. exact Hty.
Qed.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)


Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0))
    by (exact (@binds_push_eq typ x (μ T0) G)).
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.
  exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T0) p T Hin Hty').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.

    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
Qed.

(* The same statement, specialised to the exact hypothesis layout that the

Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

(* Final assembly: only the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge remains. *)
Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :

Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed agent_bridge1.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union_sub :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A. Replacement is symmetric.                                        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The domain position of an arrow is contravariant.  When an arrow is *)
(* moved across a singleton/replacement rule we therefore have to      *)
(* replace in the *opposite* direction.  The replacement relation is   *)
(* structurally symmetric.                                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_sym :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* B. Replacement commutes with opening of a bound type variable.      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the analogue of [repl_typ_subst] for de Bruijn opening.    *)
(* Needed when the body of an arrow is moved under a fresh binder.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma open_rec_path_sel_fields : forall k x (p:path) bs,
  open_rec_path k x (p •• bs) = (open_rec_path k x p) •• bs.
Proof.
  intros k x [a fs] bs. simpl. unfold sel_fields. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_path_named : forall k x (p:path),
  named_path p -> open_rec_path k x p = p.
Proof.
  intros k x [a fs] [y [cs E]]. inversion E. subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening, provided the replacement
   paths are named (so they are unaffected by opening). *)
Lemma repl_typ_open :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' ->
     named_path p -> named_path q ->
     forall k x, repl_typ p q (open_rec_typ k x T) (open_rec_typ k x T')) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' ->
     named_path p -> named_path q ->
     forall k x, repl_dec p q (open_rec_dec k x D) (open_rec_dec k x D')).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rrcd. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q bs A Hp Hq k x. simpl.
    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
    apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1)) (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
    apply rbnd. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x T1) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))
                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x T2) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))).
    apply rall1. exact (IH Hp Hq k x).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1))
                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
    apply rall2. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
  - intros p q bs Hp Hq k x. simpl.
    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
    apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtrm. apply (IH Hp Hq).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
...
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
Proof.
  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. split; auto.
  - right. split; auto.
Qed.

(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* D. Conditional application-preservation step.                       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The unrestricted bridge statements in agent_bridge.v are refutable  *)
(* in non-HInv contexts (counter_bridge2.v, and the same loose-record  *)
(* / type-member selection pattern refutes the unrestricted           *)
(* arrow_open_bridge).  The corrected HInv-aware interface lives in    *)
(* aux_bridge_fixed.v.  We expose the exact residual and the assembly. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Exact residuals.  The raw, context-free bridge statements are false
   (loose record bindings give incompatible type-member views; see
   counter_bridge2.v for the analogous refutation of bridge 2).  The
   HInv-aware variants below are the correct interfaces.

   What is *proven* in this file, unconditionally:

     - repl_typ_sym       : replacement is symmetric (needed because the
                            arrow domain is contravariant);
     - repl_typ_open      : replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening
                            when the replacement paths are named;
     - subtyp1_all_domain : arrow-domain inversion for the trans-free
                            subtyping relation [subtyp1].

   What remains for the HInv-aware arrow-opening bridge is exactly the
   *coherence* of path typings at records in an inert context: a path
   [p] can be typed at two record views [rcd{A>:S1<:T1}] and
   [rcd{A>:S2<:T2}] of the same tight record, and one needs the tight
   bound [Q] with [S1 <: Q <: T2] (and its arrow structure) to compose
   the two type-selection steps.  This is the same metatheoretic content
   as the ordinary-path -> precise3 principal-typing bridge.  Without
   it, [subtyp1] is not closed under transitivity even in an inert
   context (the detour can pass through a type member whose tight bound
   is [⊤]), although such a detour cannot connect two *arrow* endpoints
   unless the tight bound is itself arrow-compatible. *)
Definition arrow_open_HInv_residual : Prop := arrow_open_HInv_bridge.

Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_HInv_residual : Prop := rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* E.  The narrow field-precision residual.                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [field_sub_closure] (agent_bridge1.v) asks: a path [p] typed at a   *)
(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. exact HV.
Qed.

(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
Proof.
  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
Qed.

(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)

(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.

   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
   precision *soundness*:

     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)

   and its two companions R (exists U, C⊢!! p:U) and Rsing.

   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).

   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
   the unconditional implication available here is
   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)

(* Natural-field form (field type an arrow / μ-record / singleton).  The
   same reduction applies; no restriction on S is even needed. *)
Lemma field_sub_closure_natural_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
    flow_shape S -> exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT Hfs. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. apply pt3. exact HV.
Qed.

(* NOTE on the R / Rsing / F decomposition (agent_bridge1.v).  The
   [ty_new_elim] case inherently needs *unrestricted* field precision:
   from [p0 : rcd{b ⦂ rcd{a ⦂ S}}] one must precisely type [p0 • b] at
   some [V], and then select [a] from [V].  The intermediate field type
   [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is a record, so a version of [F] restricted to natural
   field types cannot be applied at that step; and the relation between
   the precise field type [V] and the ordinary view [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is
   exactly the precision-soundness invariant (a flow output being a
   subtype of the ordinary typing).  Thus [field_sub_closure] and the
   bridge are equivalent in strength for the needs of this development;
   the clean unconditional implication is the one proven above. *)

(* The assembly, restated with the exact residual name. *)
Lemma app_step_from_precise3_residual :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_residual ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv; eauto.
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.

Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Store-level aliasing (wf/HInv-derived) and its use for the          *)
(* singleton component of replacement invariance.                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition alias (γ:sta) (p q:path) : Prop := γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧.

(* A precise3 singleton typing gives a concrete store alias. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ p q.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  assert (r = defp q) by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
  subst r. exact Hstar.
Qed.

(* Aliasing is stable under appending a list of fields. *)
Lemma alias_sel_fields : forall γ (p q:path) bs,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros γ p q bs. revert p q. induction bs as [|a bs IH]; intros p q H.
  - rewrite !sel_fields_nil. exact H.
  - change (alias γ ((p •• bs) • a) ((q •• bs) • a)).
    apply lookup_star_sel_p. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Aliasing composes. *)
Lemma alias_trans : forall γ p q r,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ q r -> alias γ p r.
Proof. intros. eapply star_trans; eauto. Qed.

(* Replacement only produces singleton targets through [rsngl]; expose the
   two endpoint paths and the concrete bridge-path aliasing. *)
Lemma repl_typ_sngl_endpoints : forall p q T T' s,
  repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} ->
  exists bs, s = p •• bs /\ T' = {{ q •• bs }}.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' s H. dependent destruction H; intros E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - injection E as Es. subst s.
    exists bs. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Singleton component of replacement invariance, now verified:
   if [p] aliases [q] in the store, then aliasing of any path [r] with a
   singleton [s] is preserved when [s] is rewritten to [s'] by
   [repl_typ p q] on singleton types. *)
Lemma alias_repl_sngl :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ p q ->
    forall T T' s s',
      repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ s s' ->
      alias γ s s'.
Proof. intros; assumption. Qed.

Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ p q ->
    forall T T' s s' r,
      repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ r s ->
      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros γ p q Hab T T' s s' r Hr Hs Hs' Hrs.
  destruct (@repl_typ_sngl_endpoints p q T T' s Hr Hs) as [bs [Es ET']].
  subst s s'.
  eapply alias_trans; [exact Hrs|].
  apply alias_sel_fields. exact Hab.
Qed.

(* The same for the opposite replacement orientation (subtyp_sngl_qp). *)
Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport_qp :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ q p ->
    forall T T' s s' r,
      repl_typ q p T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ r s ->
      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros. eapply alias_repl_sngl_transport; eauto.
Qed.

(* Field-wise aliasing for a precise3 singleton typing: this is the
   path part needed by the [rdtrm]/[rpath] replacement cases. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias_sel_fields : forall γ G p q bs,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros. apply alias_sel_fields. eapply precise3_sngl_alias; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual: the non-singleton replacement components.

   - recursive/and/term-field types, which reduce recursively.

Definition alias_arrow_repl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,

    forall S1 T1 S2 T2,

Definition alias_typ_member_coherence : Prop :=

Lemma record_dec_of_rt_rcd : forall (D:dec) ls,

Lemma record_good_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> record_type U ->
  GoodEventually γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf Hrt.
  exists (g_typ_size U). intros m Hm.
  eapply (goodF_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size U) (T := U)); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma natural_good_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> wf_nat_typ T ->
  GoodEventually γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf Hn.
  exists (g_typ_size T). intros m Hm.
  eapply (goodF_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma good_of_flow_shape : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
  GoodEventually γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf Hfs. destruct Hfs as [S0 T0 | T1 Hrt | T1 Hrt | q0].
  - apply natural_good_of_flow with (R := R); auto.
    left. apply inert_typ_all.
  - apply natural_good_of_flow with (R := R); auto.
    left. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
    apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
  - apply record_good_of_flow with (R := R); auto.
  - apply natural_good_of_flow with (R := R); auto.
    right. exists q0. reflexivity.
Qed.

## Round summary: replacement coherence + `GoodEventually` fuel algebra

All eight files compile in order (`agent_app → agent_bridge → aux_bridge_fixed → agent_bridge1 → agent_mutual → agent_good → agent_repl → agent_assembly`); no forbidden tokens. New: `agent_repl.v`, `agent_assembly.v`.

### `agent_repl.v` — singleton replacement coherence (now verified) and type-member reduction

```coq
Definition alias γ p q := γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧.

Lemma precise3_sngl_alias : HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{q}} -> alias γ p q.
Lemma alias_sel_fields  : alias γ p q -> alias γ (p••bs) (q••bs).
Lemma alias_trans       : alias γ p q -> alias γ q r -> alias γ p r.
Lemma repl_typ_sngl_endpoints :
  repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{s}} -> exists bs, s = p••bs /\ T' = {{q••bs}}.
Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport :
  alias γ p q -> repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{s}} -> T' = {{s'}} ->
  alias γ r s -> alias γ r s'.
Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport_qp : (* opposite orientation for sngl_qp *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias_sel_fields : HInv γ G -> G⊢!!! p:{{q}} -> alias γ (p••bs) (q••bs).
```
This closes the **singleton component of `good_repl` unconditionally under HInv**, for both replacement orientations, using `precise3_lookupL` + `holds_sngl_pathL` + iterated `lookup_star_sel_p`. Consequence for the invariant: if `Good`’s singleton payload is the store alias `alias γ r s` (with `wf`/`precise2` supplying the reverse direction), the `sngl_pq/qp` singleton cases are done; if it stays purely `precise3`, note that lookup does *not* yield syntactic `precise3` at the rewritten singleton.

Type-member coherence is reduced to one exact input:
```coq
Lemma typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound  (* verified *)
Definition typ_member_common_bound : Prop :=   (* remaining wf residual *)
  forall γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2, HInv γ G ->
    G⊢p0 : rcd{A>:S1<:T1} -> G⊢p0 : rcd{A>:S2<:T2} ->
    exists W, (G⊢S1<:W /\ G⊢W<:T1) /\ (G⊢S2<:W /\ G⊢W<:T2).
Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound (* verified *)
```

### `agent_assembly.v` — verified `GoodEventually` fuel algebra (P0 building blocks)

These are the structural operations the P0 induction needs, all proved:

```coq
goodEventually_and            : GEv p T -> GEv p U -> GEv p (T∧U)          (* bound S(max n1 n2) *)
goodEventually_rcd_intro      : GEv (p•a) S -> GEv p {a⦂S}
goodEventually_new_elim       : GEv p {a⦂S} -> GEv (p•a) S                  (* same bound, uses GEv at fuel S m *)
goodEventually_mu_intro       : GEv p (open_typ_p p T0) -> GEv p (μT0)
goodEventually_mu_elim        : GEv p (μT0) -> GEv p (open_typ_p p T0)       (* same bound, uses fuel S m *)
goodEventually_dec_typ_elim   : GEv p {A>:L<:U} -> GEv p L -> GEv p U       (* consumes the stored transport *)
goodEventually_arrow_bridge   : GEv p (∀(S)T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S)T)
goodEventually_arrow_prec2    : GEv p (∀(S)T) -> exists U, G⊢!! p:U
goodEventually_sngl_precise3  : GEv p {{q}} -> G⊢!!! p:{{q}}
goodEventually_top            : GEv p ⊤
goodEventually_bot_absurd     : GEv p ⊥ -> False
```
Fuel shifts are explicit (and uses `S(max)`, new_elim/mu_elim use the same bound but evaluate `GoodF` at `S m`), so the non-monotonicity of `GoodF` is handled at the `GoodEventually` level as long as the construction lemmas provide `forall m >= N`. These, together with `agent_good`’s `record_good_of_flow`/`natural_good_of_flow`/`good_of_flow_shape`/`nat_typ_good_of_flow`, are all the P0 leaf/structural steps.

### Two obstacles for the proposed assembly (precise)

1. **Bounded monotonicity `size T ≤ f -> GoodF f T -> GoodF (S f) T` fails at `dec_typ`.** `GoodF f {A>:L<:U} = (GoodF (f-1) L -> GoodF (f-1) U)`, while `GoodF (S f)` needs `GoodF f L -> GoodF f U`. Given `GoodF f L` one must *decrease* fuel to `GoodF (f-1) L` to use the available transport; the type-size IH (which goes `f-1 -> f`, the wrong direction on `L`) cannot supply it. A transport stored as `forall m ≤ f` still needs the boundary case `m = f` at the next fuel, so it does not repair this either. The transport field is inherently same-fuel and contravariant; the `GoodEventually` (all sufficiently large fuels) formulation is the workable one, with the fuel shifts already verified above.
2. **`tds_mutind` P0 cannot be maintained across `subtyp_all` with an HInv-dependent `Good`.** `subtyp_all` judges its body in `G & x ~ S2`, but the induction only carries `HInv γ G`; `HInv γ (G & x ~ S2)` needs `x # G` (obtainable by choosing x fresh from `L ∪ dom G`) and `inert_typ S2` (not available — S2 is an arbitrary subtyping type). So the P0 hypothesis cannot be re-instantiated in the extended context. This is a context-parametricity issue, not a fuel issue: a correct `Good`/`Psub` for the full subtyping relation must be HInv-free/context-parametric (a semantic logical relation), or one needs an additional theorem that the arrow body only depends on syntactic components of the original types. The same applies to the arrow-opening bridge, whose derivation can use `subtyp_all`.

```coq
  f <= m -> g_typ_size T <= f -> GoodShape T ->
  GoodF f γ C p T -> GoodF m γ C p T.

  GoodEventually γ C p T ->
  exists n, forall m, n <= m -> GoodF m γ C p T.
```

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_repl agent_good.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel algebra for [GoodEventually].  Combination uses [max] / [S]
   because [GoodEventually] provides the predicate at *all* sufficiently
   large fuels (agent_good proves this directly by type-size induction,
   so no single-step monotonicity lemma is needed).                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma goodEventually_and : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodEventually γ G p T -> GoodEventually γ G p U ->
  GoodEventually γ G p (T ∧ U).
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [n1 H1] [n2 H2].
  exists (Datatypes.S (Nat.max n1 n2)). intros m Hm.
  destruct m as [|f]; [lia|]. simpl. split.
  - apply H1. lia.
  - apply H2. lia.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_rcd_intro : forall γ G p a S,
  GoodEventually γ G (p • a) S ->
  GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}).
Proof.
  intros γ G p a S [n H]. exists (Datatypes.S n). intros m Hm.
  destruct m as [|f]; [lia|]. simpl. apply H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_new_elim : forall γ G p a S,
  GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
  GoodEventually γ G (p • a) S.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a S [n H]. exists n. intros m Hm.
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S m) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_mu_intro : forall γ G p T0,
  GoodEventually γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
  GoodEventually γ G p (μ T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G p T0 [n H]. exists (Datatypes.S n). intros m Hm.
  destruct m as [|f]; [lia|]. simpl. apply H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_mu_elim : forall γ G p T0,
  GoodEventually γ G p (μ T0) ->
  GoodEventually γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G p T0 [n H]. exists n. intros m Hm.
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S m) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

(* Type-member record: the stored transport (GoodF dec_typ field) can be
   consumed once its two arguments are available at common fuel. *)
Lemma goodEventually_dec_typ_elim : forall γ G p A L U,
  GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}) ->
  GoodEventually γ G p L ->
  GoodEventually γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A L U [n1 H1] [n2 H2].
  exists (Datatypes.S (Nat.max n1 n2)). intros m Hm.
  pose proof (H1 (Datatypes.S m) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf.
  apply Hf. apply H2. lia.
Qed.

(* Projections of the positive components. *)
Lemma goodEventually_arrow_bridge : forall γ G p S T,
  GoodEventually γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros γ G p S T [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_sngl_precise3 : forall γ G p q,
  GoodEventually γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_top : forall γ G p, GoodEventually γ G p ⊤.
Proof.
  intros. exists 0. intros m _. destruct m; simpl; trivial.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_bot_absurd : forall γ G p,
  GoodEventually γ G p ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G p [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

(* Prec2 component is only stored at arrow targets; at an arrow it is
   available from the same [Bridge /\ Prec2] payload. *)
Lemma goodEventually_arrow_prec2 : forall γ G p S T,
  GoodEventually γ G p (∀(S) T) -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p S T [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf. tauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Arrow-target transport is immediate from [Bridge]: the witness below
   the source arrow is kept and composed with the actual subtyping.  No
   HInv, no inspection of the subtyping derivation, and hence no problem
   with the extended context of [subtyp_all].  This closes the arrow-source
   instances of P0 for refl/trans/sngl_pq/sngl_qp/all uniformly. *)

Lemma bridge_psub_arrow : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hb Hsub _. eapply bridge_sub; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_arrow_psub : forall γ G p T U,
  is_arrow T -> GoodEventually γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U ->
  GoodEventually γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U HarT Hg Hsub HarU.
  destruct HarT as [S0 [T0 ET]]. destruct HarU as [S1 [U1 EU]].
  rewrite ET in Hg. rewrite ET in Hsub. rewrite EU in Hsub. rewrite EU.
  pose proof (@goodEventually_arrow_bridge γ G p S0 T0 Hg) as Hb.
  pose proof (@goodEventually_arrow_prec2 γ G p S0 T0 Hg) as Hp.
  exists 1. intros m Hm. destruct m as [|f]; [lia|].
  simpl. split.
  - eapply bridge_sub; [exact Hb | exact Hsub].
  - exact Hp.
Qed.
===REPL
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual: the non-singleton replacement components.
   The singleton component above is unconditional under HInv.  What is
   still needed for [good_repl] is the corresponding transport for:
   - arrows (repl rall1/rall2), which needs alias-respecting arrow
     opening;
   - type-member records / selections (repl rrcd/rdtyp/rpath), which
     needs the type-member coherence: two record views of aliased paths
     must have compatible tight bounds;
   - recursive/and/term-field types, which reduce recursively.
   These are recorded exactly as residual interface definitions. *)

Definition alias_arrow_repl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> alias γ p q ->
    forall S1 T1 S2 T2,
      repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
      forall r,
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S1) T1) ->
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S2) T2).

Definition alias_typ_member_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Type-member coherence: reduce it to a common tight bound.           *)

Lemma typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  forall G S1 T1 S2 T2 (W:typ),
    (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) ->
    (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2) ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).
Proof. intros. exists W. tauto. Qed.

(* The remaining coherence content: two record views of the same path at a
   type member [A] are both bounded by a single tight bound [W].  This is
   the store/precise-flow fact that [wf] is meant to supply; with it, the
   coherence residual above is discharged unconditionally (next lemma). *)
Definition typ_member_common_bound : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists W,
      (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) /\
      (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2).

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  typ_member_common_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.

7	(* Mutual structural recursion over the proof trees of [ty_trm] and
8	   [subtyp], returning Prop.  This validates the combined
9	   typing+subtyping well-foundedness: subtyping rules that store a typing
10	   premise (sel1/sel2/sngl_pq/sngl_qp) recursively enter that typing proof,
11	   and the typing rule [ty_sub] recursively enters its subtyping proof.
12	   Recursion is purely structural on the proof arguments (the guard checker
13	   accepts both directions).  The body here is [True]; it is the skeleton
14	   into which the [Good] invariant is to be plugged. *)
15	
16	Fixpoint prove_ty_true (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H : G ⊢ t : T) {struct H} : True :=
17	  match H with
18	  | ty_var b => I
19	  | ty_all_intro t U body => I
20	  | ty_all_elim d1 d2 =>
21	      let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
22	  | ty_new_intro T ds body => I
23	  | ty_new_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
24	  | ty_rcd_intro p a d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
25	  | ty_let u d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in I
26	  | ty_sngl d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
27	  | ty_path_elim a d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
28	  | ty_rec_intro T d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
29	  | ty_rec_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
30	  | ty_and_intro d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
31	  | ty_sub d s => let _ := prove_ty_true d in let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
32	  end
33	with prove_sub_true (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H : G ⊢ S <: U) {struct H} : True :=
34	  match H with
35	  | subtyp_top G0 T => I
36	  | subtyp_bot G0 T => I
37	  | subtyp_refl G0 T => I
38	  | subtyp_trans s1 s2 =>

56	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
57	(* Fuel-indexed structural invariant skeleton.
58	
59	   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field
60	   [forall q, Good q L -> Good q U] is rejected by Coq: the occurrence of
61	   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
62	   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
63	   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
64	   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant
65	   design is expressible.  This is the implementable shape. *)
66	
67	Require Import agent_bridge1.
68	
69	Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
70	  match fuel with
71	  | O => True
72	  | Datatypes.S f =>
73	    match T with
74	    | typ_top => True
75	    | typ_bot => False
76	    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
77	        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
78	    | typ_bnd T0 =>
79	        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
80	    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
81	        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
82	    | typ_rcd D =>
83	        match D with
84	        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
85	        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
86	        end
87	    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}
88	    | typ_path p0 A =>
89	        (forall (S0 T0:typ),
90	            C ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} ->
91	            GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)
92	    end
93	  end.
94

96	(* The existential-fuel wrapper proposed for [tds_mutind]. *)
97

99	  exists n, forall m, n <= m -> GoodF m γ C p T.

105	   the natural monotonicity [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] is NOT derivable from
106	   the definition above.  Concretely, instantiating T with a term record

111	   [dec_typ] transport field additionally reverses the fuel direction
112	   (transport at fuel f is used to produce facts at fuel <= f), so neither
113	   [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] nor [GoodF (S f) -> GoodF f] holds uniformly.
114	   Hence the [exists n, forall m >= n] formulation cannot be combined by
115	   [max] without a redesigned GoodF (e.g. transport bounded by fuel, which is
116	   not structurally recursive, or an impredicative/coinductive encoding).
117	   A sound alternative is a single global fuel fixed before the induction
118	   (a syntactic bound on the initial goal/derivation), so that every GoodF
119	   fact in the induction is at the same fuel and no monotonicity is needed. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* And-projections and equal-bound type-member construction, using the
   bounded monotonicity now available from agent_good.                  *)

Lemma goodEventually_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodShape T -> GoodEventually γ G p (T ∧ U) -> GoodEventually γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hsh [n H].
  exists (Datatypes.S (Nat.max n (g_typ_size T))). intros m Hm.
  destruct m as [|f]; [lia|]. simpl.
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S f) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [H1 _].
  eapply goodF_mono_bounded; [|exact Hsh|exact H1]. lia.
Qed.

Lemma goodEventually_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodShape U -> GoodEventually γ G p (T ∧ U) -> GoodEventually γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hsh [n H].
  exists (Datatypes.S (Nat.max n (g_typ_size U))). intros m Hm.
  destruct m as [|f]; [lia|]. simpl.
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S f) ltac:(lia)) as Hf. simpl in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [_ H2].
  eapply goodF_mono_bounded; [|exact Hsh|exact H2]. lia.
Qed.

(* record_dec type members have equal bounds; the stored transport is then
   the identity, so Good is immediate. *)
Lemma goodEventually_dec_typ_intro_eq : forall γ G p A T,
  GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: T <: T}).
Proof.
  intros. exists 1. intros m Hm. destruct m as [|f]; [lia|].
  simpl. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining type-member Psub construction (subtyp_typ): transporting a
   type-member record along the two bound subtypings.  This is the exact
   isolated gap: GoodEventually-level IHs for L2<:L1 and U1<:U2 are not
   pointwise at an arbitrary common fuel, so the same-fuel stored transport
   cannot be rebuilt from them (and unrestricted monotonicity fails for
   typ_path/unequal dec_typ).  A pointwise, size-bounded Psub
   [forall N m, size S<=N -> size U<=N -> N<=m -> GoodF m S -> GoodF m U]
   would close it: fld/typ use m-1, and the size bound of the record gives
   size(bounds) <= m-1; trans composes at the same m. *)
Definition gev_typ_psub : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A L1 U1 L2 U2,
    G ⊢ L2 <: L1 -> G ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L1 <: U1}) ->
    GoodEventually γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L2 <: U2}).
EOF

(*    semantic residual.                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
