Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Coinductive upward-closed Good. *)
CoInductive GoodC (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
| goodC_intro :
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodC γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> GoodC γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> GoodC γ G p T1 /\ GoodC γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> GoodC γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    (forall S0 U0, T = ∀(S0) U0 ->
       Bridge γ G p T /\ (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U)) ->
    GoodC γ G p T.

(* Eliminations. *)
Lemma GoodC_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodC γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodC γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U H Hsub.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (Hup U Hsub).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_field : forall γ G p a S,
  GoodC γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) -> GoodC γ G (p • a) S.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a S H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (Hfld a S eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodC γ G p (T ∧ U) -> GoodC γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (proj1 (Hand T U eq_refl)).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  GoodC γ G p (T ∧ U) -> GoodC γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (proj2 (Hand T U eq_refl)).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_bnd_open : forall γ G p T0,
  GoodC γ G p (μ T0) -> GoodC γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G p T0 H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_sngl_payload : forall γ G p q,
  GoodC γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (Hsngl q eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_arrow_payload : forall γ G p S0 U0,
  GoodC γ G p (∀(S0) U0) ->
  Bridge γ G p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U).
Proof.
  intros γ G p S0 U0 H.
  destruct H as [Hup Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsngl Hall].
  exact (Hall S0 U0 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Payoff: the four subtyping bridges and Psub are immediate for GoodC. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodC_psub : forall γ G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> forall p, GoodC γ G p S -> GoodC γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G S U Hsub p H. exact (GoodC_sub H Hsub). Qed.

Lemma GoodC_sel2 : forall γ G (p0:path) A S T p,
  G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} ->
  GoodC γ G p S -> GoodC γ G p (p0 ↓ A).
Proof.
  intros. eapply GoodC_sub.
  - exact H0.
  - apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := S) (T := T). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_sel1 : forall γ G (p0:path) A S T p,
  G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} ->
  GoodC γ G p (p0 ↓ A) -> GoodC γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply GoodC_sub.
  - exact H0.
  - apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := S) (T := T). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_sngl_pq : forall γ G (p0 q0:path) T T' U p,
  G ⊢ trm_path p0 : {{ q0 }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q0 : U ->
  repl_typ p0 q0 T T' ->
  GoodC γ G p T -> GoodC γ G p T'.
Proof.
  intros. eapply GoodC_sub.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma GoodC_sngl_qp : forall γ G (p0 q0:path) T T' U p,
  G ⊢ trm_path p0 : {{ q0 }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q0 : U ->
  repl_typ q0 p0 T T' ->
  GoodC γ G p T -> GoodC γ G p T'.
Proof.
  intros. eapply GoodC_sub.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
Qed.

(* The fuel/selection asymmetry of GoodF2 is gone: GoodC_sub is the
   upward-closure field itself.  Soundness in the arrow case is retained
   by GoodC_arrow_payload (Bridge + Prec2 are required). *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Feasibility findings (tested separately in coind_probe).
   1. POSITIVITY: the proposed CoInductive is accepted, but [T] must be
   a *parameter*, not an index, for dependent elimination to refine
   the type (an index leaves a spurious T0 and eq_refl does not
   unify).  With T as a parameter, GoodC_sub/field/and/μ/singleton/
   arrow projections all compile.
   2. COFIX CONSTRUCTION: direct recursive calls in function fields
   are accepted (CoFixpoint f := inf_intro (fun _ => f)), and
   recursive calls in match branches on an inductive argument are
   accepted.  But a recursive cofix value may not be passed to a
   structural Fixpoint/Fixpoint-like function: Coq reports
   "Sub-expression ... not in guarded form".  The upward-closure
   field at [trans] needs exactly `GoodC_sub` applied to the
   intermediate GoodC value, i.e. passing/destructing the
   corecursive value, so a direct CoFixpoint construction of
   GoodC for arrow/record/μ is rejected by the guard condition.
   3. POSITIVITY OF TYPE-MEMBER TRANSPORT: the proposed field set
   omits the type-member transport.  Adding the needed field
   [forall A L U, T = rcd{A>:L<:U} -> GoodC L -> GoodC U] puts
   GoodC in a negative position (domain), which CoInductive rejects.
   Consequently GoodC cannot imply GoodF2's dec_typ payload, and
   the coinductive greatest fixed point loses the type-member
   structure.
   4. BOT SOUNDNESS: GoodC ⊥ is not trivially inhabited (the upward

## What works

The proposed `CoInductive` is accepted **if `T` is a parameter, not an index**:

```coq
CoInductive GoodC (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
| goodC_intro :
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodC γ G p U) ->                 (* upward closure *)
    (forall a S, T = rcd{a⦂S} -> GoodC γ G (p•a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1∧T2 -> GoodC γ G p T1 /\ GoodC γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μT0 -> GoodC γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{q}} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{q}}) ->
    (forall S0 U0, T = ∀(S0)U0 -> Bridge γ G p T /\ (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U)) ->
    GoodC γ G p T.
```

With `T` as an index, dependent elimination leaves a spurious `T0` and `eq_refl` does not unify; as a parameter, all eliminations compile:

```coq
GoodC_sub          : GoodC γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodC γ G p U.
GoodC_field        : GoodC γ G p (rcd{a⦂S}) -> GoodC γ G (p•a) S.
GoodC_and_l/_r     : GoodC γ G p (T∧U) -> GoodC γ G p T / U.
GoodC_bnd_open     : GoodC γ G p (μ T0) -> GoodC γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
GoodC_sngl_payload : GoodC γ G p {{q}} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{q}}.
GoodC_arrow_payload: GoodC γ G p (∀S0U0) ->
                     Bridge γ G p (∀S0U0) /\ (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U).
```

**The fuel/selection false-bridge problem disappears.** `GoodC_sub` is just the upward-closure field, and all four problem rules are immediate instances:

```coq
GoodC_psub, GoodC_sel1, GoodC_sel2, GoodC_sngl_pq, GoodC_sngl_qp
```

In particular the `sel1` counterexample that refuted the `GoodF2` bridge no longer applies: `GoodC` at a selection type carries its upward closure directly. Arrow/singleton non-triviality is retained by the `Bridge`/`precise3` fields.

## What does not work

**1. Cofix construction is blocked by the guard condition.** Tested separately:
- Direct recursive call in a function field is accepted: `CoFixpoint mk1 (n:nat) : Inf := inf_intro (fun m => mk1 m)`.
- Recursive calls in match branches on an inductive argument are accepted.
- Passing the recursive cofix value to a structural `Fixpoint` is rejected:
  `CoFixpoint mk6 : Inf := inf_intro (fun n => use n mk6)` with a non-trivial `Fixpoint use` gives *“Sub-expression `use n mk6` not in guarded form”*.
- Destructing the recursive cofix value inside a field is rejected: *“Invalid recursive call in the argument of `match`”*.

The upward-closure field at `trans` needs exactly `GoodC_sub` applied to the intermediate `GoodC` value, i.e. passing/destructing the corecursive value. Hence a direct `CoFixpoint` construction of `GoodC` for arrow/record/μ is rejected.

**2. Type-member transport is not positive.** The proposed positive `GoodC` omits the type-member transport. Adding the needed field
`forall A L U, T = rcd{A>:L<:U} -> GoodC L -> GoodC U`
puts `GoodC` in a negative position; Coq rejects it:
*“Non strictly positive occurrence of `Bad`”*. Consequently this `GoodC` cannot imply `GoodF2`'s `dec_typ` payload and does not relate to the construction side on type-member records.

**3. Bot soundness is not immediate.** `GoodC ⊥` would give `GoodC` at every type via the upward field, and the singleton field would demand precise3 at every singleton path; proving the contradiction needs the fresh-path precise3 impossibility, which was not formalized. Arrows are not made trivial (`GoodC_arrow_payload` still requires `Bridge` and `precise2`).

## Conclusion

- Coinductive `GoodC` is an excellent **Psub/selection interface**: it removes the fuel asymmetry and makes sel1/sel2/sngl unconditional.
- It is not directly a **construction invariant**: the direct cofix is rejected at `trans` by guardedness, and adding type-member transport breaks positivity.
- Feasible next step: a two-layer invariant — the positive coinductive upward-closure/selection layer of this file over an inductive/flow-provenance type-member layer, with type-member transport kept outside the coinductive type (or encoded as provenance data rather than a function field). A Church encoding does not avoid the type-member negativity unless the transport is replaced by such provenance.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) subst. apply sg_flow. apply (@pf_bind x T G H). exact b.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) subst. apply sg_new_elim. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) subst. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) subst. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) subst. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) subst. apply sg_rec_intro. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) subst. apply sg_rec_elim. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) subst. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) subst. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply IHHty. reflexivity.
    + apply s.
Qed.
EOF

---
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
    + assumption.
Qed.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
    + assumption.
Qed.

(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. exact HV.
Qed.

(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
Proof.
  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
Qed.

(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)

(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.

   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
   precision *soundness*:

     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)

   and its two companions R (exists U, C⊢!! p:U) and Rsing.

   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).

   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
   the unconditional implication available here is
   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_sgood.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition ArrowCl (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.

Lemma ArrowCl_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⨼ U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf V Hsub Har.
  exists U. split; [|split].
  - apply pt3. apply pt2. exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi Hf).
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc Htu V Huv Har.
  apply Hc; [eapply subtyp_trans; eauto | exact Har].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har.
  apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact Htv].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har.
  apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact Htv].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q T,
  ArrowCl γ G q T -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q T Hc Hp V Hsub Har.
  destruct (Hc V Hsub Har) as [U0 [Hp3 [Hfs Hs]]].
  exists U0. split; [|split].
  - eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp | exact Hp3].
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hs.
Qed.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.

(* Exact residual gaps for the SGood induction.  The flow/sub/and_l/and_r
   cases are discharged by the lemmas above; the remaining constructors need
   one of these projections / shape-closures. *)
Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
  (* sg_new_elim: field arrow closure *)
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (p • a) S) /\
  (* sg_rcd_intro: record-shaped target (supertype arrow is impossible) *)
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
  (* sg_rec_intro: μ-shaped target *)
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) -> ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
  (* sg_rec_elim: μ-open projection *)
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
  (* sg_and_intro: conjunction target *)
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
  (* sg_sngl: singleton target *)
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\
  (* singleton precision projection (for sg_sngl_trans) *)
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) /\
  (* sg_path_elim: field-singleton target *)
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }} ->
      ArrowCl γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}).

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps -> SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros [Gfld [Grcd [Gmu [Gopen [Gand [Gsngl [Gprec2 Gpath]]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_sub; [apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_new_elim *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gfld; eauto.
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Grcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gmu; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gopen; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_intro *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_and_l. apply IHHs.
  - (* sg_and_r *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_and_r. apply IHHs.
  - (* sg_sngl *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_sngl_alias.
    + apply IHHs2.
    + eapply Gprec2; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) intros V Hsub Har. eapply Gpath; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood :
  SGood_arrow_closure ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hcl γ G p S T Hi Hs.
  eapply Hcl; [exact Hi | exact Hs | apply subtyp_refl | exists S, T; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg. apply bridge1_of_SGood. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps. exact Hg.
Qed.

(* Combined with SGood_typing: bridge1 for ordinary arrow typings. *)
Lemma ordinary_arrow_bridge_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg γ G p S T Hi Hty.
  eapply bridge1_of_SGood_gaps; [exact Hg|exact Hi|].
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_sgood.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition ArrowCl (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.

Lemma ArrowCl_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf V Hsub Har.
  exists U. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p U). apply (@pt2 G p R U). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi Hf).
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc Htu V Huv Har.
  apply Hc; [eapply subtyp_trans; eauto | exact Har].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_self : forall γ G p T,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> is_arrow T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T Hc Har. eapply Hc; [apply subtyp_refl | exact Har]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har.
  apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact Htv].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har.
  apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact Htv].
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q T,
  ArrowCl γ G q T -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q T Hc Hp V Hsub Har.
  destruct (Hc V Hsub Har) as [U0 [Hp3 [Hfs Hs]]].
  exists U0. split; [|split].
  - eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp | exact Hp3].
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hs.
Qed.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.

(* Residual projections, each taken on the *premise* SGood of the
   corresponding constructor (never on the conclusion). *)
Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) /\
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}).

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts :
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) ->
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}) ->
  SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Gfld Grcd Gmu Gopen Gand Gsngl Gprec2 Gpath γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_flow; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_sub *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].

  - (* sg_new_elim *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gfld; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Grcd; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gmu; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gopen; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_and_intro *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gand; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_and_l *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_l; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_and_r *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_r; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_sngl *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gsngl; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [|exact Hsub].
    eapply ArrowCl_sngl_alias; [apply IHHs2|eapply Gprec2; eauto].
  - (* sg_path_elim *) intros V Hsub Har.
    eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply Gpath; eauto|exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps -> SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hg. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts.
  - exact (proj1 Hg).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 Hg)).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood :
  SGood_arrow_closure ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hcl γ G p S T Hi Hs.
  eapply ArrowCl_self; [eapply Hcl; [exact Hi | exact Hs] | exists S, T; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg. apply bridge1_of_SGood. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps. exact Hg.
Qed.

Lemma ordinary_arrow_bridge_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg γ G p S T Hi Hty.
  eapply bridge1_of_SGood_gaps; [exact Hg|exact Hi|].
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.

121	Definition Q_sub_cl : Prop :=
122	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q γ G p U.

124	Definition Q_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
125	  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G q T -> Q γ G p T.

128	  forall γ G p q a T,
129	    HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G (q • a) T -> Q γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

143	Definition SGood_Q_residuals : Prop :=
144	  Q_sub_cl /\ Q_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q_path_elim_cl /\
145	  Q_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q_rec_intro_cl /\ Q_and_intro_cl /\ Q_sngl_cl.

147	Lemma SGood_Q_of_residuals :
148	  SGood_Q_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
149	Proof.
150	  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
151	  induction Hs.
152	  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q_of_flow; eauto.
153	  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
154	  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.

156	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
157	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
158	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0' Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
159	    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
160	  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
161	  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
162	    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
163	  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
164	    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
165	  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
166	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
167	  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.

177	  inversion HQ as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.

4	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
6	Close Scope string_scope.
7	
8	(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
9	   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
10	   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
11	   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
12	   induction. *)
13	Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
14	| sg_flow p R U :
15	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
16	    SGood γ G p U
17	| sg_sub p T U :
18	    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
19	    SGood γ G p U
20	| sg_new_elim p a T :
21	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
22	    SGood γ G (p • a) T
23	| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
24	    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
25	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
26	| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
27	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
28	    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
29	| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
30	    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
31	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
32	| sg_and_intro p T U :
33	    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
34	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
35	| sg_and_l p T U :
36	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
37	| sg_and_r p T U :
38	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
39	| sg_sngl p q :
40	    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
41	    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
42	| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
43	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
44	    SGood γ G p T
45	| sg_path_elim p q a T :
46	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
47	    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
48	
49	Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
50	  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
51	Proof.
52	  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
53	  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
54	  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
55	  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
56	  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
57	  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
58	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
59	  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
60	  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
61	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
62	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
63	  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
64	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
65	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
66	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
67	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
68	  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
69	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
70	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
71	  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
72	    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
73	    + assumption.
74	Qed.

41	Proof.
42	  intros γ G p q T Hc Hp V Hsub Har.
43	  destruct (Hc V Hsub Har) as [U0 [Hp3 [Hfs Hs]]].
44	  exists U0. split; [|split].
45	  - eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp | exact Hp3].
46	  - exact Hfs.
47	  - exact Hs.
48	Qed.
49	
50	Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
51	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
52	
53	Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
54	  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
55	      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) /\
56	  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
57	      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
58	  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
59	      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
60	  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
61	      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
62	  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
63	      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
64	  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\
65	  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) /\
66	  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
67	      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
68	      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}).
69	
70	Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts :
71	  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
72	      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) ->
73	  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
74	      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) ->
75	  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
76	      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) ->
77	  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
78	      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
79	  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
80	      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) ->
81	  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) ->
82	  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
83	  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
84	      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
85	      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}) ->
86	  SGood_arrow_closure.
87	Proof.
88	  intros Gfld Grcd Gmu Gopen Gand Gsngl Gprec2 Gpath γ G p T Hi Hs.
89	  induction Hs.
90	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
91	    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_flow; eauto|exact Hsub].
92	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
93	    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_sub; [apply IHHs|exact H]|exact Hsub].
94	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
95	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gfld γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
96	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
97	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Grcd γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
98	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
99	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gmu γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
100	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
101	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
102	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
103	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gand γ G p T U Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
104	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
105	    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_l; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
106	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
107	    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_r; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
108	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
109	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gsngl γ G p q Hi H) Hsub).
110	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
111	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Gprec2 γ G p q Hi Hs1)) Hsub).
112	  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
113	    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gpath γ G p q a T Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
114	Qed.
115	
116	Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps :
117	  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps -> SGood_arrow_closure.
118	Proof.
119	  intros Hg. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts.
120	  - exact (proj1 Hg).
121	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 Hg)).
122	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))).
123	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))).
124	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))).
125	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))))).
126	  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
127	  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
128	Qed.
129	
130	Lemma bridge1_of_SGood :
131	  SGood_arrow_closure ->
132	  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
133	Proof.
134	  intros Hcl γ G p S T Hi Hs.
135	  eapply ArrowCl_self; [eapply Hcl; [exact Hi | exact Hs] | exists S, T; reflexivity].
136	Qed.
137	
138	Lemma bridge1_of_SGood_gaps :
139	  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
140	  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
141	Proof. intros Hg. apply bridge1_of_SGood. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps. exact Hg. Qed.
142	
143	Lemma ordinary_arrow_bridge_of_gaps :
144	  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
145	  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
146	Proof.
147	  intros Hg γ G p S T Hi Hty.
148	  eapply bridge1_of_SGood_gaps; [exact Hg|exact Hi|].
149	  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
150	Qed.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.

5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed agent_bridge1 agent_repl agent_good.

8	Ltac solve_union_sub :=
9	  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
10	        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
11	        | apply in_singleton_self'
12	        | assumption ].
13	
14	(* ================================================================== *)
15	(* A. Replacement is symmetric.                                        *)
16	(*                                                                     *)
17	(* The domain position of an arrow is contravariant.  When an arrow is *)
18	(* moved across a singleton/replacement rule we therefore have to      *)
19	(* replace in the *opposite* direction.  The replacement relation is   *)
20	(* structurally symmetric.                                             *)
21	(* ================================================================== *)
22	
23	Lemma repl_typ_sym :
24	  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
25	  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
26	Proof.
27	  apply repl_mutind.
28	  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
29	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
30	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
31	  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
32	  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
33	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
34	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
35	  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
36	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
37	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
38	  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
39	Qed.
40	
41	Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
42	  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
43	Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.
44	
45	Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
46	  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
47	Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.
48	
49	(* ================================================================== *)
50	(* B. Replacement commutes with opening of a bound type variable.      *)
51	(*                                                                     *)
52	(* This is the analogue of [repl_typ_subst] for de Bruijn opening.    *)
53	(* Needed when the body of an arrow is moved under a fresh binder.     *)
54	(* ================================================================== *)
55	
56	Lemma open_rec_path_sel_fields : forall k x (p:path) bs,
57	  open_rec_path k x (p •• bs) = (open_rec_path k x p) •• bs.
58	Proof.
59	  intros k x [a fs] bs. simpl. unfold sel_fields. reflexivity.
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma open_rec_path_named : forall k x (p:path),
63	  named_path p -> open_rec_path k x p = p.
64	Proof.
65	  intros k x [a fs] [y [cs E]]. inversion E. subst. reflexivity.
66	Qed.
67	
68	(* Replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening, provided the replacement
69	   paths are named (so they are unaffected by opening). *)
70	Lemma repl_typ_open :
71	  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' ->
72	     named_path p -> named_path q ->
73	     forall k x, repl_typ p q (open_rec_typ k x T) (open_rec_typ k x T')) /\
74	  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' ->
75	     named_path p -> named_path q ->
76	     forall k x, repl_dec p q (open_rec_dec k x D) (open_rec_dec k x D')).
77	Proof.
78	  apply repl_mutind.
79	  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rrcd. apply (IH Hp Hq).
80	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
81	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
82	  - intros p q bs A Hp Hq k x. simpl.
83	    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
84	    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
85	    apply rpath.
86	  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hp Hq k x.
87	    change (repl_typ p q (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1)) (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
88	    apply rbnd. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
89	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
90	    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x T1) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))
91	                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x T2) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))).
92	    apply rall1. exact (IH Hp Hq k x).
93	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
94	    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1))
95	                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
96	    apply rall2. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
97	  - intros p q bs Hp Hq k x. simpl.
98	    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
99	    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
100	    apply rsngl.
101	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
102	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
103	  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtrm. apply (IH Hp Hq).
104	Qed.
105	
106	(* ================================================================== *)
107	(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
108	(*                                                                     *)
109	(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
110	(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
111	(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
112	(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
113	(* ================================================================== *)
114	
115	Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
116	| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
117	| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
118	| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
119	| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
120	| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
121	| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
122	    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
123	| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
124	    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
125	| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
126	    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
127	    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
128	| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
129	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
130	    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
131	    repl_typ p q T T' ->
132	    subtyp1 G T T'
133	| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
134	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
135	    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
136	    repl_typ q p T T' ->
137	    subtyp1 G T T'
138	| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
139	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
140	    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
141	| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
142	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
143	    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
144	| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
145	    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
146	    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
147	    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).
148	
149	Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
150	Proof.
151	  intros G S U H. induction H.
152	  - apply subtyp_top.
153	  - apply subtyp_bot.
154	  - apply subtyp_refl.
155	  - apply subtyp_and11.
156	  - apply subtyp_and12.
157	  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
158	  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
159	  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
160	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
161	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
162	  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
163	  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
164	  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
165	Qed.
166	
167	(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
168	Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
169	  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
170	  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
171	  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
172	Proof.
173	  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
174	  - left. split; auto.
175	  - right. split; auto.
176	Qed.
177	
178	(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
179	Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
180	  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
181	Proof.
182	  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
183	  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
184	  - (* sngl_pq *)
185	    match goal with
186	    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
187	      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
188	    end.
189	    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
190	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
191	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
192	      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
193	    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
194	  - (* sngl_qp *)
195	    match goal with
196	    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
197	      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
198	    end.
199	    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
200	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
201	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
202	      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
203	    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
204	  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
205	Qed.
206	
207	(* ================================================================== *)
208	(* D. Conditional application-preservation step.                       *)
209	(*                                                                     *)
210	(* The unrestricted bridge statements in agent_bridge.v are refutable  *)
211	(* in non-HInv contexts (counter_bridge2.v, and the same loose-record  *)
212	(* / type-member selection pattern refutes the unrestricted           *)
213	(* arrow_open_bridge).  The corrected HInv-aware interface lives in    *)
214	(* aux_bridge_fixed.v.  We expose the exact residual and the assembly. *)
215	(* ================================================================== *)
216	
217	(* Exact residuals.  The raw, context-free bridge statements are false
218	   (loose record bindings give incompatible type-member views; see
219	   counter_bridge2.v for the analogous refutation of bridge 2).  The
220	   HInv-aware variants below are the correct interfaces.
221	
222	   What is *proven* in this file, unconditionally:
223	
224	     - repl_typ_sym       : replacement is symmetric (needed because the
225	                            arrow domain is contravariant);
226	     - repl_typ_open      : replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening
227	                            when the replacement paths are named;
228	     - subtyp1_all_domain : arrow-domain inversion for the trans-free
229	                            subtyping relation [subtyp1].
230	
231	   What remains for the HInv-aware arrow-opening bridge is exactly the
232	   *coherence* of path typings at records in an inert context: a path
233	   [p] can be typed at two record views [rcd{A>:S1<:T1}] and
234	   [rcd{A>:S2<:T2}] of the same tight record, and one needs the tight
235	   bound [Q] with [S1 <: Q <: T2] (and its arrow structure) to compose
236	   the two type-selection steps.  This is the same metatheoretic content
237	   as the ordinary-path -> precise3 principal-typing bridge.  Without
238	   it, [subtyp1] is not closed under transitivity even in an inert
239	   context (the detour can pass through a type member whose tight bound
240	   is [⊤]), although such a detour cannot connect two *arrow* endpoints
241	   unless the tight bound is itself arrow-compatible. *)
242	Definition arrow_open_HInv_residual : Prop := arrow_open_HInv_bridge.
243	
244	Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_HInv_residual : Prop := rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.
245	
246	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
247	(* E.  The narrow field-precision residual.                            *)
248	(*                                                                     *)
249	(* [field_sub_closure] (agent_bridge1.v) asks: a path [p] typed at a   *)
250	(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
251	(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
252	(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
253	(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
254	(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
255	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
256	
257	Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
258	  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
259	Proof.
260	  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
261	  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
262	  exists V. exact HV.
263	Qed.
264	
265	(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
266	   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
267	   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
268	Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
269	  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
270	  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
271	  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
272	Proof.
273	  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
274	  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
275	  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
276	Qed.
277	
278	(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
279	   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
280	   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
281	   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)
282	
283	(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.
284	
285	   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
286	   precision *soundness*:
287	
288	     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)
289	
290	   and its two companions R (exists U, C⊢!! p:U) and Rsing.
291	
292	   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
293	     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
294	     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
295	     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
296	     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
297	   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
298	     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
299	     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
300	     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
301	     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
302	     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
303	   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
304	     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
305	     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
306	     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).
307	
308	   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
309	   the unconditional implication available here is
310	   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)
311	
312	(* Natural-field form (field type an arrow / μ-record / singleton).  The
313	   same reduction applies; no restriction on S is even needed. *)
314	Lemma field_sub_closure_natural_of_path_precise :
315	  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
316	  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
317	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
318	    flow_shape S -> exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
319	Proof.
320	  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT Hfs. subst T.
321	  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
322	  exists V. apply pt3. exact HV.
323	Qed.

325	(* NOTE on the R / Rsing / F decomposition (agent_bridge1.v).  The
326	   [ty_new_elim] case inherently needs *unrestricted* field precision:
327	   from [p0 : rcd{b ⦂ rcd{a ⦂ S}}] one must precisely type [p0 • b] at
328	   some [V], and then select [a] from [V].  The intermediate field type
329	   [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is a record, so a version of [F] restricted to natural
330	   field types cannot be applied at that step; and the relation between
331	   the precise field type [V] and the ordinary view [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is
332	   exactly the precision-soundness invariant (a flow output being a
333	   subtype of the ordinary typing).  Thus [field_sub_closure] and the
334	   bridge are equivalent in strength for the needs of this development;
335	   the clean unconditional implication is the one proven above. *)

354	(* F. Type-member coherence: the combinatorial core and its exact     *)
355	(*    semantic residual.                                              *)
356	(*                                                                     *)
357	(* A record type has distinct labels, so a type member [A] occurring   *)
358	(* in a [record_type] occurs exactly once.  Consequently two            *)
359	(* [record_has] facts for type members with the same label expose the   *)
360	(* *same* tight bound.  This is the uniqueness half of                    *)
361	(* [typ_member_common_bound]; the provenance half (every ordinary       *)
362	(* record view brackets the tight bound of the path's precise flow) is  *)
363	(* isolated in the interfaces below.                                    *)
364	(* ================================================================== *)
365	
366	Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec),
367	  record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
368	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.
369	
370	Lemma record_typ_has_label_in : forall (T:typ) ls (D:dec),
371	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of_dec D \in ls.
372	Proof.
373	  intros T ls D Hrt. revert D.
374	  induction Hrt; intros Dx Hhas.
375	  - (* rt_one *)
376	    inversion Hhas; subst; apply in_singleton_self'.
377	  - (* rt_cons *)
378	    inversion Hhas; subst.
379	    + (* from the left component *)
380	      apply in_union_l. eapply IHHrt; eauto.
381	    + (* from the right component *)
382	      apply in_union_r.
383	      match goal with
384	      | HR : record_has (typ_rcd ?DD) _ |- _ =>
385	        pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite E
386	      end.
387	      apply in_singleton_self'.
388	Qed.
389	
390	Lemma record_has_typ_unique : forall (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W1 W2,
391	  record_type U ->
392	  record_has U { A >: W1 <: W1 } ->
393	  record_has U { A >: W2 <: W2 } ->
394	  W1 = W2.
395	Proof.
396	  intros U A W1 W2 [ls Hrt]. revert A W1 W2.
397	  induction Hrt; intros A W1 W2 Hrec1 Hrec2.
398	  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hrec1; subst; inversion Hrec2; subst; reflexivity.
399	  - (* rt_cons *)
400	    destruct (classic (label_typ A = label_of_dec D)) as [El|En].
401	    + (* both occurrences are the right component *)
402	      assert (Hr1 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
403	      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
404	        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
405	          change (label_of_dec { A >: W1 <: W1 } \in ls).
406	          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
407	        - assumption. }
408	      assert (Hr2 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
409	      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
410	        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
411	          change (label_of_dec { A >: W2 <: W2 } \in ls).
412	          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
413	        - assumption. }
414	      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr1) as E1.
415	      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr2) as E2.
416	      rewrite <- E2 in E1. injection E1 as E. exact E.
417	    + (* both occurrences are the left component *)
418	      assert (Hl1 : record_has T { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
419	      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
420	        - assumption.
421	        - exfalso. apply En.
422	          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
423	            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
424	      assert (Hl2 : record_has T { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
425	      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
426	        - assumption.
427	        - exfalso. apply En.
428	          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
429	            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
430	      eapply IHHrt; eauto.
431	Qed.

435	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

437	(* (I1) Every record-typed path has a precise flow, flow-shaped output. *)
438	Definition path_flow_exists_HInv : Prop :=
439	  forall γ G p T,
440	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
441	    exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.
442	
443	(* (I2) Precision soundness: flow output subtyping every ordinary type. *)
444	Definition flow_sound_HInv : Prop :=
445	  forall γ G p R U T,
446	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> G ⊢ U <: T.
447	
448	(* (I3) Tight type-member extraction from a record view. *)
449	Definition flow_typ_member_inv : Prop :=
450	  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
451	    HInv γ G ->
452	    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
453	    exists W,
454	      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
455	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
456	
457	Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces :
458	  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
459	  flow_sound_HInv ->
460	  flow_typ_member_inv ->
461	  typ_member_common_bound.
462	Proof.
463	  intros HF HS HM γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
464	  destruct (HF γ G p0 (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) Hi H1) as [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
465	  assert (Hs1 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
466	  assert (Hs2 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
467	  destruct (HM γ G U A S1 T1 Hi Hfs Hs1) as [W1 [Hrt [Hhas1 [Hl1 Hu1]]]].
468	  destruct (HM γ G U A S2 T2 Hi Hfs Hs2) as [W2 [_ [Hhas2 [Hl2 Hu2]]]].
469	  assert (E : W1 = W2) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
470	  subst W2.
471	  exists W1. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
472	Qed.
473	
474	Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_interfaces :
475	  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
476	  flow_sound_HInv ->
477	  flow_typ_member_inv ->
478	  alias_typ_member_coherence.
479	Proof.
480	  intros HF HS HM.
481	  apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
482	  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces; assumption.
483	Qed.

486	(* The canonical-bound interface matching the structural Good payload.  *)
487	(*                                                                     *)
488	(* The Good invariant for a record type should carry, for each type     *)
489	(* member [A], a canonical tight bound [W] (from the actual record_dec  *)
490	(* / flow provenance: for an actual [dec_typ] W = L = U).  The payload  *)
491	(* must say that *every* record view [p0 : rcd{A>:S<:T}] of that path  *)
492	(* brackets the same [W].  Then the coherence residual is immediate.    *)
493	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
494	
495	Definition canonical_member_bound : Prop :=
496	  forall γ G (p0:path) (A:typ_label),
497	    HInv γ G ->
498	    exists W, forall S T,
499	      G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
500	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
501	
502	Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical :
503	  canonical_member_bound -> typ_member_common_bound.
504	Proof.
505	  intros HC γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
506	  destruct (HC γ G p0 A Hi) as [W HW].
507	  destruct (HW S1 T1 H1) as [Hl1 Hu1].
508	  destruct (HW S2 T2 H2) as [Hl2 Hu2].
509	  exists W. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
510	Qed.
511	
512	Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_canonical :
513	  canonical_member_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
514	Proof.
515	  intros HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
516	  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical. exact HC.
517	Qed.

523	(* non-transitive fragment the only rules producing a type-member      *)
524	(* record are refl, subtyp_typ, the two and-projections and the        *)
525	(* singleton replacements, and each case is explicit.  The remaining   *)
526	(* (full [subtyp]) difficulty is exactly transitivity elimination for  *)

530	Lemma repl_typ_rcd_targets : forall p q (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,

532	  exists D, U = typ_rcd D /\ repl_dec p q D {A >: S <: T}.

540	  (exists S0, D = {A >: S0 <: T} /\ repl_typ p q S0 S) \/
541	  (exists T0, D = {A >: S <: T0} /\ repl_typ p q T0 T).
542	Proof.
543	  intros p q D A S T H. dependent destruction H.
544	  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].

576	Lemma subtyp1_typ_member_inv : forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
577	  flow_shape U ->
578	  subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) ->
579	  exists W,
580	    record_type U /\ record_has U {A >: W <: W} /\
581	    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
582	Proof.
583	  intros G U A S T Hfs Hsub.
584	  remember (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) as R eqn:ER.
585	  revert A S T Hfs ER.
586	  induction Hsub; intros A0 S0 T0 Hfs ER.
587	  - (* subtyp1_top *) discriminate ER.
588	  - (* subtyp1_bot *) exfalso. exact (flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
589	  - (* subtyp1_refl *)
590	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
591	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
592	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt) as Hdec.
593	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
594	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
595	    + apply rh_one.
596	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
597	  - (* subtyp1_and11 *)
598	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
599	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
600	    pose proof (@record_type_and_l (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) U Hrt) as Hrt1.
601	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt1) as Hdec.
602	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
603	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
604	    + apply rh_andl. apply rh_one.
605	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
606	  - (* subtyp1_and12 *)
607	    subst U. dependent destruction Hfs.
608	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
609	    pose proof (@record_type_and_r T (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) Hrt) as Hrt2.
610	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt2) as Hdec.
611	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
612	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
613	    + apply rh_andr. apply rh_one.
614	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
615	  - (* subtyp1_and2 *) discriminate ER.
616	  - (* subtyp1_fld *) discriminate ER.
617	  - (* subtyp1_typ *)
618	    injection ER as EA ES ET. subst A0. subst S0. subst T0.
619	    dependent destruction Hfs.
620	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
621	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} Hrt) as Hdec.
622	    assert (E : S1 = T1) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
623	    subst T1. exists S1. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
624	    + apply rh_one.
625	    + split.
626	      * eapply subtyp1_subtyp; eassumption.
627	      * eapply subtyp1_subtyp; eassumption.
628	  - (* subtyp1_sngl_pq *)
629	    subst T'.
630	    destruct (@repl_typ_rcd_targets p q T _ _ _ H1) as [D [ET Hdec]].
631	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
632	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
633	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd D Hrt) as Hrd.
634	    destruct (@repl_dec_typ_targets p q D _ _ _ Hdec) as [[Sx [ED Hrepl]] | [Tx [ED Hrepl]]].
635	    + subst D.
636	      assert (E : Sx = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
637	      subst T0. exists Sx. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
638	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}) {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}). apply rh_one.
639	      * split.
640	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
641	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
642	               eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | apply repl_typ_sym_t; exact Hrepl] end end.
643	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
644	    + subst D.
645	      assert (E : S0 = Tx) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
646	      subst Tx. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
647	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: S0}) {A0 >: S0 <: S0}). apply rh_one.
648	      * split.
649	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
650	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
651	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
652	               eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | exact Hrepl] end end.
653	  - (* subtyp1_sngl_qp *)
654	    subst T'.
655	    destruct (@repl_typ_rcd_targets q p T _ _ _ H1) as [D [ET Hdec]].
656	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
657	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
658	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd D Hrt) as Hrd.
659	    destruct (@repl_dec_typ_targets q p D _ _ _ Hdec) as [[Sx [ED Hrepl]] | [Tx [ED Hrepl]]].
660	    + subst D.
661	      assert (E : Sx = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
662	      subst T0. exists Sx. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
663	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}) {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}). apply rh_one.
664	      * split.
665	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
666	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
667	               eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | apply repl_typ_sym_t; exact Hrepl] end end.
668	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
669	    + subst D.
670	      assert (E : S0 = Tx) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
671	      subst Tx. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
672	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: S0}) {A0 >: S0 <: S0}). apply rh_one.
673	      * split.
674	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
675	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
676	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
677	               eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | exact Hrepl] end end.
678	  - (* subtyp1_sel2 *) discriminate ER.
679	  - (* subtyp1_sel1 *) exfalso. exact (flow_shape_path_absurd Hfs).
680	  - (* subtyp1_all *) discriminate ER.
681	Qed.

684	(* H. Final reduction of [canonical_member_bound].                     *)
685	(*                                                                     *)
686	(* Only one semantic fact is needed: record-target soundness for a     *)
687	(* precise flow.  Given a flow [p : R ⪼ U] and an ordinary record       *)
688	(* typing [p : rcd{A>:S<:T}], the flow output [U] is the actual tight   *)
689	(* record, and its type member [A] has bound [W] bracketed by [S,T].    *)
690	(* This is the runtime/provenance step (lookup of the actual object and *)
691	(* its [record_dec]); the combinatorial uniqueness is already proven.   *)
692	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
693	
694	Definition flow_record_member_sound : Prop :=
695	  forall γ G p R (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
696	    HInv γ G ->
697	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
698	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
699	    exists W,
700	      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
701	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
702	
703	Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_flow_record_member :
704	  path_flow_exists_HInv -> flow_record_member_sound -> canonical_member_bound.
705	Proof.
706	  intros HF HFS γ G p0 A Hi.
707	  destruct (classic (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }))
708	    as [[S [T Hty]] | Hnone].
709	  - destruct (HF γ G p0 (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) Hi Hty) as [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
710	    destruct (HFS γ G p0 R U A S T Hi Hf Hty) as [W [Hrt [Hhas [Hl Hu]]]].
711	    exists W. intros S' T' Hty'.
712	    destruct (HFS γ G p0 R U A S' T' Hi Hf Hty') as [W' [_ [Hhas' [Hl' Hu']]]].
713	    assert (E : W' = W) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
714	    subst W'. split; assumption.

934	(* ================================================================== *)
935	(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
936	(*                                                                     *)
937	(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
938	(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
939	(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
940	(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
941	(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
942	(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
943	(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
944	(* ================================================================== *)
945	
946	Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
947	| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
948	| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
949	| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
950	| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
951	| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
952	| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
953	    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
954	| st_fld : forall G T U a,
955	    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
956	| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
957	    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
958	    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
959	| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
960	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
961	    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
962	| st_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
963	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
964	    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
965	| st_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
966	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G S (p ↓ A)
967	| st_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
968	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G (p ↓ A) T
969	| st_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
970	    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
971	    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
972	    subtyp_step G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).
973	
974	Lemma subtyp_step_subtyp : forall G S U,
975	  subtyp_step G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
976	Proof.
977	  intros G S U H. induction H.
978	  - apply subtyp_top.
979	  - apply subtyp_bot.
980	  - apply subtyp_refl.
981	  - apply subtyp_and11.
982	  - apply subtyp_and12.
983	  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
984	  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
985	  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
986	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
987	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
988	  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
989	  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
990	  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
991	Qed.
