993	Lemma star_trans_gen : forall (A:Type) (R:A -> A -> Prop) (a b c:A),
994	  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
995	Proof.
996	  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
997	  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
998	  - exact H2.
999	  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
1000	Qed.
1001	
1002	Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
1003	  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
1004	Proof.
1005	  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
1006	  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
1007	  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
1008	  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
1009	  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
1010	  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
1011	  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
1012	  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1013	  - (* fld *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_fld; exact H | apply star_refl].
1014	  - (* typ *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_typ; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1015	  - (* sngl_pq *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_pq; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
1016	  - (* sngl_qp *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_qp; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
1017	  - (* sel2 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel2; exact H | apply star_refl].
1018	  - (* sel1 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel1; exact H | apply star_refl].
1019	  - (* all *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_all; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1020	Qed.

1022	(* [ty_sub] composition for the full classification: once [U] reaches the
1023	   premise target [R0] by a star, composing with the (star-decomposed)
1024	   rule subtyping [R0 <: R] keeps the star.  This is the branch that was
1025	   previously blocked by the missing transitivity of [subtyp1]. *)
1026	Lemma star_subtyp_step_psub : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
1027	  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 ->
1028	  G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
1029	  star (subtyp_step G) U R.
1030	Proof.
1031	  intros G U R0 R Hstar Hsub.
1032	  eapply star_trans_gen; [exact Hstar | apply subtyp_star_step; exact Hsub].

1046	(* Alert addressed: a single [subtyp1] from a whole intersection       *)

1048	(* classification we therefore select the actual *component*           *)
1049	(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}] and require single-step [subtyp1] from that          *)

1055	Inductive PathObject (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=

1062	    γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ ->

1066	    PathObject γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
1067	    γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defv (ν(Tv) dsv) ⟧ ->
1068	    PathObject γ G (p • a) (open_typ_p (p • a) Tv).

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Definitions Binding RecordAndInertTypes.

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!v' v ':' T" (at level 40, v at level 59).

Inductive ty_val_p : ctx -> val -> typ -> Prop :=





| ty_all_intro_p : forall L G T t U,
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x t : open_typ x U) ->
    G ⊢!v λ(T) t : ∀(T) U





| ty_new_intro_p
     : forall (L : fset var) (G : env typ) (T : typ) (ds : defs),
       (forall x : var, x \notin L -> x; nil; G & x ~ open_typ x T ⊢ open_defs x ds :: open_typ x T) ->
       G ⊢!v ν(T)ds : μ T

where "G '⊢!v' v ':' T" := (ty_val_p G v T).

Reserved Notation "G '⊢!' p ':' T '⪼' U" (at level 40, p at level 59).

Inductive precise_flow : ctx -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=





| pf_bind : forall x G T,
      ok G ->
      binds x T G ->
      G ⊢! pvar x: T ⪼ T




  | pf_fld : forall G p a T U,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ U} ->
      G ⊢! p•a : U ⪼ U




  | pf_open : forall p G T U,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ μ U ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ open_typ_p p U




  | pf_and1 : forall p G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1 ∧ U2 ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1




  | pf_and2 : forall p G T U1 U2,
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U1 ∧ U2 ->
      G ⊢! p: T ⪼ U2

where "G '⊢!' p ':' T '⪼' U" := (precise_flow G p T U).

| pt2_sngl_trans : forall G p q a U,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! q•a : U ->
    G ⊢!! p•a : {{ q•a }}
where "G '⊢!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing2 G p T).

Inductive precise_typing3: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt3: forall G p T,
    G ⊢!! p : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p: T
| pt3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p : T
where "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing3 G p T).

Inductive wf : ctx -> Prop :=
| wfe_empty :
    wf empty
| wfe_push G x T :
    wf G ->
    x # G ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ T ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }}->
             exists U, G & x ~ T ⊢!! q : U) ->
    wf (G & x ~ T).

Definition typed_repl_comp_qp G T1 T2 :=
  exists p q U,
    G ⊢! p: {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} /\
    G ⊢!! q : U /\
    repl_typ q p T1 T2.

Definition repl_composition_qp G := star (typed_repl_comp_qp G).

Notation "G '⊢' T '⟿' U" := (repl_composition_qp G U T) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Notation "G '⊢' p '⟿'' q" := (G ⊢ {{ p }}⟿ {{ q }}) (at level 40, p at level 59).

Notation "G '⊩' T '⟿' U '⬳' V" := (G ⊢ T ⟿ U /\ G ⊢ V ⟿ U) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Notation "G '⊩' p '⟿'' q '⬳' r" := (G ⊢ p ⟿' q /\ G ⊢ r ⟿' q) (at level 40, p at level 59).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma step_plain : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (t':trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Ht. destruct (@step γ G t T Hi Ht) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
  - left; exact Hnf.
  - right. exists γ', G', u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|exact Hty'].
Qed.

Theorem safety_test : forall t T,
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  infseq red (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, star red (empty, t) (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).
Proof.
  intros t T Ht.
  destruct (@terminate_or_diverge (fun γ G t0 T0 Hi Hty => step_plain Hi Hty) (empty:sta) (empty:ctx) t T HInv_empty Ht) as [Hinf | Hterm].
  - left; exact Hinf.
  - right. destruct Hterm as [γ [u [G [Hstar [Hnf [Hty Hi]]]]]].
    exists γ, u, G. split; [exact Hstar|]. split; [exact Hnf|]. split; [exact Hty|].
    destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf _]]]. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hwf|exact Hinert].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_repl agent_assembly agent_good2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The HInv-free version of the type-member extraction interface is    *)
(* FALSE (the loose-record detour).  agent_suball's current interface   *)
(* is HInv-aware, so the refutation does not apply to it; this note    *)
(* records why HInv/provenance is essential.                           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition flow_typ_member_inv_raw : Prop :=
  forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    exists W, record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
              G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

Lemma flow_typ_member_inv_raw_refuted :
  forall (A A0:typ_label) (z:var), ~ flow_typ_member_inv_raw.
Proof.
  intros A A0 z H.
  set (Tbody := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
  assert (Hrt : record_type Tbody).
  { exists (\{label_typ A0}). apply rt_one. - apply rd_typ. - reflexivity. }
  set (U := μ Tbody).
  set (Tgt := typ_rcd {A >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: U <: Tgt}).
  set (G := (empty:ctx) & z ~ R).
  assert (Hb : binds z R G) by apply binds_tail.
  assert (Hty : G ⊢ trm_path (pvar z) : R) by (apply ty_var; exact Hb).
  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ U <: Tgt).
  { eapply subtyp_trans.
    - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hty.
    - eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hty. }
  assert (Hfs : flow_shape U) by (apply fs_bnd; exact Hrt).
  destruct (H G U A ⊤ ⊤ Hfs Hsub) as [W [HrU _]].
  exfalso. exact (@record_type_mu_absurd Tbody HrU).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Path-flow existence, reduced to two genuinely missing links.        *)
(* FlowExists is type-independent, so no subtyping predicate is        *)
(* needed in the typing induction ([ty_sub] is immediate).             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition FlowExists (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) : Prop :=
  exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.

Definition path_flow_exists_HInv : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.

Definition field_flow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G p (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    FlowExists γ G p -> FlowExists γ G (p • a).

Definition path_elim_flow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p q:path) (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path (q • a) : T ->
    FlowExists γ G p -> FlowExists γ G (q • a) ->
    FlowExists γ G (p • a).

Lemma flow_exists_rcd_intro : forall γ G p a T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path (p • a) : T -> FlowExists γ G (p • a) ->
  FlowExists γ G p.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a T Hi Hty [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
  destruct (@flow_prefix_snoc G p a R U Hf) as [R' [V Hf']].
  exists R', V. split; [exact Hf'|].
  exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R' V Hi Hf').
Qed.

Lemma path_flow_exists_aux :
  field_flow_bridge -> path_elim_flow_bridge ->
  forall G (e:trm) T, G ⊢ e : T ->
  forall γ, HInv γ G -> forall p, e = trm_path p -> FlowExists γ G p.
Proof.
  intros Hfield Hpell G e T Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    exists T. exists T. split.
    + apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi0; exact Hi0 | exact H].
    + apply (@HInv_bind_flow_shape γ0 G x T); auto.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eapply Hfield; eauto.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eapply flow_exists_rcd_intro; eauto.
  - (* ty_let *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* ty_sngl *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eauto.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eapply Hpell; eauto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eauto.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eauto.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
    eauto.
  - (* ty_sub *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E.
    eapply IHHty; [exact Hi0|exact E].
Qed.

Lemma path_flow_exists_of_bridges :
  field_flow_bridge -> path_elim_flow_bridge -> path_flow_exists_HInv.
Proof.
  intros Hfield Hpell γ G p T Hi Hty.
  exact (@path_flow_exists_aux Hfield Hpell G (trm_path p) T Hty γ Hi p eq_refl).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact interface for [field_flow_bridge].                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The naive form with [record_has U] on the original flow output is   *)
(* false for the same reason [flow_record_member_sound] is (pf_bind     *)
(* outputs [μ R], while the ordinary record view is the *opened*       *)
(* record).  The correct interface allows the flow to be unfolded so   *)
(* that the field is visible.                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition flow_trm_field_exists : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists R' U' V,
      G ⊢! p : R' ⪼ U' /\ flow_shape U' /\
      record_has U' {a ⦂ V} /\ flow_shape V.

Lemma field_flow_bridge_of_sound :
  flow_trm_field_exists -> field_flow_bridge.
Proof.
  intros Hfld γ G p a T Hi Hty [R [U [Hfl Hfs]]].
  destruct (Hfld γ G p R U a T Hi Hfl Hfs Hty)
    as [R' [U' [V [Hfl' [Hfs' [Hhas HV]]]]]].
  exists V, V. split.
  - apply pf_fld with (T := R') (U := V).
    apply (@flow_record_has G p R' U' {a ⦂ V} Hfl'). exact Hhas.
  - exact HV.
Qed.

(* WARNING: the alias-prefix case shows [FlowExists] itself FAILS, and
   with it BOTH bridges (and [path_flow_exists_HInv]).

   Setup: [x : μV] with term field [b : {{q}}] pointing at [q]
   (so [x•b : {{q}}] by new_elim), and [q : μW] with term field [a]
   (so [q : rcd{a⦂T}] after rec_elim).
   - [ty_sngl] then gives [x•b : rcd{a⦂T}] (premise [x•b : {{q}}],
     premise [q : rcd{a⦂T}]), so [field_flow_bridge] applies with
     [p := x•b], yet [FlowExists (x•b)] holds only at the singleton
     [{{q}}] and [x•b•a] has NO syntactic flow (pf_fld needs a record
     output, and the only flow output of [x•b] is [{{q}}]).
   - Likewise [path_elim] types [(x•b)•a : {{q•a}}], while there is no
     flow for the path, so [path_elim_flow_bridge] applies and fails.
   Hence [path_flow_exists_HInv] is not a theorem.  The right invariant
   for alias-prefixed paths is precision ([precise2]/pt2_sngl_trans),
   not syntactic flow existence.  The canonical-member chain in
   agent_suball now uses [path_actual_record_trans_free] (runtime
   provenance) rather than [path_flow_exists_HInv], which is the
   sound route. *)

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Precision-based field step (alias-capable), replacing FlowExists.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition precise_trm_field_exists : Prop :=
  forall γ G p (a:trm_label) T U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    G ⊢!! p : U -> exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

(* The two precise2 constructors split the problem into:                *)
(*  (i) a precise flow output (the pt2 case, including the λ and μ      *)
(*      store values; the field must come from runtime record          *)
(*      provenance after unfolding); and                               *)
(*  (ii) a singleton-transitivity step (pt2_sngl_trans, the alias      *)
(*      case).                                                         *)

Definition flow_trm_field_precise : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Definition sngl_trans_field_precise : Prop :=
  forall γ G p (q:path) (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Lemma precise_trm_field_exists_of_cases :
  flow_trm_field_precise -> sngl_trans_field_precise ->
  precise_trm_field_exists.
Proof.
  intros Hflow Hsngl γ G p a T U Hi Hty Hp. induction Hp.
  - match goal with Hf : G ⊢! p : ?R ⪼ U |- _ =>
      exact (Hflow γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty) end.
  - exact (Hsngl γ G (p • a0) (q • a0) a T Hi
             (@pt2_sngl_trans G p q a0 U Hp1 Hp2) Hty).
Qed.

(* The flow case reduces to runtime (HInv heap) provenance: there is an
   unfolded flow output which actually contains the field [a].  This is
   the trm-label analogue of agent_suball's actual-record provenance and
   is where the λ-vs-object impossibility and the store/defs lookup enter. *)
Definition runtime_trm_field_provenance : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists R' U' V,
      G ⊢! p : R' ⪼ U' /\ record_has U' {a ⦂ V}.

Lemma flow_trm_field_precise_of_provenance :
  runtime_trm_field_provenance -> flow_trm_field_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hprov γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty.
  destruct (Hprov γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty) as [R' [U' [V [Hf' Hhas]]]].
  exists V. apply (@pt2 G (p • a) V V).
  apply pf_fld with (T := R') (U := V).
  apply (@flow_record_has G p R' U' {a ⦂ V} Hf'). exact Hhas.
Qed.

Lemma precise_trm_field_exists_of_provenance_and_sngl :
  runtime_trm_field_provenance -> sngl_trans_field_precise ->
  precise_trm_field_exists.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hsngl.
  apply precise_trm_field_exists_of_cases.
  - apply flow_trm_field_precise_of_provenance. exact Hprov.
  - exact Hsngl.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.

Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->

  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@rcd_record_type_shape a U). exact H.
  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + apply fs_rec. apply (@record_type_open_p U p).
      match goal with Hr : record_type U |- _ => exact Hr end.
    + exfalso.
      match goal with Hr : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
        exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U Hr) end.
  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_l U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_r U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
---
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Corrected, HInv/provenance-aware replacements for the raw bridge 2/3
   (the raw flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge is refuted by counter_bridge2.v). *)

Definition rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G r U A,
    HInv γ G -> RHoldsL γ G r U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

Definition arrow_open_HInv_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G T0 V0 S T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
    ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0.

Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (eapply HNS; eauto).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen γ G T0 U0 S T Hi Hcomp) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Store-level aliasing (wf/HInv-derived) and its use for the          *)
(* singleton component of replacement invariance.                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition alias (γ:sta) (p q:path) : Prop := γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧.

(* A precise3 singleton typing gives a concrete store alias. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ p q.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  assert (r = defp q) by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
  subst r. exact Hstar.
Qed.

(* Aliasing is stable under appending a list of fields. *)
Lemma alias_sel_fields : forall γ (p q:path) bs,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros γ [a fs] [b gs] bs. revert a fs b gs.
  induction bs as [|c bs IH]; intros a fs b gs H.
  - simpl. exact H.
  - change (alias γ ((p_sel a (bs ++ fs)) • c) ((p_sel b (bs ++ gs)) • c)).
    apply lookup_star_sel_p. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Aliasing composes. *)
Lemma alias_trans : forall γ p q r,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ q r -> alias γ p r.
Proof. intros. eapply star_trans; eauto. Qed.

(* Replacement only produces singleton targets through [rsngl]; expose the
   two endpoint paths and the concrete bridge-path aliasing. *)
Lemma repl_typ_sngl_endpoints : forall p q T T' s,
  repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} ->
  exists bs, s = p •• bs /\ T' = {{ q •• bs }}.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' s H. dependent destruction H; intros E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - injection E as Es.
    exists bs. split; [symmetry; exact Es | reflexivity].
Qed.

(* Singleton component of replacement invariance, now verified:
   if [p] aliases [q] in the store, then aliasing of any path [r] with a
   singleton [s] is preserved when [s] is rewritten to [s'] by
   [repl_typ p q] on singleton types. *)
Lemma alias_repl_sngl :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ p q ->
    forall T T' s s',
      repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ s s' ->
      alias γ s s'.
Proof. intros; assumption. Qed.

Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ p q ->
    forall T T' s s' r,
      repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ r s ->
      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros γ p q Hab T T' s s' r Hr Hs Hs' Hrs.
  destruct (@repl_typ_sngl_endpoints p q T T' s Hr Hs) as [bs [Es ET']].
  assert (Es' : s' = q •• bs).
  { rewrite ET' in Hs'. injection Hs' as E2. symmetry. exact E2. }
  subst s. subst s'.
  eapply alias_trans; [exact Hrs|].
  apply alias_sel_fields. exact Hab.
Qed.

(* The same for the opposite replacement orientation (subtyp_sngl_qp). *)
Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport_qp :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ q p ->
    forall T T' s s' r,
      repl_typ q p T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ r s ->
      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros γ p q Hqp T T' s s' r Hr Hs Hs' Hrs.
  eapply alias_repl_sngl_transport with (p := q) (q := p); eauto.
Qed.

(* Field-wise aliasing for a precise3 singleton typing: this is the
   path part needed by the [rdtrm]/[rpath] replacement cases. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias_sel_fields : forall γ G p q bs,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros. apply alias_sel_fields. eapply precise3_sngl_alias; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual: the non-singleton replacement components.
   The singleton component above is unconditional under HInv.  What is
   still needed for [good_repl] is the corresponding transport for:
   - arrows (repl rall1/rall2), which needs alias-respecting arrow
     opening;
   - type-member records / selections (repl rrcd/rdtyp/rpath), which
     needs the type-member coherence: two record views of aliased paths
     must have compatible tight bounds;
   - recursive/and/term-field types, which reduce recursively.
   These are recorded exactly as residual interface definitions. *)

Definition alias_arrow_repl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> alias γ p q ->
    forall S1 T1 S2 T2,
      repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
      forall r,
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S1) T1) ->
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S2) T2).

Definition alias_typ_member_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Type-member coherence: reduce it to a common tight bound.           *)

Lemma typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  forall G S1 T1 S2 T2 (W:typ),
    (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) ->
    (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2) ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).
Proof. intros. exists W. tauto. Qed.

(* The remaining coherence content: two record views of the same path at a
   type member [A] are both bounded by a single tight bound [W].  This is
   the store/precise-flow fact that [wf] is meant to supply; with it, the
   coherence residual above is discharged unconditionally (next lemma). *)
Definition typ_member_common_bound : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists W,
      (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) /\
      (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2).

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  typ_member_common_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intros Hcb γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
  destruct (Hcb γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2) as [W [Hw1 Hw2]].
  exact (@typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound G S1 T1 S2 T2 W Hw1 Hw2).

Inductive RHoldsL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rhL_lam (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv (λ(T0) t)) A
| rhL_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv v) U
| rhL_path q :
    RHoldsL γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holdsL : forall γ G p U,
  ResCoreL γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv (λ(T0) t)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (λ(T0) t)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_lam with (T0 := T0) (t := t) (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_path.
Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_pathL : forall γ G r q,
  RHoldsL γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_resL Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holdsL; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rhL_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookupL Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookupL Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Pointwise subtyping transport for GoodF2.                           *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* All subtyping rules except the four singleton-replacement and       *)
(* selection rules are proved for arbitrary fuel (in fact a stronger   *)
(* size-bounds-free statement).  The four residual rules are isolated  *)
(* as explicit bridge propositions below.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* IMPORTANT OBSTRUCTION (verified by hand; see report).

   [psub_sel1_bridge] is FALSE for the current universal, predecessor-fuel
   selection payload of GoodF2, even under HInv.  Take a context
   G = x0 ~ μ T0 with T0 = typ_rcd {A >: ⊥ <: ⊥} (a valid record_dec and
   a valid HInv heap value, since type members have equal bounds and there
   are no term fields to constrain the wf condition).  Let p0 = pvar x0.
   Then G ⊢ p0 : typ_rcd {A >: ⊥ <: ⊥} (rec_elim), so subtyp_sel1 gives
   G ⊢ (p0 ↓ A) <: ⊥.  Put m = 2 (i.e. fuel S 1).  The source
   GoodF2 2 (p0 ↓ A) unfolds to
     forall X Y, G ⊢ p0 : typ_rcd {A >: X <: Y} ->
                 GoodF2 1 p0 X -> GoodF2 1 p0 Y.
   Every record view has lower bound X = ⊥ (only ⊥ <: ⊥ is derivable as a
   lower bound here), and GoodF2 1 p0 ⊥ is False (fuel 1 at ⊥ is False),
   so the source holds vacuously.  The target GoodF2 2 p0 ⊥ is False.
   Hence the bridge cannot be proved.

   The selected predecessor fuel means GoodF2 at a selection carries only
   fuel-(m-1) information about the bounds, whereas sel1 asks for GoodF2 at
   the *same* fuel m on an arbitrary upper bound.  Canonical provenance
   fixes view coherence, not this fuel asymmetry.

   [psub_sel2_bridge] is not refuted by this example, but constructing its
   universal payload needs pointwise transport at the predecessor fuel
   for arbitrary canonical bound pairs X<:W<:Y.  That requires a mutual
   induction on (fuel, subtyping derivation): an outer Fixpoint on fuel
   with an inner structural Fixpoint on the subtyping proof, where the
   sel2 case calls the outer fuel-(m-1) function on the canonical
   subtyping proofs.  This is implementable, but it cannot rescue sel1.

   [psub_sngl_pq/qp] reduce to a GoodF2 replacement invariant
   [goodF2_repl_HInv]; agent_repl supplies the singleton alias component
   (precise3_sngl_alias, alias_sel_fields, repl_typ_sngl_transport), while
   record dec_typ needs the canonical type-member transport; structural
   and/μ recurse.  They are not needed to expose the sel1 obstruction.

   Consequently, the four-bridge reduction is sound but the four-bridge
   program cannot be completed for this GoodF2 shape.  A sound repair is
   to change the selection payload (e.g. carry canonical provenance and
   same-fuel bound information, or replace the universal transport by a
   tight/flow-derived payload). *)

Definition psub_sngl_pq_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0 q0:path) T T' U m (p:path),
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : {{ q0 }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q0 : U ->
    repl_typ p0 q0 T T' ->
    GoodF2 m γ G p T -> GoodF2 m γ G p T'.

Definition psub_sngl_qp_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0 q0:path) T T' U m (p:path),
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : {{ q0 }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q0 : U ->
    repl_typ q0 p0 T T' ->
    GoodF2 m γ G p T -> GoodF2 m γ G p T'.

Definition psub_sel2_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) A S T m (p:path),
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} ->
    GoodF2 m γ G p S -> GoodF2 m γ G p (p0 ↓ A).

Definition psub_sel1_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) A S T m (p:path),
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} ->
    GoodF2 m γ G p (p0 ↓ A) -> GoodF2 m γ G p T.

Lemma pointwise_psub_any_of_bridges :
  psub_sngl_pq_bridge -> psub_sngl_qp_bridge ->
  psub_sel2_bridge -> psub_sel1_bridge ->
  forall γ G S U, G ⊢ S <: U ->
    forall m p, GoodF2 m γ G p S -> GoodF2 m γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros Bpq Bqp Bsel2 Bsel1 γ G S U Hsub.
  rename S into St, U into Ut.
  set (P := fun (G0:ctx) (S0 U0:typ) =>
              forall m p, GoodF2 m γ G0 p S0 -> GoodF2 m γ G0 p U0).
  refine (subtyp_ind P _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsub).
  - (* top *) intros G0 T0 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|]. simpl. exact I.
  - (* bot *) intros G0 T0 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|]. simpl in H. exact (False_ind _ H).
  - (* refl *) intros G0 T0 m p H. exact H.
  - (* trans *) intros G0 S0 T0 U0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 m p H. exact (IH2 m p (IH1 m p H)).
  - (* and11 *) intros G0 T0 U0 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    simpl in H. destruct H as [H1 _]. exact H1.
  - (* and12 *) intros G0 T0 U0 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    simpl in H. destruct H as [_ H2]. exact H2.
  - (* and2 *) intros G0 S0 T0 U0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    apply (proj2 (GoodF2_and k γ G0 p T0 U0)).
    split.
    + exact (IH1 (S k) p H).
    + exact (IH2 (S k) p H).
  - (* fld *) intros G0 T0 U0 a H1 IH1 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    apply (proj2 (GoodF2_rcd_trm k γ G0 p a U0)).
    simpl in H. exact (IH1 (S k) (p • a) H).
  - (* typ *) intros G0 S1 S2 T1 T2 A H21 IH21 H12 IH12 m p H. destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    apply (proj2 (GoodF2_rcd_typ k γ G0 p A S2 T2)). intros Hg2.
    pose proof (proj1 (GoodF2_rcd_typ k γ G0 p A S1 T1) H) as Htr.
    exact (IH12 (S k) p (Htr (IH21 (S k) p Hg2))).
  - (* sngl_pq *) intros G0 p0 q0 T0 T' U0 Hty Hq Hrepl m p H.
    exact (Bpq γ G0 p0 q0 T0 T' U0 m p Hty Hq Hrepl H).
  - (* sngl_qp *) intros G0 p0 q0 T0 T' U0 Hty Hq Hrepl m p H.
    exact (Bqp γ G0 p0 q0 T0 T' U0 m p Hty Hq Hrepl H).
  - (* sel2 *) intros G0 p0 A S0 T0 Hty m p H.
    exact (Bsel2 γ G0 p0 A S0 T0 m p Hty H).
  - (* sel1 *) intros G0 p0 A S0 T0 Hty m p H.
    exact (Bsel1 γ G0 p0 A S0 T0 m p Hty H).
  - (* all *) intros L G0 S1 T1 S2 T2 H21 IH21 Hbody IHbody m p H.
    destruct m as [|k]; [simpl; exact I|].
    destruct H as [Hbr Hpre]. split.
    + eapply bridge_sub; [exact Hbr|].
      apply subtyp_all with (L := L); assumption.
    + exact Hpre.
Qed.

(* The coordinator's size-bounded statement follows from the stronger
   size-bounds-free one. *)
Lemma pointwise_psub_ge_of_bridges :
  psub_sngl_pq_bridge -> psub_sngl_qp_bridge ->
  psub_sel2_bridge -> psub_sel1_bridge ->
  forall γ G S U, G ⊢ S <: U ->
    forall N m, g_typ_size S <= N -> g_typ_size U <= N -> N <= m ->
    forall p, GoodF2 m γ G p S -> GoodF2 m γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros Bpq Bqp Bsel2 Bsel1 γ G S U Hsub N m HszS HszU HNm p H.
  eapply pointwise_psub_any_of_bridges.
  - exact Bpq.
  - exact Bqp.
  - exact Bsel2.
  - exact Bsel1.
  - exact Hsub.
  - exact H.
Qed.

  GoodEventually2 γ G p (∀(S) U) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) U).
Proof.
  intros γ G p S U [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_all in Hf. exact (proj1 Hf).
Qed.

Lemma gev2_arrow_prec2 : forall γ G p S U,
  GoodEventually2 γ G p (∀(S) U) -> exists W, G ⊢!! p : W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p S U [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_all in Hf. exact (proj2 Hf).
Qed.

Lemma gev2_sngl_precise3 : forall γ G p q,
  GoodEventually2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_sngl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma gev2_top : forall γ G p, GoodEventually2 γ G p ⊤.
Proof.
  intros. exists 0. intros m _. destruct m.
  - apply GoodF2_zero.
  - apply GoodF2_top.
Qed.

Lemma gev2_bot_absurd : forall γ G p,
  GoodEventually2 γ G p ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G p [n H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S n) ltac:(lia)) as Hf.
  exact (@GoodF2_bot n γ G p Hf).
Qed.

(* Arrow-source transport: immediate from Bridge monotonicity. *)
Lemma gev2_arrow_psub : forall γ G p T U,
  is_arrow T -> GoodEventually2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U ->
  GoodEventually2 γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U HarT Hg Hsub HarU.
  destruct HarT as [S0 [T0 ET]]. destruct HarU as [S1 [U1 EU]].
  rewrite ET in Hg. rewrite ET in Hsub. rewrite EU in Hsub. rewrite EU.
  pose proof (@gev2_arrow_bridge γ G p S0 T0 Hg) as Hb.
  pose proof (@gev2_arrow_prec2 γ G p S0 T0 Hg) as Hp.
  exists 1. intros m Hm. destruct m as [|f]; [lia|].
  rewrite GoodF2_all. split.
  - eapply bridge_sub; [exact Hb | exact Hsub].
  - exact Hp.
Qed.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L
  | μ       T      => μ (open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2       => ∀(open_rec_typ_p k u T1) open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path_p k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec_p (k: nat) (u: path) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ_p k u T <: open_rec_typ_p k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ_p k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

(* Residual: path-typing coherence for actual record fields.  Combining the
   head-compatibility fact with the def-typing structure
   (ty_def_path vs ty_def_all/ty_def_new) is intended to prove
   [nat_field_of_sub]. *)
Definition path_field_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Notes on the tds/ts_mutind instantiation (not proved).

   The proposed plumbing

     P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
     P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U

   does make the [ty_sub] and [subtyp_trans] steps work exactly as noted:
   transport along one subtyping derivation uses the good witness at the
   source, and trans composes P0 with the typing [ty_sub Hty Hsub1] (P0 is
   universally quantified over typing proofs).

   Two independent obstacles prevent a shallow [Good]:

   1. [subtyp_sel2]: P0 at S <: p↓A must produce [Good q (p↓A)] for an
      *arbitrary* path q from [Good q S].  Hence [Good] must be closed
      upward under the very subtyping relation being defined (or carry the
      selection's record-typing provenance).  Making it upward closed
      (e.g. Good p T := forall B, T<:B -> Bridge p B) pushes the burden
      into every typing rule for all supertypes.

   2. [ty_and_intro]: with upward-closed Good, one needs [Bridge p (T∧U)]
      from [Bridge p T] and [Bridge p U]; but two precise/flow witnesses
      below T and below U need not combine to one below T∧U.  In pDOT the
      relevant target is never the intersection itself (the only use is
      through and11/and12 towards an arrow), so a correct invariant must be
      target-restricted rather than uniformly upward closed.

   These are the same two places where the O1/O3 analyses got stuck; the
   full solution is the paper's precise/tight semantic invariant, with the
   selection case carrying a lower-bound witness plus record-typing
   provenance (and [wf] supplying precise2 for singleton alias targets). *)
===
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Mutual structural recursion over the proof trees of [ty_trm] and
   [subtyp], returning Prop.  This validates the combined
   typing+subtyping well-foundedness: subtyping rules that store a typing
   premise (sel1/sel2/sngl_pq/sngl_qp) recursively enter that typing proof,
   and the typing rule [ty_sub] recursively enters its subtyping proof.
   Recursion is purely structural on the proof arguments (the guard checker
   accepts both directions).  The body here is [True]; it is the skeleton
   into which the [Good] invariant is to be plugged. *)

Fixpoint prove_ty_true (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H : G ⊢ t : T) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | ty_var b => I
  | ty_all_intro t U body => I
  | ty_all_elim d1 d2 =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_new_intro T ds body => I
  | ty_new_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rcd_intro p a d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_let u d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in I
  | ty_sngl d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_path_elim a d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_rec_intro T d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rec_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_and_intro d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_sub d s => let _ := prove_ty_true d in let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  end
with prove_sub_true (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H : G ⊢ S <: U) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_top G0 T => I
  | subtyp_bot G0 T => I
  | subtyp_refl G0 T => I
  | subtyp_trans s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_and11 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and12 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and2 s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_fld a s => let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  | subtyp_typ A s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_pq t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_qp t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sel2 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_sel1 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_all T1 T2 s1 body => let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in I
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel-indexed structural invariant skeleton.

   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field
   [forall q, Good q L -> Good q U] is rejected by Coq: the occurrence of
   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant
   design is expressible.  This is the implementable shape. *)

Require Import agent_bridge1.

Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | O => True
  | Datatypes.S f =>
    match T with
    | typ_top => True
    | typ_bot => False
    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
    | typ_bnd T0 =>
        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
    | typ_rcd D =>
        match D with
        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
        end
    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}
    | typ_path p0 A =>
        (forall (S0 T0:typ),
            C ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} ->
            GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)
    end
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The existential-fuel wrapper proposed for [tds_mutind]. *)

Definition GoodEventually (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists n, forall m, n <= m -> GoodF m γ C p T.

Lemma goodF_zero : forall γ C p T, GoodF 0 γ C p T.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

(* NOTE on monotonicity (important for the max-based combination):
   the natural monotonicity [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] is NOT derivable from
   the definition above.  Concretely, instantiating T with a term record
   [rcd {a ⦂ ∀(S)U}] reduces the goal at f=0 to
       GoodF 0 (p•a) (∀(S)U)  ->  GoodF 1 (p•a) (∀(S)U)
   i.e.  True -> (Bridge γ C (p•a) (∀(S)U) /\ Prec2Exists), which needs the
   arrow resolution and is not provable for an arbitrary p/γ/C.  The
   [dec_typ] transport field additionally reverses the fuel direction
   (transport at fuel f is used to produce facts at fuel <= f), so neither
   [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] nor [GoodF (S f) -> GoodF f] holds uniformly.
   Hence the [exists n, forall m >= n] formulation cannot be combined by
   [max] without a redesigned GoodF (e.g. transport bounded by fuel, which is
   not structurally recursive, or an impredicative/coinductive encoding).
   A sound alternative is a single global fuel fixed before the induction
   (a syntactic bound on the initial goal/derivation), so that every GoodF
   fact in the induction is at the same fuel and no monotonicity is needed. *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_repl.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Strengthened Q.                                                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v with two cooperative           *)
(* strengthenings requested for the wf_push integration:                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   q2_prec2 : exists U, G ⊢!! p : U        (the explicit field)         *)
(*   q2_sngl  : the singleton payload is precise2, not merely precise3. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The precise2 singleton payload is what makes the [path_elim] and     *)
(* [sngl_trans] q2_prec2 clauses constructible (it supplies the first   *)
(* premise of [pt2_sngl_trans]); precise3 is recovered by [pt3].         *)
(* All recursive occurrences remain strictly positive (the record and   *)
(* μ occurrences are direct constructor arguments).                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive Q2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| q2_intro : forall p T,
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    Q2 γ G p T.

(* Projections. *)
Lemma Q2_arrow : forall γ G p T,
  Q2 γ G p T -> forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma Q2_fld : forall γ G p T (a:trm_label) S,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S.
Proof. intros γ G p T a S H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact (H1 a S). Qed.

Lemma Q2_and : forall γ G p T T1 T2,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2.
Proof. intros γ G p T T1 T2 H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact (H2 T1 T2). Qed.

Lemma Q2_bnd : forall γ G p T T0,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
Proof. intros γ G p T T0 H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact (H3 T0). Qed.

Lemma Q2_sngl : forall γ G p T q,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof. intros γ G p T q H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact (H4 q). Qed.

Lemma Q2_prec2 : forall γ G p T,
  Q2 γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5]. exact H5. Qed.

(* Precise3 version of the singleton payload. *)
Lemma Q2_sngl3 : forall γ G p q,
  Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q H. apply pt3. eapply Q2_sngl; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Flow base: a precise flow output is Q2 at arbitrary fuel-bounded    *)
(* type size.  (Adapted from [Q_of_flow_ge].)                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma Q2_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
  g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
    + (* top *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HTU.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. discriminate E.
      * exists ⊤. apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
    + (* bot *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
      * (* dec_typ *) apply q2_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
        -- exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
      * (* dec_trm *) apply q2_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
           ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
        -- exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
    + (* and *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros U1 U2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst U1. subst U2.
        split.
        -- refine (IH T1 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * exists (T1 ∧ T2). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
    + (* path *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
    + (* bnd *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * exists (μ T0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
    + (* all *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HV0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * exists (∀(S0) U0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
    + (* sngl *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
        apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
      * exists ({{ q0 }}). apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma Q2_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q2_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
   needed. *)
Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.

Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.

Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.

(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma SGood_Q2_of_residuals :
  Q2_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q2_of_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
  - (* sg_new_elim *) destruct IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec].
    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) destruct IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec].
    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) destruct IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec].
    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_and_r *) destruct IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec].
    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

Qed.

Theorem HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :

  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hty.
  eapply path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2; eauto.
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Combined structural property for SGood.  It mirrors the SGood
   constructors but adds the arrow/Bridge-facing clauses.  All recursive
   occurrences are positive. *)
Inductive Q (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| q_intro : forall p T,
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q γ G p T1 /\ Q γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    Q γ G p T.

(* Flow base for Q: a precise flow output is Q at arbitrary fuel-bounded
   type size.  This is the sg_flow base of the SGood induction. *)
Lemma Q_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
  g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
    + (* top *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HTU.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. discriminate E.
    + (* bot *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
      * (* dec_typ *) apply q_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * (* dec_trm *) apply q_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
            ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* and *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros U1 U2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst U1. subst U2.
        split.
        -- refine (IH T1 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* path *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
    + (* bnd *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* all *) apply q_intro.
      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HV0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* sngl *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.

Lemma Q_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* Exact closure residuals needed to turn SGood into Q. *)
Definition Q_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q γ G p U.

Definition Q_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G q T -> Q γ G p T.

Definition Q_path_elim_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G (q • a) T -> Q γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Definition Q_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G (p • a) T -> Q γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> Q γ G p U -> Q γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q_sngl_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q γ G p {{ q }}.

Definition SGood_Q_residuals : Prop :=
  Q_sub_cl /\ Q_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q_path_elim_cl /\
  Q_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q_rec_intro_cl /\ Q_and_intro_cl /\ Q_sngl_cl.

Lemma SGood_Q_of_residuals :
  SGood_Q_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q_of_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0' Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

(* Bridge 1, conditional on the closure residuals. *)
Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_residuals :
  SGood_Q_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
  pose proof (@SGood_Q_of_residuals Hres γ G p A Hi Hs) as HQ.
  inversion HQ as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
  exact (Harr A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
Qed.

(* Strengthened Q.                                                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v with two cooperative           *)
(* strengthenings requested for the wf_push integration:                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   q2_prec2 : exists U, G ⊢!! p : U        (the explicit field)         *)
(*   q2_sngl  : the singleton payload is precise2, not merely precise3. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The precise2 singleton payload is what makes the [path_elim] and     *)
(* [sngl_trans] q2_prec2 clauses constructible (it supplies the first   *)
(* premise of [pt2_sngl_trans]); precise3 is recovered by [pt3].         *)
(* All recursive occurrences remain strictly positive (the record and   *)
(* μ occurrences are direct constructor arguments).                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive Q2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| q2_intro : forall p T,
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->

(* Projections. *)
Lemma Q2_arrow : forall γ G p T,
  Q2 γ G p T -> forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.

Lemma Q2_fld : forall γ G p T (a:trm_label) S,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S.

Lemma Q2_and : forall γ G p T T1 T2,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2.

Lemma Q2_bnd : forall γ G p T T0,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).

Lemma Q2_sngl : forall γ G p T q,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

  Q2 γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

  Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.

        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.

        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
