      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
        apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
      * exists ({{ q0 }}). apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma Q2_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q2_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
   needed. *)
Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.

Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.

Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma SGood_Q2_of_residuals :
  Q2_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q2_of_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

(* Every SGood typing yields a precise2 typing of the path, under HInv,
   once the Q2 closure residuals are supplied.  This is the precise
   witness requested for [wf_push_cond]. *)
Lemma path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2 :
  Q2_residuals ->
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hs.
  exact (Q2_prec2 (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p T Hi Hs)).
Qed.

(* The direct ordinary-typing version: this is the HInv-aware
   ordinary-path-to-precise2 bridge whose output feeds
   [wf_push_cond_of_path_precise]. *)
Theorem HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
  Q2_residuals ->
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hty.
  eapply path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2; eauto.
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Conditional reductions of the remaining residuals.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Each isolates the precise semantic ingredient that is still         *)
(* missing, so the frontier is explicit rather than hidden in a        *)
(* monolithic residual.                                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* --- (A) Target-intersection arrow split. ------------------------- *)
(* If an arrow supertype of [T ∧ U] is already a supertype of one      *)
(* component, the ArrowCl fields of the two premises compose.  The     *)
(* missing fact is exactly the split; it is the "and-supertype arrow"  *)
(* classification noted in agent_bridge1 (two Bridge witnesses below T *)
(* and U need not combine below T∧U).                                  *)
Definition and_arrow_split : Prop :=
  forall G T U V, G ⊢ T ∧ U <: V -> is_arrow V ->
    G ⊢ T <: V \/ G ⊢ U <: V.

Lemma Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split :
  and_arrow_split -> Q2_and_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hsplit γ G p T U Hi HT HU. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    destruct (Hsplit G T U V Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V HTV Har).
    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p U HU V HUV Har).
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst T1. subst T2.
    split; assumption.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
Qed.

(* --- (B) No arrow from a term-field record. ----------------------- *)
Definition rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall γ G (a:trm_label) S V,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
  rcd_no_arrow -> Q2_rcd_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p a T Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* field *) intros b S E. injection E as Eb ES. subst b. subst S.
    exact Ha.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) destruct (Q2_prec2 Ha) as [U HU].
    exact (@precise2_prefix_snoc G p a U HU).
Qed.

(* --- (C) No arrow from a recursive type. -------------------------- *)
Definition bnd_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall γ G T0 V,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
  bnd_no_arrow -> Q2_rec_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p T0 Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'. exact Ha.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 Ha).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* (D) Singleton transitivity, reduced to the μ-opening transport.     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* All cases except μ go through by strong induction on the type size: *)
(* the field case at [p•a,q•a] uses [pt2_sngl_trans] to transport the  *)
(* precise2 singleton payload, and the and case uses the two IHs.      *)
(* The sole obstruction is the μ field, which asks for the body opened *)
(* at [p] given the body opened at the aliased path [q].               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition Q2_mu_open_transport : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T0,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    Q2 γ G q (open_typ_p q T0) -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).

(* Precise2 transitivity at a singleton.  This is the one precise2 rule
   missing from the raw calculus (pt2_sngl_trans only transports a field
   selector).  With the precise2 singleton payload it is exactly what the
   singleton case of sngl-transport needs. *)
Definition Q2_prec2_sngl_trans : Prop :=
  forall G p q r, G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! q : {{ r }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ r }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_ge :
  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  forall (N:nat) (T:typ), g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros Hmu Hs2 N. induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p q Hi Hp2 Hq.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - apply q2_intro.
    + (* arrow *) intros V Hsub HarV.
      destruct (@Q2_arrow γ G q T Hq V Hsub HarV) as [U [Hq3 [Hfs HUV]]].
      exists U. split; [|split].
      * eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp2 | exact Hq3].
      * exact Hfs.
      * exact HUV.
    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
      pose proof (@Q2_fld γ G q (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S Hq eq_refl) as HQqaS.
      destruct (Q2_prec2 HQqaS) as [U Hqa2].
      assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
        by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
      eapply IH.
      * simpl in Hsz. lia.
      * exact Hi.
      * exact Hpa2.
      * exact HQqaS.
    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
      destruct (@Q2_and γ G q (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 Hq eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H1].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H2].
    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
      eapply Hmu; eauto.
      eapply (@Q2_bnd γ G q (μ T0) T0 Hq eq_refl).
    + (* singleton *) intros q' E. subst T.
      eapply Hs2.
      * exact Hp2.
      * eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G q ({{ q' }}) q' Hq eq_refl).
    + (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp2.
Qed.

Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu :
  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans -> Q2_sngl_trans_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hmu Hs2 γ G p q T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  eapply (Q2_sngl_trans_ge Hmu Hs2 (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Partial sub-closure: arrow and type-member-record targets.           *)
(* These are unconditional (arrow) or conditional only on the exact     *)
(* no-arrow vacuity for the target head.                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma Q2_sub_arrow : forall γ G p T A,
  HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: A -> is_arrow A -> Q2 γ G p A.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T A Hi HT Hsub Harr. destruct Harr as [S [U EA]]. subst A.
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V HAV Har.
    apply (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V).
    + eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
    + exact Har.
  - (* field *) intros a S' E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
Qed.

(* Arrow supertypes of a top target. *)
Definition top_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall G V, G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_to_top_of_no_arrow :
  top_no_arrow -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p typ_top.
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p T Hi HT. apply q2_intro.
  - intros V HtopV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna G V HtopV Har)).
  - intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - intros q E. discriminate E.
  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
Qed.

(* Arrow supertypes of a type-member record target. *)
Definition typ_rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall γ G (A:typ_label) L U V,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_sub_typ_rcd_of_no_arrow :
  typ_rcd_no_arrow ->
  forall γ G p T (A:typ_label) L U,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T ->
    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} ->
    Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}).
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p T A L U Hi HT Hsub. apply q2_intro.
  - intros V HrecV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G A L U V Hi HrecV Har)).
  - (* field: a type-member record is not a term-field record *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - intros q E. discriminate E.
  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Compatibility with the original Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v: the      *)
(* strengthening is conservative (Q2 -> Q).  Q's singleton payload is  *)
(* precise3, recovered from Q2's precise2 payload by [pt3].            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma Q2_to_Q_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
  g_typ_size T <= N -> forall γ G p, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p H.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - apply q_intro.
    + (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har. exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T H U Hsub Har).
    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
      eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia |].
      exact (@Q2_fld γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S H eq_refl).
    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
      destruct (@Q2_and γ G p (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 H eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H1].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H2].
    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
      eapply IH.
      * rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
      * exact (@Q2_bnd γ G p (μ T0) T0 H eq_refl).
    + (* singleton *) intros q E. subst T.
      apply pt3. eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G p ({{ q }}) q H eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma Q2_to_Q : forall γ G p T, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q2_to_Q_ge (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.

  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.

(* normalize to every view.  For an actual tight member [A] of bound   *)
(* [⊥], the view [rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}] is live while the fabricated           *)
(* [rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤}] cannot have [subtyp1 G rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤} rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}]     *)
(* (that would require [⊤ <: ⊥]).  Hence the provenance relation       *)
(* (which actual record, with which [W]) must be carried as a single   *)
(* witness: the residual below cannot be decomposed.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma actual_record_exists_trivial : forall (A:typ_label),
  exists U W, record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W }.
Proof.
  intros A. exists (typ_rcd { A >: ⊤ <: ⊤ }), ⊤. split.
  - apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
  - apply rh_one.
Qed.

(* The residual with provenance carried explicitly (definitionally the
   same as [path_actual_record_trans_free], exposed for the runtime
   navigation proof): *)
Definition ActualRecordBound (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (A:typ_label)
    (U W:typ) : Prop :=
  record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
  (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
     subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

Lemma path_actual_record_trans_free_iff :
  path_actual_record_trans_free <->
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists U W, ActualRecordBound γ G p A U W).
Proof.
  unfold path_actual_record_trans_free, ActualRecordBound. tauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
| st_fld : forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G S (p ↓ A)
| st_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G (p ↓ A) T
| st_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
    subtyp_step G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp_step_subtyp : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma star_trans_gen : forall (A:Type) (R:A -> A -> Prop) (a b c:A),
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* fld *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_fld; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* typ *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_typ; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_pq *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_pq; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_qp *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_qp; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel2 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel2; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel1 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel1; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* all *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_all; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
Qed.

(* [ty_sub] composition for the full classification: once [U] reaches the
   premise target [R0] by a star, composing with the (star-decomposed)
   rule subtyping [R0 <: R] keeps the star.  This is the branch that was
   previously blocked by the missing transitivity of [subtyp1]. *)
Lemma star_subtyp_step_psub : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 ->
  G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
  star (subtyp_step G) U R.
Proof.
  intros G U R0 R Hstar Hsub.
  eapply star_trans_gen; [exact Hstar | apply subtyp_star_step; exact Hsub].
Qed.

(* In particular, every ordinary subtyping is a star of [subtyp_step]s, so
   a classification result expressed with [star (subtyp_step G)] is stable
   under all [ty_sub] widenings. *)
Lemma record_target_psub_star : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 -> G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
  star (subtyp_step G) U R.
Proof. intros. eapply star_subtyp_step_psub; eauto. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L. Runtime object relation, corrected classification interfaces.    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Alert addressed: a single [subtyp1] from a whole intersection       *)
(* [U1 ∧ U2] to a record is impossible.  For the type-member           *)
(* classification we therefore select the actual *component*           *)
(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}] and require single-step [subtyp1] from that          *)
(* component.  The full record-shape interface (needed by the          *)
(* [ty_new_elim] induction premise) uses [star subtyp1].               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Strengthened runtime object relation, with defs provenance. *)
Inductive PathObject (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| po_obj x T0 ds :
    binds x (μ T0) G ->
    binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ ->
    DefsTyped (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) x nil T0 ds ->
    PathObject γ G (pvar x) (open_typ_p (pvar x) T0)
| po_alias p q U :
    γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ ->
    PathObject γ G q U ->
    PathObject γ G p U
| po_field_obj p a T0 Tv dsv :
    PathObject γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defv (ν(Tv) dsv) ⟧ ->
    PathObject γ G (p • a) (open_typ_p (p • a) Tv).

Definition record_view (R:typ) : Prop :=
  exists (A:typ_label) S T, R = typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }.

Definition record_shape (R:typ) : Prop :=
  exists D, R = typ_rcd D.

Lemma record_view_shape : forall R, record_view R -> record_shape R.
Proof.
  intros R [A [S [T E]]]. exists {A >: S <: T}. exact E.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Type-member classification (component-selected).                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The returned [U] is the actual whole record (provenance), [W] is    *)
(* the actual tight bound of member [A], and every view is a single    *)
(* [subtyp1] step from the *component* [rcd{A>:W<:W}], never from the  *)
(* whole intersection.                                                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition record_target_classification : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      PathObject γ G p U /\ record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T,
         G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

(* The component [rcd{A>:W<:W}] is itself an actual tight record, so it
   directly witnesses [path_actual_record_trans_free]. *)
Lemma path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> path_actual_record_trans_free.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G p A Hi Hview.
  destruct (HC γ G p A Hi Hview) as [U [W [Hpo [Hrt [Hhas HW]]]]].
  exists (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }), W. split.
  - apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
  - split.
    + apply rh_one.
    + intros S T Hty. apply HW. exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> canonical_member_bound.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply canonical_member_bound_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> typ_member_common_bound.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply typ_member_common_bound_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Full record-shape classification, using [star subtyp1] to allow the *)
(* and-projections that a whole intersection needs.  This is the form  *)
(* required by the [ty_new_elim] premise (a term-field record).        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition record_target_classification_full : Prop :=
  forall γ G p,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R /\ record_shape R) ->
    exists U,
      PathObject γ G p U /\ record_type U /\
      (forall R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R -> record_shape R ->
         star (subtyp_step G) U R).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* [ty_var] base case facts (proven).                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma PathObject_var : forall γ G x T0 ds,
  HInv γ G ->
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ ->
  PathObject γ G (pvar x) (open_typ_p (pvar x) T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds Hi HbG Hbγ.
  destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]].
  apply po_obj with (ds := ds); auto.
  apply defs_at_DefsTyped. apply Hdefs; auto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_no_record_view : forall (T:typ),
  inert_typ T -> record_view T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T Hin [A [S [T0 E]]]. subst T. inversion Hin.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_record_view_absurd : forall G x T0,
  binds x T0 G -> inert_typ T0 -> record_view T0 -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_typ_no_record_view; eauto. Qed.

Lemma PathObject_alias_inv : forall γ G p q U,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> PathObject γ G q U -> PathObject γ G p U.
Proof. intros. apply po_alias with (q := q); auto. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Component-view bounds.  For the component-selected classification  *)
(* the source of every view is the single tight component              *)
(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}]; a trans-free view of it is exactly the bound        *)
(* bracket [S <: W <: T].                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds : forall G (A:typ_label) W S T,
  subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
  G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros G A W S T Hsub.
  assert (Hrt : record_type (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }))
    by (apply record_type_rcd_of_dec; apply rd_typ).
  assert (Hfs : flow_shape (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }))
    by (apply fs_rec; exact Hrt).
  destruct (@subtyp1_typ_member_inv G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) A S T Hfs Hsub)
    as [W' [_ [Hhas' [Hl' Hu']]]].
  assert (E : W' = W)
    by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; [exact Hrt | exact Hhas' | apply rh_one]).
  subst W'. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* Consequently the component-selected classification yields the
   canonical bound bracket for every view. *)
Lemma record_target_classification_bounds :
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists W, forall S T,
       G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }))
  ->
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists W, forall S T,
       G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).
Proof.
  intros HC γ G p A Hi Hview.
  destruct (HC γ G p A Hi Hview) as [W HW].
  exists W. intros S T Hty.
  exact (@subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds G A W S T (HW S T Hty)).
Qed.


(* ================================================================== *)
(* N. Warning: the HInv-free star record-view inversion is FALSE.      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Counterexample pattern (the loose-record selection detour):         *)
(*   G := empty & z ~ rcd{A0 >: U <: rcd{A>:S<:T}}                     *)
(*   U := rcd{A>:W<:W}  (a record_type with the actual member A:W)     *)
(* The same binding gives two ordinary typings of [z]:                 *)
(*   z : rcd{A0>:U<:rcd{A>:S<:T}}                                      *)
(* hence the two atoms                                                *)
(*   st_sel2 : subtyp_step G U (z ↓ A0)                                *)
(*   st_sel1 : subtyp_step G (z ↓ A0) (rcd{A>:S<:T})                   *)
(* and therefore a star from U to the view [rcd{A>:S<:T}].  But [S,T]  *)
(* are arbitrary (they are just the upper bound of the loose member     *)
(* A0), so [S <: W <: T] need not hold.  This is exactly the           *)
(* counter_bridge2 loose-record pattern; HInv/inertness is essential.  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The correct residual must therefore carry HInv:                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition star_record_view_inv_HInv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    HInv γ G ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

(* What is already proven toward it: the star decomposition
   [subtyp_star_step], the star Psub [record_target_psub_star], label
   uniqueness [record_has_typ_unique]/[record_typ_has_label_in], and the
   terminal component step [subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds].  What remains is

(* Corrected, HInv/provenance-aware replacements for the raw bridge 2/3

Definition rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G r U A,
    HInv γ G -> RHoldsL γ G r U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

Definition arrow_open_HInv_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G T0 V0 S T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
    ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0.

Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (eapply HNS; eauto).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen γ G T0 U0 S T Hi Hcomp) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The GoodClo invariant: GoodF2 at every supertype.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition GoodClo (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (m:nat) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodF2 m γ G p U.

(* Psub is absorbed by definition: one transitivity step. *)
Lemma GoodClo_sub : forall γ G m p T U,
  GoodClo γ G m p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> GoodClo γ G m p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G m p T U Hc Htu V Huv.
  apply Hc. eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Specialisation at the reflexive supertype. *)
Lemma GoodClo_self : forall γ G m p T,
  GoodClo γ G m p T -> G ⊢ T <: T -> GoodF2 m γ G p T.
Proof. intros. eapply H. apply subtyp_refl. Qed.

Lemma GoodClo_refl_self : forall γ G m p T,
  GoodClo γ G m p T -> GoodF2 m γ G p T.
Proof. intros. eapply H. apply subtyp_refl. Qed.

(* GoodEventuallyClo with the existential fuel bound. *)
Definition GoodEventuallyClo (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists N, forall m, N <= m -> GoodClo γ G m p T.

Lemma GoodEventuallyClo_elim : forall γ G p T,
  GoodEventuallyClo γ G p T ->
  exists N, forall m, N <= m -> GoodClo γ G m p T.
Proof. intros. exact H. Qed.

(* Arrow projection at a sufficiently large fuel. *)
Lemma GoodEventuallyClo_arrow_bridge : forall γ G p S U,
  GoodEventuallyClo γ G p (∀(S) U) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) U).
Proof.
  intros γ G p S U [N H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S N) ltac:(lia)) as Hc.
  pose proof (@GoodClo_refl_self γ G (Datatypes.S N) p (∀(S) U) Hc) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_all in Hf. exact (proj1 Hf).
Qed.

Lemma GoodEventuallyClo_arrow_prec2 : forall γ G p S U,
  GoodEventuallyClo γ G p (∀(S) U) -> exists W, G ⊢!! p : W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p S U [N H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S N) ltac:(lia)) as Hc.
  pose proof (@GoodClo_refl_self γ G (Datatypes.S N) p (∀(S) U) Hc) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_all in Hf. exact (proj2 Hf).
Qed.

Lemma GoodEventuallyClo_sngl : forall γ G p q,
  GoodEventuallyClo γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q [N H].
  pose proof (H (Datatypes.S N) ltac:(lia)) as Hc.
  pose proof (@GoodClo_refl_self γ G (Datatypes.S N) p {{ q }} Hc) as Hf.
  rewrite GoodF2_sngl in Hf. exact Hf.
Qed.

(* Building GoodClo from GoodF2 at the type itself is not possible in
   general (GoodClo quantifies over all supertypes).  The remaining
   construction obligations are isolated below. *)

(* Intersections: for every supertype V of T1∧T2, produce GoodF2 V.  This
   needs case analysis on the subtyping derivation to V (and11/12 give
   V=T1/T2 and use the component GoodClo; and2 gives an intersection of
   supertypes; trans needs closure at the intermediate type, i.e. the same
   obligation at that intermediate type). *)
Definition GoodClo_and_obligation : Prop :=
  forall γ G m p T1 T2,
    GoodClo γ G m p T1 -> GoodClo γ G m p T2 ->
    GoodClo γ G m p (T1 ∧ T2).

(* Term-record outputs: for every supertype V of {a⦂S}, produce GoodF2 V.
   Supertype shapes: {a⦂S'} (field/typ rules), intersections, {}⊤,
   selections/views via the runtime provenance. *)
Definition GoodClo_rcd_trm_obligation : Prop :=
  forall γ G m p a S,
    GoodClo γ G m (p • a) S -> GoodClo γ G m p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}).

(* Type-member records: use the canonical member bound for views. *)
Definition GoodClo_rcd_typ_obligation : Prop :=
  forall γ G m p A L U,
    GoodClo γ G m p L -> GoodClo γ G m p U ->
    GoodClo γ G m p (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}).

Definition GoodClo_union_obligations : Prop :=
  GoodClo_and_obligation /\ GoodClo_rcd_trm_obligation /\
  GoodClo_rcd_typ_obligation.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Trans-free one-step relation with FULL subtyp premises.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* agent_suball's [subtyp1] uses [subtyp1] premises, so [subtyp] does  *)
(* NOT factor as [star subtyp1] at rules such as and2/fld/typ/all.     *)
(* The right factorization uses the same rules as [subtyp] without     *)
(* [trans] but keeping [subtyp] premises; then every non-trans head is *)
(* one step, and only [trans] needs a star concatenation.              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Inductive subtyp0 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| s0_top : forall G T, subtyp0 G T ⊤
| s0_bot : forall G T, subtyp0 G ⊥ T
| s0_refl : forall G T, subtyp0 G T T
| s0_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp0 G (T ∧ U) T
| s0_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp0 G (T ∧ U) U
| s0_and2 : forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp0 G S (T ∧ U)
| s0_fld : forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp0 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| s0_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    subtyp0 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| s0_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp0 G T T'
| s0_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp0 G T T'
| s0_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} -> subtyp0 G S (p ↓ A)
| s0_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {A >: S <: T} -> subtyp0 G (p ↓ A) T
| s0_all : forall (L:fset var) (G:ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2:typ),
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
    subtyp0 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp0_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp0 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.   - apply subtyp_bot.   - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11. - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_star_subtyp0 : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp0 G) S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply star_step with (b := ⊤); [apply s0_top|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T); [apply s0_bot|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T); [apply s0_refl|apply star_refl].
  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans; eauto.
  - apply star_step with (b := T); [apply s0_and11|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := U); [apply s0_and12|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T ∧ U); [apply s0_and2; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}); [apply s0_fld; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2});
      [apply s0_typ; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T'); [eapply s0_sngl_pq; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T'); [eapply s0_sngl_qp; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := p ↓ A); [eapply s0_sel2; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := T); [eapply s0_sel1; eauto|apply star_refl].
  - apply star_step with (b := ∀(S2) T2); [eapply s0_all; eauto|apply star_refl].
Qed.

(* GoodClo construction along the factorization needs exactly one closure
   property for the non-transitive steps (trans is handled by the star). *)
Definition GoodClo_step_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G m p S V,
    GoodClo γ G m p S -> subtyp0 G S V -> GoodClo γ G m p V.

Lemma GoodClo_star_of_step_closure :
  GoodClo_step_closure ->
  forall γ G m p T U,
    GoodClo γ G m p T -> star (subtyp0 G) T U -> GoodClo γ G m p U.
Proof.
  intros Hstep γ G m p T U Hc Hstar. induction Hstar.
  - exact Hc.
  - apply IHHstar. eapply Hstep; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Towards GoodClo_and: seed and the target-size induction analysis.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma GoodF2_and_intro : forall m γ G p T U,
  GoodF2 m γ G p T -> GoodF2 m γ G p U -> GoodF2 m γ G p (T ∧ U).
Proof.
  intros m. destruct m as [|f]; intros γ G p T U H1 H2.
  - apply GoodF2_zero.
  - rewrite GoodF2_and. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* The seed: GoodF2 at the conjunction itself. *)
Lemma GoodClo_and_seed : forall γ G m p T1 T2,
  GoodClo γ G m p T1 -> GoodClo γ G m p T2 -> GoodF2 m γ G p (T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros γ G m p T1 T2 H1 H2.
  apply GoodF2_and_intro.
  - apply GoodClo_refl_self; auto.
  - apply GoodClo_refl_self; auto.
Qed.

(* Target-size induction handles the structural supertype shapes:
   - refl/and11/and12/top: direct sizes/known GoodF2;
   - and2 (V = V1∧V2 with T1∧T2 <: V1, T1∧T2 <: V2): V1 and V2 have
     strictly smaller g_typ_size than V, so the induction hypothesis
     (same source T1∧T2) supplies GoodF2 V1, V2, then GoodF2_and_intro;
   - fld/typ/all cannot have source T1∧T2 (their source constructors are
     rcd/rcd/arrow), so they do not arise on a star whose first source is
     a conjunction.
   Remaining non-structural cases on an and-source:
   - trans: no longer a step in subtyp0; along `star subtyp0` the
     intermediate type has arbitrary size, so propagation needs either a
     GoodClo at the intermediate or a well-founded measure on the star
     (the star is finite, but the size does not decrease);
   - sngl_pq/qp: target is a repl image of the conjunction; GoodF2 of its
     components needs repl invariance (the singled-out replacement
     residual);
   - sel2: source is the conjunction used as a lower bound; the target
     selection needs the canonical member bound and cross-view transport
     (the runtime provenance/sel residual);
   - bot: T1∧T2 <: ⊥ requires a target-⊥ inversion (and then contradicts
     GoodClo T with T <: ⊥, since GoodF2 ⊥ is False).
   These four are the exact residual cases; and11/12/and2/top/refl are
   discharged by target-size induction plus GoodClo and GoodF2_and_intro. *)

(* Store-level aliasing (wf/HInv-derived) and its use for the          *)
(* singleton component of replacement invariance.                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition alias (γ:sta) (p q:path) : Prop := γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧.

(* A precise3 singleton typing gives a concrete store alias. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ p q.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  assert (r = defp q) by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
  subst r. exact Hstar.
Qed.

(* Aliasing is stable under appending a list of fields. *)
Lemma alias_sel_fields : forall γ (p q:path) bs,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros γ [a fs] [b gs] bs. revert a fs b gs.
  induction bs as [|c bs IH]; intros a fs b gs H.
  - simpl. exact H.
  - change (alias γ ((p_sel a (bs ++ fs)) • c) ((p_sel b (bs ++ gs)) • c)).
    apply lookup_star_sel_p. apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Aliasing composes. *)
Lemma alias_trans : forall γ p q r,
  alias γ p q -> alias γ q r -> alias γ p r.
Proof. intros. eapply star_trans; eauto. Qed.

(* Replacement only produces singleton targets through [rsngl]; expose the
   two endpoint paths and the concrete bridge-path aliasing. *)
Lemma repl_typ_sngl_endpoints : forall p q T T' s,
  repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} ->
  exists bs, s = p •• bs /\ T' = {{ q •• bs }}.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' s H. dependent destruction H; intros E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - injection E as Es.
    exists bs. split; [symmetry; exact Es | reflexivity].
Qed.

(* Singleton component of replacement invariance, now verified:

Lemma alias_repl_sngl :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ p q ->
    forall T T' s s',
      repl_typ p q T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ s s' ->
      alias γ s s'.

      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros γ p q Hab T T' s s' r Hr Hs Hs' Hrs.
  destruct (@repl_typ_sngl_endpoints p q T T' s Hr Hs) as [bs [Es ET']].
  assert (Es' : s' = q •• bs).
  { rewrite ET' in Hs'. injection Hs' as E2. symmetry. exact E2. }
  subst s. subst s'.
  eapply alias_trans; [exact Hrs|].
  apply alias_sel_fields. exact Hab.
Qed.

(* The same for the opposite replacement orientation (subtyp_sngl_qp). *)
Lemma alias_repl_sngl_transport_qp :
  forall γ p q,
    alias γ q p ->
    forall T T' s s' r,
      repl_typ q p T T' -> T = {{ s }} -> T' = {{ s' }} ->
      alias γ r s ->
      alias γ r s'.
Proof.
  intros γ p q Hqp T T' s s' r Hr Hs Hs' Hrs.
  eapply alias_repl_sngl_transport with (p := q) (q := p); eauto.
Qed.

(* Field-wise aliasing for a precise3 singleton typing: this is the
   path part needed by the [rdtrm]/[rpath] replacement cases. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_alias_sel_fields : forall γ G p q bs,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> alias γ (p •• bs) (q •• bs).
Proof.
  intros. apply alias_sel_fields. eapply precise3_sngl_alias; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual: the non-singleton replacement components.
   The singleton component above is unconditional under HInv.  What is
   still needed for [good_repl] is the corresponding transport for:
   - arrows (repl rall1/rall2), which needs alias-respecting arrow
     opening;
   - type-member records / selections (repl rrcd/rdtyp/rpath), which
     needs the type-member coherence: two record views of aliased paths
     must have compatible tight bounds;
   - recursive/and/term-field types, which reduce recursively.
   These are recorded exactly as residual interface definitions. *)

Definition alias_arrow_repl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> alias γ p q ->
    forall S1 T1 S2 T2,
      repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
      forall r,
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S1) T1) ->
        (exists U, G ⊢!!! r : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: ∀(S2) T2).

Definition alias_typ_member_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Type-member coherence: reduce it to a common tight bound.           *)

Lemma typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  forall G S1 T1 S2 T2 (W:typ),
    (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) ->
    (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2) ->
    exists Q, (G ⊢ S1 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T1 /\
               G ⊢ S2 <: Q /\ G ⊢ Q <: T2).
Proof. intros. exists W. tauto. Qed.

(* The remaining coherence content: two record views of the same path at a
   type member [A] are both bounded by a single tight bound [W].  This is
   the store/precise-flow fact that [wf] is meant to supply; with it, the
   coherence residual above is discharged unconditionally (next lemma). *)
Definition typ_member_common_bound : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} ->
    exists W,
      (G ⊢ S1 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T1) /\
      (G ⊢ S2 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T2).

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound :
  typ_member_common_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intros Hcb γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
  destruct (Hcb γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2) as [W [Hw1 Hw2]].
  exact (@typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound G S1 T1 S2 T2 W Hw1 Hw2).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
    + subst. exact H.
    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
Qed.

Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
  induction H; intros T0 ET.
  - discriminate ET.
  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.
  intros C H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
  induction Hflow as
    [ x G T Hok Hb
    | G p a T U Hprem
    | p G T U Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
    intros Hin q0 ET.
  - (* pf_bind *)
    exfalso.
    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst U.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. assumption.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
Proof.
  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all_aux : forall C (p:path) T U,
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall x A B bs,
    binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hf.
  induction Hf; intros xx AA BB bs Hb Ep.
  - (* pf_bind: p = pvar x0, T = binding, U = T *)
    destruct bs as [|a bs].
    + simpl in Ep. injection Ep as Ex. subst xx.
      assert (HTeq : T = ∀(AA) BB) by (eapply binds_functional; eauto).
      subst T. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (@path_pvar_eq_cons x xx bs a Ep).
  - (* pf_fld *)
    destruct (@path_sel_cons_inv p xx a bs Ep) as [bs0 [Ebs Ep0]].
    subst bs.
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs0 Hb Ep0) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all : forall C x A B bs T U,
  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply flow_from_all_aux; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Resolving flows in the pushed context [G & x ~ μ T0].               *)
(* We build a [ResCore] for the heap [γ & x ~ ν(T0)ds] using only the   *)
(* entries/definitions components of [HInv], not its [wf] component.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma defs_at_weaken : forall (G:ctx) (x0:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) x S,
  x # G -> x <> x0 ->
  defs_at G x0 T0 ds ->
  defs_at (G & x ~ S) x0 T0 ds.
Proof.
  intros G x0 T0 ds x S Hx Hne Hd. unfold defs_at in *.
  eapply weaken_defs
    with (G1 := G) (G2 := x0 ~ open_typ_p (pvar x0) T0) (w := x) (S := S).
  - exact Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
    + exact Hx.
    + apply notin_singleton_l. intro E. apply Hne. auto.
Qed.

(* The [res_field] step does not actually use the [HInv] argument. *)
Lemma res_field_noinv : forall γ G p a U,
  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Sa [Ta E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0 (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) {a ⦂ U} H4 H5 (@rh_one {a ⦂ U})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + dependent destruction Hty.
      apply rc_alias with (q := open_rec_path_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) q).
      exact Hstep.
    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.
          - exact Hrt. }
        apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rc_lam with (v := λ(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                                    (open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv))
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.

exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* What app/bridge1 consumes: a natural-target witness gives a flow for the
   field path and the bridge witness. *)
Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
  nat_field_of_sub ->
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists W, G ⊢! (p • a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn.
  destruct (Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn) as [V [HnV [Hhas HVsub]]].
  exists V. split; [|split].
  - apply pf_fld with (T := R) (U := V).
    apply (@flow_record_has G p R U {a ⦂ V} Hf). exact Hhas.
  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
  - exact HVsub.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Head compatibility for natural types.

   [ty_def_path] types path fields at a singleton, [ty_def_all]/[ty_def_new]
   type value fields at an arrow/μ; hence actual record field types are
   exactly arrow, μ (record), or singleton, i.e. [nat_typ].  The residual
   below asks that subtyping between natural types preserves the head
   constructor; it is what remains of the O1 impasse after restricting to
   natural targets. *)

Lemma arrow_not_bnd : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma arrow_not_sngl : forall (q:path), ~ is_arrow {{ q }}.
Proof. intros q [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), μ T <> {{ q }}.
Proof. intros T q E. discriminate E. Qed.

(* The three heads of a natural type are mutually exclusive. *)
Definition nat_head_compat (G:ctx) (V T:typ) : Prop :=
  (is_arrow V /\ is_arrow T) \/
  ((exists U0, V = μ U0 /\ record_type U0) /\
   (exists T0, T = μ T0 /\ record_type T0)) \/
  ((exists q, V = {{ q }}) /\ (exists q', T = {{ q' }})).

(* Residual: natural-source / natural-target subtyping preserves the head.
   This is the "good/natural V <: natural T head-compatibility" fact. *)
Definition nat_sub_head_compat : Prop :=
  forall G V T,
    inert G -> nat_typ V -> nat_typ T -> G ⊢ V <: T ->
    nat_head_compat G V T.

(* Residual: path-typing coherence for actual record fields.  Combining the
   head-compatibility fact with the def-typing structure
   (ty_def_path vs ty_def_all/ty_def_new) is intended to prove
   [nat_field_of_sub]. *)
Definition path_field_coherence : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Notes on the tds/ts_mutind instantiation (not proved).

   The proposed plumbing

     P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
     P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U

   does make the [ty_sub] and [subtyp_trans] steps work exactly as noted:
   transport along one subtyping derivation uses the good witness at the
   source, and trans composes P0 with the typing [ty_sub Hty Hsub1] (P0 is
   universally quantified over typing proofs).

   Two independent obstacles prevent a shallow [Good]:

   1. [subtyp_sel2]: P0 at S <: p↓A must produce [Good q (p↓A)] for an
      *arbitrary* path q from [Good q S].  Hence [Good] must be closed
      upward under the very subtyping relation being defined (or carry the
      selection's record-typing provenance).  Making it upward closed
      (e.g. Good p T := forall B, T<:B -> Bridge p B) pushes the burden
      into every typing rule for all supertypes.

   2. [ty_and_intro]: with upward-closed Good, one needs [Bridge p (T∧U)]
      from [Bridge p T] and [Bridge p U]; but two precise/flow witnesses
      below T and below U need not combine to one below T∧U.  In pDOT the
      relevant target is never the intersection itself (the only use is
      through and11/and12 towards an arrow), so a correct invariant must be
      target-restricted rather than uniformly upward closed.

   These are the same two places where the O1/O3 analyses got stuck; the
   full solution is the paper's precise/tight semantic invariant, with the
   selection case carrying a lower-bound witness plus record-typing
   provenance (and [wf] supplying precise2 for singleton alias targets). *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_sgood.
Close Scope string_scope.

Definition ArrowCl (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.

Lemma ArrowCl_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf V Hsub Har.
  exists U. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p U). apply (@pt2 G p R U). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi Hf).
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc Htu V Huv Har. apply Hc; [eapply subtyp_trans; eauto | exact Har]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_self : forall γ G p T,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> is_arrow T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T Hc Har. eapply Hc; [apply subtyp_refl | exact Har]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har. apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact Htv]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har. apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact Htv]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q T,
  ArrowCl γ G q T -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q T Hc Hp V Hsub Har.
  destruct (Hc V Hsub Har) as [U0 [Hp3 [Hfs Hs]]].
  exists U0. split; [|split].
  - eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp | exact Hp3].
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hs.
Qed.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) /\
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}).

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts :
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) ->
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}) ->
  SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Gfld Grcd Gmu Gopen Gand Gsngl Gprec2 Gpath γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_flow; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_sub; [apply IHHs|exact H]|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gfld γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Grcd γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gmu γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gand γ G p T U Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_l; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_r; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gsngl γ G p q Hi H) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Gprec2 γ G p q Hi Hs1)) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gpath γ G p q a T Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
Qed.

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps -> SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hg. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts.
  - exact (proj1 Hg).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 Hg)).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood :
  SGood_arrow_closure ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hcl γ G p S T Hi Hs.
  eapply ArrowCl_self; [eapply Hcl; [exact Hi | exact Hs] | exists S, T; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof. intros Hg. apply bridge1_of_SGood. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps. exact Hg. Qed.

Lemma ordinary_arrow_bridge_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg γ G p S T Hi Hty.
  eapply bridge1_of_SGood_gaps; [exact Hg|exact Hi|].
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.

The typing rules force it. Maybe we should prove the bridge statements directly rather than these subtyping facts! The task insists on the four facts though.

But note: the facts are about *subtyping*, which doesn't mention γ. Yet HInv's store components are essential (as shown). So we need to use: `HInv γ G` includes for each binding x~T0 in G, either T0 is an arrow (with a λ in store) or T0 is μ T0' with store ν and defs_at.

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec),
  record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_has_label_in : forall (T:typ) ls (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of_dec D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. revert D.
  induction Hrt; intros Dx Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *)
    inversion Hhas; subst; apply in_singleton_self'.
  - (* rt_cons *)
    inversion Hhas; subst.
    + (* from the left component *)
      apply in_union_l. eapply IHHrt; eauto.
    + (* from the right component *)
      apply in_union_r.
      match goal with
      | HR : record_has (typ_rcd ?DD) _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite E
      end.
      apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_typ_unique : forall (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W1 W2,
  record_type U ->
  record_has U { A >: W1 <: W1 } ->
  record_has U { A >: W2 <: W2 } ->
  W1 = W2.
Proof.
  intros U A W1 W2 [ls Hrt]. revert A W1 W2.
  induction Hrt; intros A W1 W2 Hrec1 Hrec2.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hrec1; subst; inversion Hrec2; subst; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *)
    destruct (classic (label_typ A = label_of_dec D)) as [El|En].
    + (* both occurrences are the right component *)
      assert (Hr1 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
          change (label_of_dec { A >: W1 <: W1 } \in ls).
          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
        - assumption. }
      assert (Hr2 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
          change (label_of_dec { A >: W2 <: W2 } \in ls).
          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
        - assumption. }
      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr1) as E1.
      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr2) as E2.
      rewrite <- E2 in E1. injection E1 as E. exact E.
    + (* both occurrences are the left component *)
      assert (Hl1 : record_has T { A >: W1 <: W1 }).

        - assumption.
        - exfalso. apply En.

      assert (Hl2 : record_has T { A >: W2 <: W2 }).

      eapply IHHrt; eauto.
Qed.

(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros GG x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) GG).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G := GG & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & (empty:ctx))
         (G1 := GG) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow.
  assert (HinC : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  destruct (@flow_sngl_source (G & x ~ μ T0) (p_sel (avar_f x) bs)
              {{ q }} {{ q }} HinC Hflow q eq_refl)
    as [_ [p0 [a [R [Ep Hf0]]]]].
  pose proof (@flow_res_push γ G x T0 ds (G & x ~ μ T0) Hi Hx Hrt
                eq_refl Hdefs p0 R (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) Hf0) as Rc.
  destruct (@rescore_sngl_field_path_typed (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds)
              (G & x ~ μ T0) p0 a q Rc)
    as [x0 [Vc [C [bs0 [T0' [ds' [Tq [EC [Hb Hty]]]]]]]]].
  exists Tq.
  eapply (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x0 Vc q Tq Hb).
  rewrite <- EC. exact Hty.
Qed.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)


Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0))
    by (exact (@binds_push_eq typ x (μ T0) G)).
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.
  exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T0) p T Hin Hty').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  dependent destruction Hval.
  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
Qed.

(* The same statement, specialised to the exact hypothesis layout that the
   scratch [hp.v] parameter uses, for easy integration. *)
Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

(* Final assembly: only the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge remains. *)
Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof.
  intro Hpath.
  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
Qed.

(* Integration note.  Once the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge
   [inert_path_precise_bridge] is discharged (by this worker or another),
   the exact scratch parameter is recovered by

     Lemma wf_push_cond : wf_push_cond_statement :=
       wf_push_cond_of_path_precise <proof-of-bridge>.

   [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof] proves the flow-to-stored-path
   typing step without using the [wf] component of [HInv] or the old
   scratch parameter.  The only remaining hypothesis is the shared
   ordinary-path-precision fact for inert contexts. *)
