Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@rcd_record_type_shape a U). exact H.
  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + apply fs_rec. apply (@record_type_open_p U p).
      match goal with Hr : record_type U |- _ => exact Hr end.
    + exfalso.
      match goal with Hr : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
        exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U Hr) end.
  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_l U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_r U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
Qed.

(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)

(* Shape of [repl_typ] targets: arrow targets come from arrow sources, *)
(* and [⊥] is never a replacement target.                               *)

Lemma repl_typ_arrow_l : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> is_arrow T' -> is_arrow T.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H; intros Har.
  - exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).

  - exists T1, U. reflexivity.

Lemma repl_typ_not_bot : forall p q T,

(* Lifting an arrow-source classification forward along a subtyping    *)
(* step of the target.                                                *)

Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
  - left. exact Harr.
  - right. left. exact Hbot.
  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
  - right. right. right. subst S.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Hsplit as [Hs | Hs]; [left | right];
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

(*                                                                     *)
(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift -> arrow_source_class.

Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Lemma arrow_source_class_of_lifts :
  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift -> arrow_source_class.
Proof.
  intros HA HB γ0 G0 S0 U0 Hi0 Hsub0 Har0.
  revert γ0 Hi0 Har0.
  induction Hsub0 using subtyp_ind; intros γ Hi Har.
  - (* top *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E]; [exact (False_ind _ (top_not_arrow Har)) | discriminate E].
  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *)

    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Har.
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. symmetry. exact E.
  - (* trans *)

    destruct Hclass as [HarrT | [HbotT | [HpathT | [T1 [T2 [ET Hsplit]]]]]].
    + (* T arrow: use IH on the first premise *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The four HInv-aware subtyping facts blocking Q/Q2.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Note: [rcd_no_arrow] and [bnd_no_arrow] below are the *existing*     *)
(* agent_q.v residual Definitions.  [and_arrow_split_H] is the         *)
(* HInv-carrying variant of agent_q's HInv-free [and_arrow_split]      *)
(* (the HInv-free version is not provable).                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition and_arrow_split_H : Prop :=
  forall γ G T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: U -> is_arrow U ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.

(* A uniform, complete classification of the sources of an arrow          *)
(* supertype.  It is exactly the statement that the four facts record,    *)
(* for the four "rigid" source heads, plus the two remaining source kinds *)
(* (bottom / path selections) that can legitimately sit below an arrow.   *)
Definition ArrowSrc (G:ctx) (S U:typ) : Prop :=
    is_arrow S \/
    S = ⊥ \/
    (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
    (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 /\ (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U)).

Definition arrow_source_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G S U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Disjointness helpers.                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sngl_not_arrow : forall (p:path), ~ is_arrow ({{ p }}).
Proof. intros p [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_arrow : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rcd_not_arrow : forall D, ~ is_arrow (typ_rcd D).
Proof. intros D [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma and_not_arrow : forall T U, ~ is_arrow (T ∧ U).
Proof. intros T U [S [U' E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bot_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊥). 
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma top_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊤).
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma path_not_arrow : forall (p:path) (A:typ_label), ~ is_arrow (p ↓ A).
Proof. intros p A [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

(* A source of a conjunction supertype can be split, given the class. *)
Lemma and_split_of_class : arrow_source_class -> and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) U Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE Hsplit]]]]]].
  - exfalso. exact (and_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - injection HE as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> rcd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G a S V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> bnd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> forall γ G q V,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Shape of [repl_typ] targets: arrow targets come from arrow sources, *)
(* and [⊥] is never a replacement target.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_arrow_l : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> is_arrow T' -> is_arrow T.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H; intros Har.
  - exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (bnd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exists T1, U. reflexivity.
  - exists U, T1. reflexivity.
  - exact (False_ind _ (sngl_not_arrow Har)).
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_not_bot : forall p q T,
  repl_typ p q T ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros p q T H. dependent destruction H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lifting an arrow-source classification forward along a subtyping    *)
(* step of the target.                                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
  - left. exact Harr.
  - right. left. exact Hbot.
  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
  - right. right. right. subst S.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Hsplit as [Hs | Hs]; [left | right];
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The two exact residual "target-lift" facts.                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Star/step reduction of the path-target lift.                        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We follow the [subtyp_step] star from the source S to the selection *)
(* [p↓A].  The two non-structural steps are:                           *)
(*  - [st_sel2], where the source is the lower bound of a record view: *)
(*    this is the exact selection-detour residual ([sel_lower_class]); *)
(*  - [st_and2], where the source is composed into a conjunction: this *)
(*    is exactly the conjunction-target residual ([and_target_lift]).   *)
(* All other steps are structural / syntactic.                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sel_lower_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) S T U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    G ⊢ T <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Lemma star_subtyp_step_sub : forall G X Y,
  star (subtyp_step G) X Y -> G ⊢ X <: Y.
Proof.
  intros G X Y H. induction H as [| X V Hstep Hrest IH].
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_step_subtyp; exact Hstep | exact IH].
Qed.

(* Replacement transport for [ArrowSrc], using the singleton-typing
   premises to re-derive the component subtypings. *)
Lemma ArrowSrc_sngl_step : forall G p q S V U W0,
  G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : W0 ->
  repl_typ p q S V ->
  ArrowSrc G V U -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G p q S V U W0 Hp Hq Hrepl HAs.
  dependent destruction Hrepl.
  - (* rrcd *) exfalso.
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rand1: S = T1 ∧ U0, V = T2 ∧ U0 *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2.
      unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T1, U. split; [reflexivity|].
      destruct Hsplit as [H2U | HU0U].
      * left. eapply subtyp_trans.
        -- eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hp | exact Hq | exact H].
        -- exact H2U.
      * right. exact HU0U.
  - (* rand2: S = U0 ∧ T1, V = U0 ∧ T2 *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2.
      unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists U, T1. split; [reflexivity|].
      destruct Hsplit as [HU0U | H2U].
      * left. exact HU0U.
      * right. eapply subtyp_trans.
        -- eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hp | exact Hq | exact H].
        -- exact H2U.
  - (* rpath *) 
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exact Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rbnd *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (bnd_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rall1: S = ∀(T1) U0, V = ∀(T2) U0 *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists T1, U0. reflexivity.
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rall2: S = ∀(U0) T1, V = ∀(U0) T2 *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists U0, T1. reflexivity.
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rsngl *)
    exfalso.
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + discriminate E.
Qed.

(* The one-step backward classification lemma. *)
Lemma ArrowSrc_step_back :
  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class ->
  forall G S V U,
    subtyp_step G S V ->
    G ⊢ V <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G V U ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros Hand Hsel G S V U Hstep HVU Har HAs.
  dependent destruction Hstep.
  - (* st_top: V = ⊤ *) exfalso.
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + discriminate Hpath. + discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot: S = ⊥ *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* st_refl: S = V *) exact HAs.
  - (* st_and11: S = T ∧ U0, V = T *)
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. left. exact HVU.
  - (* st_and12: S = T ∧ U0, V = U0 *)
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. right. exact HVU.
  - (* st_and2: V = T ∧ U0, with S <: T and S <: U0 *)
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate Hpath.
    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2.
      exact (Hand G S T U0 U Hi (subtyp_and2 H H0) Hsplit Har).
  - (* st_fld: V = rcd {a ⦂ T} *) exfalso.
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + discriminate Hpath. + discriminate E.
  - (* st_typ: V = rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} *) exfalso.
    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + discriminate Hpath. + discriminate E.
  - (* st_sngl_pq *)
    eapply ArrowSrc_sngl_step; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact HAs].
  - (* st_sngl_qp *)
    eapply ArrowSrc_sngl_step; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact HAs].
  - (* st_sel2: S = S0, V = p↓A, typing premise p : rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} *)
    exact (Hsel G G0 p A S T U Hi H HVU Har).
  - (* st_sel1: S = p↓A *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* st_all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma path_target_lift_of_residuals :
  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class -> path_target_lift.
Proof.
  intros Hand Hsel γ G S p A U Hi Hsub Hcont Har.
  pose proof (subtyp_star_step G S (p ↓ A) Hsub) as Hstar.
  revert U Hcont Har.
  induction Hstar as [| X V Hstep Hrest IH]; intros U Hcont Har.
  - unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - assert (HVs : G ⊢ V <: p ↓ A) by (apply star_subtyp_step_sub; exact Hrest).
    assert (HVU : G ⊢ V <: U) by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
    pose proof (IH U Hcont Har) as HV.
    eapply ArrowSrc_step_back; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->

(* Q3: an SGood-shaped invariant carrying a precise2 witness.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Prec2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

Definition Q3 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  SGood γ G p T /\ Prec2 γ G p.

Lemma Q3_to_SGood : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T [Hs _]. exact Hs. Qed.

Lemma Q3_prec2 : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p.
Proof. intros γ G p T [_ Hp]. exact Hp. Qed.

Lemma Q3_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Q3 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q3 γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [Hs Hp] Hsub. split; [|exact Hp].
  eapply sg_sub; eassumption.

  (forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p) ->
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q3 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs. split; [exact Hs | apply (Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs)].
Qed.

  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->

  pose proof (SGood_arrow_closure_of_four Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec
                γ G p T Hi Hs) as Hcl.
  exact (Hcl U Hsub Har).
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences.

Require Import Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Close Scope string_scope.

Section Safety.

Reserved Notation "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" (at level 40, T at level 20).

Inductive lookup_fields_typ : var -> typ -> list trm_label -> typ -> Prop :=
| lft_empty : forall x T,
    x ==> T =nil=> T
| lft_cons : forall T bs U x a S,
    x ==> T =bs=> μ U ->
    record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) U) {a ⦂ S} ->
    x ==> T =a::bs=> S

where "x '==>' T '=' bs '=>' U" := (lookup_fields_typ x T bs U).

Definition diverges := infseq red.

Theorem safety t T :
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  diverges (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, (empty, t) ⟼* (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).

End Safety.

138	Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
139	  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
140	Proof.
141	  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
142	  - left. exact Harr.
143	  - right. left. exact Hbot.
144	  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
145	  - right. right. right. subst S.

151	(* ================================================================== *)
152	(* The two exact residual "target-lift" facts.                         *)
153	(*                                                                     *)
154	(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
155	(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
156	(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
157	(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
158	(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
159	(* ================================================================== *)
160	
161	Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
162	  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
163	    HInv γ G ->
164	    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
165	    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
166	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
167	    ArrowSrc G S U.
168	
169	Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
170	  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
171	    HInv γ G ->
172	    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
173	    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
174	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
175	    ArrowSrc G S U.

177	Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts :
178	  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift ->
179	  forall γ G S U,
180	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
181	Proof.
182	  intros HA HB γ0 G0 S0 U0 Hi0 Hsub0 Har0.
183	  revert γ0 Hi0 Har0.
184	  induction Hsub0 using subtyp_ind; intros γ Hi Har.
185	  - (* top *) 
186	    destruct Har as [Har | E]; [exact (False_ind _ (top_not_arrow Har)) | discriminate E].
187	  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
188	  - (* refl *) 
189	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
190	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Har.
191	    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact E.
192	  - (* trans *) 
193	    pose proof (IHHsub0_2 γ Hi Har) as Hclass.
194	    destruct Hclass as [HarrT | [HbotT | [HpathT | [T1 [T2 [ET Hsplit]]]]]].
195	    + (* T arrow: use IH on the first premise *)
196	      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_introl HarrT)) as HC1.
197	      eapply ArrowSrc_lift; [exact HC1 | exact Hsub0_2 | exact Har].
198	    + (* T = bot: use IH on first premise at target bot *)
199	      subst T.
200	      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_intror eq_refl)) as HC1.
201	      eapply ArrowSrc_lift; [exact HC1 | exact Hsub0_2 | exact Har].
202	    + (* T path: residual HA *)
203	      destruct HpathT as [p [A ET]]. subst T.
204	      exact (HA γ G S p A U Hi Hsub0_1 Hsub0_2 Har).
205	    + (* T conjunction: residual HB *)
206	      subst T.
207	      exact (HB γ G S T1 T2 U Hi Hsub0_1 Hsplit Har).
208	  - (* and11 *) 
209	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
210	    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
211	    + subst T. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists (⊥), U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
212	  - (* and12 *)
213	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
214	    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.
215	    + subst U. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, (⊥). split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.
216	  - (* and2 *)
217	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
218	    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
219	    + discriminate E.
220	  - (* fld *)
221	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
222	    + exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
223	    + discriminate E.
224	  - (* typ *)
225	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
226	    + exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
227	    + discriminate E.
228	  - (* sngl_pq *)
229	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
230	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
231	    + subst T'. exact (False_ind _ (repl_typ_not_bot H1)).
232	  - (* sngl_qp *)
233	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
234	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
235	    + subst T'. exact (False_ind _ (repl_typ_not_bot H1)).
236	  - (* sel2 *)
237	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
238	    + exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Har)).
239	    + discriminate E.
240	  - (* sel1 *)
241	    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
242	  - (* all *)
243	    unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
244	Qed.

246	Lemma arrow_source_class_of_lifts :
247	  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift -> arrow_source_class.
248	Proof.
249	  intros HA HB γ G S U Hi H Harr.
250	  exact (@arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts HA HB γ G S U Hi H (or_introl Harr)).
251	Qed.

254	(* Star/step reduction of the path-target lift.                        *)
255	(*                                                                     *)
256	(* We follow the [subtyp_step] star from the source S to the selection *)
257	(* [p↓A].  The two non-structural steps are:                           *)
258	(*  - [st_sel2], where the source is the lower bound of a record view: *)
259	(*    this is the exact selection-detour residual ([sel_lower_class]); *)
260	(*  - [st_and2], where the source is composed into a conjunction: this *)
261	(*    is exactly the conjunction-target residual ([and_target_lift]).   *)
262	(* All other steps are structural / syntactic.                          *)
263	(* ================================================================== *)
264	
265	Definition sel_lower_class : Prop :=
266	  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) S T U,
267	    HInv γ G ->
268	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
269	    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
270	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
271	    ArrowSrc G S U.

273	Lemma star_subtyp_step_sub : forall G X Y,
274	  star (subtyp_step G) X Y -> G ⊢ X <: Y.
275	Proof.
276	  intros G X Y H. induction H as [| X V Z Hstep Hrest IH].
277	  - apply subtyp_refl.
278	  - eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_step_subtyp; exact Hstep | exact IH].
279	Qed.

316	      destruct Hsplit as [HU0U | H2U].
317	      * left. exact HU0U.
318	      * right. eapply subtyp_trans.
319	        -- eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hp | exact Hq | exact Hrepl].
320	        -- exact H2U.
321	  - (* rpath *) 
322	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
323	    + exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Harr)).
324	    + discriminate Hbot.
325	    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. eexists _, _. reflexivity.
326	    + discriminate E.

328	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].

335	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists T1, U0. reflexivity.
336	    + discriminate Hbot.
337	    + destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]. discriminate Ep.
338	    + discriminate E.
339	  - (* rall2: S = ∀(U0) T1, V = ∀(U0) T2 *)
340	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
341	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists U0, T1. reflexivity.
342	    + discriminate Hbot.
343	    + destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]. discriminate Ep.
344	    + discriminate E.
345	  - (* rsngl *)
346	    exfalso.
347	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].

349	    + discriminate Hbot.

425	(* The one-step backward classification lemma. *)
426	Lemma ArrowSrc_step_back :
427	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class ->
428	  forall γ G S V U,
429	    HInv γ G ->
430	    subtyp_step G S V ->
431	    G ⊢ V <: U ->
432	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
433	    ArrowSrc G V U ->
434	    ArrowSrc G S U.
435	Proof.
436	  intros Hand Hsel γ G S V U Hi Hstep HVU Har HAs.
437	  dependent destruction Hstep.
438	  - (* st_top: V = ⊤ *) exfalso.
439	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
440	    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
441	  - (* st_bot: S = ⊥ *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
442	  - (* st_refl: S = V *) exact HAs.
443	  - (* st_and11: S = T ∧ U0, V = T *)
444	    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. left. exact HVU.
445	  - (* st_and12: S = T ∧ U0, V = U0 *)
446	    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. right. exact HVU.
447	  - (* st_and2: V = T ∧ U0, with S <: T and S <: U0 *)
448	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
449	    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
450	    + discriminate Hbot.
451	    + destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]. discriminate Ep.
452	    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2.
453	      exact (Hand γ G S T U0 U Hi (subtyp_and2 H H0) Hsplit Har).
454	  - (* st_fld: V = rcd {a ⦂ T} *) exfalso.
455	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
456	    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
457	  - (* st_typ: V = rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} *) exfalso.
458	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
459	    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
460	  - (* st_sngl_pq *)
461	    exact (@ArrowSrc_sngl_step G p q T T' U U0 H H0 H1 HAs).
462	  - (* st_sngl_qp *)
463	    exact (@ArrowSrc_sngl_step_qp G p q T T' U U0 H H0 H1 HAs).
464	  - (* st_sel2: S = S0, V = p↓A, typing premise p : rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} *)
465	    exact (Hsel γ G p A S T U Hi H HVU Har).
466	  - (* st_sel1: S = p↓A *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
467	  - (* st_all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
468	Qed.

470	Lemma ArrowSrc_star_back :
471	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class ->
472	  forall γ G S T,
473	    HInv γ G ->
474	    star (subtyp_step G) S T ->
475	    forall U,
476	      G ⊢ T <: U ->
477	      (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
478	      ArrowSrc G T U ->
479	      ArrowSrc G S U.
480	Proof.
481	  intros Hand Hsel γ G S T Hi Hstar.
482	  induction Hstar as [| X V Z Hstep Hrest IH]; intros U HTU Har HAs.
483	  - exact HAs.
484	  - assert (HVT : G ⊢ V <: Z) by (apply star_subtyp_step_sub; exact Hrest).
485	    assert (HVU : G ⊢ V <: U) by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HVT | exact HTU]).
486	    eapply ArrowSrc_step_back;
487	      [exact Hand | exact Hsel | exact Hi | exact Hstep | exact HVU | exact Har |].
488	    apply (IH U HTU Har HAs).
489	Qed.

491	Lemma path_target_lift_of_residuals :
492	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class -> path_target_lift.
493	Proof.
494	  intros Hand Hsel γ G S p A U Hi Hsub Hcont Har.
495	  pose proof (@subtyp_star_step G S (p ↓ A) Hsub) as Hstar.
496	  eapply (@ArrowSrc_star_back Hand Hsel γ G S (p ↓ A) Hi Hstar U Hcont Har).
497	  unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
498	Qed.

501	   from the two residuals isolated above. *)
502	Lemma arrow_source_class_of_residuals :
503	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class -> arrow_source_class.
504	Proof.
505	  intros Hand Hsel.
506	  apply arrow_source_class_of_lifts.
507	  - apply path_target_lift_of_residuals; assumption.
508	  - exact Hand.
509	Qed.

511	Lemma rcd_no_arrow_holds :
512	  arrow_source_class -> rcd_no_arrow.
513	Proof. exact rcd_no_arrow_of_class. Qed.
514	
515	Lemma bnd_no_arrow_holds :
516	  arrow_source_class -> bnd_no_arrow.
517	Proof. exact bnd_no_arrow_of_class. Qed.
518	
519	Lemma sngl_no_arrow_holds :
520	  arrow_source_class -> forall γ G q V,
521	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
522	Proof. exact sngl_no_arrow_of_class. Qed.
523	
524	Lemma and_arrow_split_H_holds :
525	  arrow_source_class -> and_arrow_split_H.
526	Proof. exact and_split_of_class. Qed.
527	
528	(* ================================================================== *)
529	(* Route A: the four facts close three of agent_q's Q2 residuals.      *)
530	(* ================================================================== *)
531	
532	Lemma Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split_H :
533	  and_arrow_split_H -> Q2_and_intro_cl.
534	Proof.
535	  intros Hsplit γ G p T U Hi HT HU. apply q2_intro.
536	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
537	    destruct (Hsplit γ G T U V Hi Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
538	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V HTV Har).
539	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p U HU V HUV Har).
540	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
541	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst T1. subst T2.
542	    split; assumption.
543	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
544	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
545	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
546	Qed.
547	
548	(* The three structural residuals are discharged by the four facts; the
549	   two analytic residuals [Q2_sub_cl] and [Q2_sngl_trans_cl] (the latter
550	   further reduced by agent_q to [Q2_mu_open_transport] and
551	   [Q2_prec2_sngl_trans]) remain. *)
552	Lemma Q2_residuals_of_class :
553	  arrow_source_class ->
554	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
555	  Q2_residuals.
556	Proof.
557	  intros HC Hsub Hmu Hs2.
558	  pose proof (rcd_no_arrow_of_class HC) as Hrcd.
559	  pose proof (bnd_no_arrow_of_class HC) as Hbnd.
560	  pose proof (and_split_of_class HC) as Hand.
561	  unfold Q2_residuals.
562	  split; [exact Hsub |].
563	  split; [apply (Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu Hmu Hs2) |].
564	  split; [exact (@Q2_path_elim_cl_proof) |].
565	  split; [apply (Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hrcd) |].
566	  split; [apply (Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hbnd) |].
567	  split; [apply (Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split_H Hand) |].
568	  exact (@Q2_sngl_cl_proof).
569	Qed.
570	
571	(* Package the ordinary-arrow precise3 bridge from Q2 residuals. *)
572	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
573	  Q2_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
574	Proof.
575	  intros Hres γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
576	  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
577	  pose proof (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p A Hi Hs) as HQ.
578	  exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p A HQ A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
579	Qed.
580	
581	(* And the precise2-existence theorem, exactly as in agent_q. *)
582	Lemma HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_class :
583	  arrow_source_class ->
584	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
585	  forall γ G p T,
586	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
587	Proof.
588	  intros HC Hsub Hmu Hs2.
589	  apply HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
590	  apply Q2_residuals_of_class; assumption.
591	Qed.
592	
593	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_class :
594	  arrow_source_class ->
595	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
596	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
597	Proof.
598	  intros HC Hsub Hmu Hs2.
599	  apply ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
600	  apply Q2_residuals_of_class; assumption.
601	Qed.
602	
603	(* ================================================================== *)
604	(* Route B: SGood arrow closure (Q3-shaped) from the four facts plus   *)
605	(* the three ordinary-path precision residuals.                        *)
606	(* ================================================================== *)
607	
608	Definition sngl_no_arrow_H : Prop :=
609	  forall γ G (q:path) V,
610	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
611	
612	Definition SGood_field_prec : Prop :=
613	  forall γ G p a S,
614	    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) -> ArrowCl γ G (p • a) S.
615	
616	Definition SGood_open_prec : Prop :=
617	  forall γ G p T0,
618	    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) -> ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
619	
620	Definition SGood_sngl_prec : Prop :=
621	  forall γ G p q,
622	    HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
623	
624	Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_four :
625	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
626	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
627	  SGood_arrow_closure.
628	Proof.
629	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p T Hi Hs.
630	  induction Hs; intros V Hsub Har.
631	  - (* sg_flow *) exists U. split; [|split].
632	    + apply (@pt3 G p U). apply (@pt2 G p R U). exact H.
633	    + apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi H).
634	    + exact Hsub.
635	  - (* sg_sub *) exact (IHHs V (subtyp_trans H Hsub) Har).
636	  - (* sg_new_elim *) apply (Hfld γ G p a T Hi Hs); assumption.
637	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) exfalso.
638	    exact (Hrcd γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har).
639	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) exfalso.
640	    exact (Hbnd γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har).
641	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) apply (Hopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs); assumption.
642	  - (* sg_and_intro *) 
643	    destruct (Hand γ G T U V Hi Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
644	    + exact (IHHs1 V HTV Har).
645	    + exact (IHHs2 V HUV Har).
646	  - (* sg_and_l *) apply (ArrowCl_and_l IHHs); assumption.
647	  - (* sg_and_r *) apply (ArrowCl_and_r IHHs); assumption.
648	  - (* sg_sngl *) exfalso.
649	    exact (Hsngl γ G q V Hi Hsub Har).
650	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) 
651	    apply (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Hsnglprec γ G p q Hi Hs1)); assumption.
652	  - (* sg_path_elim *) exfalso.
653	    exact (Hsngl γ G (q • a) V Hi Hsub Har).
654	Qed.
655	
656	(* The packaged bridge via Route B. *)
657	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four :
658	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
659	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
660	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
661	Proof.
662	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
663	  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
664	  pose proof (@SGood_arrow_closure_of_four Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec
665	                γ G p A Hi Hs) as Hcl.
666	  exact (Hcl A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
667	Qed.
668	
669	(* ================================================================== *)
670	(* Q3: an SGood-shaped invariant carrying a precise2 witness.          *)
671	(* ================================================================== *)
672	
673	Definition Prec2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) : Prop :=
674	  exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
675	
676	Definition Q3 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
677	  SGood γ G p T /\ Prec2 γ G p.
678	
679	Lemma Q3_to_SGood : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> SGood γ G p T.
680	Proof. intros γ G p T [Hs _]. exact Hs. Qed.
681	
682	Lemma Q3_prec2 : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p.
683	Proof. intros γ G p T [_ Hp]. exact Hp. Qed.
684	
685	Lemma Q3_sub : forall γ G p T U,
686	  Q3 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q3 γ G p U.
687	Proof.
688	  intros γ G p T U [Hs Hp] Hsub. split; [|exact Hp].
689	  eapply sg_sub; eassumption.
690	Qed.
691	
692	Lemma SGood_to_Q3 :
693	  (forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p) ->
694	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q3 γ G p T.
695	Proof.
696	  intros Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs. split; [exact Hs | apply (Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs)].
697	Qed.
698	
699	Lemma Q3_arrow :
700	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
701	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
702	  forall γ G p T,
703	    HInv γ G -> Q3 γ G p T ->
704	    forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
705	Proof.
706	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p T Hi [Hs _] U Hsub Har.
707	  pose proof (@SGood_arrow_closure_of_four Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec
708	                γ G p T Hi Hs) as Hcl.
709	  exact (Hcl U Hsub Har).
710	Qed.
711	
712	(* ================================================================== *)
713	(* Exact residual characterisation.                                    *)
714	(*                                                                     *)
715	(* [sel_lower_class] and [and_target_lift] are *equivalent* to the     *)
716	(* complete classification [arrow_source_class_gen] (the arrow-or-bot  *)
717	(* variant).  One direction is the reduction above; the other is        *)
718	(* immediate by transitivity, recorded here.  So no smaller structural  *)
719	(* fact remains: the missing ingredient is exactly the HInv/tight-      *)
720	(* member analysis of the selection detour (for [sel_lower_class]) and  *)
721	(* the transport of the component split through conjunction sources     *)
722	(* (for [and_target_lift]).                                             *)
723	(* ================================================================== *)
724	
725	Definition arrow_source_class_gen : Prop :=
726	  forall γ G S U,
727	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
728	
729	Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals :
730	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class -> arrow_source_class_gen.
731	Proof.
732	  intros Hand Hsel. unfold arrow_source_class_gen.
733	  exact (arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts
734	           (path_target_lift_of_residuals Hand Hsel) Hand).
735	Qed.
736	
737	Lemma and_target_lift_of_gen :
738	  arrow_source_class_gen -> and_target_lift.
739	Proof.
740	  intros Hclass γ G S T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Hsplit Har.
741	  assert (HSU : G ⊢ S <: U).
742	  { destruct Hsplit as [HT1U | HT2U].
743	    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub |].
744	      eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact HT1U].
745	    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub |].
746	      eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact HT2U]. }
747	  exact (Hclass γ G S U Hi HSU Har).
748	Qed.
749	
750	Lemma sel_lower_class_of_gen :
751	  arrow_source_class_gen -> sel_lower_class.
752	Proof.
753	  intros Hclass γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
754	  assert (HSU : G ⊢ S <: U).
755	  { eapply subtyp_trans; [apply (@subtyp_sel2 G p A S T Hty) | exact Hcont]. }
756	  exact (Hclass γ G S U Hi HSU Har).
757	Qed.
758	
759	(* ================================================================== *)
760	(* Direct packaging from the four named facts (without the uniform     *)
761	(* classification).   [sngl_no_arrow_H] is needed only by Route B.      *)
762	(* ================================================================== *)
763	
764	Lemma Q2_residuals_of_four :
765	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
766	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
767	  Q2_residuals.
768	Proof.
769	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
770	  unfold Q2_residuals.
771	  split; [exact Hsub |].
772	  split; [apply (Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu Hmu Hs2) |].
773	  split; [exact (@Q2_path_elim_cl_proof) |].
774	  split; [apply (Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hrcd) |].
775	  split; [apply (Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hbnd) |].
776	  split; [apply (Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split_H Hand) |].
777	  exact (@Q2_sngl_cl_proof).
778	Qed.
779	
780	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four_facts :
781	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
782	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
783	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
784	Proof.
785	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
786	  apply ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
787	  apply Q2_residuals_of_four; assumption.
788	Qed.
789	
790	Lemma HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_four_facts :
791	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
792	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
793	  forall γ G p T,
794	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
795	Proof.
796	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
797	  apply HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
798	  apply Q2_residuals_of_four; assumption.
799	Qed.
800	
801	(* ================================================================== *)
802	(* Assumption audit (no axioms; only the two label Parameters from     *)
803	(* the ambient Definitions).  Uncomment to inspect:                    *)
804	(* Print Assumptions ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four.           *)
805	(* ================================================================== *)
806	
807	(* The exact frontier: the two isolated residuals are together
808	   equivalent to the complete arrow-or-bot source classification. *)
809	Lemma residuals_iff_class_gen :
810	  (and_target_lift /\ sel_lower_class) <-> arrow_source_class_gen.
811	Proof.
812	  split.
813	  - intros [Hand Hsel]. apply arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals; assumption.
814	  - intros Hgen. split.
815	    + apply and_target_lift_of_gen. exact Hgen.
816	    + apply sel_lower_class_of_gen. exact Hgen.
817	Qed.

19	(* [sngl_trans] q2_prec2 clauses constructible (it supplies the first   *)
20	(* premise of [pt2_sngl_trans]); precise3 is recovered by [pt3].         *)

25	Inductive Q2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
26	| q2_intro : forall p T,
27	    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
28	    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S) ->
29	    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2) ->

36	Lemma Q2_arrow : forall γ G p T,
37	  Q2 γ G p T -> forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
38	Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact Har. Qed.

41	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S.
42	Proof. intros γ G p T a S H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hfld a S). Qed.
43	
44	Lemma Q2_and : forall γ G p T T1 T2,
45	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2.
46	Proof. intros γ G p T T1 T2 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hand T1 T2). Qed.
47	
48	Lemma Q2_bnd : forall γ G p T T0,
49	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
50	Proof. intros γ G p T T0 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hbnd T0). Qed.

52	Lemma Q2_sngl : forall γ G p T q,
53	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
54	Proof. intros γ G p T q H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hsng q). Qed.
55	
56	Lemma Q2_prec2 : forall γ G p T,

60	(* Precise3 version of the singleton payload. *)
61	Lemma Q2_sngl3 : forall γ G p q,
62	  Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.

67	(* ================================================================== *)
68	(* Flow base: a precise flow output is Q2 at arbitrary fuel-bounded    *)
69	(* type size.  (Adapted from [Q_of_flow_ge].)                          *)
70	(* ================================================================== *)
71	
72	Lemma Q2_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
73	  g_typ_size T <= N ->
74	  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.

79	    + (* top *) apply q2_intro.
80	      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
81	        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
82	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
83	        -- exact HTU.
84	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
85	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
86	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
87	      * intros q E. discriminate E.
88	      * exists ⊤. apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
89	    + (* bot *) exfalso.
90	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
91	      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
92	    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
93	      * (* dec_typ *) apply q2_intro.
94	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
95	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
96	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
97	           ++ exact HU0.
98	        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
99	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
100	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
101	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
102	        -- exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
103	      * (* dec_trm *) apply q2_intro.
104	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
105	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
106	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
107	           ++ exact HU0.
108	        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
109	           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
110	           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
111	           ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
112	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
113	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
114	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
115	        -- exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
116	    + (* and *) apply q2_intro.
117	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
118	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
119	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
120	        -- exact HU0.

123	        split.

125	           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
126	        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
127	           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
128	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
129	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
130	      * exists (T1 ∧ T2). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
131	    + (* path *) exfalso.
132	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
133	      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
134	    + (* bnd *) apply q2_intro.
135	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
136	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
137	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
138	        -- exact HU0.
139	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
140	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
141	      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
142	        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
143	        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
144	        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
145	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
146	      * exists (μ T0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
147	    + (* all *) apply q2_intro.
148	      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
149	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
150	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
151	        -- exact HV0.
152	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
153	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
154	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
155	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
156	      * exists (∀(S0) U0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
157	    + (* sngl *) apply q2_intro.
158	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
159	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
160	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
161	        -- exact HU0.
162	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
163	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
164	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
165	      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
166	        apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
167	      * exists ({{ q0 }}). apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
168	Qed.
169	
170	Lemma Q2_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
171	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
172	Proof.
173	  intros. eapply (Q2_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
174	Qed.
175	
176	(* ================================================================== *)
177	(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
178	(* ================================================================== *)
179	
180	(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
181	   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
182	   needed. *)
183	Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
184	  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.
185	
186	Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
187	Proof.
188	  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
189	  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
190	    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
191	    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
192	    + apply fs_sngl.
193	    + exact Hsub.
194	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
195	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
196	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
197	  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
198	  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
199	Qed.
200	
201	(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
202	   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
203	Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
204	  forall γ G p q a T,
205	    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
206	    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
207	
208	Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
209	Proof.
210	  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
211	  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
212	  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
213	  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
214	    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
215	  apply q2_intro.
216	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
217	    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
218	    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
219	    + apply fs_sngl.
220	    + exact Hsub.
221	  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
222	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
223	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
224	  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
225	  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
226	Qed.
227	
228	(* ================================================================== *)
229	(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
230	(* ================================================================== *)
231	
232	Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
233	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.
234	
235	Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
236	  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
237	
238	Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
239	  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).
240	
241	Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
242	  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).
243	
244	Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
245	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).
246	
247	Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
248	  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
249	  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
250	  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
251	
252	(* ================================================================== *)
253	(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
254	(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
255	(* ================================================================== *)
256	
257	Lemma SGood_Q2_of_residuals :
258	  Q2_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p T.
259	Proof.
260	  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
261	  induction Hs.
262	  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q2_of_flow; eauto.
263	  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
264	  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
265	    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
266	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
267	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
268	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
269	    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
270	  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
271	  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
272	    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
273	  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
274	    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
275	  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
276	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
277	  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
278	Qed.
279	
280	(* Every SGood typing yields a precise2 typing of the path, under HInv,
281	   once the Q2 closure residuals are supplied.  This is the precise
282	   witness requested for [wf_push_cond]. *)
283	Lemma path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2 :
284	  Q2_residuals ->
285	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
286	Proof.
287	  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hs.
288	  exact (Q2_prec2 (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p T Hi Hs)).
289	Qed.
290	
291	(* The direct ordinary-typing version: this is the HInv-aware
292	   ordinary-path-to-precise2 bridge whose output feeds
293	   [wf_push_cond_of_path_precise]. *)
294	Theorem HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
295	  Q2_residuals ->
296	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
297	Proof.
298	  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hty.
299	  eapply path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2; eauto.
300	  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
301	Qed.
302	
303	(* ================================================================== *)
304	(* Conditional reductions of the remaining residuals.                  *)
305	(*                                                                     *)
306	(* Each isolates the precise semantic ingredient that is still         *)
307	(* missing, so the frontier is explicit rather than hidden in a        *)
308	(* monolithic residual.                                                *)
309	(* ================================================================== *)
310	
311	(* --- (A) Target-intersection arrow split. ------------------------- *)
312	(* If an arrow supertype of [T ∧ U] is already a supertype of one      *)
313	(* component, the ArrowCl fields of the two premises compose.  The     *)
314	(* missing fact is exactly the split; it is the "and-supertype arrow"  *)
315	(* classification noted in agent_bridge1 (two Bridge witnesses below T *)
316	(* and U need not combine below T∧U).                                  *)
317	Definition and_arrow_split : Prop :=
318	  forall G T U V, G ⊢ T ∧ U <: V -> is_arrow V ->
319	    G ⊢ T <: V \/ G ⊢ U <: V.
320	
321	Lemma Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split :
322	  and_arrow_split -> Q2_and_intro_cl.
323	Proof.
324	  intros Hsplit γ G p T U Hi HT HU. apply q2_intro.
325	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
326	    destruct (Hsplit G T U V Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
327	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V HTV Har).
328	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p U HU V HUV Har).
329	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
330	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst T1. subst T2.
331	    split; assumption.
332	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
333	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
334	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
335	Qed.
336	
337	(* --- (B) No arrow from a term-field record. ----------------------- *)
338	Definition rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
339	  forall γ G (a:trm_label) S V,
340	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
341	
342	Lemma Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
343	  rcd_no_arrow -> Q2_rcd_intro_cl.
344	Proof.
345	  intros Hna γ G p a T Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
346	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
347	    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har)).
348	  - (* field *) intros b S E. injection E as Eb ES. subst b. subst S.
349	    exact Ha.
350	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
351	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
352	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
353	  - (* prec2 *) destruct (Q2_prec2 Ha) as [U HU].
354	    exact (@precise2_prefix_snoc G p a U HU).
355	Qed.
356	
357	(* --- (C) No arrow from a recursive type. -------------------------- *)
358	Definition bnd_no_arrow : Prop :=
359	  forall γ G T0 V,
360	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
361	
362	Lemma Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
363	  bnd_no_arrow -> Q2_rec_intro_cl.
364	Proof.
365	  intros Hna γ G p T0 Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
366	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
367	    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har)).
368	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
369	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
370	  - (* mu *) intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'. exact Ha.
371	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
372	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 Ha).
373	Qed.
374	
375	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
376	(* (D) Singleton transitivity, reduced to the μ-opening transport.     *)
377	(*                                                                     *)
378	(* All cases except μ go through by strong induction on the type size: *)
379	(* the field case at [p•a,q•a] uses [pt2_sngl_trans] to transport the  *)
380	(* precise2 singleton payload, and the and case uses the two IHs.      *)
381	(* The sole obstruction is the μ field, which asks for the body opened *)
382	(* at [p] given the body opened at the aliased path [q].               *)
383	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
384	
385	Definition Q2_mu_open_transport : Prop :=
386	  forall γ G p q T0,
387	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
388	    Q2 γ G q (open_typ_p q T0) -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
389	
390	(* Precise2 transitivity at a singleton.  This is the one precise2 rule
391	   missing from the raw calculus (pt2_sngl_trans only transports a field
392	   selector).  With the precise2 singleton payload it is exactly what the
393	   singleton case of sngl-transport needs. *)
394	Definition Q2_prec2_sngl_trans : Prop :=
395	  forall G p q r, G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! q : {{ r }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ r }}.
396	
397	Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_ge :
398	  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
399	  forall (N:nat) (T:typ), g_typ_size T <= N ->
400	  forall γ G p q,
401	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
402	Proof.
403	  intros Hmu Hs2 N. induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p q Hi Hp2 Hq.
404	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
405	  - apply q2_intro.
406	    + (* arrow *) intros V Hsub HarV.
407	      destruct (@Q2_arrow γ G q T Hq V Hsub HarV) as [U [Hq3 [Hfs HUV]]].
408	      exists U. split; [|split].
409	      * eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp2 | exact Hq3].
410	      * exact Hfs.
411	      * exact HUV.
412	    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
413	      pose proof (@Q2_fld γ G q (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S Hq eq_refl) as HQqaS.
414	      destruct (Q2_prec2 HQqaS) as [U Hqa2].
415	      assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
416	        by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
417	      eapply IH.
418	      * simpl in Hsz. lia.
419	      * exact Hi.
420	      * exact Hpa2.
421	      * exact HQqaS.
422	    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
423	      destruct (@Q2_and γ G q (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 Hq eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
424	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H1].
425	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H2].
426	    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
427	      eapply Hmu; eauto.
428	      eapply (@Q2_bnd γ G q (μ T0) T0 Hq eq_refl).
429	    + (* singleton *) intros q' E. subst T.
430	      eapply Hs2.
431	      * exact Hp2.
432	      * eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G q ({{ q' }}) q' Hq eq_refl).
433	    + (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp2.
434	Qed.
435	
436	Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu :
437	  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans -> Q2_sngl_trans_cl.
438	Proof.
439	  intros Hmu Hs2 γ G p q T Hi Hp Hq.
440	  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
441	  eapply (Q2_sngl_trans_ge Hmu Hs2 (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
442	Qed.
443	
444	(* ================================================================== *)
445	(* Partial sub-closure: arrow and type-member-record targets.           *)
446	(* These are unconditional (arrow) or conditional only on the exact     *)
447	(* no-arrow vacuity for the target head.                                *)
448	(* ================================================================== *)
449	
450	Lemma Q2_sub_arrow : forall γ G p T A,
451	  HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: A -> is_arrow A -> Q2 γ G p A.
452	Proof.
453	  intros γ G p T A Hi HT Hsub Harr. destruct Harr as [S [U EA]]. subst A.
454	  apply q2_intro.
455	  - (* arrow *) intros V HAV Har.
456	    apply (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V).
457	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
458	    + exact Har.
459	  - (* field *) intros a S' E. discriminate E.
460	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
461	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
462	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
463	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
464	Qed.
465	
466	(* Arrow supertypes of a top target. *)
467	Definition top_no_arrow : Prop :=
468	  forall G V, G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
469	
470	Lemma Q2_to_top_of_no_arrow :
471	  top_no_arrow -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p typ_top.
472	Proof.
473	  intros Hna γ G p T Hi HT. apply q2_intro.
474	  - intros V HtopV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna G V HtopV Har)).
475	  - intros a S E. discriminate E.
476	  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
477	  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
478	  - intros q E. discriminate E.
479	  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
480	Qed.
481	
482	(* Arrow supertypes of a type-member record target. *)
483	Definition typ_rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
484	  forall γ G (A:typ_label) L U V,
485	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
486	
487	Lemma Q2_sub_typ_rcd_of_no_arrow :
488	  typ_rcd_no_arrow ->
489	  forall γ G p T (A:typ_label) L U,
490	    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T ->
491	    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} ->
492	    Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}).
493	Proof.
494	  intros Hna γ G p T A L U Hi HT Hsub. apply q2_intro.
495	  - intros V HrecV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G A L U V Hi HrecV Har)).
496	  - (* field: a type-member record is not a term-field record *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
497	  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
498	  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
499	  - intros q E. discriminate E.
500	  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
501	Qed.
502	
503	(* ================================================================== *)
504	(* Compatibility with the original Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v: the      *)
505	(* strengthening is conservative (Q2 -> Q).  Q's singleton payload is  *)
506	(* precise3, recovered from Q2's precise2 payload by [pt3].            *)
507	(* ================================================================== *)
508	
509	Lemma Q2_to_Q_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
510	  g_typ_size T <= N -> forall γ G p, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
511	Proof.
512	  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p H.
513	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
514	  - apply q_intro.
515	    + (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har. exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T H U Hsub Har).
516	    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
517	      eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia |].
518	      exact (@Q2_fld γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S H eq_refl).
519	    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
520	      destruct (@Q2_and γ G p (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 H eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
521	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H1].
522	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H2].
523	    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
524	      eapply IH.
525	      * rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
526	      * exact (@Q2_bnd γ G p (μ T0) T0 H eq_refl).
527	    + (* singleton *) intros q E. subst T.
528	      apply pt3. eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G p ({{ q }}) q H eq_refl).
529	Qed.
530	
531	Lemma Q2_to_Q : forall γ G p T, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
532	Proof.
533	  intros. eapply (Q2_to_Q_ge (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
534	Qed.

8	(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
9	   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
10	   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
11	   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
12	   induction. *)
13	Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
14	| sg_flow p R U :
15	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
16	    SGood γ G p U
17	| sg_sub p T U :
18	    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
19	    SGood γ G p U
20	| sg_new_elim p a T :
21	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
22	    SGood γ G (p • a) T
23	| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
24	    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
25	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
26	| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
27	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
28	    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
29	| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
30	    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
31	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
32	| sg_and_intro p T U :
33	    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
34	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
35	| sg_and_l p T U :
36	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
37	| sg_and_r p T U :
38	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
39	| sg_sngl p q :
40	    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
41	    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
42	| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
43	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
44	    SGood γ G p T
45	| sg_path_elim p q a T :
46	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
47	    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
48	
49	Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
50	  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
51	Proof.
52	  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
53	  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
54	  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
55	  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
56	  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
57	  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
58	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
59	  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
60	  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
61	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
62	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
63	  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
64	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
65	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
66	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
67	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
68	  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
69	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
70	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
71	  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
72	    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
73	    + assumption.
74	Qed.

9	(* Combined structural property for SGood.  It mirrors the SGood
10	   constructors but adds the arrow/Bridge-facing clauses.  All recursive
11	   occurrences are positive. *)
12	Inductive Q (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
13	| q_intro : forall p T,
14	    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
15	    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q γ G (p • a) S) ->
16	    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q γ G p T1 /\ Q γ G p T2) ->
17	    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
18	    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}) ->
19	    Q γ G p T.

21	(* Flow base for Q: a precise flow output is Q at arbitrary fuel-bounded
22	   type size.  This is the sg_flow base of the SGood induction. *)
23	Lemma Q_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
24	  g_typ_size T <= N ->
25	  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
26	Proof.
27	  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
28	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
29	  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
30	    + (* top *) apply q_intro.
31	      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
32	        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
33	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
34	        -- exact HTU.
35	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
36	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
37	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
38	      * intros q E. discriminate E.
39	    + (* bot *) exfalso.
40	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
41	      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
42	    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
43	      * (* dec_typ *) apply q_intro.
44	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
45	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
46	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
47	           ++ exact HU0.
48	        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
49	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
50	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
51	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
52	      * (* dec_trm *) apply q_intro.
53	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
54	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
55	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
56	           ++ exact HU0.
57	        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
58	           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
59	           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
60	            ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
61	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
62	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
63	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
64	    + (* and *) apply q_intro.
65	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
66	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
67	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
68	        -- exact HU0.
69	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
70	      * intros U1 U2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst U1. subst U2.
71	        split.
72	        -- refine (IH T1 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
73	           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
74	        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
75	           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
76	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
77	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
78	    + (* path *) exfalso.
79	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
80	      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
81	    + (* bnd *) apply q_intro.
82	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
83	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
84	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
85	        -- exact HU0.
86	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
87	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
88	      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
89	        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
90	        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
91	        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
92	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
93	    + (* all *) apply q_intro.
94	      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
95	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
96	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
97	        -- exact HV0.
98	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
99	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
100	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
101	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
102	    + (* sngl *) apply q_intro.
103	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
104	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
105	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
106	        -- exact HU0.
107	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
108	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
109	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
110	      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
111	        apply pt3. apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
112	Qed.

114	Lemma Q_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
115	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
116	Proof.
117	  intros. eapply (Q_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
118	Qed.
