120	(* Exact closure residuals needed to turn SGood into Q. *)
121	Definition Q_sub_cl : Prop :=
122	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q γ G p U.
123	
124	Definition Q_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
125	  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G q T -> Q γ G p T.
126	
127	Definition Q_path_elim_cl : Prop :=
128	  forall γ G p q a T,
129	    HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G (q • a) T -> Q γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
130	
131	Definition Q_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
132	  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G (p • a) T -> Q γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).
133	
134	Definition Q_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
135	  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q γ G p (μ T0).
136	
137	Definition Q_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
138	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> Q γ G p U -> Q γ G p (T ∧ U).
139	
140	Definition Q_sngl_cl : Prop :=
141	  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q γ G p {{ q }}.
142	
143	Definition SGood_Q_residuals : Prop :=
144	  Q_sub_cl /\ Q_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q_path_elim_cl /\
145	  Q_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q_rec_intro_cl /\ Q_and_intro_cl /\ Q_sngl_cl.
146	
147	Lemma SGood_Q_of_residuals :
148	  SGood_Q_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
149	Proof.
150	  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
151	  induction Hs.
152	  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q_of_flow; eauto.
153	  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
154	  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
155	    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
156	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
157	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
158	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0' Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
159	    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
160	  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
161	  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
162	    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
163	  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
164	    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
165	  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
166	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
167	  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
168	Qed.
169	
170	(* Bridge 1, conditional on the closure residuals. *)
171	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_residuals :
172	  SGood_Q_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
173	Proof.
174	  intros Hres γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
175	  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
176	  pose proof (@SGood_Q_of_residuals Hres γ G p A Hi Hs) as HQ.
177	  inversion HQ as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
178	  exact (Harr A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
179	Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified pieces toward bridge 1
   (ordinary arrow path typing -> precise3 at a flow-shaped subtype).
   The raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] in agent_bridge.v is refuted by
   counter_bridge2.v; the HInv-aware assembly is in aux_bridge_fixed.v. *)

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.

(* Two facts isolated as the remaining obstructions for bridge 1. *)

(* (O1) Record-field extraction from a flow-shaped subtype of a record.
   Needed by [ty_new_elim]: from a flow output U with U <: {a : T}, recover
   a field declaration V of U (so that pf_fld applies) with V <: T.  Under
   HInv this must use provenance of U (the raw version is false). *)
Definition flow_shape_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G U a T,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, flow_shape V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* (O2) Reverse-field (record introduction) for the bridge witness.
   Needed by [ty_rcd_intro]: from a bridge witness V <: T for p•a, produce a
   flow-shaped witness W <: {a : T} for p (or a precise3 of p at such W). *)
Definition bridge_rcd_intro : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G (p•a) T ->
    exists W, G ⊢!!! p : W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}.

(* (O3) The singleton/alias refinement needed by [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]:
   a bridge witness below a singleton can be turned into a precise2 typing at
   the singleton itself. *)
Definition bridge_sngl_refine : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

(* (Reduced goal suggested by the coordinator.) *)
Definition precise_exists_of_path_typing : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

(* (Full bridge 1, imported from agent_bridge.v.) *)
Check ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified precision lemmas used by the singleton/alias cases of bridge 1. *)

(* Every precise2 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
Lemma precise2_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p T U Hi H).
  - apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

(* Every precise3 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
Lemma precise3_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.

Inductive precise_typing2: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt2: forall G p T U,
    G ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
    G ⊢!! p: U
| pt2_sngl_trans : forall G p q a U,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! q•a : U ->
    G ⊢!! p•a : {{ q•a }}
where "G '⊢!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing2 G p T).

Inductive precise_typing3: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt3: forall G p T,
    G ⊢!! p : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p: T
| pt3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p : T
where "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing3 G p T).

Inductive wf : ctx -> Prop :=
| wfe_empty :
    wf empty
| wfe_push G x T :
    wf G ->
    x # G ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ T ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }}->
             exists U, G & x ~ T ⊢!! q : U) ->
    wf (G & x ~ T).

Definition typed_repl_comp_qp G T1 T2 :=
  exists p q U,
    G ⊢! p: {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} /\
    G ⊢!! q : U /\
    repl_typ q p T1 T2.

Definition repl_composition_qp G := star (typed_repl_comp_qp G).

Notation "G '⊢' T '⟿' U" := (repl_composition_qp G U T) (at level 40, T at level 59).

Notation "G '⊢' p '⟿'' q" := (G ⊢ {{ p }}⟿ {{ q }}) (at level 40, p at level 59).

Lemma well_typed_binds : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G ->
  forall x T, binds x T G -> exists v, binds x v γ.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hwt. induction Hwt.
  - intros x T Hb. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros y T' Hb. apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Ey ET] | [Hy Hb0]].
    + subst y T'. exists v. apply binds_push_eq.
    + destruct (IHHwt y T' Hb0) as [v0 Hv0].
      exists v0. apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_entries : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G ->
  exists v, binds x v γ /\ G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] Hb.
  destruct (well_typed_binds Hwt Hb) as [v Hv].
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact (Hentries x T v Hb Hv)].
Qed.

Lemma HInv_bind_inert : forall γ G x T, HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (HInv_entries H H0) as [v [_ Hv]]. exact (ty_val_p_inert Hv).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_no_sngl_bind : forall γ G x q, HInv γ G -> binds x {{q}} G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x q Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma flow_record_has : forall C p R U D,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> record_has U D -> C ⊢! p : R ⪼ typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros C p R U D Hf Hhas. revert C p R Hf.
  induction Hhas; intros C p0 R0 Hf.
  - exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and1 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
  - apply pf_and2 in Hf. apply IHHhas; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma flow_ty_path : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> C ⊢ trm_path p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf.
  - apply ty_var; auto.
  - apply ty_new_elim. eapply ty_sub.
    + apply IHHf.
    + apply record_has_sub. apply rh_one.
  - apply ty_rec_elim. apply IHHf.
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and11].
  - apply ty_sub with (T := U1 ∧ U2); [exact IHHf | apply subtyp_and12].
Qed.

with good_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| gd_typ : forall A T U, good_dec { A >: T <: U }
| gd_trm : forall a T, good_typ T -> good_dec { a ⦂ T }.

Scheme good_mut := Induction for good_typ Sort Prop
with   good_dec_mut := Induction for good_dec Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme good_mutind from good_mut, good_dec_mut.

  (forall T, good_typ T -> forall p k, good_typ (open_rec_typ_p k p T)) /\
  (forall D, good_dec D -> forall p k, good_dec (open_rec_dec_p k p D)).
Proof.
  apply good_mutind.
  - intros S T p k. apply gt_all.

  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual bridges.                                                   *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros G x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G1 := G) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    (G & x ~ μ T0 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0)) by apply binds_push_eq.
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.

Qed.

(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->

    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->

    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.

    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].

(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. exact HV.
Qed.

(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
Proof.
  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
Qed.

(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)

(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.

   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
   precision *soundness*:

     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)

   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).

   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
   the unconditional implication available here is
   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)

   same reduction applies; no restriction on S is even needed. *)
Lemma field_sub_closure_natural_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
    flow_shape S -> exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT Hfs. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. apply pt3. exact HV.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Mutual structural recursion over the proof trees of [ty_trm] and
   [subtyp], returning Prop.  This validates the combined
   typing+subtyping well-foundedness: subtyping rules that store a typing
   premise (sel1/sel2/sngl_pq/sngl_qp) recursively enter that typing proof,
   and the typing rule [ty_sub] recursively enters its subtyping proof.
   Recursion is purely structural on the proof arguments (the guard checker
   accepts both directions).  The body here is [True]; it is the skeleton
   into which the [Good] invariant is to be plugged. *)

Fixpoint prove_ty_true (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H : G ⊢ t : T) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | ty_var b => I
  | ty_all_intro t U body => I
  | ty_all_elim d1 d2 =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_new_intro T ds body => I
  | ty_new_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rcd_intro p a d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_let u d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in I
  | ty_sngl d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_path_elim a d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_rec_intro T d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_rec_elim d => let _ := prove_ty_true d in I
  | ty_and_intro d1 d2 => let _ := prove_ty_true d1 in let _ := prove_ty_true d2 in I
  | ty_sub d s => let _ := prove_ty_true d in let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  end
with prove_sub_true (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H : G ⊢ S <: U) {struct H} : True :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_top G0 T => I
  | subtyp_bot G0 T => I
  | subtyp_refl G0 T => I
  | subtyp_trans s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_and11 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and12 G0 T U => I
  | subtyp_and2 s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_fld a s => let _ := prove_sub_true s in I
  | subtyp_typ A s1 s2 =>
      let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in let _ := prove_sub_true s2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_pq t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sngl_qp t1 t2 r =>
      let _ := prove_ty_true t1 in let _ := prove_ty_true t2 in I
  | subtyp_sel2 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_sel1 t => let _ := prove_ty_true t in I
  | subtyp_all T1 T2 s1 body => let _ := prove_sub_true s1 in I
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Fuel-indexed structural invariant skeleton.

   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field
   [forall q, Good q L -> Good q U] is rejected by Coq: the occurrence of
   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant
   design is expressible.  This is the implementable shape. *)

Require Import agent_bridge1.

Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | O => True
  | Datatypes.S f =>
    match T with
    | typ_top => True
    | typ_bot => False
    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
    | typ_bnd T0 =>
        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
    | typ_rcd D =>
        match D with
        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
        end
    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}
    | typ_path p0 A =>
        (forall (S0 T0:typ),
            C ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} ->
            GoodF f γ C p S0 -> GoodF f γ C p T0)
    end
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The existential-fuel wrapper proposed for [tds_mutind]. *)

Definition GoodEventually (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists n, forall m, n <= m -> GoodF m γ C p T.

Lemma goodF_zero : forall γ C p T, GoodF 0 γ C p T.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

(* NOTE on monotonicity (important for the max-based combination):
   the natural monotonicity [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] is NOT derivable from
   the definition above.  Concretely, instantiating T with a term record
   [rcd {a ⦂ ∀(S)U}] reduces the goal at f=0 to
       GoodF 0 (p•a) (∀(S)U)  ->  GoodF 1 (p•a) (∀(S)U)
   i.e.  True -> (Bridge γ C (p•a) (∀(S)U) /\ Prec2Exists), which needs the
   arrow resolution and is not provable for an arbitrary p/γ/C.  The
   [dec_typ] transport field additionally reverses the fuel direction
   (transport at fuel f is used to produce facts at fuel <= f), so neither
   [GoodF f -> GoodF (S f)] nor [GoodF (S f) -> GoodF f] holds uniformly.
   Hence the [exists n, forall m >= n] formulation cannot be combined by
   [max] without a redesigned GoodF (e.g. transport bounded by fuel, which is
   not structurally recursive, or an impredicative/coinductive encoding).
   A sound alternative is a single global fuel fixed before the induction
   (a syntactic bound on the initial goal/derivation), so that every GoodF
   fact in the induction is at the same fuel and no monotonicity is needed. *)

Inductive sub_rel : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| srel_refl T : sub_rel T T
| srel_bot T : sub_rel typ_bot T
| srel_top T : sub_rel T typ_top
| srel_and_l T U V : sub_rel T V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and_r T U V : sub_rel U V -> sub_rel (T ∧ U) V
| srel_and2 T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel T V -> sub_rel T (U ∧ V)
| srel_fld T U a : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| srel_typ S1 S2 T1 T2 A :
    sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel T1 T2 ->
    sub_rel (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| srel_sngl_pq p q T T' : repl_typ p q T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sngl_qp p q T T' : repl_typ q p T T' -> sub_rel T T'
| srel_sel2 p A T : sub_rel T (p ↓ A)
| srel_sel1 p A T : sub_rel (p ↓ A) T
| srel_all S1 S2 T1 T2 : sub_rel S2 S1 -> sub_rel (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2)
| srel_trans T U V : sub_rel T U -> sub_rel U V -> sub_rel T V.

Lemma subtyp_to_rel : forall G T U, G ⊢ T <: U -> sub_rel T U.
Proof.
  intros G T U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - apply srel_top.
  - apply srel_bot.
  - apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_trans; eauto.
  - apply srel_and_l. apply srel_refl.
  - apply srel_and_r. apply srel_refl.
  - eapply srel_and2; eauto.
  - apply srel_fld. assumption.
  - eapply srel_typ; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply srel_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - apply srel_sel2.
  - apply srel_sel1.
  - eapply srel_all; eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

Lemma binds_subst_drop : forall G1 z Tz G2 p y T,
  z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 ->
  binds y T (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> y <> z ->
  binds y (subst_typ z p T) (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 z Tz G2 p y T Hfz Hb Hyz.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HbG2 | [HyG2 HbG1z]].
  - apply binds_concat_right. apply binds_map. exact HbG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv HbG1z) as [HbTz | [HyTz HbG1]].
    + destruct (binds_single_inv HbTz) as [E1 E2]. subst y T. exfalso; auto.
    + assert (HT : subst_typ z p T = T).

      rewrite HT. apply binds_concat_left; auto. unfold subst_ctx. rewrite dom_map. exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       G1 & subst_ctx z p G2 ⊢ subst_trm z p t : subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) ⊢ subst_def z p d : subst_dec z p D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ) (H: x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> x0 <> z -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->
       G1 ⊢ trm_path p : Tz ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & subst_ctx z p G2) ⊢ subst_defs z p ds :: subst_typ z p T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1:ctx) (z:var) (Tz:typ) (G2:ctx) (p:path),
       ok (G1 & z ~ Tz & G2) -> G = G1 & z ~ Tz & G2 ->
       named_path p -> z \notin fv_ctx_types G1 -> z \notin fv_typ Tz ->

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.

(* Two facts isolated as the remaining obstructions for bridge 1. *)

(* (O1) Record-field extraction from a flow-shaped subtype of a record.
   Needed by [ty_new_elim]: from a flow output U with U <: {a : T}, recover
   a field declaration V of U (so that pf_fld applies) with V <: T.  Under

Definition flow_shape_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G U a T,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, flow_shape V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* (O2) Reverse-field (record introduction) for the bridge witness.
   Needed by [ty_rcd_intro]: from a bridge witness V <: T for p•a, produce a
   flow-shaped witness W <: {a : T} for p (or a precise3 of p at such W). *)
Definition bridge_rcd_intro : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G (p•a) T ->
    exists W, G ⊢!!! p : W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}.

Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.

(* Probe: can a mutual Fixpoint over ty_trm/subtyp recurse into the
   premises of a subtyping premise obtained by destructing a constructor
   argument of a typing rule (nested subterm recursion)? *)

Fixpoint psub (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H:subtyp G S U) {struct H} : Prop :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_trans H1 H2 => psub H1 /\ psub H2
  | subtyp_and2 H1 H2 => psub H1 /\ psub H2
  | subtyp_sngl_pq Ht1 Ht2 Hr => pty Ht1 /\ pty Ht2
  | subtyp_sngl_qp Ht1 Ht2 Hr => pty Ht1 /\ pty Ht2
  | subtyp_sel2 Hty => pty Hty
  | subtyp_sel1 Hty => pty Hty
  | subtyp_all _ Hsub _ => psub Hsub
  | _ => True
  end
with pty (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H:ty_trm G t T) {struct H} : Prop :=
  match H with
  | ty_sub Ht Hs => pty Ht /\ psub Hs
  | ty_new_elim Ht => pty Ht
  | ty_and_intro H1 H2 => pty H1 /\ pty H2
  | ty_sngl H1 H2 => pty H1 /\ pty H2
  | ty_path_elim H1 H2 => pty H1 /\ pty H2
  | ty_rec_intro H1 => pty H1
  | ty_rec_elim H1 => pty H1
  | ty_rcd_intro H1 => pty H1
  | _ => True
  end.

(* Now the nested case: in pty's ty_sub branch, destruct the subtyping
   proof and recurse into the premises of subtyp_typ. *)
Fixpoint qsub (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H:subtyp G S U) {struct H} : Prop :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_trans H1 H2 => qsub H1 /\ qsub H2
  | subtyp_and2 H1 H2 => qsub H1 /\ qsub H2
  | subtyp_sel2 Hty => qty Hty
  | subtyp_sel1 Hty => qty Hty
  | subtyp_all _ Hsub _ => qsub Hsub
  | _ => True
  end
with qty (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H:ty_trm G t T) {struct H} : Prop :=
  match H with
  | ty_sub Ht Hs =>
      qty Ht /\
      match Hs with
      | subtyp_typ _ H1 H2 => qsub H1 /\ qsub H2
      | subtyp_trans H1 H2 => qsub H1 /\ qsub H2
      | _ => True
      end
  | ty_new_elim Ht => qty Ht
  | ty_and_intro H1 H2 => qty H1 /\ qty H2
  | _ => True
  end.

(* Deeper: recurse into a subtyping premise nested two levels. *)
Fixpoint rsub (G:ctx) (S U:typ) (H:subtyp G S U) {struct H} : Prop :=
  match H with
  | subtyp_trans H1 H2 => rsub H1 /\ rsub H2
  | subtyp_sel2 Hty => rty Hty
  | _ => True
  end

      | _ => True

  | _ => True
  end.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. Check IHHty. apply sg_new_elim. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply IHHty. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply IHHty1. reflexivity.
    + apply IHHty2. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply IHHty. reflexivity.
    + apply s.
Qed.

Definition ArrowCl (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.

Lemma ArrowCl_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf V Hsub Har.
  exists U. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p U). apply (@pt2 G p R U). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi Hf).
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc Htu V Huv Har. apply Hc; [eapply subtyp_trans; eauto | exact Har]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_self : forall γ G p T,
  ArrowCl γ G p T -> is_arrow T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T Hc Har. eapply Hc; [apply subtyp_refl | exact Har]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_l : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har. apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact Htv]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_and_r : forall γ G p T U,
  ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U) -> ArrowCl γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T U Hc V Htv Har. apply Hc with (U := V); auto.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact Htv]. Qed.

Lemma ArrowCl_sngl_alias : forall γ G p q T,
  ArrowCl γ G q T -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q T Hc Hp V Hsub Har.
  destruct (Hc V Hsub Har) as [U0 [Hp3 [Hfs Hs]]].
  exists U0. split; [|split].
  - eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp | exact Hp3].
  - exact Hfs.
  - exact Hs.
Qed.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) /\
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) /\
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}).

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts :
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) ->
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}) ->
  SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Gfld Grcd Gmu Gopen Gand Gsngl Gprec2 Gpath γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_flow; eauto|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_sub; [apply IHHs|exact H]|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gfld γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Grcd γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gmu γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gand γ G p T U Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_l; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_r; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gsngl γ G p q Hi H) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Gprec2 γ G p q Hi Hs1)) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gpath γ G p q a T Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
Qed.

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps -> SGood_arrow_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hg. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts.
  - exact (proj1 Hg).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 Hg)).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))))).
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood :
  SGood_arrow_closure ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hcl γ G p S T Hi Hs.
  eapply ArrowCl_self; [eapply Hcl; [exact Hi | exact Hs] | exists S, T; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma bridge1_of_SGood_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (∀(S) T) -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof. intros Hg. apply bridge1_of_SGood. apply SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps. exact Hg. Qed.

Lemma ordinary_arrow_bridge_of_gaps :
  SGood_arrow_closure_gaps ->
  forall γ G p S T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> Bridge γ G p (∀(S) T).
Proof.
  intros Hg γ G p S T Hi Hty.
  eapply bridge1_of_SGood_gaps; [exact Hg|exact Hi|].
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Direct analysis of the master classification.                       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The master ([arrow_source_class_gen]) is a statement about a       *)
(* *syntactic* source type [S].  Therefore it can be analysed by a     *)
(* finite case split on the outer constructor of [S].  This isolates   *)
(* the exact semantic core: one "no rigid source below an arrow/bot"   *)
(* fact per rigid constructor, plus the component split for            *)
(* intersection sources.                                               *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The resulting [pointwise_facts] are *equivalent* to the master.     *)
(* This is strictly sharper than the earlier reduction to              *)
(* [sel_lower_class] / [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow.v): no        *)
(* selection- or typing-level reasoning remains in the reduction;      *)
(* what remains is precisely the per-constructor semantic content.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The per-constructor source facts.                                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition pointwise_facts : Prop :=
  (* no rigid source below an arrow or bot *)
  (forall γ G V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (* component split for intersection sources *)
  (forall G T1 T2 V,
      G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
  (forall G T1 T2 V,
      G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

(* The conjunction-split part at arrow and bot targets, exactly the    *)
(* HInv-aware [and_arrow_split_H] plus its bot analogue.               *)
Definition and_split_H : Prop :=
  (forall G T1 T2 V, G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
  (forall G T1 T2 V, G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

Lemma and_arrow_split_H_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha _]]]]].
  split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Master => pointwise facts.  (Easy: instantiate the master at the    *)
(* rigid head and refute the ArrowSrc disjuncts syntactically.)        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pointwise_facts_of_master :
  arrow_source_class_gen -> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  intros HC. unfold pointwise_facts.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]]].
  - (* top *) intros γ G V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G typ_top V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rcd *) intros γ G D V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd D) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* bnd *) intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* sngl *) intros γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* and / arrow target *) intros G T1 T2 V Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC _ _ (T1 ∧ T2) V ltac:(assumption) Hsub (or_introl Har)) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
  - (* and / bot target *) intros G T1 T2 V Hsub E. subst V.
    destruct (HC _ _ (T1 ∧ T2) ⊥ ltac:(assumption) Hsub (or_intror eq_refl)) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E']] | [V1 [V2 [E' Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E'.
    + injection E' as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Pointwise facts => master.  Pure case analysis on the source        *)
(* constructor.  No typing is inspected, no selection reasoning.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma master_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> arrow_source_class_gen.
Proof.
  intros [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  intros γ G S U Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct S as [| |D|T1 T2|p A|T0|S0 T0|q].
  - (* top *) exact (False_ind _ (Htop γ G U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hrcd γ G D U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* and *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Har as [Harr | E].
    + left. exact (HandA G T1 T2 U Hsub Harr).
    + right. exact (HandB G T1 T2 U Hsub E).
  - (* path *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* bnd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hbnd γ G T0 U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S0, T0. reflexivity.
  - (* sngl *) exact (False_ind _ (Hsngl γ G q U Hi Hsub Har)).
Qed.

(* The equivalence, stated cleanly. *)
Theorem master_iff_pointwise :
  arrow_source_class_gen <-> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
  - apply master_of_pointwise.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Tie-in with the selection/conjunction residuals of agent_noarrow.v. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros HP. apply sel_lower_class_of_gen.
  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma and_target_lift_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> and_target_lift.
Proof.
  intros HP. apply and_target_lift_of_gen.
  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
Qed.

(* The complete chain for packaging: pointwise facts give the master,
   hence the two residuals of agent_noarrow, hence the four named facts
   that the Q2 assembly consumes. *)
Lemma four_facts_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  rcd_no_arrow /\ bnd_no_arrow /\ and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros HP.
  pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as HC.
  split; [|split].
  - apply rcd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC.
  - apply bnd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC.
  - apply and_split_of_class. exact HC.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* What is *unconditional* here.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The equivalence [master_iff_pointwise] is fully unconditional.  So  *)
(* proving the master is *exactly* proving the six pointwise facts.    *)
(* The four "no rigid source below arrow/bot" facts and the two       *)
(* intersection splits cannot be obtained by structural recursion on   *)
(* the subtyping derivation: consider a derivation [S <: U] whose     *)
(* first non-structural atom is [st_sel2], [S <: p↓A].  The result     *)
(* [S <: U] follows by transitivity via [p↓A], and the only typing     *)
(* information is [p : rcd{A>:S<:T}].  With no canonical member bound  *)
(* this is not reducible to a smaller subtyping derivation of the same *)
(* source; counter_bridge2.v shows the HInv-free statement is false.   *)
(* Under HInv the missing ingredient is the runtime tight member bound *)
(* (PathObject/DefsTyped); its extraction is the residual isolated in  *)
(* agent_suball.v ([path_actual_record_trans_free]) and agent_wf.v     *)
(* ([inert_path_precise_bridge]).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* Direct analysis of the master classification.                       *)
11	(*                                                                     *)
12	(* The master ([arrow_source_class_gen]) is a statement about a       *)
13	(* *syntactic* source type [S].  Therefore it can be analysed by a     *)
14	(* finite case split on the outer constructor of [S].  This isolates   *)
15	(* the exact semantic core: one "no rigid source below an arrow/bot"   *)
16	(* fact per rigid constructor, plus the component split for            *)
17	(* intersection sources.                                               *)
18	(*                                                                     *)
19	(* The resulting [pointwise_facts] are *equivalent* to the master.     *)
20	(* This is strictly sharper than the earlier reduction to              *)
21	(* [sel_lower_class] / [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow.v): no        *)
22	(* selection- or typing-level reasoning remains in the reduction;      *)
23	(* what remains is precisely the per-constructor semantic content.     *)
24	(* ================================================================== *)
25	
26	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
27	(* The per-constructor source facts.                                   *)
28	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
29	
30	Definition pointwise_facts : Prop :=
31	  (* no rigid source below an arrow or bot *)
32	  (forall γ G V,
33	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
34	  (forall γ G D V,
35	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
36	  (forall γ G T0 V,
37	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
38	  (forall γ G q V,
39	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
40	  (* component split for intersection sources *)
41	  (forall γ G T1 T2 V,
42	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
43	  (forall γ G T1 T2 V,
44	      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).
45	
46	(* The conjunction-split part at arrow and bot targets, exactly the    *)
47	(* HInv-aware [and_arrow_split_H] plus its bot analogue.               *)
48	Definition and_split_H : Prop :=
49	  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V ->
50	      G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
51	  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ ->
52	      G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).
53	
54	Lemma and_split_H_of_pointwise :
55	  pointwise_facts -> and_split_H.
56	Proof.
57	  intro H. unfold pointwise_facts in H.
58	  destruct H as [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha Hb2]]]]].
59	  unfold and_split_H. split; assumption.
60	Qed.
61	
62	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
63	(* Master => pointwise facts.  (Easy: instantiate the master at the    *)
64	(* rigid head and refute the ArrowSrc disjuncts syntactically.)        *)
65	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
66	
67	Lemma pointwise_facts_of_master :
68	  arrow_source_class_gen -> pointwise_facts.
69	Proof.
70	  intros HC. unfold pointwise_facts.
71	  split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]]].
72	  - (* top *) intros γ G V Hi Hsub Har.
73	    destruct (HC γ G typ_top V Hi Hsub Har) as
74	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
75	    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr).
76	    + discriminate Hbot.
77	    + discriminate E.
78	    + discriminate E.
79	  - (* rcd *) intros γ G D V Hi Hsub Har.
80	    destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd D) V Hi Hsub Har) as
81	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
82	    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
83	    + discriminate Hbot.
84	    + discriminate E.
85	    + discriminate E.
86	  - (* bnd *) intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
87	    destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
88	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
89	    + exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
90	    + discriminate Hbot.
91	    + discriminate E.
92	    + discriminate E.
93	  - (* sngl *) intros γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
94	    destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
95	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
96	    + exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
97	    + discriminate Hbot.
98	    + discriminate E.
99	    + discriminate E.
100	  - (* and / arrow target *) intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub Har.
101	    destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)) as
102	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
103	    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
104	    + discriminate Hbot.
105	    + discriminate E.
106	    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
107	  - (* and / bot target *) intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
108	    destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) ⊥ Hi Hsub (or_intror eq_refl)) as
109	      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E']] | [V1 [V2 [E' Hsplit]]]]]].
110	    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
111	    + discriminate Hbot.
112	    + discriminate E'.
113	    + injection E' as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
114	Qed.
115	
116	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
117	(* Pointwise facts => master.  Pure case analysis on the source        *)
118	(* constructor.  No typing is inspected, no selection reasoning.       *)
119	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
120	
121	Lemma master_of_pointwise :
122	  pointwise_facts -> arrow_source_class_gen.
123	Proof.
124	  intro HF. unfold pointwise_facts in HF.
125	  destruct HF as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
126	  intros γ G S U Hi Hsub Har.
127	  destruct S as [| |D|T1 T2|p A|T0|S0 T0|q].
128	  - (* top *) exact (False_ind _ (Htop γ G U Hi Hsub Har)).
129	  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
130	  - (* rcd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hrcd γ G D U Hi Hsub Har)).
131	  - (* and *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right.
132	    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
133	    destruct Har as [Harr | E].
134	    + exact (HandA γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Harr).
135	    + exact (HandB γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub E).
136	  - (* path *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
137	  - (* bnd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hbnd γ G T0 U Hi Hsub Har)).
138	  - (* all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S0, T0. reflexivity.
139	  - (* sngl *) exact (False_ind _ (Hsngl γ G q U Hi Hsub Har)).
140	Qed.
141	
142	(* The equivalence, stated cleanly. *)
143	Theorem master_iff_pointwise :
144	  arrow_source_class_gen <-> pointwise_facts.
145	Proof.
146	  split.
147	  - apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
148	  - apply master_of_pointwise.
149	Qed.
150	
151	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
152	(* Tie-in with the selection/conjunction residuals of agent_noarrow.v. *)
153	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
154	
155	Lemma sel_lower_class_of_pointwise :
156	  pointwise_facts -> sel_lower_class.
157	Proof.
158	  intros HP. apply sel_lower_class_of_gen.
159	  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
160	Qed.
161	
162	Lemma and_target_lift_of_pointwise :
163	  pointwise_facts -> and_target_lift.
164	Proof.
165	  intros HP. apply and_target_lift_of_gen.
166	  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
167	Qed.
168	
169	Lemma sngl_no_arrow_H_of_pointwise :
170	  pointwise_facts -> sngl_no_arrow_H.
171	Proof.
172	  intro H. unfold pointwise_facts in H.
173	  destruct H as [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs _]]]].
174	  intros γ G q V Hi Hsub Har. exact (Hs γ G q V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
175	Qed.
176	
177	(* The complete chain for packaging: pointwise facts give the master,
178	   hence the two residuals of agent_noarrow, hence the four named facts
179	   that the Q2 assembly consumes. *)
180	Lemma four_facts_of_pointwise :
181	  pointwise_facts ->
182	  rcd_no_arrow /\ bnd_no_arrow /\ and_arrow_split_H.
183	Proof.
184	  intros HP.
185	  pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as HC.
186	  assert (HC' : arrow_source_class)
187	    by (intros γ G S U Hi Hsub Har; exact (HC γ G S U Hi Hsub (or_introl Har))).
188	  split; [|split].
189	  - apply rcd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC'.
190	  - apply bnd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC'.
191	  - apply and_split_of_class. exact HC'.
192	Qed.
193	
194	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
195	(* What is *unconditional* here.                                      *)
196	(*                                                                    *)
197	(* The equivalence [master_iff_pointwise] is fully unconditional.  So  *)
198	(* proving the master is *exactly* proving the six pointwise facts.    *)
199	(* The four "no rigid source below arrow/bot" facts and the two       *)
200	(* intersection splits cannot be obtained by structural recursion on   *)
201	(* the subtyping derivation: consider a derivation [S <: U] whose     *)
202	(* first non-structural atom is [st_sel2], [S <: p↓A].  The result     *)
203	(* [S <: U] follows by transitivity via [p↓A], and the only typing     *)
204	(* information is [p : rcd{A>:S<:T}].  With no canonical member bound  *)
205	(* this is not reducible to a smaller subtyping derivation of the same *)
206	(* source; counter_bridge2.v shows the HInv-free statement is false.   *)
207	(* Under HInv the missing ingredient is the runtime tight member bound *)
208	(* (PathObject/DefsTyped); its extraction is the residual isolated in  *)
209	(* agent_suball.v ([path_actual_record_trans_free]) and agent_wf.v     *)
210	(* ([inert_path_precise_bridge]).                                      *)
211	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import Lia.
4	Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
5	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
6	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl.
7	Close Scope string_scope.
8	
9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* The four HInv-aware subtyping facts blocking Q/Q2.                  *)
11	(*                                                                     *)
12	(* Note: [rcd_no_arrow] and [bnd_no_arrow] below are the *existing*     *)
13	(* agent_q.v residual Definitions.  [and_arrow_split_H] is the         *)
14	(* HInv-carrying variant of agent_q's HInv-free [and_arrow_split]      *)
15	(* (the HInv-free version is not provable).                            *)
16	(* ================================================================== *)
17	
18	Definition and_arrow_split_H : Prop :=
19	  forall γ G T1 T2 U,
20	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: U -> is_arrow U ->
21	    G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
22	
23	(* A uniform, complete classification of the sources of an arrow          *)
24	(* supertype.  It is exactly the statement that the four facts record,    *)
25	(* for the four "rigid" source heads, plus the two remaining source kinds *)
26	(* (bottom / path selections) that can legitimately sit below an arrow.   *)
27	Definition ArrowSrc (G:ctx) (S U:typ) : Prop :=
28	    is_arrow S \/
29	    S = ⊥ \/
30	    (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
31	    (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 /\ (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U)).
32	
33	Definition arrow_source_class : Prop :=
34	  forall γ G S U,
35	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.
36	
37	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
38	(* Disjointness helpers.                                              *)
39	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
40	
41	Lemma sngl_not_arrow : forall (p:path), ~ is_arrow ({{ p }}).
42	Proof. intros p [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
43	
44	Lemma bnd_not_arrow : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
45	Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
46	
47	Lemma rcd_not_arrow : forall D, ~ is_arrow (typ_rcd D).
48	Proof. intros D [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
49	
50	Lemma and_not_arrow : forall T U, ~ is_arrow (T ∧ U).
51	Proof. intros T U [S [U' E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
52	
53	Lemma bot_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊥). 
54	Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
55	
56	Lemma top_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊤).
57	Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
58	
59	Lemma path_not_arrow : forall (p:path) (A:typ_label), ~ is_arrow (p ↓ A).
60	Proof. intros p A [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
61	
62	(* A source of a conjunction supertype can be split, given the class. *)
63	Lemma and_split_of_class : arrow_source_class -> and_arrow_split_H.
64	Proof.
65	  intros HC γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Har.
66	  destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) U Hi Hsub Har) as
67	    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE Hsplit]]]]]].
68	  - exfalso. exact (and_not_arrow Harr).
69	  - discriminate Hbot.
70	  - discriminate HT.
71	  - injection HE as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
72	Qed.
73	
74	Lemma rcd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> rcd_no_arrow.
75	Proof.
76	  intros HC γ G a S V Hi Hsub Har.
77	  destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
78	    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
79	  - exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
80	  - discriminate Hbot.
81	  - discriminate HT.
82	  - discriminate HE.
83	Qed.
84	
85	Lemma bnd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> bnd_no_arrow.
86	Proof.
87	  intros HC γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
88	  destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
89	    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
90	  - exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
91	  - discriminate Hbot.
92	  - discriminate HT.
93	  - discriminate HE.
94	Qed.
95	
96	Lemma sngl_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> forall γ G q V,
97	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
98	Proof.
99	  intros HC γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
100	  destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
101	    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
102	  - exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
103	  - discriminate Hbot.
104	  - discriminate HT.
105	  - discriminate HE.
106	Qed.
107	
108	(* ================================================================== *)
109	(* Shape of [repl_typ] targets: arrow targets come from arrow sources, *)
110	(* and [⊥] is never a replacement target.                               *)
111	(* ================================================================== *)
112	
113	Lemma repl_typ_arrow_l : forall p q T T',
114	  repl_typ p q T T' -> is_arrow T' -> is_arrow T.
115	Proof.
116	  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H; intros Har.
117	  - exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
118	  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
119	  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
120	  - exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Har)).
121	  - exact (False_ind _ (bnd_not_arrow Har)).
122	  - exists T1, U. reflexivity.
123	  - exists U, T1. reflexivity.
124	  - exact (False_ind _ (sngl_not_arrow Har)).
125	Qed.
126	
127	Lemma repl_typ_not_bot : forall p q T,
128	  repl_typ p q T ⊥ -> False.
129	Proof.
130	  intros p q T H. dependent destruction H.
131	Qed.
132	
133	(* ================================================================== *)
134	(* Lifting an arrow-source classification forward along a subtyping    *)
135	(* step of the target.                                                *)
136	(* ================================================================== *)
137	
138	Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
139	  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
140	Proof.
141	  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
142	  - left. exact Harr.
143	  - right. left. exact Hbot.
144	  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
145	  - right. right. right. subst S.
146	    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
147	    destruct Hsplit as [Hs | Hs]; [left | right];
148	      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
149	Qed.
150	
151	(* ================================================================== *)
152	(* The two exact residual "target-lift" facts.                         *)
153	(*                                                                     *)
154	(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
155	(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
156	(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
157	(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
158	(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
159	(* ================================================================== *)
160	
161	Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
162	  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
163	    HInv γ G ->
164	    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
165	    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
166	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
167	    ArrowSrc G S U.
168	
169	Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
170	  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
171	    HInv γ G ->
172	    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
173	    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
174	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
175	    ArrowSrc G S U.
176	
177	Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts :
178	  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift ->
179	  forall γ G S U,
180	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
181	Proof.
182	  intros HA HB γ0 G0 S0 U0 Hi0 Hsub0 Har0.
183	  revert γ0 Hi0 Har0.
184	  induction Hsub0 using subtyp_ind; intros γ Hi Har.
185	  - (* top *) 
186	    destruct Har as [Har | E]; [exact (False_ind _ (top_not_arrow Har)) | discriminate E].
187	  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
188	  - (* refl *) 
189	    destruct Har as [Har | E].
190	    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Har.
191	    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact E.
192	  - (* trans *) 
193	    pose proof (IHHsub0_2 γ Hi Har) as Hclass.
194	    destruct Hclass as [HarrT | [HbotT | [HpathT | [T1 [T2 [ET Hsplit]]]]]].
195	    + (* T arrow: use IH on the first premise *)
196	      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_introl HarrT)) as HC1.
197	      eapply ArrowSrc_lift; [exact HC1 | exact Hsub0_2 | exact Har].
198	    + (* T = bot: use IH on first premise at target bot *)
199	      subst T.
200	      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_intror eq_refl)) as HC1.

425	(* The one-step backward classification lemma. *)
426	Lemma ArrowSrc_step_back :
427	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class ->
428	  forall γ G S V U,
429	    HInv γ G ->
430	    subtyp_step G S V ->
431	    G ⊢ V <: U ->
432	    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
433	    ArrowSrc G V U ->
434	    ArrowSrc G S U.
435	Proof.
436	  intros Hand Hsel γ G S V U Hi Hstep HVU Har HAs.
437	  dependent destruction Hstep.
438	  - (* st_top: V = ⊤ *) exfalso.
439	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
440	    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
441	  - (* st_bot: S = ⊥ *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
442	  - (* st_refl: S = V *) exact HAs.
443	  - (* st_and11: S = T ∧ U0, V = T *)
444	    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. left. exact HVU.
445	  - (* st_and12: S = T ∧ U0, V = U0 *)
446	    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U0. split; [reflexivity|]. right. exact HVU.
447	  - (* st_and2: V = T ∧ U0, with S <: T and S <: U0 *)
448	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
449	    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
450	    + discriminate Hbot.
451	    + destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]. discriminate Ep.
452	    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2.
453	      exact (Hand γ G S T U0 U Hi (subtyp_and2 H H0) Hsplit Har).
454	  - (* st_fld: V = rcd {a ⦂ T} *) exfalso.
455	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
456	    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
457	  - (* st_typ: V = rcd {A >: S2 <: T2} *) exfalso.
458	    destruct HAs as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [V1 [V2 [E _]]]]]].
459	    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr). + discriminate Hbot. + (destruct Hpath as [pp [AA Ep]]; discriminate Ep). + discriminate E.
460	  - (* st_sngl_pq *)
461	    exact (@ArrowSrc_sngl_step G p q T T' U U0 H H0 H1 HAs).
462	  - (* st_sngl_qp *)
463	    exact (@ArrowSrc_sngl_step_qp G p q T T' U U0 H H0 H1 HAs).
464	  - (* st_sel2: S = S0, V = p↓A, typing premise p : rcd {A >: S0 <: T0} *)
465	    exact (Hsel γ G p A S T U Hi H HVU Har).
466	  - (* st_sel1: S = p↓A *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
467	  - (* st_all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
468	Qed.

470	Lemma ArrowSrc_star_back :
471	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class ->
472	  forall γ G S T,
473	    HInv γ G ->
474	    star (subtyp_step G) S T ->
475	    forall U,
476	      G ⊢ T <: U ->
477	      (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
478	      ArrowSrc G T U ->
479	      ArrowSrc G S U.
480	Proof.
481	  intros Hand Hsel γ G S T Hi Hstar.
482	  induction Hstar as [| X V Z Hstep Hrest IH]; intros U HTU Har HAs.
483	  - exact HAs.
484	  - assert (HVT : G ⊢ V <: Z) by (apply star_subtyp_step_sub; exact Hrest).
485	    assert (HVU : G ⊢ V <: U) by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HVT | exact HTU]).
486	    eapply ArrowSrc_step_back;
487	      [exact Hand | exact Hsel | exact Hi | exact Hstep | exact HVU | exact Har |].
488	    apply (IH U HTU Har HAs).
489	Qed.
