624	Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_four :
625	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
626	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
627	  SGood_arrow_closure.
628	Proof.
629	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p T Hi Hs.
630	  induction Hs; intros V Hsub Har.
631	  - (* sg_flow *) exists U. split; [|split].
632	    + apply (@pt3 G p U). apply (@pt2 G p R U). exact H.
633	    + apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R U Hi H).
634	    + exact Hsub.
635	  - (* sg_sub *) exact (IHHs V (subtyp_trans H Hsub) Har).
636	  - (* sg_new_elim *) apply (Hfld γ G p a T Hi Hs); assumption.
637	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) exfalso.
638	    exact (Hrcd γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har).
639	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) exfalso.
640	    exact (Hbnd γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har).
641	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) apply (Hopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs); assumption.
642	  - (* sg_and_intro *) 
643	    destruct (Hand γ G T U V Hi Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
644	    + exact (IHHs1 V HTV Har).
645	    + exact (IHHs2 V HUV Har).
646	  - (* sg_and_l *) apply (ArrowCl_and_l IHHs); assumption.
647	  - (* sg_and_r *) apply (ArrowCl_and_r IHHs); assumption.
648	  - (* sg_sngl *) exfalso.
649	    exact (Hsngl γ G q V Hi Hsub Har).
650	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) 
651	    apply (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Hsnglprec γ G p q Hi Hs1)); assumption.
652	  - (* sg_path_elim *) exfalso.
653	    exact (Hsngl γ G (q • a) V Hi Hsub Har).
654	Qed.
655	
656	(* The packaged bridge via Route B. *)
657	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four :
658	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
659	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
660	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
661	Proof.
662	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
663	  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
664	  pose proof (@SGood_arrow_closure_of_four Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec
665	                γ G p A Hi Hs) as Hcl.
666	  exact (Hcl A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
667	Qed.
668	
669	(* ================================================================== *)
670	(* Q3: an SGood-shaped invariant carrying a precise2 witness.          *)
671	(* ================================================================== *)
672	
673	Definition Prec2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) : Prop :=
674	  exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
675	
676	Definition Q3 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
677	  SGood γ G p T /\ Prec2 γ G p.
678	
679	Lemma Q3_to_SGood : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> SGood γ G p T.
680	Proof. intros γ G p T [Hs _]. exact Hs. Qed.
681	
682	Lemma Q3_prec2 : forall γ G p T, Q3 γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p.
683	Proof. intros γ G p T [_ Hp]. exact Hp. Qed.
684	
685	Lemma Q3_sub : forall γ G p T U,
686	  Q3 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q3 γ G p U.
687	Proof.
688	  intros γ G p T U [Hs Hp] Hsub. split; [|exact Hp].
689	  eapply sg_sub; eassumption.
690	Qed.
691	
692	Lemma SGood_to_Q3 :
693	  (forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Prec2 γ G p) ->
694	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q3 γ G p T.
695	Proof.
696	  intros Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs. split; [exact Hs | apply (Hprec γ G p T Hi Hs)].
697	Qed.
698	
699	Lemma Q3_arrow :
700	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> sngl_no_arrow_H -> and_arrow_split_H ->
701	  SGood_field_prec -> SGood_open_prec -> SGood_sngl_prec ->
702	  forall γ G p T,
703	    HInv γ G -> Q3 γ G p T ->
704	    forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
705	Proof.
706	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec γ G p T Hi [Hs _] U Hsub Har.
707	  pose proof (@SGood_arrow_closure_of_four Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl Hand Hfld Hopen Hsnglprec
708	                γ G p T Hi Hs) as Hcl.
709	  exact (Hcl U Hsub Har).
710	Qed.
711	
712	(* ================================================================== *)
713	(* Exact residual characterisation.                                    *)
714	(*                                                                     *)
715	(* [sel_lower_class] and [and_target_lift] are *equivalent* to the     *)
716	(* complete classification [arrow_source_class_gen] (the arrow-or-bot  *)
717	(* variant).  One direction is the reduction above; the other is        *)
718	(* immediate by transitivity, recorded here.  So no smaller structural  *)
719	(* fact remains: the missing ingredient is exactly the HInv/tight-      *)
720	(* member analysis of the selection detour (for [sel_lower_class]) and  *)
721	(* the transport of the component split through conjunction sources     *)
722	(* (for [and_target_lift]).                                             *)
723	(* ================================================================== *)
724	
725	Definition arrow_source_class_gen : Prop :=
726	  forall γ G S U,
727	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
728	
729	Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals :
730	  and_target_lift -> sel_lower_class -> arrow_source_class_gen.
731	Proof.
732	  intros Hand Hsel. unfold arrow_source_class_gen.
733	  exact (arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts
734	           (path_target_lift_of_residuals Hand Hsel) Hand).
735	Qed.
736	
737	Lemma and_target_lift_of_gen :
738	  arrow_source_class_gen -> and_target_lift.
739	Proof.
740	  intros Hclass γ G S T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Hsplit Har.
741	  assert (HSU : G ⊢ S <: U).
742	  { destruct Hsplit as [HT1U | HT2U].
743	    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub |].
744	      eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact HT1U].
745	    - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub |].
746	      eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact HT2U]. }
747	  exact (Hclass γ G S U Hi HSU Har).
748	Qed.
749	
750	Lemma sel_lower_class_of_gen :
751	  arrow_source_class_gen -> sel_lower_class.
752	Proof.
753	  intros Hclass γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
754	  assert (HSU : G ⊢ S <: U).
755	  { eapply subtyp_trans; [apply (@subtyp_sel2 G p A S T Hty) | exact Hcont]. }
756	  exact (Hclass γ G S U Hi HSU Har).
757	Qed.
758	
759	(* ================================================================== *)
760	(* Direct packaging from the four named facts (without the uniform     *)
761	(* classification).   [sngl_no_arrow_H] is needed only by Route B.      *)
762	(* ================================================================== *)
763	
764	Lemma Q2_residuals_of_four :
765	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
766	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
767	  Q2_residuals.
768	Proof.
769	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
770	  unfold Q2_residuals.
771	  split; [exact Hsub |].
772	  split; [apply (Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu Hmu Hs2) |].
773	  split; [exact (@Q2_path_elim_cl_proof) |].
774	  split; [apply (Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hrcd) |].
775	  split; [apply (Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hbnd) |].
776	  split; [apply (Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split_H Hand) |].
777	  exact (@Q2_sngl_cl_proof).
778	Qed.
779	
780	Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four_facts :
781	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
782	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
783	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
784	Proof.
785	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
786	  apply ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
787	  apply Q2_residuals_of_four; assumption.
788	Qed.
789	
790	Lemma HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_four_facts :
791	  rcd_no_arrow -> bnd_no_arrow -> and_arrow_split_H ->
792	  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
793	  forall γ G p T,
794	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
795	Proof.
796	  intros Hrcd Hbnd Hand Hsub Hmu Hs2.
797	  apply HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
798	  apply Q2_residuals_of_four; assumption.
799	Qed.
800	
801	(* ================================================================== *)
802	(* Assumption audit (no axioms; only the two label Parameters from     *)
803	(* the ambient Definitions).  Uncomment to inspect:                    *)
804	(* Print Assumptions ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_four.           *)
805	(* ================================================================== *)
806	
807	(* The exact frontier: the two isolated residuals are together
808	   equivalent to the complete arrow-or-bot source classification. *)
809	Lemma residuals_iff_class_gen :
810	  (and_target_lift /\ sel_lower_class) <-> arrow_source_class_gen.
811	Proof.
812	  split.
813	  - intros [Hand Hsel]. apply arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals; assumption.
814	  - intros Hgen. split.
815	    + apply and_target_lift_of_gen. exact Hgen.
816	    + apply sel_lower_class_of_gen. exact Hgen.
817	Qed.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
4	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
6	Close Scope string_scope.
7	
8	(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
9	   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
10	   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
11	   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
12	   induction. *)
13	Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
14	| sg_flow p R U :
15	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
16	    SGood γ G p U
17	| sg_sub p T U :
18	    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
19	    SGood γ G p U
20	| sg_new_elim p a T :
21	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
22	    SGood γ G (p • a) T
23	| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
24	    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
25	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
26	| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
27	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
28	    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
29	| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
30	    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
31	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
32	| sg_and_intro p T U :
33	    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
34	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
35	| sg_and_l p T U :
36	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
37	| sg_and_r p T U :
38	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
39	| sg_sngl p q :
40	    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
41	    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
42	| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
43	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
44	    SGood γ G p T
45	| sg_path_elim p q a T :
46	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
47	    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
48	
49	Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
50	  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
51	Proof.
52	  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
53	  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
54	  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
55	  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
56	  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
57	  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
58	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
59	  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
60	  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
61	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
62	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
63	  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
64	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
65	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
66	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
67	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
68	  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
69	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
70	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
71	  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
72	    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
73	    + assumption.
74	Qed.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* Strengthened Q.                                                     *)
11	(*                                                                     *)
12	(* This is the Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v with two cooperative           *)
13	(* strengthenings requested for the wf_push integration:                *)
14	(*                                                                     *)
15	(*   q2_prec2 : exists U, G ⊢!! p : U        (the explicit field)         *)
16	(*   q2_sngl  : the singleton payload is precise2, not merely precise3. *)
17	(*                                                                     *)
18	(* The precise2 singleton payload is what makes the [path_elim] and     *)
19	(* [sngl_trans] q2_prec2 clauses constructible (it supplies the first   *)
20	(* premise of [pt2_sngl_trans]); precise3 is recovered by [pt3].         *)
21	(* All recursive occurrences remain strictly positive (the record and   *)
22	(* μ occurrences are direct constructor arguments).                     *)
23	(* ================================================================== *)
24	
25	Inductive Q2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
26	| q2_intro : forall p T,
27	    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
28	    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S) ->
29	    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2) ->
30	    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
31	    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
32	    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
33	    Q2 γ G p T.
34	
35	(* Projections. *)
36	Lemma Q2_arrow : forall γ G p T,
37	  Q2 γ G p T -> forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
38	Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact Har. Qed.
39	
40	Lemma Q2_fld : forall γ G p T (a:trm_label) S,
41	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S.
42	Proof. intros γ G p T a S H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hfld a S). Qed.
43	
44	Lemma Q2_and : forall γ G p T T1 T2,
45	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2.
46	Proof. intros γ G p T T1 T2 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hand T1 T2). Qed.
47	
48	Lemma Q2_bnd : forall γ G p T T0,
49	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
50	Proof. intros γ G p T T0 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hbnd T0). Qed.
51	
52	Lemma Q2_sngl : forall γ G p T q,
53	  Q2 γ G p T -> T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
54	Proof. intros γ G p T q H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hsng q). Qed.
55	
56	Lemma Q2_prec2 : forall γ G p T,
57	  Q2 γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
58	Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact Hprec. Qed.
59	
60	(* Precise3 version of the singleton payload. *)
61	Lemma Q2_sngl3 : forall γ G p q,
62	  Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
63	Proof.
64	  intros γ G p q H. apply pt3. eapply Q2_sngl; eauto.
65	Qed.
66	
67	(* ================================================================== *)
68	(* Flow base: a precise flow output is Q2 at arbitrary fuel-bounded    *)
69	(* type size.  (Adapted from [Q_of_flow_ge].)                          *)
70	(* ================================================================== *)
71	
72	Lemma Q2_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
73	  g_typ_size T <= N ->
74	  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
75	Proof.
76	  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
77	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
78	  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
79	    + (* top *) apply q2_intro.
80	      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
81	        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
82	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
83	        -- exact HTU.
84	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
85	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
86	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
87	      * intros q E. discriminate E.
88	      * exists ⊤. apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
89	    + (* bot *) exfalso.
90	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
91	      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
92	    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
93	      * (* dec_typ *) apply q2_intro.
94	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
95	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
96	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
97	           ++ exact HU0.
98	        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
99	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
100	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
101	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
102	        -- exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
103	      * (* dec_trm *) apply q2_intro.
104	        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
105	           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
106	           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
107	           ++ exact HU0.
108	        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
109	           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
110	           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
111	           ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
112	        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
113	        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
114	        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
115	        -- exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
116	    + (* and *) apply q2_intro.
117	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
118	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
119	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
120	        -- exact HU0.
121	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
122	      * intros U1 U2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst U1. subst U2.
123	        split.
124	        -- refine (IH T1 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
125	           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
126	        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
127	           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
128	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
129	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
130	      * exists (T1 ∧ T2). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
131	    + (* path *) exfalso.
132	      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
133	      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
134	    + (* bnd *) apply q2_intro.
135	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
136	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
137	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
138	        -- exact HU0.
139	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
140	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
141	      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
142	        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
143	        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
144	        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
145	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
146	      * exists (μ T0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
147	    + (* all *) apply q2_intro.
148	      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
149	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
150	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
151	        -- exact HV0.
152	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
153	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
154	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
155	      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
156	      * exists (∀(S0) U0). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
157	    + (* sngl *) apply q2_intro.
158	      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
159	        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
160	        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
161	        -- exact HU0.
162	      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
163	      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
164	      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
165	      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
166	        apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
167	      * exists ({{ q0 }}). apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
168	Qed.
169	
170	Lemma Q2_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
171	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
172	Proof.
173	  intros. eapply (Q2_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
174	Qed.
175	
176	(* ================================================================== *)
177	(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
178	(* ================================================================== *)
179	
180	(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
181	   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
182	   needed. *)
183	Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
184	  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.
185	
186	Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
187	Proof.
188	  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
189	  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
190	    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
191	    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
192	    + apply fs_sngl.
193	    + exact Hsub.
194	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
195	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
196	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
197	  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
198	  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
199	Qed.
200	
201	(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
202	   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
203	Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
204	  forall γ G p q a T,
205	    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
206	    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.
207	
208	Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
209	Proof.
210	  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
211	  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
212	  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
213	  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
214	    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
215	  apply q2_intro.
216	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
217	    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
218	    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
219	    + apply fs_sngl.
220	    + exact Hsub.
221	  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
222	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
223	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
224	  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
225	  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
226	Qed.
227	
228	(* ================================================================== *)
229	(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
230	(* ================================================================== *)
231	
232	Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
233	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.
234	
235	Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
236	  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
237	
238	Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
239	  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).
240	
241	Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
242	  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).
243	
244	Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
245	  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).
246	
247	Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
248	  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
249	  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
250	  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
251	
252	(* ================================================================== *)
253	(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
254	(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
255	(* ================================================================== *)
256	
257	Lemma SGood_Q2_of_residuals :
258	  Q2_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p T.
259	Proof.
260	  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
261	  induction Hs.
262	  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q2_of_flow; eauto.
263	  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
264	  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
265	    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
266	  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
267	  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
268	  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
269	    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
270	  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
271	  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
272	    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
273	  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
274	    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
275	  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
276	  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
277	  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
278	Qed.
279	
280	(* Every SGood typing yields a precise2 typing of the path, under HInv,
281	   once the Q2 closure residuals are supplied.  This is the precise
282	   witness requested for [wf_push_cond]. *)
283	Lemma path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2 :
284	  Q2_residuals ->
285	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
286	Proof.
287	  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hs.
288	  exact (Q2_prec2 (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p T Hi Hs)).
289	Qed.
290	
291	(* The direct ordinary-typing version: this is the HInv-aware
292	   ordinary-path-to-precise2 bridge whose output feeds
293	   [wf_push_cond_of_path_precise]. *)
294	Theorem HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
295	  Q2_residuals ->
296	  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
297	Proof.
298	  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hty.
299	  eapply path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2; eauto.
300	  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
301	Qed.
302	
303	(* ================================================================== *)
304	(* Conditional reductions of the remaining residuals.                  *)
305	(*                                                                     *)
306	(* Each isolates the precise semantic ingredient that is still         *)
307	(* missing, so the frontier is explicit rather than hidden in a        *)
308	(* monolithic residual.                                                *)
309	(* ================================================================== *)
310	
311	(* --- (A) Target-intersection arrow split. ------------------------- *)
312	(* If an arrow supertype of [T ∧ U] is already a supertype of one      *)
313	(* component, the ArrowCl fields of the two premises compose.  The     *)
314	(* missing fact is exactly the split; it is the "and-supertype arrow"  *)
315	(* classification noted in agent_bridge1 (two Bridge witnesses below T *)
316	(* and U need not combine below T∧U).                                  *)
317	Definition and_arrow_split : Prop :=
318	  forall G T U V, G ⊢ T ∧ U <: V -> is_arrow V ->
319	    G ⊢ T <: V \/ G ⊢ U <: V.
320	
321	Lemma Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split :
322	  and_arrow_split -> Q2_and_intro_cl.
323	Proof.
324	  intros Hsplit γ G p T U Hi HT HU. apply q2_intro.
325	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
326	    destruct (Hsplit G T U V Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
327	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V HTV Har).
328	    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p U HU V HUV Har).
329	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
330	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst T1. subst T2.
331	    split; assumption.
332	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
333	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
334	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
335	Qed.
336	
337	(* --- (B) No arrow from a term-field record. ----------------------- *)
338	Definition rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
339	  forall γ G (a:trm_label) S V,
340	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
341	
342	Lemma Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
343	  rcd_no_arrow -> Q2_rcd_intro_cl.
344	Proof.
345	  intros Hna γ G p a T Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
346	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
347	    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har)).
348	  - (* field *) intros b S E. injection E as Eb ES. subst b. subst S.
349	    exact Ha.
350	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
351	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
352	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
353	  - (* prec2 *) destruct (Q2_prec2 Ha) as [U HU].
354	    exact (@precise2_prefix_snoc G p a U HU).
355	Qed.
356	
357	(* --- (C) No arrow from a recursive type. -------------------------- *)
358	Definition bnd_no_arrow : Prop :=
359	  forall γ G T0 V,
360	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
361	
362	Lemma Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
363	  bnd_no_arrow -> Q2_rec_intro_cl.
364	Proof.
365	  intros Hna γ G p T0 Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
366	  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
367	    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har)).
368	  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
369	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
370	  - (* mu *) intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'. exact Ha.
371	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
372	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 Ha).
373	Qed.
374	
375	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
376	(* (D) Singleton transitivity, reduced to the μ-opening transport.     *)
377	(*                                                                     *)
378	(* All cases except μ go through by strong induction on the type size: *)
379	(* the field case at [p•a,q•a] uses [pt2_sngl_trans] to transport the  *)
380	(* precise2 singleton payload, and the and case uses the two IHs.      *)
381	(* The sole obstruction is the μ field, which asks for the body opened *)
382	(* at [p] given the body opened at the aliased path [q].               *)
383	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
384	
385	Definition Q2_mu_open_transport : Prop :=
386	  forall γ G p q T0,
387	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
388	    Q2 γ G q (open_typ_p q T0) -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
389	
390	(* Precise2 transitivity at a singleton.  This is the one precise2 rule
391	   missing from the raw calculus (pt2_sngl_trans only transports a field
392	   selector).  With the precise2 singleton payload it is exactly what the
393	   singleton case of sngl-transport needs. *)
394	Definition Q2_prec2_sngl_trans : Prop :=
395	  forall G p q r, G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! q : {{ r }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ r }}.
396	
397	Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_ge :
398	  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
399	  forall (N:nat) (T:typ), g_typ_size T <= N ->
400	  forall γ G p q,
401	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
402	Proof.
403	  intros Hmu Hs2 N. induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p q Hi Hp2 Hq.
404	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
405	  - apply q2_intro.
406	    + (* arrow *) intros V Hsub HarV.
407	      destruct (@Q2_arrow γ G q T Hq V Hsub HarV) as [U [Hq3 [Hfs HUV]]].
408	      exists U. split; [|split].
409	      * eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp2 | exact Hq3].
410	      * exact Hfs.
411	      * exact HUV.
412	    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
413	      pose proof (@Q2_fld γ G q (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S Hq eq_refl) as HQqaS.
414	      destruct (Q2_prec2 HQqaS) as [U Hqa2].
415	      assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
416	        by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
417	      eapply IH.
418	      * simpl in Hsz. lia.
419	      * exact Hi.
420	      * exact Hpa2.
421	      * exact HQqaS.
422	    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
423	      destruct (@Q2_and γ G q (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 Hq eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
424	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H1].
425	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact Hi | exact Hp2 | exact H2].
426	    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
427	      eapply Hmu; eauto.
428	      eapply (@Q2_bnd γ G q (μ T0) T0 Hq eq_refl).
429	    + (* singleton *) intros q' E. subst T.
430	      eapply Hs2.
431	      * exact Hp2.
432	      * eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G q ({{ q' }}) q' Hq eq_refl).
433	    + (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp2.
434	Qed.
435	
436	Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu :
437	  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans -> Q2_sngl_trans_cl.
438	Proof.
439	  intros Hmu Hs2 γ G p q T Hi Hp Hq.
440	  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
441	  eapply (Q2_sngl_trans_ge Hmu Hs2 (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
442	Qed.
443	
444	(* ================================================================== *)
445	(* Partial sub-closure: arrow and type-member-record targets.           *)
446	(* These are unconditional (arrow) or conditional only on the exact     *)
447	(* no-arrow vacuity for the target head.                                *)
448	(* ================================================================== *)
449	
450	Lemma Q2_sub_arrow : forall γ G p T A,
451	  HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: A -> is_arrow A -> Q2 γ G p A.
452	Proof.
453	  intros γ G p T A Hi HT Hsub Harr. destruct Harr as [S [U EA]]. subst A.
454	  apply q2_intro.
455	  - (* arrow *) intros V HAV Har.
456	    apply (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V).
457	    + eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
458	    + exact Har.
459	  - (* field *) intros a S' E. discriminate E.
460	  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
461	  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
462	  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
463	  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
464	Qed.
465	
466	(* Arrow supertypes of a top target. *)
467	Definition top_no_arrow : Prop :=
468	  forall G V, G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
469	
470	Lemma Q2_to_top_of_no_arrow :
471	  top_no_arrow -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p typ_top.
472	Proof.
473	  intros Hna γ G p T Hi HT. apply q2_intro.
474	  - intros V HtopV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna G V HtopV Har)).
475	  - intros a S E. discriminate E.
476	  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
477	  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
478	  - intros q E. discriminate E.
479	  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
480	Qed.
481	
482	(* Arrow supertypes of a type-member record target. *)
483	Definition typ_rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
484	  forall γ G (A:typ_label) L U V,
485	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
486	
487	Lemma Q2_sub_typ_rcd_of_no_arrow :
488	  typ_rcd_no_arrow ->
489	  forall γ G p T (A:typ_label) L U,
490	    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T ->
491	    G ⊢ T <: typ_rcd {A >: L <: U} ->
492	    Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}).
493	Proof.
494	  intros Hna γ G p T A L U Hi HT Hsub. apply q2_intro.
495	  - intros V HrecV Har. exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G A L U V Hi HrecV Har)).
496	  - (* field: a type-member record is not a term-field record *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
497	  - intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
498	  - intros T0 E. discriminate E.
499	  - intros q E. discriminate E.
500	  - exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
501	Qed.
502	
503	(* ================================================================== *)
504	(* Compatibility with the original Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v: the      *)
505	(* strengthening is conservative (Q2 -> Q).  Q's singleton payload is  *)
506	(* precise3, recovered from Q2's precise2 payload by [pt3].            *)
507	(* ================================================================== *)
508	
509	Lemma Q2_to_Q_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
510	  g_typ_size T <= N -> forall γ G p, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
511	Proof.
512	  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p H.
513	  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
514	  - apply q_intro.
515	    + (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har. exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T H U Hsub Har).
516	    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
517	      eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia |].
518	      exact (@Q2_fld γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S H eq_refl).
519	    + (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. subst T.
520	      destruct (@Q2_and γ G p (T1 ∧ T2) T1 T2 H eq_refl) as [H1 H2]. split.
521	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H1].
522	      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hsz; lia | exact H2].
523	    + (* mu *) intros T0 E. subst T.
524	      eapply IH.
525	      * rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
526	      * exact (@Q2_bnd γ G p (μ T0) T0 H eq_refl).
527	    + (* singleton *) intros q E. subst T.
528	      apply pt3. eapply (@Q2_sngl γ G p ({{ q }}) q H eq_refl).
529	Qed.
530	
531	Lemma Q2_to_Q : forall γ G p T, Q2 γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
532	Proof.
533	  intros. eapply (Q2_to_Q_ge (N := g_typ_size T)); eauto.
534	Qed.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
4	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap.
6	Close Scope string_scope.
7	
8	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
9	(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
10	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
11	
12	Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
13	  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
14	Proof.
15	  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
16	  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
17	  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
18	    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
19	    + subst. exact H.
20	    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
24	Proof.
25	  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
26	  induction H; intros T0 ET.
27	  - discriminate ET.
28	  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
29	Qed.
30	
31	Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
32	Proof.
33	  intros C H. induction H.
34	  - apply ok_empty.
35	  - apply ok_push; auto.
36	Qed.
37	
38	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
39	(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
40	(*                                                                     *)
41	(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
42	(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
43	(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
44	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
45	
46	Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
47	  inert C ->
48	  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
49	  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
50	  U = {{ q }} /\
51	  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
52	Proof.
53	  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
54	  induction Hflow as
55	    [ x G T Hok Hb
56	    | G p a T U Hprem
57	    | p G T U Hprem IH
58	    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
59	    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
60	    intros Hin q0 ET.
61	  - (* pf_bind *)
62	    exfalso.
63	    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
64	    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
65	  - (* pf_fld *)
66	    subst U.
67	    split; [reflexivity|].
68	    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. assumption.
69	  - (* pf_open *)
70	    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
71	    discriminate HU.
72	  - (* pf_and1 *)
73	    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
74	    discriminate HU.
75	  - (* pf_and2 *)
76	    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
77	    discriminate HU.
78	Qed.
79	
80	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
81	(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
82	(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
83	(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
84	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
85	
86	Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
87	  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
88	Proof.
89	  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
90	Qed.
91	
92	Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
93	  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
94	  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
95	Proof.
96	  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
97	  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
98	Qed.

183	                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
184	                          (U := μ T1).

186	        -- reflexivity.
187	        -- exact H1.
188	        -- reflexivity.

190	        -- exact Hrt1.
191	        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).

232	      [ destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]; exact HinertG
233	      | destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec]; apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls:=ls); exact Hrec
234	      | exact Hx ]. }

248	      * reflexivity.

250	      * exact Hrt.

253	        -- rewrite EC. apply binds_push_eq.
254	    + (* an older variable *)
255	      assert (HbG : binds x0 T G).
256	      { eapply binds_concat_left_inv;
257	          [ rewrite EC in H0; exact H0
258	          | rewrite dom_single; apply notin_singleton_l; auto ]. }
259	      destruct (HInv_entries Hi HbG) as [v0 [Hv0 Hval0]].
260	      pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v0 T Hval0) as HinerT.
261	      pose proof (@ty_val_p_weaken G v0 T Hval0 x (μ T0) Hx) as Hval0'.
262	      dependent destruction Hval0'.
263	      * (* lambda *) apply rc_lam with (v := λ(T) t) (S0 := ∀(T) U).
264	        -- apply lookup_var. apply binds_push_neq; auto.
265	        -- apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L). intros z Hz.
266	           rewrite EC. exact (H1 z Hz).
267	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
268	        -- exists T, U; reflexivity.

270	                           (C := G0 & x0 ~ open_typ_p (pvar x0) T)
271	                           (bs := nil) (T0 := T) (ds := ds0) (U := μ T).

273	        -- reflexivity.
274	        -- exact H0.
275	        -- reflexivity.
276	        -- apply defs_at_DefsTyped.
277	           rewrite EC. eapply defs_at_weaken; [exact Hx | exact Hne |].
278	           exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hi))) x0 T ds0 HbG Hv0).
279	        -- exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinerT).

282	           ++ exact H0.

293	      * reflexivity.

295	      * reflexivity.

327	(* Extract the concrete stored-path typing from a [ResCore] whose output is
328	   a record with a singleton field.  The stored definition must be a path
329	   (a [defv] cannot be typed at a singleton field type), and its typing
330	   premise in the DefsTyped view context is returned. *)
331	Lemma rescore_sngl_field_path_typed : forall γ G p a q,
332	  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) ->
333	  exists (x:var) (Vc:typ) (C:ctx) (bs:fields) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (Tq:typ),
334	    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc /\
335	    binds x (μ Vc) G /\
336	    C ⊢ trm_path q : Tq.
337	Proof.
338	  intros γ G p a q R. dependent destruction R.
339	  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
340	  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0
341	                  (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) {a ⦂ {{ q }}} H4 H5
342	                  (@rh_one {a ⦂ {{ q }}})) as Hhas.
343	    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds
344	                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a {{ q }} H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
345	      as [rhs [Hd [Hstep Hty]]].
346	    destruct rhs as [q0|val].
347	    + dependent destruction Hty.
348	      exists x. exists Vc. exists (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc).
349	      exists bs. exists T0. exists ds. exists T.
350	      split; [reflexivity|split; [exact H1|exact H0]].
351	    + exfalso. dependent destruction Hty.
352	Qed.

357	(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
358	(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
359	(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
360	(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
361	(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
362	(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
363	(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
364	(*                                                                     *)
365	(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
366	(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
367	(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
368	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

370	Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
371	  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
372	    HInv γ G ->
373	    x # G ->
374	    record_type T0 ->
375	    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
376	    forall bs,
377	      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
378	      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

380	Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
381	  binds x (μ T0) G ->
382	  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
383	  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
384	Proof.
385	  intros GG x T0 p T Hb Hty.
386	  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) GG).
387	  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
388	    with (G := GG & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & (empty:ctx))
389	         (G1 := GG) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
390	  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
391	  - exact Hb.
392	  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
393	  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
394	Qed.

396	Lemma self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof :
397	  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge.
398	Proof.
399	  intros γ G x T0 ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow.
400	  assert (HinC : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
401	  { apply inert_push.
402	    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
403	    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
404	      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
405	    - exact Hx. }
406	  destruct (@flow_sngl_source (G & x ~ μ T0) (p_sel (avar_f x) bs)
407	              {{ q }} {{ q }} HinC Hflow q eq_refl)
408	    as [_ [p0 [a [R [Ep Hf0]]]]].
409	  pose proof (@flow_res_push γ G x T0 ds (G & x ~ μ T0) Hi Hx Hrt
410	                eq_refl Hdefs p0 R (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) Hf0) as Rc.
411	  destruct (@rescore_sngl_field_path_typed (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds)
412	              (G & x ~ μ T0) p0 a q Rc)
413	    as [x0 [Vc [C [bs0 [T0' [ds' [Tq [EC [Hb Hty]]]]]]]]].
414	  exists Tq.
415	  eapply (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x0 Vc q Tq Hb).

427	   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
428	   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow

437	    record_type T0 ->

442	  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.

462	Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
463	  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
464	  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
465	  forall γ G x S v,
466	    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
467	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
468	    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
469	              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
470	Proof.
471	  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
472	  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
473	  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
474	  dependent destruction Hval.
475	  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
476	    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
477	    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
478	    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
479	                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
480	    discriminate Esrc.
481	  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
482	    intros bs q Hflow.
483	    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
484	    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
485	    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
486	    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
487	    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
488	    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
489	    { apply inert_push.
490	      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
491	      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
492	        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
493	      - exact Hx. }
494	    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
495	Qed.

501	    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
502	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
503	    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->

508	  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
509	  wf_push_cond_statement.

513	Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
514	  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
515	Proof.
516	  intro Hpath.
517	  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
518	           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
519	Qed.
520	
521	(* Integration note.  Once the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge
522	   [inert_path_precise_bridge] is discharged (by this worker or another),
523	   the exact scratch parameter is recovered by
524	
525	     Lemma wf_push_cond : wf_push_cond_statement :=
526	       wf_push_cond_of_path_precise <proof-of-bridge>.
527	
528	   All the self/flow-resolution work is already unconditional:
529	   [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof] proves the flow-to-stored-path
530	   typing step without using the [wf] component of [HInv] or the old
531	   scratch parameter.  The only remaining hypothesis is the shared
532	   ordinary-path-precision fact for inert contexts. *)
533

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
4	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed agent_bridge1 agent_repl agent_good.
6	Close Scope string_scope.
7	
8	Ltac solve_union_sub :=
9	  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_sub
10	        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_sub
11	        | apply in_singleton_self'
12	        | assumption ].
13	
14	(* ================================================================== *)
15	(* A. Replacement is symmetric.                                        *)
16	(*                                                                     *)
17	(* The domain position of an arrow is contravariant.  When an arrow is *)
18	(* moved across a singleton/replacement rule we therefore have to      *)
19	(* replace in the *opposite* direction.  The replacement relation is   *)
20	(* structurally symmetric.                                             *)
21	(* ================================================================== *)
22	
23	Lemma repl_typ_sym :
24	  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T) /\
25	  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D).
26	Proof.
27	  apply repl_mutind.
28	  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH. apply rrcd. apply IH.
29	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand1. apply IH.
30	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rand2. apply IH.
31	  - intros p q bs A. apply rpath.
32	  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH. apply rbnd. apply IH.
33	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall1. apply IH.
34	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH. apply rall2. apply IH.
35	  - intros p q bs. apply rsngl.
36	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp1. apply IH.
37	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH. apply rdtyp2. apply IH.
38	  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH. apply rdtrm. apply IH.
39	Qed.
40	
41	Lemma repl_typ_sym_t : forall p q (T T':typ),
42	  repl_typ p q T T' -> repl_typ q p T' T.
43	Proof. intros. exact (proj1 repl_typ_sym p q T T' H). Qed.
44	
45	Lemma repl_typ_sym_d : forall p q (D D':dec),
46	  repl_dec p q D D' -> repl_dec q p D' D.
47	Proof. intros. exact (proj2 repl_typ_sym p q D D' H). Qed.
48	
49	(* ================================================================== *)
50	(* B. Replacement commutes with opening of a bound type variable.      *)
51	(*                                                                     *)
52	(* This is the analogue of [repl_typ_subst] for de Bruijn opening.    *)
53	(* Needed when the body of an arrow is moved under a fresh binder.     *)
54	(* ================================================================== *)
55	
56	Lemma open_rec_path_sel_fields : forall k x (p:path) bs,
57	  open_rec_path k x (p •• bs) = (open_rec_path k x p) •• bs.
58	Proof.
59	  intros k x [a fs] bs. simpl. unfold sel_fields. reflexivity.
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma open_rec_path_named : forall k x (p:path),
63	  named_path p -> open_rec_path k x p = p.
64	Proof.
65	  intros k x [a fs] [y [cs E]]. inversion E. subst. reflexivity.
66	Qed.
67	
68	(* Replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening, provided the replacement
69	   paths are named (so they are unaffected by opening). *)
70	Lemma repl_typ_open :
71	  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' ->
72	     named_path p -> named_path q ->
73	     forall k x, repl_typ p q (open_rec_typ k x T) (open_rec_typ k x T')) /\
74	  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' ->
75	     named_path p -> named_path q ->
76	     forall k x, repl_dec p q (open_rec_dec k x D) (open_rec_dec k x D')).
77	Proof.
78	  apply repl_mutind.
79	  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rrcd. apply (IH Hp Hq).
80	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
81	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
82	  - intros p q bs A Hp Hq k x. simpl.
83	    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
84	    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
85	    apply rpath.
86	  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hp Hq k x.
87	    change (repl_typ p q (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1)) (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
88	    apply rbnd. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
89	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
90	    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x T1) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))
91	                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x T2) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))).
92	    apply rall1. exact (IH Hp Hq k x).
93	  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
94	    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1))
95	                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
96	    apply rall2. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
97	  - intros p q bs Hp Hq k x. simpl.
98	    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
99	    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
100	    apply rsngl.
101	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
102	  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
103	  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtrm. apply (IH Hp Hq).
104	Qed.
105	
106	(* ================================================================== *)
107	(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
108	(*                                                                     *)
109	(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
110	(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
111	(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
112	(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
113	(* ================================================================== *)
114	
115	Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
116	| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
117	| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
118	| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
119	| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
120	| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
121	| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
122	    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
123	| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
124	    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
125	| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
126	    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
127	    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
128	| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
129	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
130	    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
131	    repl_typ p q T T' ->
132	    subtyp1 G T T'
133	| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
134	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
135	    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
136	    repl_typ q p T T' ->
137	    subtyp1 G T T'
138	| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
139	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
140	    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
141	| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
142	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
143	    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
144	| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
145	    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
146	    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
147	    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).
148	
149	Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
150	Proof.
151	  intros G S U H. induction H.
152	  - apply subtyp_top.
153	  - apply subtyp_bot.
154	  - apply subtyp_refl.
155	  - apply subtyp_and11.
156	  - apply subtyp_and12.
157	  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
158	  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
159	  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
160	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
161	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
162	  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
163	  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
164	  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
165	Qed.
166	
167	(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
168	Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
169	  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
170	  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
171	  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
172	Proof.
173	  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
174	  - left. split; auto.
175	  - right. split; auto.
176	Qed.
177	
178	(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
179	Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
180	  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
181	Proof.
182	  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
183	  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
184	  - (* sngl_pq *)
185	    match goal with
186	    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
187	      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
188	    end.
189	    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
190	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
191	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
192	      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
193	    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
194	  - (* sngl_qp *)
195	    match goal with
196	    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
197	      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
198	    end.
199	    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
200	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
201	      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
202	      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
203	    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
204	  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
205	Qed.
206	
207	(* ================================================================== *)
208	(* D. Conditional application-preservation step.                       *)
209	(*                                                                     *)
210	(* The unrestricted bridge statements in agent_bridge.v are refutable  *)
211	(* in non-HInv contexts (counter_bridge2.v, and the same loose-record  *)
212	(* / type-member selection pattern refutes the unrestricted           *)
213	(* arrow_open_bridge).  The corrected HInv-aware interface lives in    *)
214	(* aux_bridge_fixed.v.  We expose the exact residual and the assembly. *)
215	(* ================================================================== *)
216	
217	(* Exact residuals.  The raw, context-free bridge statements are false
218	   (loose record bindings give incompatible type-member views; see
219	   counter_bridge2.v for the analogous refutation of bridge 2).  The
220	   HInv-aware variants below are the correct interfaces.
221	
222	   What is *proven* in this file, unconditionally:
223	
224	     - repl_typ_sym       : replacement is symmetric (needed because the
225	                            arrow domain is contravariant);
226	     - repl_typ_open      : replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening
227	                            when the replacement paths are named;
228	     - subtyp1_all_domain : arrow-domain inversion for the trans-free
229	                            subtyping relation [subtyp1].
230	
231	   What remains for the HInv-aware arrow-opening bridge is exactly the
232	   *coherence* of path typings at records in an inert context: a path
233	   [p] can be typed at two record views [rcd{A>:S1<:T1}] and
234	   [rcd{A>:S2<:T2}] of the same tight record, and one needs the tight
235	   bound [Q] with [S1 <: Q <: T2] (and its arrow structure) to compose
236	   the two type-selection steps.  This is the same metatheoretic content
237	   as the ordinary-path -> precise3 principal-typing bridge.  Without
238	   it, [subtyp1] is not closed under transitivity even in an inert
239	   context (the detour can pass through a type member whose tight bound
240	   is [⊤]), although such a detour cannot connect two *arrow* endpoints
241	   unless the tight bound is itself arrow-compatible. *)
242	Definition arrow_open_HInv_residual : Prop := arrow_open_HInv_bridge.
243	
244	Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_HInv_residual : Prop := rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.
245	
246	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
247	(* E.  The narrow field-precision residual.                            *)
248	(*                                                                     *)
249	(* [field_sub_closure] (agent_bridge1.v) asks: a path [p] typed at a   *)
250	(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
251	(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
252	(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
253	(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
254	(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
255	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
256	
257	Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
258	  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
259	Proof.
260	  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
261	  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
262	  exists V. exact HV.
263	Qed.
264	
265	(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
266	   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
267	   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
268	Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
269	  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
270	  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
271	  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
272	Proof.
273	  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
274	  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
275	  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
276	Qed.
277	
278	(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
279	   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
280	   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
281	   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)
282	
283	(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.
284	
285	   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
286	   precision *soundness*:
287	
288	     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)
289	
290	   and its two companions R (exists U, C⊢!! p:U) and Rsing.
291	
292	   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
293	     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
294	     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
295	     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
296	     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
297	   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
298	     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
299	     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
300	     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
301	     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
302	     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
303	   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
304	     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
305	     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
306	     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).
307	
308	   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
309	   the unconditional implication available here is
310	   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)
311	
312	(* Natural-field form (field type an arrow / μ-record / singleton).  The
313	   same reduction applies; no restriction on S is even needed. *)
314	Lemma field_sub_closure_natural_of_path_precise :
315	  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
316	  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
317	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
318	    flow_shape S -> exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
319	Proof.
320	  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT Hfs. subst T.
321	  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
322	  exists V. apply pt3. exact HV.
323	Qed.
324	
325	(* NOTE on the R / Rsing / F decomposition (agent_bridge1.v).  The
326	   [ty_new_elim] case inherently needs *unrestricted* field precision:
327	   from [p0 : rcd{b ⦂ rcd{a ⦂ S}}] one must precisely type [p0 • b] at
328	   some [V], and then select [a] from [V].  The intermediate field type
329	   [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is a record, so a version of [F] restricted to natural
330	   field types cannot be applied at that step; and the relation between
331	   the precise field type [V] and the ordinary view [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is
332	   exactly the precision-soundness invariant (a flow output being a
333	   subtype of the ordinary typing).  Thus [field_sub_closure] and the
334	   bridge are equivalent in strength for the needs of this development;
335	   the clean unconditional implication is the one proven above. *)
336	
337	(* The assembly, restated with the exact residual name. *)
338	Lemma app_step_from_precise3_residual :
339	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
340	  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
341	  arrow_open_HInv_residual ->
342	  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
343	    HInv γ G ->
344	    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
345	    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
346	    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
347	      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
348	      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
349	Proof.
350	  intros. eapply app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv; eauto.
351	Qed.
352	
353	(* ================================================================== *)
354	(* F. Type-member coherence: the combinatorial core and its exact     *)
355	(*    semantic residual.                                              *)
356	(*                                                                     *)
357	(* A record type has distinct labels, so a type member [A] occurring   *)
358	(* in a [record_type] occurs exactly once.  Consequently two            *)
359	(* [record_has] facts for type members with the same label expose the   *)
360	(* *same* tight bound.  This is the uniqueness half of                    *)
361	(* [typ_member_common_bound]; the provenance half (every ordinary       *)
362	(* record view brackets the tight bound of the path's precise flow) is  *)
363	(* isolated in the interfaces below.                                    *)
364	(* ================================================================== *)
365	
366	Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec),
367	  record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
368	Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.
369	
370	Lemma record_typ_has_label_in : forall (T:typ) ls (D:dec),
371	  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of_dec D \in ls.
372	Proof.
373	  intros T ls D Hrt. revert D.
374	  induction Hrt; intros Dx Hhas.
375	  - (* rt_one *)
376	    inversion Hhas; subst; apply in_singleton_self'.
377	  - (* rt_cons *)
378	    inversion Hhas; subst.
379	    + (* from the left component *)
380	      apply in_union_l. eapply IHHrt; eauto.
381	    + (* from the right component *)
382	      apply in_union_r.
383	      match goal with
384	      | HR : record_has (typ_rcd ?DD) _ |- _ =>
385	        pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite E
386	      end.
387	      apply in_singleton_self'.
388	Qed.
389	
390	Lemma record_has_typ_unique : forall (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W1 W2,
391	  record_type U ->
392	  record_has U { A >: W1 <: W1 } ->
393	  record_has U { A >: W2 <: W2 } ->
394	  W1 = W2.
395	Proof.
396	  intros U A W1 W2 [ls Hrt]. revert A W1 W2.
397	  induction Hrt; intros A W1 W2 Hrec1 Hrec2.
398	  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hrec1; subst; inversion Hrec2; subst; reflexivity.
399	  - (* rt_cons *)
400	    destruct (classic (label_typ A = label_of_dec D)) as [El|En].
401	    + (* both occurrences are the right component *)
402	      assert (Hr1 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
403	      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
404	        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
405	          change (label_of_dec { A >: W1 <: W1 } \in ls).
406	          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
407	        - assumption. }
408	      assert (Hr2 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
409	      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
410	        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
411	          change (label_of_dec { A >: W2 <: W2 } \in ls).
412	          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
413	        - assumption. }
414	      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr1) as E1.
415	      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr2) as E2.
416	      rewrite <- E2 in E1. injection E1 as E. exact E.
417	    + (* both occurrences are the left component *)
418	      assert (Hl1 : record_has T { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
419	      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
420	        - assumption.
421	        - exfalso. apply En.
422	          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
423	            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
424	      assert (Hl2 : record_has T { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
425	      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
426	        - assumption.
427	        - exfalso. apply En.
428	          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
429	            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
430	      eapply IHHrt; eauto.
431	Qed.

437	(* (I1) Every record-typed path has a precise flow, flow-shaped output. *)
438	Definition path_flow_exists_HInv : Prop :=
439	  forall γ G p T,
440	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
441	    exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.
442	
443	(* (I2) Precision soundness: flow output subtyping every ordinary type. *)
444	Definition flow_sound_HInv : Prop :=
445	  forall γ G p R U T,
446	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> G ⊢ U <: T.
447	
448	(* (I3) Tight type-member extraction from a record view. *)
449	Definition flow_typ_member_inv : Prop :=
450	  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
451	    HInv γ G ->
452	    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
453	    exists W,
454	      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
455	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

457	Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces :
458	  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
459	  flow_sound_HInv ->
460	  flow_typ_member_inv ->
461	  typ_member_common_bound.
462	Proof.
463	  intros HF HS HM γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
464	  destruct (HF γ G p0 (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) Hi H1) as [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
465	  assert (Hs1 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
466	  assert (Hs2 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
467	  destruct (HM γ G U A S1 T1 Hi Hfs Hs1) as [W1 [Hrt [Hhas1 [Hl1 Hu1]]]].
468	  destruct (HM γ G U A S2 T2 Hi Hfs Hs2) as [W2 [_ [Hhas2 [Hl2 Hu2]]]].
469	  assert (E : W1 = W2) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
470	  subst W2.
471	  exists W1. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
472	Qed.

474	Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_interfaces :
475	  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
476	  flow_sound_HInv ->
477	  flow_typ_member_inv ->
478	  alias_typ_member_coherence.
479	Proof.
480	  intros HF HS HM.
481	  apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
482	  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces; assumption.
483	Qed.

486	(* The canonical-bound interface matching the structural Good payload.  *)
487	(*                                                                     *)
488	(* The Good invariant for a record type should carry, for each type     *)
489	(* member [A], a canonical tight bound [W] (from the actual record_dec  *)
490	(* / flow provenance: for an actual [dec_typ] W = L = U).  The payload  *)
491	(* must say that *every* record view [p0 : rcd{A>:S<:T}] of that path  *)
492	(* brackets the same [W].  Then the coherence residual is immediate.    *)
493	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
494	
495	Definition canonical_member_bound : Prop :=
496	  forall γ G (p0:path) (A:typ_label),
497	    HInv γ G ->
498	    exists W, forall S T,
499	      G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
500	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

502	Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical :
503	  canonical_member_bound -> typ_member_common_bound.
504	Proof.
505	  intros HC γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
506	  destruct (HC γ G p0 A Hi) as [W HW].
507	  destruct (HW S1 T1 H1) as [Hl1 Hu1].
508	  destruct (HW S2 T2 H2) as [Hl2 Hu2].
509	  exists W. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
510	Qed.

512	Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_canonical :
513	  canonical_member_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
514	Proof.
515	  intros HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
516	  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical. exact HC.
517	Qed.

523	(* non-transitive fragment the only rules producing a type-member      *)
524	(* record are refl, subtyp_typ, the two and-projections and the        *)
525	(* singleton replacements, and each case is explicit.  The remaining   *)
526	(* (full [subtyp]) difficulty is exactly transitivity elimination for  *)

532	  exists D, U = typ_rcd D /\ repl_dec p q D {A >: S <: T}.

540	  (exists S0, D = {A >: S0 <: T} /\ repl_typ p q S0 S) \/
541	  (exists T0, D = {A >: S <: T0} /\ repl_typ p q T0 T).
542	Proof.
543	  intros p q D A S T H. dependent destruction H.
544	  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
