576	Lemma subtyp1_typ_member_inv : forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
577	  flow_shape U ->
578	  subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) ->
579	  exists W,
580	    record_type U /\ record_has U {A >: W <: W} /\
581	    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
582	Proof.
583	  intros G U A S T Hfs Hsub.
584	  remember (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) as R eqn:ER.
585	  revert A S T Hfs ER.
586	  induction Hsub; intros A0 S0 T0 Hfs ER.
587	  - (* subtyp1_top *) discriminate ER.
588	  - (* subtyp1_bot *) exfalso. exact (flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
589	  - (* subtyp1_refl *)
590	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
591	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
592	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt) as Hdec.
593	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
594	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
595	    + apply rh_one.
596	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
597	  - (* subtyp1_and11 *)
598	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
599	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
600	    pose proof (@record_type_and_l (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) U Hrt) as Hrt1.
601	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt1) as Hdec.
602	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
603	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
604	    + apply rh_andl. apply rh_one.
605	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
606	  - (* subtyp1_and12 *)
607	    subst U. dependent destruction Hfs.
608	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
609	    pose proof (@record_type_and_r T (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) Hrt) as Hrt2.
610	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt2) as Hdec.
611	    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
612	    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
613	    + apply rh_andr. apply rh_one.
614	    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
615	  - (* subtyp1_and2 *) discriminate ER.
616	  - (* subtyp1_fld *) discriminate ER.
617	  - (* subtyp1_typ *)
618	    injection ER as EA ES ET. subst A0. subst S0. subst T0.
619	    dependent destruction Hfs.
620	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
621	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1} Hrt) as Hdec.
622	    assert (E : S1 = T1) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
623	    subst T1. exists S1. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
624	    + apply rh_one.
625	    + split.
626	      * eapply subtyp1_subtyp; eassumption.
627	      * eapply subtyp1_subtyp; eassumption.
628	  - (* subtyp1_sngl_pq *)
629	    subst T'.
630	    destruct (@repl_typ_rcd_targets p q T _ _ _ H1) as [D [ET Hdec]].
631	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
632	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
633	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd D Hrt) as Hrd.
634	    destruct (@repl_dec_typ_targets p q D _ _ _ Hdec) as [[Sx [ED Hrepl]] | [Tx [ED Hrepl]]].
635	    + subst D.
636	      assert (E : Sx = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
637	      subst T0. exists Sx. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
638	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}) {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}). apply rh_one.
639	      * split.
640	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
641	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
642	               eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | apply repl_typ_sym_t; exact Hrepl] end end.
643	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
644	    + subst D.
645	      assert (E : S0 = Tx) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
646	      subst Tx. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
647	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: S0}) {A0 >: S0 <: S0}). apply rh_one.
648	      * split.
649	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
650	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
651	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
652	               eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | exact Hrepl] end end.
653	  - (* subtyp1_sngl_qp *)
654	    subst T'.
655	    destruct (@repl_typ_rcd_targets q p T _ _ _ H1) as [D [ET Hdec]].
656	    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
657	    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
658	    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd D Hrt) as Hrd.
659	    destruct (@repl_dec_typ_targets q p D _ _ _ Hdec) as [[Sx [ED Hrepl]] | [Tx [ED Hrepl]]].
660	    + subst D.
661	      assert (E : Sx = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
662	      subst T0. exists Sx. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
663	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}) {A0 >: Sx <: Sx}). apply rh_one.
664	      * split.
665	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
666	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
667	               eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | apply repl_typ_sym_t; exact Hrepl] end end.
668	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
669	    + subst D.
670	      assert (E : S0 = Tx) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hrd]).
671	      subst Tx. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
672	      * change (record_has (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: S0}) {A0 >: S0 <: S0}). apply rh_one.
673	      * split.
674	        -- apply subtyp_refl.
675	        -- match goal with Hs1 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ =>
676	             match goal with Hs2 : ?GG ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ =>
677	               eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2 | exact Hrepl] end end.
678	  - (* subtyp1_sel2 *) discriminate ER.
679	  - (* subtyp1_sel1 *) exfalso. exact (flow_shape_path_absurd Hfs).
680	  - (* subtyp1_all *) discriminate ER.
681	Qed.

684	(* H. Final reduction of [canonical_member_bound].                     *)
685	(*                                                                     *)
686	(* Only one semantic fact is needed: record-target soundness for a     *)
687	(* precise flow.  Given a flow [p : R ⪼ U] and an ordinary record       *)
688	(* typing [p : rcd{A>:S<:T}], the flow output [U] is the actual tight   *)
689	(* record, and its type member [A] has bound [W] bracketed by [S,T].    *)
690	(* This is the runtime/provenance step (lookup of the actual object and *)
691	(* its [record_dec]); the combinatorial uniqueness is already proven.   *)
692	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
693	
694	Definition flow_record_member_sound : Prop :=
695	  forall γ G p R (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
696	    HInv γ G ->
697	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
698	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
699	    exists W,
700	      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
701	      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
702	
703	Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_flow_record_member :
704	  path_flow_exists_HInv -> flow_record_member_sound -> canonical_member_bound.
705	Proof.
706	  intros HF HFS γ G p0 A Hi.
707	  destruct (classic (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }))
708	    as [[S [T Hty]] | Hnone].
709	  - destruct (HF γ G p0 (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) Hi Hty) as [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
710	    destruct (HFS γ G p0 R U A S T Hi Hf Hty) as [W [Hrt [Hhas [Hl Hu]]]].
711	    exists W. intros S' T' Hty'.
712	    destruct (HFS γ G p0 R U A S' T' Hi Hf Hty') as [W' [_ [Hhas' [Hl' Hu']]]].
713	    assert (E : W' = W) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
714	    subst W'. split; assumption.
715	  - exists typ_top. intros S T Hty. exfalso. apply Hnone. exists S, T. exact Hty.
716	Qed.

718	Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_record_sound :
719	  path_flow_exists_HInv -> flow_record_member_sound -> typ_member_common_bound.
720	Proof.
721	  intros HF HS. apply typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical.
722	  apply canonical_member_bound_of_flow_record_member; assumption.
723	Qed.

726	  path_flow_exists_HInv -> flow_record_member_sound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
727	Proof.
728	  intros HF HS. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
729	  apply canonical_member_bound_of_record_sound; assumption.
730	Qed.

735	(* A [pf_bind] flow on [x : μ R] outputs [μ R] itself, while the       *)
736	(* ordinary record view of the same path is obtained by [ty_rec_elim]. *)
737	(* Hence the conclusion would require [record_type (μ R)], which is    *)
738	(* absurd.  We exhibit a concrete HInv context below.                  *)

741	Lemma open_typ_p_closed_rcd_top : forall (A0:typ_label) x,
742	  open_typ_p (pvar x) (typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) = typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}.
743	Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

745	Lemma defs_typ_one_typed : forall (A0:typ_label) (C:ctx) (x0:var),
746	  x0; nil; C ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}.
747	Proof. intros. apply ty_defs_one. apply ty_def_typ. Qed.

749	Lemma HInv_mu_rcd_top : forall (A0:typ_label) (x:var),
750	  x # (empty:ctx) ->
751	  HInv (empty & x ~ (ν(typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) (defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤))))
752	        (empty & x ~ μ (typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤})).
753	Proof.
754	  intros A0 x Hx.
755	  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
756	  set (ds := defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤)).
757	  set (v := ν(R) ds).
758	  assert (Hval : empty ⊢!v v : μ R).
759	  { subst v. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := (\{} : vars)). intros w _.
760	    change (w; nil; (empty & w ~ R) ⊢ ds :: R).
761	    subst ds. change (w; nil; (empty & w ~ R) ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
762	    apply defs_typ_one_typed. }
763	  assert (Hxs : x # (empty:sta)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
764	  apply (@HInv_push empty empty x (μ R) v).
765	  - apply HInv_empty.
766	  - exact Hx.
767	  - exact Hxs.
768	  - exact Hval.
769	  - intros T0 ds0 E.
770	    subst v. injection E as ER Eds. subst T0. subst ds0. split; [reflexivity|].
771	    unfold defs_at.
772	    subst ds.
773	    change (x; nil; ((empty & x ~ μ typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) & x ~ typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤})
774	              ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
775	    apply defs_typ_one_typed.
776	Qed.

778	Lemma flow_record_member_sound_false : forall (A0:typ_label),
779	  ~ flow_record_member_sound.
780	Proof.
781	  intros A0 HFS.
782	  destruct (var_fresh (\{} : vars)) as [x Hx].
783	  assert (Hxctx : x # (empty:ctx)) by (rewrite dom_empty; exact Hx).
784	  pose proof (@HInv_mu_rcd_top A0 x Hxctx) as Hi.
785	  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) in *.
786	  assert (Hb : binds x (μ R) (empty & x ~ μ R))
787	    by (apply binds_push_eq).
788	  assert (Hok : ok (empty & x ~ μ R)) by (eapply HInv_ok; exact Hi).
789	  assert (Hf : (empty & x ~ μ R) ⊢! pvar x : μ R ⪼ μ R)
790	    by (apply pf_bind; [exact Hok | exact Hb]).
791	  assert (Hvar : (empty & x ~ μ R) ⊢ trm_path (pvar x) : μ R)
792	    by (apply ty_var; exact Hb).
793	  assert (Hty : (empty & x ~ μ R) ⊢ trm_path (pvar x) : R).
794	  { change ((empty & x ~ μ R) ⊢ trm_path (pvar x) : open_typ_p (pvar x) R).
795	    apply ty_rec_elim. exact Hvar. }
796	  destruct (HFS _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hi Hf Hty) as [W [Hrt _]].
797	  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd R Hrt).
798	Qed.

801	(* J. Record-view inversion and the exact runtime residual.            *)
802	(*                                                                     *)
803	(* Proven here: for a *trans-free* comparison from an actual tight     *)
804	(* record to a member view, the view's bounds bracket the actual tight *)
805	(* member bound.  Uniqueness of the type member ([record_has_typ_unique]) *)
806	(* identifies the two [W]s.                                            *)
807	(* ================================================================== *)
808	
809	Lemma record_dec_view_inv_subtyp1 : forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
810	  record_type U ->
811	  record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
812	  subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
813	  G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
814	Proof.
815	  intros G U A W S T Hrt Hhas Hsub.
816	  assert (Hfs : flow_shape U) by (apply fs_rec; exact Hrt).
817	  destruct (@subtyp1_typ_member_inv G U A S T Hfs Hsub)

935	(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
936	(*                                                                     *)
937	(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
938	(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
939	(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
940	(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
941	(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
942	(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
943	(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
944	(* ================================================================== *)
945	
946	Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
947	| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
948	| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
949	| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
950	| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
951	| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
952	| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
953	    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
954	| st_fld : forall G T U a,
955	    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
956	| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
957	    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
958	    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
959	| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
960	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
961	    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
962	| st_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
963	    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
964	    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
965	| st_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
966	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G S (p ↓ A)
967	| st_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
968	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G (p ↓ A) T
969	| st_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
970	    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
971	    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
972	    subtyp_step G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).
973	
974	Lemma subtyp_step_subtyp : forall G S U,
975	  subtyp_step G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
976	Proof.
977	  intros G S U H. induction H.
978	  - apply subtyp_top.
979	  - apply subtyp_bot.
980	  - apply subtyp_refl.
981	  - apply subtyp_and11.
982	  - apply subtyp_and12.
983	  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
984	  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
985	  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
986	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
987	  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
988	  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
989	  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
990	  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
991	Qed.
992	
993	Lemma star_trans_gen : forall (A:Type) (R:A -> A -> Prop) (a b c:A),
994	  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
995	Proof.
996	  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
997	  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
998	  - exact H2.
999	  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
1000	Qed.
1001	
1002	Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
1003	  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
1004	Proof.
1005	  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
1006	  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
1007	  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
1008	  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
1009	  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
1010	  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
1011	  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
1012	  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1013	  - (* fld *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_fld; exact H | apply star_refl].
1014	  - (* typ *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_typ; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1015	  - (* sngl_pq *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_pq; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
1016	  - (* sngl_qp *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_qp; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
1017	  - (* sel2 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel2; exact H | apply star_refl].
1018	  - (* sel1 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel1; exact H | apply star_refl].
1019	  - (* all *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_all; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
1020	Qed.

1024	   rule subtyping [R0 <: R] keeps the star.  This is the branch that was
1025	   previously blocked by the missing transitivity of [subtyp1]. *)
1026	Lemma star_subtyp_step_psub : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
1027	  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 ->
1028	  G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
1029	  star (subtyp_step G) U R.

1031	  intros G U R0 R Hstar Hsub.

1227	(* N. Warning: the HInv-free star record-view inversion is FALSE.      *)
1228	(*                                                                     *)
1229	(* Counterexample pattern (the loose-record selection detour):         *)
1230	(*   G := empty & z ~ rcd{A0 >: U <: rcd{A>:S<:T}}                     *)
1231	(*   U := rcd{A>:W<:W}  (a record_type with the actual member A:W)     *)
1232	(* The same binding gives two ordinary typings of [z]:                 *)
1233	(*   z : rcd{A0>:U<:rcd{A>:S<:T}}                                      *)
1234	(* hence the two atoms                                                *)
1235	(*   st_sel2 : subtyp_step G U (z ↓ A0)                                *)
1236	(*   st_sel1 : subtyp_step G (z ↓ A0) (rcd{A>:S<:T})                   *)
1237	(* and therefore a star from U to the view [rcd{A>:S<:T}].  But [S,T]  *)
1238	(* are arbitrary (they are just the upper bound of the loose member     *)
1239	(* A0), so [S <: W <: T] need not hold.  This is exactly the           *)
1240	(* counter_bridge2 loose-record pattern; HInv/inertness is essential.  *)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

Require Import TLC.LibOption.

Require Import List String.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

11	Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=

18	  | typ_bot => 1

59	   The coordinator's Inductive "Good" with a type-member transport field

61	   Good in the domain of that function is not strictly positive (verified
62	   separately for both the single and the mutual Inductive forms).  A
63	   *fuel-indexed Fixpoint* returning Prop has no positivity restriction, and
64	   [mu]-unfolding is handled by decreasing the fuel, so the same invariant

69	Fixpoint GoodF (fuel:nat) (γ:sta) (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
70	  match fuel with
71	  | O => True
72	  | Datatypes.S f =>
73	    match T with
74	    | typ_top => True
75	    | typ_bot => False
76	    | typ_all S0 U0 =>
77	        Bridge γ C p (∀(S0) U0) /\ (exists U, C ⊢!! p : U)
78	    | typ_bnd T0 =>
79	        GoodF f γ C p (open_typ_p p T0)
80	    | typ_and T1 T2 =>
81	        GoodF f γ C p T1 /\ GoodF f γ C p T2
82	    | typ_rcd D =>
83	        match D with
84	        | dec_typ A L U => (GoodF f γ C p L -> GoodF f γ C p U)
85	        | dec_trm a S0 => GoodF f γ C (p • a) S0
86	        end
87	    | typ_sngl q => C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}

117	   A sound alternative is a single global fuel fixed before the induction
118	   (a syntactic bound on the initial goal/derivation), so that every GoodF
119	   fact in the induction is at the same fuel and no monotonicity is needed. *)

14	(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
15	Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
16	  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.
17	
18	(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
19	   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
20	Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
21	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
22	Proof.
23	  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
24	  exists T. split; [|split].
25	  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
26	  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
27	  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
28	Qed.

30	(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
31	   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
32	Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
33	  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
34	Proof.
35	  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
36	  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
37	  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
38	Qed.

40	(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)

49	Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,

58	  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.

143	(* A precise2 typing is a bridge witness for its own type, under HInv. *)
144	Lemma bridge_of_precise2 : forall γ G p U,
145	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> Bridge γ G p U.
146	Proof.

148	  exists U. split; [|split].
149	  - apply pt3. exact Hp.
150	  - eapply precise2_flow_shape; eauto.

156	(* R/Rsing/F decomposition (coordinator suggestion).
157	
158	   R      p T := exists U, C⊢!! p:U
159	   Rsing  p T := forall q, T = {{q}} -> C⊢!! p:{{q}}
160	   F      p T := forall a S, T = {a⦂S} -> exists V, C⊢!! (p•a):V
161	
162	   The structural induction goes through for every rule except [ty_sub],
163	   where exactly the two closure facts below are needed.  [R] itself is
164	   independent of T, so the [ty_sub] case for [R] is immediate; the two
165	   closure facts are only needed to maintain [Rsing]/[F] through [ty_sub]
166	   (so that outer [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]/[ty_new_elim] can consume them). *)
167	
168	Definition R (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
169	  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.
170	
171	Definition Rsing (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
172	  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
173	
174	Definition F (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
175	  forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> exists V, C ⊢!! (p • a) : V.
176	
177	Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
178	  forall C p T, inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.
179	
180	(* Minimal [ty_sub] closure for singleton targets. *)
181	Definition Rsing_sub_closure : Prop :=
182	  forall C p T q, inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
183	
184	(* Minimal [ty_sub] closure for record targets (field existence/precision). *)
185	Definition field_sub_closure : Prop :=
186	  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
187	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
188	    exists V, C ⊢!! (p • a) : V.
189	
190	(* The two closure facts imply the reduced precise2-existence bridge, provided
191	   the structural R/Rsing/F induction (which is purely syntactic) is carried
192	   out.  Recorded here as the precise integration shape. *)
193	Definition RRF_suffices : Prop :=
194	  Rsing_sub_closure -> field_sub_closure -> inert_path_precise_bridge.
195	
196	(* Verified inert-context facts used by the R/Rsing/F base cases. *)
197	Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
198	Proof. intros C H. induction H. - apply ok_empty. - apply ok_push; auto. Qed.
199	
200	Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T, inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
201	Proof.
202	  intros C x T H. induction H; intros Hb.
203	  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
204	  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[E1 E2] | [_ Hb']].
205	    + subst. exact H0.
206	    + exact (IHinert Hb').
207	Qed.
208	
209	Lemma inert_typ_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), inert_typ T -> T = {{ q }} -> False.
210	Proof. intros T q H E. subst T. inversion H. Qed.
211	
212	Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall T (a:trm_label) S, inert_typ T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> False.
213	Proof. intros T a S H E. subst T. inversion H. Qed.
214	
215	Lemma inert_bind_not_sngl : forall C x (q:path), inert C -> binds x {{ q }} C -> False.
216	Proof.
217	  intros. eapply inert_typ_not_sngl; [|reflexivity]. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto.
218	Qed.
219	
220	Lemma inert_bind_not_rcd : forall C x (a:trm_label) S,
221	  inert C -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) C -> False.
222	Proof.
223	  intros. eapply inert_typ_not_rcd; [|reflexivity]. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto.
224	Qed.
225	
226	Lemma inert_bind_flow_shape : forall C x T, inert C -> binds x T C -> flow_shape T.
227	Proof. intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto. Qed.
228	
229	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
230	(* Precise3-based singleton invariant (coordinator refinement).
231	
232	   precise2 is not closed under singleton transitivity, but precise3 is
233	   (precise3_sngl_trans, proved above), so Rsing uses precise3. *)
234	
235	Definition Rsing3 (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
236	  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
237	
238	(* Minimal singleton-target subtyping inversion under inert typing. *)
239	Definition sngl_sub_precise3 : Prop :=
240	  forall C p T q,
241	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> C ⊢ T <: {{ q }} ->
242	    C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
243	
244	(* Two-sided form used inside the typing induction at [ty_sub]: the [Rsing3]
245	   invariant is available for the source type T, and must be transported to
246	   the target B along T <: B. *)
247	Definition Rsing3_sub_closure : Prop :=
248	  forall C p T B,
249	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Rsing3 C p T -> C ⊢ T <: B ->
250	    Rsing3 C p B.
251	
252	(* Same for the field/record invariant. *)
253	Definition field_sub_closure3 : Prop :=
254	  forall C p T a S,
255	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
256	    exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
257	
258	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
259	(* Natural (tight field) targets.
260	
261	   Term-field declarations in a record are either [inert_typ] or a
262	   singleton (record_dec = rd_trm / rd_trm_sngl), and these are exactly the
263	   field types that application/bridge1 can ever require.  Restricting O1 to
264	   such targets avoids arbitrary record/and field types. *)
265	
266	Definition nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop := inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).
267	
268	Lemma nat_flow_shape : forall T, nat_typ T -> flow_shape T.
269	Proof.
270	  intros T [H | [q E]].
271	  - apply inert_flow_shape. exact H.
272	  - subst. apply fs_sngl.
273	Qed.
274	
275	(* Natural-target field extraction (the reduced O1). *)
276	Definition nat_field_of_sub : Prop :=
277	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
278	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
279	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
280	    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.
281	
282	(* What app/bridge1 consumes: a natural-target witness gives a flow for the
283	   field path and the bridge witness. *)
284	Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
285	  nat_field_of_sub ->
286	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
287	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
288	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
289	    exists W, G ⊢! (p • a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
290	Proof.
291	  intros Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn.
292	  destruct (Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn) as [V [HnV [Hhas HVsub]]].
293	  exists V. split; [|split].
294	  - apply pf_fld with (T := R) (U := V).
295	    apply (@flow_record_has G p R U {a ⦂ V} Hf). exact Hhas.
296	  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
297	  - exact HVsub.
298	Qed.
299	
300	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
301	(* Head compatibility for natural types.
302	
303	   [ty_def_path] types path fields at a singleton, [ty_def_all]/[ty_def_new]
304	   type value fields at an arrow/μ; hence actual record field types are
305	   exactly arrow, μ (record), or singleton, i.e. [nat_typ].  The residual
306	   below asks that subtyping between natural types preserves the head
307	   constructor; it is what remains of the O1 impasse after restricting to
308	   natural targets. *)
309	
310	Lemma arrow_not_bnd : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
311	Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
312	
313	Lemma arrow_not_sngl : forall (q:path), ~ is_arrow {{ q }}.
314	Proof. intros q [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
315	
316	Lemma bnd_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), μ T <> {{ q }}.
317	Proof. intros T q E. discriminate E. Qed.
318	
319	(* The three heads of a natural type are mutually exclusive. *)
320	Definition nat_head_compat (G:ctx) (V T:typ) : Prop :=
321	  (is_arrow V /\ is_arrow T) \/
322	  ((exists U0, V = μ U0 /\ record_type U0) /\
323	   (exists T0, T = μ T0 /\ record_type T0)) \/
324	  ((exists q, V = {{ q }}) /\ (exists q', T = {{ q' }})).
325	
326	(* Residual: natural-source / natural-target subtyping preserves the head.
327	   This is the "good/natural V <: natural T head-compatibility" fact. *)
328	Definition nat_sub_head_compat : Prop :=
329	  forall G V T,
330	    inert G -> nat_typ V -> nat_typ T -> G ⊢ V <: T ->
331	    nat_head_compat G V T.
332	
333	(* Residual: path-typing coherence for actual record fields.  Combining the
334	   head-compatibility fact with the def-typing structure
335	   (ty_def_path vs ty_def_all/ty_def_new) is intended to prove
336	   [nat_field_of_sub]. *)
337	Definition path_field_coherence : Prop :=
338	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
339	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
340	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
341	    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.
342	
343	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
344	(* Notes on the tds/ts_mutind instantiation (not proved).
345	
346	   The proposed plumbing
347	
348	     P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
349	     P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U
350	
351	   does make the [ty_sub] and [subtyp_trans] steps work exactly as noted:
352	   transport along one subtyping derivation uses the good witness at the
353	   source, and trans composes P0 with the typing [ty_sub Hty Hsub1] (P0 is
354	   universally quantified over typing proofs).
355	
356	   Two independent obstacles prevent a shallow [Good]:
357	
358	   1. [subtyp_sel2]: P0 at S <: p↓A must produce [Good q (p↓A)] for an
359	      *arbitrary* path q from [Good q S].  Hence [Good] must be closed
360	      upward under the very subtyping relation being defined (or carry the
361	      selection's record-typing provenance).  Making it upward closed
362	      (e.g. Good p T := forall B, T<:B -> Bridge p B) pushes the burden
363	      into every typing rule for all supertypes.
364	
365	   2. [ty_and_intro]: with upward-closed Good, one needs [Bridge p (T∧U)]
366	      from [Bridge p T] and [Bridge p U]; but two precise/flow witnesses
367	      below T and below U need not combine to one below T∧U.  In pDOT the
368	      relevant target is never the intersection itself (the only use is
369	      through and11/and12 towards an arrow), so a correct invariant must be
370	      target-restricted rather than uniformly upward closed.
371	
372	   These are the same two places where the O1/O3 analyses got stuck; the
373	   full solution is the paper's precise/tight semantic invariant, with the
374	   selection case carrying a lower-bound witness plus record-typing
375	   provenance (and [wf] supplying precise2 for singleton alias targets). *)

Now let's think about the overall plan. Time is finite. We should try to deliver a real proof if possible.

Let me reconsider the problem. The six facts are equivalent to the master classification. Is there any existing *paper* result (pDOT safety) we can lean on? The development is essentially a formalization of the pDOT paper's safety proof. The sel_lower_class fact is a known lemma in the pDOT paper (roughly: in an inert context, subtyping cannot move from a non-arrow-shaped lower bound to an arrow through a selection). The paper's proof uses "tight bounds" and precise typing.

The actual pDOT paper (Developers' formalization) has a notion of "inert" and proves things like: if G inert and G ⊢ T <: U with U an arrow, then T is an arrow, or T is a path, etc. There is a lemma called "subtyping of arrow types" / "inversion of subtyping". Maybe the paper proves "G ⊢ S <: U and U arrow implies S arrow / S path / S bottom / S and". This is exactly the classification. The proof is by induction on subtyping with the sel case using precise typing: any path p typed at a record rcd{A>:S<:T} in an inert context has a precise type... The paper's "inert contexts" and "precise typing" machinery handles this.

The existing development hasn't completed "path -> precise typing" (the main residual `inert_path_precise_bridge`), which is also needed by wf_push. So a full solution here would probably also solve that. Hard.

Let's look at whether there's a much simpler route specific to the six facts that avoids full precise typing. Let's revisit and try to prove directly by induction on subtyping, with a stronger statement designed to handle trans/sel, and see what's needed.

Define for fixed HInv γ G:

`Cls S U := is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (∃ p A, S = p↓A) \/ (∃ T1 T2, S = T1∧T2 /\ (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U))` (ArrowSrc).

We want: for all U with is_arrow U \/ U=⊥, for all S, G⊢S<:U -> Cls S U. That's ArrowSrc / arrow_source_class_gen.

Proof by induction on the derivation? We saw the problem at trans when the middle is a path selection. But perhaps we can prove the following *additional* lemma independently:

`sel_class`: for all p A U, if (∃ S T, G ⊢ p : rcd{A>:S<:T}) and G ⊢ p↓A <: U and U arrow/bot, then Cls?? — this is sel_lower_class which asserts Cls S U for the lower bound S of a view. But we want a statement about S and U; still uses Cls. Circular but maybe we can prove sel_class by a separate induction on the subtyping derivation `p↓A <: U` where the source is *fixed* path selection, and use the actual tight bound W as the intermediate. Let's attempt:

sel_class_gen: Suppose HInv, p : rcd{A>:S<:T}, i.e., we have an ordinary view. Let W be the actual tight bound (to be obtained). Claim: G ⊢ p↓A <: U and U arrow/bot => Cls_W? Hmm, the conclusion needs about S: ArrowSrc S U. Since S <: W (bracket), and if Cls about W holds with target U, then lift to S? Wait ArrowSrc_lift goes forward along S <: W and W <: U: ArrowSrc(S, ???). Let's see: If we know Cls W U (i.e., W <: U classifiable at target U) — but ArrowSrc is about a source and a target U, with the disjunction components referencing U. If Cls W U then we can get ArrowSrc S U? No, Cls W U is a disjunction about W's shape, not a relation. To get ArrowSrc S U we need to transport Cls backward from W to S? Since S <: W <: U, and ArrowSrc S U: if W is arrow then S <: W so ArrowSrc? No, ArrowSrc S U requires S itself to be arrow/bot/path/and; S <: W doesn't make S arrow.

Hmm, actually ArrowSrc_lift: ArrowSrc G S T and G⊢T<:U => ArrowSrc G S U. So class at target T lifts to target U. In sel_class, the lower bound S and target U: we have S <: W <: U. To get ArrowSrc S U, it suffices to get ArrowSrc S W (class of S at target W) and then lift along W <: U. But ArrowSrc S W requires S <: W (true) and is about S's shape relative to W: S is rigid (say ⊤), so ArrowSrc ⊤ W would be false! Wait but S <: W with W maybe an arrow would then be a counterexample. Precisely: ArrowSrc S W for S=⊤ says ⊤ must be arrow/bot/path/and — impossible. So if S rigid and S <: W then W cannot be arrow/bot. That's exactly the fact 1 at W! So sel_class for rigid S reduces to fact 1 at W (the actual bound). Good: the recursive call is at W, the actual tight bound, and W is a *stored definition type*. 113	| s0_bot : forall G T, subtyp0 G ⊥ T

15	Definition flow_typ_member_inv_raw : Prop :=
16	  forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
17	    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
18	    exists W, record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\

22	  forall (A A0:typ_label) (z:var), ~ flow_typ_member_inv_raw.
23	Proof.
24	  intros A A0 z H.
25	  set (Tbody := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
26	  assert (Hrt : record_type Tbody).
27	  { exists (\{label_typ A0}). apply rt_one. - apply rd_typ. - reflexivity. }
28	  set (U := μ Tbody).
29	  set (Tgt := typ_rcd {A >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
30	  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: U <: Tgt}).
31	  set (G := (empty:ctx) & z ~ R).
32	  assert (Hb : binds z R G) by apply binds_tail.
33	  assert (Hty : G ⊢ trm_path (pvar z) : R) by (apply ty_var; exact Hb).
34	  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ U <: Tgt).
35	  { eapply subtyp_trans.
36	    - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hty.
37	    - eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hty. }
38	  assert (Hfs : flow_shape U) by (apply fs_bnd; exact Hrt).

45	(* FlowExists is type-independent, so no subtyping predicate is        *)
46	(* needed in the typing induction ([ty_sub] is immediate).             *)

48	
49	Definition FlowExists (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) : Prop :=
50	  exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.
51	
52	Definition path_flow_exists_HInv : Prop :=
53	  forall γ G p T,
54	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
55	    exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.

58	  forall γ G p (a:trm_label) T,
59	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
60	    FlowExists γ G p -> FlowExists γ G (p • a).
61	
62	Definition path_elim_flow_bridge : Prop :=
63	  forall γ G (p q:path) (a:trm_label) T,
64	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path (q • a) : T ->
65	    FlowExists γ G p -> FlowExists γ G (q • a) ->
66	    FlowExists γ G (p • a).

68	Lemma flow_exists_rcd_intro : forall γ G p a T,
69	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path (p • a) : T -> FlowExists γ G (p • a) ->
70	  FlowExists γ G p.
71	Proof.
72	  intros γ G p a T Hi Hty [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
73	  destruct (@flow_prefix_snoc G p a R U Hf) as [R' [V Hf']].
74	  exists R', V. split; [exact Hf'|].

78	Lemma path_flow_exists_aux :
79	  field_flow_bridge -> path_elim_flow_bridge ->

81	  forall γ, HInv γ G -> forall p, e = trm_path p -> FlowExists γ G p.

84	  - (* ty_var *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
85	    exists T. exists T. split.
86	    + apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi0; exact Hi0 | exact H].
87	    + apply (@HInv_bind_flow_shape γ0 G x T); auto.
88	  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
89	  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
90	  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
91	  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
92	    eapply Hfield; eauto.
93	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
94	    eapply flow_exists_rcd_intro; eauto.
95	  - (* ty_let *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. discriminate E.
96	  - (* ty_sngl *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
97	    eauto.
98	  - (* ty_path_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
99	    eapply Hpell; eauto.
100	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
101	    eauto.
102	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
103	    eauto.
104	  - (* ty_and_intro *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E. injection E as Ep. subst p0.
105	    eauto.
106	  - (* ty_sub *) intros γ0 Hi0 p0 E.
107	    eapply IHHty; [exact Hi0|exact E].
108	Qed.

111	  field_flow_bridge -> path_elim_flow_bridge -> path_flow_exists_HInv.
112	Proof.

114	  exact (@path_flow_exists_aux Hfield Hpell G (trm_path p) T Hty γ Hi p eq_refl).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Semantic analysis of the six per-constructor facts (agent_master).  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The point of this file is to separate three layers:                 *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (1) the *bottom* half of the classification.  This is purely      *)
(*       syntactic: no derivation can end at [⊥] except through        *)
(*       [subtyp_bot] / [subtyp_refl], hence the source is [⊥].        *)
(*       Consequently facts 1-4 at [V = ⊥] and fact 6 are             *)
(*       unconditional (no HInv is needed).                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (2) the *transitive-free* fragment [subtyp1] (agent_suball).      *)
(*       A single non-trans rule never turns a rigid source into an    *)
(*       arrow; we record the exact classification and the            *)
(*       intersection split for this fragment.                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (3) the arrow half of the classification under HInv.  This is     *)
(*       where the runtime provenance of a type-member view is used;   *)
(*       the precise semantic statement is isolated in Section 4 and   *)
(*       the derivation of the six facts from it is checked.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Bottom targets are impossible except from bottom.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp_bot_source : forall G S,
  G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> S = ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G S H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - (* subtyp_top *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_bot *) reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp_refl *) assumption.
  - (* subtyp_trans *)
    subst U. apply IHsubtyp1. exact IHsubtyp2.
  - (* subtyp_and11 *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_and12 *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_and2 *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_fld *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_typ *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_sngl_pq *)
    exfalso. eapply repl_typ_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sngl_qp *)
    exfalso. eapply repl_typ_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp_sel2 *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_sel1 *) discriminate.
  - (* subtyp_all *) discriminate.
Qed.

(* The general "no rigid source below bottom" statements. *)

Lemma top_no_bot : forall G V,
  G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G ⊤ Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_no_bot : forall G D V,
  G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G D V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (typ_rcd D) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_no_bot : forall G T0 V,
  G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G T0 V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (μ T0) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_bot : forall G q V,
  G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G q V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G ({{ q }}) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

(* Fact 6 of [pointwise_facts]: the conjunction split at [⊥].  The
   statement is vacuous because the source of a subtyping into [⊥] has
   to be [⊥], which is not an intersection. *)

Lemma and_bot_split : forall γ G T1 T2 V,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V.
Proof.
  intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub E. subst V. exfalso.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (T1 ∧ T2) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

(* Thus the four bottom instances and fact 6 are unconditional.  We
   package them in the shape required by [pointwise_facts]. *)

Lemma pointwise_bot_facts :
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ ->
     G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).
Proof.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - intros. eapply top_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply rcd_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply bnd_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply sngl_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply and_bot_split; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. The trans-free fragment [subtyp1]: no rigid source below an      *)
(*    arrow, and the intersection split.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp1_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* subtyp1_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_refl *) left. subst T. exact Har.
  - (* subtyp1_and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp1_sel2 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_sel1 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp1 G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* subtyp1_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_bot *) elimtype False.
    destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_and11 : source (T ∧ U0), target T *) left. subst T.
    apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp1_and12 *) right. subst U0. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp1_and2 : target (T0 ∧ U0) *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0' E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_pq : source T = T1∧T2, repl target T' is an and *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_cases p q T T' U0 H1) as [E | [A1 [A2 [ET ET']]]].
    + discriminate ET.
    + subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_qp *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_cases q p T T' U0 H1) as [E | [A1 [A2 [ET ET']]]].
    + discriminate ET.
    + subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sel2 : target p↓A *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sel1 : source p↓A *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_all *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Semantic analysis of the six per-constructor facts (agent_master).  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The point of this file is to separate three layers:                 *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (1) the *bottom* half of the classification.  This is purely      *)
(*       syntactic: no derivation can end at [⊥] except through        *)
(*       [subtyp_bot] / [subtyp_refl], hence the source is [⊥].        *)
(*       Consequently facts 1-4 at [V = ⊥] and fact 6 are             *)
(*       unconditional (no HInv is needed).                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (2) the *transitive-free* fragment [subtyp1] (agent_suball).      *)
(*       A single non-trans rule never turns a rigid source into an    *)
(*       arrow; we record the exact classification and the            *)
(*       intersection split for this fragment.                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   (3) the arrow half of the classification under HInv.  This is     *)
(*       where the runtime provenance of a type-member view is used;   *)
(*       the precise semantic statement is isolated in Section 4 and   *)
(*       the derivation of the six facts from it is checked.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Bottom targets are impossible except from bottom.                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp_bot_source_gen : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> U = ⊥ -> S = ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G S U H.
  apply subtyp_ind with (P := fun G S U => U = ⊥ -> S = ⊥).
  - (* top *) intros G T E. discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) intros G T E. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) intros G T E. exact E.
  - (* trans *) intros G S T U HST IH1 HTU IH2 E.
    apply IH1. apply IH2. exact E.
  - (* and11 *) intros G T U E. discriminate.
  - (* and12 *) intros G T U E. discriminate.
  - (* and2 *) intros G S T U HST IH1 HSU IH2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) intros G T U a H IH E. discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) intros G S1 S2 T1 T2 A H21 IH1 H12 IH2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *) intros G p q T T' U Hp Hq Hrepl E.
    exfalso. subst T'. eapply repl_typ_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) intros G p q T T' U Hp Hq Hrepl E.
    exfalso. subst T'. eapply repl_typ_not_bot; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) intros G p A S T Hty E. discriminate.
  - (* sel1 *) intros G p A S T Hty E. discriminate E.
  - (* all *) intros L G S1 T1 S2 T2 H21 IH body E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_bot_source : forall G S,
  G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> S = ⊥.
Proof. intros G S H. exact (@subtyp_bot_source_gen G S ⊥ H eq_refl). Qed.

(* The general "no rigid source below bottom" statements. *)

Lemma top_no_bot : forall G V,
  G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G ⊤ Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_no_bot : forall G D V,
  G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G D V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (typ_rcd D) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_no_bot : forall G T0 V,
  G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G T0 V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (μ T0) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_bot : forall G q V,
  G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G q V Hsub E. subst V.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G ({{ q }}) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

(* Fact 6 of [pointwise_facts]: the conjunction split at [⊥].  The
   statement is vacuous because the source of a subtyping into [⊥] has
   to be [⊥], which is not an intersection. *)

Lemma and_bot_split : forall γ G T1 T2 V,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V.
Proof.
  intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub E. subst V. exfalso.
  pose proof (@subtyp_bot_source G (T1 ∧ T2) Hsub) as E'. discriminate E'.
Qed.

(* Thus the four bottom instances and fact 6 are unconditional.  We
   package them in the shape required by [pointwise_facts]. *)

Lemma pointwise_bot_facts :
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ ->
     G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).
Proof.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - intros. eapply top_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply rcd_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply bnd_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply sngl_no_bot; eauto.
  - intros. eapply and_bot_split; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. The trans-free fragment [subtyp1]: no rigid source below an      *)
(*    arrow, and the intersection split.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp1_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* subtyp1_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_refl *) left. subst T. exact Har.
  - (* subtyp1_and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp1_sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* subtyp1_sel2 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* subtyp1_sel1 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* subtyp1_all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Replacement of an intersection is again an intersection. *)
Lemma repl_typ_and_inv : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> forall A1 A2, T = A1 ∧ A2 ->
  exists B1 B2, T' = B1 ∧ B2.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H;
    intros A1 A2 E; try discriminate E.
  - (* rand1 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst.
    exists T2, U. reflexivity.
  - (* rand2 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst.
    exists U, T2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp1_ind;
    intros A1 A2 EA Har.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv p q T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv q p T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate EA.
  - (* all *) discriminate EA.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp1 G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

Proof.
  intros G S U H.
  induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - intros E. discriminate E.
  - intros E. reflexivity.
  - intros E. exact E.
  - intros E. apply IHsubtyp1. apply IHsubtyp2. exact E.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Semantic analysis of the six per-constructor facts (agent_master).  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Contents.                                                           *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (1) A correction: the naive "bottom inversion"                        *)
(*          G ⊢ S <: ⊥  ->  S = ⊥                                    *)
(*      is FALSE (counterexample [⊥ ∧ ⊤ <: ⊥], which also shows that  *)
(*      fact 6 is *not* vacuous).                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (2) Unconditional facts:                                            *)
(*      - the bottom instances of facts 1-4 follow from their arrow     *)
(*        instances by composing with [⊥ <: arrow];                     *)
(*      - the easy direction of fact 6 (a component below ⊥ yields the  *)
(*        intersection below ⊥);                                       *)
(*      - replacement of an intersection is an intersection (used in    *)
(*        the trans-free classification).                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (3) The trans-free fragment [subtyp1]: a single non-trans rule     *)
(*      never turns a rigid source into an arrow, and the intersection  *)
(*      split holds.  These are fully unconditional (agent_suball).     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (4) The exact frontier: the six facts are equivalent to             *)
(*      [sel_lower_class ∧ and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow).  We also   *)
(*      isolate the runtime provenance statement that the selection     *)
(*      case requires and show that, together with a lower/upper        *)
(*      inversion, it yields [sel_lower_class].  The construction of    *)
(*      that provenance from [HInv] (PathObject/DefsTyped) is not       *)
(*      carried out here; it is the remaining semantic obligation.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. The naive bottom-source inversion is FALSE.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* The intersection [⊥ ∧ ⊤] is below [⊥] by [subtyp_and11], but is not
   syntactically [⊥].  (This is the step that makes fact 6, the
   intersection split at [⊥], non-vacuous.) *)

Lemma subtyp_and11_bot_top : (empty:ctx) ⊢ ⊥ ∧ ⊤ <: ⊥.
Proof. apply subtyp_and11. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_bot_source_false :
  ~ (forall G S, G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> S = ⊥).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (H empty (⊥ ∧ ⊤) (@subtyp_and11_bot_top)) as E.
  discriminate E.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Unconditional facts.                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Composing [S <: ⊥] with [⊥ <: A] yields any arrow supertype.  Hence
   "no arrow supertype" implies "no bottom supertype": the bottom
   instances of facts 1-4 are consequences of their arrow instances. *)

Lemma no_bot_of_no_arrow : forall G S,
  (forall A, is_arrow A -> G ⊢ S <: A -> False) ->
  G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G S Hna Hbot.
  eapply Hna.
  - exists ⊤, ⊤. reflexivity.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hbot | apply subtyp_bot].
Qed.

(* The same for the four rigid source shapes, packaged together.  This
   shows that once the four arrow facts are known, the four bot facts
   come for free. *)

Lemma pointwise_rigid_bot_of_arrow :
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False).
Proof.
  intros Htop Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl.
  split; [|split; [|split]].
  - intros γ G V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (no_bot_of_no_arrow G ⊤
             (fun A Har Hsa => Htop γ G A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G D V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (no_bot_of_no_arrow G (typ_rcd D)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hrcd γ G D A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (no_bot_of_no_arrow G (μ T0)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hbnd γ G T0 A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G q V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (no_bot_of_no_arrow G ({{ q }})
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hsngl γ G q A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
Qed.

(* The easy direction of fact 6: if a component is below [⊥], so is the
   intersection.  In particular fact 6 has genuine content (it cannot be
   discharged by a source-shape inversion). *)

Lemma and_bot_of_component_l : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T1 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact H].
Qed.

Lemma and_bot_of_component_r : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T2 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact H].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The trans-free fragment [subtyp1].                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Replacement of an intersection is again an intersection. *)
Lemma repl_typ_and_inv : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> forall A1 A2, T = A1 ∧ A2 ->
  exists B1 B2, T' = B1 ∧ B2.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. induction H; intros A1 A2 E.
  - (* rrcd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rand1 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rand2 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rpath *) discriminate E.
  - (* rbnd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall1 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall2 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rsngl *) discriminate E.
Qed.

(* One trans-free step never produces an arrow from a rigid source. *)
Lemma subtyp1_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) left. exact Har.
  - (* and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The intersection split for one trans-free step.  The only cases are
   the two projections, which pick the corresponding component. *)
Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp1_ind;
    intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv p q T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv q p T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate EA.
  - (* all *) discriminate EA.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp1 G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4. The exact frontier.                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_lower_class] and [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow) are          *)
(* together equivalent to the complete arrow-or-bot source             *)
(* classification and hence to [pointwise_facts].  We record this      *)
(* equivalence; it shows that no further purely syntactic reduction is *)
(* available.                                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_arrow_class :
  arrow_source_class -> arrow_source_class_gen.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G S U Hi Hsub Har.
  apply (@ArrowSrc_lift G S U U).
  - apply HC; [exact Hi | exact Hsub | exact Har].
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - exact Har.
Qed.

Lemma pointwise_facts_iff_residuals :
  pointwise_facts <-> (sel_lower_class /\ and_target_lift).
Proof.
  split.
  - intro HP.
    pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as Hgen.
    split.
    + apply sel_lower_class_of_gen. exact Hgen.
    + apply and_target_lift_of_gen. exact Hgen.
  - intros [Hsel Hand].
    apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
    apply arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals;
      [exact Hand | exact Hsel].
Qed.

(* The arrow-only form of the four rigid facts plus fact 5.  [pointwise]
   is obtained from it by the bottom reduction above and fact 6.  This
   packages the observation that facts 1-4 at [⊥] are not independent. *)

Definition pointwise_arrow_facts : Prop :=
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V ->
     G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

Lemma pointwise_arrow_facts_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> pointwise_arrow_facts.
Proof.
  intros [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha _]]]]].
  unfold pointwise_arrow_facts.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - exact (fun γ G V Hi H Har => Ht γ G V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G D V Hi H Har => Hr γ G D V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G T0 V Hi H Har => Hb γ G T0 V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G q V Hi H Har => Hs γ G q V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact Ha.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 5. The semantic obligation.                                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The selection case of the classification needs the *runtime* tight  *)
(* bound of a type-member view.  The following two predicates isolate   *)
(* the two ingredients precisely.                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [uniform_tight_member] is the provenance statement: every path that  *)
(* has a type-member view has one canonical tight bound [W] (the actual *)
(* record member), it admits the tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}], and   *)
(* every view brackets [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_          *)
(* provenance] of agent_suball (see [canonical_member_bound_of_         *)
(* provenance]) together with the tight view itself; it is the form     *)
(* produced by PathObject/DefsTyped in an HInv heap.                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_bound_inv] turns the canonical bound into the two inversion     *)
(* facts [S <: p↓A -> S <: W] and [p↓A <: U -> W <: U].                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [tight_bound_arrow_class] is the normal-form statement: below a     *)
(* canonical *tight* bound, the arrow-or-bot classification holds for   *)
(* every source.  Because canonical bounds are exactly the stored       *)
(* member types, this is the well-founded "heap definition depth"       *)
(* induction hypothesis of the task description; it is strictly         *)
(* weaker than quantifying over all types.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition uniform_tight_member : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

Definition sel_bound_inv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
    (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T) ->
    (forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W) /\
    (forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U).

Definition tight_bound_arrow_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G W S U,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists p A, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
       (forall S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
          G ⊢ S0 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T0)) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W -> G ⊢ W <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* [sel_lower_class] follows from provenance plus the tight-bound normal
   form.  This is the precise sense in which the selection residual is
   a semantic fact about actual record members. *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> sel_bound_inv -> tight_bound_arrow_class ->
  sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hinv Hcls γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
  destruct (Hprov γ G p A Hi (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hty)))
    as [W [Htight Hbrack]].
  destruct (Hinv γ G p A W Hi Htight Hbrack) as [Hleft Hright].
  destruct (Hleft S Hty) as [HSW _].
  pose proof (Hright U Hcont) as HWU.
  exact (Hcls γ G W S U Hi
           (ex_intro _ p (ex_intro _ A (conj Htight Hbrack)))
           HSW HWU Har).
Qed.

(* Consequently the six facts are implied by the semantic package
   together with [and_target_lift] (the remaining intersection-target
   residual of agent_noarrow). *)

Theorem pointwise_facts_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> sel_bound_inv -> tight_bound_arrow_class ->
  and_target_lift -> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hinv Hcls Hand.
  apply pointwise_facts_iff_residuals.
  split.
  - apply sel_lower_class_of_semantic; assumption.
  - exact Hand.
Qed.
