(* 5. The semantic obligation.                                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The selection case of the classification needs the *runtime* tight  *)
(* bound of a type-member view.  The following two predicates isolate   *)
(* the two ingredients precisely.                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [uniform_tight_member] is the provenance statement: every path that  *)
(* has a type-member view has one canonical tight bound [W] (the actual *)
(* record member), it admits the tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}], and   *)
(* every view brackets [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_          *)
(* provenance] of agent_suball (see [canonical_member_bound_of_         *)
(* provenance]) together with the tight view itself; it is the form     *)
(* produced by PathObject/DefsTyped in an HInv heap.                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_bound_inv] turns the canonical bound into the two inversion     *)
(* facts [S <: p↓A -> S <: W] and [p↓A <: U -> W <: U].                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [tight_bound_arrow_class] is the normal-form statement: below a     *)
(* canonical *tight* bound, the arrow-or-bot classification holds for   *)
(* every source.  Because canonical bounds are exactly the stored       *)
(* member types, this is the well-founded "heap definition depth"       *)
(* induction hypothesis of the task description; it is strictly         *)
(* weaker than quantifying over all types.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition uniform_tight_member : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

(* The bound inversions are *provable*: from the tight view typing alone,
   every type below [p↓A] is below [W], and every type above [p↓A] is
   above [W].  The proofs are by induction on the subtyping derivation;
   the selection steps use the tight view again, the replacement and
   conjunction steps are structural. *)

Lemma sel_right_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> S = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros ES.
  - (* top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* bot *) discriminate ES.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + exact Hsub2.
  - (* and11 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and12 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and2 *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
  - (* fld *) discriminate ES.
  - (* typ *) discriminate ES.
  - (* sngl_pq *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) subst S.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + rewrite <- ES. eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
  - (* all *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma sel_right_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight U H.
  eapply (@sel_right_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight (p ↓ A) U H eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> U = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros EU.
  - (* top *) discriminate EU.
  - (* bot *) apply subtyp_bot.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + exact Hsub1.
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact EU].
  - (* and11 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and12 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and12.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and2 *) discriminate EU.
  - (* fld *) discriminate EU.
  - (* typ *) discriminate EU.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel2 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* all *) discriminate EU.
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S H.
  eapply (@sel_left_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight S (p ↓ A) H eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Package the two inversions, now as a theorem. *)
Definition sel_bound_inv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
    (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T) ->
    (forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W) /\
    (forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U).

Lemma sel_bound_inv_proof : sel_bound_inv.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight Hbrack. split.
  - intros S HS. eapply (@sel_left_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight S HS).
  - intros U HU. eapply (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U HU).
Qed.

Definition tight_bound_arrow_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G W S U,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists p A, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
       (forall S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
          G ⊢ S0 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T0)) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W -> G ⊢ W <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* [sel_lower_class] now follows from provenance plus the tight-bound
   normal form alone: the bracket gives [S <: W], the (proved) inversion
   gives [W <: U], and the normal form classifies [S] at [U]. *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> tight_bound_arrow_class -> sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hcls γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
  destruct (Hprov γ G p A Hi (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hty)))
    as [W [Htight Hbrack]].
  destruct (Hbrack S T Hty) as [HSW _].
  pose proof (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U Hcont) as HWU.
  exact (Hcls γ G W S U Hi
           (ex_intro _ p (ex_intro _ A (conj Htight Hbrack)))
           HSW HWU Har).
Qed.

(* Consequently the six facts are implied by the semantic package
   together with [and_target_lift] (the remaining intersection-target
   residual of agent_noarrow). *)

Theorem pointwise_facts_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> tight_bound_arrow_class ->
  and_target_lift -> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hcls Hand.
  apply pointwise_facts_iff_residuals.
  split.
  - apply sel_lower_class_of_semantic; assumption.
  - exact Hand.
Qed.

(* The two remaining semantic obligations, stated exactly:

   (A) [uniform_tight_member] (runtime provenance): every path with a
       type-member view has a canonical actual tight bound [W] with the
       tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}] and with every view bracketing
       [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_provenance] of
       agent_suball; its construction from [HInv] via PathObject /
       DefsTyped is the provenance theorem that is not carried out in
       this file.

   (B) [tight_bound_arrow_class] (normal form / heap-rank induction):
       below a canonical tight bound the arrow-or-bot classification
       holds.  Canonical bounds are stored member types of strictly
       older variables (the store built by [well_typed] is acyclic), so
       this is the well-founded "definition depth" statement; it is not
       an instance of the master because it quantifies only over actual
       bounds.

   Together with [and_target_lift], (A) and (B) give the six facts by
   [pointwise_facts_of_semantic], whose proof is fully checked. *)

(*                                                                     *)
(* The selection case of the classification needs the *runtime* tight  *)
(* bound of a type-member view.  The following two predicates isolate   *)
(* the two ingredients precisely.                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [uniform_tight_member] is the provenance statement: every path that  *)
(* has a type-member view has one canonical tight bound [W] (the actual *)
(* record member), it admits the tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}], and   *)
(* every view brackets [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_          *)
(* provenance] of agent_suball (see [canonical_member_bound_of_         *)
(* provenance]) together with the tight view itself; it is the form     *)
(* produced by PathObject/DefsTyped in an HInv heap.                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_bound_inv] turns the canonical bound into the two inversion     *)
(* facts [S <: p↓A -> S <: W] and [p↓A <: U -> W <: U].                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [tight_bound_arrow_class] is the normal-form statement: below a     *)
(* canonical *tight* bound, the arrow-or-bot classification holds for   *)
(* every source.  Because canonical bounds are exactly the stored       *)
(* member types, this is the well-founded "heap definition depth"       *)
(* induction hypothesis of the task description; it is strictly         *)
(* weaker than quantifying over all types.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition uniform_tight_member : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

(* The bound inversions are *provable*: from the tight view typing alone,
   every type below [p↓A] is below [W], and every type above [p↓A] is
   above [W].  The proofs are by induction on the subtyping derivation;
   the selection steps use the tight view again, the replacement and
   conjunction steps are structural. *)

Lemma sel_right_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> S = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros ES.
  - (* top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* bot *) discriminate ES.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + exact Hsub2.
  - (* and11 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and12 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and2 *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
  - (* fld *) discriminate ES.
  - (* typ *) discriminate ES.
  - (* sngl_pq *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) subst S.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + rewrite <- ES. eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
  - (* all *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma sel_right_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight U H.
  eapply (@sel_right_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight (p ↓ A) U H eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> U = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros EU.
  - (* top *) discriminate EU.
  - (* bot *) apply subtyp_bot.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + exact Hsub1.
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact EU].
  - (* and11 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and12 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and12.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and2 *) discriminate EU.
  - (* fld *) discriminate EU.
  - (* typ *) discriminate EU.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel2 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* all *) discriminate EU.
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S H.
  eapply (@sel_left_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight S (p ↓ A) H eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Package the two inversions, now as a theorem. *)
Definition sel_bound_inv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
    (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T) ->
    (forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W) /\
    (forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U).

Lemma sel_bound_inv_proof : sel_bound_inv.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight Hbrack. split.
  - intros S HS. eapply (@sel_left_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight S HS).
  - intros U HU. eapply (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U HU).
Qed.

Definition tight_bound_arrow_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G W S U,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists p A, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
       (forall S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
          G ⊢ S0 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T0)) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W -> G ⊢ W <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* [sel_lower_class] now follows from provenance plus the tight-bound
   normal form alone: the bracket gives [S <: W], the (proved) inversion
   gives [W <: U], and the normal form classifies [S] at [U]. *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> tight_bound_arrow_class -> sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hcls γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
  destruct (Hprov γ G p A Hi (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hty)))
    as [W [Htight Hbrack]].
  destruct (Hbrack S T Hty) as [HSW _].
  pose proof (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U Hcont) as HWU.
  exact (Hcls γ G W S U Hi
           (ex_intro _ p (ex_intro _ A (conj Htight Hbrack)))
           HSW HWU Har).
Qed.

   residual of agent_noarrow). *)

Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros a t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_trm :
  (forall (t:trm) k x, open_rec_trm_p k (pvar x) t = open_rec_trm k x t) /\
  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T 0 x). Qed.
Lemma open_defs_pvar : forall (ds:defs) x, open_defs_p (pvar x) ds = open_defs x ds.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 open_pvar_trm)))). Qed.
Lemma open_path_pvar : forall (q:path) x, open_path_p (pvar x) q = open_path x q.
Proof. intros. apply open_pvar_path. Qed.

Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
  γ ⫶ G /\
  inert G /\
  wf G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Parameter wf_push_cond : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
            exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,
  G ⊢!v v : T -> x # G -> G & x ~ T ⊢!v v : T.
Proof. intros G v T x H Hx. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v T H x T Hx). Qed.

Lemma HInv_empty : HInv empty empty.
Proof.
  unfold HInv. split; [apply well_typed_empty|]. split; [apply inert_empty|]. split; [apply wfe_empty|]. split.
  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros x T0 ds Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
Qed.

Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
  G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs.
  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
    + exact HxG.
  - apply wfe_push.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact HxG.
    + assert (Hi : HInv γ G) by (unfold HInv; split; [exact Hwt|]; split; [exact Hinert|]; split; [exact Hwf|]; split; [exact Hentries|exact Hdefs]).
      exact (@wf_push_cond γ G x S v Hi HxG Hval Hnewdefs).
  - intros y T' v' HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * subst. exact (ty_val_p_weaken_single Hval HxG).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).
  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * rewrite Eyx. exact (proj2 (Hnewdefs T0 ds (eq_sym Ev))).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * unfold defs_at in *.
        eapply weaken_defs with (G1:=G) (G2:= y ~ open_typ_p (pvar y) T0) (w:=x) (S:=S).
        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
           ++ exact HxG.
           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about inert contexts and tight value typing.            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T,
  inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros C x T Hin. induction Hin; intros Hb.
  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Ex ET] | [Hx Hb0]].
    + subst. exact H.
    + apply IHHin. exact Hb0.
Qed.

Lemma inert_mu_inv : forall T, inert_typ (μ T) -> record_type T.
Proof.
  intros T H. remember (μ T) as B eqn:EB. revert T EB.
  induction H; intros T0 ET.
  - discriminate ET.
  - injection ET as ET. subst T0. exact (ex_intro _ ls H).
Qed.

Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
Proof.
  intros C H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Shape of a flow whose declared (source) type is a singleton.        *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* We show that, in an inert context, such a flow must end in a field  *)
(* selection whose field type is the singleton; in particular the      *)
(* output is the same singleton and we obtain the immediate subflow.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma flow_sngl_source : forall C p T U,
  inert C ->
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall q, T = {{ q }} ->
  U = {{ q }} /\
  (exists p0 a R, p = p0 • a /\ C ⊢! p0 : R ⪼ typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}).
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hin Hflow. revert Hin.
  induction Hflow as
    [ x G T Hok Hb
    | G p a T U Hprem
    | p G T U Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH
    | p G T U1 U2 Hprem IH ];
    intros Hin q0 ET.
  - (* pf_bind *)
    exfalso.
    assert (HinT : inert_typ T) by (eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto).
    rewrite ET in HinT. inversion HinT.
  - (* pf_fld *)
    subst U.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    exists p, a, T. split; [reflexivity|]. assumption.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IH Hin q0 ET) as [HU _].
    discriminate HU.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* No flow to a singleton can start at a variable whose binding type   *)
(* is an arrow.  More generally, a flow whose path is x•bs, where x    *)
(* is bound to an arrow, can only be the trivial one.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma path_pvar_eq_cons : forall x y bs a,
  p_sel (avar_f x) nil = p_sel (avar_f y) (a :: bs) -> False.
Proof.
  intros x y bs a E. simpl in E. injection E as _ Hnil. discriminate Hnil.
Qed.

Lemma path_sel_cons_inv : forall (p:path) y a bs,
  p • a = p_sel (avar_f y) bs ->
  exists bs0, bs = a :: bs0 /\ p = p_sel (avar_f y) bs0.
Proof.
  intros [av bs0] y a bs E. simpl in E. injection E as Hav Hbs. subst av bs.
  exists bs0. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all_aux : forall C (p:path) T U,
  C ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
  forall x A B bs,
    binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros C p T U Hf.
  induction Hf; intros xx AA BB bs Hb Ep.
  - (* pf_bind: p = pvar x0, T = binding, U = T *)
    destruct bs as [|a bs].
    + simpl in Ep. injection Ep as Ex. subst xx.
      assert (HTeq : T = ∀(AA) BB) by (eapply binds_functional; eauto).
      subst T. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (@path_pvar_eq_cons x xx bs a Ep).
  - (* pf_fld *)
    destruct (@path_sel_cons_inv p xx a bs Ep) as [bs0 [Ebs Ep0]].
    subst bs.
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs0 Hb Ep0) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_open *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and1 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
  - (* pf_and2 *)
    pose proof (IHHf xx AA BB bs Hb Ep) as [_ Hout].
    discriminate Hout.
Qed.

Lemma flow_from_all : forall C x A B bs T U,
  binds x (∀(A) B) C ->
  C ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : T ⪼ U ->
  T = ∀(A) B /\ U = ∀(A) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply flow_from_all_aux; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Resolving flows in the pushed context [G & x ~ μ T0].               *)
(* We build a [ResCore] for the heap [γ & x ~ ν(T0)ds] using only the   *)
(* entries/definitions components of [HInv], not its [wf] component.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma defs_at_weaken : forall (G:ctx) (x0:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) x S,
  x # G -> x <> x0 ->
  defs_at G x0 T0 ds ->
  defs_at (G & x ~ S) x0 T0 ds.
Proof.
  intros G x0 T0 ds x S Hx Hne Hd. unfold defs_at in *.
  eapply weaken_defs
    with (G1 := G) (G2 := x0 ~ open_typ_p (pvar x0) T0) (w := x) (S := S).
  - exact Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
    + exact Hx.
    + apply notin_singleton_l. intro E. apply Hne. auto.
Qed.

(* The [res_field] step does not actually use the [HInv] argument. *)
Lemma res_field_noinv : forall γ G p a U,
  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a U R. dependent destruction R.

(* Extract the concrete stored-path typing from a [ResCore] whose output is
   a record with a singleton field.  The stored definition must be a path
   (a [defv] cannot be typed at a singleton field type), and its typing
   premise in the DefsTyped view context is returned. *)
Lemma rescore_sngl_field_path_typed : forall γ G p a q,
  ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) ->
  exists (x:var) (Vc:typ) (C:ctx) (bs:fields) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (Tq:typ),
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc /\
    binds x (μ Vc) G /\
    C ⊢ trm_path q : Tq.
Proof.
  intros γ G p a q R. dependent destruction R.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - pose proof (@flow_mu_record_has G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0
                  (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) {a ⦂ {{ q }}} H4 H5
                  (@rh_one {a ⦂ {{ q }}})) as Hhas.
    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a {{ q }} H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q0|val].
    + dependent destruction Hty.
      exists x. exists Vc. exists (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc).
      exists bs. exists T0. exists ds. exists T.
      split; [reflexivity|split; [exact H1|exact H0]].
    + exfalso. dependent destruction Hty.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Residual bridges.                                                   *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge] is the flow-resolution step     *)
(* for a freshly pushed [x ~ μ T0] whose definitions are recorded by    *)
(* [defs_at]: a self-flow ending in a singleton exposes the stored path *)
(* singleton [q], and that path is typable in the pushed context.       *)
(* It should be proved by adapting [flow_res]/[res_field] to the        *)
(* "entries/defs, no [wf]" setting and using [aux_swap]/               *)
(* [self_remove_ty] to move the stored path's typing to [G & x ~ μ T0]. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [inert_path_precise_bridge] is the general ordinary-path-to-precise  *)
(* typing theorem for inert contexts.  It is the same ordinary-path    *)
(* precision residual that underlies [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge]. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) (q:path),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    defs_at (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 ds ->
    forall bs,
      (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
      exists T, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢ trm_path q : T.

Lemma self_remove_view_ty : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) T,
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : T.
Proof.
  intros GG x T0 p T Hb Hty.
  rewrite <- (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) GG).
  eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty)
    with (G := GG & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & (empty:ctx))
         (G1 := GG) (G2 := (empty:ctx)) (x := x) (T0 := T0).
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. exact Hty.
  - exact Hb.
  - rewrite dom_empty. apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge.
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow.
  assert (HinC : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  destruct (@flow_sngl_source (G & x ~ μ T0) (p_sel (avar_f x) bs)
              {{ q }} {{ q }} HinC Hflow q eq_refl)
    as [_ [p0 [a [R [Ep Hf0]]]]].
  pose proof (@flow_res_push γ G x T0 ds (G & x ~ μ T0) Hi Hx Hrt
                eq_refl Hdefs p0 R (typ_rcd {a ⦂ {{ q }}}) Hf0) as Rc.
  destruct (@rescore_sngl_field_path_typed (γ & x ~ ν(T0) ds)
              (G & x ~ μ T0) p0 a q Rc)
    as [x0 [Vc [C [bs0 [T0' [ds' [Tq [EC [Hb Hty]]]]]]]]].
  exists Tq.
  eapply (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x0 Vc q Tq Hb).
  rewrite <- EC. exact Hty.
Qed.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ),
    inert C ->
    C ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Shared self-path precision fact: a path typed in the "view" context
   [G & x ~ open T0] is precisely typed in the pushed context
   [G & x ~ μ T0].  This is the self/stored-path instance of ordinary
   path precision and is the fact needed both here and by the arrow
   bridge.  It follows from the general inert-context bridge plus
   [self_remove_ty]. *)


Definition self_view_path_precise : Prop :=
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (p:path) (T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    x # G ->
    record_type T0 ->
    ((G & x ~ μ T0) & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists U, (G & x ~ μ T0) ⊢!! p : U.

Lemma self_view_path_precise_of_bridge :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> self_view_path_precise.
Proof.
  intros Hpath γ G x T0 p T Hi Hx Hrt Hty.
  assert (Hin : inert (G & x ~ μ T0)).
  { apply inert_push.
    - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
    - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
      apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
    - exact Hx. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (μ T0) (G & x ~ μ T0))
    by (exact (@binds_push_eq typ x (μ T0) G)).
  pose proof (@self_remove_view_ty (G & x ~ μ T0) x T0 p T Hb Hty) as Hty'.
  exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T0) p T Hin Hty').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  dependent destruction Hval.
  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
Qed.

(* The same statement, specialised to the exact hypothesis layout that the
   scratch [hp.v] parameter uses, for easy integration. *)
Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

(* Final assembly: only the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge remains. *)
Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof.
  intro Hpath.
  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
Qed.

(* Integration note.  Once the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge

   scratch parameter.  The only remaining hypothesis is the shared
   ordinary-path-precision fact for inert contexts. *)

Proof. apply subtyp_and11. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_bot_source_false :
  ~ (forall G S, G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> S = ⊥).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (H empty (⊥ ∧ ⊤) (@subtyp_and11_bot_top)) as E.
  discriminate E.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Unconditional facts.                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Composing [S <: ⊥] with [⊥ <: A] yields any arrow supertype.  Hence
   "no arrow supertype" implies "no bottom supertype": the bottom
   instances of facts 1-4 are consequences of their arrow instances. *)

Lemma no_bot_of_no_arrow : forall G S,
  (forall A, is_arrow A -> G ⊢ S <: A -> False) ->
  G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G S Hna Hbot.
  eapply Hna.
  - exists ⊤, ⊤. reflexivity.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hbot | apply subtyp_bot].
Qed.

(* The same for the four rigid source shapes, packaged together.  This
   shows that once the four arrow facts are known, the four bot facts
   come for free. *)

Lemma pointwise_rigid_bot_of_arrow :
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False).
Proof.
  intros Htop Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl.
  split; [|split; [|split]].
  - intros γ G V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G ⊤
             (fun A Har Hsa => Htop γ G A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G D V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G (typ_rcd D)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hrcd γ G D A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G (μ T0)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hbnd γ G T0 A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G q V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G ({{ q }})
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hsngl γ G q A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
Qed.

(* The easy direction of fact 6: if a component is below [⊥], so is the
   intersection.  In particular fact 6 has genuine content (it cannot be
   discharged by a source-shape inversion). *)

Lemma and_bot_of_component_l : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T1 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact H].
Qed.

Lemma and_bot_of_component_r : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T2 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact H].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The trans-free fragment [subtyp1].                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Replacement of an intersection is again an intersection. *)
Lemma repl_typ_and_inv : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> forall A1 A2, T = A1 ∧ A2 ->
  exists B1 B2, T' = B1 ∧ B2.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. induction H; intros A1 A2 E.
  - (* rrcd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rand1 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rand2 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rpath *) discriminate E.
  - (* rbnd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall1 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall2 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rsngl *) discriminate E.
Qed.

(* One trans-free step never produces an arrow from a rigid source. *)
Lemma subtyp1_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) left. exact Har.
  - (* and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The intersection split for one trans-free step.  The only cases are
   the two projections, which pick the corresponding component. *)
Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp1_ind;
    intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv p q T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv q p T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) discriminate EA.
  - (* all *) discriminate EA.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp1 G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* The same one-step classification for the star generator
   [subtyp_step] (agent_suball), which is what the decomposition
   [subtyp_star_step] produces.  No premise (typing or subtyping) is
   inspected: the shape of the conclusion alone determines the case. *)

Lemma subtyp_step_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* st_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* st_refl *) left. exact Har.
  - (* st_and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* st_and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* st_and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* st_sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* st_sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sel1 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* st_all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_step_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* st_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* st_refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* st_and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* st_and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* st_and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sngl_pq *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv p q T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sngl_qp *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv q p T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sel1 *) discriminate EA.
  - (* st_all *) discriminate EA.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_step_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp_step G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp_step_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Hence each single step whose target is an arrow is already correctly
   classified.  The whole remaining content of the classification is
   therefore the *backward lifting* of [ArrowSrc] through a star, whose
   two non-structural cases are precisely [sel_lower_class] and
   [and_target_lift] (see [ArrowSrc_star_back] in agent_noarrow). *)

Lemma subtyp_step_arrow_src : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H Har.
  destruct (@subtyp_step_arrow_shape G S U H Har)
    as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | Hand]]].
  - unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Harr.
  - unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact Hbot.
  - destruct Hpath as [p [A E]]. subst S.
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - destruct Hand as [T1 [T2 E]]. subst S.
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    exact (@subtyp_step_and_arrow_split G T1 T2 U H Har).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4. The exact frontier.                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_lower_class] and [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow) are          *)
(* together equivalent to the complete arrow-or-bot source             *)
(* classification and hence to [pointwise_facts].  We record this      *)
(* equivalence; it shows that no further purely syntactic reduction is *)
(* available.                                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pointwise_facts_iff_residuals :
  pointwise_facts <-> (sel_lower_class /\ and_target_lift).
Proof.
  split.
  - intro HP.
    pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as Hgen.
    split.
    + apply sel_lower_class_of_gen. exact Hgen.
    + apply and_target_lift_of_gen. exact Hgen.
  - intros [Hsel Hand].
    apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
    apply arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals;
      [exact Hand | exact Hsel].
Qed.

(* The arrow-only form of the four rigid facts plus fact 5.  [pointwise]
   is obtained from it by the bottom reduction above and fact 6.  This
   packages the observation that facts 1-4 at [⊥] are not independent. *)

Definition pointwise_arrow_facts : Prop :=
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V ->
     G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

Lemma pointwise_arrow_facts_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> pointwise_arrow_facts.
Proof.
  intros [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha _]]]]].
  unfold pointwise_arrow_facts.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - exact (fun γ G V Hi H Har => Ht γ G V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G D V Hi H Har => Hr γ G D V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G T0 V Hi H Har => Hb γ G T0 V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G q V Hi H Har => Hs γ G q V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact Ha.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 5. The semantic obligation.                                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The selection case of the classification needs the *runtime* tight  *)
(* bound of a type-member view.  The following two predicates isolate   *)
(* the two ingredients precisely.                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [uniform_tight_member] is the provenance statement: every path that  *)
(* has a type-member view has one canonical tight bound [W] (the actual *)
(* record member), it admits the tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}], and   *)
(* every view brackets [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_          *)
(* provenance] of agent_suball (see [canonical_member_bound_of_         *)
(* provenance]) together with the tight view itself; it is the form     *)
(* produced by PathObject/DefsTyped in an HInv heap.                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_bound_inv] turns the canonical bound into the two inversion     *)
(* facts [S <: p↓A -> S <: W] and [p↓A <: U -> W <: U].                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [tight_bound_arrow_class] is the normal-form statement: below a     *)
(* canonical *tight* bound, the arrow-or-bot classification holds for   *)
(* every source.  Because canonical bounds are exactly the stored       *)
(* member types, this is the well-founded "heap definition depth"       *)
(* induction hypothesis of the task description; it is strictly         *)
(* weaker than quantifying over all types.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition uniform_tight_member : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

(* The bound inversions are *provable*: from the tight view typing alone,
   every type below [p↓A] is below [W], and every type above [p↓A] is
   above [W].  The proofs are by induction on the subtyping derivation;
   the selection steps use the tight view again, the replacement and
   conjunction steps are structural. *)

Lemma sel_right_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> S = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros ES.
  - (* top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* bot *) discriminate ES.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + exact Hsub2.
  - (* and11 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and12 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and2 *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
  - (* fld *) discriminate ES.
  - (* typ *) discriminate ES.
  - (* sngl_pq *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) subst S.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + rewrite <- ES. eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
  - (* all *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma sel_right_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight U H.
  eapply (@sel_right_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight (p ↓ A) U H eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> U = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros EU.
  - (* top *) discriminate EU.
  - (* bot *) apply subtyp_bot.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + exact Hsub1.
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact EU].
  - (* and11 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and11.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and12 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_and12.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* and2 *) discriminate EU.
  - (* fld *) discriminate EU.
  - (* typ *) discriminate EU.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel2 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
    + rewrite EU. apply subtyp_sel1 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* all *) discriminate EU.
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S H.
  eapply (@sel_left_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight S (p ↓ A) H eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Package the two inversions, now as a theorem. *)
Definition sel_bound_inv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
    (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T) ->
    (forall S, G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A -> G ⊢ S <: W) /\
    (forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U).

Lemma sel_bound_inv_proof : sel_bound_inv.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight Hbrack. split.
  - intros S HS. eapply (@sel_left_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight S HS).
  - intros U HU. eapply (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U HU).
Qed.

Definition tight_bound_arrow_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G W S U,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists p A, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
       (forall S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
          G ⊢ S0 <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T0)) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W -> G ⊢ W <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* [sel_lower_class] now follows from provenance plus the tight-bound
   normal form alone: the bracket gives [S <: W], the (proved) inversion
   gives [W <: U], and the normal form classifies [S] at [U]. *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> tight_bound_arrow_class -> sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hcls γ G p A S T U Hi Hty Hcont Har.
  destruct (Hprov γ G p A Hi (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hty)))
    as [W [Htight Hbrack]].
  destruct (Hbrack S T Hty) as [HSW _].
  pose proof (@sel_right_bound γ G p A W Hi Htight U Hcont) as HWU.
  exact (Hcls γ G W S U Hi
           (ex_intro _ p (ex_intro _ A (conj Htight Hbrack)))
           HSW HWU Har).
Qed.

(* Consequently the six facts are implied by the semantic package
   together with [and_target_lift] (the remaining intersection-target
   residual of agent_noarrow). *)

Theorem pointwise_facts_of_semantic :
  uniform_tight_member -> tight_bound_arrow_class ->
  and_target_lift -> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  intros Hprov Hcls Hand.
  apply pointwise_facts_iff_residuals.
  split.
  - apply sel_lower_class_of_semantic; assumption.
  - exact Hand.
Qed.

(* The two remaining semantic obligations, stated exactly:

   (A) [uniform_tight_member] (runtime provenance): every path with a
       type-member view has a canonical actual tight bound [W] with the
       tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}] and with every view bracketing
       [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_provenance] of
       agent_suball; its construction from [HInv] via PathObject /
       DefsTyped is the provenance theorem that is not carried out in
       this file.

   (B) [tight_bound_arrow_class] (normal form / heap-rank induction):
       below a canonical tight bound the arrow-or-bot classification
       holds.  Canonical bounds are stored member types of strictly
       older variables (the store built by [well_typed] is acyclic), so
       this is the well-founded "definition depth" statement; it is not
       an instance of the master because it quantifies only over actual
       bounds.

   Together with [and_target_lift], (A) and (B) give the six facts by
   [pointwise_facts_of_semantic], whose proof is fully checked. *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Direct analysis of the master classification.                       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The master ([arrow_source_class_gen]) is a statement about a       *)
(* *syntactic* source type [S].  Therefore it can be analysed by a     *)
(* finite case split on the outer constructor of [S].  This isolates   *)
(* the exact semantic core: one "no rigid source below an arrow/bot"   *)
(* fact per rigid constructor, plus the component split for            *)
(* intersection sources.                                               *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The resulting [pointwise_facts] are *equivalent* to the master.     *)
(* This is strictly sharper than the earlier reduction to              *)
(* [sel_lower_class] / [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow.v): no        *)
(* selection- or typing-level reasoning remains in the reduction;      *)
(* what remains is precisely the per-constructor semantic content.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The per-constructor source facts.                                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition pointwise_facts : Prop :=
  (* no rigid source below an arrow or bot *)
  (forall γ G V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_top <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> (is_arrow V \/ V = ⊥) -> False) /\
  (* component split for intersection sources *)
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V,
      HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

(* The conjunction-split part at arrow and bot targets, exactly the    *)
(* HInv-aware [and_arrow_split_H] plus its bot analogue.               *)
Definition and_split_H : Prop :=
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V ->
      G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> V = ⊥ ->
      G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

Lemma and_split_H_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> and_split_H.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold pointwise_facts in H.
  destruct H as [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha Hb2]]]]].
  unfold and_split_H. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Master => pointwise facts.  (Easy: instantiate the master at the    *)
(* rigid head and refute the ArrowSrc disjuncts syntactically.)        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pointwise_facts_of_master :
  arrow_source_class_gen -> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  intros HC. unfold pointwise_facts.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]]].
  - (* top *) intros γ G V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G typ_top V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (top_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* rcd *) intros γ G D V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd D) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* bnd *) intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* sngl *) intros γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [T1 [T2 [E _]]]]]].
    + exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* and / arrow target *) intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub Har.
    destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E]] | [V1 [V2 [E Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E.
    + injection E as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
  - (* and / bot target *) intros γ G T1 T2 V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) ⊥ Hi Hsub (or_intror eq_refl)) as
      [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A E']] | [V1 [V2 [E' Hsplit]]]]]].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Harr)).
    + discriminate Hbot.
    + discriminate E'.
    + injection E' as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Pointwise facts => master.  Pure case analysis on the source        *)
(* constructor.  No typing is inspected, no selection reasoning.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma master_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> arrow_source_class_gen.
Proof.
  intro HF. unfold pointwise_facts in HF.
  destruct HF as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  intros γ G S U Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct S as [| |D|T1 T2|p A|T0|S0 T0|q].
  - (* top *) exact (False_ind _ (Htop γ G U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hrcd γ G D U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* and *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Har as [Harr | E].
    + exact (HandA γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Harr).
    + exact (HandB γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub E).
  - (* path *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* bnd *) exact (False_ind _ (Hbnd γ G T0 U Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* all *) unfold ArrowSrc. left. exists S0, T0. reflexivity.
  - (* sngl *) exact (False_ind _ (Hsngl γ G q U Hi Hsub Har)).
Qed.

(* The equivalence, stated cleanly. *)
Theorem master_iff_pointwise :
  arrow_source_class_gen <-> pointwise_facts.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
  - apply master_of_pointwise.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Tie-in with the selection/conjunction residuals of agent_noarrow.v. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sel_lower_class_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> sel_lower_class.
Proof.
  intros HP. apply sel_lower_class_of_gen.
  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma and_target_lift_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> and_target_lift.
Proof.
  intros HP. apply and_target_lift_of_gen.
  apply master_of_pointwise. exact HP.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_arrow_H_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> sngl_no_arrow_H.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold pointwise_facts in H.
  destruct H as [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs _]]]].
  intros γ G q V Hi Hsub Har. exact (Hs γ G q V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* The complete chain for packaging: pointwise facts give the master,
   hence the two residuals of agent_noarrow, hence the four named facts
   that the Q2 assembly consumes. *)
Lemma four_facts_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  rcd_no_arrow /\ bnd_no_arrow /\ and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros HP.
  pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as HC.
  assert (HC' : arrow_source_class)
    by (intros γ G S U Hi Hsub Har; exact (HC γ G S U Hi Hsub (or_introl Har))).
  split; [|split].
  - apply rcd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC'.
  - apply bnd_no_arrow_of_class. exact HC'.
  - apply and_split_of_class. exact HC'.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* What is *unconditional* here.                                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The equivalence [master_iff_pointwise] is fully unconditional.  So  *)
(* proving the master is *exactly* proving the six pointwise facts.    *)
(* The four "no rigid source below arrow/bot" facts and the two       *)
(* intersection splits cannot be obtained by structural recursion on   *)
(* the subtyping derivation: consider a derivation [S <: U] whose     *)
(* first non-structural atom is [st_sel2], [S <: p↓A].  The result     *)
(* [S <: U] follows by transitivity via [p↓A], and the only typing     *)
(* information is [p : rcd{A>:S<:T}].  With no canonical member bound  *)
(* this is not reducible to a smaller subtyping derivation of the same *)
(* source; counter_bridge2.v shows the HInv-free statement is false.   *)
(* Under HInv the missing ingredient is the runtime tight member bound *)
(* (PathObject/DefsTyped); its extraction is the residual isolated in  *)
(* agent_suball.v ([path_actual_record_trans_free]) and agent_wf.v     *)
(* ([inert_path_precise_bridge]).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_repl agent_assembly agent_assembly2 agent_final2.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma step_plain : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (t':trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Ht. destruct (@step γ G t T Hi Ht) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
  - left; exact Hnf.
  - right. exists γ', G', u'. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact Hi'|exact Hty'].
Qed.

Theorem safety_test : forall t T,
  empty ⊢ t : T ->
  infseq red (empty, t) \/
  (exists γ u G, star red (empty, t) (γ, u) /\
            norm_form u /\
            G ⊢ u : T /\
            γ ⫶ G /\
            wf G /\
            inert G).
Proof.
  intros t T Ht.
  destruct (@terminate_or_diverge (fun γ G t0 T0 Hi Hty => step_plain Hi Hty) (empty:sta) (empty:ctx) t T HInv_empty Ht) as [Hinf | Hterm].
  - left; exact Hinf.
  - right. destruct Hterm as [γ [u [G [Hstar [Hnf [Hty Hi]]]]]].
    exists γ, u, G. split; [exact Hstar|]. split; [exact Hnf|]. split; [exact Hty|].
    destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf _]]]. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hwf|exact Hinert].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.
        assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ T & empty)).
        { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; auto|auto]. }
        pose proof (Hsubst_trm (G & x ~ T) (open_trm x u) U Hbody G x T empty p Hok (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ T))) Hnp Hxctx HxT Hty0) as Hsub.
        unfold subst_ctx in Hsub.
        rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ x p)) in Hsub.
        rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub.
        unfold open_trm in Hsub.
        rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z u 0 x Hxu p Hnp) in Hsub.
        rewrite (@subst_typ_fresh U x p HxU) in Hsub.
        exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p p u). split.
        -- apply red_let_path.
        -- split; [exact Hi|]. split; [exact Hsub|].
           exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
      * (* let-val *)
        right.
        destruct (ty_val_inv Hty0) as
          [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]].
        -- (* lambda *)
           subst v.
           set (Lx := L \u dom G \u dom γ).
           destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
           assert (HxL : x \notin L).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (HxG : x # G).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           assert (Hxγ : x # γ).
           { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
           pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
           assert (Hnewdefs : forall T0x dsx, (λ(T1) t') = ν(T0x) dsx -> ∀(T1) T2 = μ T0x /\ defs_at (G & x ~ ∀(T1) T2) x T0x dsx).

| pt2: forall G p T U,
    G ⊢! p : T ⪼ U ->
    G ⊢!! p: U
| pt2_sngl_trans : forall G p q a U,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! q•a : U ->
    G ⊢!! p•a : {{ q•a }}
where "G '⊢!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing2 G p T).

Inductive precise_typing3: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt3: forall G p T,
    G ⊢!! p : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p: T
| pt3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p : T
where "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing3 G p T).

Inductive wf : ctx -> Prop :=
| wfe_empty :
    wf empty
| wfe_push G x T :
    wf G ->
    x # G ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ T ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }}->
             exists U, G & x ~ T ⊢!! q : U) ->
    wf (G & x ~ T).

Definition typed_repl_comp_qp G T1 T2 :=
  exists p q U,
    G ⊢! p: {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} /\
    G ⊢!! q : U /\
    repl_typ q p T1 T2.

Definition repl_composition_qp G := star (typed_repl_comp_qp G).
