Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_repl.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Strengthened Q.                                                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the Q of agent_sgood_bridge.v with two cooperative           *)
(* strengthenings requested for the wf_push integration:                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   q2_prec2 : exists U, G ⊢!! p : U        (the explicit field)         *)
(*   q2_sngl  : the singleton payload is precise2, not merely precise3. *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The precise2 singleton payload is what makes the [path_elim] and     *)
(* [sngl_trans] q2_prec2 clauses constructible (it supplies the first   *)
(* premise of [pt2_sngl_trans]); precise3 is recovered by [pt3].         *)
(* All recursive occurrences remain strictly positive (the record and   *)
(* μ occurrences are direct constructor arguments).                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive Q2 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| q2_intro : forall p T,
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    Q2 γ G p T.

(* Projections. *)
Lemma Q2_arrow : forall γ G p T,
  Q2 γ G p T -> forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact Har. Qed.

Lemma Q2_fld : forall γ G p T (a:trm_label) S,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q2 γ G (p • a) S.
Proof. intros γ G p T a S H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hfld a S). Qed.

Lemma Q2_and : forall γ G p T T1 T2,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q2 γ G p T1 /\ Q2 γ G p T2.
Proof. intros γ G p T T1 T2 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hand T1 T2). Qed.

Lemma Q2_bnd : forall γ G p T T0,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = μ T0 -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).
Proof. intros γ G p T T0 H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hbnd T0). Qed.

Lemma Q2_sngl : forall γ G p T q,
  Q2 γ G p T -> T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof. intros γ G p T q H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact (Hsng q). Qed.

Lemma Q2_prec2 : forall γ G p T,
  Q2 γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros γ G p T H. destruct H as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand Hbnd Hsng Hprec]. exact Hprec. Qed.

(* Precise3 version of the singleton payload. *)
Lemma Q2_sngl3 : forall γ G p q,
  Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q H. apply pt3. eapply Q2_sngl; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Flow base: a precise flow output is Q2 at arbitrary fuel-bounded    *)
(* type size.  (Adapted from [Q_of_flow_ge].)                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma Q2_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
  g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
    + (* top *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HTU.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. discriminate E.
      * exists ⊤. apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
    + (* bot *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
      * (* dec_typ *) apply q2_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
        -- exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
      * (* dec_trm *) apply q2_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
           ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
        -- exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
    + (* and *) apply q2_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.

Lemma Q2_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q2_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
   needed. *)
Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.

Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.

Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma SGood_Q2_of_residuals :
  Q2_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q2_of_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 u0 Har Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl' Hprec]; subst.
    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

(* Every SGood typing yields a precise2 typing of the path, under HInv,
   once the Q2 closure residuals are supplied.  This is the precise
   witness requested for [wf_push_cond]. *)
Lemma path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2 :
  Q2_residuals ->
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hs.
  exact (Q2_prec2 (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p T Hi Hs)).
Qed.

(* The direct ordinary-typing version: this is the HInv-aware
   ordinary-path-to-precise2 bridge whose output feeds
   [wf_push_cond_of_path_precise]. *)
Theorem HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
  Q2_residuals ->
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p T Hi Hty.
  eapply path_prec2_exists_of_SGood_Q2; eauto.
  eapply SGood_typing; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Conditional reductions of the remaining residuals.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Each isolates the precise semantic ingredient that is still         *)
(* missing, so the frontier is explicit rather than hidden in a        *)
(* monolithic residual.                                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* --- (A) Target-intersection arrow split. ------------------------- *)
(* If an arrow supertype of [T ∧ U] is already a supertype of one      *)
(* component, the ArrowCl fields of the two premises compose.  The     *)
(* missing fact is exactly the split; it is the "and-supertype arrow"  *)
(* classification noted in agent_bridge1 (two Bridge witnesses below T *)
(* and U need not combine below T∧U).                                  *)
Definition and_arrow_split : Prop :=
  forall G T U V, G ⊢ T ∧ U <: V -> is_arrow V ->
    G ⊢ T <: V \/ G ⊢ U <: V.

Lemma Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split :
  and_arrow_split -> Q2_and_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hsplit γ G p T U Hi HT HU. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    destruct (Hsplit G T U V Hsub Har) as [HTV | HUV].
    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p T HT V HTV Har).
    + exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p U HU V HUV Har).
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst T1. subst T2.
    split; assumption.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 HT).
Qed.

(* --- (B) No arrow from a term-field record. ----------------------- *)
Definition rcd_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall γ G (a:trm_label) S V,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
  rcd_no_arrow -> Q2_rcd_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p a T Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G a T V Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* field *) intros b S E. injection E as Eb ES. subst b. subst S.
    exact Ha.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) destruct (Q2_prec2 Ha) as [U HU].
    exact (@precise2_prefix_snoc G p a U HU).
Qed.

(* --- (C) No arrow from a recursive type. -------------------------- *)
Definition bnd_no_arrow : Prop :=
  forall γ G T0 V,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.

Lemma Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow :
  bnd_no_arrow -> Q2_rec_intro_cl.
Proof.
  intros Hna γ G p T0 Hi Ha. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exact (False_ind _ (Hna γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har)).
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'. exact Ha.
  - (* singleton *) intros q E. discriminate E.
  - (* prec2 *) exact (Q2_prec2 Ha).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* (D) Singleton transitivity, reduced to the μ-opening transport.     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* All cases except μ go through by strong induction on the type size: *)
(* the field case at [p•a,q•a] uses [pt2_sngl_trans] to transport the  *)
(* precise2 singleton payload, and the and case uses the two IHs.      *)
(* The sole obstruction is the μ field, which asks for the body opened *)
(* at [p] given the body opened at the aliased path [q].               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition Q2_mu_open_transport : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T0,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    Q2 γ G q (open_typ_p q T0) -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0).

(* Precise2 transitivity at a singleton.  This is the one precise2 rule
   missing from the raw calculus (pt2_sngl_trans only transports a field
   selector).  With the precise2 singleton payload it is exactly what the
   singleton case of sngl-transport needs. *)
Definition Q2_prec2_sngl_trans : Prop :=
  forall G p q r, G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! q : {{ r }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ r }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_trans_ge :
  Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  forall (N:nat) (T:typ), g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros Hmu Hs2 N. induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p q Hi Hp2 Hq.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - apply q2_intro.
    + (* arrow *) intros V Hsub HarV.
      destruct (@Q2_arrow γ G q T Hq V Hsub HarV) as [U [Hq3 [Hfs HUV]]].
      exists U. split; [|split].
      * eapply precise3_sngl_trans; [apply pt3; exact Hp2 | exact Hq3].
      * exact Hfs.
      * exact HUV.
    + (* field *) intros a S E. subst T.
      pose proof (@Q2_fld γ G q (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) a S Hq eq_refl) as HQqaS.
      destruct (Q2_prec2 HQqaS) as [U Hqa2].
      assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
        by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
      eapply IH.
      * simpl in Hsz. lia.
      * exact Hi.
      * exact Hpa2.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Combined structural property for SGood.  It mirrors the SGood
   constructors but adds the arrow/Bridge-facing clauses.  All recursive
   occurrences are positive. *)
Inductive Q (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| q_intro : forall p T,
    (forall U, G ⊢ T <: U -> is_arrow U -> Bridge γ G p U) ->
    (forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> Q γ G (p • a) S) ->
    (forall T1 T2, T = T1 ∧ T2 -> Q γ G p T1 /\ Q γ G p T2) ->
    (forall T0, T = μ T0 -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
    (forall q, T = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}) ->
    Q γ G p T.

(* Flow base for Q: a precise flow output is Q at arbitrary fuel-bounded
   type size.  This is the sg_flow base of the SGood induction. *)
Lemma Q_of_flow_ge : forall (N:nat) (T:typ),
  g_typ_size T <= N ->
  forall γ G p R, HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  induction N as [|N IH]; intros T Hsz γ G p R Hi Hf.
  - pose proof (g_typ_size_pos T). lia.
  - destruct T as [| |D|T1 T2|q0 l|T0|S0 U0|q0].
    + (* top *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U HTU _. exists ⊤. split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p ⊤). apply (@pt2 G p R ⊤). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊤ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HTU.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. discriminate E.
    + (* bot *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R ⊥ Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
    + (* rcd D *) destruct D as [A L U | a S].
      * (* dec_typ *) apply q_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {A >: L <: U}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * (* dec_trm *) apply q_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
           ++ apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
           ++ exact HU0.
        -- intros a0 S0 E. injection E as Ea ES. subst a0. subst S0.
           refine (IH S _ γ G (p • a) S Hi _).
           ++ simpl in Hsz. lia.
            ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* and *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (T1 ∧ T2). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros U1 U2 E. injection E as E1 E2. subst U1. subst U2.
        split.
        -- refine (IH T1 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and1 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
        -- refine (IH T2 _ γ G p R Hi _). simpl in Hsz. lia.
           apply (@pf_and2 p G R T1 T2). exact Hf.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* path *) exfalso.
      pose proof (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R (q0 ↓ l) Hi Hf) as Hfs.
      exact (@flow_shape_path_absurd q0 l Hfs).
    + (* bnd *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists (μ T0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0' E. injection E as E. subst T0'.
        refine (IH (open_typ_p p T0) _ γ G p R Hi _).
        -- rewrite g_typ_size_open_eq. simpl in Hsz. lia.
        -- apply (@pf_open p G R T0). exact Hf.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* all *) apply q_intro.
      * intros V0 HV0 _. exists (∀(S0) U0). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HV0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q0 E. discriminate E.
    + (* sngl *) apply q_intro.
      * intros U0 HU0 _. exists ({{ q0 }}). split; [|split].
        -- apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.
        -- apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R _ Hi Hf).
        -- exact HU0.
      * intros a S E. discriminate E.
      * intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
      * intros T0 E. discriminate E.
      * intros q E. injection E as E. subst q.
        apply pt3. apply (@pt2 G p R {{ q0 }}). exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma Q_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (Q_of_flow_ge (N := g_typ_size T) (T := T)); eauto.
Qed.

(* Exact closure residuals needed to turn SGood into Q. *)
Definition Q_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q γ G p U.

Definition Q_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G q T -> Q γ G p T.

Definition Q_path_elim_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q γ G p {{ q }} -> Q γ G (q • a) T -> Q γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Definition Q_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q γ G (p • a) T -> Q γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q γ G p T -> Q γ G p U -> Q γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q_sngl_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q γ G p {{ q }}.

Definition SGood_Q_residuals : Prop :=
  Q_sub_cl /\ Q_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q_path_elim_cl /\
  Q_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q_rec_intro_cl /\ Q_and_intro_cl /\ Q_sngl_cl.

Lemma SGood_Q_of_residuals :
  SGood_Q_residuals -> forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> Q γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros [Hsub [Hsngl [Hpath [Hrcd [Hrec [Hand Hsng]]]]]] γ G p T Hi Hs.
  induction Hs.
  - (* sg_flow *) eapply Q_of_flow; eauto.
  - (* sg_sub *) eapply Hsub; eauto.
  - (* sg_new_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (Hfld a T eq_refl).
  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_intro *) apply Hrec; eauto.
  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0' Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (Hbnd T0 eq_refl).
  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (proj1 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
    exact (proj2 (Hand' T U eq_refl)).
  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

(* Bridge 1, conditional on the closure residuals. *)
Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_residuals :
  SGood_Q_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
  pose proof (@SGood_Q_of_residuals Hres γ G p A Hi Hs) as HQ.
  inversion HQ as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.
  exact (Harr A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
Qed.

Lemma label_of_def_open_p : forall k p (d:def),

  defs_has (open_rec_defs_p k p ds) d ->
  exists d0, defs_has ds d0 /\ open_rec_def_p k p d0 = d.
Proof.
  intros k p ds d. revert k p d.
  induction ds as [|rest IH d0]; intros k p d H.
  - unfold defs_has in H. simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - unfold defs_has in H. cbn in H.
    destruct (classic (label_of_def (open_rec_def_p k p d0) = label_of_def d)) as [Heq|Hne].
    + rewrite If_l in H by auto. injection H as E. subst d.
      exists d0. split; [apply defs_has_cons_same|reflexivity].
    + rewrite If_r in H by auto.
      assert (Hlab : label_of_def d0 <> label_of_def d).
      { intro E. apply Hne. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. exact E. }
      destruct (IH k p d H) as [ds0 [Hds E]].
      exists ds0. split.
      * unfold defs_has. rewrite get_def_cons_neq.
        -- unfold defs_has in Hds. exact Hds.
        -- assert (Elab : label_of_def ds0 = label_of_def d).
           { rewrite <- E. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. reflexivity. }
           intro E2. apply Hlab. rewrite E2. exact Elab.
      * exact E.

  defs_at G x T0 ds -> DefsTyped (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) x nil T0 ds.

  intros. unfold defs_at, DefsTyped in *. simpl. exact H.
Qed.

  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
  record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
  exists d, defs_has (open_defs_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds) d /\
            x; bs; C ⊢ d : {a ⦂ S}.
Proof.
  intros. unfold DefsTyped in H.
  exact (ty_defs_record_has_inv H H0).
Qed.

  record_has (open_typ_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) T0) {a ⦂ S} ->

  rewrite label_of_def_open_p in Hlab.
  simpl in Hlab.
  destruct d0 as [A Td | b rhs]; simpl in Hlab.

  - injection Hlab as Eba. subst b.
    exists rhs. split; [exact Hd0|]. split.
    + apply lookup_sel_v with (T := T0) (ds := ds); auto.
    + exact Hty.

Require Export TLC.LibLN.

  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Definition fields := list trm_label.

Inductive path :=
  | p_sel : avar -> fields ->  path.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_path : path -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sngl : path -> typ



with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> dec.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_val  : val -> trm
  | trm_app  : path -> path -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_path : path -> trm







with val : Set :=
  | val_new  : typ -> defs -> val
  | val_lambda : typ -> trm -> val



with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def_rhs -> def




with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs

with def_rhs : Set :=
  | defp : path -> def_rhs
  | defv : val -> def_rhs.

Notation "'{' a '⦂' T '}'" := (dec_trm a T) (T at level 50).

Notation "'{' A '>:' S '<:' T '}'" := (dec_typ A S T) (S at level 58).

Notation "T '∧' U" := (typ_and T U) (at level 30).

Notation "'∀' '(' T ')' U" := (typ_all T U) (at level 30).

Notation "p '↓' A" := (typ_path p A) (at level 30).

Notation "'μ' T" := (typ_bnd T) (at level 30, T at level 50).

Notation "⊤" := typ_top.

Notation "⊥" := typ_bot.

Notation "'{{' p '}}'" := (typ_sngl p).

Notation "'ν' '(' T ')' ds" := (val_new T ds) (at level 40, T at level 40, ds at level 40).

Notation "'λ' '(' T ')' t" := (val_lambda T t) (at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=' t '}'" := (def_trm a t) (t at level 50).

Notation "'{' a ':=p' p '}'" := (def_trm a (defp p)).

Notation "'{' a ':=v' v '}'" := (def_trm a (defv v)).

Notation "'{' A '⦂=' T '}'" := (def_typ A T).

Notation pvar x := (p_sel (avar_f x) nil).

Notation  tvar x := (trm_path (pvar x)).

Definition sel_field (p : path) (b : trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel x (b :: bs)
  end.

Definition sel_fields (p : path) (bs : list trm_label) :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs' => p_sel x (bs ++ bs')
  end.

Notation "p '•' a" := (sel_field p a) (at level 5).

Notation "p '••' bs" := (sel_fields p bs) (at level 5).

Definition label_of_def(d: def): label := match d with
| def_typ A _ => label_typ A
| { a := t }  => label_trm a
end.

Definition label_of_dec(D: dec): label := match D with
| { A >: _ <: _ } => label_typ A
| { a ⦂ _ }  => label_trm a
end.

Fixpoint get_def(l: label)(ds: defs): option def :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of_def d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of_def d) ds = Some d.

Definition defs_hasnt(ds: defs)(l: label) := get_def l ds = None.

Definition open_rec_avar (k: nat) (u: var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then avar_f u else avar_b i
  | avar_f x => avar_f x
end.

Definition open_rec_path (k: nat) (u: var) (p: path): path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => p_sel (open_rec_avar k u x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path k u p ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | ∀(T1) T2      => ∀(open_rec_typ k u T1) open_rec_typ (S k) u T2
  | {{ p }}        => {{ open_rec_path k u p }}
  end
with open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => { A >: open_rec_typ k u T <: open_rec_typ k u U }
  | { a ⦂ T } => { a ⦂ open_rec_typ k u T }
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path k u p) (open_rec_path k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val (k: nat) (u: var) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T)ds   => ν (open_rec_typ (S k) u T) open_rec_defs (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ k u T) open_rec_trm (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => def_typ A (open_rec_typ k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs (k: nat) (u: var) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar u a := open_rec_avar  0 u a.

Definition open_typ  u t := open_rec_typ   0 u t.

Definition open_dec  u D := open_rec_dec   0 u D.

Definition open_trm  u e := open_rec_trm   0 u e.

Definition open_val  u v := open_rec_val   0 u v.

Definition open_def  u d := open_rec_def   0 u d.

Definition open_defs u l := open_rec_defs  0 u l.

Definition open_defrhsdd u t := open_rec_defrhs 0 u t.

Definition open_path u p := open_rec_path  0 u p.

Definition open_paths u ps := map (open_path u) ps.

Definition open_rec_avar_p (k: nat) (u: path) (a: avar) : path :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => If k = i then u else p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f x => pvar x
  end.

Definition open_rec_path_p (k: nat) (u: path) (p: path): path :=
  match p, u with
  | p_sel x bs, p_sel y cs=>
    match x with
    | avar_b i => If k = i then p_sel y (bs ++ cs) else p
    | avar_f x => p
    end
  end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ_p (k: nat) (u: path) (T: typ): typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec_p k u D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => open_rec_typ_p k u T1 ∧ open_rec_typ_p k u T2
  | p ↓ L          => open_rec_path_p k u p ↓ L

(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. exact HV.
Qed.

(* Field selection from a precise flow with a known field: this is the
   "field part" that composes cleanly, and is the payload needed once the
   record head and the field declaration are available. *)
Lemma flow_field_precise2 : forall C p R U (a:trm_label) V,
  C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  record_has U {a ⦂ V} ->
  exists W, C ⊢!! (p • a) : W.
Proof.
  intros C p R U a V Hf Hhas.
  exists V. eapply pt2. eapply pf_fld.
  apply (@flow_record_has C p R U {a ⦂ V}); auto.
Qed.

(* NOTE: a precise2 typing can also be a [pt2_sngl_trans] whose output is
   a singleton.  Such an output can never carry a [record_has] field, so
   the flow-based [flow_field_precise2] above is the usable field step;
   record-typed precise2 outputs are always [pt2] flow outputs. *)

(* Reduction insight for the Good/Psub induction.

   The invariant that makes the mutual typing/subtyping induction close is
   precision *soundness*:

     Snd C p T  :=  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U /\ C ⊢ U <: T      (plus flow_shape U)

   and its two companions R (exists U, C⊢!! p:U) and Rsing.

   - Snd is preserved by any subtyping T <: T' by transitivity of <:, so
     the [ty_sub] case is immediate and the trans case composes the two
     Psub hypotheses without any measure issue (this is the tds_mutind
     observation: the right premise's Psub is already universally
     quantified over an arbitrary typing of the intermediate type).
   - [ty_new_elim] is the only place where a field is created: from
     Snd at [rcd{b ⦂ T}] we get a precise output U with U <: rcd{b ⦂ T};
     since U is flow-shaped, extracting the field declaration of U is
     exactly [flow_shape_field_of_sub] (O1 of agent_bridge1.v).  With
     that declaration {b ⦂ V}, V <: T, [flow_field_precise2] gives the
     precise field selector and hence Snd at T.
   - For `field_sub_closure` at a natural field type S we only need O1 at
     U <: rcd{a ⦂ S}; the natural (inert/singleton) hypothesis is what
     makes the extraction sound (an inert/singleton output cannot be a
     record, so U must be the record-shaped flow output).

   Thus [field_sub_closure] is downstream of O1 plus precision soundness;
   the unconditional implication available here is
   [field_sub_closure_of_path_precise]. *)

(* Natural-field form (field type an arrow / μ-record / singleton).  The
   same reduction applies; no restriction on S is even needed. *)
Lemma field_sub_closure_natural_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
    flow_shape S -> exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT Hfs. subst T.
  destruct (Hbridge C (p • a) S Hin (@ty_new_elim C p a S Hp)) as [V HV].
  exists V. apply pt3. exact HV.
Qed.

(* NOTE on the R / Rsing / F decomposition (agent_bridge1.v).  The
   [ty_new_elim] case inherently needs *unrestricted* field precision:
   from [p0 : rcd{b ⦂ rcd{a ⦂ S}}] one must precisely type [p0 • b] at
   some [V], and then select [a] from [V].  The intermediate field type
   [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is a record, so a version of [F] restricted to natural
   field types cannot be applied at that step; and the relation between
   the precise field type [V] and the ordinary view [rcd{a ⦂ S}] is
   exactly the precision-soundness invariant (a flow output being a
   subtype of the ordinary typing).  Thus [field_sub_closure] and the
   bridge are equivalent in strength for the needs of this development;
   the clean unconditional implication is the one proven above. *)

(* The assembly, restated with the exact residual name. *)
Lemma app_step_from_precise3_residual :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_residual ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* F. Type-member coherence: the combinatorial core and its exact     *)
(*    semantic residual.                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* A record type has distinct labels, so a type member [A] occurring   *)
(* in a [record_type] occurs exactly once.  Consequently two            *)
(* [record_has] facts for type members with the same label expose the   *)
(* *same* tight bound.  This is the uniqueness half of                    *)
(* [typ_member_common_bound]; the provenance half (every ordinary       *)
(* record view brackets the tight bound of the path's precise flow) is  *)
(* isolated in the interfaces below.                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma record_has_rcd_inv : forall (D D':dec),
  record_has (typ_rcd D) D' -> D' = D.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_typ_has_label_in : forall (T:typ) ls (D:dec),
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of_dec D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrt. revert D.
  induction Hrt; intros Dx Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *)
    inversion Hhas; subst; apply in_singleton_self'.
  - (* rt_cons *)
    inversion Hhas; subst.
    + (* from the left component *)
      apply in_union_l. eapply IHHrt; eauto.
    + (* from the right component *)
      apply in_union_r.
      match goal with
      | HR : record_has (typ_rcd ?DD) _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite E
      end.
      apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma record_has_typ_unique : forall (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W1 W2,
  record_type U ->
  record_has U { A >: W1 <: W1 } ->
  record_has U { A >: W2 <: W2 } ->
  W1 = W2.
Proof.
  intros U A W1 W2 [ls Hrt]. revert A W1 W2.
  induction Hrt; intros A W1 W2 Hrec1 Hrec2.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hrec1; subst; inversion Hrec2; subst; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *)
    destruct (classic (label_typ A = label_of_dec D)) as [El|En].
    + (* both occurrences are the right component *)
      assert (Hr1 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
          change (label_of_dec { A >: W1 <: W1 } \in ls).
          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
        - assumption. }
      assert (Hr2 : record_has (typ_rcd D) { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
        - exfalso. apply H1. rewrite <- El.
          change (label_of_dec { A >: W2 <: W2 } \in ls).
          eapply record_typ_has_label_in; [exact Hrt | assumption].
        - assumption. }
      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr1) as E1.
      pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv Hr2) as E2.
      rewrite <- E2 in E1. injection E1 as E. exact E.
    + (* both occurrences are the left component *)
      assert (Hl1 : record_has T { A >: W1 <: W1 }).
      { inversion Hrec1; subst.
        - assumption.
        - exfalso. apply En.
          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
      assert (Hl2 : record_has T { A >: W2 <: W2 }).
      { inversion Hrec2; subst.
        - assumption.
        - exfalso. apply En.
          match goal with HR : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ =>
            pose proof (record_has_rcd_inv HR) as E; rewrite <- E; simpl; reflexivity end. }
      eapply IHHrt; eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exact semantic interfaces isolating the provenance half.             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* (I1) Every record-typed path has a precise flow, flow-shaped output. *)
Definition path_flow_exists_HInv : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists R U, G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U /\ flow_shape U.

(* (I2) Precision soundness: flow output subtyping every ordinary type. *)
Definition flow_sound_HInv : Prop :=
  forall γ G p R U T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> G ⊢ U <: T.

(* (I3) Tight type-member extraction from a record view. *)
Definition flow_typ_member_inv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
    HInv γ G ->
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    exists W,
      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces :
  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
  flow_sound_HInv ->
  flow_typ_member_inv ->
  typ_member_common_bound.
Proof.
  intros HF HS HM γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
  destruct (HF γ G p0 (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) Hi H1) as [R [U [Hf Hfs]]].
  assert (Hs1 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
  assert (Hs2 : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2}) by (eapply HS; eauto).
  destruct (HM γ G U A S1 T1 Hi Hfs Hs1) as [W1 [Hrt [Hhas1 [Hl1 Hu1]]]].
  destruct (HM γ G U A S2 T2 Hi Hfs Hs2) as [W2 [_ [Hhas2 [Hl2 Hu2]]]].
  assert (E : W1 = W2) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
  subst W2.
  exists W1. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_interfaces :
  path_flow_exists_HInv ->
  flow_sound_HInv ->
  flow_typ_member_inv ->
  alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intros HF HS HM.
  apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_interfaces; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The canonical-bound interface matching the structural Good payload.  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The Good invariant for a record type should carry, for each type     *)
(* member [A], a canonical tight bound [W] (from the actual record_dec  *)
(* / flow provenance: for an actual [dec_typ] W = L = U).  The payload  *)
(* must say that *every* record view [p0 : rcd{A>:S<:T}] of that path  *)
(* brackets the same [W].  Then the coherence residual is immediate.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition canonical_member_bound : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p0:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    exists W, forall S T,
      G ⊢ trm_path p0 : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
      G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical :
  canonical_member_bound -> typ_member_common_bound.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G p0 A S1 T1 S2 T2 Hi H1 H2.
  destruct (HC γ G p0 A Hi) as [W HW].
  destruct (HW S1 T1 H1) as [Hl1 Hu1].
  destruct (HW S2 T2 H2) as [Hl2 Hu2].
  exists W. split; [split; assumption | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_canonical :
  canonical_member_bound -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intros HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical. exact HC.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* G. Type-member extraction for the *trans-free* subtyping relation.  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* This is the record-target analogue of [subtyp1_all_domain]: in the  *)
(* non-transitive fragment the only rules producing a type-member      *)
(* record are refl, subtyp_typ, the two and-projections and the        *)
(* singleton replacements, and each case is explicit.  The remaining   *)
(* (full [subtyp]) difficulty is exactly transitivity elimination for  *)
(* record targets, which the runtime/flow provenance would supply.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_rcd_targets : forall p q (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
  repl_typ p q U (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) ->
  exists D, U = typ_rcd D /\ repl_dec p q D {A >: S <: T}.
Proof.
  intros p q U A S T H. dependent destruction H.
  - eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma repl_dec_typ_targets : forall p q (D:dec) (A:typ_label) S T,
  repl_dec p q D {A >: S <: T} ->
  (exists S0, D = {A >: S0 <: T} /\ repl_typ p q S0 S) \/
  (exists T0, D = {A >: S <: T0} /\ repl_typ p q T0 T).
Proof.
  intros p q D A S T H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
  - right. eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma record_dec_typ_eq : forall (D:dec) (A:typ_label) S T,
  D = {A >: S <: T} -> record_dec D -> S = T.
Proof. intros. subst. inversion H0; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_type_rcd_of_dec : forall (D:dec), record_dec D -> record_type (typ_rcd D).
Proof.
  intros D Hdec. exists (\{label_of_dec D}). apply rt_one; [assumption | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma record_dec_of_record_type_rcd : forall (D:dec),
  record_type (typ_rcd D) -> record_dec D.
Proof. intros D [ls H]. exact (@record_dec_of_rt_rcd D ls H). Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bot_absurd : flow_shape typ_bot -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. dependent destruction H.
  match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ =>
    destruct Hr as [ls Hr0]; inversion Hr0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_path_absurd : forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
  flow_shape (p ↓ A) -> False.
Proof.
  intros p A H. dependent destruction H.
  match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ =>
    destruct Hr as [ls Hr0]; inversion Hr0 end.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp1_typ_member_inv : forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) S T,
  flow_shape U ->
  subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd {A >: S <: T}) ->
  exists W,
    record_type U /\ record_has U {A >: W <: W} /\
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros G U A S T Hfs Hsub.
  remember (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) as R eqn:ER.
  revert A S T Hfs ER.
  induction Hsub; intros A0 S0 T0 Hfs ER.
  - (* subtyp1_top *) discriminate ER.
  - (* subtyp1_bot *) exfalso. exact (flow_shape_bot_absurd Hfs).
  - (* subtyp1_refl *)
    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt) as Hdec.
    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
    + apply rh_one.
    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp1_and11 *)
    subst T. dependent destruction Hfs.
    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
    pose proof (@record_type_and_l (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) U Hrt) as Hrt1.
    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt1) as Hdec.
    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
    + apply rh_andl. apply rh_one.
    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp1_and12 *)
    subst U. dependent destruction Hfs.
    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.
    pose proof (@record_type_and_r T (typ_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0}) Hrt) as Hrt2.
    pose proof (@record_dec_of_record_type_rcd {A0 >: S0 <: T0} Hrt2) as Hdec.
    assert (E : S0 = T0) by (eapply record_dec_typ_eq; [reflexivity | exact Hdec]).
    subst T0. exists S0. split; [exact Hrt |]. split.
    + apply rh_andr. apply rh_one.
    + split; apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* subtyp1_and2 *) discriminate ER.
  - (* subtyp1_fld *) discriminate ER.
  - (* subtyp1_typ *)
    injection ER as EA ES ET. subst A0. subst S0. subst T0.
    dependent destruction Hfs.
    match goal with Hr : record_type _ |- _ => rename Hr into Hrt end.

| ty_let : forall L G t u T U,

      G & x ~ T ⊢ open_trm x u : U) ->

| ty_sngl : forall G p q T,

with ty_def : var -> fields -> ctx -> def -> dec -> Prop :=

| subtyp_top: forall G T,

| subtyp_trans: forall G S T U,

| subtyp_and11: forall G T U,

Definition subst_var (z: var) (y: var) (x: var): var :=
  If x = z then y else x.

Definition subst_var_p (z: var) (p: path) (x: var): path :=
  If x = z then p else (pvar x).

Definition subst_avar (z: var) (p: path) (x: avar) : path :=
  match x with
  | avar_b i => p_sel (avar_b i) nil
  | avar_f y => subst_var_p z p y
  end.

Definition subst_path (z: var) (q: path) (p: path) : path :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => sel_fields (subst_avar z q x) bs
  end.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (p: path) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z p D)
  | T1 ∧ T2        => subst_typ z p T1 ∧ subst_typ z p T2
  | q ↓ L          => subst_path z p q ↓ L
  | μ T            => μ (subst_typ z p T)
  | ∀(T) U         => ∀ (subst_typ z p T) subst_typ z p U
  | {{ q }}        => {{ subst_path z p q }}
  end
with subst_dec (z: var) (p: path) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | {A >: T <: U} => {A >: subst_typ z p T <: subst_typ z p U}
  | {a ⦂ U}        => {a ⦂ subst_typ z p U }
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: path) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => trm_val (subst_val z u v)
  | trm_path p       => trm_path (subst_path z u p)
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_path z u x1) (subst_path z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  end
with subst_val (z: var) (u: path) (v: val) : val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds  => ν(subst_typ z u T) subst_defs z u ds
  | λ(T) t   => λ(subst_typ z u T) subst_trm z u t
  end
with subst_def (z: var) (u: path) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (subst_typ z u T)
  | { a := t }  => { a := subst_defrhs z u t }
  end

  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end

  match drhs with

Definition is_arrow T := exists S U, T = ∀(S) U.

Inductive ResCore (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rc_lam p v S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv v ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v v : S0 ->
    G ⊢ S0 <: A ->
    is_arrow A ->
    ResCore γ G p A
| rc_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
    p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
    binds x (μ Vc) G ->
    C = G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc ->
    DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
    record_type T0 ->
    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    ResCore γ G p U
| rc_alias p q :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->
    ResCore γ G p {{ q }}.

Parameter res_field : forall γ G p a U,
  HInv γ G -> ResCore γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> ResCore γ G (p • a) U.

Lemma flow_res : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->
  forall p S U, G ⊢! p : S ⪼ U -> ResCore γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi p S U Hf.
  induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    dependent destruction Hval.
    + (* lambda *) Show.
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L); exact H.
      * apply subtyp_refl.
      * exists Sarg, Tres; reflexivity.
    + (* object *) apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := T0) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0)
                               (bs := nil) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * apply lookup_var. exact Hv.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact H0.
      * reflexivity.
      * apply defs_at_DefsTyped. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hi))) x T0 ds H0 Hv).
      * inversion Hiner; subst. exists ls. assumption.
      * apply pf_bind; auto.
  - (* fld *) apply res_field with (a := a) (U := U).
    + exact Hi.
    + apply IHHf.
  - (* open *) simpl in IHHf.
    destruct IHHf as [pv Hvpe S0 HHsub Harr | pv x Vc C bs T0 ds Uobj Hlook Ep HbC HC HD Hrt Hflow | pv q Hlook].
    + (* lam *) destruct Harr as [Sa Ta EA]. discriminate EA.
    + (* obj *) apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := C) (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact Hlook.
      * exact Ep.
      * exact HbC.
      * exact HC.
      * exact HD.
      * exact Hrt.
      * pose proof (flow_mu_same Hrt Hflow) as E. subst U0.
        apply (@pf_open p G (μ T0) T0 Hflow).
    + (* alias *) discriminate.
  - (* and1 *) simpl in IHHf.
    destruct IHHf as [pv Hvpe S0 HHsub Harr | pv x Vc C bs T0 ds Uobj Hlook Ep HbC HC HD Hrt Hflow | pv q Hlook].
    + destruct Harr as [Sa Ta EA]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := C) (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact Hlook.
      * exact Ep.
      * exact HbC.
      * exact HC.
      * exact HD.
      * exact Hrt.
      * apply (@pf_and1 p G T U1 U2 Hflow).
    + discriminate.
  - (* and2 *) simpl in IHHf.
    destruct IHHf as [pv Hvpe S0 HHsub Harr | pv x Vc C bs T0 ds Uobj Hlook Ep HbC HC HD Hrt Hflow | pv q Hlook].
    + destruct Harr as [Sa Ta EA]. discriminate EA.
    + apply rc_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := C) (bs := bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds).
      * exact Hlook.
      * exact Ep.
      * exact HbC.
      * exact HC.
      * exact HD.
      * exact Hrt.
      * apply (@pf_and2 p G T U1 U2 Hflow).
    + discriminate.
Qed.

Definitions:

HInv0 γ G:
- γ ⫶ G (well_typed)
- inert G
- entries: forall x T v, binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T
- defs_at: forall x T0 ds, binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν T0 ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds

PrecAll G := forall p T, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Prov γ G := forall p A, (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : rcd{A>:S<:T}) -> exists W, G ⊢ trm_path p : rcd{A>:W<:W} /\ (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : rcd{A>:S<:T} -> G⊢S<:W /\ G⊢W<:T).

HInvS γ G := HInv0 γ G /\ PrecAll G /\ Prov γ G /\ wf G.

Empty: HInv0 empty = well_typed_empty, inert_empty, entries trivial, defs trivial. PrecAll empty: any path typed in empty? ty_var requires binds x T empty impossible. So all typing derivations... need to show exists U empty ⊢!! p:U for any G⊢trm_path p:T. This is not trivial: with empty context there are no bindings, but ty_rcd_intro/ty_and_intro etc can still derive? For example `empty ⊢ trm_path p : rcd{a⦂⊤}` requires `empty ⊢ trm_path p•a : ⊤`, which by ty_sub can come from anything below ⊤... e.g. ty_new_elim from p : rcd{a⦂⊤}; this is circular. Could there be no typing at all in empty? Let's see. Without bindings, base cases ty_var impossible; ty_new_intro/let produce trm_val/let, not paths. Path terms only via ty_var, ty_sngl, ty_path_elim, ty_rec_intro/elim, ty_and_intro, ty_rcd_intro, ty_new_elim, ty_sub. All path-typing rules eventually need ty_var? Not necessarily: ty_rec_intro of ty_rec_elim of ty_var. But maybe ty_and_intro of p:⊤ (from ty_sub of p:rcd...) circular. Could a cyclic derivation without ty_var exist? For a path p to be typed at all, the derivation is finite and the only "source" non-structural rules are ty_var and ty_sngl (needs p:{{q}} premise). ty_sngl needs p:{{q}} from ty_var or ty_path_elim etc. ty_path_elim needs p:{{q}}, again. So ultimately a path typing must include ty_var at the base? Hmm, but path p can be p•a; then ty_new_elim p•a needs p:rcd{...}; for p:rcd intro needs p•a. Cyclic. So yes, likely empty ⊢ trm_path p : T is impossible. But the invariant PrecAll is vacuous at empty if no path typing exists. To prove forall p T, empty ⊢ p:T -> exists U, precise: we can do induction on typing derivation and derive contradiction or use precise. Actually maybe easier: prove a general "in empty context, no path typing" lemma? Or prove PrecAll holds in empty via inversion: any path typing in empty implies False? Let's test. Could there be a derivation of path typing in empty not using ty_var? Consider trm_path (p_sel (avar_b 0) nil) : ⊤ via... ty_sub of anything. Base path rules: ty_var (needs binds) no; ty_new_elim needs p:a typing; ty_rcd_intro needs p•a; ty_and_intro needs two; ty_rec_intro needs open p T; ty_rec_elim needs μ; ty_sngl needs singleton; ty_path_elim needs singleton. All circular along path structure; but p•a is longer path. Induction on typing derivation: all premises' subject terms are either same path or longer, but derivation size decreases. Eventually leaves are ty_var? Actually a derivation tree is finite; leaves are rules with no typing premises: ty_var only (among path-subject rules). So yes, every path typing has a ty_var leaf along its branch. But context empty has no binds, so any ty_var impossible. So by induction, empty ⊢ trm_path p:T is False. Wait, ty_sngl has premise trm_path p:{{q}} and trm_path q:T; both path. ty_var is only base. So indeed no path typing in empty.

But careful: typ context "empty" is Coq empty env; binds impossible. So yes.

Prove lemma `empty_path_typing_absurd : forall p T, (empty:ctx) ⊢ trm_path p : T -> False` by induction on typing. This is easy. Then PrecAll empty trivial.

So HInvS_empty is easy.

Now HInvS_push. This is the meat. We have HInvS γ G, x # G, x # γ, G ⊢!v v : S, and newdefs for ν case (S=μT0 and defs_at).

1. HInv0:

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
Proof.
  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros a t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_pvar_trm :
  (forall (t:trm) k x, open_rec_trm_p k (pvar x) t = open_rec_trm k x t) /\
  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros k x. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T 0 x). Qed.
Lemma open_defs_pvar : forall (ds:defs) x, open_defs_p (pvar x) ds = open_defs x ds.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 open_pvar_trm)))). Qed.
Lemma open_path_pvar : forall (q:path) x, open_path_p (pvar x) q = open_path x q.
Proof. intros. apply open_pvar_path. Qed.

Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
  γ ⫶ G /\
  inert G /\
  wf G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Parameter wf_push_cond : forall γ G x S v,
  HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
            exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,
  G ⊢!v v : T -> x # G -> G & x ~ T ⊢!v v : T.
Proof. intros G v T x H Hx. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v T H x T Hx). Qed.

Lemma HInv_empty : HInv empty empty.
Proof.
  unfold HInv. split; [apply well_typed_empty|]. split; [apply inert_empty|]. split; [apply wfe_empty|]. split.
  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - intros x T0 ds Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
Qed.

  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).
    + exact Hinert.
    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
    + exact HxG.
  - apply wfe_push.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact HxG.
    + assert (Hi : HInv γ G) by (unfold HInv; split; [exact Hwt|]; split; [exact Hinert|]; split; [exact Hwf|]; split; [exact Hentries|exact Hdefs]).
      exact (@wf_push_cond γ G x S v Hi HxG Hval Hnewdefs).
  - intros y T' v' HbG Hbγ.
    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * subst. exact (ty_val_p_weaken_single Hval HxG).
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | assumption ].

Definition bind_sub_trm := proj1 bind_sub_ty.

Definition StepOK (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) :=
  norm_form t \/
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ G' = G & H.

Parameter app_step : forall γ G p q S T,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.

Lemma well_typed_ok : forall γ G, γ ⫶ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma HInv_ok : forall γ G, HInv γ G -> ok G.
Proof. intros γ G H. destruct H as [Hwt _]. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G Hwt). Qed.

Lemma weaken_sub_ctx : forall G H S U,
  ok (G & H) -> G ⊢ S <: U -> G & H ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros S U Hok Hsub. rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hsub.
  - intros H' w S0 IH S U Hok Hsub.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    apply weaken_sub_last; auto.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_insert_ctx : forall G H x T t U,
  ok (G & H) -> x # (G & H) ->
  G & x ~ T ⊢ t : U -> G & H & x ~ T ⊢ t : U.
Proof.
  intros G H. pattern H. apply env_ind.
  - intros x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G). exact Hty.
  - intros H' w S0 IH x T t U Hok Hx Hty.
    rewrite concat_assoc in Hok.
    apply ok_push_inv in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok' Hw].
    pose proof Hx as Hx0.
    rewrite dom_concat in Hx0. apply notin_union_r in Hx0.
    destruct Hx0 as [HxG HxRest].
    rewrite dom_concat in HxRest. apply notin_union_r in HxRest.
    destruct HxRest as [HxH' HxwS].
    rewrite dom_single in HxwS. apply notin_singleton_r in HxwS.
    assert (Hx' : x # (G & H')).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; auto. }
    assert (Hxw : x <> w) by auto.
    assert (Hty' : (G & H') & x ~ T ⊢ t : U).
    { apply (IH x T t U); auto. }
    rewrite concat_assoc.
    assert (Hw' : w # ((G & H') & x ~ T)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. auto. }
    exact (@weaken_trm ((G & H') & x ~ T) t U Hty' (G & H') (x ~ T) w S0 eq_refl Hw').
Qed.

Lemma step : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T -> StepOK γ G t T.
Proof.
  intros γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Hty0. revert γ0 Hi0.
  induction Hty0 using ty_trm_ind; intros γ Hi.
  - (* ty_var *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros. right.
    apply app_step with (S:=S); auto.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) left. apply nf_val.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) left. apply nf_path.
  - (* ty_let *) intros. destruct (IHHty0 γ Hi) as [Hnf | (γ' & G' & Hext & u' & Hred & Hi' & Hty' & Heq)].
    + destruct Hnf as [p Hp | v Hv].
      * (* let-path *)
        right.
        (* choose fresh x *)
        set (Lx := L \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T \u fv_typ U \u fv_trm u).
        destruct (var_fresh Lx) as [x Hx].
        assert (HxL : x \notin L).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxG : x # G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxctx : x \notin fv_ctx_types G).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxT : x \notin fv_typ T).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (HxU : x \notin fv_typ U).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_trm u).
        { intro E. apply Hx. unfold Lx. solve_union. }
        pose proof (ty_path_named Hty0) as Hnp.
        pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
        pose proof (proj1 subst_ty) as Hsubst_trm.

Lemma ty_val_p_ty : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> G ⊢ trm_val v : T.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply ty_all_intro with (L := L); auto.
  - apply ty_new_intro with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_val_p_inert : forall G (v:val) T, G ⊢!v v : T -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply inert_typ_all.
  - destruct (var_fresh (L \u fv_typ T)) as [x Hx].
    apply notin_union_r in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxT].
    destruct (ty_defs_record_typ (H x HxL)) as [ls Hrt].
    apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls).
    eapply record_typ_open_var; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_val_inv_inert : forall G (v:val) T,
  G ⊢ trm_val v : T -> exists S, G ⊢!v v : S /\ inert_typ S.
Proof.
  intros G v T H. destruct (ty_val_inv H) as [[T1 [T2 [t [Ev [Hp _]]]]] | [T0 [ds [Ev [Hp _]]]]].
  - subst. exists (∀(T1) T2). split; auto. apply ty_val_p_inert in Hp; auto.
  - subst. exists (μ T0). split; auto. apply ty_val_p_inert in Hp; auto.
Qed.

  forall x S, x # G -> G & x ~ S ⊢!v v : T.

    + apply H. auto.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l.
      * auto.
      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hxz. rewrite in_singleton in Hxz. apply Hzx. symmetry. exact Hxz.
  - (* new *) intros x S Hx. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
    apply notin_union_r in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzx].

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Semantic analysis of the six per-constructor facts (agent_master).  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Contents.                                                           *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (1) A correction: the naive "bottom inversion"                        *)
(*          G ⊢ S <: ⊥  ->  S = ⊥                                    *)
(*      is FALSE (counterexample [⊥ ∧ ⊤ <: ⊥], which also shows that  *)
(*      fact 6 is *not* vacuous).                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (2) Unconditional facts:                                            *)
(*      - the bottom instances of facts 1-4 follow from their arrow     *)
(*        instances by composing with [⊥ <: arrow];                     *)
(*      - the easy direction of fact 6 (a component below ⊥ yields the  *)
(*        intersection below ⊥);                                       *)
(*      - replacement of an intersection is an intersection (used in    *)
(*        the trans-free classification).                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (3) The trans-free fragment [subtyp1]: a single non-trans rule     *)
(*      never turns a rigid source into an arrow, and the intersection  *)
(*      split holds.  These are fully unconditional (agent_suball).     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*  (4) The exact frontier: the six facts are equivalent to             *)
(*      [sel_lower_class ∧ and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow).  We also   *)
(*      isolate the runtime provenance statement that the selection     *)
(*      case requires and show that, together with a lower/upper        *)
(*      inversion, it yields [sel_lower_class].  The construction of    *)
(*      that provenance from [HInv] (PathObject/DefsTyped) is not       *)
(*      carried out here; it is the remaining semantic obligation.      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. The naive bottom-source inversion is FALSE.                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* The intersection [⊥ ∧ ⊤] is below [⊥] by [subtyp_and11], but is not
   syntactically [⊥].  (This is the step that makes fact 6, the
   intersection split at [⊥], non-vacuous.) *)

Lemma subtyp_and11_bot_top : (empty:ctx) ⊢ ⊥ ∧ ⊤ <: ⊥.
Proof. apply subtyp_and11. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_bot_source_false :
  ~ (forall G S, G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> S = ⊥).
Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (H empty (⊥ ∧ ⊤) (@subtyp_and11_bot_top)) as E.
  discriminate E.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. Unconditional facts.                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Composing [S <: ⊥] with [⊥ <: A] yields any arrow supertype.  Hence
   "no arrow supertype" implies "no bottom supertype": the bottom
   instances of facts 1-4 are consequences of their arrow instances. *)

Lemma no_bot_of_no_arrow : forall G S,
  (forall A, is_arrow A -> G ⊢ S <: A -> False) ->
  G ⊢ S <: ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros G S Hna Hbot.
  eapply Hna.
  - exists ⊤, ⊤. reflexivity.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hbot | apply subtyp_bot].
Qed.

(* The same for the four rigid source shapes, packaged together.  This
   shows that once the four arrow facts are known, the four bot facts
   come for free. *)

Lemma pointwise_rigid_bot_of_arrow :
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) ->
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> V = ⊥ -> False).
Proof.
  intros Htop Hrcd Hbnd Hsngl.
  split; [|split; [|split]].
  - intros γ G V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G ⊤
             (fun A Har Hsa => Htop γ G A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G D V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G (typ_rcd D)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hrcd γ G D A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G T0 V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G (μ T0)
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hbnd γ G T0 A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
  - intros γ G q V Hi Hsub E. subst V.
    exact (@no_bot_of_no_arrow G ({{ q }})
             (fun A Har Hsa => Hsngl γ G q A Hi Hsa Har) Hsub).
Qed.

(* The easy direction of fact 6: if a component is below [⊥], so is the
   intersection.  In particular fact 6 has genuine content (it cannot be
   discharged by a source-shape inversion). *)

Lemma and_bot_of_component_l : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T1 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and11 | exact H].
Qed.

Lemma and_bot_of_component_r : forall G T1 T2,
  G ⊢ T2 <: ⊥ -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: ⊥.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 H.
  eapply subtyp_trans; [apply subtyp_and12 | exact H].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. The trans-free fragment [subtyp1].                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Replacement of an intersection is again an intersection. *)
Lemma repl_typ_and_inv : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> forall A1 A2, T = A1 ∧ A2 ->
  exists B1 B2, T' = B1 ∧ B2.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. induction H; intros A1 A2 E.
  - (* rrcd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rand1 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rand2 *) injection E as E1 E2. subst. eexists _, _; reflexivity.
  - (* rpath *) discriminate E.
  - (* rbnd *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall1 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rall2 *) discriminate E.
  - (* rsngl *) discriminate E.
Qed.

(* One trans-free step never produces an arrow from a rigid source. *)
Lemma subtyp1_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) left. exact Har.
  - (* and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sel1 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The intersection split for one trans-free step.  The only cases are
   the two projections, which pick the corresponding component. *)
Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp1 G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp1_ind;
    intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    destruct (@repl_typ_and_inv p q T T' H1 A1 A2 EA) as [B1 [B2 ET']].
    subst T'. destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* sngl_qp *)

  - (* sel1 *) discriminate EA.
  - (* all *) discriminate EA.

Lemma subtyp1_and_arrow_split : forall G T1 T2 U,
  subtyp1 G (T1 ∧ T2) U -> is_arrow U ->
  G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp1_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* The same one-step classification for the star generator
   [subtyp_step] (agent_suball), which is what the decomposition
   [subtyp_star_step] produces.  No premise (typing or subtyping) is
   inspected: the shape of the conclusion alone determines the case. *)

Lemma subtyp_step_arrow_shape : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  is_arrow S \/ S = ⊥ \/ (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
  (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2).
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har.
  - (* st_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot *) right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* st_refl *) left. exact Har.
  - (* st_and11 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* st_and12 *) right. right. right. exists T, U. split; reflexivity.
  - (* st_and2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_fld *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_typ *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sngl_pq *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* st_sngl_qp *) left. eapply repl_typ_arrow_l; eassumption.
  - (* st_sel2 *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_sel1 *) right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - (* st_all *) left. exists S1, T1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_step_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* st_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* st_refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* st_and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* st_and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
