(* ================================================================== *)
(* The four HInv-aware subtyping facts blocking Q/Q2.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Note: [rcd_no_arrow] and [bnd_no_arrow] below are the *existing*     *)
(* agent_q.v residual Definitions.  [and_arrow_split_H] is the         *)
(* HInv-carrying variant of agent_q's HInv-free [and_arrow_split]      *)
(* (the HInv-free version is not provable).                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition and_arrow_split_H : Prop :=
  forall γ G T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: U -> is_arrow U ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.

(* A uniform, complete classification of the sources of an arrow          *)
(* supertype.  It is exactly the statement that the four facts record,    *)
(* for the four "rigid" source heads, plus the two remaining source kinds *)
(* (bottom / path selections) that can legitimately sit below an arrow.   *)
Definition ArrowSrc (G:ctx) (S U:typ) : Prop :=
    is_arrow S \/
    S = ⊥ \/
    (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
    (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 /\ (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U)).

Definition arrow_source_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G S U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Disjointness helpers.                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sngl_not_arrow : forall (p:path), ~ is_arrow ({{ p }}).
Proof. intros p [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_arrow : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rcd_not_arrow : forall D, ~ is_arrow (typ_rcd D).
Proof. intros D [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma and_not_arrow : forall T U, ~ is_arrow (T ∧ U).
Proof. intros T U [S [U' E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bot_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊥). 
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma top_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊤).
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma path_not_arrow : forall (p:path) (A:typ_label), ~ is_arrow (p ↓ A).
Proof. intros p A [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

(* A source of a conjunction supertype can be split, given the class. *)
Lemma and_split_of_class : arrow_source_class -> and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) U Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE Hsplit]]]]]].
  - exfalso. exact (and_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - injection HE as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> rcd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G a S V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> bnd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> forall γ G q V,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Shape of [repl_typ] targets: arrow targets come from arrow sources, *)
(* and [⊥] is never a replacement target.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_arrow_l : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> is_arrow T' -> is_arrow T.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H; intros Har.
  - exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (bnd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exists T1, U. reflexivity.
  - exists U, T1. reflexivity.
  - exact (False_ind _ (sngl_not_arrow Har)).
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_not_bot : forall p q T,
  repl_typ p q T ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros p q T H. dependent destruction H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lifting an arrow-source classification forward along a subtyping    *)
(* step of the target.                                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
  - left. exact Harr.
  - right. left. exact Hbot.
  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
  - right. right. right. subst S.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Hsplit as [Hs | Hs]; [left | right];
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The two exact residual "target-lift" facts.                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts :
  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift ->
  forall γ G S U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros HA HB γ0 G0 S0 U0 Hi0 Hsub0 Har0.
  revert γ0 Hi0 Har0.
  induction Hsub0 using subtyp_ind; intros γ Hi Har.
  - (* top *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E]; [exact (False_ind _ (top_not_arrow Har)) | discriminate E].
  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Har.
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact E.
  - (* trans *) 
    pose proof (IHHsub0_2 γ Hi Har) as Hclass.

      exact (HB γ G S T1 T2 U Hi Hsub0_1 Hsplit Har).

    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
    + subst T. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists (⊥), U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *)
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.
    + subst U. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, (⊥). split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.

  - (* rbnd *) discriminate E.

Lemma subtyp_step_and_arrow_split_gen : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U ->
  forall T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 -> G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H; intros Har A1 A2 EA.
  - (* st_top *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; discriminate E.
  - (* st_bot *) discriminate EA.
  - (* st_refl *) destruct Har as [S0 [T0 E]]; rewrite EA in E; discriminate E.
  - (* st_and11 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
    left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* st_and12 *) injection EA as E1 E2. subst A1 A2.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The four HInv-aware subtyping facts blocking Q/Q2.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Note: [rcd_no_arrow] and [bnd_no_arrow] below are the *existing*     *)
(* agent_q.v residual Definitions.  [and_arrow_split_H] is the         *)
(* HInv-carrying variant of agent_q's HInv-free [and_arrow_split]      *)
(* (the HInv-free version is not provable).                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition and_arrow_split_H : Prop :=
  forall γ G T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: U -> is_arrow U ->
    G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U.

(* A uniform, complete classification of the sources of an arrow          *)
(* supertype.  It is exactly the statement that the four facts record,    *)
(* for the four "rigid" source heads, plus the two remaining source kinds *)
(* (bottom / path selections) that can legitimately sit below an arrow.   *)
Definition ArrowSrc (G:ctx) (S U:typ) : Prop :=
    is_arrow S \/
    S = ⊥ \/
    (exists (p:path) (A:typ_label), S = p ↓ A) \/
    (exists T1 T2, S = T1 ∧ T2 /\ (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U)).

Definition arrow_source_class : Prop :=
  forall γ G S U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Disjointness helpers.                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sngl_not_arrow : forall (p:path), ~ is_arrow ({{ p }}).
Proof. intros p [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_arrow : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma rcd_not_arrow : forall D, ~ is_arrow (typ_rcd D).
Proof. intros D [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma and_not_arrow : forall T U, ~ is_arrow (T ∧ U).
Proof. intros T U [S [U' E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bot_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊥). 
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma top_not_arrow : ~ is_arrow (⊤).
Proof. intros [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma path_not_arrow : forall (p:path) (A:typ_label), ~ is_arrow (p ↓ A).
Proof. intros p A [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

(* A source of a conjunction supertype can be split, given the class. *)
Lemma and_split_of_class : arrow_source_class -> and_arrow_split_H.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T1 T2 U Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (T1 ∧ T2) U Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE Hsplit]]]]]].
  - exfalso. exact (and_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - injection HE as E1 E2. subst V1. subst V2. exact Hsplit.
Qed.

Lemma rcd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> rcd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G a S V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (rcd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> bnd_no_arrow.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T0 V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G (μ T0) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (bnd_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

Lemma sngl_no_arrow_of_class : arrow_source_class -> forall γ G q V,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G q V Hi Hsub Har.
  destruct (HC γ G ({{ q }}) V Hi Hsub Har) as
    [Harr | [Hbot | [[p [A HT]] | [V1 [V2 [HE _]]]]]].
  - exact (sngl_not_arrow Harr).
  - discriminate Hbot.
  - discriminate HT.
  - discriminate HE.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Shape of [repl_typ] targets: arrow targets come from arrow sources, *)
(* and [⊥] is never a replacement target.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma repl_typ_arrow_l : forall p q T T',
  repl_typ p q T T' -> is_arrow T' -> is_arrow T.
Proof.
  intros p q T T' H. dependent destruction H; intros Har.
  - exact (False_ind _ (rcd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (path_not_arrow Har)).
  - exact (False_ind _ (bnd_not_arrow Har)).
  - exists T1, U. reflexivity.
  - exists U, T1. reflexivity.
  - exact (False_ind _ (sngl_not_arrow Har)).
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_not_bot : forall p q T,
  repl_typ p q T ⊥ -> False.
Proof.
  intros p q T H. dependent destruction H.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lifting an arrow-source classification forward along a subtyping    *)
(* step of the target.                                                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma ArrowSrc_lift : forall G S T U,
  ArrowSrc G S T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S T U [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | [T1 [T2 [E Hsplit]]]]]] Hsub Har.
  - left. exact Harr.
  - right. left. exact Hbot.
  - right. right. left. exact Hpath.
  - right. right. right. subst S.
    exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct Hsplit as [Hs | Hs]; [left | right];
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The two exact residual "target-lift" facts.                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* They are the selection/path-target and conjunction-target versions  *)
(* of the classification.  The path-target one is where the tight      *)
(* record-member bracket (canonical bound) has to be used; the          *)
(* conjunction-target one is where the and-projection information      *)
(* has to be transported across subtyping.                             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition path_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S (p:path) A U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Definition and_target_lift : Prop :=
  forall γ G S T1 T2 U,
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ S <: T1 ∧ T2 ->
    (G ⊢ T1 <: U \/ G ⊢ T2 <: U) ->
    (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) ->
    ArrowSrc G S U.

Lemma arrow_source_class_gen_of_lifts :
  path_target_lift -> and_target_lift ->
  forall γ G S U,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ S <: U -> (is_arrow U \/ U = ⊥) -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros HA HB γ0 G0 S0 U0 Hi0 Hsub0 Har0.
  revert γ0 Hi0 Har0.
  induction Hsub0 using subtyp_ind; intros γ Hi Har.
  - (* top *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E]; [exact (False_ind _ (top_not_arrow Har)) | discriminate E].
  - (* bot *) unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. reflexivity.
  - (* refl *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Har.
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact E.
  - (* trans *) 
    pose proof (IHHsub0_2 γ Hi Har) as Hclass.
    destruct Hclass as [HarrT | [HbotT | [HpathT | [T1 [T2 [ET Hsplit]]]]]].
    + (* T arrow: use IH on the first premise *)
      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_introl HarrT)) as HC1.
      eapply ArrowSrc_lift; [exact HC1 | exact Hsub0_2 | exact Har].
    + (* T = bot: use IH on first premise at target bot *)
      subst T.
      pose proof (IHHsub0_1 γ Hi (or_intror eq_refl)) as HC1.
      eapply ArrowSrc_lift; [exact HC1 | exact Hsub0_2 | exact Har].
    + (* T path: residual HA *)
      destruct HpathT as [p [A ET]]. subst T.
      exact (HA γ G S p A U Hi Hsub0_1 Hsub0_2 Har).
    + (* T conjunction: residual HB *)
      subst T.
      exact (HB γ G S T1 T2 U Hi Hsub0_1 Hsplit Har).
  - (* and11 *) 
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
    + subst T. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists (⊥), U. split; [reflexivity|]. left. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and12 *)
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, U. split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.
    + subst U. unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T, (⊥). split; [reflexivity|]. right. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* and2 *)
    destruct Har as [Har | E].
    + exact (False_ind _ (and_not_arrow Har)).

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh.

Lemma star_trans : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) a b c,
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. induction H1; intros H2.
  - exact H2.
  - apply star_step with (b:=b); auto.
Qed.

Lemma infseq_from_function : forall A (R:A->A->Prop) (f:nat->A),
  (forall n, R (f n) (f (S n))) -> infseq R (f 0).
Proof.
  intros A R f H. generalize 0 as n. cofix IH. intro n.
  apply infseq_step with (f (S n)); auto.
Qed.

Definition TypedState (T:typ) :=
  sig (fun s : sta * trm => exists G, G ⊢ (snd s) : T /\ HInv (fst s) G).

Definition ts_state T (a:TypedState T) : sta * trm := proj1_sig a.

Definition mkTS : forall (T:typ) (γ:sta) (t:trm) (G:ctx),
  G ⊢ t : T -> HInv γ G -> TypedState T.
Proof.
  intros T γ t G Ht Hi.
  exists (γ,t). exists G. simpl. auto.
Defined.

Lemma ts_typed : forall T (a:TypedState T),
  exists G, G ⊢ (snd (ts_state a)) : T /\ HInv (fst (ts_state a)) G.
Proof. intros T [s Hs]. exact Hs. Qed.

Definition next_rel T (a b:TypedState T) : Prop :=
  red (ts_state a) (ts_state b) \/
  (norm_form (snd (ts_state a)) /\ b = a).

Lemma next_exists : forall T,
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall a : TypedState T, exists b, next_rel a b.
Proof.
  intros T Hstep [[γ t] [G [Ht Hi]]].
  destruct (Hstep γ G t Hi Ht) as [Hnf | [γ' [G' [t' [Hred [Hi' Ht']]]]]].
  - exists (@mkTS T γ t G Ht Hi). right. split; auto.
  - exists (@mkTS T γ' t' G' Ht' Hi'). left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma terminate_or_diverge :
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/
     exists γ' G' t', red (γ,t) (γ',t') /\ HInv γ' G' /\ G' ⊢ t' : T) ->
  forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
    infseq red (γ,t) \/
    exists γ' (u:trm) G', star red (γ,t) (γ',u) /\ norm_form u /\ G' ⊢ u : T /\ HInv γ' G'.
Proof.
  intros Hstep γ0 G0 t0 T0 Hi0 Ht0.
  destruct (classic (infseq red (γ0,t0))) as [Hinf|Hnin].
  - left; auto.
  - destruct (classic (exists a : TypedState T0,
        star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state a) /\ norm_form (snd (ts_state a)))) as [Hterm|Hnoterm].
    + right. destruct Hterm as [a [Hstar Hnf]].
      destruct (ts_state a) as [γs us] eqn:E. simpl in Hstar, Hnf.
      destruct (ts_typed a) as [G' [Hty Hi]].
      rewrite E in Hty, Hi. simpl in Hty, Hi.
      exists γs, us, G'. auto.
    + exfalso. apply Hnin.
      set (a0 := @mkTS T0 γ0 t0 G0 Ht0 Hi0 : TypedState T0).
      destruct (@functional_choice (TypedState T0) (TypedState T0) (@next_rel T0) (@next_exists T0 (fun γ G t Hi Ht => @Hstep γ G t T0 Hi Ht))) as [f Hf].
      assert (Hstar : forall n, star red (γ0,t0) (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      { intro n. induction n as [|n IH].
        - simpl. apply star_refl.
        - simpl. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hred | [Hnf _]].
          + apply star_trans with (b := ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)).
            * exact IH.
            * apply star_step with (b := ts_state (f (Nat.iter n f a0))).
              -- exact Hred.
              -- apply star_refl.
          + exfalso. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; auto. }
      assert (Hnon : forall n, ~ norm_form (snd (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)))).
      { intros n Hnf. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; [apply Hstar|auto]. }
      assert (Hred : forall n, red (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)) (ts_state (Nat.iter (S n) f a0))).
      { intro n. destruct (Hf (Nat.iter n f a0)) as [Hr | [Hnf _]].
        - exact Hr.
        - exfalso. exact (Hnon n Hnf). }
      apply (@infseq_from_function (sta*trm) red (fun n => ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      intro n. exact (Hred n).
Qed.

  - exists (@mkTS T γ t G Ht Hi). right. split; auto.

Lemma terminate_or_diverge :
  (forall (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
     norm_form t \/

  destruct (classic (infseq red (γ0,t0))) as [Hinf|Hnin].

      destruct (ts_typed a) as [G' [Hty Hi]].

              -- exact Hred.

          + exfalso. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; auto. }
      assert (Hnon : forall n, ~ norm_form (snd (ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0)))).
      { intros n Hnf. apply Hnoterm. exists (Nat.iter n f a0). split; [apply Hstar|auto]. }

      apply (@infseq_from_function (sta*trm) red (fun n => ts_state (Nat.iter n f a0))).
      intro n. exact (Hred n).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified pieces toward bridge 1
   (ordinary arrow path typing -> precise3 at a flow-shaped subtype).
   The raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] in agent_bridge.v is refuted by
   counter_bridge2.v; the HInv-aware assembly is in aux_bridge_fixed.v. *)

(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.

(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
  exists T. split; [|split].
  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
Qed.

(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
  - apply fs_all.
  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
Qed.

(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
Proof.
  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
Qed.

(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
Proof.
  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
  inversion Hv.
Qed.

(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.

(* Two facts isolated as the remaining obstructions for bridge 1. *)

(* (O1) Record-field extraction from a flow-shaped subtype of a record.
   Needed by [ty_new_elim]: from a flow output U with U <: {a : T}, recover
   a field declaration V of U (so that pf_fld applies) with V <: T.  Under
   HInv this must use provenance of U (the raw version is false). *)
Definition flow_shape_field_of_sub : Prop :=
  forall γ G U a T,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
    exists V, flow_shape V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.

(* (O2) Reverse-field (record introduction) for the bridge witness.
   Needed by [ty_rcd_intro]: from a bridge witness V <: T for p•a, produce a
   flow-shaped witness W <: {a : T} for p (or a precise3 of p at such W). *)
Definition bridge_rcd_intro : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G (p•a) T ->
    exists W, G ⊢!!! p : W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}.

(* (O3) The singleton/alias refinement needed by [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]:
   a bridge witness below a singleton can be turned into a precise2 typing at
   the singleton itself. *)
Definition bridge_sngl_refine : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q,
    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

(* (Reduced goal suggested by the coordinator.) *)
Definition precise_exists_of_path_typing : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

(* (Full bridge 1, imported from agent_bridge.v.) *)
Check ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Verified precision lemmas used by the singleton/alias cases of bridge 1. *)

(* Every precise2 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
Lemma precise2_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p T U Hi H).
  - apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

(* Every precise3 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
Lemma precise3_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.

apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtrm. apply (IH Hp Hq).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
Proof.
  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. split; auto.
  - right. split; auto.
Qed.

(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* D. Conditional application-preservation step.                       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The unrestricted bridge statements in agent_bridge.v are refutable  *)
(* in non-HInv contexts (counter_bridge2.v, and the same loose-record  *)
(* / type-member selection pattern refutes the unrestricted           *)
(* arrow_open_bridge).  The corrected HInv-aware interface lives in    *)
(* aux_bridge_fixed.v.  We expose the exact residual and the assembly. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Exact residuals.  The raw, context-free bridge statements are false
   (loose record bindings give incompatible type-member views; see
   counter_bridge2.v for the analogous refutation of bridge 2).  The
   HInv-aware variants below are the correct interfaces.

   What is *proven* in this file, unconditionally:

     - repl_typ_sym       : replacement is symmetric (needed because the
                            arrow domain is contravariant);
     - repl_typ_open      : replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening
                            when the replacement paths are named;
     - subtyp1_all_domain : arrow-domain inversion for the trans-free
                            subtyping relation [subtyp1].

   What remains for the HInv-aware arrow-opening bridge is exactly the
   *coherence* of path typings at records in an inert context: a path
   [p] can be typed at two record views [rcd{A>:S1<:T1}] and
   [rcd{A>:S2<:T2}] of the same tight record, and one needs the tight
   bound [Q] with [S1 <: Q <: T2] (and its arrow structure) to compose
   the two type-selection steps.  This is the same metatheoretic content
   as the ordinary-path -> precise3 principal-typing bridge.  Without
   it, [subtyp1] is not closed under transitivity even in an inert
   context (the detour can pass through a type member whose tight bound
   is [⊤]), although such a detour cannot connect two *arrow* endpoints
   unless the tight bound is itself arrow-compatible. *)
Definition arrow_open_HInv_residual : Prop := arrow_open_HInv_bridge.

Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_HInv_residual : Prop := rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* E.  The narrow field-precision residual.                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [field_sub_closure] (agent_bridge1.v) asks: a path [p] typed at a   *)
(* record [rcd{a ⦂ S}] in an inert context has a precise2 field        *)
(* selector [p • a].  This is *weaker* than the shared ordinary-path   *)
(* precision bridge: from the ordinary typing of [p] we get an         *)
(* ordinary typing of [p • a] by [ty_new_elim], and the bridge then    *)
(* yields precise2 directly.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma field_sub_closure_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> field_sub_closure.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge C p T a S Hin Hp HT. subst T.
  record_target_classification -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Full record-shape classification, using [star subtyp1] to allow the *)
(* and-projections that a whole intersection needs.  This is the form  *)
(* required by the [ty_new_elim] premise (a term-field record).        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition record_target_classification_full : Prop :=
  forall γ G p,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R /\ record_shape R) ->
    exists U,
      PathObject γ G p U /\ record_type U /\
      (forall R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R -> record_shape R ->
         star (subtyp_step G) U R).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* [ty_var] base case facts (proven).                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma PathObject_var : forall γ G x T0 ds,
  HInv γ G ->
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ ->
  PathObject γ G (pvar x) (open_typ_p (pvar x) T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds Hi HbG Hbγ.
  destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]].
  apply po_obj with (ds := ds); auto.
  apply defs_at_DefsTyped. apply Hdefs; auto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_no_record_view : forall (T:typ),
  inert_typ T -> record_view T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T Hin [A [S [T0 E]]]. subst T. inversion Hin.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_record_view_absurd : forall G x T0,
  binds x T0 G -> inert_typ T0 -> record_view T0 -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_typ_no_record_view; eauto. Qed.

Lemma PathObject_alias_inv : forall γ G p q U,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> PathObject γ G q U -> PathObject γ G p U.
Proof. intros. apply po_alias with (q := q); auto. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Component-view bounds.  For the component-selected classification  *)
(* the source of every view is the single tight component              *)
(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}]; a trans-free view of it is exactly the bound        *)
(* bracket [S <: W <: T].                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds : forall G (A:typ_label) W S T,

(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| subtyp1_top : forall G T, subtyp1 G T typ_top
| subtyp1_bot : forall G T, subtyp1 G typ_bot T
| subtyp1_refl : forall G T, subtyp1 G T T
| subtyp1_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) T
| subtyp1_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp1 G (T ∧ U) U
| subtyp1_and2 : forall G S T U,
    subtyp1 G S T -> subtyp1 G S U -> subtyp1 G S (T ∧ U)
| subtyp1_fld : forall G T U a,
    subtyp1 G T U -> subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| subtyp1_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 -> subtyp1 G T1 T2 ->
    subtyp1 G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| subtyp1_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' ->
    subtyp1 G T T'
| subtyp1_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G S (p ↓ A)
| subtyp1_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    subtyp1 G (p ↓ A) T
| subtyp1_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    subtyp1 G S2 S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> subtyp1 (G & x ~ S2) (open_typ x T1) (open_typ x T2)) ->
    subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp1_subtyp : forall G S U, subtyp1 G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a replacement at the top-level arrow constructor. *)
Lemma repl_all_cases : forall p q (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
  repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (repl_typ p q S1 S2 /\ T1 = T2) \/
  (repl_typ p q T1 T2 /\ S1 = S2).
Proof.
  intros p q S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. split; auto.
  - right. split; auto.
Qed.

(* Arrow domain inversion for the trans-free relation. *)
Lemma subtyp1_all_domain : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) -> G ⊢ S2 <: S1.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_pq *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ p q (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_qp.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* sngl_qp *)
    match goal with
    | Hr : repl_typ q p (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) |- _ =>
      destruct (repl_all_cases Hr) as [[Hd Hb]|[Hb Hd]]
    end.
    + subst T2. eapply subtyp_sngl_pq.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * match goal with Hs : G ⊢ trm_path q : _ |- _ => exact Hs end.
      * apply repl_typ_sym_t. exact Hd.
    + subst S2. apply subtyp_refl.
  - (* all *) apply subtyp1_subtyp. assumption.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* The arrow-subtyping opening relation.  If [G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T], then
   [ArrowOpen G S T A B] records the two pieces of information supplied by
   arrow subtyping inversion: the parameter is contravariant and the bodies
   are related under the *target* parameter. *)
Definition ArrowOpen (G:ctx) (S T A B:typ) : Prop :=
  G ⊢ S <: A /\
  exists L, forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ S ⊢ open_typ z B <: open_typ z T.

(* Main reduction/preservation step for an application, given a store lookup
   of the function path to a literal lambda together with the tight type of
   that lambda and its subtyping to the arrow target.  [ArrowOpen] is the
   only remaining subtyping fact; it is hypothesis-free here. *)
Lemma app_red_pres : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ) (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  (* invert the tight typing of the lambda to obtain its body *)
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now the typing is [G ⊢ open_trm z t : open_typ z V0] for z ∉ L0 *)
  destruct Hop as [Hparam [L1 Hbody_sub]].
  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ T \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ T).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  (* typing of the substituted body *)
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ T0) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z V0) Hbz
                G z T0 empty q Hok0
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ T0)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzT0 Hq0) as Hsub_trm.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  (* subtyping of the opened result types *)
  assert (Hok1 : ok (G & z ~ S & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 subst_ty))
                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z T) Hsubz
                G z S empty q Hok1
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub_out.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z T 0 z HzT q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  exists γ, G, (empty:ctx), (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := T0) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - split; [exact Hi|]. split.
    + apply ty_sub with (T := open_typ_p q V0); auto.
    + exact (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)).
Qed.

(* Conditional form: if the precise3 typing of the function path is available
   (the ordinary-path-to-precise3 bridge) and incoming arrow subtyping can be
   opened (ArrowOpen), then the full app_step statement holds. *)
Lemma app_step_of_precise3_open : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢!!! p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  (forall (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
      γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq Hbridge.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* now S0 = ∀(T0) U0 and Hsub : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* Also expose the reduction-plus-typing core with the raw RHoldsL facts,
   for callers that obtain the lambda by another route. *)
Lemma app_step_of_RHoldsL_lam : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T0 ->
  ArrowOpen G S T0 T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T0 /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros. eapply app_red_pres; eauto.
Qed.

(* normalize to every view.  For an actual tight member [A] of bound   *)
(* [⊥], the view [rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}] is live while the fabricated           *)
(* [rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤}] cannot have [subtyp1 G rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤} rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}]     *)
(* (that would require [⊤ <: ⊥]).  Hence the provenance relation       *)
(* (which actual record, with which [W]) must be carried as a single   *)
(* witness: the residual below cannot be decomposed.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma actual_record_exists_trivial : forall (A:typ_label),
  exists U W, record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W }.
Proof.
  intros A. exists (typ_rcd { A >: ⊤ <: ⊤ }), ⊤. split.
  - apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
  - apply rh_one.
Qed.

(* The residual with provenance carried explicitly (definitionally the
   same as [path_actual_record_trans_free], exposed for the runtime
   navigation proof): *)
Definition ActualRecordBound (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (A:typ_label)
    (U W:typ) : Prop :=
  record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
  (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
     subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

Lemma path_actual_record_trans_free_iff :
  path_actual_record_trans_free <->
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists U W, ActualRecordBound γ G p A U W).
Proof.
  unfold path_actual_record_trans_free, ActualRecordBound. tauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
| st_fld : forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G S (p ↓ A)
| st_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G (p ↓ A) T
| st_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
    subtyp_step G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp_step_subtyp : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma star_trans_gen : forall (A:Type) (R:A -> A -> Prop) (a b c:A),
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].

(* ================================================================== *)
(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
| st_fld : forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ p q T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sngl_qp : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->
    repl_typ q p T T' -> subtyp_step G T T'
| st_sel2 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G S (p ↓ A)
| st_sel1 : forall G p A S T,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } -> subtyp_step G (p ↓ A) T
| st_all : forall (L : fset var) (G : ctx) (S1 T1 S2 T2 : typ),
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x : var, x \notin L -> G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2) ->
    subtyp_step G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2).

Lemma subtyp_step_subtyp : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> G ⊢ S <: U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - apply subtyp_and2; auto.
  - apply subtyp_fld; auto.
  - apply subtyp_typ; auto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply subtyp_all; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma star_trans_gen : forall (A:Type) (R:A -> A -> Prop) (a b c:A),
  star R a b -> star R b c -> star R a c.
Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* fld *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_fld; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* typ *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_typ; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_pq *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_pq; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_qp *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_qp; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel2 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel2; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel1 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel1; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* all *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_all; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres resL.
Close Scope string_scope.

Inductive RHoldsL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rhL_lam (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv (λ(T0) t)) A
| rhL_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHoldsL γ G (defv v) U
| rhL_path q :
    RHoldsL γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holdsL : forall γ G p U,
  ResCoreL γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv (λ(T0) t)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (λ(T0) t)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_lam with (T0 := T0) (t := t) (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rhL_path.
Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_pathL : forall γ G r q,
  RHoldsL γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_resL Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holdsL; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rhL_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookupL : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHoldsL γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookupL Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookupL Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_pathL γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

Lemma res_fieldL : forall γ G p a U,

    destruct (@defs_field_lookup γ (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) x bs T0 ds (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc) a U H eq_refl H3 Hhas)
      as [rhs [Hd0 [Hstep Hty]]].
    destruct rhs as [q|v].
    + (* stored path *) dependent destruction Hty.

    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).
        assert (Hrt1 : record_type T1).
        { destruct (ty_defs_record_typ H6) as [ls Hrt].
          exists ls. apply (@record_typ_open_p T1 ((p_sel (avar_f x) bs) • a) ls).
          - exact H2.

        apply rcL_obj with (x := x) (Vc := Vc) (C := G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                          (bs := a :: bs) (T0 := T1) (ds := ds1)
                          (U := μ T1).
        -- exact Hstep.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exact H1.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- unfold DefsTyped. exact H6.
        -- exact Hrt1.
        -- apply (@pf_fld G (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) a (μ T0) (μ T1) H5).
      * (* stored lambda *) dependent destruction Hty.
        destruct (ty_val_inv H0) as [[T1 [T2 [t' [Ev [Hval Hsub]]]]] | [T1b [dsb [Ev [Hvalb Hsubb]]]]].
        -- dependent destruction Hval.
           apply rcL_lam with (T0 := open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv)
                             (t := open_rec_trm_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) tv)
                             (S0 := ∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                             (A := ∀(U0) V).
           ++ exact Hstep.
           ++ apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L \u \{x}). intros z Hz.
              destruct (notin_union_single Hz) as [HzL Hzx].
              eapply (proj1 self_remove_ty) with (G1 := G) (G2 := z ~ open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) (x := x) (T0 := Vc).
              ** exact (H2 z HzL).

              pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 self_remove_ty))
                (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)
                (∀(open_rec_typ_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv) T2)
                (∀(U0) V) Hsub G (empty:ctx) x Vc H1 Hxempty
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) Vc)))) as HsubG.

(* [HInvS] has four components:                                       *)
(*   - [HInv0]: well_typed, inert, tight entries, and stored defs;     *)
(*   - [PrecAll]: every ordinarily typed path is precisely typable;    *)
(*   - [Prov]: tight runtime bounds for type-member views;             *)
(*   - [wf]: the recursive well-formedness of the context.             *)
(*                                                                    *)

(* ================================================================== *)

Definition HInv0 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  (γ ⫶ G) /\
  inert G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs),
      binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Definition PrecAll (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (T:typ), G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

Definition Prov (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),

    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->

  HInv0 γ G /\ PrecAll G /\ Prov γ G /\ wf G.

intros G T1 T2 U H Har.
  exact (@subtyp_step_and_arrow_split_gen G (T1 ∧ T2) U H Har T1 T2 eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Hence each single step whose target is an arrow is already correctly
   classified.  The whole remaining content of the classification is
   therefore the *backward lifting* of [ArrowSrc] through a star, whose
   two non-structural cases are precisely [sel_lower_class] and
   [and_target_lift] (see [ArrowSrc_star_back] in agent_noarrow). *)

Lemma subtyp_step_arrow_src : forall G S U,
  subtyp_step G S U -> is_arrow U -> ArrowSrc G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H Har.
  destruct (@subtyp_step_arrow_shape G S U H Har)
    as [Harr | [Hbot | [Hpath | Hand]]].
  - unfold ArrowSrc. left. exact Harr.
  - unfold ArrowSrc. right. left. exact Hbot.
  - destruct Hpath as [p [A E]]. subst S.
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. left. exists p, A. reflexivity.
  - destruct Hand as [T1 [T2 E]]. subst S.
    unfold ArrowSrc. right. right. right. exists T1, T2. split; [reflexivity|].
    exact (@subtyp_step_and_arrow_split G T1 T2 U H Har).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4. The exact frontier.                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_lower_class] and [and_target_lift] (agent_noarrow) are          *)
(* together equivalent to the complete arrow-or-bot source             *)
(* classification and hence to [pointwise_facts].  We record this      *)
(* equivalence; it shows that no further purely syntactic reduction is *)
(* available.                                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pointwise_facts_iff_residuals :
  pointwise_facts <-> (sel_lower_class /\ and_target_lift).
Proof.
  split.
  - intro HP.
    pose proof (master_of_pointwise HP) as Hgen.
    split.
    + apply sel_lower_class_of_gen. exact Hgen.
    + apply and_target_lift_of_gen. exact Hgen.
  - intros [Hsel Hand].
    apply pointwise_facts_of_master.
    apply arrow_source_class_gen_of_residuals;
      [exact Hand | exact Hsel].
Qed.

(* The arrow-only form of the four rigid facts plus fact 5.  [pointwise]
   is obtained from it by the bottom reduction above and fact 6.  This
   packages the observation that facts 1-4 at [⊥] are not independent. *)

Definition pointwise_arrow_facts : Prop :=
  (forall γ G V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ⊤ <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G D V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ typ_rcd D <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T0 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ μ T0 <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G q V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ {{ q }} <: V -> is_arrow V -> False) /\
  (forall γ G T1 T2 V, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ T1 ∧ T2 <: V -> is_arrow V ->
     G ⊢ T1 <: V \/ G ⊢ T2 <: V).

Lemma pointwise_arrow_facts_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> pointwise_arrow_facts.
Proof.
  intros [Ht [Hr [Hb [Hs [Ha _]]]]].
  unfold pointwise_arrow_facts.
  split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
  - exact (fun γ G V Hi H Har => Ht γ G V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G D V Hi H Har => Hr γ G D V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G T0 V Hi H Har => Hb γ G T0 V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact (fun γ G q V Hi H Har => Hs γ G q V Hi H (or_introl Har)).
  - exact Ha.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 5. The semantic obligation.                                         *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The selection case of the classification needs the *runtime* tight  *)
(* bound of a type-member view.  The following two predicates isolate   *)
(* the two ingredients precisely.                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [uniform_tight_member] is the provenance statement: every path that  *)
(* has a type-member view has one canonical tight bound [W] (the actual *)
(* record member), it admits the tight view [p : {A >: W <: W}], and   *)
(* every view brackets [W].  This is [record_member_canonical_          *)
(* provenance] of agent_suball (see [canonical_member_bound_of_         *)
(* provenance]) together with the tight view itself; it is the form     *)
(* produced by PathObject/DefsTyped in an HInv heap.                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [sel_bound_inv] turns the canonical bound into the two inversion     *)
(* facts [S <: p↓A -> S <: W] and [p↓A <: U -> W <: U].                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [tight_bound_arrow_class] is the normal-form statement: below a     *)
(* canonical *tight* bound, the arrow-or-bot classification holds for   *)
(* every source.  Because canonical bounds are exactly the stored       *)
(* member types, this is the well-founded "heap definition depth"       *)
(* induction hypothesis of the task description; it is strictly         *)
(* weaker than quantifying over all types.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition uniform_tight_member : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

(* The bound inversions are *provable*: from the tight view typing alone,
   every type below [p↓A] is below [W], and every type above [p↓A] is
   above [W].  The proofs are by induction on the subtyping derivation;
   the selection steps use the tight view again, the replacement and
   conjunction steps are structural. *)

Lemma sel_right_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall S U, G ⊢ S <: U -> S = p ↓ A -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight S U Hsub.
  induction Hsub using subtyp_ind; intros ES.
  - (* top *) apply subtyp_top.
  - (* bot *) discriminate ES.
  - (* refl *) subst. apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
  - (* trans *) apply subtyp_trans with (T := T).
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + exact Hsub2.
  - (* and11 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and12 *) discriminate ES.
  - (* and2 *) apply subtyp_and2.
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hi | exact Htight | exact ES].
  - (* fld *) discriminate ES.
  - (* typ *) discriminate ES.
  - (* sngl_pq *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_pq; eassumption.
  - (* sngl_qp *) subst T.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sngl_qp; eassumption.
  - (* sel2 *) subst S.
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2; eassumption.
  - (* sel1 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply subtyp_sel2 with (S := W) (T := W). exact Htight.
    + rewrite <- ES. eapply subtyp_sel1; eassumption.
  - (* all *) discriminate ES.
Qed.

Lemma sel_right_bound : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } ->
  forall U, G ⊢ p ↓ A <: U -> G ⊢ W <: U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A W Hi Htight U H.
  eapply (@sel_right_bound_gen γ G p A W Hi Htight (p ↓ A) U H eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma sel_left_bound_gen : forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) W,

(* J. Record-view inversion and the exact runtime residual.            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Proven here: for a *trans-free* comparison from an actual tight     *)
(* record to a member view, the view's bounds bracket the actual tight *)
(* member bound.  Uniqueness of the type member ([record_has_typ_unique]) *)
(* identifies the two [W]s.                                            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma record_dec_view_inv_subtyp1 : forall G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
  record_type U ->
  record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
  subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
  G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros G U A W S T Hrt Hhas Hsub.
  assert (Hfs : flow_shape U) by (apply fs_rec; exact Hrt).
  destruct (@subtyp1_typ_member_inv G U A S T Hfs Hsub)
    as [W' [Hrt' [Hhas' [Hl' Hu']]]].
  assert (E : W' = W) by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; eauto).
  subst W'. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exact runtime residual: the actual tight record of [p] (chosen       *)
(* view-independently, from the HInv heap/defs), together with a        *)
(* trans-free comparison of every ordinary member view to it.           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition path_actual_record_trans_free : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T,
         G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

Definition record_member_canonical_provenance : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T,
         G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

Lemma record_member_canonical_provenance_of_actual :
  path_actual_record_trans_free -> record_member_canonical_provenance.
Proof.
  intros HPA γ G p A Hi.
  destruct (classic (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }))
    as [Hex | Hnone].
  - destruct (HPA γ G p A Hi Hex) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas Hcomp]]]].
    exists U, W. split; [exact Hrt |]. split; [exact Hhas |].
    intros S T Hty. eapply record_dec_view_inv_subtyp1; eauto.
  - (* no record view: fabricate a record with a tight member A *)
    exists (typ_rcd { A >: ⊤ <: ⊤ }), ⊤. split.
    + apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
    + split.
      * apply rh_one.
      * intros S T Hty. exfalso. apply Hnone. exists S, T. exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_provenance :
  record_member_canonical_provenance -> canonical_member_bound.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G p A Hi.
  destruct (HP γ G p A Hi) as [U [W [_ [_ HW]]]].
  exists W. exact HW.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_actual_trans_free :
  path_actual_record_trans_free -> canonical_member_bound.
Proof.
  intro HPA. apply canonical_member_bound_of_provenance.
  apply record_member_canonical_provenance_of_actual. exact HPA.
Qed.

Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_actual_trans_free :
  path_actual_record_trans_free -> typ_member_common_bound.
Proof.
  intro HPA. apply typ_member_common_bound_of_canonical.
  apply canonical_member_bound_of_actual_trans_free. exact HPA.
Qed.

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_actual_trans_free :
  path_actual_record_trans_free -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intro HPA. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_common_bound.
  apply typ_member_common_bound_of_actual_trans_free. exact HPA.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* K. Why [path_actual_record_trans_free] cannot be split into an      *)
(*    independent "existence" and "normalization" pair.                *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Existence of a tight record with member [A] is trivial (fabricate   *)
(* [rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤}]).  It is useless because the *same* [U] must         *)
(* normalize to every view.  For an actual tight member [A] of bound   *)
(* [⊥], the view [rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}] is live while the fabricated           *)
(* [rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤}] cannot have [subtyp1 G rcd{A>:⊤<:⊤} rcd{A>:⊥<:⊥}]     *)
(* (that would require [⊤ <: ⊥]).  Hence the provenance relation       *)
(* (which actual record, with which [W]) must be carried as a single   *)
(* witness: the residual below cannot be decomposed.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma actual_record_exists_trivial : forall (A:typ_label),
  exists U W, record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W }.
Proof.
  intros A. exists (typ_rcd { A >: ⊤ <: ⊤ }), ⊤. split.
  - apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
  - apply rh_one.
Qed.

(* The residual with provenance carried explicitly (definitionally the
   same as [path_actual_record_trans_free], exposed for the runtime
   navigation proof): *)
Definition ActualRecordBound (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (A:typ_label)
    (U W:typ) : Prop :=
  record_type U /\ record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
  (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
     subtyp1 G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

Lemma path_actual_record_trans_free_iff :
  path_actual_record_trans_free <->
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists U W, ActualRecordBound γ G p A U W).
Proof.
  unfold path_actual_record_trans_free, ActualRecordBound. tauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* M. A star-decomposition of ordinary subtyping.                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* NOTE: the version with the *self-recursive* [subtyp1] is false:     *)
(* [subtyp_and2] concludes [S <: T ∧ U] from two premises [S <: T],    *)
(* [S <: U]; a star of one-step rules cannot turn the two stars into   *)
(* the single [subtyp1_and2] step (which needs single-step premises).  *)
(* The correct atom is a [subtyp_step] whose premises are full         *)
(* [subtyp]; then every non-trans rule is one atom and [trans] is      *)
(* star concatenation.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp_step : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| st_top : forall G T, subtyp_step G T typ_top
| st_bot : forall G T, subtyp_step G typ_bot T
| st_refl : forall G T, subtyp_step G T T
| st_and11 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) T
| st_and12 : forall G T U, subtyp_step G (T ∧ U) U
| st_and2 : forall G S T U,
    G ⊢ S <: T -> G ⊢ S <: U -> subtyp_step G S (T ∧ U)
| st_fld : forall G T U a,
    G ⊢ T <: U -> subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U})
| st_typ : forall G S1 S2 T1 T2 A,
    G ⊢ S2 <: S1 -> G ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    subtyp_step G (typ_rcd {A >: S1 <: T1}) (typ_rcd {A >: S2 <: T2})
| st_sngl_pq : forall G p q T T' U,
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢ trm_path q : U ->

content.thinking:
The coordinator's suggested lemma (ty_defs unique) is independent and provable. Let's add it. Also perhaps use it to prove a *partial* Prov for new root path with a view that is exactly the actual rec_elim view (not all views). But the coordinator says "This gives the tight view for a μ-rooted path from HInv's defs_at; the ordinary view pvar x : rcd{A>:S<:T} must come from rec_elim/projections of open T0, and record_has_typ_unique ties the bound."

Maybe they intend a specific new-path Prov case: For a new path x (μ root), any ordinary view of x at record is (after rec_elim) a view of open T0, and by uniqueness actual member W matches. Proving that ordinary view must come from rec_elim/projections requires subtyping record extraction/transitivity, maybe can be done via `subtyp_star_step` classification? agent_suball has subtyp_star_step decomposition and trans-free tools. But full extraction still open (path_actual_record_trans_free residual). However, for *new path pvar x*, maybe simpler: x's only typing source is ty_var x:μT0 then ty_rec_elim to open T0, then any record view via subtyping from open T0. So we need: if G⊢open T0 <: rcd{A>:S<:T} and open T0 is a record, then actual member A exists and brackets. That's exactly record_dec_view_inv_subtyp1 but for full subtyp. The subtyp1 version is proven; full subtyp requires trans decomposition into subtyp1 steps, but targets record and sources record: composition of steps may pass through other shapes (sel types etc.). path_actual_record_trans_free is the residual. So not fully.

Nevertheless, prove the defs uniqueness lemma; it's requested and useful. Let's implement.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub.
