Lemma get_def_cons_same : forall ds d, get_def (label_of_def d) (defs_cons ds d) = Some d.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite If_l; auto. Qed.

Lemma get_def_cons_neq : forall ds d l, label_of_def d <> l ->
  get_def l (defs_cons ds d) = get_def l ds.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite If_r; auto. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_same : forall ds d, defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof. intros. unfold defs_has. apply get_def_cons_same. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_inv : forall ds d d0,
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d0 -> d0 = d \/ defs_has ds d0.
Proof.
  intros ds d d0 H. unfold defs_has in *. simpl in H.
  destruct (classic (label_of_def d = label_of_def d0)) as [Heq|Hne].
  - rewrite If_l in H by auto. injection H as ->. auto.
  - rewrite If_r in H by auto. auto.
Qed.

Lemma get_def_some_label : forall l ds d, get_def l ds = Some d -> label_of_def d = l.
Proof.
  intros l ds. induction ds as [|rest IH dd]; intros d E; [discriminate E|].
  simpl in E. destruct (classic (label_of_def dd = l)) as [H|H].
  - rewrite If_l in E by auto. injection E as ->. auto.
  - rewrite If_r in E by auto. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_iff : forall ds l,
  defs_hasnt ds l <-> (forall d, defs_has ds d -> label_of_def d <> l).
Proof.
  intros ds l. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has. split.
  - intros H d Hd Heq. rewrite <- Heq in H. rewrite Hd in H. discriminate H.
  - intros H. destruct (get_def l ds) as [d|] eqn:E.
    + exfalso. pose proof (@get_def_some_label l ds d E) as Heq.
      apply (H d).
      * unfold defs_has. rewrite Heq. exact E.
      * auto.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition defs_labels (ds:defs) (ls:fset label) :=
  (forall l, l \in ls -> exists d, defs_has ds d /\ label_of_def d = l) /\
  (forall d, defs_has ds d -> label_of_def d \in ls).

Lemma defs_labels_nil : defs_labels defs_nil (\{} : fset label).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros l Hl. apply in_empty_inv in Hl. tauto.
  - intros d Hd. unfold defs_has, defs_hasnt in *. simpl in Hd. discriminate Hd.

      exists W0. split; [| exact E].

      rewrite get_def_cons_neq; [exact Hstored|].
      intro Elab.

Definition tight_member_view_provenance : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }.

Lemma uniform_tight_member_of_tight_view :
  tight_member_view_provenance -> uniform_tight_member.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G p A Hi [S [T Hview]].
  destruct (HP γ G p A Hi (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hview)))
    as [W Htight].
  exists W. split; [exact Htight|].
  intros S0 T0 Hv.
  split.
  - (* S0 <: p↓A <: W *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hv.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Htight.
  - (* W <: p↓A <: T0 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hv.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A strengthened heap invariant, aimed at removing [wf_push_cond].   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [HInvS] has four components:                                       *)
(*   - [HInv0]: well_typed, inert, tight entries, and stored defs;     *)
(*   - [PrecAll]: every ordinarily typed path is precisely typable;    *)
(*   - [Prov]: tight runtime bounds for type-member views;             *)
(*   - [wf]: the recursive well-formedness of the context.             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [wf] is *derivable* at push from [PrecAll] plus the unconditional   *)
(* stored-path bridge of agent_wf; this is the point of replacing the  *)
(* old [wf_push_cond] parameter of hp.v.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition HInv0 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  (γ ⫶ G) /\
  inert G /\
  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs),
      binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).

Definition PrecAll (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (T:typ), G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.

Definition Prov (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W,
      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).

(* The bracket half of [Prov] is derivable from the mere existence of a
   tight view: both views give selection bounds through [p ↓ A], and the
   two bounds compose.  Hence the real push obligation is only the
   existence of a tight view (the "provenance" half). *)
Definition TightProv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists W, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }.

Lemma Prov_of_TightProv : forall γ G, TightProv γ G -> Prov γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G HP p A [S [T Hview]].
  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hview))) as [W Htight].
  exists W. split; [exact Htight|].
  intros S0 T0 Hv. split.
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hv.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Htight.
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Htight.
    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hv.
Qed.

Definition HInvS (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  HInv0 γ G /\ PrecAll G /\ Prov γ G /\ wf G.

(* Projections. *)
Lemma HInvS_wt : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> γ ⫶ G.
Proof. intros γ G [[H _] _]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma HInvS_inert : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> inert G.
Proof. intros γ G [[_ [H _]] _]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma HInvS_entries : forall γ G x T v,
  HInvS γ G -> binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T.
Proof. intros γ G x T v [[_ [_ [H _]]] _] Hb Hv. exact (H x T v Hb Hv). Qed.

Lemma HInvS_defs : forall γ G x T0 ds,
  HInvS γ G -> binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds.
Proof. intros γ G x T0 ds [[_ [_ [_ H]]] _] Hb Hv. exact (H x T0 ds Hb Hv). Qed.

Lemma HInvS_prec : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> PrecAll G.
Proof. intros γ G [_ [H _]]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma HInvS_prov : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> Prov γ G.
Proof. intros γ G [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma HInvS_wf : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> wf G.
Proof. intros γ G [_ [_ [_ H]]]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma HInv0_HInv : forall γ G,
  HInv0 γ G -> wf G -> HInv γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G [Hwt [Hin [Hent Hdef]]] Hwf.
  unfold HInv. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hin|]. split; [exact Hwf|].
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma HInvS_HInv : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> HInv γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi. exact (HInv0_HInv (proj1 Hi) (HInvS_wf Hi)).
Qed.

(* Reassembly: the four pieces build an [HInvS]. *)
Lemma HInvS_intro : forall γ G,
  HInv0 γ G -> PrecAll G -> Prov γ G -> wf G -> HInvS γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G H0 HP HV Hw. unfold HInvS.
  split; [exact H0 | split; [exact HP | split; [exact HV | exact Hw]]].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
   singleton. *)
Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.

Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
Proof.
  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
Proof.
  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
  - (* bind *) subst.
    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
    + apply fs_all.
    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@rcd_record_type_shape a U). exact H.
  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    + apply fs_rec. apply (@record_type_open_p U p).
      match goal with Hr : record_type U |- _ => exact Hr end.
    + exfalso.
      match goal with Hr : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
        exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U Hr) end.
  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_l U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
    apply (@flow_shape_and_r U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
Qed.

(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)
Definition ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
    exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A.

(* NOTE (coordinator): the raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] below is FALSE;
   counter_bridge2.v exhibits a loose record type member in a non-HInv
   context.  The HInv/provenance-aware replacement and the authoritative
   assembly live in aux_bridge_fixed.v.  The lemma below is kept only as the
   (conditional) shape of the original decomposition; do not integrate it. *)
(* Residual bridge 2: no non-arrow flow-shaped type is a subtype of an
   arrow. *)
Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G U A,
    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.

(* Residual bridge 3: opening/inversion of arrow subtyping. *)
Definition arrow_open_bridge : Prop :=
  forall G A B S T,
    G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T -> ArrowOpen G S T A B.

(* Assembly: the three bridges imply the full app_step statement. *)
Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge ->
  arrow_open_bridge ->
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (exact (HNS G U (∀(S)T) Hfs Hsub Har)).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  (* Hval-type : G ⊢!v λ(T0)t : ∀(T0) U0, and
     Hsub0 : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S') T'. *)
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma counter_bridge2 : forall (A0:typ_label) (z:var),
  exists G U A, flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A /\ is_arrow A /\ ~ is_arrow U.
Proof.
  intros A0 z.
  set (Arrow := ∀(⊤) ⊤).
  set (Tbody := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
  assert (Hrt : record_type Tbody).
  { exists (\{label_typ A0}). apply rt_one; [apply rd_typ|reflexivity]. }
  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: μ Tbody <: Arrow}).
  set (G := (empty:ctx) & z ~ R).
  exists G, (μ Tbody), Arrow. split.
  - apply fs_bnd. exact Hrt.
  - split.
    + eapply subtyp_trans.
      * eapply subtyp_sel2 with (T := Arrow) (A := A0).
        apply ty_var. apply binds_tail.
      * eapply subtyp_sel1 with (S := μ Tbody) (A := A0).
        apply ty_var. apply binds_tail.
    + split.
      * exists ⊤, ⊤. reflexivity.
      * intro H. destruct H as [S [U E]]. discriminate E.
Qed.

"""Final monolithic Task.v builder with parameter-free ordering.
Usage: python3 merge_final.py OUT.v
Expected agent deliverables (all must exist and compile):
  agent_wf.v      : theorem `wf_push_cond`
  agent_bridge1.v : theorem `ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_proof`
  agent_suball.v  : theorems `rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_proof`, `arrow_open_HInv_bridge_proof`
Creates a deferred HInv_push and step, and defines app_step_proof from the
corrected HInv-aware assembly.
"""
import re, sys, os
WORK=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); TASK='/workspace/Task.v'

def rd(name): return open(os.path.join(WORK,name)).read()

def strip_scratch(txt):
    out=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('Require Import') or s.startswith('Require Export'): continue
        if s in ('Set Implicit Arguments.','Close Scope string_scope.'): continue
        out.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(out)

def strip_ltac(txt, seen):
    if 'Ltac solve_union :=' in txt:
        if seen[0]:
            txt=re.sub(r'^\s*Ltac solve_union :=.*?\.\s*$','',txt,flags=re.M|re.S)
        else: seen[0]=True
    return txt

def main():
    out=sys.argv[1]
    for f in ['agent_wf.v','agent_bridge1.v','agent_suball.v']:
        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(WORK,f)):
            sys.exit('missing required final file '+f)
    hp=rd('hp.v')
    # hp prefix without Parameter, before HInv_push
    hp=re.sub(r'Parameter wf_push_cond\s*:.*?\.\n\n','',hp,count=1,flags=re.S)
    hi=hp.index('Lemma HInv_push')
    hp_pre, hp_post = hp[:hi], hp[hi:]
    st=rd('step.v')
    st=re.sub(r'Parameter app_step\s*:.*?\.\n\n','',st,count=1,flags=re.S)
    si=st.index('Lemma step :')
    st_pre, st_post = st[:si], st[si:]
    core=['dev9','w3','b','b2','v3','s','sp','sub','rec','op','dr','val2','look']
    # hp_pre provides HInv/defs_at
    after_hp=['sh','term']

    after_step=['wfpush','precise','appvar','resnav','selfswap','defsn','res',

                'aux_arrow','aux_prefix','agent_app','agent_bridge','aux_bridge_fixed']
    chunks=[]; seen=[False]

        t=strip_scratch(txt); t=strip_ltac(t,seen)
        if re.search(r'^\s*(Parameter|Axiom|Conjecture)\b',t,re.M):

        chunks.append('\n(* ===== %s ===== *)\n'%label+t)
    for f in core: add(f+'.v',rd(f+'.v'))
    add('hp.v (definitions, without Parameter/HInv_push)',hp_pre)
    for f in after_hp: add(f+'.v',rd(f+'.v'))
    add('step.v (StepOK/helpers, without Parameter/step)',st_pre)
    for f in after_step: add(f+'.v',rd(f+'.v'))
    add('agent_wf.v',rd('agent_wf.v'))
    add('hp.v HInv_push',hp_post)
    add('agent_bridge1.v',rd('agent_bridge1.v'))
    add('agent_suball.v',rd('agent_suball.v'))
    app_final='''

Lemma app_step_proof : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
    red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\\ HInv γ' G' /\\
    G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\\ G' = G & H.
Proof.
  exact (app_step_proof_of_bridges_HInv
           ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_proof
           rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_proof
           arrow_open_HInv_bridge_proof).
Qed.
'''
    add('app_final',app_final)
    add('step.v step theorem',st_post)
    add('safety.v',rd('safety.v'))
    task=open(TASK).read(); ti=task.index('Theorem safety t T :'); ei=task.index('End Safety.',ti)
    prefix=task[:ti]; target=task[ti:ei].rstrip()
    saf=strip_scratch(rd('safety.v'))
    th=saf.index('Theorem safety_test'); pi=saf.index('Proof.',th); qi=saf.index('Qed.',pi)+4
    body=saf[pi:qi].replace('intros t T Ht.','intros Ht.',1)
    merged=prefix+'\n\nRequire Import TLC.LibChoice.\n\n'+''.join(chunks)+'\n\n(* ===== supplied target statement, unchanged ===== *)\n'+target+'\n'+body+'\n\nEnd Safety.\n'
    open(out,'w').write(merged); print('wrote',out,len(merged))
if __name__=='__main__': main()

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional assembly of [wf_push_cond] from the two bridges.        *)
(* The statement is *exactly* the one of the scratch Parameter.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_push_cond_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
Proof.
  intros Hstored Hpath γ G x S v Hi Hx Hval Hnewdefs.
  (* Record inertness of S before we invert the value. *)
  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
  dependent destruction Hval.
  - (* S = ∀(T) U : no self-flow to a singleton can exist *)
    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs
                 {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow) as [Esrc _].
    discriminate Esrc.
  - (* S = μ T : use the stored-path bridge and path precision *)
    intros bs q Hflow.
    (* record_type T from the inertness of μ T *)
    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
    destruct (Hstored γ G x T ds q Hi Hx Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
    assert (HinertC : inert (G & x ~ μ T)).
    { apply inert_push.
      - destruct Hi as [Hwt [HinertG _]]. exact HinertG.
      - destruct Hrt as [ls Hrec].
        apply inert_typ_bnd with (ls := ls). exact Hrec.
      - exact Hx. }
    exact (Hpath (G & x ~ μ T) q Tq HinertC Hq).
Qed.

(* The same statement, specialised to the exact hypothesis layout that the
   scratch [hp.v] parameter uses, for easy integration. *)
Definition wf_push_cond_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
              exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).

Lemma wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges :
  self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge ->
  inert_path_precise_bridge ->
  wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof. intros Hs Hp. exact (wf_push_cond_of_bridges Hs Hp). Qed.

(* Final assembly: only the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge remains. *)
Lemma wf_push_cond_of_path_precise :
  inert_path_precise_bridge -> wf_push_cond_statement.
Proof.
  intro Hpath.
  exact (wf_push_cond_statement_of_bridges
           self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof Hpath).
Qed.

(* Integration note.  Once the shared ordinary-path-precision bridge
   [inert_path_precise_bridge] is discharged (by this worker or another),
   the exact scratch parameter is recovered by

     Lemma wf_push_cond : wf_push_cond_statement :=
       wf_push_cond_of_path_precise <proof-of-bridge>.

   All the self/flow-resolution work is already unconditional:
   [self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof] proves the flow-to-stored-path
   typing step without using the [wf] component of [HInv] or the old
   scratch parameter.  The only remaining hypothesis is the shared
   ordinary-path-precision fact for inert contexts. *)


  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
  - exact HVsub.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Head compatibility for natural types.

   [ty_def_path] types path fields at a singleton, [ty_def_all]/[ty_def_new]
   type value fields at an arrow/μ; hence actual record field types are
   exactly arrow, μ (record), or singleton, i.e. [nat_typ].  The residual
   below asks that subtyping between natural types preserves the head
   constructor; it is what remains of the O1 impasse after restricting to
   natural targets. *)

Lemma arrow_not_bnd : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma arrow_not_sngl : forall (q:path), ~ is_arrow {{ q }}.
Proof. intros q [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma bnd_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), μ T <> {{ q }}.
Proof. intros T q E. discriminate E. Qed.

(* The three heads of a natural type are mutually exclusive. *)
Definition nat_head_compat (G:ctx) (V T:typ) : Prop :=
  (is_arrow V /\ is_arrow T) \/
  ((exists U0, V = μ U0 /\ record_type U0) /\
   (exists T0, T = μ T0 /\ record_type T0)) \/
  ((exists q, V = {{ q }}) /\ (exists q', T = {{ q' }})).

(* Residual: natural-source / natural-target subtyping preserves the head.
   This is the "good/natural V <: natural T head-compatibility" fact. *)
Definition nat_sub_head_compat : Prop :=
  forall G V T,

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Weakening a typing by one fresh push.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma weaken_trm_last : forall G (t:trm) T,
  G ⊢ t : T -> forall x S, x # G -> G & x ~ S ⊢ t : T.
Proof.
  intros G t T H x S Hx.
  pose proof (@weaken_trm G t T H G empty x S eq_refl) as Hw.
  rewrite concat_empty_r in Hw.
  assert (Hx' : x # (G & empty)) by (rewrite dom_concat_empty; exact Hx).
  exact (@weaken_trm G t T H G empty x S eq_refl Hx').
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The four inheritance obligations of the push.                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The first two concern paths whose head is not the freshly pushed   *)
(* variable; the last two concern paths whose head is [x].  They are  *)
(* stated as separate [Prop]s so that the unconditional assembly      *)
(* below is independent of how they are eventually discharged.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition OldPathPrecLift : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    exists T', G ⊢ trm_path p : T'.

Definition OldPathViewLift : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) A S0 T0,
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    exists S1 T1, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 }.

Definition PrecAll_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,

Definition TightProv_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->

(* Assembling [PrecAll] for the pushed context.                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma PrecAll_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  PrecAll (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p T Hty.
  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hin).
  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot)
      as [T' HtyG].

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

  OldPathViewLift ->
  TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p A [S0 [T0 Hview]].
  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs

  OldPathPrecLift ->
  OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  TightProv_push_new ->

  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Proof.

Wait `[H _]` is a pair (ent, defs), so `[H _]` after second component means rest = inert /\ (ent /\ defs) parsed as `[_ [H _]]`: first `_` = inert, second `[H _]` = (ent /\ defs) with H=ent. - HInvP_defs: `[[_ [_ [_ H]]] _]`: H0 = wt /\ (inert /\ (ent /\ defs)) => H = defs. Correct.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master agent_sem agent_hinvs.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* Under [Prov], a star from an actual record type [U] (with tight member
   [A>W<W]) to an arbitrary record view [rcd{A>:S<:T}] brackets [W].
   The path [p : U] is what lets [Prov] compare the actual tight view with
   the view reached by subtyping; no star/step induction is needed. *)

Lemma star_record_view_inv_of_Prov :
  forall γ G (p:path) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U A W S T HP HpU Hrt Hhas Hstar.
  assert (HsubUW : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: W <: W })
    by (apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas G)).
  assert (HpTW : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W })
    by (apply ty_sub with (T := U); assumption).
  assert (HsubUV : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })
    by (apply (@star_subtyp_step_sub G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) Hstar)).
  assert (HpV : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })
    by (apply ty_sub with (T := U); assumption).
  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ W (ex_intro _ W HpTW))) as [W' [Htight Hb]].
  destruct (Hb W W HpTW) as [_ HW'W].
  destruct (Hb S T HpV) as [HSW' HW'T].
  split.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HSW' | exact HW'W].
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HWW' | exact HW'T].
Qed.
EOF

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The [HInvP] fragment: HInv0 + PrecAll + wf.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the fragment needed by the step relation:                  *)
(*   - app reduction does not change the heap/context;                 *)
(*   - let-value push uses [HInvP_push];                               *)
(*   - let-path / let-target inherit through the typing derivation.    *)
(* [Prov] is deliberately not a component here, so the preservation   *)
(* of [HInvP] does not depend on the view-provenance work.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma HInvP_empty : HInvP (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).
Proof.
  apply HInvP_intro.
  - exact HInv0_empty.
  - exact PrecAll_empty.
  - apply wfe_empty.
Qed.

Lemma HInvP_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec Hwf]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
  { eapply PrecAll_push.
    - exact HoldP. - exact HnewP.
    - apply HInvP_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hwf].
    - exact HxG. - exact Hxg. - exact Hval. - exact Hdefs. }
  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply wfe_push.
    - exact Hwf.
    - exact HxG.
    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
  exact (HInvP_intro H0' HP' Hwf').
Qed.

Definition HInvP_push_principle : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Lemma HInvP_push_of_obligations :
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new -> HInvP_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros HoldP HnewP γ G x S v Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  exact (@HInvP_push γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).
Qed.
'''

7	Lemma open_pvar_path : forall k (q:path) x,
8	  open_rec_path_p k (pvar x) q = open_rec_path k x q.
9	Proof.
10	  intros k [a bs] x. destruct a as [i|y]; simpl.
11	  - destruct (classic (k = i)) as [E|E].
12	    + rewrite If_l by auto. simpl. rewrite If_l by auto. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
13	    + rewrite If_r by auto. simpl. rewrite If_r by auto. reflexivity.
14	  - reflexivity.
15	Qed.

17	Lemma open_pvar_typ_dec :
18	  (forall (T:typ) k x, open_rec_typ_p k (pvar x) T = open_rec_typ k x T) /\
19	  (forall (D:dec) k x, open_rec_dec_p k (pvar x) D = open_rec_dec k x D).
20	Proof.
21	  apply typ_mutind.
22	  - intros k x. reflexivity.
23	  - intros k x. reflexivity.
24	  - intros d IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
25	  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
26	  - intros q A k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
27	  - intros t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
28	  - intros t IH1 t0 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
29	  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
30	  - intros A t0 IH1 t1 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
31	  - intros a t IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
32	Qed.

34	Lemma open_pvar_trm :
35	  (forall (t:trm) k x, open_rec_trm_p k (pvar x) t = open_rec_trm k x t) /\
36	  ((forall (v:val) k x, open_rec_val_p k (pvar x) v = open_rec_val k x v) /\
37	  ((forall (d:def) k x, open_rec_def_p k (pvar x) d = open_rec_def k x d) /\
38	  ((forall (ds:defs) k x, open_rec_defs_p k (pvar x) ds = open_rec_defs k x ds) /\
39	   (forall (dr:def_rhs) k x, open_rec_defrhs_p k (pvar x) dr = open_rec_defrhs k x dr)))).
40	Proof.
41	  apply trm_mutind.
42	  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
43	  - intros q r k x. simpl. f_equal; apply open_pvar_path.
44	  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
45	  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
46	  - intros T ds IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
47	    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T (Datatypes.S k) x). + apply IH.
48	  - intros T t IH k x. simpl. f_equal.
49	    + exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x). + apply IH.
50	  - intros A T k x. simpl. f_equal. exact (proj1 open_pvar_typ_dec T k x).
51	  - intros a dr IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
52	  - intros k x. reflexivity.
53	  - intros ds IH1 d IH2 k x. simpl. f_equal; auto.
54	  - intros q k x. simpl. f_equal. apply open_pvar_path.
55	  - intros v IH k x. simpl. f_equal. apply IH.
56	Qed.

58	Lemma open_typ_pvar : forall (T:typ) x, open_typ_p (pvar x) T = open_typ x T.

60	Lemma open_defs_pvar : forall (ds:defs) x, open_defs_p (pvar x) ds = open_defs x ds.
61	Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 open_pvar_trm)))). Qed.

65	Definition defs_at (G:ctx) (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs) :=
66	  x; nil; (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) ⊢ open_defs_p (pvar x) ds :: open_typ_p (pvar x) T0.

68	Definition HInv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) :=
69	  γ ⫶ G /\
70	  inert G /\
71	  wf G /\
72	  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
73	  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs), binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).
74	
75	Parameter wf_push_cond : forall γ G x S v,
76	  HInv γ G -> x # G -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
77	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
78	  (forall bs q, G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }}⪼ {{ q }} ->
79	            exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
80	
81	Lemma ty_val_p_weaken_single : forall G (v:val) T x,
82	  G ⊢!v v : T -> x # G -> G & x ~ T ⊢!v v : T.
83	Proof. intros G v T x H Hx. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v T H x T Hx). Qed.
84	
85	Lemma HInv_empty : HInv empty empty.
86	Proof.
87	  unfold HInv. split; [apply well_typed_empty|]. split; [apply inert_empty|]. split; [apply wfe_empty|]. split.
88	  - intros x T v Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
89	  - intros x T0 ds Hb _; destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
90	Qed.

92	Lemma HInv_push : forall γ G x S v,
93	  HInv γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
94	  G ⊢!v v : S ->
95	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
96	  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
97	Proof.
98	  intros γ G x S v [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]] HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs.
99	  unfold HInv. split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]].
100	  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
101	    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
102	  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).
103	    + exact Hinert.
104	    + exact (ty_val_p_inert Hval).
105	    + exact HxG.
106	  - apply wfe_push.
107	    + exact Hwf.
108	    + exact HxG.
109	    + assert (Hi : HInv γ G) by (unfold HInv; split; [exact Hwt|]; split; [exact Hinert|]; split; [exact Hwf|]; split; [exact Hentries|exact Hdefs]).
110	      exact (@wf_push_cond γ G x S v Hi HxG Hval Hnewdefs).
111	  - intros y T' v' HbG Hbγ.
112	    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
113	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
114	      * subst. exact (ty_val_p_weaken_single Hval HxG).
115	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
116	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
117	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
118	      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).
119	  - intros y T0 ds HbG Hbγ.
120	    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].
121	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
122	      * rewrite Eyx. exact (proj2 (Hnewdefs T0 ds (eq_sym Ev))).
123	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
124	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
125	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
126	      * unfold defs_at in *.
127	        eapply weaken_defs with (G1:=G) (G2:= y ~ open_typ_p (pvar y) T0) (w:=x) (S:=S).
128	        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
129	        -- reflexivity.
130	        -- rewrite dom_concat, dom_single. apply notin_union_l.
131	           ++ exact HxG.
132	           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.
133	Qed.

11	Lemma defs_has_open_p_inv : forall k p (ds:defs) d,
12	  defs_has (open_rec_defs_p k p ds) d ->
13	  exists d0, defs_has ds d0 /\ open_rec_def_p k p d0 = d.
14	Proof.
15	  intros k p ds d. revert k p d.
16	  induction ds as [|rest IH d0]; intros k p d H.
17	  - unfold defs_has in H. simpl in H. discriminate H.
18	  - unfold defs_has in H. cbn in H.
19	    destruct (classic (label_of_def (open_rec_def_p k p d0) = label_of_def d)) as [Heq|Hne].
20	    + rewrite If_l in H by auto. injection H as E. subst d.
21	      exists d0. split; [apply defs_has_cons_same|reflexivity].
22	    + rewrite If_r in H by auto.
23	      assert (Hlab : label_of_def d0 <> label_of_def d).
24	      { intro E. apply Hne. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. exact E. }
25	      destruct (IH k p d H) as [ds0 [Hds E]].
26	      exists ds0. split.
27	      * unfold defs_has. rewrite get_def_cons_neq.
28	        -- unfold defs_has in Hds. exact Hds.
29	        -- assert (Elab : label_of_def ds0 = label_of_def d).
30	           { rewrite <- E. rewrite label_of_def_open_p. reflexivity. }
31	           intro E2. apply Hlab. rewrite E2. exact Elab.
32	      * exact E.
33	Qed.

48	  exists d, defs_has (open_defs_p (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds) d /\

56	  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->

58	  exists d, defs_has ds d /\ x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d : {a ⦂ S}.
59	Proof.
60	  intros C x bs T0 ds a S Hds Hhas.
61	  destruct (DefsTyped_field Hds Hhas) as [d [Hd Hty]].
62	  destruct (@defs_has_open_p_inv 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) ds d Hd) as [d0 [Hd0 E]].
63	  exists d0. split; [exact Hd0|]. rewrite E. exact Hty.

67	  γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (ν(T0) ds) ⟧ ->
68	  p = p_sel (avar_f x) bs ->
69	  DefsTyped C x bs T0 ds ->
70	  record_has (open_typ_p p T0) {a ⦂ S} ->
71	  exists rhs,
72	    defs_has ds {a := rhs} /\
73	    γ ⟦ p • a ⤳ open_defrhs_p p rhs ⟧ /\
74	    x; bs; C ⊢ open_rec_def_p 0 p {a := rhs} : {a ⦂ S}.
75	Proof.
76	  intros γ p x bs T0 ds C a S Hlook Ep Hds Hhas.
77	  subst p.
78	  destruct (DefsTyped_field_stored Hds Hhas) as [d0 [Hd0 Hty]].
79	  destruct (proj1 ty_def_record x bs C (open_rec_def_p 0 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) d0) {a ⦂ S} Hty) as [_ Hlab].
80	  rewrite label_of_def_open_p in Hlab.
81	  simpl in Hlab.
82	  destruct d0 as [A Td | b rhs]; simpl in Hlab.
83	  - discriminate Hlab.
84	  - injection Hlab as Eba. subst b.
85	    exists rhs. split; [exact Hd0|]. split.
86	    + apply lookup_sel_v with (T := T0) (ds := ds); auto.
87	    + exact Hty.
88	Qed.

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

8	(* The possible shapes of the result type of a precise flow, in an HInv
9	   context: an arrow, a recursive record type, a record type, or a
10	   singleton. *)
11	Inductive flow_shape : typ -> Prop :=
12	| fs_all : forall S T, flow_shape (∀(S) T)
13	| fs_bnd : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape (μ T)
14	| fs_rec : forall T, record_type T -> flow_shape T
15	| fs_sngl : forall p, flow_shape {{ p }}.
16	
17	Lemma flow_shape_all : forall U, flow_shape U -> is_arrow U \/ True.
18	Proof. intros U H. destruct H; auto. Qed.
19	
20	Lemma rcd_record_type_shape : forall a U,
21	  record_type (typ_rcd {a ⦂ U}) -> flow_shape U.
22	Proof.
23	  intros a U Hrt. destruct Hrt as [ls Hrt]. inversion Hrt; subst; clear Hrt.
24	  inversion H0; subst; clear H0.
25	  - (* rd_trm *) destruct H1 as [S0 T0 | T0 ls' Hrt'].
26	    + apply fs_all.
27	    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls'; exact Hrt'.
28	  - (* rd_trm_sngl *) apply fs_sngl.
29	Qed.
30	
31	Lemma flow_shape_bnd_type : forall U, flow_shape (μ U) -> record_type U.
32	Proof.
33	  intros U H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
34	  - exact H1.
35	  - exfalso. match goal with H0 : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
36	                  exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U H0) end.
37	Qed.
38	
39	Lemma flow_shape_and_l : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U1.
40	Proof.
41	  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
42	  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
43	    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_l with (U2:=U2); exact H0 end.
44	Qed.
45	
46	Lemma flow_shape_and_r : forall U1 U2, flow_shape (U1 ∧ U2) -> flow_shape U2.
47	Proof.
48	  intros U1 U2 H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
49	  match goal with H0 : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ =>
50	    apply fs_rec; apply record_type_and_r with (U1:=U1); exact H0 end.
51	Qed.
52	
53	Lemma flow_shape_of_flow : forall γ G p R U,
54	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U.
55	Proof.
56	  intros γ G p R U Hi Hf. induction Hf.
57	  - (* bind *) subst.
58	    destruct (HInv_entries Hi H0) as [v [Hv Hval]].
59	    pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v T Hval) as Hiner.
60	    destruct Hiner as [S0 T0 | T0 ls Hrt].
61	    + apply fs_all.
62	    + apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
63	  - (* fld *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
64	    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
65	    apply (@rcd_record_type_shape a U). exact H.
66	  - (* open *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
67	    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
68	    + apply fs_rec. apply (@record_type_open_p U p).
69	      match goal with Hr : record_type U |- _ => exact Hr end.
70	    + exfalso.
71	      match goal with Hr : record_type (μ U) |- _ =>
72	        exact (@record_type_mu_absurd U Hr) end.
73	  - (* and1 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
74	    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
75	    apply (@flow_shape_and_l U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
76	    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
77	  - (* and2 *) pose proof (IHHf Hi) as Hsh.
78	    inversion Hsh; subst; clear Hsh.
79	    apply (@flow_shape_and_r U1 U2). apply fs_rec.
80	    match goal with Hr : record_type (U1 ∧ U2) |- _ => exact Hr end.
81	Qed.
82	
83	(* Residual bridge 1: ordinary arrow typing of a path yields a precise3
84	   typing at some flow-shaped type below the arrow. *)
85	Definition ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge : Prop :=
86	  forall γ G p A,
87	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
88	    exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: A.
89	
90	(* NOTE (coordinator): the raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] below is FALSE;
91	   counter_bridge2.v exhibits a loose record type member in a non-HInv
92	   context.  The HInv/provenance-aware replacement and the authoritative
93	   assembly live in aux_bridge_fixed.v.  The lemma below is kept only as the
94	   (conditional) shape of the original decomposition; do not integrate it. *)
95	(* Residual bridge 2: no non-arrow flow-shaped type is a subtype of an
96	   arrow. *)
97	Definition flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge : Prop :=
98	  forall G U A,
99	    flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: A -> is_arrow A -> is_arrow U.
100	
101	(* Residual bridge 3: opening/inversion of arrow subtyping. *)
102	Definition arrow_open_bridge : Prop :=
103	  forall G A B S T,
104	    G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T -> ArrowOpen G S T A B.
105	
106	(* Assembly: the three bridges imply the full app_step statement. *)
107	Lemma app_step_proof_of_bridges :
108	  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
109	  flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge ->
110	  arrow_open_bridge ->
111	  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
112	    HInv γ G ->
113	    G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T ->
114	    G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
115	    exists (γ':sta) (G':ctx) (H:ctx) (u:trm),
116	      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ',u) /\ HInv γ' G' /\
117	      G' ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T /\ G' = G & H.
118	Proof.
119	  intros Hbridge HNS Hopen γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq.
120	  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
121	  destruct (Hbridge γ G p (∀(S)T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
122	  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (exact (HNS G U (∀(S)T) Hfs Hsub Har)).
123	  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
124	  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
125	  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
126	  subst r.
127	  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
128	  (* Hval-type : G ⊢!v λ(T0)t : ∀(T0) U0, and
129	     Hsub0 : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S') T'. *)
130	  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
131	    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
132	  (* compose the two arrow subtypings: ∀(T0)U0 <: ∀(S')T' <: ∀(S)T *)
133	  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
134	    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
135	  pose proof (Hopen G T0 U0 S T Hcomp) as Hop.
136	  exact (@app_red_pres γ G p q S T T0 U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq).
137	Qed.

8	Ltac solve_union :=

14	(* The arrow-subtyping opening relation.  If [G ⊢ ∀(A) B <: ∀(S) T], then
15	   [ArrowOpen G S T A B] records the two pieces of information supplied by
16	   arrow subtyping inversion: the parameter is contravariant and the bodies
17	   are related under the *target* parameter. *)
18	Definition ArrowOpen (G:ctx) (S T A B:typ) : Prop :=
19	  G ⊢ S <: A /\
20	  exists L, forall z, z \notin L -> G & z ~ S ⊢ open_typ z B <: open_typ z T.

9	(* ================================================================== *)
10	(* A strengthened heap invariant, aimed at removing [wf_push_cond].   *)
11	(*                                                                    *)
12	(* [HInvS] has four components:                                       *)
13	(*   - [HInv0]: well_typed, inert, tight entries, and stored defs;     *)
14	(*   - [PrecAll]: every ordinarily typed path is precisely typable;    *)
15	(*   - [Prov]: tight runtime bounds for type-member views;             *)
16	(*   - [wf]: the recursive well-formedness of the context.             *)
17	(*                                                                    *)
18	(* [wf] is *derivable* at push from [PrecAll] plus the unconditional   *)
19	(* stored-path bridge of agent_wf; this is the point of replacing the  *)
20	(* old [wf_push_cond] parameter of hp.v.                              *)
21	(* ================================================================== *)
22	
23	Definition HInv0 (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
24	  (γ ⫶ G) /\
25	  inert G /\
26	  (forall (x:var) (T:typ) (v:val), binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T) /\
27	  (forall (x:var) (T0:typ) (ds:defs),
28	      binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds).
29	
30	Definition PrecAll (G:ctx) : Prop :=
31	  forall (p:path) (T:typ), G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
32	
33	Definition Prov (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
34	  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
35	    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
36	    exists W,
37	      G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W } /\
38	      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
39	         G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).
40	
41	(* The bracket half of [Prov] is derivable from the mere existence of a
42	   tight view: both views give selection bounds through [p ↓ A], and the
43	   two bounds compose.  Hence the real push obligation is only the
44	   existence of a tight view (the "provenance" half). *)
45	Definition TightProv (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
46	  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
47	    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
48	    exists W, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }.
49	
50	Lemma Prov_of_TightProv : forall γ G, TightProv γ G -> Prov γ G.
51	Proof.
52	  intros γ G HP p A [S [T Hview]].
53	  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ S (ex_intro _ T Hview))) as [W Htight].
54	  exists W. split; [exact Htight|].
55	  intros S0 T0 Hv. split.
56	  - eapply subtyp_trans.
57	    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hv.
58	    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Htight.
59	  - eapply subtyp_trans.
60	    + eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Htight.
61	    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hv.
62	Qed.
63	
64	Definition HInvS (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
65	  HInv0 γ G /\ PrecAll G /\ Prov γ G /\ wf G.
66	
67	Lemma HInv0_HInv : forall γ G,
68	  HInv0 γ G -> wf G -> HInv γ G.
69	Proof.
70	  intros γ G [Hwt [Hin [Hent Hdef]]] Hwf.
71	  unfold HInv. split; [exact Hwt|]. split; [exact Hin|]. split; [exact Hwf|].
72	  split; assumption.
73	Qed.
74	
75	(* The part of [HInvS] that suffices to replace [wf_push_cond] and to run
76	   the step relation: [HInv0], [PrecAll], and [wf].  [Prov] is kept as a
77	   separate, optional component of [HInvS]. *)

79	  HInv0 γ G /\ PrecAll G /\ wf G.

84	  split; [exact H0 | split; [exact HP | exact Hw]].
85	Qed.

92

94	  HInvP γ G -> binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T.
95	Proof. intros γ G x T v [[_ [_ [H _]]] _] Hb Hv. exact (H x T v Hb Hv). Qed.
96

98	  HInvP γ G -> binds x (μ T0) G -> binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ -> defs_at G x T0 ds.
99	Proof. intros γ G x T0 ds [[_ [_ [_ H]]] _] Hb Hv. exact (H x T0 ds Hb Hv). Qed.
100	
101	Lemma HInvP_prec : forall γ G, HInvP γ G -> PrecAll G.
102	Proof. intros γ G [_ [H _]]. exact H. Qed.
103	
104	Lemma HInvP_wf : forall γ G, HInvP γ G -> wf G.
105	Proof. intros γ G [_ [_ H]]. exact H. Qed.
106	
107	Lemma HInvP_HInv : forall γ G, HInvP γ G -> HInv γ G.

110	Qed.

116	  split; [exact H0 | split; [exact HP | exact Hw]].
117	Qed.

121	Proof. intros γ G [[H _] _]. exact H. Qed.
122	
123	Lemma HInvS_inert : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> inert G.
124	Proof. intros γ G [[_ [H _]] _]. exact H. Qed.

127	  HInvS γ G -> binds x T G -> binds x v γ -> G ⊢!v v : T.
128	Proof. intros γ G x T v [[_ [_ [H _]]] _] Hb Hv. exact (H x T v Hb Hv). Qed.

139	
140	Lemma HInvS_wf : forall γ G, HInvS γ G -> wf G.

144	Proof.

148	(* Reassembly: the four pieces build an [HInvS]. *)
149	Lemma HInvS_intro : forall γ G,
150	  HInv0 γ G -> PrecAll G -> Prov γ G -> wf G -> HInvS γ G.
151	Proof.
152	  intros γ G H0 HP HV Hw. unfold HInvS.
153	  split; [exact H0 | split; [exact HP | split; [exact HV | exact Hw]]].
154	Qed.

156	(* ================================================================== *)
157	(* Empty heap.                                                        *)
158	(*                                                                    *)
159	(* In the empty context there is no ordinary path typing at all: the   *)
160	(* only leaf rule for a path subject is [ty_var], which needs a        *)
161	(* binding.  Hence both [PrecAll] and [Prov] are vacuous.              *)
162	(* ================================================================== *)
163	
164	Lemma empty_path_typing_absurd_gen : forall G (t:trm) T,
165	  G ⊢ t : T -> G = empty -> (exists (p:path), t = trm_path p) -> False.
166	Proof.
167	  intros G t T Hty.
168	  induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros EG Hex.
169	  all: try (destruct Hex as [p0 Ep]; discriminate Ep).
170	  - (* ty_var *) subst G. destruct (binds_empty_inv H).
171	  - (* ty_new_elim *) apply IHHty; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
172	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) apply IHHty; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
173	  - (* ty_sngl *) apply IHHty1; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
174	  - (* ty_path_elim *) apply IHHty1; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
175	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) apply IHHty; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
176	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) apply IHHty; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].
177	  - (* ty_and_intro *) apply IHHty1; [exact EG | eexists; reflexivity].

181	Lemma empty_path_typing_absurd : forall (p:path) T,
182	  (empty:ctx) ⊢ trm_path p : T -> False.
183	Proof.
184	  intros p T Hty.
185	  exact (@empty_path_typing_absurd_gen empty (trm_path p) T Hty eq_refl
186	           (ex_intro _ p eq_refl)).

188	
189	Lemma PrecAll_empty : PrecAll empty.
190	Proof.
191	  intros p T H. exfalso. exact (empty_path_typing_absurd H).
192	Qed.
193	
194	Lemma Prov_empty : Prov (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).
195	Proof.
196	  intros p A [S [T H]]. exfalso. exact (empty_path_typing_absurd H).
197	Qed.
198	
199	Lemma HInv0_empty : HInv0 (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).
200	Proof.
201	  unfold HInv0. split; [apply well_typed_empty|].
202	  split; [apply inert_empty|]. split.
203	  - intros x T v Hb _. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
204	  - intros x T0 ds Hb _. destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).

206	
207	Lemma HInvS_empty : HInvS (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).

211	  - exact PrecAll_empty.
212	  - exact Prov_empty.

216	(* ================================================================== *)
217	(* Stored type members are determined by the [ty_defs] typing.         *)
218	(*                                                                    *)
219	(* The [ty_defs] derivation has exactly one type-member definition per *)
220	(* label, and its declared (tight) type is the one recorded in the     *)
221	(* record type of the definitions.  This is the provenance fact that   *)
222	(* lets a μ-rooted path expose its actual tight member bound.           *)
223	(* ================================================================== *)

225	Lemma label_of_def_typ : forall A T, label_of_def (def_typ A T) = label_typ A.
226	Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

228	Lemma ty_defs_typ_member_unique : forall x bs G ds U,
229	  x; bs; G ⊢ ds :: U ->
230	  forall A W,
231	    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
232	    exists W0, defs_has ds (def_typ A W0) /\ W0 = W.
233	Proof.
234	  intros x bs G ds U Hds. induction Hds as
235	    [ x0 bs0 G0 d D Hd
236	    | x0 bs0 G0 d ds0 D T Hds' IH Hd Hhasnt ].
237	  - (* ty_defs_one *)
238	    intros A W Hhas.
239	    inversion Hhas as [D0 | T U0 D0 Hrh | T U0 D0 Hrh]; subst.
240	    (* the record target is literally the single dec D *)
241	    dependent destruction Hd.
242	    exists W. split; [apply defs_has_cons_same | reflexivity].
243	  - (* ty_defs_cons *)
244	    intros A W Hhas.
245	    inversion Hhas as [D0 | T0 U0 D0 Hrh | T0 U0 D0 Hrh]; subst.
246	    + (* from the left component *)
247	      destruct (IH A W Hrh) as [W0 [Hstored E]].
248	      exists W0. split; [| exact E].
249	      unfold defs_has in *.
250	      rewrite get_def_cons_neq; [exact Hstored|].
251	      intro Elab.
252	      pose proof (proj1 (defs_hasnt_iff ds0 (label_of_def d)) Hhasnt) as Hnot.
253	      exact (Hnot (def_typ A W0) Hstored (eq_sym Elab)).
254	    + (* from the right component (the newly added dec D) *)
255	      assert (Ed : { A >: W <: W } = D)
256	        by (eapply record_has_rcd_inv; exact Hrh).
257	      subst D.
258	      dependent destruction Hd.
259	      exists W. split; [apply defs_has_cons_same | reflexivity].
260	Qed.

262	(* ================================================================== *)
263	(* Preservation of [HInv0] under heap push.                            *)
264	(*                                                                    *)
265	(* This is the well_typed/inert/entries/defs part of [HInv_push]; it   *)
266	(* does not use [wf] and therefore does not use [wf_push_cond].        *)
267	(* ================================================================== *)
268	
269	Lemma HInv0_push : forall γ G x S v,
270	  HInv0 γ G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
271	  G ⊢!v v : S ->
272	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->

276	  unfold HInv0. split; [|split; [|split]].
277	  - apply well_typed_push with (T:=S).
278	    + exact Hwt. + exact HxG. + exact Hxg. + exact (ty_val_p_ty Hval).
279	  - apply inert_push with (T:=S).

282	    destruct (binds_push_inv HbG) as [[Eyx ET] | [Hyx HbG']].

284	      * subst. exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v S Hval x S HxG).
285	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
286	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
287	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
288	      * exact (@ty_val_p_weaken G v' T' (@Hentries y T' v' HbG' Hbγ') x S HxG).

292	      * rewrite Eyx. exact (proj2 (Hnewdefs T0 ds (eq_sym Ev))).
293	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx' Eyx).
294	    + destruct (binds_push_inv Hbγ) as [[Eyx' Ev] | [Hyx' Hbγ']].
295	      * exfalso. exact (Hyx Eyx').
296	      * unfold defs_at in *.
297	        eapply weaken_defs with (G1:=G) (G2:= y ~ open_typ_p (pvar y) T0) (w:=x) (S:=S).
298	        -- exact (@Hdefs y T0 ds HbG' Hbγ').
299	        -- reflexivity.

301	           ++ exact HxG.
302	           ++ apply notin_singleton_l. intro Hxy. apply Hyx'. auto.
303	Qed.

306	(* [wf] push from [PrecAll].                                           *)
307	(*                                                                    *)
308	(* This is the replacement for the old [wf_push_cond] parameter.  The  *)
309	(* only extra ingredient is the unconditional stored-path bridge of    *)
310	(* agent_wf, which supplies ordinary typability of the path [q] from   *)
311	(* a self-flow to a singleton.  [PrecAll] then upgrades it to a        *)
312	(* precise typing, exactly the premise of the [wfe_push] constructor.  *)

315	Lemma wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll : forall γ G x S v,
316	  HInv0 γ G -> wf G ->
317	  x # G ->
318	  G ⊢!v v : S ->
319	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
320	  PrecAll (G & x ~ S) ->
321	  (forall bs q,
322	      G & x ~ S ⊢! p_sel (avar_f x) bs : {{ q }} ⪼ {{ q }} ->
323	      exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! q : U).
324	Proof.
325	  intros γ G x S v H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hnewdefs HP.
326	  assert (Hi : HInv γ G) by (apply HInv0_HInv; assumption).
327	  pose proof (@ty_val_p_inert G v S Hval) as HinertS.
328	  dependent destruction Hval.
329	  - (* lambda: no self-flow to a singleton *)
330	    intros bs q Hflow. exfalso.
331	    assert (Hb : binds x (∀(T) U) (G & x ~ ∀(T) U)) by apply binds_push_eq.
332	    pose proof (@flow_from_all (G & x ~ ∀(T) U) x T U bs {{ q }} {{ q }} Hb Hflow)
333	      as [Esrc _].
334	    discriminate Esrc.
335	  - (* object: stored-path bridge, then PrecAll *)
336	    intros bs q Hflow.
337	    assert (Hrt : record_type T) by (exact (@inert_mu_inv T HinertS)).
338	    assert (Hdefs : defs_at (G & x ~ μ T) x T ds).
339	    { destruct (Hnewdefs T ds eq_refl) as [_ Hd]. exact Hd. }
340	    destruct (@self_flow_stored_path_typed_bridge_proof γ G x T ds q
341	                Hi HxG Hrt Hdefs bs Hflow) as [Tq Hq].
342	    exact (HP q Tq Hq).
343	Qed.

346	Lemma HInv_push_of_PrecAll : forall γ G x S v,
347	  HInv0 γ G -> wf G -> x # G -> x # γ ->
348	  G ⊢!v v : S ->
349	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
350	  PrecAll (G & x ~ S) ->
351	  HInv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
352	Proof.
353	  intros γ G x S v H0 Hwf HxG Hxg Hval Hnewdefs HP.
354	  apply HInv0_HInv.
355	  - eapply HInv0_push; eauto.
356	  - apply wfe_push.
357	    + exact Hwf.
358	    + exact HxG.
359	    + exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hnewdefs HP).
360	Qed.

364	(* ================================================================== *)
365	
366	Lemma weaken_trm_last : forall G (t:trm) T,
367	  G ⊢ t : T -> forall x S, x # G -> G & x ~ S ⊢ t : T.
368	Proof.
369	  intros G t T H x S Hx.
370	  assert (Hx' : x # (G & empty)) by (rewrite dom_concat_empty; exact Hx).
371	  pose proof (@weaken_trm G t T H G empty x S
372	                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G)) Hx') as Hw.
373	  rewrite concat_empty_r in Hw. exact Hw.
374	Qed.

377	(* The four inheritance obligations of the push.                      *)
378	(*                                                                    *)
379	(* The first two concern paths whose head is not the freshly pushed   *)
380	(* variable; the last two concern paths whose head is [x].  They are  *)
381	(* stated as separate [Prop]s so that the unconditional assembly      *)
382	(* below is independent of how they are eventually discharged.        *)

385	Definition OldPathPrecLift : Prop :=
386	  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,
387	    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
388	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
389	    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
390	    x \notin fv_path p ->
391	    exists T', G ⊢ trm_path p : T'.
392	
393	Definition OldPathViewLift : Prop :=
394	  forall γ G x S v (p:path) A S0 T0,
395	    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
396	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
397	    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
398	    x \notin fv_path p ->
399	    exists S1 T1, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 }.

401	Definition PrecAll_push_new : Prop :=
402	  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,
403	    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
404	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
405	    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
406	    x \in fv_path p ->
407	    exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
408	
409	Definition TightProv_push_new : Prop :=
410	  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
411	    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
412	    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
413	    (exists S0 T0, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
414	    x \in fv_path p ->
415	    exists W, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }.

418	(* Assembling [PrecAll] for the pushed context.                       *)
419	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
420	
421	Lemma PrecAll_push : forall γ G x S v,
422	  OldPathPrecLift ->
423	  PrecAll_push_new ->
424	  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
425	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
426	  PrecAll (G & x ~ S).
427	Proof.
428	  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p T Hty.
429	  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
430	  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hin).
431	  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot)
432	      as [T' HtyG].
433	    destruct (@HInvP_prec γ G Hi p T' HtyG) as [U HU].
434	    exists U. exact (@precise2_weaken G p U HU x S HxG).
435	Qed.

437	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
438	(* Assembling [TightProv] (and hence [Prov]) for the pushed context.  *)
439	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
440	
441	Lemma TightProv_push : forall γ G x S v,
442	  OldPathViewLift ->
443	  TightProv_push_new ->
444	  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
445	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
446	  TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
447	Proof.
448	  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p A [S0 [T0 Hview]].
449	  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
450	  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs
451	             (ex_intro _ S0 (ex_intro _ T0 Hview)) Hin).
452	  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p A S0 T0 Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hnot)
453	      as [S1 [T1 Holdview]].
454	    destruct (@HInvS_prov γ G Hi p A (ex_intro _ S1 (ex_intro _ T1 Holdview)))
455	      as [W [HtightG _]].
456	    exists W. exact (@weaken_trm_last G (trm_path p) _ HtightG x S HxG).
457	Qed.

459	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
460	(* Conditional preservation of [HInvS] under heap push.               *)
461	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
462	
463	Lemma HInvS_push : forall γ G x S v,
464	  OldPathPrecLift ->
465	  OldPathViewLift ->
466	  PrecAll_push_new ->
467	  TightProv_push_new ->
468	  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
469	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
470	  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
471	Proof.
472	  intros γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
473	  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec [Hprov Hwf]]].
474	  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
475	    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
476	  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
477	  { eapply PrecAll_push.
478	    - exact HoldP.
479	    - exact HnewP.
480	    - apply HInvP_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hwf].
481	    - exact HxG.
482	    - exact Hxg.
483	    - exact Hval.
484	    - exact Hdefs. }
485	  assert (HT' : TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
486	    by (eapply TightProv_push; eauto).
487	  assert (HV' : Prov (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
488	    by (apply Prov_of_TightProv; exact HT').
489	  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
490	  { apply wfe_push.
491	    - exact Hwf.
492	    - exact HxG.
493	    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
494	  exact (HInvS_intro H0' HP' HV' Hwf').
495	Qed.

502	    HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

504	Lemma HInvS_push_of_obligations :
505	  OldPathPrecLift -> OldPathViewLift ->
506	  PrecAll_push_new -> TightProv_push_new ->
507	  HInvS_push_principle.

510	  exact (@HInvS_push γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV
511	           Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).

516	(* The [HInvP] fragment: HInv0 + PrecAll + wf.                        *)
517	(*                                                                    *)
518	(* This is the fragment needed by the step relation:                  *)
519	(*   - app reduction does not change the heap/context;                 *)
520	(*   - let-value push uses [HInvP_push];                               *)
521	(*   - let-path / let-target inherit through the typing derivation.    *)

523	(* of [HInvP] does not depend on the view-provenance work.             *)

529	  - exact HInv0_empty.
530	  - exact PrecAll_empty.

536	  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
537	  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
538	  HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
539	Proof.
540	  intros γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.

544	  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).

196	  flow_trm_field_precise -> sngl_trans_field_precise ->
197	  precise_trm_field_exists.

200	  - match goal with Hf : G ⊢! p : ?R ⪼ U |- _ =>
201	      exact (Hflow γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty) end.

207	   unfolded flow output which actually contains the field [a].  This is
208	   the trm-label analogue of agent_suball's actual-record provenance and
209	   is where the λ-vs-object impossibility and the store/defs lookup enter. *)
210	Definition runtime_trm_field_provenance : Prop :=
211	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
212	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
213	    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
214	    exists R' U' V,
215	      G ⊢! p : R' ⪼ U' /\ record_has U' {a ⦂ V}.
216

218	  runtime_trm_field_provenance -> flow_trm_field_precise.
219	Proof.
220	  intros Hprov γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty.
221	  destruct (Hprov γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hty) as [R' [U' [V [Hf' Hhas]]]].
222	  exists V. apply (@pt2 G (p • a) V V).
223	  apply pf_fld with (T := R') (U := V).
224	  apply (@flow_record_has G p R' U' {a ⦂ V} Hf'). exact Hhas.
225	Qed.
226	
227	Lemma precise_trm_field_exists_of_provenance_and_sngl :
228	  runtime_trm_field_provenance -> sngl_trans_field_precise ->
229	  precise_trm_field_exists.
230	Proof.
231	  intros Hprov Hsngl.
232	  apply precise_trm_field_exists_of_cases.
233	  - apply flow_trm_field_precise_of_provenance. exact Hprov.
234	  - exact Hsngl.
235	Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush.
Close Scope string_scope.

Lemma wf_ok : forall G, wf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply ok_empty.
  - apply ok_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma flow_weaken : forall C p R U, C ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢! p : R ⪼ U.
Proof.
  intros C p R U Hf. induction Hf; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply pf_bind.
    + apply ok_push; [exact H|exact Hx].
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H0.
      * rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
        apply binds_neq_fresh with (v:=T) (E:=G); auto.
  - apply (@pf_fld (G & x0 ~ S0) p a T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_open p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and1 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
  - apply (@pf_and2 p (G & x0 ~ S0) T U1 U2). apply IHHf; auto.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_weaken : forall C p U, C ⊢!! p : U ->
  forall x S, x # C -> C & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros C p U Hp. induction Hp; intros x0 S0 Hx.
  - apply (@pt2 (G & x0 ~ S0) p T U). exact (@flow_weaken G p T U H x0 S0 Hx).
  - apply (@pt2_sngl_trans (G & x0 ~ S0) p q a U).
    + apply IHHp1; auto.
    + apply IHHp2; auto.
Qed.

   [A>W<W]) to an arbitrary record view [rcd{A>:S<:T}] brackets [W].
   The path [p : U] is what lets [Prov] compare the actual tight view with
   the view reached by subtyping; no star/step induction is needed. *)

Lemma star_record_view_inv_of_Prov :
  forall γ G (p:path) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U A W S T HP HpU Hrt Hhas Hstar.
  assert (HsubUW : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: W <: W })
    by (apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas G)).
  assert (HpTW : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W })
    by (apply ty_sub with (T := U); assumption).
  assert (HsubUV : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })
    by (apply (@star_subtyp_step_sub G U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) Hstar)).
  assert (HpV : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })
    by (apply ty_sub with (T := U); assumption).
  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ W (ex_intro _ W HpTW))) as [W' [Htight Hb]].
  destruct (Hb W W HpTW) as [HWW' HW'W].
  destruct (Hb S T HpV) as [HSW' HW'T].
  split.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HSW' | exact HW'W].
  - eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HWW' | exact HW'T].
Qed.
