Proof.
  intros A R a b c H1. revert c.
  induction H1 as [a0 | a0 b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH]; intros c1 H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply star_step; [exact Hstep | eapply IH; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_star_step : forall G S U,
  G ⊢ S <: U -> star (subtyp_step G) S U.
Proof.
  intros G S U H. induction H using subtyp_ind.
  - (* top *) eapply star_step; [apply st_top | apply star_refl].
  - (* bot *) eapply star_step; [apply st_bot | apply star_refl].
  - (* refl *) eapply star_step; [apply st_refl | apply star_refl].
  - (* trans *) eapply star_trans_gen; [exact IHsubtyp1 | exact IHsubtyp2].
  - (* and11 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and11 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and12 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and12 | apply star_refl].
  - (* and2 *) eapply star_step; [apply st_and2; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* fld *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_fld; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* typ *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_typ; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_pq *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_pq; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sngl_qp *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sngl_qp; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1] | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel2 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel2; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* sel1 *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_sel1; exact H | apply star_refl].
  - (* all *) eapply star_step; [eapply st_all; [exact H | exact H0] | apply star_refl].
Qed.

(* [ty_sub] composition for the full classification: once [U] reaches the
   premise target [R0] by a star, composing with the (star-decomposed)
   rule subtyping [R0 <: R] keeps the star.  This is the branch that was
   previously blocked by the missing transitivity of [subtyp1]. *)
Lemma star_subtyp_step_psub : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 ->
  G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
  star (subtyp_step G) U R.
Proof.
  intros G U R0 R Hstar Hsub.
  eapply star_trans_gen; [exact Hstar | apply subtyp_star_step; exact Hsub].
Qed.

(* In particular, every ordinary subtyping is a star of [subtyp_step]s, so
   a classification result expressed with [star (subtyp_step G)] is stable
   under all [ty_sub] widenings. *)
Lemma record_target_psub_star : forall G (U R0 R:typ),
  star (subtyp_step G) U R0 -> G ⊢ R0 <: R ->
  star (subtyp_step G) U R.
Proof. intros. eapply star_subtyp_step_psub; eauto. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* L. Runtime object relation, corrected classification interfaces.    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Alert addressed: a single [subtyp1] from a whole intersection       *)
(* [U1 ∧ U2] to a record is impossible.  For the type-member           *)
(* classification we therefore select the actual *component*           *)
(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}] and require single-step [subtyp1] from that          *)
(* component.  The full record-shape interface (needed by the          *)
(* [ty_new_elim] induction premise) uses [star subtyp1].               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Strengthened runtime object relation, with defs provenance. *)
Inductive PathObject (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| po_obj x T0 ds :
    binds x (μ T0) G ->
    binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ ->
    DefsTyped (G & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) x nil T0 ds ->
    PathObject γ G (pvar x) (open_typ_p (pvar x) T0)
| po_alias p q U :
    γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ ->
    PathObject γ G q U ->
    PathObject γ G p U
| po_field_obj p a T0 Tv dsv :
    PathObject γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    γ ⟦ defp (p • a) ⤳* defv (ν(Tv) dsv) ⟧ ->
    PathObject γ G (p • a) (open_typ_p (p • a) Tv).

Definition record_view (R:typ) : Prop :=
  exists (A:typ_label) S T, R = typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }.

Definition record_shape (R:typ) : Prop :=
  exists D, R = typ_rcd D.

Lemma record_view_shape : forall R, record_view R -> record_shape R.
Proof.
  intros R [A [S [T E]]]. exists {A >: S <: T}. exact E.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Type-member classification (component-selected).                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The returned [U] is the actual whole record (provenance), [W] is    *)
(* the actual tight bound of member [A], and every view is a single    *)
(* [subtyp1] step from the *component* [rcd{A>:W<:W}], never from the  *)
(* whole intersection.                                                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition record_target_classification : Prop :=
  forall γ G p A,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      PathObject γ G p U /\ record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      (forall S T,
         G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

(* The component [rcd{A>:W<:W}] is itself an actual tight record, so it
   directly witnesses [path_actual_record_trans_free]. *)
Lemma path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> path_actual_record_trans_free.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G p A Hi Hview.
  destruct (HC γ G p A Hi Hview) as [U [W [Hpo [Hrt [Hhas HW]]]]].
  exists (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }), W. split.
  - apply record_type_rcd_of_dec. apply rd_typ.
  - split.
  - split.
    + apply rh_one.
    + intros S T Hty. apply HW. exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_member_bound_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> canonical_member_bound.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply canonical_member_bound_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma typ_member_common_bound_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> typ_member_common_bound.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply typ_member_common_bound_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma alias_typ_member_coherence_of_classification :
  record_target_classification -> alias_typ_member_coherence.
Proof.
  intro HC. apply alias_typ_member_coherence_of_actual_trans_free.
  apply path_actual_record_trans_free_of_classification. exact HC.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Full record-shape classification, using [star subtyp1] to allow the *)
(* and-projections that a whole intersection needs.  This is the form  *)
(* required by the [ty_new_elim] premise (a term-field record).        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition record_target_classification_full : Prop :=
  forall γ G p,
    HInv γ G ->
    (exists R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R /\ record_shape R) ->
    exists U,
      PathObject γ G p U /\ record_type U /\
      (forall R, G ⊢ trm_path p : R -> record_shape R ->
         star (subtyp_step G) U R).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* [ty_var] base case facts (proven).                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma PathObject_var : forall γ G x T0 ds,
  HInv γ G ->
  binds x (μ T0) G ->
  binds x (ν(T0) ds) γ ->
  PathObject γ G (pvar x) (open_typ_p (pvar x) T0).
Proof.
  intros γ G x T0 ds Hi HbG Hbγ.
  destruct Hi as [Hwt [Hinert [Hwf [Hentries Hdefs]]]].
  apply po_obj with (ds := ds); auto.
  apply defs_at_DefsTyped. apply Hdefs; auto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_no_record_view : forall (T:typ),
  inert_typ T -> record_view T -> False.
Proof.
  intros T Hin [A [S [T0 E]]]. subst T. inversion Hin.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_record_view_absurd : forall G x T0,
  binds x T0 G -> inert_typ T0 -> record_view T0 -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_typ_no_record_view; eauto. Qed.

Lemma PathObject_alias_inv : forall γ G p q U,
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defp q ⟧ -> PathObject γ G q U -> PathObject γ G p U.
Proof. intros. apply po_alias with (q := q); auto. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Component-view bounds.  For the component-selected classification  *)
(* the source of every view is the single tight component              *)
(* [rcd{A>:W<:W}]; a trans-free view of it is exactly the bound        *)
(* bracket [S <: W <: T].                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds : forall G (A:typ_label) W S T,
  subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
  G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros G A W S T Hsub.
  assert (Hrt : record_type (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }))
    by (apply record_type_rcd_of_dec; apply rd_typ).
  assert (Hfs : flow_shape (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }))
    by (apply fs_rec; exact Hrt).
  destruct (@subtyp1_typ_member_inv G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) A S T Hfs Hsub)
    as [W' [_ [Hhas' [Hl' Hu']]]].
  assert (E : W' = W)
    by (eapply record_has_typ_unique; [exact Hrt | exact Hhas' | apply rh_one]).
  subst W'. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* Consequently the component-selected classification yields the
   canonical bound bracket for every view. *)
Lemma record_target_classification_bounds :
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists W, forall S T,
       G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       subtyp1 G (typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }) (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }))
  ->
  (forall γ G p A, HInv γ G ->
     (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
     exists W, forall S T,
       G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
       G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T).
Proof.
  intros HC γ G p A Hi Hview.
  destruct (HC γ G p A Hi Hview) as [W HW].
  exists W. intros S T Hty.
  exact (@subtyp1_rcd_typ_view_bounds G A W S T (HW S T Hty)).
Qed.


(* ================================================================== *)
(* N. Warning: the HInv-free star record-view inversion is FALSE.      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Counterexample pattern (the loose-record selection detour):         *)
(*   G := empty & z ~ rcd{A0 >: U <: rcd{A>:S<:T}}                     *)
(*   U := rcd{A>:W<:W}  (a record_type with the actual member A:W)     *)
(* The same binding gives two ordinary typings of [z]:                 *)
(*   z : rcd{A0>:U<:rcd{A>:S<:T}}                                      *)
(* hence the two atoms                                                *)
(*   st_sel2 : subtyp_step G U (z ↓ A0)                                *)
(*   st_sel1 : subtyp_step G (z ↓ A0) (rcd{A>:S<:T})                   *)
(* and therefore a star from U to the view [rcd{A>:S<:T}].  But [S,T]  *)
(* are arbitrary (they are just the upper bound of the loose member     *)
(* A0), so [S <: W <: T] need not hold.  This is exactly the           *)
(* counter_bridge2 loose-record pattern; HInv/inertness is essential.  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The correct residual must therefore carry HInv:                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition star_record_view_inv_HInv : Prop :=
  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    HInv γ G ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.

(* What is already proven toward it: the star decomposition
   [subtyp_star_step], the star Psub [record_target_psub_star], label
   uniqueness [record_has_typ_unique]/[record_typ_has_label_in], and the

   exclusion for the sel detours). *)

(* Actual-record provenance implies a tight view.                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the easy half of the view-provenance obligation: if the    *)

(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Provenance_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->

      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : U.

  Provenance_push_new -> TightProv_push_new.
Proof.
  intros Hprov γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hin.

  - exact HpU.
  - apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas (G & x ~ S)).

| pt2: forall G p T U,

    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! q•a : U ->
    G ⊢!! p•a : {{ q•a }}

Inductive precise_typing3: ctx -> path -> typ -> Prop :=
| pt3: forall G p T,
    G ⊢!! p : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p: T
| pt3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!!! q : T ->
    G ⊢!!! p : T
where "G '⊢!!!' p ':' T" := (precise_typing3 G p T).

| wfe_empty :

    repl_typ q p T1 T2.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The four inheritance obligations of the push.                      *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The first two concern paths whose head is not the freshly pushed   *)
(* variable; the last two concern paths whose head is [x].  They are  *)
(* stated as separate [Prop]s so that the unconditional assembly      *)
(* below is independent of how they are eventually discharged.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition OldPathPrecLift : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    exists T', G ⊢ trm_path p : T'.

Definition OldPathViewLift : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) A S0 T0,
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    exists S1 T1, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 }.

Definition PrecAll_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) T,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    x \in fv_path p ->
    exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! p : U.

Definition TightProv_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (exists S0 T0, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    x \in fv_path p ->
    exists W, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: W <: W }.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Assembling [PrecAll] for the pushed context.                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma PrecAll_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  PrecAll (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p T Hty.
  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hin).
  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot)
      as [T' HtyG].
    destruct (@HInvP_prec γ G Hi p T' HtyG) as [U HU].
    exists U. exact (@precise2_weaken G p U HU x S HxG).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Assembling [TightProv] (and hence [Prov]) for the pushed context.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma TightProv_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathViewLift ->
  TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v Hold Hnew Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs p A [S0 [T0 Hview]].
  destruct (classic (x \in fv_path p)) as [Hin | Hnot].
  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs
             (ex_intro _ S0 (ex_intro _ T0 Hview)) Hin).
  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p A S0 T0 Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hnot)
      as [S1 [T1 Holdview]].
    destruct (@HInvS_prov γ G Hi p A (ex_intro _ S1 (ex_intro _ T1 Holdview)))
      as [W [HtightG _]].
    exists W. exact (@weaken_trm_last G (trm_path p) _ HtightG x S HxG).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional preservation of [HInvS] under heap push.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma HInvS_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec [Hprov Hwf]]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HiP : HInvP γ G).
  { apply HInvP_intro; assumption. }
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply (@PrecAll_push γ G x S v HoldP HnewP HiP HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs). }
  assert (HiS : HInvS γ G).
  { apply HInvS_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hprov | exact Hwf]. }
  assert (HT' : TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply (@TightProv_push γ G x S v HoldV HnewV HiS HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs). }
  assert (HV' : Prov (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (apply Prov_of_TightProv; exact HT').
  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply wfe_push.
    - exact Hwf.
    - exact HxG.
    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
  exact (HInvS_intro H0' HP' HV' Hwf').
Qed.

(* The same statement packaged as a single push principle. *)
Definition HInvS_push_principle : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Lemma HInvS_push_of_obligations :
  OldPathPrecLift -> OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new -> TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV γ G x S v Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  exact (@HInvS_push γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV
           Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).
Qed.


(* ================================================================== *)
(* The [HInvP] fragment: HInv0 + PrecAll + wf.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the fragment needed by the step relation:                  *)
(*   - app reduction does not change the heap/context;                 *)
(*   - let-value push uses [HInvP_push];                               *)
(*   - let-path / let-target inherit through the typing derivation.    *)
(* [Prov] is deliberately not a component here, so the preservation   *)
(* of [HInvP] does not depend on the view-provenance work.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma HInvP_empty : HInvP (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).
Proof.
  apply HInvP_intro.
  - exact HInv0_empty.
  - exact PrecAll_empty.
  - apply wfe_empty.
Qed.

Lemma HInvP_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec Hwf]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
  { eapply PrecAll_push.
    - exact HoldP. - exact HnewP.
    - apply HInvP_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hwf].
    - exact HxG. - exact Hxg. - exact Hval. - exact Hdefs. }
  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply wfe_push.
    - exact Hwf.
    - exact HxG.
    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
  exact (HInvP_intro H0' HP' Hwf').
Qed.

Definition HInvP_push_principle : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Lemma HInvP_push_of_obligations :
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new -> HInvP_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros HoldP HnewP γ G x S v Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  exact (@HInvP_push γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Actual-record provenance implies a tight view.                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the easy half of the view-provenance obligation: if the    *)
(* path has an ordinary typing at an actual record [U] whose member   *)
(* [A] has tight bound [W], then [record_has_sub] plus [ty_sub] gives *)
(* the tight view.  The remaining obligation is exactly to produce    *)
(* such an actual [U] and [W] from an arbitrary record view.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Provenance_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (exists S0 T0, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    x \in fv_path p ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : U.

Lemma TightProv_push_new_of_provenance :
  Provenance_push_new -> TightProv_push_new.
Proof.
  intros Hprov γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hin.
  destruct (Hprov γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hin)
    as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas HpU]]]].
  exists W.
  eapply ty_sub.
  - exact HpU.
  - apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas (G & x ~ S)).
Qed.

(* Conditional [HInvS] push with the provenance-shaped new-path
   obligation instead of the tight-view-shaped one. *)
Lemma HInvS_push_of_provenance : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  Provenance_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP Hprov Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  eapply HInvS_push.
  - exact HoldP.
  - exact HoldV.
  - exact HnewP.
  - apply TightProv_push_new_of_provenance. exact Hprov.
  - exact Hi.
  - exact HxG.
  - exact Hxg.
  - exact Hval.

  - exact (Hnew γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs
             (ex_intro _ S0 (ex_intro _ T0 Hview)) Hin).
  - destruct (Hold γ G x S v p A S0 T0 Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hnot)
      as [S1 [T1 Holdview]].

Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conditional preservation of [HInvS] under heap push.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma HInvS_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec [Hprov Hwf]]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HiP : HInvP γ G).
  { apply HInvP_intro; assumption. }
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply (@PrecAll_push γ G x S v HoldP HnewP HiP HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs). }
  assert (HiS : HInvS γ G).
  { apply HInvS_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hprov | exact Hwf]. }
  assert (HT' : TightProv (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply (@TightProv_push γ G x S v HoldV HnewV HiS HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs). }
  assert (HV' : Prov (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (apply Prov_of_TightProv; exact HT').
  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply wfe_push.
    - exact Hwf.
    - exact HxG.
    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
  exact (HInvS_intro H0' HP' HV' Hwf').
Qed.

(* The same statement packaged as a single push principle. *)
Definition HInvS_push_principle : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Lemma HInvS_push_of_obligations :
  OldPathPrecLift -> OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new -> TightProv_push_new ->
  HInvS_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV γ G x S v Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  exact (@HInvS_push γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP HnewV
           Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).
Qed.


(* ================================================================== *)
(* The [HInvP] fragment: HInv0 + PrecAll + wf.                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the fragment needed by the step relation:                  *)
(*   - app reduction does not change the heap/context;                 *)
(*   - let-value push uses [HInvP_push];                               *)
(*   - let-path / let-target inherit through the typing derivation.    *)
(* [Prov] is deliberately not a component here, so the preservation   *)
(* of [HInvP] does not depend on the view-provenance work.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma HInvP_empty : HInvP (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).
Proof.
  apply HInvP_intro.
  - exact HInv0_empty.
  - exact PrecAll_empty.
  - apply wfe_empty.
Qed.

Lemma HInvP_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec Hwf]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).
  { eapply PrecAll_push.
    - exact HoldP. - exact HnewP.
    - apply HInvP_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hwf].
    - exact HxG. - exact Hxg. - exact Hval. - exact Hdefs. }
  assert (Hwf' : wf (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply wfe_push.
    - exact Hwf.
    - exact HxG.
    - exact (wf_push_cond_from_PrecAll H0 Hwf HxG Hval Hdefs HP'). }
  exact (HInvP_intro H0' HP' Hwf').
Qed.

Definition HInvP_push_principle : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).

Lemma HInvP_push_of_obligations :
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new -> HInvP_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros HoldP HnewP γ G x S v Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  exact (@HInvP_push γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Actual-record provenance implies a tight view.                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the easy half of the view-provenance obligation: if the    *)
(* path has an ordinary typing at an actual record [U] whose member   *)
(* [A] has tight bound [W], then [record_has_sub] plus [ty_sub] gives *)
(* the tight view.  The remaining obligation is exactly to produce    *)
(* such an actual [U] and [W] from an arbitrary record view.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Provenance_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (exists S0 T0, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    x \in fv_path p ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : U.

Lemma TightProv_push_new_of_provenance :
  Provenance_push_new -> TightProv_push_new.
Proof.
  intros Hprov γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hin.
  destruct (Hprov γ G x S v p A Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs Hview Hin)
    as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas HpU]]]].
  exists W.
  eapply ty_sub.
  - exact HpU.
  - apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas (G & x ~ S)).
Qed.

(* Conditional [HInvS] push with the provenance-shaped new-path
   obligation instead of the tight-view-shaped one. *)
Lemma HInvS_push_of_provenance : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift ->
  OldPathViewLift ->
  PrecAll_push_new ->
  Provenance_push_new ->
  HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvS (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HoldV HnewP Hprov Hi HxG Hxg Hval Hdefs.
  eapply HInvS_push.
  - exact HoldP.
  - exact HoldV.
  - exact HnewP.
  - apply TightProv_push_new_of_provenance. exact Hprov.
  - exact Hi.
  - exact HxG.
  - exact Hxg.
  - exact Hval.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import agent_hinvs agent_provstar.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Connecting the provenance-shaped push obligation to actual records. *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [ActualViewProvenance] says: every record view of a path comes from *)
(* a genuine record [U] that the path also has as an ordinary type,   *)
(* with the tight member [A >: W <: W] present in [U].  From this the *)
(* tight view is [record_has_sub] + [ty_sub], and [Prov] follows from *)
(* [Prov_of_TightProv].                                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [star_record_view_inv_of_Prov] (agent_provstar) gives a second,     *)
(* star-based route to the bracket half: once [Prov] holds, any star   *)
(* from the actual record [U] to a view is bracketed by [W].  The      *)
(* lemma [bracket_via_star] below records that compatibility.          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition ActualViewProvenance (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G ⊢ trm_path p : U.

Lemma TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenance :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenance γ G -> TightProv γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G HP p A Hview.
  destruct (HP p A Hview) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas HpU]]]].
  exists W.
  eapply ty_sub.
  - exact HpU.
  - apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas G).
Qed.

Lemma Prov_of_ActualViewProvenance :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenance γ G -> Prov γ G.
Proof.
  intros. apply Prov_of_TightProv. apply TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenance. exact H.
Qed.

(* Compatibility with the star-based inversion of agent_provstar. *)
Lemma bracket_via_star :
  forall γ G (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    Prov γ G ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros γ G U A W S T HP Hrt Hhas Hstar.
  assert (Hprov : Prov γ G) by exact HP.
  (* a path typing of [U] is supplied by the caller in the application;
     here we expose the exact agent_provstar interface for a path [p]. *)
  exact (@star_record_view_inv_of_Prov γ G (p_sel (avar_b 0) nil) U A W S T
           HP (ltac:(match goal with
                     | H : _ ⊢ trm_path _ : U |- _ => exact H
                     end)) Hrt Hhas Hstar).
Abort.

(* The version with the path-typing premise explicit, matching
   [star_record_view_inv_of_Prov] exactly. *)
Lemma bracket_via_star_path :
  forall γ G (p:path) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply star_record_view_inv_of_Prov; eauto.
Qed.

(* The bracket half of [Prov] via provenance + star.  This uses
   [bracket_via_star_path] with the [Prov] derived from the provenance. *)
Lemma ActualViewProvenance_bracket_via_star :
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) S T,
    ActualViewProvenance γ G ->
    (exists S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    exists W, G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A S T HP Hview Hv.
  destruct (HP p A Hview) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas HpU]]]].
  exists W.
  (* the star from [U] to the view is a subtyping derivation in this
     setting; its decomposition is [subtyp_star_step]. *)
  assert (Hsub : G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }).
  { eapply subtyp_trans.
    - exact (ltac:(eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2
        (fun H => H) )))))) . }
Abort.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import agent_hinvs agent_provstar.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Connecting the provenance-shaped push obligation to actual records. *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [ActualViewProvenance] says: every record view of a path comes from *)
(* a genuine record [U] that the path also has as an ordinary type,   *)
(* with the tight member [A >: W <: W] present in [U].  From this the *)
(* tight view is [record_has_sub] + [ty_sub], and [Prov] follows from *)
(* [Prov_of_TightProv].                                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [star_record_view_inv_of_Prov] (agent_provstar) gives a second,     *)
(* star-based route to the bracket half: once [Prov] holds, any star   *)
(* from the actual record [U] to a view is bracketed by [W].  The      *)
(* lemma [ActualViewProvenanceStar_bracket] records this compatibility.*)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition ActualViewProvenance (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G ⊢ trm_path p : U.

(* The star-enriched form: the actual record [U] additionally reaches
   every view by a star of [subtyp_step]s, which is what the runtime
   provenance construction naturally supplies. *)
Definition ActualViewProvenanceStar (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    (exists S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G ⊢ trm_path p : U /\
      (forall S T, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
         star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T })).

Lemma ActualViewProvenance_of_star :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenanceStar γ G -> ActualViewProvenance γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G HP p A Hview.
  destruct (HP p A Hview) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas [HpU _]]]]].
  exists U, W. split; [exact Hrt | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenance :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenance γ G -> TightProv γ G.
Proof.
  intros γ G HP p A Hview.
  destruct (HP p A Hview) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas HpU]]]].
  exists W.
  eapply ty_sub.
  - exact HpU.
  - apply (@record_has_sub U { A >: W <: W } Hhas G).
Qed.

Lemma Prov_of_ActualViewProvenance :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenance γ G -> Prov γ G.
Proof.
  intros. apply Prov_of_TightProv. apply TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenance. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenanceStar :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenanceStar γ G -> TightProv γ G.
Proof.
  intros. apply TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenance.
  apply ActualViewProvenance_of_star. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Prov_of_ActualViewProvenanceStar :
  forall γ G, ActualViewProvenanceStar γ G -> Prov γ G.
Proof.
  intros. apply Prov_of_TightProv. apply TightProv_of_ActualViewProvenanceStar. exact H.
Qed.

(* The explicit agent_provstar interface: the star from the actual
   record to a view is bracketed by the actual tight member. *)
Lemma bracket_via_star_path :
  forall γ G (p:path) (U:typ) (A:typ_label) W S T,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : U ->
    record_type U ->
    record_has U { A >: W <: W } ->
    star (subtyp_step G) U (typ_rcd { A >: S <: T }) ->
    G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply star_record_view_inv_of_Prov; eauto.
Qed.

(* Consistency check: for the star-enriched provenance the bracket for
   every view can also be recovered through agent_provstar rather than
   through the tight view.  Both routes agree. *)
Lemma ActualViewProvenanceStar_bracket :
  forall γ G (p:path) (A:typ_label) S T,
    ActualViewProvenanceStar γ G ->
    (exists S0 T0, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S <: T } ->
    exists W, G ⊢ S <: W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p A S T HP Hview Hv.
  destruct (HP p A Hview) as [U [W [Hrt [Hhas [HpU Hstar]]]]].
  exists W.
  exact (bracket_via_star_path (Prov_of_ActualViewProvenanceStar HP)
           HpU Hrt Hhas (Hstar S T Hv)).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The push-shaped provenance obligation, and its reduction to the     *)
(* uncovered new-path case.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition ActualProvenance_push_new : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (p:path) (A:typ_label),
    HInvS γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    (exists S0 T0, G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 }) ->
    x \in fv_path p ->
    exists U W,
      record_type U /\
      record_has U { A >: W <: W } /\
      G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : U.

Lemma Provenance_push_new_of_actual :
  ActualProvenance_push_new -> Provenance_push_new.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma TightProv_push_new_of_actual_provenance :
  ActualProvenance_push_new -> TightProv_push_new.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm_p (k: nat) (u: path) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v      => trm_val (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  | trm_path p     => trm_path (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | trm_app p q    => trm_app (open_rec_path_p k u p) (open_rec_path_p k u q)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm_p k u t1) (open_rec_trm_p (S k) u t2)
  end
with open_rec_val_p (k: nat) (u: path) (v: val): val :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds => ν(open_rec_typ_p (S k) u T) open_rec_defs_p (S k) u ds
  | λ(T) e  => λ(open_rec_typ_p k u T) open_rec_trm_p (S k) u e
  end
with open_rec_def_p (k: nat) (u: path) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec_typ_p k u T)
  | { a := t } => { a := open_rec_defrhs_p k u t }
  end
with open_rec_defs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs_p k u tl) (open_rec_def_p k u d)
  end
with open_rec_defrhs_p (k: nat) (u: path) (drhs: def_rhs) : def_rhs :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => defp (open_rec_path_p k u p)
  | defv v => defv (open_rec_val_p k u v)
  end.

Definition open_avar_p u a := open_rec_avar_p  0 u a.

Definition open_typ_p  u t := open_rec_typ_p   0 u t.

Definition open_dec_p  u D := open_rec_dec_p   0 u D.

Definition open_path_p u p := open_rec_path_p  0 u p.

Definition open_trm_p  u t := open_rec_trm_p   0 u t.

Definition open_val_p  u v := open_rec_val_p   0 u v.

Definition open_def_p  u d := open_rec_def_p   0 u d.

Definition open_defs_p u l := open_rec_defs_p 0 u l.

Definition open_defrhs_p u t := open_rec_defrhs_p 0 u t.

Inductive repl_typ : path -> path -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| rrcd: forall p q D1 D2,
    repl_dec p q D1 D2 ->
    repl_typ p q (typ_rcd D1) (typ_rcd D2)
| rand1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (T1 ∧ U) (T2 ∧ U)
| rand2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (U ∧ T1) (U ∧ T2)
| rpath: forall p q bs A,
    repl_typ p q (p••bs ↓ A) (q••bs ↓ A)
| rbnd: forall p q T1 T2,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (μ T1) (μ T2)
| rall1: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(T1) U) (∀(T2) U)
| rall2: forall p q T1 T2 U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_typ p q (∀(U) T1) (∀(U) T2)
| rsngl: forall p q bs,
    repl_typ p q {{ p••bs }} {{ q••bs }}
with repl_dec : path -> path -> dec -> dec -> Prop :=
| rdtyp1: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: T1 <: U} {A >: T2 <: U}
| rdtyp2: forall p q T1 T2 A U,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {A >: U <: T1} {A >: U <: T2}
| rdtrm: forall p q T1 T2 a,
    repl_typ p q T1 T2 ->
    repl_dec p q {a ⦂ T1} {a ⦂ T2}.

Definition fv_avar (a: avar) : vars :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => \{}
  | avar_f x => \{x}
  end.

Fixpoint fv_path (p: path) : vars :=
  match p with
  | p_sel x bs => fv_avar x
  end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => fv_dec D
  | T ∧ U          => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | p ↓ L          => fv_path p
  | μ T            => fv_typ T
  | ∀(T1) T2       => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | {{ p }}        => fv_path p
  end
with fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end

1	Set Implicit Arguments.
2	Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
3	Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
4	Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
5	Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed.
6	Close Scope string_scope.

8	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
9	(* Verified pieces toward bridge 1
10	   (ordinary arrow path typing -> precise3 at a flow-shaped subtype).
11	   The raw [flow_shape_no_arrow_bridge] in agent_bridge.v is refuted by
12	   counter_bridge2.v; the HInv-aware assembly is in aux_bridge_fixed.v. *)
13	
14	(* The bridge predicate at an arbitrary target type T. *)
15	Definition Bridge (γ:sta) (G:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
16	  exists U, G ⊢!!! p : U /\ flow_shape U /\ G ⊢ U <: T.
17	
18	(* Base case: a precise flow already is a bridge witness (its own output
19	   type, classified by flow_shape_of_flow). *)
20	Lemma bridge_of_flow : forall γ G p R T,
21	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> Bridge γ G p T.
22	Proof.
23	  intros γ G p R T Hi Hf.
24	  exists T. split; [|split].
25	  - apply (@pt3 G p T). apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact Hf.
26	  - exact (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p R T Hi Hf).
27	  - apply (@subtyp_refl G T).
28	Qed.
29	
30	(* Subtyping closure is immediate: keep the same witness and compose.  This
31	   is what makes the [ty_sub] case of the eventual induction trivial. *)
32	Lemma bridge_sub : forall γ G p T U,
33	  Bridge γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Bridge γ G p U.
34	Proof.
35	  intros γ G p T U [W [Hp [Hfs Hsub]]] Htu.
36	  exists W. split; [exact Hp|]. split; [exact Hfs|].
37	  eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
38	Qed.
39	
40	(* Inert types are flow-shaped. *)
41	Lemma inert_flow_shape : forall T, inert_typ T -> flow_shape T.
42	Proof.
43	  intros T H. destruct H as [S U | T0 ls Hrt].
44	  - apply fs_all.
45	  - apply fs_bnd. exists ls; exact Hrt.
46	Qed.
47	
48	(* Binding types in an HInv context are flow-shaped. *)
49	Lemma HInv_bind_flow_shape : forall γ G x T,
50	  HInv γ G -> binds x T G -> flow_shape T.
51	Proof.
52	  intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply HInv_bind_inert; eauto.
53	Qed.
54	
55	(* HInv forbids record-typed bindings.  This is the fact that rules out the
56	   counterexample's loose-record trick at the variable base case. *)
57	Lemma HInv_no_rcd_bind : forall γ G x a T,
58	  HInv γ G -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) G -> False.
59	Proof.
60	  intros γ G x a T Hi Hb.
61	  destruct (HInv_entries Hi Hb) as [v [_ Hv]].
62	  inversion Hv.
63	Qed.
64	
65	(* A flow immediately gives a precise2 typing at its output. *)
66	Lemma flow_precise2_exists : forall (γ:sta) G p R T,
67	  G ⊢! p : R ⪼ T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
68	Proof. intros. exists T. apply (@pt2 G p R T). exact H. Qed.
69	
70	(* Two facts isolated as the remaining obstructions for bridge 1. *)
71	
72	(* (O1) Record-field extraction from a flow-shaped subtype of a record.
73	   Needed by [ty_new_elim]: from a flow output U with U <: {a : T}, recover
74	   a field declaration V of U (so that pf_fld applies) with V <: T.  Under
75	   HInv this must use provenance of U (the raw version is false). *)
76	Definition flow_shape_field_of_sub : Prop :=
77	  forall γ G U a T,
78	    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} ->
79	    exists V, flow_shape V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.
80	
81	(* (O2) Reverse-field (record introduction) for the bridge witness.
82	   Needed by [ty_rcd_intro]: from a bridge witness V <: T for p•a, produce a
83	   flow-shaped witness W <: {a : T} for p (or a precise3 of p at such W). *)
84	Definition bridge_rcd_intro : Prop :=
85	  forall γ G p a T,
86	    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G (p•a) T ->
87	    exists W, G ⊢!!! p : W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}.
88	
89	(* (O3) The singleton/alias refinement needed by [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]:
90	   a bridge witness below a singleton can be turned into a precise2 typing at
91	   the singleton itself. *)
92	Definition bridge_sngl_refine : Prop :=
93	  forall γ G p q,
94	    HInv γ G -> Bridge γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
95	
96	(* (Reduced goal suggested by the coordinator.) *)
97	Definition precise_exists_of_path_typing : Prop :=
98	  forall γ G p A, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : A -> is_arrow A ->
99	    exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
100	
101	(* (Full bridge 1, imported from agent_bridge.v.) *)
102	Check ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
103	
104	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
105	(* Verified precision lemmas used by the singleton/alias cases of bridge 1. *)
106	
107	(* Every precise2 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
108	Lemma precise2_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
109	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
110	Proof.
111	  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
112	  - apply (@flow_shape_of_flow γ G p T U Hi H).
113	  - apply fs_sngl.
114	Qed.
115	
116	(* Every precise3 typing has a flow-shaped type, under HInv. *)
117	Lemma precise3_flow_shape : forall γ G p U,
118	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U -> flow_shape U.
119	Proof.
120	  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
121	  - eapply precise2_flow_shape; eauto.
122	  - exact (IHHp Hi).
123	Qed.
124	
125	(* Transitivity of precise3 at a singleton: this makes the [ty_sngl] case of
126	   bridge 1 go through once the singleton witness has been refined. *)
127	Lemma precise3_sngl_trans_gen : forall G p S q T,
128	  G ⊢!!! p : S -> S = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.
129	Proof.
130	  intros G p S q T H1. revert q T.
131	  induction H1; intros q0 T0 ES H2.
132	  - subst. apply (@pt3_sngl_trans G p q0 T0); auto.
133	  - eapply pt3_sngl_trans; [exact H|].
134	    apply (IHprecise_typing3 q0 T0 ES H2).
135	Qed.
136	
137	Lemma precise3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
138	  G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.
139	Proof.
140	  intros. eapply precise3_sngl_trans_gen; [exact H|reflexivity|exact H0].
141	Qed.
142	
143	(* A precise2 typing is a bridge witness for its own type, under HInv. *)
144	Lemma bridge_of_precise2 : forall γ G p U,
145	  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> Bridge γ G p U.
146	Proof.
147	  intros γ G p U Hi Hp.
148	  exists U. split; [|split].
149	  - apply pt3. exact Hp.
150	  - eapply precise2_flow_shape; eauto.
151	  - apply (@subtyp_refl G U).
152	Qed.
153	
154	
155	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
156	(* R/Rsing/F decomposition (coordinator suggestion).
157	
158	   R      p T := exists U, C⊢!! p:U
159	   Rsing  p T := forall q, T = {{q}} -> C⊢!! p:{{q}}
160	   F      p T := forall a S, T = {a⦂S} -> exists V, C⊢!! (p•a):V
161	
162	   The structural induction goes through for every rule except [ty_sub],
163	   where exactly the two closure facts below are needed.  [R] itself is
164	   independent of T, so the [ty_sub] case for [R] is immediate; the two
165	   closure facts are only needed to maintain [Rsing]/[F] through [ty_sub]
166	   (so that outer [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]/[ty_new_elim] can consume them). *)
167	
168	Definition R (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
169	  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.
170	
171	Definition Rsing (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
172	  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
173	
174	Definition F (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
175	  forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> exists V, C ⊢!! (p • a) : V.
176	
177	Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
178	  forall C p T, inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.
179	
180	(* Minimal [ty_sub] closure for singleton targets. *)
181	Definition Rsing_sub_closure : Prop :=
182	  forall C p T q, inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.
183	
184	(* Minimal [ty_sub] closure for record targets (field existence/precision). *)
185	Definition field_sub_closure : Prop :=
186	  forall C p T (a:trm_label) S,
187	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
188	    exists V, C ⊢!! (p • a) : V.
189	
190	(* The two closure facts imply the reduced precise2-existence bridge, provided
191	   the structural R/Rsing/F induction (which is purely syntactic) is carried
192	   out.  Recorded here as the precise integration shape. *)
193	Definition RRF_suffices : Prop :=
194	  Rsing_sub_closure -> field_sub_closure -> inert_path_precise_bridge.
195	
196	(* Verified inert-context facts used by the R/Rsing/F base cases. *)
197	Lemma inert_ok : forall C, inert C -> ok C.
198	Proof. intros C H. induction H. - apply ok_empty. - apply ok_push; auto. Qed.
199	
200	Lemma inert_bind_inert : forall C x T, inert C -> binds x T C -> inert_typ T.
201	Proof.
202	  intros C x T H. induction H; intros Hb.
203	  - destruct (binds_empty_inv Hb).
204	  - apply binds_push_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [[E1 E2] | [_ Hb']].
205	    + subst. exact H0.
206	    + exact (IHinert Hb').
207	Qed.
208	
209	Lemma inert_typ_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), inert_typ T -> T = {{ q }} -> False.
210	Proof. intros T q H E. subst T. inversion H. Qed.
211	
212	Lemma inert_typ_not_rcd : forall T (a:trm_label) S, inert_typ T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> False.
213	Proof. intros T a S H E. subst T. inversion H. Qed.
214	
215	Lemma inert_bind_not_sngl : forall C x (q:path), inert C -> binds x {{ q }} C -> False.
216	Proof.
217	  intros. eapply inert_typ_not_sngl; [|reflexivity]. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto.
218	Qed.
219	
220	Lemma inert_bind_not_rcd : forall C x (a:trm_label) S,
221	  inert C -> binds x (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) C -> False.
222	Proof.
223	  intros. eapply inert_typ_not_rcd; [|reflexivity]. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto.
224	Qed.
225	
226	Lemma inert_bind_flow_shape : forall C x T, inert C -> binds x T C -> flow_shape T.
227	Proof. intros. apply inert_flow_shape. eapply inert_bind_inert; eauto. Qed.
228	
229	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
230	(* Precise3-based singleton invariant (coordinator refinement).
231	
232	   precise2 is not closed under singleton transitivity, but precise3 is
233	   (precise3_sngl_trans, proved above), so Rsing uses precise3. *)
234	
235	Definition Rsing3 (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
236	  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
237	
238	(* Minimal singleton-target subtyping inversion under inert typing. *)
239	Definition sngl_sub_precise3 : Prop :=
240	  forall C p T q,
241	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> C ⊢ T <: {{ q }} ->
242	    C ⊢!!! p : {{ q }}.
243	
244	(* Two-sided form used inside the typing induction at [ty_sub]: the [Rsing3]
245	   invariant is available for the source type T, and must be transported to
246	   the target B along T <: B. *)
247	Definition Rsing3_sub_closure : Prop :=
248	  forall C p T B,
249	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Rsing3 C p T -> C ⊢ T <: B ->
250	    Rsing3 C p B.
251	
252	(* Same for the field/record invariant. *)
253	Definition field_sub_closure3 : Prop :=
254	  forall C p T a S,
255	    inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} ->
256	    exists V, C ⊢!!! (p • a) : V.
257	
258	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
259	(* Natural (tight field) targets.
260	
261	   Term-field declarations in a record are either [inert_typ] or a
262	   singleton (record_dec = rd_trm / rd_trm_sngl), and these are exactly the
263	   field types that application/bridge1 can ever require.  Restricting O1 to
264	   such targets avoids arbitrary record/and field types. *)
265	
266	Definition nat_typ (T:typ) : Prop := inert_typ T \/ (exists q, T = {{ q }}).
267	
268	Lemma nat_flow_shape : forall T, nat_typ T -> flow_shape T.
269	Proof.
270	  intros T [H | [q E]].
271	  - apply inert_flow_shape. exact H.
272	  - subst. apply fs_sngl.
273	Qed.
274	
275	(* Natural-target field extraction (the reduced O1). *)
276	Definition nat_field_of_sub : Prop :=
277	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
278	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
279	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
280	    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.
281	
282	(* What app/bridge1 consumes: a natural-target witness gives a flow for the
283	   field path and the bridge witness. *)
284	Lemma nat_field_bridge_reduction :
285	  nat_field_of_sub ->
286	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
287	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
288	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
289	    exists W, G ⊢! (p • a) : W ⪼ W /\ flow_shape W /\ G ⊢ W <: T.
290	Proof.
291	  intros Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn.
292	  destruct (Hnat γ G p R U a T Hi Hf Hfs Hsub Hn) as [V [HnV [Hhas HVsub]]].
293	  exists V. split; [|split].
294	  - apply pf_fld with (T := R) (U := V).
295	    apply (@flow_record_has G p R U {a ⦂ V} Hf). exact Hhas.
296	  - apply nat_flow_shape. exact HnV.
297	  - exact HVsub.
298	Qed.
299	
300	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
301	(* Head compatibility for natural types.
302	
303	   [ty_def_path] types path fields at a singleton, [ty_def_all]/[ty_def_new]
304	   type value fields at an arrow/μ; hence actual record field types are
305	   exactly arrow, μ (record), or singleton, i.e. [nat_typ].  The residual
306	   below asks that subtyping between natural types preserves the head
307	   constructor; it is what remains of the O1 impasse after restricting to
308	   natural targets. *)
309	
310	Lemma arrow_not_bnd : forall T, ~ is_arrow (μ T).
311	Proof. intros T [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
312	
313	Lemma arrow_not_sngl : forall (q:path), ~ is_arrow {{ q }}.
314	Proof. intros q [S [U E]]. discriminate E. Qed.
315	
316	Lemma bnd_not_sngl : forall T (q:path), μ T <> {{ q }}.
317	Proof. intros T q E. discriminate E. Qed.
318	
319	(* The three heads of a natural type are mutually exclusive. *)
320	Definition nat_head_compat (G:ctx) (V T:typ) : Prop :=
321	  (is_arrow V /\ is_arrow T) \/
322	  ((exists U0, V = μ U0 /\ record_type U0) /\
323	   (exists T0, T = μ T0 /\ record_type T0)) \/
324	  ((exists q, V = {{ q }}) /\ (exists q', T = {{ q' }})).
325	
326	(* Residual: natural-source / natural-target subtyping preserves the head.
327	   This is the "good/natural V <: natural T head-compatibility" fact. *)
328	Definition nat_sub_head_compat : Prop :=
329	  forall G V T,
330	    inert G -> nat_typ V -> nat_typ T -> G ⊢ V <: T ->
331	    nat_head_compat G V T.
332	
333	(* Residual: path-typing coherence for actual record fields.  Combining the
334	   head-compatibility fact with the def-typing structure
335	   (ty_def_path vs ty_def_all/ty_def_new) is intended to prove
336	   [nat_field_of_sub]. *)
337	Definition path_field_coherence : Prop :=
338	  forall γ G p R U (a:trm_label) T,
339	    HInv γ G -> G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U -> flow_shape U ->
340	    G ⊢ U <: typ_rcd {a ⦂ T} -> nat_typ T ->
341	    exists V, nat_typ V /\ record_has U {a ⦂ V} /\ G ⊢ V <: T.
342	
343	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
344	(* Notes on the tds/ts_mutind instantiation (not proved).
345	
346	   The proposed plumbing
347	
348	     P  G t T   := match t with trm_path p => Good G p T | _ => True end
349	     P0 G T U s := forall p, G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> Good G p T -> Good G p U
350	
351	   does make the [ty_sub] and [subtyp_trans] steps work exactly as noted:
352	   transport along one subtyping derivation uses the good witness at the
353	   source, and trans composes P0 with the typing [ty_sub Hty Hsub1] (P0 is
354	   universally quantified over typing proofs).
355	
356	   Two independent obstacles prevent a shallow [Good]:
357	
358	   1. [subtyp_sel2]: P0 at S <: p↓A must produce [Good q (p↓A)] for an
359	      *arbitrary* path q from [Good q S].  Hence [Good] must be closed
360	      upward under the very subtyping relation being defined (or carry the
361	      selection's record-typing provenance).  Making it upward closed
362	      (e.g. Good p T := forall B, T<:B -> Bridge p B) pushes the burden
363	      into every typing rule for all supertypes.
364	
365	   2. [ty_and_intro]: with upward-closed Good, one needs [Bridge p (T∧U)]
366	      from [Bridge p T] and [Bridge p U]; but two precise/flow witnesses
367	      below T and below U need not combine to one below T∧U.  In pDOT the
368	      relevant target is never the intersection itself (the only use is
369	      through and11/and12 towards an arrow), so a correct invariant must be
370	      target-restricted rather than uniformly upward closed.
371	
372	   These are the same two places where the O1/O3 analyses got stuck; the
373	   full solution is the paper's precise/tight semantic invariant, with the
374	   selection case carrying a lower-bound witness plus record-typing
375	   provenance (and [wf] supplying precise2 for singleton alias targets). *)

- ty_var: p = pvar x, A = binding type T, which is inert (arrow or μ-record). If arrow: use flow pf_bind: G ⊢! pvar x : T ⪼ T; flow_shape T; U:=T; precise3; T <: T. If μ-record: A=μT0 not arrow — contradiction since A arrow. Good, so ty_var only arrow case and easy.
- ty_all_intro etc: term not path. ty_all_elim: trm_app not path. ty_new_intro: val. ty_let: trm_let not path. ty_new_elim: p = p0•a, A = field type T from p0 : rcd{a ⪂ T}; not directly arrow. Need: for p0•a typed at T and T <:? Wait A = T (the field type); but ty_new_elim's conclusion is exactly T. is_arrow T. Need precise3 of p0•a at flow-shaped U <: T. Induction on p0's typing gives... p0 : rcd{a⦂T}, whose target is a record, not arrow. So we need a more general invariant than (A): for every ordinary path typing, not just arrow targets. That's the whole precision bridge. So (A) can't be proven by a simple induction restricted to arrow targets; the induction hypothesis is at a record target. Hence the full precision invariant is needed. This explains the residuals.

- ty_rcd_intro: p typed at rcd{a:T}... 
- ty_sngl: p typed at {{q}}, q : T.
- ty_path_elim.
- ty_rec_intro/elim.
- ty_and_intro.
- ty_sub.

So (A) genuinely needs the full mutable precision invariant. The development has that (SGood, Q2). Good: we can present (A) as a *theorem* conditional on the four precision residuals? 8	(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
9	   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
10	   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
11	   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
12	   induction. *)
13	Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
14	| sg_flow p R U :
15	    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
16	    SGood γ G p U
17	| sg_sub p T U :
18	    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
19	    SGood γ G p U
20	| sg_new_elim p a T :
21	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
22	    SGood γ G (p • a) T
23	| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
24	    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
25	    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
26	| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
27	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
28	    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
29	| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
30	    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
31	    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
32	| sg_and_intro p T U :
33	    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
34	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
35	| sg_and_l p T U :
36	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
37	| sg_and_r p T U :
38	    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
39	| sg_sngl p q :
40	    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
41	    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
42	| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
43	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
44	    SGood γ G p T
45	| sg_path_elim p q a T :
46	    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
47	    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

49	Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
50	  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
51	Proof.
52	  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
53	  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
54	  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
55	  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
56	  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
57	  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
58	  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.

61	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
62	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
63	  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
64	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
65	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
66	  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
67	  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
68	  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
69	    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
70	    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
71	  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
72	    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
73	    + assumption.

Lemma binds_remove_self : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/ binds y Ty (G1 & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hb Hx H.
  apply binds_concat_inv in H. destruct H as [HG2 | [HyG2 H1]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - apply binds_concat_inv in H1. destruct H1 as [Hxopen | [Hyopen H1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hxopen. exact Hxopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma self_remove_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       binds x (μ T0) G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).

  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.
    destruct (binds_remove_self Hb Hx b) as [[Eyx ETy] | Hb'].
    + subst y Ty. apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; auto.
    + apply ty_var. exact Hb'.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hb Hx Heq. subst G.

Lemma HInvP_empty : HInvP (empty:sta) (empty:ctx).

Lemma HInvP_push : forall γ G x S v,
  OldPathPrecLift -> PrecAll_push_new ->
  HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> x \notin fv_ctx_types G -> x \notin fv_typ S -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
  (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
  HInvP (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S).
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HoldP HnewP Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs.
  destruct Hi as [H0 [Hprec Hwf]].
  assert (H0' : HInv0 (γ & x ~ v) (G & x ~ S))
    by (eapply HInv0_push; eauto).
  assert (HP' : PrecAll (G & x ~ S)).

    - exact HoldP. - exact HnewP.
    - apply HInvP_intro; [exact H0 | exact Hprec | exact Hwf].

| { A >: T <: U } => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | { a ⦂ T } => fv_typ T
  end.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_val v        => (fv_val v)
  | trm_path p       => (fv_path p)
  | trm_app p q      => (fv_path p) \u (fv_path q)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  end
with fv_val (v: val) : vars :=
  match v with
  | ν(T) ds    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  | λ(T)t      => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_trm t)
  end
with fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T => (fv_typ T)
  | { _ := t }  => (fv_defrhs t)
  end
with fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end
with fv_defrhs(drhs: def_rhs) : vars :=
  match drhs with
  | defp p => fv_path p
  | defv v => fv_val v
  end.

Definition ctx := env typ.

Definition sta := env val.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union_aux :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union_aux
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union_aux
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

Lemma binds_open_to_mu : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x (T0:typ) y Ty,
  x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2) ->
  (y = x /\ Ty = open_typ_p (pvar x) T0) \/
  binds y Ty (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 Hb.
  destruct (binds_concat_inv Hb) as [HG2 | [HyG2 Hbpre]].
  - right. apply binds_concat_right. exact HG2.
  - destruct (binds_concat_inv Hbpre) as [Hopen | [Hyopen HG1]].
    + left. apply binds_single_inv in Hopen. exact Hopen.
    + right. apply binds_concat_left; [|exact HyG2].
      apply binds_concat_left; [exact HG1|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l.
      intro E. subst y. apply Hyopen. rewrite dom_single. apply in_singleton_self'.
Qed.

Lemma swap_view_mu_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ), G ⊢ t : T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (d:def) (D:dec), x0;bs;G ⊢ d : D ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ d : D) /\
  (forall (x0:var) (bs:fields) (G:ctx) (ds:defs) (T:typ), x0;bs;G ⊢ ds :: T ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       x0; bs; (G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2) ⊢ ds :: T) /\
  (forall (G:ctx) (S U:typ), G ⊢ S <: U ->
     forall G1 G2 x T0,
       x # G1 -> x # G2 ->
       G = G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2 ->
       G1 & x ~ (μ T0) & G2 ⊢ S <: U).
Proof.
  apply tds_mutind.
  - (* ty_var *) intros y Ty G b G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    destruct (@binds_open_to_mu G1 G2 x T0 y Ty Hx1 Hx2 b) as [[Eyx ETy] | Hb].
    + subst y Ty. apply ty_rec_elim with (T := T0). apply ty_var.
      apply binds_concat_left; [apply binds_tail|exact Hx2].
    + apply ty_var. exact Hb.
  - (* ty_all_intro *) intros L G Tb t U d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).
    intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hz) as [HzL HzC].
    assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. repeat rewrite dom_single. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HzG1 : z # G1).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HzG2 : z # G2).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HxG2z : x # (G2 & z ~ Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx2|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    specialize (IH z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ Tb) x T0 Hx1 HxG2z).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply IH.
    rewrite concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) intros G p q S T d1 IH1 d2 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_all_elim with (S := S).
    + apply (IH1 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_new_intro *) intros L G Tb ds t0 IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_intro with (L := L \u dom (G1 & x ~ open_typ_p (pvar x) T0 & G2)).
    intros z Hz.
    destruct (notin_union_dom Hz) as [HzL HzC].
    assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. repeat rewrite dom_single. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HzG1 : z # G1).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HzG2 : z # G2).
    { intro E. apply HzC. repeat rewrite dom_concat. solve_union_aux. }
    assert (HxG2z : x # (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb)).
    { rewrite dom_concat. apply notin_union_l; [exact Hx2|].
      rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l; auto. }
    specialize (IH z HzL G1 (G2 & z ~ open_typ z Tb) x T0 Hx1 HxG2z).
    rewrite <- concat_assoc.
    apply IH.
    rewrite concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_new_elim. apply (IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) intros G p a T d IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.
    apply ty_rcd_intro. apply (IH G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_let *) intros L G t u Tb U d1 IH1 u1 IH2 G1 G2 x T0 Hx1 Hx2 Heq. subst G.

Lemma binds_shadow : forall A (y:var) (T:A) G1 G2 (w:var) (S:A),
  binds y T (G1 & G2) -> w \in dom G2 -> binds y T (G1 & w ~ S & G2).
Proof.
  intros A y T G1 G2 w S Hb Hw.
  apply binds_concat_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [HyG2 H1]].

    apply binds_concat_right. exact Hb.
  - change (binds y T ((G1 & w ~ S) & G2)).
    apply binds_concat_left.
    + apply binds_concat_left.
      * exact H1.
      * rewrite dom_single. intro Hyw. rewrite in_singleton in Hyw.

    + exact HyG2.
Qed.

Lemma weaken_shadow_ty :
  (forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) (T:typ) (H: G ⊢ t : T),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> G1 & w ~ S & G2 ⊢ t : T) /\

  (forall (G:ctx) (S:typ) (U:typ) (H: G ⊢ S <: U),
     forall (G1 G2:ctx) (w:var) (S0:typ),
       G = G1 & G2 -> w \in dom G2 -> G1 & w ~ S0 & G2 ⊢ S <: U).

  - intros L G T t U t0 IH G1 G2 w S0 Heq Hw. subst G.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Old paths: reduction to pure context removal.                       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The old-path obligations are independent of the heap value and of  *)
(* [wf]; they are pure statements about deleting a fresh binding from  *)
(* a context.  We isolate them here exactly.  The only obstruction in  *)
(* the induction on the typing derivation is that a [ty_sngl] premise  *)
(* may pass through an auxiliary singleton type [{{q}}] in which the   *)
(* removed variable [x] still occurs (subtyping can create such types  *)
(* from an [x]-free context type by [subtyp_sngl_pq] replacement).     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition FreshRemovePathTypingSome : Prop :=
  forall G (x:var) S (p:path) T,
    x \notin fv_ctx_types G ->
    x \notin fv_typ S ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists T', G ⊢ trm_path p : T'.

Definition FreshRemovePathViewSome : Prop :=
  forall G (x:var) S (p:path) (A:typ_label) S0 T0,
    x \notin fv_ctx_types G ->
    x \notin fv_typ S ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
    exists S1 T1, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 }.

Lemma OldPathPrecLift_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathTypingSome -> OldPathPrecLift.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot.
  exact (Hfresh G x S p T HxFctx HxFS Hnot Hty).
Qed.

Lemma OldPathViewLift_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathViewSome -> OldPathViewLift.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh γ G x S v p A S0 T0 Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot.
  exact (Hfresh G x S p A S0 T0 HxFctx HxFS Hnot Hty).
Qed.

(* The [HInvP] push therefore reduces to two pure context-removal
   residuals plus the new-path precision obligation. *)
Lemma HInvP_push_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathTypingSome -> PrecAll_push_new -> HInvP_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh HnewP.
  apply HInvP_push_of_obligations.
  - apply OldPathPrecLift_of_fresh_remove. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HnewP.
Qed.
EOF

(* [PrecAll_push_new] without any shape reasoning.  The remaining     *)
(* non-root case (a selection [x • a • bs]) is isolated below.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma HInvP_ok : forall γ G, HInvP γ G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros γ G Hi. exact (@well_typed_ok γ G (@HInvP_wt γ G Hi)).
Qed.

Lemma prec2_pvar_self : forall G (x:var) S,
  ok G -> x # G -> G & x ~ S ⊢!! pvar x : S.
Proof.
  intros G x S Hok Hx.
  apply (@pt2 (G & x ~ S) (pvar x) S S).
  apply (@pf_bind x (G & x ~ S) S).
  - apply ok_push; auto.
  - apply binds_push_eq.
Qed.

Definition PrecAll_push_field : Prop :=
  forall γ G x S v (a:trm_label) (bs:fields) T,
    HInvP γ G -> x # G -> x # γ -> x \notin fv_ctx_types G ->
    x \notin fv_typ S -> G ⊢!v v : S ->
    (forall T0 ds, v = ν(T0) ds -> S = μ T0 /\ defs_at (G & x ~ S) x T0 ds) ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path (p_sel (avar_f x) (a :: bs)) : T ->
    exists U, G & x ~ S ⊢!! p_sel (avar_f x) (a :: bs) : U.

Lemma PrecAll_push_new_of_root_field :
  PrecAll_push_field -> PrecAll_push_new.
Proof.
  intros Hfield γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hin.
  destruct p as [av bs].
  destruct av as [i | y].
  - (* bound variable: cannot contain x *)
    simpl in Hin. apply in_empty_inv in Hin. tauto.
  - (* free head y; [Hin : x \in \{y}] *)
    simpl in Hin. rewrite in_singleton in Hin. subst y.
    destruct bs as [| a bs].
    + (* pvar x *)
      exists S. apply (@prec2_pvar_self G x S (HInvP_ok Hi) HxG).
    + (* a selection rooted at x *)
      exact (Hfield γ G x S v a bs T Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Old paths: reduction to pure context removal.                       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The old-path obligations are independent of the heap value and of  *)
(* [wf]; they are pure statements about deleting a fresh binding from  *)
(* a context.  We isolate them here exactly.  The only obstruction in  *)
(* the induction on the typing derivation is that a [ty_sngl] premise  *)
(* may pass through an auxiliary singleton type [{{q}}] in which the   *)
(* removed variable [x] still occurs (subtyping can create such types  *)
(* from an [x]-free context type by [subtyp_sngl_pq] replacement).     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition FreshRemovePathTypingSome : Prop :=
  forall G (x:var) S (p:path) T,
    x \notin fv_ctx_types G ->
    x \notin fv_typ S ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : T ->
    exists T', G ⊢ trm_path p : T'.

Definition FreshRemovePathViewSome : Prop :=
  forall G (x:var) S (p:path) (A:typ_label) S0 T0,
    x \notin fv_ctx_types G ->
    x \notin fv_typ S ->
    x \notin fv_path p ->
    G & x ~ S ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S0 <: T0 } ->
    exists S1 T1, G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: S1 <: T1 }.

Lemma OldPathPrecLift_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathTypingSome -> OldPathPrecLift.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh γ G x S v p T Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot.
  exact (Hfresh G x S p T HxFctx HxFS Hnot Hty).
Qed.

Lemma OldPathViewLift_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathViewSome -> OldPathViewLift.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh γ G x S v p A S0 T0 Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hnot.
  exact (Hfresh G x S p A S0 T0 HxFctx HxFS Hnot Hty).
Qed.

(* The [HInvP] push therefore reduces to two pure context-removal
   residuals plus the new-path precision obligation. *)
Lemma HInvP_push_of_fresh_remove :
  FreshRemovePathTypingSome -> PrecAll_push_new -> HInvP_push_principle.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh HnewP.
  apply HInvP_push_of_obligations.
  - apply OldPathPrecLift_of_fresh_remove. exact Hfresh.
  - exact HnewP.
Qed.
