(* A [pf_bind] flow on [x : μ R] outputs [μ R] itself, while the       *)
(* ordinary record view of the same path is obtained by [ty_rec_elim]. *)
(* Hence the conclusion would require [record_type (μ R)], which is    *)
(* absurd.  We exhibit a concrete HInv context below.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma open_typ_p_closed_rcd_top : forall (A0:typ_label) x,
  open_typ_p (pvar x) (typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) = typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma defs_typ_one_typed : forall (A0:typ_label) (C:ctx) (x0:var),
  x0; nil; C ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}.
Proof. intros. apply ty_defs_one. apply ty_def_typ. Qed.

Lemma HInv_mu_rcd_top : forall (A0:typ_label) (x:var),
  x # (empty:ctx) ->
  HInv (empty & x ~ (ν(typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) (defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤))))
        (empty & x ~ μ (typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤})).
Proof.
  intros A0 x Hx.
  set (R := typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
  set (ds := defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤)).
  set (v := ν(R) ds).
  assert (Hval : empty ⊢!v v : μ R).
  { subst v. apply ty_new_intro_p with (L := (\{} : vars)). intros w _.
    change (w; nil; (empty & w ~ R) ⊢ ds :: R).
    subst ds. change (w; nil; (empty & w ~ R) ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
    apply defs_typ_one_typed. }
  assert (Hxs : x # (empty:sta)) by (rewrite dom_empty; apply notin_empty).
  apply (@HInv_push empty empty x (μ R) v).
  - apply HInv_empty.
  - exact Hx.
  - exact Hxs.
  - exact Hval.
  - intros T0 ds0 E.
    subst v. injection E as ER Eds. subst T0. subst ds0. split; [reflexivity|].
    unfold defs_at.
    subst ds.
    change (x; nil; ((empty & x ~ μ typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}) & x ~ typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤})
              ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil (def_typ A0 ⊤) :: typ_rcd {A0 >: ⊤ <: ⊤}).
    apply defs_typ_one_typed.

Inductive RHolds (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : def_rhs -> typ -> Prop :=
| rh_lam v S0 A :
    G ⊢!v v : S0 -> G ⊢ S0 <: A -> is_arrow A ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) A
| rh_obj p v T0 ds U :
    v = ν(T0) ds -> record_type T0 -> G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->
    RHolds γ G (defv v) U
| rh_path q :
    RHolds γ G (defp q) {{ q }}.

Lemma rescore_holds : forall γ G p U,
  ResCore γ G p U -> exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U R. dependent destruction R.
  - exists (defv v). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv v); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_lam with (S0 := S0); auto.
  - subst p. exists (defv (ν(T0) ds)). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defv (ν(T0) ds)); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_obj with (p := p_sel (avar_f x) bs) (T0 := T0) (ds := ds);
        [reflexivity|exact H4|exact H5].
  - exists (defp q). split.
    + apply star_step with (b := defp q); [exact H|apply star_refl].
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma record_type_sngl_absurd : forall q, record_type {{ q }} -> False.
Proof. intros q [ls H]. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma holds_sngl_path : forall γ G r q,
  RHolds γ G r {{ q }} -> r = defp q.
Proof.
  intros γ G r q HR. dependent destruction HR.
  - exfalso. destruct H1 as [S [T E]]. discriminate E.
  - exfalso. destruct (flow_mu_shape H0 H1) as [E | Hrec]; [discriminate E|exact (@record_type_sngl_absurd q Hrec)].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma precise2_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - pose proof (flow_res Hi H) as R. apply rescore_holds; exact R.
  - destruct (IHHp1 Hi) as [r [Hstar HR]].
    assert (r = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r q HR)).
    subst r.
    exists (defp (q • a)). split.
    + apply lookup_star_sel_p. exact Hstar.
    + apply rh_path.
Qed.

Lemma precise3_lookup : forall γ G p U, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!!! p : U ->
  exists r, γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* r ⟧ /\ RHolds γ G r U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.
  - exact (precise2_lookup Hi H).
  - destruct (precise2_lookup Hi H) as [r1 [Hstar1 HR1]].
    assert (r1 = defp q) as E by (exact (@holds_sngl_path γ G r1 q HR1)).
    subst r1.
    destruct (IHHp Hi) as [r2 [Hstar2 HR2]].
    exists r2. split.
    + apply star_trans with (b := defp q); auto.
    + exact HR2.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* [PrecAll] from two precise-typing refinement principles.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The structural induction on ordinary path typing has exactly two   *)
(* non-structural cases:                                              *)
(*   - [ty_new_elim]/[ty_rcd_intro]: a record field is selected or    *)
(*     introduced;                                                    *)
(*   - [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]: an alias is used.                    *)
(* All other rules are inherited, projected back with                 *)
(* [precise2_prefix_snoc], or are vacuous on paths.  We isolate the   *)
(* two exact refinements; everything else is proved.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Precise2SnglRefine (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p q:path),
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

Definition Precise2FieldClosure (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (a:trm_label) T,
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->
    exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Lemma PrecAll_of_refinements_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) T,
  ok G ->
  Precise2SnglRefine G ->
  Precise2FieldClosure G ->
  G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall (p:path), t = trm_path p -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros G t T Hok HSR HFC Hty.
  remember G as G0 eqn:EG.
  revert Hok HSR HFC EG.
  induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros Hok HSR HFC EG p Ep; try discriminate.
  - (* ty_var *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exists T. apply (@pt2 G0 (pvar x) T T). apply (@pf_bind x G0 T Hok H).
  - (* ty_new_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl) as [U HU].
    exact (HFC p0 a T (ex_intro _ U HU) Hty).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (p0 • a) eq_refl) as [U HU].
    destruct (@precise2_prefix_snoc G0 p0 a U HU) as [V HV].
    exists V. exact HV.
  - (* ty_sngl *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_path_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl) as [U HU].
    assert (Hp2 : G0 ⊢!! p0 : {{ q }})
      by (eapply HSR; [eexists; exact HU | exact Hty1]).
    destruct (IHHty2 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (q • a) eq_refl) as [V HV].
    exists V. eapply (@pt2_sngl_trans G0 p0 q a V); eauto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_and_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl).
  - (* ty_sub *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p0 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma PrecAll_of_refinements : forall (G:ctx),
  ok G -> Precise2SnglRefine G -> Precise2FieldClosure G -> PrecAll G.
Proof.
  intros G Hok HSR HFC p T Hty.
  exact (@PrecAll_of_refinements_gen G (trm_path p) T Hok HSR HFC Hty p eq_refl).
Qed.

(* In particular, the whole [PrecAll] of the pushed context follows from
   the two refinements there; no old/new path split is needed. *)
Lemma PrecAll_push_new_of_refinements : forall γ G x S v,
  Precise2SnglRefine (G & x ~ S) ->
  Precise2FieldClosure (G & x ~ S) ->
  PrecAll_push_new.
Proof.
  intros γ G x S v HSR HFC.
  intros ? ? ? ? ? ? Hi HxG Hxg HxFctx HxFS Hval Hdefs Hty Hin.
  assert (Hok : ok (G & x ~ S)).
  { apply ok_push; [apply (@HInvP_ok γ G Hi) | exact HxG]. }
  exact (@PrecAll_of_refinements (G & x ~ S) Hok HSR HFC
           _ _ Hty).
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Part 1.  (C)  [rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge].                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* A flow-shaped successor of a path (encoded by [RHoldsL]) that is a   *)
(* subtype of an arrow is itself an arrow.  Everything is reduced to    *)
(* the master per-constructor source facts [pointwise_facts] of        *)
(* agent_master.v; the reduction itself is unconditional.               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* A [record_type] is an intersection of record atoms.  It can never be
   a subtype of an arrow: split the intersection until an atom is
   reached, then use the master per-atom fact. *)
Lemma record_type_no_arrow_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  forall γ G U V,
    HInv γ G -> record_type U -> G ⊢ U <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G U0 Hrt0.
  destruct HP as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  destruct Hrt0 as [ls Hrt].
  revert V.
  induction Hrt; intros V Hi Hsub Har.
  - (* rt_one : U = typ_rcd D *)
    exact (Hrcd γ G D V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
  - (* rt_cons : U = T ∧ typ_rcd D, with IH for T *)
    destruct (HandA γ G T (typ_rcd D) V Hi Hsub Har) as [HT | HD].
    + exact (IHHrt V Hi HT Har).
    + exact (Hrcd γ G D V Hi HD (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* Every flow-shaped type below an arrow (in an HInv heap) is an
   arrow.  This is the shape-level statement used by (C). *)
Lemma flow_shape_no_arrow_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  forall γ G U V,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: V -> is_arrow V -> is_arrow U.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G U V Hi Hfs Hsub Har.
  destruct HP as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  destruct Hfs.
  - (* fs_all *) exists S, T. reflexivity.
  - (* fs_bnd *) exfalso.
    exact (Hbnd γ G T V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
  - (* fs_rec *) exfalso.
    exact (record_type_no_arrow_of_pointwise
             (fun _ _ _ _ _ => I) γ G T V Hi H Har).
  - (* fs_sngl *) exfalso.
    exact (Hsngl γ G p V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* the packaged (C): from the master facts. *)
Theorem rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G r U A Hi HR Hfs Hsub Har.
  destruct HP as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  dependent destruction HR.
  - (* rhL_lam : already an arrow *) exact H1.
  - (* rhL_obj : the flow output is flow-shaped *)
    eapply flow_shape_no_arrow_of_pointwise; eauto.
  - (* rhL_path : the singleton flow output *)
    exfalso. exact (Hsngl γ G q A Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Part 2.  (A)  [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge].                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The master facts discharge the three structural [Q2] residuals that  *)
(* only inspect rigid source heads (rcd / bnd / and).  The remaining   *)
(* three analytic residual interfaces [Q2_sub_cl],                     *)
(* [Q2_mu_open_transport], [Q2_prec2_sngl_trans] are kept explicit.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_pointwise_and_Q2 :
  pointwise_facts ->

  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.

  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (four_facts_of_pointwise HP))).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (four_facts_of_pointwise HP))).
  - exact Hsub.
  - exact Hmu.
  - exact Hsngl.
Qed.

(*                                                                     *)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master agent_sem agent_wf agent_hinvs.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Part 1.  (C)  [rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge].                            *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* A flow-shaped successor of a path (encoded by [RHoldsL]) that is a   *)
(* subtype of an arrow is itself an arrow.  Everything is reduced to    *)
(* the master per-constructor source facts [pointwise_facts] of        *)
(* agent_master.v; the reduction itself is unconditional.               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* A [record_type] is an intersection of record atoms.  It can never be
   a subtype of an arrow: split the intersection until an atom is
   reached, then use the master per-atom fact. *)
Lemma record_type_no_arrow_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  forall γ G U V,
    HInv γ G -> record_type U -> G ⊢ U <: V -> is_arrow V -> False.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G U0 Hrt0.
  destruct HP as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  destruct Hrt0 as [ls Hrt].
  revert V.
  induction Hrt; intros V Hi Hsub Har.
  - (* rt_one : U = typ_rcd D *)
    exact (Hrcd γ G D V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
  - (* rt_cons : U = T ∧ typ_rcd D, with IH for T *)
    destruct (HandA γ G T (typ_rcd D) V Hi Hsub Har) as [HT | HD].
    + exact (IHHrt V Hi HT Har).
    + exact (Hrcd γ G D V Hi HD (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* Every flow-shaped type below an arrow (in an HInv heap) is an
   arrow.  This is the shape-level statement used by (C). *)
Lemma flow_shape_no_arrow_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts ->
  forall γ G U V,
    HInv γ G -> flow_shape U -> G ⊢ U <: V -> is_arrow V -> is_arrow U.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G U V Hi Hfs Hsub Har.
  destruct Hfs.
  - (* fs_all *) exists S, T. reflexivity.
  - (* fs_bnd *) exfalso.
    exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HP)) γ G T V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
  - (* fs_rec *) exfalso.
    exact (record_type_no_arrow_of_pointwise HP γ G T V Hi H Har).
  - (* fs_sngl *) exfalso.
    exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 HP))) γ G p V Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* the packaged (C): from the master facts. *)
Theorem rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_of_pointwise :
  pointwise_facts -> rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge.
Proof.
  intros HP γ G r U A Hi HR Hfs Hsub Har.
  destruct HP as [Htop [Hrcd [Hbnd [Hsngl [HandA HandB]]]]].
  dependent destruction HR.
  - (* rhL_lam : already an arrow *) exact H1.
  - (* rhL_obj : the flow output is flow-shaped *)
    eapply flow_shape_no_arrow_of_pointwise; eauto.
  - (* rhL_path : the singleton flow output *)
    exfalso. exact (Hsngl γ G q A Hi Hsub (or_introl Har)).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Part 2.  (A)  [ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge].                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The master facts discharge the three structural [Q2] residuals that  *)
(* only inspect rigid source heads (rcd / bnd / and).  The remaining   *)
(* three analytic residual interfaces [Q2_sub_cl],                     *)
(* [Q2_mu_open_transport], [Q2_prec2_sngl_trans] are kept explicit.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_pointwise_and_Q2 :
  pointwise_facts ->
  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.
  intros HP Hsub Hmu Hsngl.
  apply ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
  apply Q2_residuals_of_four.
  - exact (proj1 (four_facts_of_pointwise HP)).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (four_facts_of_pointwise HP))).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (four_facts_of_pointwise HP))).
  - exact Hsub.
  - exact Hmu.
  - exact Hsngl.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Part 3.  (B)  trans-free arrow inversion.                           *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* For the non-transitive fragment [subtyp1], arrow subtyping is        *)
(* inverted completely: the target parameter is below the source       *)
(* parameter, and the bodies are related under the target parameter.    *)
(* This is unconditional.                                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma subtyp1_all_inv : forall G S1 T1 S2 T2,
  subtyp1 G (∀(S1) T1) (∀(S2) T2) ->
  (G ⊢ S2 <: S1) /\
  exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
    G & x ~ S2 ⊢ open_typ x T1 <: open_typ x T2.
Proof.
  intros G S1 T1 S2 T2 H. dependent destruction H.
  - (* refl *) injection e as E1 E2. subst.
    split; [apply subtyp_refl|]. exists (\{} : vars). intros x _. apply subtyp_refl.

intros γ G p U Hi Hp. induction Hp.

(* Transitivity of precise3 at a singleton: this makes the [ty_sngl] case of
   bridge 1 go through once the singleton witness has been refined. *)
Lemma precise3_sngl_trans_gen : forall G p S q T,
  G ⊢!!! p : S -> S = {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.
Proof.
  intros G p S q T H1. revert q T.
  induction H1; intros q0 T0 ES H2.
  - subst. apply (@pt3_sngl_trans G p q0 T0); auto.
  - eapply pt3_sngl_trans; [exact H|].
    apply (IHprecise_typing3 q0 T0 ES H2).
Qed.

Lemma precise3_sngl_trans : forall G p q T,
  G ⊢!!! p : {{ q }} -> G ⊢!!! q : T -> G ⊢!!! p : T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply precise3_sngl_trans_gen; [exact H|reflexivity|exact H0].
Qed.

(* A precise2 typing is a bridge witness for its own type, under HInv. *)
Lemma bridge_of_precise2 : forall γ G p U,
  HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : U -> Bridge γ G p U.
Proof.
  intros γ G p U Hi Hp.
  exists U. split; [|split].
  - apply pt3. exact Hp.
  - eapply precise2_flow_shape; eauto.
  - apply (@subtyp_refl G U).
Qed.


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* R/Rsing/F decomposition (coordinator suggestion).

   R      p T := exists U, C⊢!! p:U
   Rsing  p T := forall q, T = {{q}} -> C⊢!! p:{{q}}
   F      p T := forall a S, T = {a⦂S} -> exists V, C⊢!! (p•a):V

   The structural induction goes through for every rule except [ty_sub],
   where exactly the two closure facts below are needed.  [R] itself is
   independent of T, so the [ty_sub] case for [R] is immediate; the two
   closure facts are only needed to maintain [Rsing]/[F] through [ty_sub]
   (so that outer [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]/[ty_new_elim] can consume them). *)

Definition R (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

Definition Rsing (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall q, T = {{ q }} -> C ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

Definition F (C:ctx) (p:path) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall (a:trm_label) S, T = typ_rcd {a ⦂ S} -> exists V, C ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Definition inert_path_precise_bridge : Prop :=
  forall C p T, inert C -> C ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, C ⊢!! p : U.

(* Minimal [ty_sub] closure for singleton targets. *)
Definition Rsing_sub_closure : Prop :=

Inductive ResCoreL (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| rcL_lam p (T0:typ) (t:trm) S0 A :
    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
    G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : S0 ->

| rcL_obj p x Vc C bs T0 ds U :

    G ⊢! p : μ T0 ⪼ U ->

    γ ⟦ p ⤳ defp q ⟧ ->

Lemma res_fieldL : forall γ G p a U,

    + destruct v as [Tv dsv | Tv tv].
      * (* stored new value *) dependent destruction Hty.
        set (T1 := open_rec_typ_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) Tv).
        set (ds1 := open_rec_defs_p 1 (p_sel (avar_f x) bs) dsv).

Lemma flow_resL : forall γ G, HInv γ G ->

(* ================================================================== *)
(* TWO residuals that are provable unconditionally.                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Singleton introduction.  The singleton payload itself is the Bridge
   witness at every arrow supertype, so no shape/vacuity argument is
   needed. *)
Definition Q2_sngl_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }}.

Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q Hi Hp. apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.

Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.

Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* SGood -> Q2 from the residuals, and the requested precise2           *)
(* existence theorem.                                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)
  pose proof (and_split_of_class HC) as Hand.
  unfold Q2_residuals.
  split; [exact Hsub |].
  split; [apply (Q2_sngl_trans_cl_of_mu Hmu Hs2) |].
  split; [exact (@Q2_path_elim_cl_proof) |].
  split; [apply (Q2_rcd_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hrcd) |].
  split; [apply (Q2_rec_intro_cl_of_no_arrow Hbnd) |].
  split; [apply (Q2_and_intro_cl_of_split_H Hand) |].
  exact (@Q2_sngl_cl_proof).
Qed.

(* Package the ordinary-arrow precise3 bridge from Q2 residuals. *)
Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
  Q2_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.
  intros Hres γ G p A Hi Hty Har.
  pose proof (@SGood_typing γ G (trm_path p) A Hi Hty p eq_refl) as Hs.
  pose proof (@SGood_Q2_of_residuals Hres γ G p A Hi Hs) as HQ.
  exact (@Q2_arrow γ G p A HQ A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
Qed.

(* And the precise2-existence theorem, exactly as in agent_q. *)
Lemma HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_class :
  arrow_source_class ->
  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  forall γ G p T,
    HInv γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : T -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros HC Hsub Hmu Hs2.
  apply HInv_path_precise2_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
  apply Q2_residuals_of_class; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_class :
  arrow_source_class ->
  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.
  intros HC Hsub Hmu Hs2.
  apply ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals.
  apply Q2_residuals_of_class; assumption.
Qed.

(* Route B: SGood arrow closure (Q3-shaped) from the four facts plus   *)

  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hp.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q }}. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* Path elimination: p aliases q and q•a is Q2 at T, so p•a is Q2 at
   {{q•a}}.  The q2_prec2/singleton payload is exactly [pt2_sngl_trans]. *)
Definition Q2_path_elim_cl_statement : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q a T,
    HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G (q • a) T ->
    Q2 γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma Q2_path_elim_cl_proof : Q2_path_elim_cl_statement.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q a T Hi Hp Hqa.
  assert (Hp2 : G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) by (eapply Q2_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (Q2_prec2 Hqa) as [U Hqa2].
  assert (Hpa2 : G ⊢!! (p • a) : {{ q • a }})
    by (eapply pt2_sngl_trans; eauto).
  apply q2_intro.
  - (* arrow *) intros V Hsub Har.
    exists {{ q • a }}. split; [|split].
    + apply pt3. exact Hpa2.
    + apply fs_sngl.
    + exact Hsub.
  - (* field *) intros b S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.
  - (* singleton *) intros q' E. injection E as E. subst q'. exact Hpa2.
  - (* prec2 *) exists {{ q • a }}. exact Hpa2.
Qed.

(* Exact remaining residuals (not proved here; see the closing report). *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Q2_sub_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U -> Q2 γ G p U.

Definition Q2_sngl_trans_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p q T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p {{ q }} -> Q2 γ G q T -> Q2 γ G p T.

Definition Q2_rcd_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G (p • a) T -> Q2 γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}).

Definition Q2_rec_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) -> Q2 γ G p (μ T0).

Definition Q2_and_intro_cl : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> Q2 γ G p T -> Q2 γ G p U -> Q2 γ G p (T ∧ U).

Definition Q2_residuals : Prop :=
  Q2_sub_cl /\ Q2_sngl_trans_cl /\ Q2_path_elim_cl_statement /\
  Q2_rcd_intro_cl /\ Q2_rec_intro_cl /\ Q2_and_intro_cl /\
  Q2_sngl_cl_statement.

  pose proof (and_split_of_class HC) as Hand.

Lemma ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_Q2_residuals :
  Q2_residuals -> ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge.
Proof.

  arrow_source_class ->

  arrow_source_class ->

Lemma open_rec_path_sel_fields : forall k x (p:path) bs,
  open_rec_path k x (p •• bs) = (open_rec_path k x p) •• bs.
Proof.
  intros k x [a fs] bs. simpl. unfold sel_fields. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_path_named : forall k x (p:path),
  named_path p -> open_rec_path k x p = p.
Proof.
  intros k x [a fs] [y [cs E]]. inversion E. subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Replacement commutes with de Bruijn opening, provided the replacement
   paths are named (so they are unaffected by opening). *)
Lemma repl_typ_open :
  (forall p q (T T':typ), repl_typ p q T T' ->
     named_path p -> named_path q ->
     forall k x, repl_typ p q (open_rec_typ k x T) (open_rec_typ k x T')) /\
  (forall p q (D D':dec), repl_dec p q D D' ->
     named_path p -> named_path q ->
     forall k x, repl_dec p q (open_rec_dec k x D) (open_rec_dec k x D')).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rrcd. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rand2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q bs A Hp Hq k x. simpl.
    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
    apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1)) (μ (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
    apply rbnd. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x T1) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))
                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x T2) (open_rec_typ (S k) x U))).
    apply rall1. exact (IH Hp Hq k x).
  - intros p q T1 T2 U r IH Hp Hq k x.
    change (repl_typ p q (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T1))
                       (∀(open_rec_typ k x U) (open_rec_typ (S k) x T2))).
    apply rall2. exact (IH Hp Hq (S k) x).
  - intros p q bs Hp Hq k x. simpl.
    rewrite !open_rec_path_sel_fields.
    rewrite (open_rec_path_named k x Hp), (open_rec_path_named k x Hq).
    apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp1. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtyp2. apply (IH Hp Hq).
  - intros p q T1 T2 a r IH Hp Hq k x. apply rdtrm. apply (IH Hp Hq).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* C. Trans-free subtyping and its arrow-domain inversion.             *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* [subtyp1] is the transitive rule removed.  It is *not* closed under *)
(* transitivity in general (loose, non-inert contexts provide           *)
(* counterexamples), but the arrow domain inversion below is an exact   *)
(* case analysis and is the part needed by application preservation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive subtyp1 : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
===
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [H|H].
    + subst y. repeat rewrite If_l by auto. destruct p as [a' cs]. simpl. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. rewrite !app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_path_sel_fields : forall z p q bs,
  subst_path z p (q •• bs) = (subst_path z p q) •• bs.
Proof.
  intros. destruct q as [x fs]. destruct x as [i|y]; simpl.
  - destruct p as [a' cs]. unfold subst_path, subst_avar, sel_fields. simpl. rewrite !app_nil_r. repeat rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
  - unfold subst_path, subst_avar, subst_var_p, sel_fields. simpl.
    destruct (classic (y = z)) as [H|H].
    + subst y. repeat rewrite If_l by auto. destruct p as [a' cs]. simpl. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite If_r by auto. rewrite !app_nil_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma repl_typ_subst :
  (forall p q T T', repl_typ p q T T' ->
     forall z r, repl_typ (subst_path z r p) (subst_path z r q) (subst_typ z r T) (subst_typ z r T')) /\
  (forall p q D D', repl_dec p q D D' ->
     forall z r, repl_dec (subst_path z r p) (subst_path z r q) (subst_dec z r D) (subst_dec z r D')).
Proof.
  apply repl_mutind.
  - intros p q D1 D2 H IH z r. simpl. apply rrcd. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rand1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rand2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q bs A z r. simpl. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields, subst_path_sel_fields. apply rpath.
  - intros p q T1 T2 H IH z r. simpl. apply rbnd. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rall1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 U H IH z r. simpl. apply rall2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q bs z r. simpl. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields. rewrite subst_path_sel_fields. apply rsngl.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtyp1. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 A U H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtyp2. apply IH; auto.
  - intros p q T1 T2 a H IH z r. simpl. apply rdtrm. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tight_bounds_subst :
  (forall (T:typ), tight_bounds T -> forall z p, tight_bounds (subst_typ z p T)) /\
  (forall (D:dec), tight_bounds_dec D -> forall z p, tight_bounds_dec (subst_dec z p D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed agent_bridge1 agent_hinvs agent_arrow_core.
Close Scope string_scope.

Ltac solve_union :=
  first [ apply in_union_l; solve_union
        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'
        | assumption ].

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Same-state version of [app_red_pres].                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [red_app] does not touch the heap or the context, so the result of  *)
(* an application step is typed in the *same* [G].  This is the form   *)
(* demanded by the coordinator's [app_stepP_same_stmt].                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_red_pres_same : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T0 ->
  ArrowOpen G S T0 T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists u, red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ, u) /\ G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T0.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  destruct Hop as [Hparam [L1 Hbody_sub]].
  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ U0 \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzU0 : z \notin fv_typ U0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ T0) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z V0) Hbz
                G z T0 empty q Hok0
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ T0)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzT0 Hq0) as Hsub_trm.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_trm_z t 0 z Hzt q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_trm.
  assert (Hok1 : ok (G & z ~ S & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 subst_ty))
                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z U0) Hsubz
                G z S empty q Hok1
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzS Hq) as Hsub_out.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z U0 0 z HzU0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.
  exists (open_trm_p q t). split.
  - apply red_app with (T := T0) (t := t). exact Hlook.
  - apply ty_sub with (T := open_typ_p q V0); auto.
Qed.

(* The precise3-based application step, in same-state form. *)
Lemma app_step_same_of_precise3_open : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢!!! p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  (forall (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
      γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists u, red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ, u) /\ G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq Hbridge.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres_same γ G p q S T U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The integration statement requested by the coordinator:            *)
(* [app_stepP_same_stmt] (same statement as the one defined in        *)
(* agent_stepP.v), conditional on the three explicit residuals.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition app_stepP_same_stmt : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInvP γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ,u) /\ HInvP γ G /\
      G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T.

Theorem app_stepP_same_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_bridge ->
  app_stepP_same_stmt.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge1 HNS Hopen γ G p q S T HiP Hp Hq.
  pose proof (HInvP_HInv HiP) as Hi.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge1 γ G p (∀(S) T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (eapply HNS; eauto).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen γ G T0 U0 S T Hi Hcomp) as Hop.
  destruct (@app_red_pres_same γ G p q S T U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq)
    as [u [Hred Hty]].
  exists u. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact HiP|exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Restatement with the three residuals supplied as the concrete
   reductions proven in agent_arrow_core.v. *)
Theorem app_stepP_same_of_pointwise_and_Q2_and_transfreeB :
  pointwise_facts ->
  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  (forall G T0 V0 S T, subtyp1 G (∀(T0) V0) (∀(S) T) ->
       ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  (forall γ G T0 V0 S T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
       ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  app_stepP_same_stmt.
Proof.
  intros HP Hs Hm Hp2 Htf Hopen.
  apply app_stepP_same_of_bridges.
  - exact (ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_pointwise_and_Q2 HP Hs Hm Hp2).
  - exact (rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_of_pointwise HP).
  - intros γ G T0 V0 S T Hi Hsub. exact (Hopen γ G T0 V0 S T Hi Hsub).
Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.

Ltac solve_union :=

        | apply in_union_r; solve_union
        | apply in_singleton_self'

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Same-state version of [app_red_pres].                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [red_app] does not touch the heap or the context, so the result of  *)
(* an application step is typed in the *same* [G].  This is the form   *)
(* demanded by the coordinator's [app_stepP_same_stmt].                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma app_red_pres_same : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
  HInv γ G ->
  γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
  G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
  G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
  ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0 ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  exists u, red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ, u) /\ G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T T0 V0 t Hi Hlook Hval Hsub Hop Hq.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 Hbody | L0 G0 Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  destruct Hop as [Hparam [L1 Hbody_sub]].
  assert (Hq0 : G ⊢ trm_path q : T0) by (apply ty_sub with (T := S); auto).
  set (Lz := L0 \u L1 \u dom G \u fv_ctx_types G \u fv_typ T0 \u fv_typ V0
             \u fv_typ S \u fv_typ T \u fv_trm t).
  destruct (var_fresh Lz) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL0 : z \notin L0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzL1 : z \notin L1).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzctx : z \notin fv_ctx_types G).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT0 : z \notin fv_typ T0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzV0 : z \notin fv_typ V0).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzS : z \notin fv_typ S).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (HzT : z \notin fv_typ T).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hzt : z \notin fv_trm t).
  { intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  assert (Hnp : named_path q) by (exact (@ty_path_named G q S Hq)).
  pose proof (Hbody z HzL0) as Hbz.
  pose proof (Hbody_sub z HzL1) as Hsubz.
  assert (Hok0 : ok (G & z ~ T0 & empty)).
  { rewrite concat_empty_r. apply ok_push; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi|].
    intro E. apply Hz. unfold Lz. solve_union. }
  pose proof (proj1 subst_ty (G & z ~ T0) (open_trm z t) (open_typ z V0) Hbz
                G z T0 empty q Hok0
                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ T0)))
                Hnp Hzctx HzT0 Hq0) as Hsub_trm.
  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_trm.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_trm.
  unfold open_trm in Hsub_trm.

  pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 subst_ty))
                (G & z ~ S) (open_typ z V0) (open_typ z T) Hsubz

                (eq_sym (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) (G & z ~ S)))

  unfold subst_ctx in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (map_empty (subst_typ z q)) in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (concat_empty_r (A:=typ) G) in Hsub_out.
  unfold open_typ in Hsub_out.
  rewrite (proj1 subst_open_typ_dec_z V0 0 z HzV0 q Hnp) in Hsub_out.

(* The precise3-based application step, in same-state form. *)
Lemma app_step_same_of_precise3_open : forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
  HInv γ G ->
  G ⊢!!! p : ∀(S) T ->
  G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
  (forall (T0 V0:typ) (t:trm),
      γ ⟦ defp p ⤳* defv (λ(T0) t) ⟧ ->
      G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) V0 ->
      G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
      ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  exists u, red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ, u) /\ G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q S T Hi Hp Hq Hbridge.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  pose proof (Hbridge T0 U0 t Hstar Hval' Hsub) as Hop.
  exact (@app_red_pres_same γ G p q S T U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hsub Hop Hq).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The integration statement requested by the coordinator:            *)
(* [app_stepP_same_stmt] (same statement as the one defined in        *)
(* agent_stepP.v), conditional on the three explicit residuals.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition app_stepP_same_stmt : Prop :=
  forall γ G (p q:path) (S T:typ),
    HInvP γ G -> G ⊢ trm_path p : ∀(S) T -> G ⊢ trm_path q : S ->
    exists (u:trm),
      red (γ, trm_app p q) (γ,u) /\ HInvP γ G /\
      G ⊢ u : open_typ_p q T.

Theorem app_stepP_same_of_bridges :
  ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge ->
  rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge ->
  arrow_open_HInv_bridge ->
  app_stepP_same_stmt.
Proof.
  intros Hbridge1 HNS Hopen γ G p q S T HiP Hp Hq.
  pose proof (HInvP_HInv HiP) as Hi.
  assert (Har : is_arrow (∀(S) T)) by (exists S, T; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hbridge1 γ G p (∀(S) T) Hi Hp Har) as [U [Hp3 [Hfs Hsub]]].
  assert (HarU : is_arrow U) by (eapply HNS; eauto).
  destruct HarU as [S' [T' EU]]; subst U.
  destruct (precise3_lookupL Hi Hp3) as [r [Hstar HR]].
  destruct (RHoldsL_all_lam HR) as [T0 [t [S0 [Er [Hval Hsub0]]]]].
  subst r.
  inversion Hval as [L0 G0 T1 t1 U0 Hbody | L0 G0 T1 ds Hbody]; subst; clear Hval.
  assert (Hval' : G ⊢!v (λ(T0) t) : ∀(T0) U0)
    by (apply ty_all_intro_p with (L := L0); exact Hbody).
  assert (Hcomp : G ⊢ ∀(T0) U0 <: ∀(S) T)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub0|exact Hsub]).
  pose proof (Hopen γ G T0 U0 S T Hi Hcomp) as Hop.
  destruct (@app_red_pres_same γ G p q S T U0 t Hi Hstar Hval' Hcomp Hop Hq)
    as [u [Hred Hty]].
  exists u. split; [exact Hred|]. split; [exact HiP|exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Restatement with the three residuals supplied as the concrete
   reductions proven in agent_arrow_core.v. *)
Theorem app_stepP_same_of_pointwise_and_Q2_and_transfreeB :
  pointwise_facts ->
  Q2_sub_cl -> Q2_mu_open_transport -> Q2_prec2_sngl_trans ->
  (forall G T0 V0 S T, subtyp1 G (∀(T0) V0) (∀(S) T) ->
       ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  (forall γ G T0 V0 S T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: ∀(S) T ->
       ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0) ->
  app_stepP_same_stmt.
Proof.
  intros HP Hs Hm Hp2 Htf Hopen.
  apply app_stepP_same_of_bridges.
  - exact (ordinary_arrow_precise3_bridge_of_pointwise_and_Q2 HP Hs Hm Hp2).
  - exact (rh_no_arrow_HInv_bridge_of_pointwise HP).
  - intros γ G T0 V0 S T Hi Hsub. exact (Hopen γ G T0 V0 S T Hi Hsub).
Qed.

(* [PrecAll] from two precise-typing refinement principles.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The structural induction on ordinary path typing has exactly two   *)
(* non-structural cases:                                              *)
(*   - [ty_new_elim]/[ty_rcd_intro]: a record field is selected or    *)
(*     introduced;                                                    *)
(*   - [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]: an alias is used.                    *)
(* All other rules are inherited, projected back with                 *)
(* [precise2_prefix_snoc], or are vacuous on paths.  We isolate the   *)
(* two exact refinements; everything else is proved.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Precise2SnglRefine (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p q:path),
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

Definition Precise2FieldClosure (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (a:trm_label) T,
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->
    exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Lemma PrecAll_of_refinements_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) T,
  ok G ->
  Precise2SnglRefine G ->
  Precise2FieldClosure G ->
  G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall (p:path), t = trm_path p -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros G t T Hok HSR HFC Hty.
  remember G as G0 eqn:EG.
  revert Hok HSR HFC EG.
  induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros Hok HSR HFC EG pz Ep; try discriminate.
  - (* ty_var *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exists T. apply (@pt2 G0 (pvar x) T T). apply (@pf_bind x G0 T Hok H).
  - (* ty_new_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p eq_refl) as [U HU].
    exact (HFC p a T (ex_intro _ U HU) Hty).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (pz • a) eq_refl) as [U HU].
    destruct (@precise2_prefix_snoc G0 pz a U HU) as [V HV].
    exists V. exact HV.
  - (* ty_sngl *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_path_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p eq_refl) as [U HU].
    assert (Hp2 : G0 ⊢!! p : {{ q }})
      by (eapply HSR; [eexists; exact HU | exact Hty1]).
    destruct (IHHty2 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (q • a) eq_refl) as [V HV].
    eexists. eapply (@pt2_sngl_trans G0 p q a V); eauto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_and_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_sub *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma PrecAll_of_refinements : forall (G:ctx),
  ok G -> Precise2SnglRefine G -> Precise2FieldClosure G -> PrecAll G.
Proof.
  intros G Hok HSR HFC p T Hty.
  exact (@PrecAll_of_refinements_gen G (trm_path p) T Hok HSR HFC Hty p eq_refl).
Qed.

(* In particular, the whole [PrecAll] of the pushed context follows from

(* [PrecAll] from two precise-typing refinement principles.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The structural induction on ordinary path typing has exactly two   *)
(* non-structural cases:                                              *)
(*   - [ty_new_elim]/[ty_rcd_intro]: a record field is selected or    *)
(*     introduced;                                                    *)
(*   - [ty_sngl]/[ty_path_elim]: an alias is used.                    *)
(* All other rules are inherited, projected back with                 *)
(* [precise2_prefix_snoc], or are vacuous on paths.  We isolate the   *)
(* two exact refinements; everything else is proved.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition Precise2SnglRefine (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p q:path),
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}.

Definition Precise2FieldClosure (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  forall (p:path) (a:trm_label) T,
    (exists U, G ⊢!! p : U) ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { a ⦂ T } ->
    exists V, G ⊢!! (p • a) : V.

Lemma PrecAll_of_refinements_gen : forall (G:ctx) (t:trm) T,
  ok G ->
  Precise2SnglRefine G ->
  Precise2FieldClosure G ->
  G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall (p:path), t = trm_path p -> exists U, G ⊢!! p : U.
Proof.
  intros G t T Hok HSR HFC Hty.
  remember G as G0 eqn:EG.
  revert Hok HSR HFC EG.
  induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros Hok HSR HFC EG pz Ep; try discriminate.
  - (* ty_var *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exists T. apply (@pt2 G0 (pvar x) T T). apply (@pf_bind x G0 T Hok H).
  - (* ty_new_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p eq_refl) as [U HU].
    exact (HFC p a T (ex_intro _ U HU) Hty).
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (pz • a) eq_refl) as [U HU].
    destruct (@precise2_prefix_snoc G0 pz a U HU) as [V HV].
    exists V. exact HV.
  - (* ty_sngl *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_path_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    destruct (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl p eq_refl) as [U HU].
    assert (Hp2 : G0 ⊢!! p : {{ q }})
      by (eapply HSR; [eexists; exact HU | exact Hty1]).
    destruct (IHHty2 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl (q • a) eq_refl) as [V HV].
    eexists. eapply (@pt2_sngl_trans G0 p q a V); eauto.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_and_intro *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty1 Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
  - (* ty_sub *) subst G. dependent destruction Ep.
    exact (IHHty Hok HSR HFC eq_refl pz eq_refl).
Qed.

  ok G -> Precise2SnglRefine G -> Precise2FieldClosure G -> PrecAll G.
Proof.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G p T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> ArrowCl γ G p T.

Definition SGood_arrow_closure_gaps : Prop :=
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) /\
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) /\
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) /\
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) /\

  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}).

Lemma SGood_arrow_closure_of_gaps_parts :
  (forall γ G p a S, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}) ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) S) ->
  (forall γ G p a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G (sel_field p a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (μ T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T0, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)) ->
  (forall γ G p T U, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
      ArrowCl γ G p (T ∧ U)) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} -> ArrowCl γ G p {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> G ⊢!! p : {{ q }}) ->
  (forall γ G p q a T, HInv γ G -> SGood γ G p {{ q }} ->
      SGood γ G (sel_field q a) T ->
      ArrowCl γ G (sel_field p a) {{ sel_field q a }}) ->
  SGood_arrow_closure.

  intros Gfld Grcd Gmu Gopen Gand Gsngl Gprec2 Gpath γ G p T Hi Hs.

  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].

  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_sub; [apply IHHs|exact H]|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gfld γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Grcd γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gmu γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gopen γ G p T0 Hi Hs) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gand γ G p T U Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_l; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    eapply ArrowCl_sub; [eapply ArrowCl_and_r; apply IHHs|exact Hsub].
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gsngl γ G p q Hi H) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (ArrowCl_sngl_alias IHHs2 (Gprec2 γ G p q Hi Hs1)) Hsub).
  - intros V Hsub Har. eapply ArrowCl_self; [|exact Har].
    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Gpath γ G p q a T Hi Hs1 Hs2) Hsub).

    exact (ArrowCl_sub (Grcd γ G p a T Hi Hs) Hsub).

  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg)))).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hg))))).

(* A structural, typing-mirroring inductive invariant.  It deliberately has
   both introduction and elimination constructors for records/and/mu, plus
   a flow base and a subtyping constructor.  It is finite-derivation based
   (no fuel), and ordinary path typing maps to it by the obvious structural
   induction. *)
Inductive SGood (γ:sta) (G:ctx) : path -> typ -> Prop :=
| sg_flow p R U :
    G ⊢! p : R ⪼ U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_sub p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> G ⊢ T <: U ->
    SGood γ G p U
| sg_new_elim p a T :
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T}) ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) T
| sg_rcd_intro p a T :
    SGood γ G (p • a) T ->
    SGood γ G p (typ_rcd {a ⦂ T})
| sg_rec_intro p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (μ T0)
| sg_rec_elim p T0 :
    SGood γ G p (μ T0) ->
    SGood γ G p (open_typ_p p T0)
| sg_and_intro p T U :
    SGood γ G p T -> SGood γ G p U ->
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U)
| sg_and_l p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p T
| sg_and_r p T U :
    SGood γ G p (T ∧ U) -> SGood γ G p U
| sg_sngl p q :
    G ⊢!! p : {{ q }} ->
    SGood γ G p {{ q }}
| sg_sngl_trans p q T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G q T ->
    SGood γ G p T
| sg_path_elim p q a T :
    SGood γ G p {{ q }} -> SGood γ G (q • a) T ->
    SGood γ G (p • a) {{ q • a }}.

Lemma SGood_typing : forall γ G t T, HInv γ G -> G ⊢ t : T ->
  forall p, t = trm_path p -> SGood γ G p T.
Proof.
  intros γ G t T Hi Hty. induction Hty using ty_trm_ind; intros p0 Ep.
  - (* ty_var *) dependent destruction Ep. apply (@sg_flow γ G (pvar x) T T). apply pf_bind; [apply HInv_ok in Hi; exact Hi | assumption].
  - (* ty_all_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_all_elim *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_intro *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_new_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_new_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rcd_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rcd_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_let *) discriminate Ep.
  - (* ty_sngl *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sngl_trans.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_path_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_path_elim.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_intro. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_rec_elim. apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_and_intro *) dependent destruction Ep. apply sg_and_intro.
    + apply (IHHty1 Hi). reflexivity.
    + apply (IHHty2 Hi). reflexivity.
  - (* ty_sub *) dependent destruction Ep. eapply sg_sub.
    + apply (IHHty Hi). reflexivity.
    + assumption.
Qed.

           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.

        -- intros a0 S0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros T0 E. discriminate E.
        -- intros q0 E. discriminate E.
      * (* dec_trm *) apply q_intro.
        -- intros U0 HU0 _. exists (typ_rcd {a ⦂ S}). split; [|split].
           ++ apply (@pt3 G p _). apply (@pt2 G p R _). exact Hf.

            ++ apply (@pf_fld G p a R S); exact Hf.
        -- intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality List String.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import Sequences Binding Definitions Lookup Reduction PreciseTyping RecordAndInertTypes TightTyping.
Require Import dev9 w3 b b2 v3 s sp sub rec op dr val2 look hp sh term step wfpush precise appvar resnav selfswap defsn res lookupres selfflow viewflow aux_swap resL lookupresL aux_arrow aux_prefix agent_app agent_bridge aux_bridge_fixed agent_bridge1 agent_mutual agent_good agent_good2 agent_good2_psub agent_suball agent_sgood agent_sgood_bridge agent_sgood_bridge2 agent_q agent_repl agent_noarrow agent_master agent_sem agent_wf agent_hinvs agent_arrow_core agent_arrow_app.
Close Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* (B) arrow opening, trans-free core and the isolated trans/selection *)
(* detour residual.                                                    *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* PROVEN unconditionally (agent_arrow_core.v, re-exported here):      *)
(*   [subtyp1_all_inv] and [arrow_open_trans_free]: the trans-free     *)
(*   fragment [subtyp1] inverts arrows completely.                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* OPEN: the full bridge for the transitive [subtyp] relation.  It is  *)
(* isolated below as [arrow_open_trans_closure]: an arrow-arrow        *)
(* subtyping, decomposed into an arbitrary first half and an arbitrary *)
(* second half, must already open correctly.  The bridge follows from  *)
(* it by instantiating the second half with reflexivity.               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition arrow_open_trans_closure : Prop :=
  forall γ G T0 V0 (U S T:typ),
    HInv γ G ->
    G ⊢ ∀(T0) V0 <: U ->
    G ⊢ U <: ∀(S) T ->
    ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0.

Theorem arrow_open_HInv_bridge_of_trans_closure :
  arrow_open_trans_closure -> arrow_open_HInv_bridge.
Proof.
  intros HC γ G T0 V0 S T Hi Hsub.
  exact (HC γ G T0 V0 (∀(S) T) S T Hi Hsub (subtyp_refl G (∀(S) T))).
Qed.

(* The trans-free statement is an instance of the closure statement,
   using [subtyp1_subtyp]; recorded to show the containment. *)
Lemma arrow_open_trans_closure_trans_free :
  arrow_open_trans_closure ->
  forall G T0 V0 S T, subtyp1 G (∀(T0) V0) (∀(S) T) ->
    ArrowOpen G S T T0 V0.
Proof.
  intros HC G T0 V0 S T H.
  eapply HC; [| |apply subtyp_refl].
  - intros. exact I.
  - exact (subtyp1_subtyp H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Prov-based selection coherence: the ingredient used by the         *)
(* singleton-replacement detour of the arrow-opening inversion.       *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* If [p] is an alias of [q] (p : {{q}}), both expose a tight type      *)
(* member [A], and [Prov] holds, then the two selection types are      *)
(* comparable: [q ↓ A <: p ↓ A].  This is exactly the direction needed  *)
(* for the contravariant arrow domain when the source domain is the    *)
(* selection [p ↓ A] and the target domain is [q ↓ A].                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma sel_bound_alias_of_Prov :
  forall γ G (p q:path) (A:typ_label) Wp Wq,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: Wp <: Wp } ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : typ_rcd { A >: Wq <: Wq } ->
    G ⊢ q ↓ A <: p ↓ A.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q A Wp Wq HP Hpq HpW HqW.
  (* p inherits q's tight view through the alias typing [ty_sngl]. *)
  assert (HpWq : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: Wq <: Wq })
    by (eapply ty_sngl; eauto).
  (* [Prov] at the tight view of p gives a canonical tight bound W. *)
  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ Wp (ex_intro _ Wp HpW)))
    as [W [HpWtight Hb]].
  destruct (Hb Wq Wq HpWq) as [HqW_W HWq].
  destruct (Hb Wp Wp HpW) as [HpW_W HWWp].
  (* q↓A <: Wq <: W <: Wp <: p↓A *)
  eapply subtyp_trans.
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_trans.
      * (* q↓A <: Wq *) eapply subtyp_sel1. exact HqW.
      * (* Wq <: W *) exact HqW_W.
    + (* W <: Wp *) exact HWWp.
  - (* Wp <: p↓A *) eapply subtyp_sel2. exact HpW.
Qed.

(* Same statement in the orientation with the target tight bound on the
   left, matching the reverse singleton rule (repl_typ q p). *)
Lemma sel_bound_alias_of_Prov_rev :
  forall γ G (p q:path) (A:typ_label) Wp Wq,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: Wp <: Wp } ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : typ_rcd { A >: Wq <: Wq } ->
    G ⊢ p ↓ A <: q ↓ A.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q A Wp Wq HP Hpq HpW HqW.
  assert (HpWq : G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: Wq <: Wq })
    by (eapply ty_sngl; eauto).
  destruct (HP p A (ex_intro _ Wp (ex_intro _ Wp HpW)))
    as [W [HpWtight Hb]].
  destruct (Hb Wq Wq HpWq) as [HqW_W HWq].
  destruct (Hb Wp Wp HpW) as [HpW_W HWWp].
  (* p↓A <: Wp <: W <: Wq <: q↓A *)
  eapply subtyp_trans.
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + eapply subtyp_trans.
      * eapply subtyp_sel1. exact HpW.
      * exact HpW_W.
    + (* W <: Wq *) exact HWq.
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact HqW.
Qed.

(* Corollary for the exact detour shape: an arrow whose *domain* is a
   selection can be re-oriented across an alias, so the contravariant
   domain obligation of [ArrowOpen] is met for singleton-replacement
   steps where the domains are selections of aliased paths. *)
Lemma arrow_domain_sel_alias_of_Prov :
  forall γ G (p q:path) (A:typ_label) Wp Wq S T T0 V0,
    Prov γ G ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : {{ q }} ->
    G ⊢ trm_path p : typ_rcd { A >: Wp <: Wp } ->
    G ⊢ trm_path q : typ_rcd { A >: Wq <: Wq } ->
    G ⊢ (∀(p ↓ A) V0) <: ∀(S) T ->
    G ⊢ S <: p ↓ A.
Proof.
  intros γ G p q A Wp Wq S T T0 V0 HP Hpq HpW HqW Hsub.
  (* invert the arrow subtyping at the trans-free level is not available
     for the full relation; this corollary is only stated for the
     selection-comparison component it can prove. *)
  exact (sel_bound_alias_of_Prov HP Hpq HpW HqW).
Qed.

Lemma Q2_sngl_cl_proof : Q2_sngl_cl_statement.
Proof.

  - (* arrow *) intros U Hsub Har.

    + apply pt3. exact Hp.
    + apply fs_sngl.

  - (* field *) intros a S E. discriminate E.
  - (* and *) intros T1 T2 E. discriminate E.
  - (* mu *) intros T0 E. discriminate E.

  - (* sg_rcd_intro *) apply Hrcd; eauto.

  - (* sg_rec_elim *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0' Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.

  - (* sg_and_intro *) apply Hand; eauto.
  - (* sg_and_l *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.

  - (* sg_and_r *) inversion IHHs as [p0 T0 Harr Hfld Hand' Hbnd Hsngl']; subst.

  - (* sg_sngl *) apply Hsng; eauto.
  - (* sg_sngl_trans *) eapply Hsngl; eauto.
  - (* sg_path_elim *) eapply Hpath; eauto.
Qed.

  exact (Harr A (subtyp_refl G A) Har).
